title: Test Data Management Analyst - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Test Data Management Analyst - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in guiding our clients through the complexities of Guidewire Testing within our Advisory - Other competency network. You will leverage your skills to deliver exceptional client support in the Banking and Capital Markets sector, driving impactful solutions that align with their business objectives. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be at the forefront of our Business & Supply Chain Operations network, working closely with clients to optimize their Life, Annuity & Group Benefits Operations. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by driving client engagement workstreams and delivering high-quality deliverables.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manages test data provisioning, masking, and refresh processes for all DNA testing phases. Builds on the test data framework from Systematics, applies it to DNA data structures, and ensures reliable data availability for each DNA test cycle.
* Coordinating with cross-functional teams to integrate Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications effectively
* Developing and executing automation testing strategies to enhance testing efficiency and accuracy
* Providing coaching and feedback to team members to foster professional growth and improve testing methodologies
* Analyzing testing results to identify areas for improvement and optimize testing processes
* Collaborating with clients to understand their business needs and tailor testing solutions accordingly
* Managing stakeholder expectations and maintaining strong client relationships throughout project lifecycles
* Utilizing analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve complex testing issues
* Promoting the adoption of innovative testing practices and tools to drive continuous improvement

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* 9+ years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Test data management and synthetic data generation
* SQL / ETL for data provisioning
* DNA banking data structures
* Coordination with data migration and testing workstreams

title: Senior Integration Solutions Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Kolkata, India
  
  
**Function:**
(DEAI HV) Product
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
R0137531
  
  
**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Integration Solutions Engineer is responsible for architecting, validating, and documenting enterprise solutions leveraging S3-compatible object storage. This role works across data protection, analytics, AI/ML, search, and modern data lakehouse platforms to ensure solution interoperability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. The engineer functions as a technical authority, designing validation strategies, developing performance benchmarks, troubleshooting complex environments, and publishing best-practice guidance for customers and partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Validation**

* Validate partner solutions including data protection, analytics, observability, search, and data lake platforms.
* Design and validate end-to-end reference architectures leveraging S3-compatible object storage for data protection, analytics, search, AI/ML, and data lake workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify strategic integration opportunities for object storage platforms.
* Define validation methodologies that accurately reflect real-world customer deployment scenarios.
* Work directly with engineering, product management, partners, and field teams to ensure successful solution integration and deployment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for object storage integration patterns, performance characteristics, and best practices.

**Integration & Performance Testing**

* Develop and execute comprehensive integration, interoperability, scalability, and performance test plans.
* Design benchmark tests that characterize throughput, latency, concurrency, and scalability under production-scale workloads.
* Build automated validation frameworks and test environments that improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Identify performance bottlenecks across storage, network, compute, application, and infrastructure layers.

**Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate complex issues spanning distributed applications, object storage systems, networking, operating systems, and cloud-native technologies.
* Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and telemetry data to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Reproduce field and customer-reported issues and work with development teams to validate resolutions.
* Provide technical leadership during escalations involving partner integrations and strategic customer environments.
* Publish validated reference architectures, deployment guides, solution briefs, and technical whitepapers.
* Develop sizing guidance, architecture recommendations, and performance tuning documentation.
* Present technical findings to customers, partners, sales engineers, and executive stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing, validating, or supporting enterprise-scale data platform, storage, or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Strong background in integration testing, performance testing, or solution validation.
* Proven troubleshooting experience with distributed applications and multi-tier architectures.
* Experience with object storage technologies and S3-compatible APIs.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate complex technical challenges independently.
* Excellent written communication skills with experience creating technical documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or other data protection platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk, or large-scale search and observability platforms.
* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Starburst, Databricks, or similar data analytics technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML data pipelines and data lake architectures.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native environments.
* Experience authoring technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and reference architectures.
* Experience presenting technical findings to customers and executive audiences.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and system administration concepts.
* Proficiency in Python, scripting, or test automation development.

**About Us**
We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Specialist - Application Security
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
Specialist - Application Security
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req32550**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* The Specialist in this position will plan and deliver web, API and mobile VAPT engagements within agreed scope, quality and timelines
* You will perform manual and automated testing; validate findings and eliminate false positives
* And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof-of-concept steps and practical remediation actions
* You will need to retest fixes, confirm closure and record residual risk or exceptions
* And maintain test cases, evidence, reports and engagement records in line with VAPT standards
* Lastly, escalate critical findings and delivery blockers promptly; support critical activities outside business hours when required

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* You must have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline
* And a CEH or relevant web-security / scanner certification preferred
* Must have two to four (2–4) years in application security or an enterprise security team
* And also, at least six months of hands-on web, API or mobile security testing, including manual testing and scanner validation
* Must is knowledge with OWASP, WSTG, MAS, CWE and CVSS, Web, API and mobile black-box/grey-box testing
* You must also know Burp Suite, Qualys WAS/Acunetix, Kali Linux, Nmap and sqlmap, HTTP/S, REST APIs, authentication protocols, mobile controls and network fundamentals

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

**Experienced Associate**

**www.sikich.com)**
is a global company specializing in technology enabled-professional services. title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions.

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance & Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Demonstrates strong AI acumen, with the ability to effectively leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.
* AINS Certifications or other insurance industry certifications.
* CBAP (Certified Business Analyst Professional) or similar business analysis certification.
* Web Services/APIs and ACORD standards experience.

your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/.NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing.
* Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management.
* Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models.
* Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates.
* Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests.
* Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures.
* Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains.
* Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery.
* Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice.

**What You’ll Bring**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically.
* Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and .NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture.
* Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp.
* Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation.
* Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs.
* Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches.
* Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments.
* Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing.
* Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization.
* Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates.
* Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams.
* Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Allure reporting is preferred.
* Experience with Postman is good to have.
* Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments.
* Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products.
* Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous.
* Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC.
* Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software.
* Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews.
* Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

title: Test Lead
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Test Engineer who can own quality across DataWeave's SaaS platform, spanning manual and automation testing, API and data validation, and testing of AI and ML driven features such as pricing insights, recommendations, and LLM powered outputs. This role requires strong testing fundamentals, comfort building and maintaining automation frameworks, and the judgment to design test strategies for features whose outputs are probabilistic rather than deterministic. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and data science to ensure releases are reliable, performant, and trustworthy at scale.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases for new features, covering functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across the DataWeave platform.
* Build and extend automation test suites (UI and API) using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress, integrated into CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable feedback.
* Own API testing end to end: functional, contract, negative, and performance testing of REST and internal service APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent.
* Define and execute test strategies for AI and ML driven features (LLM based insights, recommendations, classification, and NLP or computer vision pipelines), including evaluation of output accuracy, consistency, edge cases, hallucination checks, and regression across model or prompt changes.
* Validate large scale data pipelines and outputs for correctness, completeness, and consistency, working closely with data engineering and data science teams.
* Set up and maintain test data, environments, and mocks needed for repeatable manual and automated testing.
* Triage defects, drive root cause analysis with engineering, and track quality metrics (coverage, defect leakage, automation ROI) to improve release quality over time.
* Contribute to test strategy, tooling choices, and best practices, and mentor junior QA engineers on the team.
* Participate in sprint planning, story grooming, and release readiness reviews, representing the quality and testability point of view.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 4 to 7 years of overall QA/testing experience, with a strong mix of manual and automation testing in a SaaS or product engineering environment.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar) and integrating them into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Strong experience in API testing (REST, JSON/XML payloads) using Postman, RestAssured, or comparable tools, including contract and performance testing.
* Practical exposure to testing AI/ML or LLM powered features, such as evaluating model outputs, prompt regression, accuracy and precision/recall style metrics, or building golden datasets for evaluation.
* Solid understanding of SQL and the ability to validate data in large datasets or data warehouses.
* Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, Java, or JavaScript) for automation and data validation scripts.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery, defect tracking (Jira), and test management tools.
* Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to reason about edge cases in complex, data heavy, AI driven systems.
* Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with engineering, product, and data science stakeholders.
* Proficiency in using at least one of the AI Developer Productivity Tools (like Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor..)
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

title: Solution Test Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About the Opportunity:**
At Ericsson, we're shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge 5G and cloud-native technologies. We're looking for a Solution Test Engineer to lead end-to-end testing, system integration, automation, and validation of Ericsson Private 5G solutions ( BEWS - Private Networks). In this role, you'll work across 5G Core, RAN, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms, drive quality through automation and CI/CD, troubleshoot complex network issues, and collaborate with global teams to deliver world-class telecom solutions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Test Design & Execution: Design and execute detailed E2E system test plans for Ericsson Private 5G (EP5G) solutions, ensuring full coverage of 3GPP features and customer use cases.
* System Integration: Integrate and validate 5G components, including Cloud-Native Core (cn5GC), RAN, and Management/Orchestration platforms, ensuring seamless interoperability.
* Advanced Validation: Own the E2E validation for specific feature sets across performance, scaling, and stability, utilizing CI/CD pipelines for automated regression.
* Protocol Debugging: Perform deep-dive troubleshooting of complex call flows using tools like Wireshark/QXDM to analyze NAS/AS signaling and interfaces (N1, N2, N3, etc.).
* Automation Development: Develop and maintain automated test scripts within a Python/Robot Framework environment to increase test velocity and reliability.
* Stability & Performance Testing: Design and run soak tests, stress tests, and load models to identify memory leaks and system bottlenecks before deployment.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, conduct peer reviews of test cases, and contribute to the team's internal knowledge base.

**Skills You Bring**
Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS, EE, or related field with 6–8 years of experience in Telecom/Network testing.
  
  
5G/4G Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of 3GPP architectures and protocols (NGAP, S1AP, RRC, HTTP/2). Ability to analyze multi-interface traces to isolate faults.
  
  
Cloud-Native Skills: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm. Understanding of K8s networking (Services, Load Balancers, and CNI basics) is essential.
  
  
Networking Foundations: Solid knowledge of L2/L3 networking, including IPV4/V6, VLANs, Routing, and familiarity with OSPF/BGP.
  
  
Automation Proficiency: Strong Python scripting skills and experience with Robot Framework (or similar) to automate complex system-level scenarios.
  
  
System Validation Expertise: Proven ability to design test cases for performance (throughput/latency), scaling, and stability (soak/reliability).
  
  
Infrastructure & Tools: Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments. Experience with industry tools such as Spirent (Landslide), Keysight, or Viavi.
  
  
**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

title: QA Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
As a Software Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive test planning, test execution, and defect management. You will work closely with developers and product teams to identify and address potential issues early in the software development lifecycle. You will be expected to write automated tests using Python and the Robot Framework, contribute to test processes, and manage end-to-end testing to ensure our software products deliver the best user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning & Strategy:

+ Develop comprehensive test plans and test strategies for software applications based on requirements and specifications.
+ Define test cases, test data, and create a clear roadmap for testing activities.

* Automated Testing:

+ Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
+ Design and develop reusable and scalable automated tests for both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., performance, security).
+ Integrate automated tests with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

* End-to-End Testing:

+ Lead and perform end-to-end testing for the entire software product, ensuring that all parts of the system work together as expected.
+ Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and functional testing across multiple environments.
+ Identify, reproduce, and document defects and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution.

* Test Execution & Reporting:

+ Execute both manual and automated test cases across various platforms (web, desktop, etc.).
+ Track, report, and prioritize defects and issues found during testing, ensuring proper communication with relevant teams.
+ Ensure thorough test coverage by validating the full functionality of the product, including edge cases.

* Continuous Improvement:

+ Collaborate with development teams to improve the testing process, quality practices, and automation strategies.
+ Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to continuously improve testing workflows.

* Collaboration & Communication:

+ Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, review user stories, and ensure proper test coverage.
+ Provide detailed feedback and suggestions to the development team to enhance the quality of the product.

**Requirements**

* Educational Qualifications:

+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Relevant Experience:

+ 3-7 years of experience as a Software Quality Engineer or equivalent.

* Technical Skills:

+ Proficient in Python programming for test automation and scripting.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Robot Framework for automated testing.
+ Solid understanding of Test Process and Test Lifecycle (requirement analysis, test planning, test execution, defect management, etc.).
+ Experience with end-to-end testing of software applications, ensuring full coverage of all functionality.
+ Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and integrating tests into automated pipelines.
+ Knowledge of version control systems like Git and experience with branching and merging strategies.

* Testing Experience:

+ Strong background in manual testing (functional, regression, smoke, and system testing).
+ Experience in automated testing, with a deep understanding of test frameworks and tools.
+ Familiar with test case design, test execution, and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail).
+ Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) is a plus.

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
+ Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

* Nice to Have:

+ Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
+ Experience with medical device/biomedical device is a plus.
+ Exposure to agile methodologies and familiarity with Agile tools like Jira, Trello, or Asana.

* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

* Expertise in across the levels of virtualization, from L1 to L4 and with both Open and closed loop simulation.

This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world.**
****Company Culture****
**Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here.**

**Visteon is a global technology company serving the mobility industry, dedicated to creating a more enjoyable, connected and safe driving experience. The company’s platforms leverage proven, scalable hardware and software solutions that enable the digital, electric, and autonomous evolution of our global automotive customers. Visteon products align with key industry trends and include digital instrument clusters, displays, Android-based infotainment systems, domain controllers, advanced driver assistance systems and battery management systems. Visteon reported sales of approximately $2.8 billion and booked $5.1 billion of new business in 2021.**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights that help clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape and technology environment as we partner with them to transform their businesses.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for leading offensive security engagements and helping clients identify, validate, and remediate vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystem.
  
  

* Lead penetration testing workstreams across web, API, mobile, thick-client, network, cloud, and infrastructure environments.
* Design and execute manual and automated security assessments, validate findings, and develop remediation recommendations.
* Perform secure code reviews, application security architecture reviews, and threat modeling to identify design and implementation risks.
* Prepare client-ready reports, executive summaries, technical findings, and presentation materials, and support remediation and retesting discussions with stakeholders.
* Contribute to engagement planning, proposal support, delivery optimization, methodology development, and mentoring of junior team members.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber Defense & Resilience teams assist clients in identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystems. Through penetration testing, application security assessments, attack surface management, red teaming, and purple teaming, our professionals help clients understand how threat actors may exploit weaknesses across applications, networks, cloud environments, endpoints, and enterprise systems. The team combines offensive security expertise with practical defensive recommendations. Our work helps clients improve detection, response, remediation, and overall cyber resilience while aligning technical findings to business priorities and risk objectives.

* 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, application security, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or cyber risk services.

* Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Fiddler, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, Qualys, Tenable, Veracode, Frida, Apktool, JADX, dnSpy, or IDA Pro.

* Experience developing security testing automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Experience supporting executive briefings and presenting technical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. **Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Fixed Income Testing Analyst with strong knowledge of fixed income

products, investment analytics, and data validation. The role will support testing, analysis,

and validation of fixed income data, risk measures, performance calculations, and portfolio

analytics within investment management platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong

analytical skills, experience with investigating data discrepancies, and an understanding of

fixed income instruments, performance attribution, performance and risk analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Design, execute, and maintain functional, integration, regression, and data-validation test

scenarios for fixed income investment management platforms.

 Validate fixed income data, portfolio attributes, returns, benchmarks, attribution outputs,

risk metrics, and reporting results.

including pricing, cash flows, accrued interest, duration, convexity, yield, spread, and

sensitivity measures.

 Analyze fixed income risk, attribution, and analytics outputs to ensure accuracy and

completeness.

 Investigate data discrepancies, calculation issues, and testing exceptions through root

cause analysis and defect resolution.

 Perform data quality reviews and collaborate with Performance Management, Fund

Operations, Technology, and Data teams to resolve issues.

 Support user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, production checks, and issue

triage activities.

documentation.

measurement, testing, and reporting.

 Business analysis and platform-testing experience within investment management.

Experience validating calculation engines, market and reference data, security-level and

portfolio-level results, and upstream/downstream interfaces is highly desirable.

Proficiency in SQL, Excel, Agile delivery, requirements traceability, UAT, regression

measures, and portfolio reporting.

bonds, agency securities, structured products, swaps, futures, options, and other fixed

income derivatives.

calculations, and reports.

 Strong analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-

management skills.

 Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into comprehensive test

scenarios and expected results.

 Fixed Income Risk Analytics

 Performance Measurement

 Investment Analytics

 Portfolio Analytics

 Data Quality Validation

 Reconciliation & Exception Analysis

income analytics, attribution, risk, or performance measurement experience on other

investment platforms will also be considered.

 Familiarity with SQL, data-query tools, test-management tools, and defect-tracking

platforms.

 Knowledge of fund accounting, portfolio accounting, market data, and investment

operations.

 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science,

or a related discipline; relevant investment or testing certifications are advantageous.

We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team.

* The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
* You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
* The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description: DescriptionAmazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.Key job responsibilities Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews. Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.A day in the lifeYou start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.About The TeamWe are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Experience programming with at least one software programming languagePreferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalentOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.Company - ADCI HYD 13 SEZJob ID: A10561005

About the Role
  
  
At Amazon, we're looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE III) who are passionate about solving complex technical challenges and building innovative, scalable solutions that impact millions of customers worldwide. As part of Amazon's engineering organization, you'll work on the latest technologies, collaborate with world-class engineers, and develop products and services that power one of the world's most customer-centric companies.
  
  
Our engineers solve some of the most challenging technical problems at global scale—designing highly available distributed systems, driving architectural innovation, and delivering exceptional customer experiences. Amazon's culture of Customer Obsession, Ownership, Invent and Simplify, and Learn and Be Curious empowers engineers to innovate, take bold decisions, and make a lasting impact.
  
  
We are actively hiring Software Development Engineer III (SDE III) talent across multiple Amazon businesses in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, and Chennai.

Role Overview
  
  
**As a Software Development Engineer III, You Will**
Design and build highly scalable, reliable, and distributed software systems.
  
  
Own end-to-end technical solutions, from architecture and design through development, deployment, and operational excellence.
  
  
Partner with senior engineers, principal engineers, and technical leaders to solve complex engineering challenges.
  
  
Collaborate with product managers, cross-functional teams, and customers to build innovative, customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Drive technical excellence while contributing to the long-term architectural vision of the organization.
  
  
Mentor engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software solutions using modern technologies.
  
  
Lead architectural discussions and influence technical strategy.
  
  
Build highly available and performant distributed systems.
  
  
Collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
  
  
Continuously improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance.
  
  
Champion engineering best practices, quality, automation, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: Enterprise Integration Specialist - Senior Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
The Officer, Enterprise Integration Specialist will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integrations across cybersecurity, engineering, operations, identity, and data platforms. The role will enable the onboarding of new data sources, automate workflow orchestration, and establish seamless connectivity between enterprise systems to improve operational efficiency, risk visibility, and remediation effectiveness.
  
  
This position will serve as a key technical partner across Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Application Development, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure data flows, system integrations, and business processes are scalable, reliable, and well-governed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Integration & Data Onboarding-***

* Design and implement integrations to onboard new enterprise data sources, including vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, cloud security platforms, and operational tooling.
* Develop API-based, event-driven, and batch integrations to aggregate and normalize data from disparate systems.
* Define and maintain integration standards, schemas, and data mapping frameworks.

***Workflow Automation & Orchestration-***

* Automate end-to-end workflows across security, engineering, operations, and governance processes.
* Enable automated ticket creation, assignment, escalation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Design workflow integrations that improve traceability and reduce manual effort across teams.
* Enterprise Platform Integration

**Build And Maintain Integrations With Platforms Such As**

* Jira
* GitHub / Git-based repositories
* ServiceNow
* IAM
* GCS Data Lakehouse and enterprise data platforms
* Vulnerability management and security scanning solutions
* CI/CD and DevSecOps toolchains
* Asset management and CMDB platforms

**Data Engineering & Analytics-**

* Develop and support data ingestion pipelines, transformations, and enrichment processes.
* Create integration patterns that support enterprise reporting, analytics, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and auditability across integrated systems.

**Stakeholder Collaboration-**

* Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data, Risk, and Business teams to understand integration requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and Engineering Leads to develop integration roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Support onboarding of new platforms, capabilities, and enterprise services.

**Security & Compliance-**

* Ensure integrations comply with enterprise security, privacy, and data governance standards.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection controls.
* Support audit, regulatory, and risk-management initiatives as required.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience with REST APIs, Graph APIs, webhooks, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar integration technologies.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, and identity management systems.
* Knowledge of ETL processes, data pipelines, and enterprise data architectures.
* Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, and workflow automation concepts.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience integrating cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and risk-management platforms.
* Familiarity with SailPoint, cloud platforms, and enterprise data lake architectures.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.

**Success Measures**

* Successful onboarding of new enterprise data sources and platforms.
* Increased automation and reduction of manual process steps.
* Improved visibility, traceability, and reporting across workflows.
* High reliability and scalability of integrations.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and adoption of integrated capabilities.

**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
  
  
We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.
  
  
Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

* Log, reproduce and prioritise defects with enough detail that the implementation partner can act without a follow-up conversation

**Essential**

* Genuine attention to detail, and the discipline to follow a script fully rather than stopping at the first thing that works
