title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**
===============================

**Location:** Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | **Team:** Engineering | **Reporting to:** CTO | **Level**: Senior Individual Contributor

**OVERVIEW**
------------

APEXX is an **independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.** Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: **acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.** Our **routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.** We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by **MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital** and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including **Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an **Engineering Operations Lead** to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
------------------------

### **Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:** take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:** establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:** connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:** oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:** troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

### **Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:** establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:** develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:** coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:** track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:** strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:** translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:** identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

### **AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:** develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:** explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:** strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:** reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:** evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* Strong experience in **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role** within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving **Jira**, including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with **engineering performance metrics**, including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting** to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**, constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Experience working within a **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management** function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**, ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**
---------------

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges — improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
---------------------------

* **Competitive compensation:** that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:** annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:** up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:** for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:** for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:** enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:** opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**
-----------------------------

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to **200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.** We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

**About the role**
------------------

The Pod Lead Engineer is a hands‑on software engineering specialist who leads a small, outcome‑focused delivery pod of 4–5 Pod Engineers. The role combines deep technical contribution with day‑to‑day pod leadership, enabling faster delivery through AI‑assisted / AI‑orchestrated SDLC practices.
  
Unlike a traditional team lead role, the Pod Lead Engineer operates in an AI‑native delivery model where AI tools and agents are used across the SDLC to accelerate requirements, design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release readiness. The Pod Lead Engineer contribute to technical direction, delivery execution, and engineering quality, while maintaining high standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1) Hands‑On Delivery Leadership (Core)**  

* Lead a 4–5 engineer pod by building software alongside the team, taking ownership of design, coding, reviews, and integration while breaking work into small, deliverable increments using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automation, code quality gates).
* Drive frequent delivery of working software by ensuring clear definitions of done, measurable progress, and strong accountability for end‑to‑end delivery outcomes.

**2)AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution**  

* Embed AI across SDLC stages (requirements, design, build, test, deploy, operate) to accelerate solution design, safely generate/refactor code, create tests/automation, and support reviews and documentation.
* Establish pod‑level practices to maximize productivity with clear human accountability for decisions and release readiness, while maintaining required gates (e.g., quality checks, approvals) aligned to organizational standards.

**3)Technical Direction & Engineering Quality**  

* Act as the pod’s technical authority, defining architecture (within guardrails), patterns, component design, and integration approach.
* Own code quality, maintainability, performance, reliability, and security, while establishing pod‑level engineering standards (branching, coding conventions, reviews, CI/CD hygiene).

**4)Pod Management (Small Team Leadership)**  

* Provide day‑to‑day leadership for a 4–5 engineer pod, including task allocation, pairing strategy, prioritization, and removing blockers.
* Coach engineers in AI‑native ways of working (prompting, evaluation, safe AI use) while driving continuous improvement through retrospectives, root cause analysis, and measurable cycle‑time and quality gains.

**5)Stakeholder Alignment & Outcome Ownership**  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, AI Engineering and business/product stakeholders to clarify outcomes, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, translating needs into clear technical milestones and deliverable increments.
* Provide transparent updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions to ensure strong alignment and end‑to‑end outcome ownership.

**6)Governance, Risk, and Responsible Engineering**  

* Ensure adherence to security, data protection, and engineering governance standards while proactively managing risks from AI‑assisted development (e.g., licensing, security vulnerabilities, hallucinated code, weak tests).
* Maintain required auditable artefacts (documentation, traceability, approvals) aligned with enterprise expectations for controlled delivery.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Strong experience as a senior software engineer / technical lead / engineering specialist delivering production systems.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: API design (REST), data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD, secure coding, reliability practices.
* Expertise in Java or .NET or Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
* Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
* Experience leading small delivery groups (e.g., squad/pod/team) and delivering iteratively.
* Practical experience using AI development tools (Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, agent workflows, automated test generation, AI‑assisted documentation).

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in AI‑assisted / agentic delivery models or rapid delivery “pods” / cohort models.
* Familiarity with governance practices with quality and assurance in delivery environments (e.g., gate reviews, readiness checks).

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Implement, test and support well-defined slices of X3 modernisation while developing strong X3 domain knowledge and safe engineering habits.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Strong software engineering experience in modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a proven ability to build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade services.
  
- Solid foundation in software design, object-oriented and distributed systems principles, API-first development, automated testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery practices.
  
- Required understanding of distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency patterns, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, observability, and data consistency trade-offs.
  
- Experience designing and consuming REST, GraphQL, and event-based integrations, with strong understanding of API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and secure service interactions.
  
- Experience working with relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, migration, and operational considerations.
  
- Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, including containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, secure software supply chains, and operational readiness.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Practical experience with modern web application development using React and TypeScript or equivalent modern dynamic UX frameworks, including component-based architectures, responsive and accessible user experiences, state management, browser diagnostics, and automated UI testing.
  
- Ability to learn and work effectively within Sage X3 business processes, metadata-driven architectures, extensibility models, modernization initiatives, and SaaS transformation programs.
  
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed global engineering teams and contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Implement and test service/API contracts and integrations in the assigned discipline; follow secure CI/CD, identity/secrets and telemetry patterns, and contribute compatibility, upgrade and rollback checks. Build hands-on container or IaC skills when required by the owned service, using team-supported paths.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Commercial ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance experience, including L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL.
  
- React, automated API testing, telemetry, batch processing or migration tooling.
  
- Practical use of AI coding assistants with human review and regression checks.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 2+ years of professional software development, or equivalent practical experience. Degree, diploma or apprenticeship in computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Owned work is delivered to agreed acceptance criteria with useful tests and no avoidable regression.
  
- The engineer builds confidence in X3 domain knowledge and contributes to safe modernisation decisions.
  
- Defects, risks and support issues are surfaced early with enough evidence to act.
  
- Learning, review feedback and delivery estimates become more accurate over time.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Senior and Principal Engineers, Automation, Product, Architecture, Security, Cloud Support/L3 and Customer Services. India-based delivery is integrated with distributed squads and planned Europe/North America overlap.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Asks good questions, honours commitments, learns from feedback and keeps quality visible.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Implement features, fixes, APIs, components or migration assets from clear designs and acceptance criteria.
  
- Write maintainable code and automated tests, participate in review, and keep technical documentation and operational notes current.
  
- Learn X3 processes, metadata, Xtrem/X3 architecture and the effect of changes on customers, partners and upgrades.
  
- Use CI/CD, observability and local diagnostics to find problems early; escalate uncertainty with evidence.
  
- Contribute to refactoring, automation, accessibility, performance and reliability improvements within the squad.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Implementation choices within agreed patterns, test coverage for owned changes, and prompt escalation when requirements, customer behaviour, security or rollback are unclear.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead substantial engineering work within a X3 squad, delivering maintainable modern capabilities while protecting X3 behaviour, upgradeability and operational continuity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required Technical and Domain Skills
  
- Strong software engineering experience delivering cloud-native SaaS platforms and distributed systems using modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a track record of building secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready services.
  
- Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including service decomposition, synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, event-driven architectures, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, scalability, observability, eventual consistency, and failure-recovery strategies.
  
- Deep experience designing, developing, and evolving API-first platforms, including REST, GraphQL, event-driven integrations, service contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, security controls, and integration governance.
  
- Experience designing and operating solutions using relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, migration strategies, and operational support.
  
- Strong cloud-native engineering experience across containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, telemetry, secure software supply chains, reliability engineering, release management, upgrade strategies, disaster recovery, and rollback mechanisms.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes.
  
- Experience defining domain boundaries, service ownership models, integration contracts, extensibility frameworks, and modernization patterns that improve maintainability, scalability, and customer continuity.
  
- Strong understanding of modern web application architecture, including React, TypeScript, component-based design, state management, accessibility, responsive design, browser performance optimization, and browser-to-service integration patterns where relevant to the domain.
  
- Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering responsibly with appropriate human review, traceability, automated testing, security validation, and regression evidence.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, participate in architecture reviews, and collaborate effectively across globally distributed engineering teams.
  
Modern Platform Skills for this Role
  
- Own service and API contracts, event-driven integrations, and domain boundaries within the assigned area, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and backward compatibility.
  
- Design and operate distributed services using modern SaaS engineering principles, including observability, performance management, fault isolation, resiliency patterns, capacity planning, and reliability engineering.

- Establish and maintain OpenTelemetry-compatible observability practices, including logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, operational dashboards, alerting strategies, and production diagnostics.

- Senior Software Engineers are expected to design, build, and operate distributed SaaS platforms, own domain-level architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, mentor engineers, and deliver reliable cloud-native services using technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, while leveraging X3 domain knowledge to accelerate transformation rather than as a prerequisite for hiring.

title: Senior Software Engineer 2 - (iOS, Swift)
description:
You will build and ship production iOS apps for a large Indian banking client, where security, performance and release discipline matter more than in a typical consumer app. You will own features end-to-end in Swift — UI, data flow, networking, persistence and App Store release — and be a core part of GeekyAnts' native iOS practice. This is a native-first role, but we are building a mobile team that can flex. Over time you may work on React Native or Flutter projects alongside Swift, with support from our existing teams in both. Candidates who want to stay purely in one stack forever will not be the right fit.

**What you will do:**

* Design, build and maintain iOS features in Swift using UIKit and SwiftUI, following MVVM and clean architecture principles
* Implement secure networking (URLSession, SSL pinning, Codable) and data persistence (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData, UserDefaults) for a banking-grade app
* Write concurrent, responsive code using GCD, OperationQueue, async/await and Combine
* Own quality: unit tests with XCTest, profiling with Instruments, crash triage and fixes
* Handle code signing, provisioning, App Store Connect submissions and release management
* Review code, mentor SE1–SE3 engineers and raise the bar on iOS standards across the team
* Work with the client's product, backend and security teams; translate requirements into technical designs and estimates
* Contribute to presales solutioning (architecture inputs, effort estimates) when needed
* Be open to picking up React Native or Flutter work when project demand shifts

**Must-have skills:**

* 4+ years of hands-on iOS development with at least 2 apps shipped to the App Store.
* Swift & Xcode- Strong Swift (protocols, generics, optionals, value vs reference types), Xcode project structure, UIViewController lifecycle, working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code
* UI — UIKit- Storyboards, Auto Layout, UITableView, UICollectionView, custom views, navigation and modal flows
* UI — SwiftUI- Views, modifiers, stacks, NavigationStack, TabView, List, Form, sheets and modals; can mix SwiftUI with UIKit
* Concurrency- GCD, OperationQueue, async/await, Task, structured concurrency, thread-safety and main-thread discipline
* State & architecture- @State, @Binding, @ObservedObject, @EnvironmentObject, MVVM, dependency injection (Needle, Swinject or similar)
* Reactive & networking- Combine (publishers, operators, cancellables), URLSession, Codable, SSL/certificate pinning, API error handling
* Persistence- UserDefaults, Core Data; exposure to Realm and SwiftData
* Quality & debugging- Xcode debugger, Instruments (Time Profiler, Leaks, Allocations), crash log symbolication, XCTest unit and UI tests
* Release- Code signing, provisioning profiles, App Store Connect, TestFlight, phased releases

**Good to have:**

* Working exposure to React Native or Flutter, or a demonstrated willingness to learn one
* BFSI / fintech experience: PCI-DSS or RBI-aware development, Keychain, jailbreak and tamper detection, secure storage, biometric auth
* CI/CD for iOS (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
* Modular architecture (Swift Package Manager, feature modules), Clean Architecture or VIPER
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type) and localisation
* Experience working in a client-facing or consulting setup

**Who you are:**

* You care about how the app behaves on a slow network and an old iPhone, not just on the simulator
* You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical client stakeholder without hiding behind jargon
* You are comfortable owning a feature from estimate to App Store release, not only the coding part
* You are curious about the wider mobile ecosystem and willing to work across stacks when the business needs it
* You give and take code review feedback well and help junior engineers grow

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT is preferred.
* Candidates with a relevant MCA or equivalent qualification may also be considered.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

The Director, Product Manager - Legal leads a group of Legal Technology Products – spanning Legal Operations and Intellectual Property (IP) within the Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech Domain, ensuring they deliver measurable value, support business processes, and are continuously improved. The Director, Legal Product Manager ensures that Legal & Compliance products are usable, compliant, secure, and efficient to operate, while fostering a culture of agile delivery, value realisation, and continuous improvement across their Product group.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Translate functional strategies provided by the SD, Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech into actionable product roadmaps and delivery priorities across the Legal product group – covering Legal Operations and Intellectual Property as well as the Legal AI Platform products.
* Provide leadership, direction and coaching to Product Owners, ensuring requirements are well-defined, business cases for investment are robust, backlogs are prioritised to support business goals, architectural guidance, compliance needs, data-driven decisions, FinOps considerations, and domain ecosystem dependencies through cross-functional partnering.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand pain points, process challenges, and improvement needs, shaping product enhancements and technology-enabled opportunities.
* Oversee delivery execution across the Legal product group, ensuring the quality, usability, stability, and supportability of released features and services.
* Promote agile and iterative delivery practices (e.g. SaFe, Scrum), supporting incremental value release, transparency of priorities, and improved collaboration with business users. Being comfortable providing product leadership to multiple delivery initiatives at one time.
* Act as the escalation point for critical product performance, delivery issues, and dependency conflicts, addressing risks and facilitating decisions.
* Champion the adoption of user-centred improvements, Legal business process optimisation, and automation/AI opportunities that reduce cycle time and enhance user experience.
* Ensure effective, defensible, risk, security, and compliance management (e.g. ISO controls, GDPR, legal privilege, Information governance requirements) across the Legal product group, embedding relevant controls in partnership with Security, Risk, Legal and Compliance SMEs.
* Support Solution Architects in shaping cross-product and cross-platform solutions, ensuring Product Owners manage dependencies to deliver integrated outcomes.
* Track and report performance against agreed KPIs for the Legal product group, driving continuous improvement activities to maximise value for the Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech Domain.
* Provide financial oversight of the Legal product group, including product budgets and internal/external team resourcing costs, to inform strategic decision‑making and ensure alignment with GSK’s financial objectives.
* Lead Innovation agenda across the Legal & IP products ensuring we are running a top quartile technology stack. Includes staying abreast of advancements of the Legal technology ecosystem
* Ensure investment requests in Legal technology follow the Legal & Compliance Tech & AI board governance, and partner with business leaders to develop robust plans and robust designs as part of approval processes.
* Champion the use of AI, automation and technology in the Legal & Compliance function
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience
* Extensive experience 18+ years overseeing end-to-end product delivery, including prioritisation, backlog management, solution design support, testing oversight, and value-focused release planning – with clear focus on Legal Tech
* Proven track record in overseeing the definition and execution of Legal technology systems in a company of similar size and scale to GSK, realising tangible benefits for the Business.
* Deep experience in concurrently overseeing multiple Product teams across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements elicitation through to release.
* Proficient in conveying complex technology ideas to non-conversant audiences.
* Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing Product use cases and determining their associated value.

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Digital Transformation, Generative AI, Information Governance, Intellectual Property, Legal Technology, Product Management Leadership  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

  

  
* Contribute to Pearson's AgentOps roadmap and enterprise AI strategy.
  
  
* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  
  
* Prompt libraries
  
  
* Agent templates
  
  
* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  

  

**Technology Ecosystem**

  
  

**Agentic AI & Large Language Models**

  

  
* Azure OpenAI
  
  
* OpenAI APIs
  
  
* Claude
  
  
* Enterprise AI Platforms
  
  
* Multi-Agent Frameworks
  

  

**Automation & Orchestration**

  

  
* UiPath Studio
  
  
* UiPath Orchestrator
  
  
* UiPath Agent Builder
  
  
* UiPath Document Understanding
  
  
* Microsoft Power Automate
  

  

**Data, Integration & Enterprise Platforms**

  

  
* REST APIs
  
  
* JSON / XML
  
  
* OAuth
  
  
* Salesforce
  
  
* ServiceNow
  
  
* Oracle
  
  
* BigQuery
  
  
* OCR & Intelligent Document Processing
  

  

**Engineering & Development**

  

  
* Python
  
  
* JavaScript
  
  
* SQL
  
  
* Git & Version Control
  
  
* AI-Assisted Development Tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  
  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  
  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  

  

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

  
  

Deep understanding of:

  

  
* Agentic AI and autonomous systems
  
  
* Intelligent process automation
  
  
* Enterprise integration patterns
  
  
* Human-in-the-loop workflow design
  
  
* AI governance and Responsible AI principles
  
  
* Enterprise architecture frameworks
  
  
* Business process analysis and optimization
  
  
* Risk management, compliance, and security requirements
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

  

  
* Strategic thinking and problem solving
  
  
* Exceptional stakeholder management
  
  
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
  
  
* Executive presence and influence
  
  
* Decision-making under ambiguity
  
  
* Collaboration across global and cross-functional teams
  
  
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by:

  

  
* Enterprise adoption of agentic automation solutions
  
  
* Measurable productivity and efficiency gains
  
  
* ROI realization from automation investments
  
  
* Delivery quality and stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
* Reusability and scalability of solutions
  
  
* Compliance with Responsible AI and governance standards
  
  
* Contribution to Pearson's AI and automation transformation agenda
  

  

**Pearson is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where innovation thrives and every employee can contribute to shaping the future of learning through AI and technology.**

  
  

**Join us in building the future of work, where humans and intelligent agents collaborate to create extraordinary outcomes.**

  
  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

  
  

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

description:
**Technical Content Marketer**

*Location: (On-site) Hyderabad, India*

**What you'll own:**

* **Distribution:** Every piece starts with a plan for who will see it and where. You'll map the channels before you write, adapt the piece for each one and track how it performs.
* **Long-form TOFU pieces:** Write blog posts, newsletters, explainers and research write-ups that make our work appeal to people evaluating AI model training and deployment.
* **BOFU content:** Create landing pages, one-pagers and pitch for our datasets across modalities (audio, languages, coding RL, physical AI and more), our RL environments and our agent observability suite. Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.
* **SEO and AEO:** Plan content around what our buyers search for. Structure pages so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite them.
* **Social media:** Plan and write content for Deccan's LinkedIn, X, and more.
* **Strategic case studies:** Work with customers and our sales team to write case studies that capture why each customer chose Deccan and what it changed for them.
* **Launches and announcements:** Write for funding news, partnerships, product releases and conferences.

**You'll do well here if you**

* **Shun AI slop:** You take your writing personally, and you can't stand content that reads like it came off an assembly line and recognize a technical subject is never an excuse for flat, generic content.

* **Obsess over quality:** You edit your own drafts closely and use feedback to improve the work.

* **Use AI tools well.** You use LLMs for research and first drafts, and you know how to edit the output so it reads like a person wrote it.
* **Enjoy collaboration:** You're comfortable working with researchers, product managers, sales and design to get what a piece needs.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years in B2B content marketing, editorial, journalism or product storytelling, ideally at a dev tools SaaS/technology company.

* Hands-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.

title: APAC Portfolio (Sr.) Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an independent, commercially minded professional to join our Portfolio team and own the identification, evaluation, and advancement of novel pharmaceutical opportunities for our APAC markets, taking each opportunity from first signal to a clear recommendation and driving the agreed next steps.

The role will focus on innovative and differentiated assets, including NCEs, 505(b)(2) products, and other value-added pharmaceutical opportunities, assessing their strategic fit, value, and timing across our key APAC markets to decide where our time and resources are best invested.

The individual will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Business Development, Finance, and other internal teams, integrating their input into a single Portfolio view of each opportunity and a clear recommendation the business can act on.

**Scope and Decision Rights**

The Head of Portfolio APAC sets strategy, priorities, and major portfolio decisions. Within that framework, this role independently drives its own analyses, opportunities, and projects, makes recommendations, and executes the agreed actions. It is expected to move work forward without step-by-step approval and to judge when to involve others:

* **Decides directly:**
  how to scope and structure an evaluation, which data and internal experts to draw on, when a first answer is sufficient, and which opportunities to screen out against agreed criteria.
* **Aligns with the Head of Portfolio APAC:**
  recommendations to advance, pause, or stop an opportunity, changes to priorities, and positions to take with potential partners.
* **Escalates:**
  matters with material financial, legal, IP, or reputational impact, and cross-functional disagreements that cannot be resolved at working level.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own an up-to-date view of the APAC opportunity pipeline across near-, mid-, and long-term horizons, flag gaps and imbalances, and recommend areas for expansion, investment, or rationalization.
* Proactively scan global markets, pipelines, and competitor activity to identify novel product opportunities relevant to APAC, and bring forward those worth pursuing with a clear rationale.
* Lead the evaluation of shortlisted opportunities end-to-end, integrating medical, clinical, IP, regulatory, development, commercial, competitive, and market-access perspectives with timing and economics, and scaling the depth of analysis to what the decision actually requires.
* Build a working understanding of treatment guidelines, clinical practice, patient pathways, unmet needs, and physician preferences in each market, and use it to judge whether an opportunity is genuinely differentiated against current and future standards of care.
* Assess competitive landscape, product differentiation, market potential, pricing, reimbursement, and positioning, distinguishing real, reachable opportunities from theoretical ones.
* Drive product evaluations to a conclusion with Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Medical, and Business Development teams, involving the right people at the right time and reconciling conflicting inputs.
* Build patient-based forecasts, sales potential, and scenario analyses, making key assumptions explicit and identifying which of them drive the decision.
* Identify relevant companies and assets for partnering and licensing opportunities, and recommend, together with Business Development, which to prioritize and how to approach them.
* Plan and follow through on partnering conferences: prioritize target companies, products, and meetings beforehand, and turn outcomes into agreed next steps afterwards.
* Own follow-through on assigned opportunities, keeping evaluation status, partner interactions, and follow-up actions current, and making sure agreed actions are delivered.
* Present assigned areas in periodic portfolio reviews with management in decision-ready form, highlighting key risks, gaps, growth opportunities, the recommended course of action, and the decisions required.

**Ways of Working**

We are looking for someone who, given an objective and the context, works out how to get there: think, decide, act, and follow through. In practice, this means:

* **Own the outcome, not just the task.**
  Start from what needs to be achieved, structure the problem, find and analyze the information needed, reach a conclusion, and follow through until the agreed actions are delivered.
* **Useful answers, fast.**
  Produce a solid first answer quickly, be explicit about what is fact and what is assumption, identify what is missing, and go deeper only where it would change the decision.
* **Always a recommendation.**
  Analysis ends with a position, not a list of findings: “Based on this, I recommend X because Y, and the next step is Z.”
* **Proactive.**
  Spot risks and opportunities before being asked (in an asset, market, patent situation, launch opportunity, competitive development, or portfolio assumption), raise them early, and propose how to address them.
* **Independent, not isolated.**
  Move work forward without needing approval for each step, and know when to bring in Portfolio, BD, Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Medical, Finance, or other functions.
* **Constructive challenge.**
  Question assumptions, analyses, and proposed approaches when there is good reason to, explain why, and bring a better alternative.
* **Clear and concise.**
  Communicate across functions and geographies in a structured, commercially relevant way: what is happening, why it matters, what you think, and what we should do.

**Preferred Profile**

* Degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field; MBA or equivalent business training is an advantage.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in New Product Planning, Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Commercial Strategy, Medical Affairs, or pharmaceutical consulting, including a track record of taking evaluations or projects through to a decision or outcome.
* Strong ability to interpret clinical data and translate it into commercial implications and portfolio recommendations.
* Strong analytical and forecasting skills, combined with the judgment to separate what matters from what does not and to know when an answer is good enough to act on.
* Intellectual curiosity about pharmaceutical innovation and emerging assets, with the commercial sense to tell an interesting asset from a real opportunity for the company.
* Working understanding of how IP, regulatory pathways (including 505(b)(2)), development, and market access shape the value and timing of an asset; deep expertise in every area is not required.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and willing to take a position, defend it with evidence, and revise it when the evidence changes.
* Clear, concise communicator, effective with colleagues and partners across functions, cultures, and geographies.

title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
description:
**About Us**
We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.
  
  
Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.
  
  
You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.
  
  
Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.
  
  
You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.
  
  
Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
* Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
* Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
* Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
* Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
* Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
* Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
* Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
* Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
* Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.

description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Product Development
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Prepaid Management Services global digital presence with over 55+ websites and 10+ mobile application. We are looking for senior specialist to be responsible for maintaining the current portfolio of customer facing channels - Mobile apps, My Account, Commercial platforms. The role holder will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of product features, enhancements and work collaboratively with the relevant regional product, account management, marketing, engineering, Bizops teams, Compliance and Legal to oversee the successful delivery of the changes as well as the launch of new digital platforms and capabilities.
  
  
**The Role**

* Managing the growth of Mastercard’s Prepaid Management Services (MPMS) websites: Including product capabilities, Web, CMS and mobile app updates and constant innovation to drive business success online.
* Attending scrum ceremonies and working closely with internal web and mobile development teams, to improve the user experience and always put the customer first.
* Delivering digital platforms for MPMS and clients, including the launch of new marketing, servicing sites and mobile application.
* Implement digital best practice, improve existing customer experience and drive financial growth with a focus on platform consolidation.
* Use data driven insights to reduce customer friction across our portfolio of websites and mobile apps.
* Provide regular analytical reporting and recommendations based on data.
* Partnering with and supporting regional team (Marketing, Product and Sales in particular) to advise on best practice digital execution and instigate change for the better.

**About You**

* The role requires someone with a strong all-round approach to digital; ranging from content management, launching of new features/functionality in production and a strong desire to innovate and learn from the ecommerce industry.
* Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues.

* Experience in the SAFe/Agile software development lifecycle methodology
* A background in financial services is desirable; knowledge/experience in actively managing websites or mobile apps is a must.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead, Scrum Master
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Major Duties :1. Create empowered, self-organizing, high-performing teams by serving as the team’s servant leader
  
  

* Mentor the team and the Product Owner on Scrum and Agile best practices
* Continuously improve team productivity and facilitate completion of work
* Educate the team, Product Owner and stakeholders on the business value of engineering practices, and promote the use of engineering practices to provide faster delivery, better quality, and fewer defects
* In collaboration with the team and Product Owner, regularly assess the Agile maturity of the team, identify improvement opportunities, and implement the improvements at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team and the organization
* Coach the team on the value and methods of developing cross-functional skills
* Facilitate planning
* Coach the Product Owner on creating and maintaining a continuously prioritized Product Backlog of stories with clear acceptance criteria and high-level estimates
* In collaboration with the team, facilitate the creation of team agreements which minimally include a Definition of Done (DOD) and a Definition of Ready (DOR)
* Facilitate regular Release Planning workshops
* Ensure updates to the plan are communicated to stakeholders
* Facilitate delivery
* In collaboration with the team, identify and mitigate risks, issues and dependencies internal and external to the team
* Remove impediments that prevent the team from delivering work and continuously improving
* Facilitate sprint execution including elaborate planning sessions, sprint planning preparation sessions, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and sprint retrospectives. Team coaching on:
* Creating small stories with thin slices of end-to-end functionality

ii. The value and use of relative estimation
  
  
iii. Executing Design/Build/Test activities daily
  
  
iv. Testing early and often during each sprint
  
  

* Incorporating engineering practices

vi. Completing committed stories in the sprint
  
  
vii. Completing Potentially Shippable
  
  
Increments (PSI) in each sprint
  
  
viii. Correctly and effectively using velocity for planning
  
  

* Time box events to effectively manage the team’s and stakeholders’ time. Create information radiators that automatically and continuously share pertinent information with the team and stakeholders. Increase transparency and aid in internal and external communication and alignment. Read and recommend valuable Lean and Agile books, blogs, articles, etc. to continuously increase the team’s Agile maturity.
* Expertise in Agile principles and practices, with strong technical and / or business knowledge. Provides comprehensive, in-depth consulting and leadership to team and partners at a high technical level.
* Able to facilitate open, fact based discussions, build consensus and reach decisions.
* Carries out moderately complex activities and initiatives involving multiple disciplines and/or ambiguous issues.

Knowledge :Excellent oral and written communication skills, time management and individual and team building skills. Strong interpersonal skills, able to establish strong working relationships and promote bi-directional communication within and across teams and programs.
  
  
Good leadership and organizational skills, skilled in facilitation, continuous improvement, empowerment, transparency, building trust and servant leadership. Able to effectively manage challenging situations through negotiation and conflict resolution.
  
  
Strong understanding of all facets of the software development life cycle including planning, development, quality assurance, change management and release management.
  
  
Strong understanding of software development methodologies and fundamentals (Agile, SCRUM, Kanban, Waterfall, etc.) Strong knowledge and experience with Agile techniques such as Continuous Integration, automated testing, test-first approaches such as TDD, ATDD, etc., pairing, Agile games, etc.
  
  
Able to organize, moderate and demonstrate Agile industry best practices. Experience with developing and executing plans, meeting deadlines, coordinating timelines and efforts and applying advanced principles, theories and experiences.
  
  
Experience :A College or University degree and relevant proven work experience of Agile practical usage in the role of Scrum Master is required. Experience with Agile Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools (JIRA, Rally/CA Agile Central, VersionOne, etc.) preferred. Certified Scrum Professional and/or certified Scrum Master preferred.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Product Executive
description:
* **Company Description**

* **Experience:**

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.
