title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
description:
**About Us**
We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.
  
  
Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.
  
  
You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.
  
  
Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.
  
  
You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.
  
  
Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
* Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
* Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
* Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
* Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
* Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
* Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
* Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
* Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
* Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
* Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

* Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
* Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
* Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
* Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
* Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
* The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
* Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
* Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
* A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
* The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
* A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
* Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
* Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
* Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
* Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
* Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
* Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
* Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
* Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
* Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

**What We Offer**

* A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
* Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
* The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
* The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

**How To Apply**
Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:
  
  

* Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
* Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
* Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
* AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
* Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

- Take ownership of campaign execution, performance analysis, and continuous improvement.

2. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Develop campaign strategies based on business objectives, customer segments, locations, and stages of the customer journey.

- Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, ad creatives, and campaign structures.

- Build and optimize search, display, remarketing, and other relevant paid campaign formats.

- Develop full-funnel advertising strategies to attract new customers, nurture interested audiences, and drive conversions.

- Collaborate with content and design teams to create effective advertisements, messaging, and landing-page experiences.

- Monitor cost per lead (CPL), customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), and revenue contribution.

- Identify underperforming campaigns, reduce wasted spend, and reallocate budgets toward better-performing audiences and campaigns.

- Conduct regular creative, audience, offer, and campaign experiments to improve results.

- Ensure appropriate conversion tracking and attribution are in place to evaluate campaign performance.

3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Analyze website journeys and conversion funnels to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement.

- Optimize landing pages, product pages, enquiry forms, booking flows, calls to action, and other conversion elements.

- Conduct A/B testing and structured experiments to evaluate changes in messaging, design, offers, and user experience.

- Use analytics and user-behaviour insights to understand visitor interactions and reasons for drop-offs.

- Improve the alignment between advertisements, landing pages, customer expectations, and conversion objectives.

- Work with design and development teams to implement and measure website improvements.

- Track the impact of changes on conversion rates, lead quality, booking completion, and revenue.

4. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting

- Establish and maintain reliable measurement frameworks for paid campaigns, website activity, leads, bookings, and revenue.

- Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Ads reporting, Meta Ads Manager, and other relevant analytics tools.

- Configure and monitor conversion events, campaign tracking, attribution, and performance dashboards.

- Analyze customer acquisition costs, campaign efficiency, audience behaviour, landing-page performance, and conversion funnels.

- Prepare regular reports highlighting key metrics, campaign outcomes, trends, challenges, and recommended actions.

- Identify tracking gaps and reporting discrepancies and coordinate their resolution.

- Use data to determine which campaigns and channels should be optimized, scaled, or discontinued.

- Present actionable performance insights to management and connect marketing investments with business outcomes.

5. Lead Generation & Revenue Growth

- Develop digital acquisition strategies to generate qualified enquiries and increase online bookings.

- Identify opportunities to improve the quality of leads generated through paid campaigns.

- Work with the sales and operations teams to understand lead outcomes, customer requirements, and conversion challenges.

- Analyze the complete funnel from advertisement engagement and website visits to enquiries, bookings, and revenue.

- Develop remarketing and lead-nurturing strategies to re-engage potential customers who have not completed a purchase.

- Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition efficiency and maximize returns from existing marketing budgets.

- Support the development of campaigns for key products, destinations, adventure activities, and target customer segments.

- Use customer and campaign data to identify opportunities for repeat purchases, cross-selling, and improved customer value where relevant.

6. Campaign Planning & Creative Optimization

- Plan and execute campaigns around business priorities, seasonal demand, destination-specific requirements, and promotional opportunities.

- Develop campaign briefs covering objectives, target audiences, messaging, budget, expected outcomes, and measurement criteria.

- Work with designers, content creators, and other stakeholders to develop compelling ad creatives and campaign assets.

- Test different creative formats, headlines, calls to action, and value propositions.

- Monitor creative fatigue and audience saturation, refreshing campaigns when required.

- Maintain consistency in brand messaging across advertisements, landing pages, and other customer touchpoints.

- Evaluate campaign results and document learnings to improve future initiatives.

7. Collaboration & Execution

- Work closely with management to align growth priorities with business and revenue objectives.

- Coordinate with sales, operations, content, design, and technology teams to execute growth initiatives.

- Translate performance insights into clear action plans with defined priorities and deadlines.

- Manage external agencies, freelancers, and marketing partners where required.

- Maintain structured documentation of campaigns, budgets, experiments, and performance outcomes.

- Take ownership of execution and ensure that identified opportunities translate into measurable improvements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against agreed business targets, including:

- Qualified leads and online bookings generated.

- Customer acquisition cost (CAC) and cost per lead (CPL).

- Return on ad spend (ROAS) and advertising efficiency.

- Website and landing-page conversion rates.

- Lead-to-booking and visitor-to-customer conversion rates.

- Revenue generated and contribution from paid marketing.

- Campaign performance and budget utilization.

- Improvement in funnel performance and reduction in drop-offs.

- Quality and accuracy of marketing analytics and reporting.

- Timely execution of growth experiments and optimization initiatives.

Targets will be established based on current performance, available budgets, business priorities, and market conditions.

Required Qualifications & Skills

3 to 7 years of relevant experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, paid acquisition, or digital marketing.

- Demonstrated hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

- Strong understanding of campaign optimization, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.

- Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising dashboards, and conversion tracking.

- Understanding of CAC, CPL, ROAS, attribution, conversion funnels, and revenue measurement.

- Experience optimizing landing pages and improving website conversion rates.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable decisions.

- Experience planning, executing, and evaluating marketing experiments.

- Ability to manage budgets, prioritize initiatives, and work toward measurable targets.

- Strong communication and coordination skills, with a hands-on approach to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or performance-driven business.

- Experience targeting international audiences or managing campaigns across multiple geographies.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation, lead-nurturing systems, and remarketing tools.

- Experience with online bookings, e-commerce, lead-generation platforms, or service-based businesses.

- Experience working with design and development teams on landing-page and funnel improvements.

- Ability to connect marketing performance with customer acquisition, bookings, and commercial outcomes.

Why Join ASC360?

- Ownership: Build and scale ASC360’s paid acquisition and digital growth function.

- Business impact: Directly influence qualified leads, bookings, customer acquisition costs, and revenue.

Hands-on execution: Combine strategic planning with campaign management, testing, and optimization.

- Global opportunities: Help expand ASC360’s reach across domestic and international markets.

- Cross-functional exposure: Work closely with leadership and teams across sales, operations, marketing, and technology.

- Purpose-driven business: Contribute to making adventure activities safer through specialized insurance solutions, medical assistance, and evacuation coordination.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will build a structured, measurable, and scalable growth marketing function for ASC360. They will improve paid acquisition efficiency, generate qualified leads, increase booking conversions, optimize marketing budgets, and establish reliable reporting that connects campaign performance with business results.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, takes ownership of outcomes, and can turn data, experimentation, and customer insights into sustainable business growth.

* Help hire and train new team members

* Care about whether content sells, not only about views and likes

It is a bonus if you have worked with an ecommerce or D2C brand, especially gifting or jewellery, or with freelance creators.

Bring 5 to 10 videos you managed, and what results they got, to your interview.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About the Function**

The Product Management function at MakeMyTrip sits at the core of how we build, scale, and reimagine travel. By bringing together technology, data, design, and business insight, it creates seamless experiences for millions of travelers across discovery, personalization, payments, and loyalty.

Our PM teams act as mini-CEOs — shaping strategy, translating insights into impact, and pushing the boundaries of travel tech to make MMT a truly product-first organization.

Within this, myBiz — MakeMyTrip's comprehensive business travel suite — is redefining how organizations manage corporate travel end to end. The Post Sales charter focuses on everything that happens after a booking is made: servicing, support, modifications, and issue resolution, ensuring corporate travelers and travel admins get a fast, reliable, and delightful experience at every step.

**About the Role**

The Product Manager role for myBiz Post Sales is centered around building high-impact, AI-led solutions that transform how corporate travelers are serviced after booking. The incumbent will own the Voice Bot and conversational AI experience within the post-sales journey — driving automation, deflection, and quality across customer interactions.

A core focus of this role is leveraging AI to power the Voice Bot, systematically measuring and improving its quality through evaluation frameworks (Evals) and customer frustration scoring, and continuously expanding the range of use cases the bot can resolve autonomously. A key success metric is measuring actual agent handoff and consistently reducing it through smarter, higher-quality automation.

This role demands a strong product mindset, comfort with AI/ML-driven products and data, and close collaboration with business, tech, design, and analytics teams. The Product Manager will be expected to deeply understand post-sales pain points, prioritize impactful initiatives, and deliver outcomes that improve customer experience and operational efficiency for myBiz.

**What will you be doing**

* Owning the AI-powered Voice Bot roadmap for the myBiz post-sales journey — conceptualizing and building accurate, scalable, and impactful conversational experiences that resolve customer needs autonomously.
* Defining and driving the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-led servicing to deliver measurable improvements in automation, deflection, and customer satisfaction.
* Building and operationalizing Evals (evaluation frameworks) to measure Voice Bot quality, accuracy, and reliability, and driving consistent quality improvements based on these signals.
* Defining, measuring, and improving customer frustration scores across bot interactions, and using these insights to refine flows and responses.
* Measuring actual agent handoff rates and driving initiatives to systematically reduce handoffs through higher-quality automation and expanded coverage.
* Continuously identifying and adding new post-sales use cases for the Voice Bot to handle, expanding automation coverage while maintaining quality.
* Collaborating closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance, AI/ML, and customer support teams to ensure seamless execution of product releases.
* Owning and tracking key product KPIs, analyzing performance continuously, and iterating post-launch to strengthen adoption and experience.
* Building strong product insights through consistent customer engagement, conversation analysis, market research, and competitive benchmarking.
* Creating a seamless and differentiated service experience for corporate travelers and travel admins within the myBiz ecosystem.
* Demonstrating a passion for data, problem-solving and simplifying complex experiences to deliver intuitive, high impact solutions.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 1-3 years of experience in a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business or product environment.
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, conversational AI, or automation is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

**Key Success Factors for the Role**

* Customer Centricity: A deep passion for understanding and improving customer and partner experiences.
* Ownership & Execution: Ability to translate ideas into impactful products through structured execution and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strategic Thinking: Aptitude for building long-term product vision aligned with business goals.
* Analytical Rigor: Data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision-making, especially around Evals, quality metrics, and handoff reduction.
* Innovation & Agility: Eagerness to experiment with AI, learn quickly, and adapt solutions to dynamic market needs.
* Communication & Influence: Strong ability to articulate product vision and rally teams around shared outcomes.

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.

Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.

title: Capability Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Data Product Capability Manager is a senior, hybrid role that combines the strategic focus of a data product owner with the cross-functional coordination responsibilities of a capability manager. This individual will own the definition, prioritization, and delivery of enterprise data capabilities - establishing the structure for how structured data is identified, governed, and consumed across the organization. Reporting into the Product Management organization, the role serves as the central connective tissue between business stakeholders, data domain owners, IT delivery, and data governance functions, ensuring that data products are developed in alignment with enterprise strategy, quality standards, and business value objectives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Strategy Management & Roadmap Ownership: Define and maintain the enterprise data capability roadmap in alignment with overall business strategy. Identify data investment priorities, manage the capability backlog, and communicate progress and value delivery to senior stakeholders
* Vendor & Internal Data Needs Assessment: Evaluate and document structured data requirements across both vendor-sourced and internally generated datasets. Partner with procurement, legal, and data architecture teams to assess fit, feasibility, and compliance of data supply options
* Business & Domain Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with business and domain owners to identify and validate authoritative data sources (Systems of Truth / SOTs) and key attribute requirements. Facilitate workshops and working sessions to surface data needs, resolve conflicts, and build shared understanding of data definitions
* IT Partnership & Agile Delivery Planning: Collaborate with IT and engineering teams to translate data capability requirements into delivery plans using agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum). Participate in sprint planning, PI planning, and backlog grooming to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution
* Data Governance Support & Stewardship: Support and actively contribute to enterprise data governance frameworks, policies, and practices. Work with data stewards and governance councils to ensure data capabilities are developed and maintained in compliance with data standards, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations
* Data Quality Management: Define and enforce data quality standards, metrics, and SLAs for owned data products. Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to implement monitoring, remediation, and continuous improvement processes that ensure fitness-for-purpose data across the enterprise
* Data Product Definition & Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise data products - from ideation and requirements definition through development, launch, and sunset. Ensure data products are well-documented, discoverable, and aligned to measurable business outcomes
* Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation path for data capability delivery across business, IT, and governance functions. Manage stakeholder expectations, facilitate issue resolution, and deliver regular status updates and executive-level reporting
* Data Maturity & Capability Development: Assess the current state of enterprise data capabilities against industry benchmarks and organizational goals. Develop and execute maturity improvement plans that elevate the organization's ability to manage, consume, and derive value from data assets
* Metadata & Data Catalog Stewardship: Champion the adoption and maintenance of enterprise metadata standards and data catalog tools. Ensure critical data attributes, lineage, and ownership are documented and accessible to enable data discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in product management, data management, or a related discipline, with demonstrated accountability for delivering data or technology capabilities in a complex enterprise environment
* Hands-on experience working in agile delivery environments; proficiency with agile frameworks such as Scrum, and familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent
* Experience supporting or leading data governance initiatives, including data quality programs, data stewardship models, or regulatory compliance efforts (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
* Solid understanding of structured data concepts including data modeling, data dictionaries, systems of record/truth, master data management, and enterprise data architecture principles
* Proven ability to elicit, document, and prioritize data requirements from business and domain stakeholders, including the ability to reconcile conflicting priorities and drive alignment
* Proven exceptional cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across business, IT, and executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant certifications such as CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), SAFe Product Owner/Manager, or equivalent data or agile credentials
* Experience with vendor evaluation and management, including RFI/RFP processes for data and technology solutions
* Experience on US Healthcare Domain
* Experience in a capability management, product ownership, or enterprise program management role within a data & analytics, enterprise architecture, or digital transformation context
* Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools such as Alation, Collibra, Informatica, or Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of cloud data platform ecosystems (e.g., Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) and their implications for data product design and delivery

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you'll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You'll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.
  
NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

* At least 15+ years' overall experience, preferably across procurement, strategic sourcing or enterprise platforms

* Experience preparing test strategies, scripts and test data, coordinating UAT, managing defects and supporting release readiness

**Qualification Requirements**

* Tertiary qualification in a related industry, Business, Information Technology or Supply Chain

**Essential capabilities**

* Strong functional knowledge of strategic sourcing, procurement and Source-to-Contract processes, including sourcing events, supplier onboarding, contracting and supplier management
* Hands-on capability in platform configuration, business rules, templates, user roles, permissions and system controls
* Ability to design, configure and govern multi-level approval workflows, delegations, exception paths and segregation-of-duties controls
* Strong testing capability across unit, system integration, regression and user acceptance testing, including traceability from requirements to evidence and defects
* Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and practical platform solutions
* People leadership, stakeholder management, project delivery, quality, risk and audit discipline

**Key Accountabilities**

* Own functional configuration and operational support for strategic sourcing and procurement platforms
* Elicit, challenge and document business requirements, process maps, functional specifications and acceptance criteria
* Configure and maintain sourcing templates, approval flows, roles, permissions, business rules, notifications and controls
* Plan and execute unit, integration, regression and UAT activities; maintain requirements traceability, evidence and defect resolution
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Technology, Risk and vendors to deliver controlled releases and sustainable solutions

A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:
  
Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It's a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.
  
  
More focus on you:
  
We're committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities
  
  
Join NAB India:
  
This is your chance to join NAB India and along with your experience and expertise to help shape an innovation driven organisation that focuses on making a positive impact in the lives of its customers, colleagues and communities.

title: Transformation Leader-Master Black Belt
description:
The Transformation Leader (Insurance) is responsible for driving end-to-end operational transformation across Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier & broker operations. The role focuses on improving efficiency, scalability, service quality, and profitability through process redesign, digitization, operating model changes, and data-driven decision making.

The role would be responsible for the effective delivery of the Transformation Roadmaps and projects for the clients with a distinctive focus on deploying digital technologies like Robotics, Machine Learning, Intelligent automations, Generative AI, etc. by working with cross-functional global teams to favourably impact to the business outcomes of the customer.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Operational Transformation**

• Lead large-scale transformation initiatives across core broker operations, including:

• Policy placement & renewals

• Endorsements & mid-term adjustments

• New business onboarding

• Claims coordination & servicing

• Carrier interactions and compliance

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and cost drivers; redesign processes using Lean / Six Sigma principles.

• Standardize workflows across lines of business, geographies, and acquired broker entities.

**2. Digital & Automation Enablement**

• Drive adoption of digital tools, workflow platforms, and automation (RPA, OCR, straight-through processing).

• Partner with IT, vendors, and Insurtech to modernize broker management systems (BMS), CRM, and document management.

• Enable data integration between carriers, brokers, and internal systems.

**3. Operating Model & Organization Design**

• Define target operating models aligned to growth, M&A, and client segmentation strategies.

• Optimize role clarity, spans of control, and sourcing models (onshore/offshore/shared services).

• Support post-merger integration for acquired brokerages.

**4. Performance & Analytics**

• Establish operational KPIs and dashboards (e.g., turnaround time, hit ratios, cost per policy, error rates).

• Embed performance management routines and continuous improvement culture.

• Use data to drive prioritization of transformation initiatives.

**5. Change & Stakeholder Management**

• Lead change management across frontline teams, leaders, and partners.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

• Communicate vision, progress, and impact clearly and consistently.

**Skillset**

* 12–18+ years of experience in insurance, with deep exposure to P&C broker or carrier operations
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformation or operational excellence programs
* Strong understanding of broker workflows, carrier interactions, and regulatory requirements
* Experience working with senior executives and cross-functional teams
* Experience in setting up process measurement systems with advance visualization tools to implement real time monitoring frameworks and platforms
* Proficiency in data and analytical tools like control charts, descriptive statistics, box charts, hypothesis testing etc
* Certifications in Project Management, Automation, Design Thinking will be preferred.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and risk-taking abilities.
* Strong Quantitative and problem-solving ability: Ability to conceptualize complex problems and develop an Analytical Road map for them
* Experience of leading and driving strategic initiatives for COO, CFO and CIO personas
* Proven experience in driving continuous improvements across teams using Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Digital and Automation Solutions, Advanced Analytics and GenAI
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management with ability to work in diverse teams and with multiple stakeholders
* Facilitative Leadership skills – Influencing skills, mentoring and coaching – to be able to drive change

* **Qualifications**
* MBA / Post Graduation in any discipline
* Certified Project Manager/ Master Black Belt
* Certified in RPA/Digital
* Certified Design Thinking

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Sr Product Manager, Financial Services**

**Location: Ahmedabad | Experience: 4+ years in Product Management**

**About the Role**

Delhivery is building a platform to help transporters and fleet owners access financial and vehicle-related services through one platform. With FASTag, payments, wallet and GPS journeys already launched, the next phase includes expanding banking partnerships, automating payments, launching fuel service and building lending capabilities.

As Product Manager for Financial Services, you will own initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work closely with engineering, business, operations, finance, compliance and external partners to deliver reliable products that simplify customers’ daily operations.

**What You Will Do**

* **Own the roadmap and outcomes:**
  Translate customer needs and business priorities into a focused roadmap across FASTag, wallets, Fuel Card, GPS and upcoming lending products. Track adoption, transaction success, revenue and servicing costs.
* **Understand customers and field operations:**
  Spend time with transporters, fleet owners, sales and support teams. Identify friction across onboarding, KYC, purchase, fulfilment, activation and ongoing usage.
* **Build reliable transaction journeys:**
  Improve recharges, refunds, reconciliation, disputes and invoicing. Anticipate failed transactions, partner downtime and exceptions, with clear recovery paths for customers and operations.
* **Expand the product portfolio:**
  Drive new bank integrations, automated recharges, prepaid wallet integration and GPS offerings. Develop lending journeys spanning discounting, loan origination, servicing and co-lending partnerships.
* **Manage integrations and controls:**
  Work with banks, payment providers and technology partners on API readiness, testing and production stability. Partner with compliance and finance on consent, data sharing, KYC and transaction controls.
* **Drive execution and practical automation:**
  Write clear requirements, make prioritisation trade-offs and own rollout and post-launch improvements. Apply AI and workflow automation where they improve customer experience, accuracy or operating efficiency.

**What You Bring**

* 4+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated ownership from problem discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Prior experience in fintech, payments or lending is preferred, not mandatory. Strong product fundamentals and the ability to learn complex domains matter.
* Strong analytical skills and hands-on SQL proficiency to investigate funnels, transaction failures and customer behaviour.
* Technical fluency to discuss APIs, integrations, data flows and system reliability with engineering and external partners.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, understand operational details and balance customer experience, commercial goals and compliance requirements.
* Practical familiarity with AI tools for research, prototyping, analysis and automation, with sound judgment about their limitations.
* Clear communication and the ability to align stakeholders, resolve dependencies and drive adoption after launch.

**Why This Role**

Build on a live platform while shaping its next stage of growth. This role offers ownership across everyday transaction products and new lending capabilities, with direct impact on how transporters access services, manage payments and keep their businesses moving.

title: Associate Technical Program Manager
description:
**Associate Technical Program Manager**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Full-time, On-site | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 1-5 years | Reports to: Founder & CEO | Joining: Immediate or early joining preferred

**ABOUT SVECTOR**

SVECTOR builds enterprise software and decision-intelligence systems for complex industries and high-stakes business environments. Our work spans enterprise AI, healthcare, industrial intelligence, talent intelligence and financial intelligence.

Engineering, product, research, customer requirements and business execution are closely connected here, and this role sits at the center of that.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This role combines Technical Program Management with Chief of Staff responsibilities, working directly with the Founder & CEO. It is designed for early-career professionals with 1-5 years of experience who want heavy responsibility early. It is not a senior or leadership position, and we will not consider applicants with significantly more experience than this range. It is a six-day, on-site role in Ahmedabad, not remote or hybrid. It is not an admin, calendar or task-tracking job, and "I passed it on" does not count as finished work. If you are ready to earn responsibility through real work, read on.

THE ROLE

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO on important product, technology, customer and business initiatives, and with engineering, product and business teams to get them done. On one initiative you may be working with engineers to resolve an API integration. On another you may be preparing a customer requirements brief, evaluating an unfamiliar technology, coordinating a product demo or driving a business priority to completion.

The job in one line: understand the problem, decide what needs to happen, bring the right people and information together, and make sure the intended result is delivered and verified.

You do not need prior experience with these titles. You do need technical curiosity, strong analytical ability, reliable execution and the willingness to own difficult work. We do not want someone who only tracks tasks, schedules meetings or forwards instructions. We want someone who understands the substance and owns the outcome.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Technical Program Execution

- Turn broad priorities into clear workstreams with owners, milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria

- Coordinate engineers, product contributors and business stakeholders

- Track real progress, not just reported task status

- Investigate blockers and find out why work is delayed or incomplete

- Raise risks before deadlines are missed and propose practical recovery plans

- Verify that delivered work meets the original requirement

A task marked done is not a completed program. The outcome has to be verified.

Product and Software Understanding

- Understand user journeys and product workflows, and test our software

- Write PRDs, BRDs, functional requirements and acceptance criteria

- Read API documentation, JSON structures and integration specifications

- Understand authentication, data flows and external service dependencies

- Reproduce issues and document expected versus actual behaviour

- Convert customer feedback into actionable requirements

- Support demos, pilots and implementation work

You are not expected to replace an engineer or decide architecture. You are expected to understand the technology well enough to ask meaningful questions and spot missing information. Blind coordination is not enough.

Ownership and Accountability

For every assignment, establish the problem, the expected outcome, what is known and unknown, who must contribute, what blocks progress, the deadline, which decisions need approval and how completion will be verified.

"I sent the message", "I followed up" and "I completed my part" are not proof of completion. If a stakeholder does not respond, decide the next action. If a technical issue is unresolved, investigate the dependency and find a path forward. If a deadline is at risk, say so early. If you make a mistake, report it accurately and fix it.

Research and Decision Support

- Research enterprise customers, software products, competitors, AI systems, vendors and industries

- Examine primary sources, question assumptions and spot inconsistencies

- Clearly separate verified facts, estimates, interpretation and open questions

- Deliver findings, implications and recommendations, not long summaries

Customer and Business Initiatives

- Research prospective customers and prepare briefs for important conversations

- Document customer requirements and support proof-of-concept work

- Prepare structured technical and commercial material

- Make sure every customer conversation ends with clear next actions and owners

Chief of Staff Responsibilities

- Turn the Founder & CEO's priorities into plans with owners and deadlines

- Prepare decision briefs, executive summaries and program reviews that can be used without rewriting

- Keep accurate records of commitments, decisions, owners and deadlines across teams

- Surface cross-functional conflicts, clarify decision rights and escalate what needs leadership input

- Make sure decisions reach the right people accurately and follow up until they are carried out

- Maintain continuity when priorities change

- Support selected hiring research, interview preparation and onboarding

- Handle confidential company, customer and personnel information with strict discretion

Coordination does not mean authority over other functions. You will respect specialist expertise and decision rights, and recognise when a decision belongs to leadership. Access to leadership does not create authority to make personnel, contractual or commercial commitments.

HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK

AI-native: You should already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, analysis, requirements and documentation. You are responsible for checking the output and must be able to explain the work without the tool. Confidential information must never go into unauthorised external tools.

Communication: Your writing must be clear, accurate and concise. You should be able to explain a technical problem to a business stakeholder and a business requirement to an engineer. When you raise an issue, state what happened, what is verified, why it matters, the options, your recommendation and the decision needed.

Judgment: We expect reliability, honest reporting of problems and mistakes, independent problem-solving before escalating, and well-reasoned disagreement. Once a decision is made, you help execute it professionally.

WHO YOU ARE

Experience: 1-5 years in a relevant role such as Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Operations, Software Engineer interested in product and business execution, Implementation Engineer or Analyst, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, Technical Presales or Technical Customer Success. Experience supporting a founder or CEO is not required.

Education: A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science or a closely related technical field is preferred. Others may be considered if they show strong technical understanding through professional work.

Essential skills

- Technical fluency in software, APIs, integrations and data flows

- Product understanding and the ability to interpret requirements and workflows

- Ability to take work from problem definition to verified completion

- Strong reasoning, research discipline and attention to evidence

- Fast learning in unfamiliar products and industries

- Clear professional writing and verbal communication

- Reliable follow-through, discretion and accountability

Good to have

- REST APIs, JSON and SQL

- PRD and BRD writing

- Jira, Linear, Notion or similar tools

- Software testing or technical implementation

- SaaS or AI-powered products

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first three months you should be progressing toward:

- Understanding product workflows and technical dependencies independently

- Turning ambiguous requirements into useful execution plans

- Investigating technical issues instead of simply forwarding them

- Producing accurate requirements, research and decision briefs

- Separating actual completion from reported progress

- Reducing the effort leadership spends tracking your work

Early assignments are scoped to your experience, and responsibility grows as you prove your capability. Performance is judged on real work, feedback and verified outcomes, not activity.

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Not remote or hybrid. Immediate or early joining is preferred. If you are currently employed, give your accurate notice period and a realistic joining date.

WHY SVECTOR

- Work directly with the Founder & CEO

- Real exposure to building and running enterprise software and AI products

- Work that connects engineering, product, customers, research and business decisions

- Growing responsibility as your capability develops

We value people who want to build strong technical and commercial judgment through real work, not just collect a more impressive title.

HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Your application must include a short written description of one technical or business initiative you personally helped take from problem definition to completion. Cover:

- The original problem

- What you personally owned

- The technical or business challenges that came up

- What you did

- The result and how you verified it

Applications without this response will not be reviewed. Generic or AI-generated answers that you cannot explain in detail will be exposed in the interview.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions.

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance & Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Demonstrates strong AI acumen, with the ability to effectively leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.
* AINS Certifications or other insurance industry certifications.
* CBAP (Certified Business Analyst Professional) or similar business analysis certification.
* Web Services/APIs and ACORD standards experience.

* *Referral Bonus program*
* *Exam Fee Reimbursement Policy*

title: Manager - Special Projects & Sustainability
description:
**Position Title**
- Manager – Special Projects & Sustainability

**Department:**
Business Development

**Reporting to:**
Director – Business Development

**Location:**
Corporate Office, with travel to manufacturing sites as required

**1. Role Purpose**

Identify, evaluate and execute strategic projects that deliver measurable business value through technology adoption, green energy, brewing-process optimisation, waste-to-wealth initiatives and resource efficiency.

The role combines technology scouting, data analytics, financial modelling and end-to-end project execution. The incumbent will be responsible for converting opportunities into commercially viable investments and ensuring delivery against approved business cases, frozen engineering designs, budgets, specifications and timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Technology Scouting and Special Projects.**

* Maintain current knowledge of developments in renewable energy, industrial energy efficiency, waste recovery, circular economy and emerging technologies relevant to brewing and process manufacturing.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities in solar and other green energy solutions, heat recovery, energy optimisation, biogas, compressed biogas (CBG) and alternative fuels.
* Identify opportunities to convert brewing by-products and manufacturing waste—including spent grain, surplus yeast, effluent and other process residues, as applicable—into saleable products, energy or useful raw materials.
* Benchmark industry practices, assess technology providers and develop a prioritised pipeline of commercially attractive projects.

**B. Data Analytics and Business Case Development**

* Analyse plant operating data, energy consumption, production yields, waste streams, water usage and operating costs to identify improvement opportunities.
* Independently develop detailed, data-driven business cases and financial models covering capital expenditure, operating costs, revenue potential, savings, payback, NPV, IRR and sensitivity analysis.
* Compare alternative technologies and commercial models, validate assumptions and assess technical feasibility, investment risks and expected returns.
* Prepare evidence-based investment recommendations for management approval, supported by clear assumptions and quantified benefits.
* Use advanced Excel for financial modelling and data analysis. Proficiency in Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools is desirable; familiarity with SQL, Python and AI-enabled analytical tools is an advantage.

**C. Project Execution and Commissioning**

* Take approved projects from detailed planning and engineering through procurement, installation, commissioning, performance testing and operational handover.
* Establish and maintain the approved design, scope, specifications, budget, quality standards and schedule as the execution baseline.
* Coordinate with engineering consultants, technology providers, contractors, plant teams and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective implementation.
* Enforce strict adherence to the frozen design and approved specifications. Any proposed deviation must undergo documented technical and commercial evaluation and formal approval before implementation.
* Monitor project progress, expenditure, risks, quality and milestones; promptly escalate deviations and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure commissioning, performance validation, documentation, training and handover, followed by verification of actual financial and operational benefits against the approved business case.

**D. Sustainability and Resource Efficiency**

* Develop projects to reduce energy consumption, conventional energy costs.
* Evaluate waste-to-energy, waste-to-wealth, water recovery.
* Quantify environmental and financial benefits against defined baselines and identify opportunities to replicate successful projects across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure proposed initiatives meet applicable regulatory, environmental, quality and safety requirements.

**E. Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Engineering, Plant Operations, Finance, Procurement and other relevant functions to validate proposals and deliver approved projects.
* Build relationships with technology providers, equipment manufacturers, consultants and potential commercial partners.
* Present investment proposals, project updates, risks and benefits realisation to the Director – Business Development and senior management.

3. Qualifications and Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Energy, Environmental or another relevant engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in energy management, sustainability, project management or business management is desirable.

**Experience**

* Approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience in industrial project execution, engineering, energy management, process manufacturing or technology implementation.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering projects from feasibility through commissioning.
* Proven capability in financial modelling, investment evaluation and project cost and schedule control.
* Exposure to renewable energy, brewing or fermentation, bioenergy, CBG, waste management, resource recovery or industrial energy efficiency is desirable.

**Preferred industry background**

Brewing and distilleries, food and beverage, bioenergy and CBG, chemicals, cement, paper and pulp, renewable energy, industrial engineering or EPC project execution.

4. Critical Competencies

* Strong technical understanding of industrial processes, utilities, energy systems and resource efficiency.
* Advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to independently build comprehensive financial models and data-backed business cases.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and commercial decision-making skills.
* Hands-on project planning, execution, commissioning and performance validation experience.
* High discipline in engineering design freeze, scope control, change management, quality and cost control.
* Ability to challenge vendor assumptions and translate technical opportunities into measurable financial returns.

5. Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against agreed annual targets:

1. **Value creation:**
   Verified cost savings and incremental revenue delivered.
2. **Project execution:**
   Projects commissioned within approved budgets and timelines.
3. **Design compliance:**
   Adherence to frozen designs and formal change-control procedures.
4. **Investment performance:**
   Actual returns against approved business cases.
5. **Resource efficiency:**
   Measurable improvements in energy, and identified oppurtunties
6. **Waste-to-wealth:**
   Commercial value realised from by-products and waste streams.
7. **Benefits realisation:**
   Achievement of agreed technical, financial and environmental outcomes after commissioning.
