title: ESG Programme Implementation Lead
description:
**ESG Programme Implementation Lead - Education Sector**

**Location: Hybrid, Bangalore**

The ESG Programme Implementation Lead is responsible for turning ESG strategy and priorities into action. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who takes ownership, creates momentum and ensures initiatives are effectively implemented across an international business.

The role requires strong project leadership, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with accountability for taking initiatives from planning through to implementation, adoption and measurable outcomes.

Success will be measured by what is implemented, adopted and achieved — not simply by the quality of project plans, trackers or reporting.

The post holder is expected to act with integrity, treat colleagues and stakeholders with care and respect, work collaboratively across teams and locations, use resources responsibly, and remain committed to continuous learning and improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Implementation & Project Delivery**

* Lead the end-to-end implementation of key ESG initiatives, taking accountability for agreed outcomes, timelines and impact.
* Translate strategic priorities into practical delivery plans, taking ownership of the approach, defining actions, resources, and dependencies.
* Drive implementation across locations and external partners, removing barriers and resolving issues to maintain momentum.
* Identify risks, dependencies and emerging challenges, implementing mitigation actions and escalating decisions where required.
* Lead the onboarding of new entities into ESG framework, sustainability practices and energy reporting requirements, from initial engagement through to adoption and ongoing compliance.
* Monitor implementation effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve, standardise and scale ESG initiatives.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Capability Building**

* Develop and implement stakeholder engagement and communication approaches that support adoption of ESG initiatives.
* Build effective relationships with regional teams and senior stakeholders, influencing teams to secure commitment and deliver agreed actions.
* Lead the ESG Community of Practice and other knowledge-sharing forums to drive adoption, share learning and build implementation capability.
* Facilitate training, workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions to enable effective implementation of ESG processes, tools and best practice.
* Capture project outcomes, lessons learned and impact to support case studies, organisational learning and sustainability reporting.

**Strategic Project Support & Governance**

* Provide proactive strategic and operational support to the Group Head of ESG and wider sustainability team, translating priorities into action and maintaining momentum across key initiatives.
* Lead critical projects and ad hoc initiatives, bringing structure, pace and accountability to delivery.
* Prepare high-quality presentations, recommendations and materials for leadership teams, steering committees and other stakeholders.
* Support Board and shareholder reporting, GHG audits, assurance processes and other strategic ESG activities, ensuring information is accurate, timely and evidence-based.

**Project Management & Process Improvement**

* Establish appropriate project management approaches, tools and governance to provide visibility and accountability for delivery.
* Maintain project plans, dashboards and reporting that clearly track actions, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions and deadlines.
* Coordinate project meetings and working sessions, ensuring clear decisions, actions and follow-up.
* Develop and maintain practical process documentation, user guides and standard operating procedures to support consistent implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, improve and standardise processes across the organisation.
* Use data, stakeholder feedback and lessons learned to evaluate effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

**Skills, Qualifications And Experience**

* **Project leadership:**
  Significant proven experience leading complex programmes across multiple sites or institutions, from scoping through to implementation and completion, with a strong track record of delivering outcomes.

* **Implementation & delivery:**
  Proven ability to translate strategy into action, manage risks and dependencies, solve problems and drive initiatives through to measurable results.

* **Stakeholder management:**
  Strong experience engaging and influencing stakeholders at different levels and across functions, cultures and geographies, including senior leadership.

* **Facilitation & Capacity Building:**
  Confident facilitator with experience designing and delivering training, workshops, and peer learning networks.

* **Strategic and operational thinking:**
  Able to understand the strategic objective while determining the practical actions, resources and decisions required to deliver it.

* **Problem solving & judgement:**
  Solutions-focused and comfortable navigating ambiguity, making sound decisions and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

* **Project governance & process improvement:**
  Experience establishing effective project management processes, monitoring delivery and implementing improvements to increase efficiency and impact.

* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing clear reports, presentations and communications for senior stakeholders. ESG or sustainability reporting experience is desirable.

* **ESG / sustainability:**
  Experience in ESG, sustainability or a related field is desirable, particularly within a complex or multinational organisation.

* **Organisation & adaptability:**
  Highly organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within a small, agile team.

* **Sustainability mindset:**
  Demonstrates a genuine interest in sustainability and social impact, with a strong focus on practical delivery and meaningful outcomes.

**Additional requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Sustainability or a related discipline preferred.
* Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
* Project management or business analysis certification such as
  **PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or CBAP**
  is desirable.
* Fluent written and spoken English; Spanish is desirable.

title: Sr Manager, Business strategy & PMO
description:

In this critical role, you will shape strategic priorities, establish a rigorous operating cadence, and drive cross-functional execution of high-impact initiatives for the India Cross Border Trade business.

**About the Team**

The Walmart India Cross Border team provides an opportunity for Indian brands, manufacturers, MSMEs, and other potential sellers to sell their products across global Walmart online marketplaces, helping them expand internationally as cross-border sellers on Walmart Marketplace.

**About the Role:**

As the Senior Manager - Business Strategy and PMO, you will partner with business leaders and cross-functional teams to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, measurable outcomes, and disciplined execution. You will lead annual and long-range planning, portfolio governance, business reviews, and executive reporting while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities. This role requires strategic thinking, strong program leadership, analytical depth, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and drive the business strategy, annual operating plan, and long-range priorities for the India Cross Border Trade organization.
* Identify key opportunities for business growth; develop and execute plans to leverage these opportunities.
* Drive internal productivity and operational efficiency improvement projects.
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners, success metrics, and governance mechanisms.
* Lead the PMO for high-impact, cross-functional programs from definition through execution, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Establish and manage operating cadences, including weekly program reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews, and leadership updates.
* Create executive-ready narratives, dashboards, and decision documents that communicate progress, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Partner with Business Development, Category Management, Account Management, Operations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to drive coordinated execution.
* Identify business performance trends, root causes, and growth opportunities through structured analysis and translate insights into actionable plans.
* Define and track key performance indicators, program health metrics, and benefits realization across the strategic portfolio.
* Proactively surface risks, interdependencies, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation and escalation with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Improve planning and execution mechanisms by standardizing processes, templates, governance, and decision-making frameworks.
* Lead strategic problem-solving on ambiguous business questions, evaluate options, and develop recommendations for senior leadership.
* Ensure accountability and follow-through across workstreams while enabling teams to move quickly and make informed decisions.
* Support organizational goal setting, resource prioritization, and change management for new initiatives and operating model improvements.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and influence outcomes without direct authority across a complex, matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.
* 8+ years of experience in business strategy, program management, management consulting, business operations, e-commerce, or a related field.
* Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs and converting strategic priorities into measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and develop structured, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive-level narratives and presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a matrixed organization.
* Experience establishing PMO governance, business review cadences, KPI frameworks, and portfolio-level reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment.

**Why Walmart?**

At Walmart, we believe in providing opportunities for our associates to grow and succeed. You will be part of the India Cross Border Trade team that is transforming the retail landscape and helping businesses expand internationally. Join our team and help shape strategy, strengthen execution, and deliver sustainable growth for Walmart Marketplace.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people.

Walmart doesn’t charge any recruitment or similar fee in the recruitment process, including but not limited to interview, offering, and onboarding.

title: Manager - Process Excellence
description:
**About:**

River is a design company building personal transportation for livelihood.

We focus on creating multi-utility products for those independently carving their own path. We’re building from the ground up, bringing together design, engineering and technology to solve real, everyday problems. Our signature two-wheeler, Indie – The SUV of Scooters, is built to be a dependable companion for getting things done.

Today, we’re 1,500+ people strong, headquartered in Bengaluru, and have raised our Series C.

River is backed by leading global automotive OEMs, international tech investors, and top institutional asset managers, including Yamaha Motor, Al-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Marubeni Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Maniv Mobility, Elev8 Venture Partners, Claypond Capital, Trucks Venture Capital, 360 ONE Asset, HDFC AMC, Singularity AMC, Anicut Capital, and JIF Capital.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Ensure comprehensive documentation of processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and best practices to maintain consistency and compliance.
- Lead change management efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes and practices, minimizing resistance and maximizing engagement.
- Manage and execute Transformation projects independently for internal stakeholders across the Value Stream . Lead the creation of current and future state value stream maps to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Identify opportunities for automation and digital tools to enhance process efficiency and effectiveness.
- Responsible for spearheading initiatives to enhance value streams by integrating process excellence methodologies with digital technologies
- Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, Implement lean methodologies and create processes and procedures across Value Streams.
- Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and other process improvement methodologies to streamline operations, reduce cycle times, and eliminate non-value-added activities.
- Develop a structured qualification program encompassing various levels (e.g., Green Belt, Black Belt) to standardize process excellence competencies across the organization.
- Work closely with stakeholders across departments to design and implement process changes that align with organizational goals.
- Lead process audit efforts for identified value streams for compliance on defined processes.
- Deep understanding of DMAIC frameworks, waste elimination (Muda, Mura, Muri), cycle-time reduction, and root-cause analysis.
- Understanding of structured audit execution, compliance monitoring, and root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, A3 problem solving.)
- Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without formal authority

**Ideal Candidate:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related discipline
- 8+ years experience within commercial functions across industries like Automotive, CPG, FMCG, High-Tech is mandatory for this role.
- Certifications as a Lean Practitioner/ Six Sigma Green Belt, or Certified ISO Internal Auditor will be an added advantage
- Advanced proficiency in creating & analyzing workflow design, mapping current vs. future states process, and identifying bottlenecks, waste, and friction points.
- Ability to design, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices to ensure compliance and quality control.
- Familiarity or hands-on experience in commercial functions like Sales, Marketing, Service, Dealer Development, Customer Service, Customer Experience is highly desirable.
- 100% on-schedule completion of process mapping/ VSM workflow and deployment for the identified value streams.
- Timely completion of assigned process audits along with management report-out of findings.
- Minimizing recurring value stream process gaps and operational bottlenecks via improvements

title: PROGRAMMING MANAGER
description:
Business Introduction At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
Find out more:
  
  
Our approach to R&D Position Summary You will lead clinical programming for multiple studies, ensuring high-quality, regulatory-ready data and reports. You will work closely with statisticians, data managers, clinical colleagues, and external partners. We value clear communication, practical problem solving, and a coaching mindset. This role offers significant growth, the chance to mentor others, and a meaningful impact aligned with GSK’s mission to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Join us to build your career where your work truly matters. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Plan, manage, and deliver programming outputs such as datasets, tables, listings, and figures across multiple studies. - Provide technical leadership and oversight for outsourced programming and external vendors. - Define, implement, and maintain programming standards, templates, and processes to ensure quality and regulatory readiness. - Review and contribute to study documents including analysis plans, output specifications, and submission materials. - Identify risks early, propose practical solutions, and escalate issues to keep projects on track. - Coach and mentor programming team members to build skills and support professional growth. Why You? Work model: Hybrid. Combine on-site collaboration in India with flexible remote working. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, life sciences, or a related field. - Minimum 5 years of clinical or statistical programming experience supporting clinical trials. - Strong skills in SAS programming, including macro development and writing reusable code. - Practical understanding of clinical data standards, such as SDTM and ADaM, and clinical data flows. - Experience managing programming deliverables and providing oversight to vendors or contract research organizations. - Clear written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Master’s degree in statistics, data science, computer science, or a related field. - Experience with R, Python, or other scripting languages for analysis and automation. - Familiarity with regulatory submission processes and define.xml generation. - Experience working with Agile methods and tools such as Jira. - Demonstrated leadership in study teams and effective cross-functional collaboration. - Proven track record of mentoring team members and improving programming processes. What we value You are collaborative and inclusive. You focus on delivering results while balancing priorities. You make evidence-based decisions and keep teams informed. You enjoy developing others and are always looking for ways to improve how we work together. Ready to apply? If this role fits your skills and ambitions, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to seeing how you will grow with us and help get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Skills**
Agile Leadership, Agile Methodology, Clinical Development, Data Engineering, Data Science, Influencing Without Authority, Learning Agility, Problem Solving, Statistical Programming
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Post Production Manager
description:
**👩 💻 The role**

As
**Post-Production Manager**
, you'll lead video editing at Headout, building the team, systems, and creative standards that make great travel content possible at scale.

We create long-form and short-form videos that help millions of people make better travel decisions. From explaining the London Underground to breaking down museum tickets or navigating an unfamiliar city, our videos turn complicated information into something simple, useful, and engaging.

You'll own creative quality, editorial standards, timelines, and the post-production pipeline while building workflows that help the team deliver excellent videos consistently. You'll partner with producers and writers to improve storytelling and formats, use YouTube performance data to make better creative decisions, and develop editors who can work independently.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll continue editing and independently own a smaller slate of videos alongside your management responsibilities, with lower individual output targets than the editors you manage.

**🤩 What makes this role special?**

* **Set the Editorial Standard:**
  You'll define what great looks like across storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and audience retention. Your goal is to make informational travel content genuinely engaging without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Build a Scalable Post-Production System:**
  You'll own the pipeline from asset handover and first cuts to feedback, quality checks, and final delivery. You'll build workflows, templates, and reusable visual systems that help the team produce better videos, faster.
* **Stay Hands-On with the Craft:**
  You'll continue editing videos yourself, experimenting with formats, and making creative decisions. You'll balance your own editing responsibilities with leading the team and maintaining quality across projects.
* **Build a Team of Independent Editors:**
  You'll lead editors working across long-form and short-form content, owning creative quality, timelines, feedback, and delivery. You'll mentor them, strengthen their editorial judgement, and build a culture of ownership and constructive feedback.
* **Shape Stories That People Want to Watch:**
  You'll work closely with producers and writers to improve formats, identify storytelling opportunities, and solve creative challenges. You'll turn information people are actively searching for into content they find useful and enjoyable.
* **Use Data to Make Better Creative Decisions:**
  You'll use YouTube metrics, including click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration, to understand what's working and improve future edits. Data will inform your creative judgement, not replace it.
* **Make Creative Work More Efficient:**
  You'll experiment with new tools, including AI, to eliminate repetitive tasks and give editors more time to focus on creative decisions. You'll build systems that reduce firefighting, improve consistency, and make every project easier to execute than the last.

**💝 What skills & experience do you need?**

* **4–6 years of experience**
  in video editing and post-production, with experience leading editors or managing multiple projects.
* **Strong editing skills:**
  A portfolio demonstrating excellent storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and editorial judgement. A portfolio is a must.
* **Team leadership:**
  Experience leading editors, managing feedback and timelines, maintaining creative quality, and developing team members.
* **Strong storytelling instincts:**
  Ability to make informational content engaging and easy to understand without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Workflow management:**
  Ability to manage multiple deadlines, streamline post-production processes, and build reusable templates and systems that improve speed and consistency.
* **Understanding of YouTube:**
  Familiarity with how editing decisions influence click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration.
* **Technical expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of editing software, motion graphics, asset management, and collaborative workflows.
* **Feedback and mentorship:**
  Ability to give clear, actionable feedback that strengthens editorial judgement and helps editors become more independent.
* **Hands-on ownership:**
  Willingness to continue editing videos while managing and developing a team.
* **A systems-first mindset:**
  Someone who simplifies workflows, balances quality with speed, uses data to inform creative decisions, and looks for ways to make every project more efficient than the last.

title: SMB Implementation Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Implementation is an essential differentiator for Rippling. As an Implementation Manager, you will work with our customers to implement and drive the adoption of Rippling’s suite of products. You will consult with the customer to understand their unique objectives and leverage deep knowledge of Rippling’s products as well as a strong commitment to customer experience to help clients realize the full potential of our offerings.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Partner one-on-one with clients to develop custom plans and implement the Rippling products they have purchased across HR, Payroll, Benefits Administration, IT platform, and various other products tailored to the customer’s specific business objectives
* Proactively manage the implementation process end-to-end, consulting with customers to align on target timelines and specific goals, ensuring that each milestone meets their operational needs
* Drive adoption of purchased products providing bespoke guidance, best practices, and insights that empower clients to maximize the platform’s capabilities
* Partner with Sales, Account Management, Technical Account Management, and Support to ensure seamless hand-offs and long-term customer success
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to offer feedback on customer insights, partner on technical issues, and advocate for product enhancements that align with customer needs and industry trends
* Collaborate with internal teams in the development of processes and best practices which integrates customer feedback and learnings to increase operational efficiency and success

What you will need
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in Implementation and/or Customer Experience at a rapidly growing SaaS company.
* Proven project management experience, deploying multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Stellar communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills along with a deep commitment to driving an exceptional customer experience.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with partners across Sales, CX, Product, and Engineering teams

Bonus
  
  

* 2+ years experience in a customer-facing position within the HCM or IT space (HR, Payroll, Benefits, Identity Management, Device Management, etc).

Note
  
  

* This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.
* This job requires you a to work in the EST/PST shift

title: Sr Staff, Product/Program Management - Semiconductor NPI(Analog/Power)
description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‑generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‑class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‑defining breakthroughs. The company’s footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan’s semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‑solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‑level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader—paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies.

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

**Job Description**

* Responsible for managing the development of New Products (Industrial and Automotive) and delivering on all program commitments from inception through execution to tape out and start of production.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource allocations to ensure on-time project completion within budget constraints while maintaining high quality
* Drive cross-functional teams including design, test, product engineering, validation, marketing, systems, applications, operations, planning, various factories, and vendors as Program Manager to meet project milestones and objectives.
* Manage several key projects in parallel or singular large program
* Continuously reviews program progress, proactively identify risks and collaboratively develops and drives risk mitigation efforts
* Collaborate with cross-functional and peers from other business groups to drive collaboration and harvest best practices and lessons learned to keep the business group in sync with One Renesas methodologies, tools and systems
* Drive execution initiatives and process improvements at the functional, cross functional and business group level
* Monitor and report on project progress, including key performance indicators and metrics, to senior management and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities may include:**

* Collaborate and work in a team environment with Design, Applications, Test, Marketing, Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability in all aspects of new product development, production release to accomplish goals and objectives
* Design bench evaluation PCBs (printed circuit boards) and generating characterizations programs for bench evaluations
* Perform evaluation, debug and characterization of integrated circuits to ensure they meet the product requirement specifications and manufacturing requirements
* Work with failure analysis (FA) to determine root cause of any reliability and qualification failures
* Knowledge of statistics and tools (example: Spotfire) to analyze large amounts of characterization data and determine and set production test limits and predict yield data
* Work with process and package technology development to develop and qualify technologies for new product development
* Work closely with the global manufacturing facilities to address customer specific product quality, yield management and cost reductions issues on mature products. Scope of work could include product spins and derivatives

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering

* 7+ years of hand`s on technical program/project management experience leading cross functional teams to develop broad market or custom Power/Analog/ Mixed-Signal products for commercial, industrial or automotive applications with at least 10 years of experience working in the Semiconductor domain

* Solid understanding of Semiconductor Manufacturing, Development and Management

* Ability to work in a team setup comprising of other functional groups

* Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment

* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

* Strong problem solving, verbal and written communications skills

* Ability to multiplex between projects and be able to maintain project schedules

* Familiarity with JEDEC / AEC Qualification standards

* Familiarity with ATE tester platforms (Teradyne / Eagle)

* Knowledge of statistics and tools (example: Spotfire) to analyse large amounts of characterization data and determine and set production test limits and predict yield data

* Knowledge of back-end semiconductor processes like Wafer Fabrication, Bump, Packaging, Assembly and Test is an asset.

* Working experience in a high-pressure environment, competing priorities and tight turnaround times.

* Strong communication, presentation, and leadership skills; Ability to lead technical discussions and summarize outcome for executive level status reporting.

* Proficient with industry standard project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, SharePoint, DFMEA, Root Cause Analysis , Confluence, Microsoft OneNote

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

**shape the future**
with us?

title: Senior Manager, Technical Program Management
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
PMO for AI Efficiencies & Workflow Redesign
  
  
We are establishing a newly created, high-impact role to lead our enterprise-wide AI Efficiencies and Workflow Redesign Program Management Office (PMO). This is a hands-on Senior Manager – Program Management position that sits at the intersection of business transformation, generative AI adoption, and operational excellence.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner with leaders across Business Units (BUs) to identify, prioritize, design, and deliver AI-driven productivity and workflow transformation initiatives. You will be responsible for embedding GenAI tools and re-engineered workflows into the fabric of how our organization operates—translating AI potential into measurable business outcomes such as cost reduction, cycle-time compression, quality uplift, and revenue enablement.
  
  
This is not a "PowerPoint PMO" role. We are looking for a builder—someone who can roll up their sleeves, prototype with GenAI tools, facilitate process redesign workshops, run agile delivery, and personally drive change alongside business and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Program Strategy & PMO Leadership
* Establish and run the AI Efficiencies & Workflow Redesign PMO as a cross-BU center of excellence.
* Build the enterprise opportunity pipeline of AI/GenAI use cases; prioritize based on value, feasibility, and risk.
* Define program governance, KPIs (productivity gains, FTE re-deployment, $ savings, NPS, cycle time), and a value-tracking framework with Finance.
* Maintain an executive-level program dashboard and report progress to the C-suite and steering committees.
* Hands-on Program & Delivery Management
* Personally drive end-to-end delivery of multiple concurrent AI/workflow initiatives across BUs.
* Run discovery, design, pilot, scale, and adoption phases using agile/lean methods.
* Manage cross-functional pods comprising business SMEs, data scientists, AI engineers, designers, and change managers.
* Own risks, dependencies, budgets, vendor management, and stakeholder communication.
* Workflow Redesign & Process Re-engineering
* Lead "as-is to to-be" workflow mapping using Lean, Six Sigma, and design-thinking techniques.
* Identify automation, augmentation, and elimination opportunities; redesign processes to be "AI-native."
* Partner with BU heads to redefine operating models, roles, and SOPs post-AI deployment.
* GenAI Tooling, Experimentation & Solutioning
* Stay deeply hands-on with leading GenAI tools and platforms (e.g., ChatGPT/Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Claude, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, agentic frameworks, RAG architectures, low-code/no-code AI builders).
* Personally prototype, demo, and pilot GenAI solutions—prompt engineering, custom GPTs/agents, workflow bots—before scaling.
* Evaluate build vs. buy decisions; partner with AI/IT teams to operationalize solutions responsibly.
* Maintain a working knowledge of model capabilities, limitations, cost, and Responsible AI considerations.
* Change Management & Adoption
* Drive end-user adoption through training, communications, and "AI champions" networks across BUs.
* Co-create change management plans with HR and BU leadership; address concerns related to role evolution and reskilling.
* Build internal capability through playbooks, reusable assets, and knowledge repositories.
* Governance, Risk & Responsible AI
* Ensure all initiatives comply with data privacy, security, IP, and Responsible AI policies.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, InfoSec, and Compliance to maintain guardrails for GenAI usage.
* Establish review checkpoints for model risk, bias, and ethical implications.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years of total experience, with a strong foundation in program/project management, business transformation, and operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.
* Minimum 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with GenAI/AI tools in an enterprise setting—either delivering AI products, leading AI transformation programs, or running AI-led process redesign.
* Proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional transformation programs spanning multiple Business Units, geographies, or functions.
* Demonstrated experience in workflow re-engineering, process automation, and operating model design (Lean/Six Sigma certifications a plus).
* Strong delivery credentials: PMP, Prince2, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certifications preferred.
* Experience managing budgets, vendors, and senior stakeholder relationships at the VP/CXO level.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
**Technical & Tooling**

* Hands-on proficiency with GenAI platforms (ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot, Gemini, Claude) and prompt engineering.
* Familiarity with RAG, AI agents, automation platforms (UiPath, Power Automate, n8n, Zapier), and integration patterns.
* Working understanding of LLMs, APIs, data pipelines, and AI governance frameworks.
* Comfort with analytics and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).

**Program & Business**

* Exceptional program management, structured problem-solving, and prioritization skills.
* Strong financial acumen—able to build business cases and quantify ROI.
* Outstanding executive communication, storytelling, and stakeholder influence.
* Change leadership and the ability to drive adoption in resistant environments.

**Personal Attributes**

* Hands-on operator's mindset—comfortable moving between strategy and execution.
* Intellectually curious; continuously experiments with emerging AI tools.
* Bias for action, outcome orientation, and high ownership.
* Collaborative, low-ego, and able to thrive in ambiguity.

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* Month 3: PMO operating model, governance, and value-tracking framework established; cross-BU use-case pipeline built and prioritized.
* Month 6: 3–5 high-impact GenAI/workflow pilots delivered with measurable productivity outcomes.
* Month 9: Scaled adoption of top 2–3 use cases across BUs; reusable playbooks and AI champions network in place.
* Month 12: Demonstrated enterprise-level efficiency gains (quantified $ savings / FTE productivity); AI-native workflows embedded into BAU; second-wave roadmap funded and underway.

**Why This Role**
This is a rare opportunity to shape and lead the AI transformation agenda of an entire enterprise. You will work directly with senior leadership, influence the future operating model of the organization, and play a defining role in how our people and processes evolve in the age of AI.
  
  
If you are a seasoned program leader who is equally excited by strategy decks and tinkering with the latest GenAI agent—this role is built for you
  
  
**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**
To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
  
  
**AI Technology Statement**
Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies

* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  
  
* Prompt libraries
  
  
* Agent templates
  
  
* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  
  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  
  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  

  

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

  
  

Deep understanding of:

**Leadership Competencies**

**Your next role:**
As a
**Senior Electrical Energy Engineer,**
you will take a leading role in the delivery of electrical infrastructure projects, supporting clients through the full project lifecycle. You will act as a technical lead, project manager, and trusted advisor, helping shape solutions that integrate engineering excellence with commercial and environmental insight.
  
  
This role is significant in working with colleagues both within the energy team and other discipline areas. The successful candidate will find themselves in a position of responsibility working directly with senior team members and mentoring junior engineers. They will be contributing directly into the technical strategy and leading design activities on a varied and exciting portfolio of projects.
  
  
Contribute to live projects from the start and have responsibilities and deadlines; advise clients, other engineers, architects and urban planners on holistic solutions
  
  
Specific projects are likely to include district energy projects and masterplan development including Energy Centre design, load calculations, conventional and renewable technologies and energy policy
  
  
Work alongside experienced engineering colleagues and attend client meetings
  
  
Make an impact and manage your workload

* Undertake feasibility studies, optioneering, and business case development for electrical infrastructure and energy systems.

* Develop and review private wire network designs, including load demand assessments, network architecture and network operation philosophies.
* Provide technical leadership on power systems studies (load flow, fault level, protection coordination studies) using industry‑standard tools such as DIgSILENT Power Factory and ETAP.
* Act as a client‑facing lead, presenting technical findings, managing expectations, and building long‑term relationships.
* Producing accurate, professional written reports clearly communicating our work to clients and stakeholders.
* Ensuring that all stakeholders are kept informed of design progress and any risks are consulted with project leader/project director.
* Supporting the Energy leadership in client and design team relationships.
* Oversee project delivery, ensuring quality, budget, and programme compliance.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across energy, sustainability, buildings, and infrastructure.
* Contributing to techno-economic modelling.
* Mentor and support junior engineers, contributing to team development and knowledge sharing.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered or working toward Chartership.
* Ideally be in the range of 6-12 years’ experience range
* Strong experience in medium‑voltage distribution, substation design, and electrical infrastructure planning.
* Demonstrable experience delivering projects through RIBA Stages 1-3
* Familiarity with DNO/IDNO processes, grid connection requirements, and relevant UK standards.
* Experience with private wire networks, campus energy systems, distribution network electrical infrastructure.
* Experience with power systems analysis software (eg. ETAP, DIgSILENT, SKM).
* Strong communication skills and confidence in client‑facing roles.
* Ability to lead projects, coordinate multidisciplinary inputs, and manage budgets and programmes.
* Strong numerical analysis and modelling skills
* Ability to apply a systematic approach to complex problems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for mentoring junior colleagues.

**Desirable Skills**

* Knowledge of the UK energy sector
* Experience in developing detailed feasibility studies for energy systems at different scales
* Experience with protection studies, load
* Familiarity with relevant ENA, IEEE, BS EN, IEC, and network operator standards.
* Understanding of electrical connection strategies.
* Technical awareness of low carbon technologies
* A clear understanding of the interface requirements of electrical systems in low carbon system design e.g., storage, renewables, low carbon heating, demand side response, electric vehicles and energy efficiency
* Revit and/or AutoCAD conversant
* Participation in HAZOP and/or HAZID studies
* Commercial experience in evaluating project design costs
* Experience in techno-economic modelling of energy systems for feasibility studies/options appraisals
* Knowledge of electro-mechanical system interfaces and digital operating systems
* Experience in client or owner’s engineer roles
* Experience of utility providers systems and applications process.
* RIBA Stage 4+ experience
* Excellent graphic design and presentational skills.
* Ability to contribute to project fee proposals and bids working with senior team members on strategy
* Be open to serving as Line Manager to junior staff members, providing pastoral support, career guidance, and day-to-day mentoring.

**What We Offer You**
Bring your knowledge and expertise to one of the world’s most respected consultancies.
  
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package including Annual Discretionary Bonus, Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme for both you and your family, Group Personal Accident Cover
* Our 5-day workweek policy supports work-life balance, ensuring you have time to relax and recharge.
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Benefit from our Employee Referral Bonus, rewarding you for bringing talented candidates into our fold
* A commitment to your wellbeing through a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellness initiatives designed to support your mental and physical health
* Back to Work Program for Women - Swam Siddha - We're committed to empowering women, facilitating seamless re-entry into the workforce through our dedicated program
* Engage with our vibrant community through the Young Employees Forum, Diversity and Inclusion Forum, and BH Women's Network, fostering a supportive and diverse workplace culture
* Make a difference in the world with our Share Our Skills (SOS) program, offering opportunities to support local communities and those in need globally.
* An International Culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.

**Join us to find out what you’re capable of**
**.**
**A place for everyone**
Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.
  
  
Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.
  
  
We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.
  
  
Please let us know if there are any adjustments we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

description:

Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
Job Role: Lead Functional Consultant - SAP S/4HANA RTR - Finance Transformation & Migration
  
  
Shift: UK Shift (2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST)
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid
  
  
Relevant Exp: 10+ Years
  
  
Location: Pune, Noida, Bangalore, Chennai
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP S/4HANA RTR Lead Consultant with SAP S/4HANA RTR functional & technical experience executing and delivering a complex migration project from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA. The candidate will be responsible for the configuration of SAP S/4HANA Target System to receive selected data migrated from a current SAP ECC system to ensure a seamless transition, while providing expert guidance and support to clients throughout the configuration build, testing and cutover activities of their journey to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities: Functional and Technical Consulting:**
Leading Workshops AS IS / TO BE Process to map requirements from business process understanding, cost management and reporting, integration with other modules and systems, overall business strategy.
  
  
Provide expert guidance and support in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis. Work with SAP S/4HANA Core Team to configure and customize SAP S/4HANA functionalities to meet client requirements, ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards.
  
  
Develop technical solutions and enhancements to support data migration, integration, and reporting requirements.
  
  
Provide guidance and support with S/4 HANA transformation project including configuration, Data Migration, providing functional Expertise, trouble shooting, User training.
  
  
Designs and optimizes controlling processes to meet the business needs.
  
  
**Business Process Analysis And Optimization**
Work closely with finance and control departments to understand their processes and needs.
  
  
Analyze existing financial processes and suggest improvements.
  
  
Ensure the SAP system is aligned with business financial operations and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Testing, Training, And Support**
Develop and execute test plans, scenarios, and scripts to validate SAP S/4HANA configurations and functionalities.
  
  
Conduct system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and regression testing to ensure system reliability, accuracy, and performance.
  
  
Collaborate with business users to resolve issues, address concerns, and implement solutions to meet project objectives.
  
  
Train end-users on the functionality of SAP S/4HANA RTR Workstream
  
  
Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for SAP RTR Workstream issues.
  
  
**Integration And Data Migration**
Ensure seamless integration of the S/4 Finance Accounting with other SAP modules like Order to Cash, Sourcing & Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain.
  
  
Oversee data migration from SAP ECC/legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
  
  
Work with the Selective Data/Bluefield Migration Team on the migration of data from Customer’s SAP ECC System target SAP S/4HANA System to ensure minimal business disruption and maximum efficiency.
  
  
Collaborate with data migration and technical teams on activities regarding data extraction, transformation, and loading into SAP S/4HANA during build, test and cutover phases of the project.
  
  
**Reporting And Analytics**
Develop and maintain financial accounting reports and dashboards using SAP tools.
  
  
Assist in the utilization of SAP S/4HANA's embedded analytics capabilities to provide actionable insights into financial data.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement And Communication**
Act as the primary point of contact for key business and IT stakeholders including business users, project sponsors, and IT teams, providing regular updates, progress reports, and presentations on project status and milestones.
  
  
Proactively engage with stakeholders to gather and validate requirements, address concerns, and obtain feedback throughout the migration and transformation process to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, fostering trust and confidence in the migration process and deliverables.
  
  
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  
  
**Skill & Experience Required**
10+ years of experience in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis, implementation and support.
  
  
Strong analytical Skills to analyze complex business data, identify potential issues, business challenges, recommend and develop solutions implementing with SAP Best practices.
  
  
Should be well versed with end-to-end Product costing processes including Material Ledger functionality with integration points with other modules like Product Planning, Materials Management, Order to Cash etc.
  
  
Should have worked on reports and able to identify the requirement and integrate effectively with SAP BW/BI or other reporting tools.
  
  
Certification in SAP S/4HANA is required.
  
  
Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead customer engagements at an executive level.
  
  
Excellent interpersonal skills in areas such as teamwork, facilitation, and negotiation
  
  
Strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical audiences including the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport, persuades others, and establishes domain expertise.
  
  
Working knowledge of SAP Activate Roadmap for Central Finance
  
  
Primarily Remote with occasional onsite meetings
  
  
**Nice to Have**
Experience, knowledge in other SAP modules and migration tools, such as Data Migration Cockpit, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, Inventory Management and Warehouse Management is a plus.
  
  
Prior experience with SAP RISE implementations.
  
  
Understanding of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) applications and use cases.
  
  
Understanding and working knowledge of SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) and potential integration scenarios using MDG.
  
  
Relocation Supported: Yes
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

* 6–10 years of experience in Automotive, Auto Ancillary, or Engineering Services industries.

* Strong expertise in HyperMesh and LS-DYNA.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Data Architect – Data Platform Delivery & Client Program Lead**

**Full Time | Chennai |**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to own the architecture, delivery, and client relationship for a strategic data program at an enterprise manufacturing organization, built on a modern cloud data stack. You will operate within the client's established enterprise architecture design standards and governance frameworks adapting and delivering to those standards rather than building in a greenfield. In areas where standards do not exist, you will have the opportunity to shape & help establish standards.

This is a role that goes well beyond technical design. Alongside architecting and leading hands-on implementation, you will play an account leadership role, own client delivery and stakeholder relationships, contribute to presales, and act as the primary liaison for the data program. Over time, we see your contribution in organizational presales and contributions to multiple accounts.

You will architect and guide solutions across Snowflake, cloud ETL / integration tooling (Informatica IICS, Talend, Boomi), AWS, and enterprise reporting (Cognos, Power BI) while playing a strategic role leading the team and partnering directly with client stakeholders to shape the roadmap and deliver outcomes.

This role suits someone who is technically deep, delivery lead capable, and client-facing, with solid team-management foundations and a genuine appetite to grow as a leader. We will actively support your development in people and delivery management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

* Own the end-to-end data architecture across the client stack: Snowflake, IICS, Talend, Boomi, Qlik Replicate, AWS, Cognos, and Power BI.
* Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions spanning ingestion, integration, data warehousing, modelling, and reporting.
* Work within the client's enterprise architecture design standards, integration patterns, and governance frameworks - and contribute to strengthening them where appropriate.
* Architect Snowflake solutions directly, or partner with the client's Snowflake leads to shape them, while safeguarding governance: cost management, consumption oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices.
* Lead technical implementation and stay hands-on where it matters - reviewing designs, unblocking the team, and building critical components.
* Own solution design decisions and their trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and business audiences.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate a data team of seven across engineering, integration, and BI.
* Plan and run sprints, manage and prioritize the backlog, and keep delivery on track (scrum-master responsibilities).
* Own solution delivery from analysis through build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage defects, enhancements, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
* Mentor team members, set technical direction, and support the team's growth.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Own the client relationship and act as the primary liaison for the data program.
* Manage stakeholder communications across internal and external teams.
* Gather requirements directly from business and technical stakeholders; define priorities, KPIs, and acceptance criteria.
* Own client delivery outcomes and contribute to presales relationships.
* Build solution and proposal decks and present them to executive, business, and technical audiences.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* 5+ years in data engineering, data integration, or business intelligence, with 3+ years in a data architecture capacity.
* Strong Snowflake experience - able to architect solutions independently or collaborate closely with dedicated Snowflake leads to shape them.
* Solid grasp of Snowflake governance concepts: cost management, consumption / credit oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices (RBAC, data security).
* Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and governance framework.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud ETL / data integration tooling - one or more of Informatica IICS, Talend, or Boomi - and the ability to design across a mixed toolset.
* Solid experience with AWS data and platform services.
* Experience delivering enterprise reporting and analytics with Cognos and/or Power BI.
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills (dimensional and analytical modelling).
* Demonstrated ability to lead delivery and coordinate a team, with foundational team-management experience and a clear interest in growing as a people / delivery leader.
* Proven ability to own client relationships and gather requirements directly from business stakeholders.
* Experience running agile delivery - sprint planning, backlog management, and prioritization.
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and ownership skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience owning presales and building solution proposal decks.
* Snowflake advanced features and warehouse / cost optimization.
* Experience across multiple ETL / integration tools in the same landscape (IICS + Talend + Boomi).
* Data governance, security, and role-based access / access-model design.
* Experience delivering into a large, standards-driven enterprise - ideally in manufacturing or a comparable industrial / operational domain.
* Migration, go-live, or platform-modernization experience.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change-management processes.
* Certified Scrum Master or equivalent agile / delivery experience.

**Certifications (one or more preferred)**

* SnowPro Core - or SnowPro Advanced: Architect
* AWS Certified - Solutions Architect or Data Engineer / Data Analytics
* Informatica Cloud (IICS) certification
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM) / Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
* ITIL Foundation
