title: Sr. Manager Supplier Engineering
description:
**Company Description**
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
  
  
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
  
  
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
  
  
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
  
  
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of the Position:**
The successful candidate will lead a team of Supplier Engineers, to develop a portfolio of suppliers that deliver components, parts, and sub-assemblies at lowest landed cost for Intuitive’s robotic systems. By building technical expertise and business acumen in the Robotics space including its primary commodities of Motion control (electric motors, gearboxes, brakes, sensors, and other actuators), Electronics (PCBAs, PCBs, and electrical harness assemblies), Metals (CNC machining, Castings), and Plastics (injection molding, thermoforming, reaction injection molding), Supplier Engineering leads the technical evaluation during supplier selection, works with suppliers to develop manufacturing processes for components, and qualifies these processes to ensure suppliers can deliver the quality, capability, capacity, and cost necessary to meet Intuitive’s needs.
  
  
You will be responsible for the engineering relationship with many suppliers and the corresponding spend required to establish production, as well as for the discovery and development of new suppliers. You will strive to deliver the best-in-class performance score from your suppliers which is derived from several KPIs of Capacity, On-time Delivery, Cost reduction, Risk Mitigation, Product Quality and Service levels.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**
Lead a team of supplier engineers who are delivering value to the business through the following activities.
  
  

* Supply-chain Strategy: Develop and execute Global Supply-chain strategy and roadmap for long term, sustainable and resilient supply-chain to support Intuitive’s Product strategy and roadmap.
* Supplier Selection: Conduct market research to identify trends in the field of [plastics, Metal] manufacturing and accordingly select and evaluate suppliers to enable Agility and innovation during New Product Introduction, and to enable production scale globally for products that reach broad commercial launch. Establish a strong partnership with the commodity sourcing team to incorporate commercial viability in supplier selection process.
* Supplier Development and collaboration: Drive and adopt new technologies and automation in supply-chain to achieve high efficiency and production scale. Champion best practices like DFX, Lean, SPC, Six-sigma, Project management, into supply-chain. Establish clear communication channels with suppliers and manage both technical and business relationships
* Supplier Performance and Monitoring: Partner closely with suppliers to select optimal mfg process and process controls to achieve high quality and cost performance. Develop effective KPIs to monitor supplier performance (delivery, capacity, cost, quality). Execute projects towards continuous improvements of KPIs.
* Supplier Compliance: Partner with Supplier Quality org to drive audit finding resolution with suppliers through processes like CAPA and SCARs to maintain compliance with QMS requirements
* Supplier Risk management: Partner with Global supply-chain team to identify various risks within supply-chain and implement mitigation measures.
* Supplier Change management: For commercially launched products, execute Intuitive’s change management processes like major/moderate change (MCF), Supplier Change Request (SCR) and Change Order (CO) to support large scale projects towards capacity scaling, cost reduction, product quality improvement and supply-chain risk mitigation.
* Stakeholder Influence: Aligning/Negotiating on project ownership and hand-off points with various peer Supplier engineering groups (like New Product Introduction, Mfg Plant support, Tooling development). Influencing decisions with key partners in Global Ops (planning, sourcing, purchasing), Engineering (Design, Process, Quality) and Project Management Org.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Proven ability to lead teams to solve complex technical and process problems
* Proven ability to hire highly capable staff, and grow and mentor staff
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentations to executives
* Demonstrated Project Management skills and ability to influence and negotiate with stakeholders.
* Domain Knowledge expertise in the [Plastic, Metal] commodity. Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes and measurement techniques. Deep understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, schedule and capacity
* Outstanding analytical skills along with good judgment
* Proficiency in Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing techniques; certification preferred
* Knowledge of document management systems and ERP Systems, preferably Agile and SAP
* Knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485 preferred
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus
* Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis – domestic and international (25%)

**Required Education And Training**

* BS degree in engineering, advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years related experience in Manufacturing, Operations, Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, or related field with significant medical or medical device experience preferred
* 3+ years of experience leading supplier engineering, supplier quality or supplier development teams, or leadership of equivalent areas.

Ensure the achievement of project milestones, productivity targets, quality standards, safety requirements, and cost objectives in line with overall project schedules and business goals.
* Production Performance and Delivery Management: Assume overall responsibility for Hull Production performance and delivery. Drive cross-functional coordination among engineering, planning, quality assurance, procurement, subcontractors, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth execution of production activities. Monitor progress against project schedules, proactively address bottlenecks, resolve operational challenges, and ensure timely completion of hull construction in accordance with business objectives and vessel delivery commitments.
* Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Productivity (SQDCP): Establish and sustain a strong culture of Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Productivity across the Hull Production function. Ensure strict adherence to safety procedures, quality standards, approved engineering drawings, work instructions, and production processes. Implement effective controls to minimize workplace incidents, welding defects, rework, material wastage, and production delays while continuously improving operational efficiency.
* Subcontractor and Resource Management: Ensure effective subcontractor management, including work allocation, productivity assessment, performance monitoring, quality compliance, and timely completion of assigned scopes. Optimize the utilization of manpower, machinery, equipment, production facilities, and other resources. Establish clear performance expectations for subcontractors, review progress periodically, resolve execution-related issues, and ensure that all outsourced activities meet prescribed safety, quality, productivity, and delivery requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Digitalisation and Productivity Improvement: Drive the implementation of Lean Manufacturing principles, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), digital production monitoring, automation, mechanisation, and other productivity-enhancement initiatives. Identify opportunities to streamline production workflows, reduce non-value-added activities, improve material flow, optimize work processes, and enhance shop-floor efficiency. Promote continuous improvement initiatives to improve hull production capacity, reduce cycle time, and achieve sustainable improvements in operational performance.
* Production Monitoring and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Establish and maintain a robust system for monitoring and reviewing key production performance indicators, including tonnage achieved, man-hours per tonne, welding productivity, schedule adherence, manpower utilization, rework levels, material utilization, and cost performance. Analyse production data to identify deviations from planned targets, determine root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Provide periodic performance reviews and actionable inputs to management to facilitate timely decision-making and achievement of production objectives.

title: Executive to the Chairman – Special Projects, Business Execution & Transformation
description:
Executive to the Chairman – Special Projects, Business Execution &

Transformation

Company: Spartek Group

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Experience: 3–5 Years

Qualification: Engineering Graduate preferred; MBA or management

qualification is an added advantage.

About Spartek Group

Spartek Group is a diversified business group with a legacy spanning over four

decades, with interests across building materials, ceramics, sanitaryware,

precast concrete solutions, industrial and decorative flooring, construction

chemicals, and consumer tableware.

Through its various businesses and brands, including Spartek Tiles, Neycer

Sanitaryware, Spartekoncrete and UNIFORT, the Group is focused on

expanding its market presence, strengthening manufacturing and operational

capabilities, developing new business opportunities, and adopting technology-

driven solutions to improve business performance.

As the Group continues to pursue new growth opportunities and business

transformation initiatives, it offers an entrepreneurial environment for

professionals who are keen to work closely with senior leadership, take

ownership of challenging assignments, and contribute directly to business

growth.

About the Role

Spartek Group is looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial and execution-

oriented professional to work directly with the Chairman on strategic

initiatives, special projects, business development, operational improvements

and organisational transformation.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role that provides exposure to

multiple business verticals, including manufacturing, sales and marketing,

finance, human resources, technology, digital transformation and new

business development.

1The individual will be responsible for converting the Chairman’s priorities and

business ideas into actionable plans and ensuring their successful

implementation. The role requires someone who is equally comfortable

analysing business opportunities, coordinating with senior management,

visiting manufacturing facilities, working with frontline teams and personally

driving projects to completion.

This is not a conventional desk-based corporate strategy role. We are looking

for someone who can move beyond planning and presentations to deliver

tangible, measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Chairman’s Special Projects: Drive priority assignments, new initiatives

and strategic projects from conception through implementation and

closure.

* Business Development: Evaluate new products, markets, customer

segments and business opportunities; support commercial proposals,

market research and business launches.

* Manufacturing and Operations: Identify opportunities to improve

productivity, quality, cost efficiency, inventory management,

procurement and operational processes.

* Finance and Commercial Analysis: Support budgeting, cost monitoring,

working capital improvements, financial reporting and business

performance analysis.

* Technology and AI: Identify and implement practical applications of AI,

automation, ERP, CRM, dashboards and digital tools to improve

productivity and decision-making.

* Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with business heads, plant

teams, sales, finance, HR, IT, procurement and external stakeholders to

ensure timely execution.

* Project Monitoring: Establish milestones, timelines, budgets,

performance indicators and progress reports to monitor implementation

and results.

* Organisational Improvement: Support recruitment, performance

measurement, process standardisation, accountability and change

management initiatives.

2Candidate Profile

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in project execution, business

operations, business development, manufacturing, consulting with

hands-on implementation, or business transformation.

* Engineering degree preferred, particularly in Mechanical, Industrial,

Civil, Electrical or related disciplines.

* MBA or a management qualification in Operations, Finance, Strategy,

Marketing or General Management is an added advantage.

* Experience in building materials, manufacturing, consumer products,

homeware, FMCG, distribution or allied industries is desirable.

* Strong analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills.

* Good working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, project management

tools and business reporting.

* Practical familiarity with AI tools, automation and digital applications.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and coordination

skills.

* Willingness to travel to factories, warehouses, customer locations and

other Group offices as required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong

sense of ownership, a bias for action and the ability to work independently in a

fast-paced business environment.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with ambiguity, learning

unfamiliar business processes, solving ground-level problems and taking

responsibility for outcomes.

Candidates who have personally implemented projects and delivered

measurable results will be preferred over those whose experience is primarily

limited to analysis, presentations or recommendations.

Career Development

This role offers direct exposure to the Chairman and the opportunity to

understand and contribute to multiple businesses within Spartek Group.

Based on demonstrated performance, the individual may progress into roles

such as Special Projects Manager, Business Operations or Transformation

3Manager, New Business Initiative Lead, or Business Development/Operations

Head for a business unit.

The position is particularly suited to professionals who aspire to develop into

future business leaders by combining analytical ability, commercial

understanding, technology orientation and hands-on execution.

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with brief

details of two or three projects or initiatives they have personally

implemented. Applications should highlight the candidate’s individual

contribution, challenges addressed and measurable outcomes achieved.

If you are someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving real business

problems and wants to build businesses rather than simply manage tasks, we

would like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Program Manager - Technology
description:
**Company Description**

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**

**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)
description:
**Job Title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)**

**Location: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Travel: As per the project need**

**Position Overview:**

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana Skill Education component as part of a dedicated Project Management Unit (PMU). The Assistant/ Deputy Manager will lead school based skill education reforms across the state, working directly with senior bureaucrats (including IAS officers) on Skill Education strengthening, managing co-ordination between National & State level Institutions in Education & Skilling domain, policy implementation & Tech & Data based governance improvement. Based in Hyderabad, the role combines strategic exposure, scale based execution and high-impact work in India’s skilling & education ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Govt & Stakeholder Engagement

* State & Central Ministry: Facilitate co-ordination between State School Education dept (Samagra Shiksha) & other Central institutions: Ministry of Education, NCVET, PSSCIVE, SSCs etc under established State & Centre channel for Samagra Shiksha based Skill Education delivery in schools
* Inter-State Depts: Facilitate coordination between Dept of School Education (Samagra Shiksha), SCERT, State Board, Dept of Skill Development & other relevant departments for School based Skill Education delivery support

2.School based Skill Education Delivery Facilitation at State Level

* Skill Education Delivery as per Scheme & Policy: Facilitate Skill Education delivery in Govt Schools at Scale in alignment with CSSVSE scheme, NEP-NCF mandate & State Vision for Skill Education for thousands of schools (Grade 6-12)
* Facilitate design & delivery of System setup in Schools: e.g-Skill lab setup in Schools, Skill Education Books delivery, Internships for School Students, AI integration in Skill Education curriculum etc
* Facilitate sufficient govt budget allocation to Skill Education in coordination with State School Education dept & Ministry of Education

3. Teacher Onboarding, Capacity Building

* Vocational Teacher Onboarding Facilitation: Support onboarding and management of vocational training partners (VTPs) & Vocational Teachers/ Trainers (VTs).
* Training: Coordinate Vocational/ Skill Education teacher training, Training of Trainers (ToT) and master trainer development.
* Support development of training resources and capacity-building systems.

4.Tech & Data Based Governance Improvement- Monitoring

* Facilitate effective monitoring through State based Monitoring platform; Monthly District & VTP review meeting; keeping IAS/State officers updated on progress through data & reports
* Prepare progress reports and analytical presentations for program reviews
* Facilitate large data collection from govt schools, analytics & outcome reporting to IAS & other senior officials for timely decision making around Skill Education

5. Drive Student Outcome

* Facilitate Students Internships (Grade 11-12), Career Counselling, Job Fairs, Higher Education pathways by planning & designing intervention at the State level
* Facilitate delivery of the same in schools as per State budget & program allocation

6. Team Management-PMU

* Manage PMU Team at State level
* Guide & Mentor all PMU team members of the State

7. PMU Operations & Government Coordination

* Support day-to-day functioning of the Skill/Vocational Education PMU at Samagra Shiksha, School Education Dept
* Coordinate with senior officers, including IAS and State Services officers, for meetings, reviews, and follow-ups
* Prepare briefing notes, presentations, concept notes, and action trackers for senior bureaucrat/IAS leadership
* Track meeting outcomes, decisions, and implementation timelines

8. Reporting & Documentation

* Prepare periodic progress reports, and presentations
* Maintain records of PMU activities, meetings, and outputs
* Ensure professional communication between Lend A Hand India and Government counterparts

9. Support to all LAHI’s Projects in Telangana: Need based support to other LAHI’s projects in Andhra Pradesh (SCERT, State Board, Skill Development Dept)

**About Lend A Hand India :**
Lend A Hand India (LAHI) is a leading national Think Tank/Non Profit Organisation with over 20 years of experience in strengthening India’s skill and vocational education ecosystem. LAHI works closely with 20+ State and UT governments through long-term partnerships, providing technical advisory and Project Management Unit (PMU) support to drive systemic reforms. In Telangana, LAHI partners with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha to support large-scale improvements in school based Skill Education (6-12) delivery. Currently, In 20+ States 22,000+ schools and 25 lakh + students are supported by LAHI through 300+ team members working Pan-India.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
* 250+ Team Members

**What Truly Sets a Career at Lend A Hand India Apart –**

* **Work as a Systems Architect, not just an Implementer:**
  You help build and refine the system itself, influencing policy and creating lasting change.
* **Experience the thrill of scale with depth:**
  See your ideas and efforts replicated across thousands of schools, impacting millions of students in a measurable way.
* **Master Complex Collaboration:**
  Gain unparalleled experience navigating and synergizing the worlds of government, corporate CSR, and community.
* **Career with a Tangible Legacy:**
  Your work directly creates skilled professionals, confident entrepreneurs, and a stronger national economy.
* **Investment in you:**
  We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive support & robust benefits and a culture that actively champions your professional development and holistic well-being.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Overall experience of 5-10+ years in Education & Govt PMU Management
* Prior experience of Education/Skill Development
* Prior experience of working with State level Senior bureaucrats/ IAS (preferred)
* Experience of relevant fellowship desirable (Education/Skilling: Gandhi, TFI, MGNF etc)
* Prior experience working with State or Central Government departments preferred

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Public Policy, Education, Management, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Relevant fellowships (e.g., MGNF, Gandhi Fellowship, TFI, etc.) will be an added advantage

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Language: Excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & Telugu
* Team management: Experience of Managing team, Ability to lead State PMU and manage/guide team members who are part of PMU
* Technical Skills: Experience of developing strategy & documentation for IAS/State level Govt officials use: State level presentations for Senior Bureaucrats; Policy/Guideline Drafts; Notesheets; Concept Notes, SOPs; tender work-technical support etc
* Ability to manage Govt projects at State level (notesheets, tender work-technical support, desk research work, orientation to senior officials about project details)
* Strong Expertise in Technical project writing work & data analytics-Report writing (Word, PPT) & large datasets analysis using excel
* Proficient in drafting official letters, note sheets, proposals, concept notes, SOPs, making presentations etc. (preferred)
* Proficient in large data analytics (excel & google sheet based) & presenting the findings via great visual presentation & report to senior officials
* Good understanding of India’s School Education system
* Ability to work in a government system with professionalism, discretion, and persistence

title: Director of Delivery Assurance
description:
**Overview**
We are looking for Director of Delivery Assurance (DDA) with a passion for delivering desired customer outcomes, who can take responsibility for driving the successful initiation, governance oversight, recovery, and acceleration of large-scale, complex cloud programs. This role focuses on the governance infrastructure, tools, and processes needed to quickly and successfully launch or recover a multimillion-dollar program, setting up program governance, setting up operational cadence, and managing stakeholder relationships. DDA will serve as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and clients, ensuring that every program starts proficiently, is positioned for long-term success, and can be rapidly brought back on track when challenges arise. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Explore how intelligent automation and AI-augmented workflows can enhance execution on complex engagements, partnering across the organization to identify scalable patterns and shape ISD’s AI-enabled delivery roadmap.

.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.

From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

title: Program Manager - AI Transformation
description: MediaMint Combined — MediaMint, DataBeat, and Taktical Digital, 3,000 people across Hyderabad and New York — istransforming into a Native Agentic company. The Chief Transformation Officer owns the vision, governance, andexecution oversight for AI and agentic adoption across all three companies.This is a senior program management role. It is an ownership job with visible sponsorship from the CEO, COO, and CTO.What You Will Own Program governance and cadence: run the transformation operating cadence: monthly scorecard, quarterly goalreviews, and milestone tracking across every initiative and owner. The single view (PMO): own the central registry of every agentic initiative across the three companies: what is beingbuilt, by whom, with what outcome. Leadership should never feel randomized again. You govern from experience, not theory: you know that anyone can automate the happy path and the value is inthe exceptions, and that an agent should not grade its own work. You can challenge whether a solution can actuallyrun the business. Structured to a fault: you turn ambiguity into plans, plans into trackers, and trackers into decisions. You measurewhat matters and kill vanity metrics. Relationship builder and connector: you build trust across teams and act as the central liaison for AI practicedevelopment and adoption across the group. High ownership, low ego: you are happy for initiative owners to get the credit while you make the whole systemwork.STRONG PLUSES Hands-on experience rolling out AI or agentic programs: copilots, automation platforms, or adoption initiatives. Experience standing up PMO, measurement, or benefit-realization frameworks from scratch. Experience working across India and US teams and time zones. MBA or equivalent: useful, not required. Evidence of shipped outcomes beats credentials.What Success Looks Like — First 2 Quarters30 days - Operating cadence live. Central registry and skills repository v1 populated across all three companies.Efficiency baseline methodology locked with Delivery.90 days - Scorecard publishing on schedule. Every delivery director has a nominated AI champion. AI Championsand repository programs running. Measurement layer live on the first set of solutions.180 days - A stream of agents deployed for internal efficiency, with gains measured against baseline. Agenticgovernance framework developed and adopted. AI Champions and central repository programsrunning successfully, with duplicate builds cut and reuse visible across projects. POC to productionconversion tracked. The CTO is spending measurably less time on program mechanics and more onstrategy and clients.WHY THIS ROLE Rare vantage point: you see and shape the AI transformation of an entire 3,000-person group, three companies andten countries, from the sponsor's seat. title: Production lead – Printing & Production Operations
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Production Manager to oversee end-to-end print production operations, including vendor management, cost negotiation, quality control, delivery coordination, and production documentation.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of print deliverables, from understanding client requirements and print specifications to coordinating with printers, monitoring production timelines, inspecting finished materials, and ensuring timely delivery. The ideal candidate must have strong knowledge of paper grades, GSM, printing techniques, finishing processes, binding, packaging, and quality standards, along with excellent negotiation and coordination skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Print Production Management
* Manage end-to-end production of print materials, including scientific journals, medical education modules, calendars, brochures, booklets, newsletters, certificates, conference materials, and other marketing collaterals.
* Understand production briefs, artwork, quantities, dimensions, paper specifications, finishing requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure all print jobs are executed according to approved specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor production schedules and proactively address delays or operational challenges.
* Vendor & Printer Management
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and maintain relationships with printing vendors, paper suppliers, binding units, packaging vendors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate with printers at every stage, from quotation and proof approval to production, inspection, dispatch, and delivery.
* Obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors and assess them based on cost, quality, reliability, and turnaround time.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms to achieve cost efficiencies.
* Maintain an updated vendor database, including capabilities, pricing, turnaround times, and performance records.
* Knowledge of Paper & Print Specifications
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of paper types, grades, GSM, thickness, texture, opacity, and suitability for different print applications.
* Understand printing methods, including offset and digital printing, as well as lamination, UV coating, binding, folding, die-cutting, and other finishing techniques.
* Interpret technical specifications accurately, including dimensions, colour requirements, page counts, cover materials, binding styles, and packaging instructions.
* Verify that the paper and materials used by vendors match the approved specifications.
* Identify material substitutions or specification deviations before production and obtain approval wherever required.
* Costing & Budget Control
* Prepare and evaluate print production estimates and quotations.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive pricing without compromising quality.
* Compare actual production costs against approved budgets and identify opportunities for savings.
* Track cost variations arising from changes in quantities, paper specifications, artwork, finishing, or delivery requirements.
* Ensure all commercial commitments and additional costs are documented and approved.
* Quality Control & Inspection
* Inspect samples, colour proofs, paper quality, print alignment, colour consistency, binding, finishing, and overall workmanship.
* Ensure the final output matches the approved artwork, specifications, sample, and purchase order.
* Identify defects such as incorrect GSM, colour variations, misprints, poor binding, damaged copies, and quantity shortages.
* Coordinate corrective actions, reprints, replacements, or vendor claims wherever necessary.
* Ensure that only approved, quality-checked materials are dispatched to clients or designated locations.
* Delivery & Logistics Coordination
* Ensure timely delivery of all print materials to clients, offices, warehouses, event venues, and other designated locations.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners for dispatch schedules, packaging, transportation, and delivery tracking.
* Monitor committed delivery dates and escalate potential delays well in advance.
* Verify delivered quantities against purchase orders and dispatch records.
* Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, carton identification, and shipment documentation for every delivery.
* Documentation & Reporting
* Maintain complete documentation for every print job, including:

+ Production briefs and approved specifications.
+ Vendor quotations and cost comparisons.
+ Purchase orders and work orders.
+ Artwork and proof approvals.
+ Paper specifications and quality inspection reports.
+ Delivery challans, e-way bills wherever applicable, invoices, and dispatch records.
+ Delivery confirmations, shortage reports, and quality-related claims.

* Maintain a production tracker covering job status, vendor, quantities, costs, deadlines, and delivery status.
* Provide regular updates to management and internal teams on production progress, delays, costs, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure records are accurate, traceable, and readily available for audits and financial reconciliation.
* Internal Coordination
* Work closely with client servicing, medical education, design, accounts, procurement, and operations teams.
* Clarify technical requirements before releasing jobs to printers.
* Ensure approved artwork, specifications, quantities, and delivery instructions are communicated clearly to vendors.
* Coordinate invoice verification against purchase orders, agreed pricing, and actual deliveries.
* Take ownership of production-related issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Printing Technology, Print Production, Graphic Arts, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant experience in print production, commercial printing, publishing, or production operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of paper quality, GSM, printing processes, binding, finishing, and packaging.
* Proven experience in vendor coordination, quotation evaluation, and cost negotiation.
* Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, inventory, and delivery management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation, with the ability to maintain production trackers and cost comparison sheets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple jobs simultaneously.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time delivery rate of print jobs.
* Adherence to approved print specifications and quality standards.
* Cost savings achieved through vendor negotiations.
* Reduction in printing errors, reprints, wastage, and material shortages.
* Accuracy and completeness of production documentation.
* Vendor performance and responsiveness.
* Timely resolution of production and delivery issues.
* Adherence to approved budgets and purchase order values.

title: Enterprise Integration Specialist - Senior Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
The Officer, Enterprise Integration Specialist will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integrations across cybersecurity, engineering, operations, identity, and data platforms. The role will enable the onboarding of new data sources, automate workflow orchestration, and establish seamless connectivity between enterprise systems to improve operational efficiency, risk visibility, and remediation effectiveness.
  
  
This position will serve as a key technical partner across Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Application Development, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure data flows, system integrations, and business processes are scalable, reliable, and well-governed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Integration & Data Onboarding-***

* Design and implement integrations to onboard new enterprise data sources, including vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, cloud security platforms, and operational tooling.
* Develop API-based, event-driven, and batch integrations to aggregate and normalize data from disparate systems.
* Define and maintain integration standards, schemas, and data mapping frameworks.

***Workflow Automation & Orchestration-***

* Automate end-to-end workflows across security, engineering, operations, and governance processes.
* Enable automated ticket creation, assignment, escalation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Design workflow integrations that improve traceability and reduce manual effort across teams.
* Enterprise Platform Integration

**Build And Maintain Integrations With Platforms Such As**

* Jira
* GitHub / Git-based repositories
* ServiceNow
* IAM
* GCS Data Lakehouse and enterprise data platforms
* Vulnerability management and security scanning solutions
* CI/CD and DevSecOps toolchains
* Asset management and CMDB platforms

**Data Engineering & Analytics-**

* Develop and support data ingestion pipelines, transformations, and enrichment processes.
* Create integration patterns that support enterprise reporting, analytics, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and auditability across integrated systems.

**Stakeholder Collaboration-**

* Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data, Risk, and Business teams to understand integration requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and Engineering Leads to develop integration roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Support onboarding of new platforms, capabilities, and enterprise services.

**Security & Compliance-**

* Ensure integrations comply with enterprise security, privacy, and data governance standards.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection controls.
* Support audit, regulatory, and risk-management initiatives as required.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience with REST APIs, Graph APIs, webhooks, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar integration technologies.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, and identity management systems.
* Knowledge of ETL processes, data pipelines, and enterprise data architectures.
* Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, and workflow automation concepts.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience integrating cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and risk-management platforms.
* Familiarity with SailPoint, cloud platforms, and enterprise data lake architectures.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.

**Success Measures**

* Successful onboarding of new enterprise data sources and platforms.
* Increased automation and reduction of manual process steps.
* Improved visibility, traceability, and reporting across workflows.
* High reliability and scalability of integrations.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and adoption of integrated capabilities.

**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
  
  
We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.
  
  
Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery—from concept through detailed and construction design.
  
  
Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems.
* Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables

+ Equipment sizing & selection
+ Mechanical design calculations
+ Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
+ P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
+ Mechanical data sheets and specifications

* Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design.
* Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements.
* Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews.
* Manage and own key design management documents

+ Project Responsibility Matrix
+ Basis of Design
+ Overall Design Programme
+ Schedule of Deliverables
+ Design Risk Register
+ Design Change Register

* Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery.
* Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling.
* Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability.
* Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.

* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for

+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.
* Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.

* Socialize solution approaches with customers, validating feasibility, operating impact, scalability, and change management required for Copilot and agent rollouts.

* Partner with account and delivery teams to shape the solution play, refine estimates, adjust pre‑sales solution components, govern scope changes, and position technical risks for agentic AI adoption.

**Architecture Design and Deployment**

* Apply structured delivery methodologies (Agile/Iterative/Hybrid) and reference architectures to design scalable Copilot and agentic solutions.
* Own and maintain architectural documentation, including agent design specs, integration contracts, and operational runbooks.
* Define and communicate end-to-end architecture with traceability from business outcomes to agent behaviors, tools, data grounding, quality attributes, and compliance controls.
* Lead cost- and technology-based discussions to assess feasibility, deployment options (cloud/edge), scale, and customer appetite for agentic innovation.
* Apply business value principles prioritizing ROI, productivity, adoption/usage intensity, and long-term operational efficiency.
* Partner with the Project Manager to drive governance across design, build, testing, deployment, pilots, and scale-out of Copilot and agent capabilities.
* Validate delivered business value (revenue enablement, productivity uplift, customer/employee experience improvement, cost savings) and connect outcomes to telemetry and adoption signals.
* Direct development and execution of test strategies (functional, security, privacy, and AI evaluations) to prove requirement compliance and support remediation and sign-off.
* Collaborate with bid teams to prepare costed, traceable solution approaches with trade-offs, AI risk posture, and clear positions on responsible AI.
* Lead implementation with the Project Manager, establishing quality standards, release planning, and operational transition for agentic workloads.
* Highlight invalidated assumptions and drive refinements through structured change control and continuous learning from production usage.

**AI, Copilot, LowCode, and Agent Extensibility**

* Establish enterprise-grade architecture to support scaled Copilot and agent deployments.
* Design Copilot extensibility solutions with secure data access patterns and clear user/agent experience flows.
* Use Copilot Studio to build and manage agents (topics/actions, orchestration, channels, monitoring) for customer productivity improvement and business process transformation.
* Apply GitHub Copilot to accelerate engineering, enforce secure coding and quality, and improve delivery velocity for agentic solutions.

**Practice Development**

* Continuously evaluate and evolve architectural approaches based on field learnings, product roadmap, and responsible AI guidance to maintain a high quality IP portfolio.
* Drive reuse of IP across pre-sales and delivery to accelerate pipeline, improve quality, and standardize agentic delivery practices. Drive reuse of IP across pre‑sales and delivery engagements.
* Contribute to internal and external Microsoft professional communities by sharing patterns, learnings, and reusable agent/Copilot assets.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Build strong networks and influence across customer and internal teams to remove barriers and accelerate Copilot and agent adoption.
* Stay current on Microsoft’s AI Business Solutions strategy and communicate platform direction across M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Act as the technical conscience balancing customer expectations with feasibility, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

**Thought Leadership**

* Share insights, reusable patterns, and strategic guidance for Copilot and agentic architectures across global communities.
* Mentor technical talent on agentic design patterns, Power Platform governance, Copilot extensibility, and responsible AI engineering.

**PreSales**

* Discover customer priorities and pain points to shape Copilot and agentic solution plays that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Propose architectures and roadmaps with clear assumptions for data readiness, identity/permissions, integrations, and AI risk controls.
* Support Sales teams in winning and expanding enterprise engagements by leading with Copilot and Agents as the transformation entry point.
* Own technical estimates and delivery approach for agentic engagements using proven, experience‑based estimation methods and reusable accelerators.

**Solution Delivery**

* Guide Low‑Code / No‑Code AI adoption across Power Platform and Copilot-‑enabled development to accelerate business process transformation.
* Lead governance and deployment of Copilot Studio agents ensuring security, responsible AI, connector controls, and data boundary alignment.
* Deliver custom Microsoft 365 Copilot extensions using approved SDKs, plugins/connectors, automation frameworks, and secure data access patterns.
* Apply engineering excellence and DevOps practices (CI/CD, quality gates, automation, observability) using Azure DevOps and GitHub.
* Guide sprint/iteration planning, dependency mapping, and end‑to‑end release alignment to move from pilots to scaled production adoption.

**Quality Assurance**

* Review solutions for requirement fidelity, security/privacy posture, responsible AI compliance technical quality, best‑practice alignment, and operational readiness
* Provide advisory guidance for Copilot and agent architecture, design, and delivery execution.
* Enforce best practices for Copilot Studio agent lifecycle management, grounding strategies, evaluations, and monitoring for continuous improvement .

**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years in technology solutions, architecture, consulting, or specialized technical domains (e.g., Security).

OR
  
  

* Master’s degree in related field AND 12+ years in technology solutions, architecture, consulting, or specialized technical domains.

OR
  
  
Equivalent experience.
  
  

* Experience with a Global Systems Integrator, IT Vendor, or Microsoft Partner delivering enterprise‑scale Microsoft Business Applications.
* Strong hands‑on background in Business Applications and CRM solution delivery across medium to large enterprises.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
EndtoEnd IT / Low Code Business Applications Delivery
  
  

* Expertise across the full lifecycle of IT Solutions Delivery: Estimation, Proposal Development, Requirements, Business Process Modelling, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, and Operations.
* Proven delivery experience on Power Platform, M365, Copilot Studio solutions across industries.
* Experience building or extending solutions using M365 Copilot and hands on Copilot Studio expertise.
* Proficiency using GitHub Copilot or similar tools to accelerate solution development, improve engineering productivity, maintain coding standards, and support modern DevOps workflows.

Architecture, Design & Technical Leadership
