title: Team Lead - Engineering
description:
**About Tripstack -**
Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining. Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API. Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily. Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection. For more information, visit: www.tripstack.com ,www.etraveligroup.com
  
  
**Role Overview :**
As a Technical Lead on the Content team, you will architect software that ensures people can find the best flight combinations, as well as making Tripstack's software solid and scalable. A successful candidate will thrive in and help lead fast-paced environments that leverage agile planning techniques, encourage and reward creative design and intelligent risk taking, and find innovative ways to leverage cutting-edge technology. You will lead a high-performing team to ensure our systems are scalable and low-latency. You will drive the technical roadmap, mentor senior engineers, and balance innovative feature development with technical debt management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure high-quality delivery by owning the development from ideation, planning, design, implementation, and quality assurance to post-production monitoring.
* Ensure the team's technical decisions are consistently correct, and revisit them when the context changes.
* Unblock the team on technical ambiguity by resolving it quickly and directly.
* Strategize and support the team in unblocking itself using existing company resources and cross team collaboration.
* Author and approve code and designs that rarely require architectural rework after release.
* Ensure the team's solutions follow code guidelines and apply secure and defensive coding practices as a default.
* Build scalable, low-latency, fault-tolerant systems empirically proven through load and stress testing.
* Flag known tradeoffs before they become incidents.
* Track, plan, and resolve tech debt consciously so that it doesn’t pile up.
* Ensure the team's releases are monitored, documented, and supportable.
* Act as scrum master for the team.
* Improve the SDLC and project workflow for the team and group.
* Create an inclusive environment where every engineer can contribute and be heard.
* Promote team building and a durable team culture.
* Encourage responsible AI adoption within the team.
* Set clear expectations for how AI-assisted work is reviewed before it merges.
* You translate broader business objectives into clear engineering tasks while shielding the team from unnecessary external noise.
* Remove blockers using approved AI tooling.

**Requirements -**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using C#, .Net core, javascript, and typescript.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading an agile development team.
* Strong experience in leading a mid-sized team (7-10) which includes developers and QA Engineers.
* Strong experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, XML, JSON, and SOAP.
* Strong architectural & system design skills.
* Experience in GCP/AWS is a plus.
* Strong experience with code review tools like SonarQube, etc.
* Hands-on experience in driving ambiguous problem areas in existing or new software initiatives.
* Proven experience in solving complex architecture and business problems with solutions that are extensible, simple, and optimal.
* Ability to think in terms of integrating systems and networks as well as programs.
* Strong Experience influencing software engineering best practices within your team, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Experience taking a leading role in building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers with other engineers working under your guidance.
* Experience mentoring software engineers to improve their skills, and making them more effective software engineers.
* Experience in communicating with engineering leadership to understand requirements describing software product features, technical designs, and product strategy.
* Experience in system development skills in C#.
* Experience upskilling senior engineers in AI-assisted coding.
* Proficiency in using AI tools like Claude to improve efficiency of SDLC.

**What Success Looks Like -**

* The team regularly meets the delivery commitments on quality.
* Technical ambiguity does not stall the team; decisions are made and communicated quickly.
* Post-release architectural rework, rollbacks or incidents are rare.
* Engineers on the team describe it as a place where they express themselves and produce their best work.

**Other:**

* Work Mode : Hybrid
* Work Timings: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
* Second level of On call support for production systems that are owned by team

**What it takes to succeed here -**
Ambition and dedication to make a difference and change the way people travel; Where we always play to each other's strength in a high performing team reaching for our common goal. We hold ourselves to the highest expectations, and move with a sense of urgency and hold ourselves accountable and win by staying true to what we believe in.
  
  
**What we offer -**
We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
  
  
**Diversity disclaimer -**
At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Ops Support Senior Supervisor

The overall objective of this role is to ensure the seamless delivery of operations support services in alignment with Citi operations support infrastructure and processes.

Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.

Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.

title: Manager - Cloud Container Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise.
  
  
This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi-tenant AKS operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform Operations & Service Ownership
  
  

* Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls.
* Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-life planning.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements.

Kubernetes Platform Management
  
  

* Oversee centralized multi-tenant AKS environments supporting mission-critical and non-mission-critical workloads.
* Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations.
* Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements.
* Implement automation-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code.
* Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity readiness for critical Kubernetes workloads.
* Reduce operational overhead through standardization and automated remediation.

Executive Reporting & Operational Metrics
  
  

* Develop executive dashboards and leadership reporting focused on:

+ Platform Availability & Uptime
+ Cluster Health Metrics
+ MTTR & Incident Trends
+ SLA/SLO Compliance
+ Kubernetes Resource Utilization
+ Capacity Planning & Forecasting
+ Node Pool Utilization
+ Security & Compliance Posture
+ Platform Adoption Metrics
+ Cost Optimization & FinOps Insights
+ Support Backlog & Service Request Metrics

* Present operational reviews, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership

**Security & Governance**

* Maintain enterprise Kubernetes governance standards.
* Oversee RBAC, Azure AD integration, Managed Identities, and secrets management.
* Ensure enforcement of Azure Policy, security guardrails, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to ensure secure platform operations.
* Lead audit and regulatory compliance activities related to container platforms

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary operational contact for application teams consuming AKS services.
* Build relationships with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and strategic partners to optimize platform capabilities.
* Drive customer experience and service improvement initiatives across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Kubernetes platform operations team.
* Establish operational goals and performance expectations.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical capability growth.
* Promote a culture of automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, container engineering or platform engineering with 15+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments.
* 5+ years of people management experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, specifically:

+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
+ Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD.
+ DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Hub and Spoke Architecture,
+ RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault etc..

* Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews.
* Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Kubernetes Services.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration, and cloud-native technologies.
* Expertise in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) administration and operations.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong knowledge of container technologies including Docker and container registries.
* Experience with GitOps practices using ArgoCD and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Bicep).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Private Link, Azure Firewall, ingress, and service networking.
* Experience implementing Kubernetes security controls, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Secrets Management.
* Expertise in observability, monitoring, logging, and performance management using enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
* Vendor and Managed Service Provider Governance.

Key Success Metrics
  
  

* Enterprise CAKS platform consistently achieves availability, performance, and security objectives.
* Increased adoption of centralized AKS services across business units.
* High levels of automation, self-service, and operational maturity.
* Reduced operational overhead and improved platform reliability.
* Leadership receives timely, actionable operational insights and recommendations.
* High-performing teams delivering secure, scalable, and resilient Kubernetes platform services.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**

title: RFX Specialist
description:
Job Title
  
  
RFX Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
**RfX Specialist | Pune | Full-time**
Vanderlande is seeking a proactive Global RfX Specialist to enhance our procurement excellence through robust RfX processes. As part of the global Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will play a pivotal role in supporting our category managers and demand managers worldwide. Your expertise will streamline RfX operations, strengthen supplier communication, and drive process improvements.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables our projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the smart, cost effective, and sustainable procurement of goods and services. We ensure a resilient and competitive supplier ecosystem, supporting our transition towards best-in-class procurement practices and a more efficient, effective, and future proof organization.
  
  
Furthermore, procurement plays an important role in Vanderlande’s transformation from an Engineer to Order (ETO) to a Configure to Order (CTO) business model—enhancing customer value through increased standardization, scalability, and competitiveness.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Global RfX Specialist, you will support all RfX related activities, ensuring the timely and smooth execution of proposals and quotations. You will coordinate submission timelines, assist in evaluating supplier responses, and collaborate closely with cross functional business functions. You will follow established RfX processes while contributing to the continuous improvement of procurement practices across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you bring**

* Support category managers and demand managers worldwide in executing RfX processes (including spot buys and light tenders), including drafting RfX documents and assisting with initial proposal and quotation analysis.
* Coordinate and communicate submission timelines with suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal stakeholders.
* Consolidate supplier responses into clear, structured formats to support evaluations and decision making.
* Execute all RfX activities in compliance with procurement policies, legal regulations, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Identify opportunities for improving RfX processes and support the implementation of best practices across the Procurement CoE.

**What do we ask from you?**
To be successful in this role, you should have
  
  

* 4-7 years of proven progressive experience in procurement processes and sourcing strategies, ideally with hands on involvement in RfX activities such as drafting documents, evaluating proposals, and supporting supplier selection.
* Experience in project-based procurement environments (e.g., engineering, automation, intralogistics, material handling, or system integration), with the ability to work effectively when requirements evolve or clarity is limited.
* Strong ability to analyze supplier responses, identify key performance indicators, and support strategic procurement decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple RfX tasks simultaneously while maintaining accurate documentation.
* Demonstrated capability to identify and support process improvements, ideally within RfX or procurement operations.
* Stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively with cross functional global teams such as engineering, project management, category management, finance, and planning.
* Comfort working in ambiguous, low SOP environments, bringing structure, clarity, and proactive follow up when information is incomplete.
* Exposure to global, multicultural environments, with the ability to work across regions, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to interact effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders worldwide.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Tech Resilience - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments
* Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements
* Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services
* Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness
* Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. They manage dynamic attack surfaces and support business continuity through services such as operational resilience, crisis and incident response, and security operations center transformation.
  
  
Resilience as a Practice focuses on preparing organizations to anticipate, withstand, and recover from disruptions—including cyberattacks, natural disasters, and operational failures—by embedding resilience into processes, technology, and culture. Deloitte’s Resilience Team combines technical, operational, and strategic expertise to deliver integrated solutions for business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management, ensuring organizations meet regulatory demands and maintain stakeholder trust during crises.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Based on client / project needs**
**Qualifications**

title: Closing Manager-Commercial Projects
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Discovery & Qualification:** Conduct structured discovery meetings to understand customer requirements, investment objectives, budget, preferred location, business needs, decision-making process, and purchase timeline before presenting suitable commercial inventory.
* **Commercial Project Presentation:** Present commercial projects by highlighting location advantages, connectivity, product positioning, Grade-A specifications, floor plate and unit options, pricing, payment plans, and overall investment rationale.
* **Investment Analysis & Comparison:** Prepare relevant comparisons with competing commercial projects and alternative investment options, focusing on location, specifications, pricing, rental potential, and other key factors without making unsupported claims.
* **Rental Yield & Appreciation Discussion:** Explain rental income potential, yield calculations, and capital appreciation scenarios using only company-approved assumptions, data, and tools. Clearly communicate that projections are indicative and not guaranteed returns.
* **Objection Handling:** Address customer concerns related to pricing, construction timelines, leasing potential, parking, floor selection, unit size, total investment, payment schedules, liquidity, and other purchase-related considerations.
* **Customer Engagement & Follow-ups:** Drive repeat meetings, property revisits, family and business-partner discussions, and meetings with key decision-makers to build confidence and accelerate purchase decisions.
* **Negotiation & Deal Closure:** Negotiate commercial terms within approved pricing and discount authority. Escalate requests for exceptions with complete deal details, customer expectations, commercial justification, and proposed terms for approval.
* **Sales Pipeline Management:** Maintain accurate CRM records for every active opportunity, including meeting notes, customer feedback, objections, next actions, opportunity maturity stage, expected closure date, and probability of conversion.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:** Coordinate with sourcing, channel partner, CRM, finance, legal, and documentation teams to ensure smooth communication and timely resolution of customer queries throughout the closing process.
* **Booking & Documentation Handover:** Drive the customer through booking confirmation and coordinate the complete handover of booking details, customer commitments, approved commercial terms, and relevant documentation to the CRM and documentation teams after closure.
* **Target Achievement:** Achieve assigned sales and revenue targets by converting qualified leads into confirmed bookings, improving conversion ratios, and maintaining a healthy pipeline of closure-ready opportunities.
* **Customer Relationship Management:** Build long-term relationships with investors, business owners, corporate occupiers, and other commercial property buyers to encourage repeat business and referrals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong face-to-face sales presence with confidence in handling high-value commercial real estate transactions.
* Ability to sell to both investors seeking investment opportunities and end-users purchasing commercial premises for their own business requirements.
* Financial acumen and the ability to explain pricing structures, payment schedules, rental yield calculations, and investment scenarios.
* Strong negotiation, objection-handling, presentation, and deal-closing skills.
* Excellent follow-up discipline, customer relationship management, and decision-maker engagement.
* Working knowledge of CRM systems, sales pipeline management, booking processes, and commercial documentation.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹68,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

The Senior Project Manager will lead end-to-end execution of commercial office interior fit-out projects, ensuring timely delivery, cost control, quality, and client satisfaction. The role involves overseeing project teams, managing contractors and vendors, coordinating with design and procurement teams, and driving project performance, profitability, and compliance across multiple project sites.

* Lead end-to-end project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution in alignment with client expectations and organisational objectives.

* Ensure adherence to project timelines, budgets, quality standards, and safety regulations.

2. Project Execution & Team Management

* Lead project review meetings, provide progress updates, and ensure timely resolution of client concerns.
* Manage scope changes, variations, claims, and escalations in coordination with internal teams.
* Build and maintain strong client, consultant, contractor, and vendor relationships.

* Monitor project budgets, cost estimates, procurement commitments, and actual expenditure.
* Ensure effective resource utilisation and cost control without compromising quality.
* Review BOQs, tender documents, material specifications, and vendor quotations.
* Support billing, variation management, commercial negotiations, and project profitability.

5. Leadership, Reporting & Compliance

* Lead, mentor, and manage Project Managers, site teams, and execution personnel.
* Establish project governance mechanisms, reporting structures, and performance review processes.
* Review project MIS, dashboards, site reports, risk registers, and quality documentation.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, statutory regulations, safety standards, and sustainability requirements, including LEED documentation where applicable.
* Drive process improvements, operational efficiency, and consistent project delivery standards.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in commercial office interior fit-out and project execution, preferably in a design-and-build organisation.
* Proven experience managing large-scale commercial interior projects and multiple project teams.
* Strong understanding of construction planning, site execution, finishing works, procurement coordination, and material specifications.
* Experience in project budgeting, cost control, BOQs, vendor negotiations, variations, and commercial management.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, tender documents, and construction specifications.
* Excellent leadership, client management, stakeholder coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong reporting, documentation, and project management capabilities.
* Willingness to travel to project sites across locations, as required.
* **Preferred Experience:**
  Candidates with experience in corporate office interiors, commercial interior fit-outs, and turnkey design-and-build projects will be preferred.

Medigrad is a trusted online learning platform for doctors, offering fellowship courses after MBBS across 40+ specialties, accredited by CPD (UK) and supported by training options in 80+ hospitals. description:

  1–2 years
* **Work Mode:**

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Full-time · Some travel

Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. Built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Sitender Sehrawat is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. The work is active across Europe, the US, and the Gulf, and it is scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does. The bridge between Sitender and the world— the person who holds the whole picture, ensures nothing is dropped, and protects the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

You will run the day-to-day across event logistics, the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: capable of managing a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and sensing what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats
* Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up
* Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination
* Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and maintaining a consistent voice and aesthetic
* Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators spanning multiple time zones
* Keep the office of the founder moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and ensuring projects don't stall
* Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

*Essential*

* 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles
* Exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details
* Strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency
* Comfortable owning social media and marketing execution
* Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed
* Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

*Preferred*

* Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure
* Background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation with many moving parts
* A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities
* Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

* You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped
* Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters
* Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things
* A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

* Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location
* A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide
* Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer
* Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role
* Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

We don't pay much attention to where you went to school — or whether you did. A degree is welcome but not necessary. What matters is capability, character, and care. We're looking for the kind of person whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

**Compensation & Onboarding**

This role begins with an 8-week probation period. During these first eight weeks, you'll be paid a mutually agreed figure while we both find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion — based on performance and delivery — you'll step into the role permanently, with a full CTC
upwards
of 6 LPA, commensurate with experience and growing as the work expands across cities.

**To Apply**

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

www.antaha.org

description:
**Overview**
Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
  
  
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems. Jhpiego currently works in over 14 states of India, focusing on women’s health — including maternal, reproductive, and women’s cancers — and provides technical assistance to governments on health systems, human resources, quality of care, health surveillance, digital health, and primary health care.
  
  
SAAKSHI (Strengthening Access to Affordable and Quality Healthcare for Worker Communities through Awareness, Prevention, and Public Health Linkages) is a three-year initiative supported by the H&M Foundation, working in Panipat’s textile recycling ecosystem. The project will strengthen health, hygiene, and workforce stability for 1,500 migrant workers and their families by establishing integrated, community-owned primary healthcare access systems; strengthening preventive and occupational health practices at the workplace and in the community; and driving behaviour change and facilitation support to increase uptake of Government health and social protection schemes, including PM-JAY and ESIC.
  
  
The project is organised around three sub-goals: (1) improving sustained access to preventive, occupational, and primary healthcare; (2) enabling behaviour change and community ownership for long-term outcomes; and (3) strengthening local systems, governance, and frontline capacity to sustain impact.
  
  
The Senior Assistant- Program will support the implementation of community-based project activities and work closely with migrant worker communities, public health systems, employers, frontline health workers, and community leaders. The role requires strong field coordination, community engagement, and stakeholder management skills to ensure effective delivery of project interventions
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support implementation of community outreach, health promotion, and occupational health activities.
* Mobilize communities for health camps, screenings, awareness sessions, and enrolment drives.
* Facilitate access to government health and social protection schemes, including PM-JAY, ESIC, and other welfare programs.
* Coordinate with ASHAs, ANMs, public health facilities, hospitals, employers, and community stakeholders.
* Support identification and capacity building of community champions and peer leaders.
* Assist in establishing and strengthening workplace health and safety committees.
* Maintain project records, beneficiary databases, activity reports, and referral tracking systems.

Contribute to data collection, monitoring, reporting, and project review processes
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in public health, community development, social protection, or related programs.
* Experience in community mobilization, behavior change communication, and stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with government health systems and social welfare schemes is desirable.
* Experience working with migrant populations, urban health, or occupational health programs will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong community mobilization and facilitation abilities.
* Good documentation, reporting, and data management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital data collection tools.
* Ability to work independently in field settings and manage multiple priorities.
* Fluency in Hindi; working knowledge of English preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Panipat and surrounding areas.

title: Associate Fire Engineer
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
  
  
We are an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services. Through our work, we make a positive difference in the world.
  
  
As an Associate Fire Engineer you will be working with a creative, innovative, multi-cultural and self-motivated team of fire safety consultants in India, the wider UKIMEA region and globally. The successful candidate will complement our fire safety consultants by assisting with the implementation of fire engineering solutions and fire strategies across our projects. Due to our geographic location, we are very well positioned to work closely with our fire teams globally. It's an exciting time to be a part of our growth in India.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The successful candidate will form part of the project team on a range of different projects, managing junior engineers, and being supported by the wider team as necessary. The role will involve interactive and collaborative working with our fire engineers and with colleagues throughout the multidisciplinary teams at Arup. The projects will be diverse, exciting and range from conceptual fire strategy and masterplan developments through to detailed design and handing over landmark projects.
  
  
Our Fire Engineering team takes a particularly active role in the development of our people and routinely provide opportunities to attend appropriate training and development courses. Also, because of the developing nature of fire engineering, employees are encouraged to attend annual conferences and CPD events (both internal and external). Once you have demonstrated a suitable skill level in fire engineering and delivery of projects there will be a number of opportunities to advance your career.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is technically excellent and capable of delivering quality fire safety solutions on time and on budget. A proven track record of gaining agreement for prescriptive and performance-based design solutions from approving authorities is also essential.
  
  
As a senior member of the Fire team, you will have strong communication and negotiating skills and experience of leading project teams. You will be a team player capable of imparting knowledge and experience to other members of the team to grow and develop them under your support.
  
  
You should have strong commercial and client facing skills and be able to represent Arup externally with minimal supervision. An existing portfolio of clients / contacts in the industry would be of benefit.
  
  
Experience in the principles of smoke control and means of escape are essential and knowledge of fire safety codes, standards and guidance associated with the industry is also important.
  
  
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
  
  
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
  
  
**Is this role right for you?**
**We Are Looking For Candidates With**

* A minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant degree subject (fire engineering, other types of engineering, or architecture related degree).
* Chartered status with a relevant institution such as the Institution of Fire Engineers or be close to gaining Chartered Engineer status or equivalent (e.g. Professional Engineer in USA).
* 7+ years’ experience in a consultancy or similar environment with at least 3 years in a similar senior position. Extensive experience in delivering fire engineered solutions.
* Awareness of industry challenges and code changes and experience in implementation in projects as well as discussing/presenting to clients and stakeholders on the topic.
* Knowledge of IBC and NFPA codes and standards would be a benefit but not essential.
* Be familiar with RIBA stages of design or other design frameworks and understand the total fire concept: from the client brief through to construction and operation, the fire engineering challenges relevant to different design stages and the level/type of fire engineering input required to progress the design and contribute to completion.
* Experience in managing other engineers in the development and implementation of fire strategies, projects, and research initiatives.
* Experience in managing financial performance on projects.
* Experience in negotiation and agreement of scope, fee, contractual terms and conditions with clients. Understand and manage the scope and relevant programme constraints of projects, experience in project changes management.
* Experience in presenting and discussing design solutions, including fire engineering assessments, to approving authorities and other stakeholders.
* Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting junior engineers in their career development.
* Excellent report writing, presentation and communication skills, be collaborative, be creative and engaging.
* Experience in business development activities and establishing a network of clients / colleagues inside and outside Arup.

**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance
  
  
**Different people, shared values**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

description:
**\*\* Deadline to apply is 23 October 2026 \*\***

**Description of assignment title**

Sustainable Finance Specialist - Integrated Watershed Management

**Host entity**

UNEP India

**Modality**

Onsite

National

Specialist UCoS from Apr2026

Full-time

1

India

**Duty stations**

New Delhi

**Work location**

On UN premises

**Expected start date**

01/11/2026

**Expected end date**

31/03/2027

**Mission and objectives**

UNEP’s mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in caring for the environment by inspiring, informing, and enabling nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations. For five decades, the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) has been a leading advocate for the environment, a steadfast partner and a trusted adviser with a mission to inform, enable and inspire nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations. UNEP monitors the state and health of the planet, ensures that science remains at the centre of decision-making processes, and that environmental rule of law continues to underpin global environmental governance.

Together with its partners, UNEP has made significant progress, yet there is no denying that today, environmental challenges have reached unprecedented levels. Unsustainable patterns of consumption and production have led to the triple planetary crisis of climate change, nature and biodiversity loss, and pollution and waste. The science is clear: human health, prosperity, equity and peace are all under threat. We must urgently transform our economies and societies and our relationship with nature. UNEP is here to lead this transformation with its 193 Member States, and in partnership with other UN agencies and stakeholders. With its experience, expertise, dynamic programmes and forward-thinking strategy, and with its dedicated staff, UNEP is uniquely positioned in addressing and reversing the triple planetary crisis.

**Context**

The UN Volunteer assignment is part of the India component of the European Commission-funded Sustainable Watershed Management Project in Brazil and India. The UN Volunteer will be working under the direct supervision of the relevant Programme Management Officer in UNEP India Office and the overall project supervision of the Project Lead within the Freshwater and Wetlands Ecosystems Unit, Marine and Freshwater Branch at UNEP HQ, and in close collaboration with relevant UNEP teams, implementing partners, national counterparts and technical experts.

**Task description**

• Conduct targeted research and analysis on existing financing approaches and enabling conditions at the national, state, and local/project levels.

• Analyze best practices and challenges in existing financing approaches in India based on review of the literature and stakeholder consultations.

• Support the analysis and documentation of findings and insights of the financing dimension of the India pilot.

• Develop a draft sustainable finance framework and accompanying recommendations for integrated watershed management in India, including the identification and assessment of relevant investment opportunities.

• Support stakeholder consultations and coordination with relevant government agencies, financial institutions, implementing partners, and technical experts contributing to the India pilot case.

• Draft technical outputs related to the India sustainable finance framework, including reports, presentations, and supporting knowledge products.

• Support the development of a global guidance document on sustainable finance for watershed management based on the analysis and synthesis of lessons learned and practical experiences from the India and Brazil case studies, contributing to a replicable and scalable approach for integrated, sustainable watershed management across regions and countries.

• Coordinate with UNEP teams, project partners, and technical experts to support the integration of technical inputs and feedback into project deliverables.

• Support knowledge-sharing and communication activities related to sustainable finance, watershed management, and freshwater ecosystem resilience, as relevant to the project.

• Report regularly to the supervising officer and project lead within the Freshwater and Wetlands Ecosystems Unit on progress related to the assignment and delivery of outputs.

• Any other tasks that may be required in support of the assignment and project objectives.

**Relevant experience**

4 years

**Languages**

English, Level: Fluent, Required

Hindi, Level: Fluent, Desirable

**Required education level**

Master's degree in Sustainable finance, environmental finance, natural resource economics

An advantage will be given to candidates with prior experience in freshwater ecosystems, watershed management, or related natural resource management fields.

**Skills and experience**

• Minimum of 4 years of progressively responsible professional experience at national and/or international level in sustainable finance, environmental finance, climate finance, investment analysis, natural resource economics, or related fields.

• Demonstrated experience in developing technical reports, policy papers, financing frameworks, guidance documents, or knowledge products related to sustainable or environmental finance.

• Strong experience in research and analysis of financing mechanisms, including blended finance, investment structuring, and enabling policy/financial environments for sustainable development.

• Proven ability to produce high-quality written outputs, including drafting, editing, and synthesizing complex technical information for diverse audiences.

Desirable Experience

• Experience engaging with or coordinating among government institutions, development partners, financial institutions, private sector actors, and technical experts.

• Familiarity with watershed management, freshwater ecosystems, nature-based solutions, or climate adaptation financing.

• Experience working in international, multi-stakeholder environments, including development or UN system contexts.

• Previous experience with the United Nations system or other international organizations is an asset

Skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong drafting, formulation, and reporting abilities.

• High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism in document production and editing.

• Strong interpersonal and intercultural skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders, including government counterparts, technical experts, and community-level actors.

• Ability to work effectively in complex and multicultural environments, demonstrating adaptability and sound judgment under tight deadlines.

• Strong computer literacy, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and standard digital communication tools; familiarity with databases or project management tools is an advantage.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision while delivering high-quality outputs under time constraints.

description:

Yahhvi – EV Charging is dedicated to accelerating India’s transition to clean mobility by building a sustainable, reliable, and future-ready EV charging ecosystem for commercial and heavy-duty vehicles. The company focuses on infrastructure that supports rapid electrification and strengthens the broader EV ecosystem through innovation, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships. Yahhvi’s vision is to power the electrification of India’s freight economy by creating backbone charging infrastructure that connects warehouses, logistics hubs, and freight corridors. The mission centers on deploying high-performance charging hubs for electric fleets using strategic location planning, demand-controlled energy distribution, and integrated fleet partnerships. Yahhvi aims to deliver reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient charging solutions for commercial trucks and fleet operators.

title: Global Project Manager – Corporate Real Estate, IT Infrastructure & Procurement
description:
**Global Project Manager – Corporate Real Estate, IT Infrastructure & Procurement**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, Bangalore, and Mumbai, India

**Experience:**
(3–8 years of relevant experience)

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems through hands-on execution. Its culture values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. Established in 2023, A&M’s India Global Capability Center (GCC) partners with leadership across business units and geographies to scale client delivery, accelerate execution, improve pricing, and apply automation. Unlike a traditional back-office center, the GCC supports end-to-end case delivery and thought leadership across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The 900+ member team serves sectors including Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources, and Financial Services. Nearly 90% of consultants hold advanced degrees, while its leadership team brings more than 1,000 years of combined experience. GESS is a strategic partner supporting technology, marketing, information security, knowledge management, corporate real estate, human resources, and operations.

**About the Role**

As Global Project Manager, you will own cross-regional IT infrastructure and Corporate Real Estate initiatives from planning through completion. You will coordinate office build-outs, relocations, decommissioning, site readiness, procurement, vendor execution, and IT asset lifecycle activities. The role connects architecture frameworks, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, office space networking, software-led infrastructure delivery, Facilities, Security, IT, CRE, and regional stakeholders. Success means delivering compliant projects on schedule, within approved budgets, and aligned with business requirements. You will manage multiple workstreams, maintain executive visibility, and improve the systems and processes that make global project delivery predictable. Candidates must hold a PMP certification and demonstrate flexibility to relocate to Gurgaon, where the majority of the global IT team is based.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own global IT infrastructure and CRE project plans for office build-outs, relocations, and decommissioning, using schedules, milestones, dependencies, and risk controls to deliver predictable outcomes.
* Translate architecture frameworks and software-led infrastructure requirements across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and office networking into coordinated site-readiness plans with IT, CRE, Facilities, Security, and regional teams.
* Control procurement execution for equipment, infrastructure, and project services by managing vendors, contracts, purchase orders, delivery schedules, invoices, and spend against approved budgets.
* Govern stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, decision logs, escalation paths, and leadership updates that keep global teams aligned on scope, timing, risks, and business impact.
* Own IT asset lifecycle coordination across deployment, redeployment, inventory, audits, and disposition, maintaining accurate records in IT Asset Management systems such as ServiceNow.
* Improve project, procurement, and asset-management workflows through standardization, vendor performance management, cost-saving opportunities, and compliance with corporate financial and procurement policies.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* PMP certification is mandatory, supported by 3–8 years of experience in project management, corporate real estate, IT infrastructure, procurement, or a closely related field.
* Proven experience delivering global or multi-site projects, including office build-outs, relocations, site readiness, infrastructure deployments, and coordination across international stakeholders.
* Strong capability with software-led infrastructure concepts, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, office networking, vendor management, budget tracking, Microsoft Office, project tracking tools, and ITAM platforms such as ServiceNow.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience partnering with Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Security, IT operations, architecture, or workplace technology teams in large enterprise or global environments.
* Experience managing IT equipment deployment, inventory planning, lifecycle controls, audits, and disposition across multiple locations and regional operating models.
* Familiarity with procurement standardization, contract execution, project financial controls, and identifying measurable vendor savings or process efficiencies.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring structured ownership of complex, multi-region programs and can turn ambiguous requirements into sequenced plans, clear accountabilities, controlled risks, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* You combine corporate real estate awareness with practical IT infrastructure understanding, especially architecture frameworks, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, office space networking, and software-led delivery environments.
* You are commercially disciplined, able to connect procurement decisions, vendor performance, purchase orders, invoices, asset records, and budget variance to sound financial governance.
* You communicate confidently with leadership, vendors, technical teams, Facilities, CRE, Security, and regional stakeholders, adapting detail and escalation to the decision required.
* You are organized across competing priorities, solve problems without losing momentum, and use systems, reporting, and standardization to improve operational reliability.
* You hold a PMP certification and are willing to relocate to Gurgaon if required, recognizing that most of the global IT team is based there.

**Why Join Us**

At A&M, your work will shape how a rapidly growing global capability center delivers technology-enabled workplaces and supports international consulting teams. You will own visible projects that connect corporate real estate, IT infrastructure, procurement, and asset operations across multiple regions. The role offers exposure to global stakeholders, varied industries, and the full lifecycle of complex workplace and infrastructure initiatives rather than a narrow administrative remit. You will join GESS, a strategic business partner whose work enables client service delivery, go-to-market execution, risk management, and firm growth. A&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives capable professionals room to make decisions, challenge conventional approaches, and create practical improvements. Your impact will be visible through faster site readiness, stronger governance, better vendor outcomes, accurate asset control, and reliable delivery against business commitments. The firm supports continued growth through merit-based development, training, on-the-job learning, well-being resources, and opportunities to build specialized expertise in a global environment.

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where independent thinkers can influence global projects, improve operating models, and see the business impact of their work.
* Continuous learning through formal training, on-the-job development, performance feedback, and exposure to senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
* A people-focused experience with merit-based growth opportunities, benefits, and well-being resources supporting professional development and personal success.

title: Project Leader - Mergers & Acquisitions CoE
description:
**About Us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, cross-industry capabilities, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

 

**About M&A CoE**

* M&A Center of Excellence (CoE) at BCN is a new CoE being established to support Bain’s capabilities for
  **M&A And Divestitures practice**
* **Bain’s M&A CoE offerings will include offerings across Growth and M&A Strategy, Deal Sourcing and Screening, Corporate Due Diligence (Integration thesis and Synergies modules) , Merger Integration, Divestiture and Separation. The CoE will play a crucial role in improving and further differentiating Bain’s approach across these offerings.**
* The M&A CoE will actively support Bain Partners/ Global Case teams across and Client Cases/ Client development efforts
* Additionally, the CoE will also work closely with M&A and Divestitures practice/solution leadership in building new IP/ Products/ Tools etc.
* CoE scope and scale is expected to evolve over time to more deeper domain expertise, broader scope and end-to-end offerings. Plan is to also expand the CoE to BCN Mexico in future.

**About You**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong academic background
* 4-6 years of prior domain experience/ relevant expertise e,g. Synergy analysis (and/or cost diagnostics), Due Diligence (M&A or Private Equity), Merger Integration, Divestiture strategy, etc
* Strong analytical skills with proven ability of leveraging/ embracing automation / AI to drive efficiency across products/ offerings.
* High-level competence in core analytical tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Hands-on skills in research and analytics are required, along with significant exposure to key secondary data sources. A robust consulting and problem-solving skill set tied with a background in marketing analytics is also necessary
* Fundamental skills include excellent work planning, communication, and team leading abilities. Relevant experience with data analytics, project and team management, coaching, and mentoring is also required

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead a team of Associates /Analysts to produce client-ready products and analysis, generating strong business insights and understanding implications
* Works under the guidance of the COE Manager/Senior Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer, final materials, client communication, work planning, and team management. Brainstorming with the Manager on various aspects for IP development, CD, case work as needed
* Works with project/case teams across geographies and industries; however, they focus almost exclusively M&A related projects/ cases
* Ensure timely, high quality, error-free research, analysis and output produced by the analysts/associates. Driving insights through data analysis – Story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses
* Brings to the table various cutting-edge technologies and best practices in a productized delivery model; adoption of AI/ agentic tools for driving efficiency
* Communicate effectively and clearly explain insights and implications for the client
* Openness to transfer to Mexico / help set-up M&A in Mexico will be an added advantage

  

**What makes us a great place to work**

We are proud to be
consistently recognized
as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for
diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents
.

You will ensure organizational alignment, integrate systems and tools, and manage the end-to-end change process to deliver a highly efficient and effective global sourcing function
* **Strategic Insights**
  : Consolidate and analyze internal and external data to identify emerging trends, commercial risks, and white-space opportunities. Translate these insights into executive-level narratives and actionable recommendations that influence long-term strategy

  Lead the execution of high-priority strategic projects (team level or Group level) from inception to completion. Establish project governance, track milestones, and manage cross-functional dependencies to ensure initiatives are delivered on time
* **AOP Planning:**
  Orchestrate the annual planning cycle for Asia Sourcing team, translating multi year strategies into actionable targets - defining budget requirements, resource allocation and KPIs that ensure the Group’s commercial and operation goals are met
* **Thought Leadership:**
  Act as a subject matter expert on strategic framework designs, global sourcing trends, emerging technologies, and geopolitical shifts. You will proactively identify industry best practices and innovative sourcing models to challenge the status quo, ensuring the Group remains competitive and resilient in a changing global market.
* **Collaboration Facilitation:**
  Build communication and internal collaboration within the Sourcing and Asia teams and between the Australian business commercial teams. Identify opportunities and ensure teams are working towards common goals.
* **Stakeholder Engagement and Management:**
  Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the Group commercial and enablement teams and within sourcing teams to understand their needs and align sourcing strategies and strategic initiatives accordingly

**What You'll Bring**

***Personal Characteristics***

* Influence, adaptability, judgment, collaboration, managerial skills, interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Horizontal Leadership capabilities and the ability to work well in a pressured situation
* Ability to influence, establish and maintain strong relationships with senior management.

***Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities***

* 10+ years of relevant retail / industry experience necessary.
* Proven experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management. Project management experience is an added advantage.
* Strong business acumen analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good understanding of retail operations, industry trends, supply chain and AI Integration.
* Track record of managing and delivering change as well as results
* Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of relevant sourcing tools and buying processes & systems.

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium insurance coverage for you and your dependents

**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group**

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems.
