title: Transformation Leader-Master Black Belt
description:
The Transformation Leader (Insurance) is responsible for driving end-to-end operational transformation across Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier & broker operations. The role focuses on improving efficiency, scalability, service quality, and profitability through process redesign, digitization, operating model changes, and data-driven decision making.

The role would be responsible for the effective delivery of the Transformation Roadmaps and projects for the clients with a distinctive focus on deploying digital technologies like Robotics, Machine Learning, Intelligent automations, Generative AI, etc. by working with cross-functional global teams to favourably impact to the business outcomes of the customer.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Operational Transformation**

• Lead large-scale transformation initiatives across core broker operations, including:

• Policy placement & renewals

• Endorsements & mid-term adjustments

• New business onboarding

• Claims coordination & servicing

• Carrier interactions and compliance

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and cost drivers; redesign processes using Lean / Six Sigma principles.

• Standardize workflows across lines of business, geographies, and acquired broker entities.

**2. Digital & Automation Enablement**

• Drive adoption of digital tools, workflow platforms, and automation (RPA, OCR, straight-through processing).

• Partner with IT, vendors, and Insurtech to modernize broker management systems (BMS), CRM, and document management.

• Enable data integration between carriers, brokers, and internal systems.

**3. Operating Model & Organization Design**

• Define target operating models aligned to growth, M&A, and client segmentation strategies.

• Optimize role clarity, spans of control, and sourcing models (onshore/offshore/shared services).

• Support post-merger integration for acquired brokerages.

**4. Performance & Analytics**

• Establish operational KPIs and dashboards (e.g., turnaround time, hit ratios, cost per policy, error rates).

• Embed performance management routines and continuous improvement culture.

• Use data to drive prioritization of transformation initiatives.

**5. Change & Stakeholder Management**

• Lead change management across frontline teams, leaders, and partners.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

• Communicate vision, progress, and impact clearly and consistently.

**Skillset**

* 12–18+ years of experience in insurance, with deep exposure to P&C broker or carrier operations
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformation or operational excellence programs
* Strong understanding of broker workflows, carrier interactions, and regulatory requirements
* Experience working with senior executives and cross-functional teams
* Experience in setting up process measurement systems with advance visualization tools to implement real time monitoring frameworks and platforms
* Proficiency in data and analytical tools like control charts, descriptive statistics, box charts, hypothesis testing etc
* Certifications in Project Management, Automation, Design Thinking will be preferred.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and risk-taking abilities.
* Strong Quantitative and problem-solving ability: Ability to conceptualize complex problems and develop an Analytical Road map for them
* Experience of leading and driving strategic initiatives for COO, CFO and CIO personas
* Proven experience in driving continuous improvements across teams using Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Digital and Automation Solutions, Advanced Analytics and GenAI
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management with ability to work in diverse teams and with multiple stakeholders
* Facilitative Leadership skills – Influencing skills, mentoring and coaching – to be able to drive change

* **Qualifications**
* MBA / Post Graduation in any discipline
* Certified Project Manager/ Master Black Belt
* Certified in RPA/Digital
* Certified Design Thinking

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

title: Senior Functional Consultant
description:

Powered by generative AI, our platform delivers extraction, conversational search, and AI-driven negotiation capabilities that have redefined contract management for some of the world’s most valuable brands.   Support practice development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

  Hands-on experience with packaged product implementations such as CLM, ERP, or CRM.

title: Project Manager
description:

This is an individual contributor role. Splits time in a project management capacity and supporting reporting and analytics.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
Project manager for various Finance Source To Pay (S2P) initiatives, including business and technical process changes, reporting enhancements, and application implementations. This includes managing projects through all phases: initiation, where project scope, objectives, and deliverables are defined in collaboration with stakeholders; planning, involving the development of detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and risk management strategies; execution, coordinating and overseeing the implementation of project activities to ensure alignment with project goals and timelines; monitoring and controlling, tracking project progress, managing changes, and addressing any issues to ensure the project stays on track; and closing, ensuring successful project completion, including final deliverables, project documentation, and post-implementation reviews.
  
  
**Project Management**

* Project Planning: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management, stakeholders and third parties/vendors.
* Timeline Management: Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
* Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Stakeholder Communication: Maintain regular communication with stakeholders, providing updates on project status, issues, and changes.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and stakeholder expectations.
* Documentation: Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and post-project evaluations.

**Reporting & Collaboration**

* Self-Service Analytics Development: Partner in the development of self-service analytics solutions
* Requirements Documentation: Understand and document business requirements for reporting and analytics projects.
* Cross-Team Collaboration: Engage in cross-team collaboration with multiple business units, working with individuals who have varying levels of analytical experience within those units.

**Internal and External Relationships/Interactions**

* Gartner Finance+ Teams, IT, Financial Systems Support, and Other Business Units: Collaborate closely with these teams to gather requirements, share insights, and ensure alignment on project goals and reporting needs.
* Immediate Team Members: Work collaboratively with team members on assigned tasks, leveraging each other's strengths to achieve common objectives.
* Senior Staff and Supervisors: Seek guidance and mentorship from senior team members or supervisors within the department to enhance your skills and ensure adherence to best practices.
* Direct Supervisors: Regularly communicate updates, progress, and any potential issues to direct supervisors to maintain transparency and receive timely feedback.
* Internal Team Members: Build strong rapport and foster a collaborative environment to facilitate teamwork and ensure successful project and reporting outcomes.
* External Third Parties/Vendors/Suppliers: Occasionally interact with external vendors or clients under supervision to gather information, provide updates, or address specific needs related to projects or reporting.

**Education/Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree is required. Degree with a concentration in Finance, Operations, Statistics or Business Administration preferred
* Technical Foundation
* Strong Microsoft office skills, including MS Visio (for process design/architecture)
* Proficiency in using Collaboration tools like Shared Google Drives & MS SharePoints is a must
* Experience in Data Analysis and Visualization using Excel (MS Power BI is a plus).

* 2-3 years of experience in business operations, with a focus on project management and/or reporting and analytics. Familiarity with processes around Procure-to-Pay, Travel & Expense or a similar area of finance would be an advantage.

**Technical/Professional Skills & Competencies**

* Adaptability: Effectively adapts to new technical tools and methodologies, staying current with industry trends and best practices.
* Communication Skills: Possesses good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey requests clearly, concisely, and in a timely fashion. Capable of developing and conducting effective summaries for project stakeholders.

* Time Management and Organization: Operates with a structured approach and methodology to deliver results, demonstrating excellent time management and organizational skills, including the prioritization of competing priorities and attention to detail.

title: Transformation Delivery Consultant - LifeSciences
description:
**About Inizio Ignite:**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health.
  
  
**Company Descriptor**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Our Research Partnership healthcare market research team provides research and insights to inform and power healthcare decisions. Serving a variety of clients across the lifecycle, our expertise includes data, research & insights (proprietary syndicated and custom research) and brand tracking (ATU). Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver High-Impact Solutions: Create and deliver high-quality project outcomes that align with client objectives, incorporating life science consulting principles to promote business excellence and scientific advancement.
* Project & Risk Management: Lead project plans or workstreams, proactively resolving issues, mitigating risks, and escalating concerns when necessary to ensure project success.
* Strategic Analysis & Recommendations: Systematically gather, analyze, and interpret scientific and business information, using a life science consulting lens to make confident, data-driven recommendations with urgency.
* Contribute to Vynamic's Growth: Dedicate time to enhancing Vynamic’s competencies by sharing life science consulting insights and contributing to the firm’s knowledge base and brand.
* Brand Representation: Act as a Vynamic brand ambassador, demonstrating a strong commitment to company values both internally and externally.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build authentic, trust-based relationships with stakeholders through partnership, effective communication, and delivering outcomes that exceed expectations.
* Team Development: Support team growth by identifying learning opportunities, mentoring colleagues, and integrating life science consulting practices into daily operations to achieve collective goals.
* Collaborative Leadership: Work closely with Navigators, Go-Tos, Account Managers, and self-selected Counselors to support personal and professional development journeys within Vynamic.
* Continuous Feedback & Growth: Proactively seek feedback, develop actionable personal growth plans, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
* Inclusive Leadership: Recognize and celebrate diverse perspectives, experiences, and cultures, ensuring all voices are heard and valued in decision-making processes.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of experience in life science consulting, advanced degree (MS, MBA, PhD) preferred.
* Proven track record of managing collaborative teams or projects within dynamic, fast-paced environments.
* Strong understanding of relationship management principles, with a focus on fostering genuine connections within the life sciences ecosystem.
* Experience applying project management methodologies to oversee workstreams and complex initiatives.
* Familiarity with Vynamic’s sectors, services, and unique value proposition (preferred but not required).
* Strong presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively through written and verbal channels to diverse audiences, including scientific and executive stakeholders.
* Growth-oriented mindset, embracing challenges as opportunities for learning and personal development.

**Ideal candidate should be**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

***Artificial Intelligence***
*Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices. Don't meet every requirement? That's okay! We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

  

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

  

**Qualification**
**Education**
 Required 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required

Preferred

* Master’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred

  

**Experience**
 Required

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

Preferred

* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

Required

* Experience with:
  + Salesforce / CRM
  + Advanced SQL
  + Advanced Alteryx
  + Python / ML

+ AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI

* Data Analysis

+ Data Research
+ Data Integrity
+ Data Visualization
+ Automation
+ Project Management
+ Team Leadership

* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry
* Consistent alignment with Bain’s Operating Principles
* Skilled with advanced Excel and PowerPoint

  

Preferred

* Experience with:

* ServiceNow
* Coaching
* Mentoring
* Training
* Advanced Tableau
* Helpdesk support (email, live user training)

title: Service Delivery Manager, gTech Ads Customer Experience
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.

**About the job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well-being, Google provides support for any non-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Tax Technology Services Consultant II-SAP PaPM
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP PaPM - Tax Technology Services Consultant II**
Join Deloitte’s Tax Management Consulting team and support global clients as they modernize tax operations through SAP-enabled transformation. As an SAP PaPM -Tax Technology Services Consultant II, you will help translate tax and business requirements into scalable technology solutions that support complex business change. This role offers the opportunity to work across large transformation programs, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and contribute to the design and delivery of tax technology solutions within SAP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an SAP PaPM -Tax Technology Services Consultant II on the Tax Management Consulting team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Evaluating client tax and business requirements to define SAP PaPM and broader tax technology solution designs
* Translating functional requirements into system design specifications and supporting configuration, build, testing, and deployment activities
* Assessing current-state processes, supply chains, and systems landscapes to identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Coordinating with client stakeholders, internal teams, and systems integration partners to communicate status, resolve issues, and support project delivery
* Contributing to demos, solution assets, and internal accelerators that support Deloitte’s S/4HANA Tax Value Proposition

**The team**
Tax Management Consulting brings together consulting, technology, tax, and tax reporting experience to help organizations address multi-jurisdictional tax operations, compliance, reporting, tax technology, and tax risk management. Within this practice, the S/4HANA Tax Value Proposition supports SAP-enabled business transformation by helping clients design and implement tax solutions that align with broader enterprise processes. Professionals on this team work across complex transformation programs with Deloitte practitioners and client stakeholders to deliver practical, scalable tax technology solutions.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore / Gurgaon / Mumbai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
Regular business hours
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Taxation; or MBA; or Chartered Accountant qualification
* 3-7 years of experience in SAP or SAP S/4HANA
* Experience implementing SAP PaPM in project environments
* Experience with SAP HANA, SQL Script, SAP BW, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP HANA Studio
* Experience working with project delivery methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall
* Experience supporting SAP migration and testing processes
* Experience preparing client demos and presentation materials for stakeholder audiences

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
* Experience integrating SAP with other modules
* Knowledge of tax touchpoints within SAP and SAP S/4HANA
* Experience with tax procedures, tax conditions, general ledger setup, tax codes, access sequences, condition records, and intercompany tax configuration

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: Specialist, Financial Operations
description:
**Transformation Analyst - Agentic Process Transformation**

  
  

*Rights & Royalties Transformation | IC20 | 3-4*
*years experience*

  
  

**Role Focus**

  
  

**Primary Platforms**

  
  

**Success Measure**

  
  

**Domain Advantage**

  
  

Agent creation, workflow automation and process transformation

  
  

Copilot Studio, Power Automate, M365 ecosystem; BI/data tools as enabling skills

  
  

Efficiency gains, cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption and controls

  
  

Rights, royalties, licensing, finance operations and publishing

  
  

**Role Summary**

  
  

We are seeking a high-impact Business Transformation Analyst to help modernise the Rights & Royalties operating model through AI-enabled agents, workflow automation, process simplification and measurable efficiency gains. This role is designed for someone who can understand operational pain points quickly, convert them into practical automation opportunities, and deliver adoption-ready solutions that improve speed, quality, control and stakeholder experience.

  
  

The ideal candidate combines structured business analysis with a maker mindset: able to map processes, define requirements, build low-code/agentic solutions, partner with technology teams, and track outcomes through clear KPIs. Hands-on data capability remains important, but the emphasis is on using data, AI and automation to transform recurring operational work, not on deep engineering or specialist BI development.

  
  

Royalties, rights, licensing, finance operations, publishing/media or revenue-share experience will be a strong advantage, particularly where it supports understanding of contracts, statements, payments, deductions, reserves, exceptions, approvals and audit sensitivity.

  
  

**Key Objectives - What Success Looks Like**

  

  
* Create practical AI agents and guided automations that reduce manual effort, improve response quality and accelerate decision-making across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Simplify and standardise recurring workflows such as exception triage, approvals, reconciliations, case routing, notifications, quality checks and reporting packs.
  
  
* Deliver measurable efficiency gains through cycle-time reduction, lower rework, improved SLA performance, better adoption and stronger process controls.
  
  
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and adoption plans.
  
  
* Enable operational leaders with concise, self-serve visibility into risks, bottlenecks, productivity, quality and customer impact.
  

  

**Core Responsibilities**

  
  

**1) Process Transformation & Business Analysis**

  

  
* Conduct rapid discovery of current-state processes, pain points, root causes, handoffs, control gaps and duplication across Rights, Royalties and related Finance Operations.
  
  
* Design future-state workflows using a transformation lens: Simplify -> Standardise -> Automate -> Augment with AI -> Scale.
  
  
* Convert business needs into crisp requirements, user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
* Prioritise opportunities based on effort, impact, control risk, adoption readiness and efficiency potential.
  
  
* Support UAT, adoption, change communication, training aids and post-launch benefit tracking.
  

  

**2) Agent Creation & AI-enabled Solutions**

  

  
* Help design, configure and improve business-facing agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  
  
* Translate operational use cases into agent capabilities such as document review support, answer retrieval, exception explanation, guided decisioning, case summarisation and next-best-action recommendations.
  
  
* Define agent knowledge sources, prompts/instructions, guardrails, escalation paths, testing scenarios, success metrics and adoption feedback loops.
  
  
* Partner with technology, governance and business stakeholders to ensure agents are controlled, explainable, secure, measurable and fit for production use.
  
  
* Identify where agents should be combined with workflows, for example where AI reasoning is needed within a structured approval, triage or notification process.
  

  

**3) Workflow Automation & Operational Enablement**

  

  
* Build or support low-code automations using Power Automate, Copilot Studio workflows and connected Microsoft 365 services.
  
  
* Automate high-volume, rule-led and repeatable activities including validations, approvals, reminders, case routing, exception logging, report refreshes and stakeholder notifications.
  
  
* Design automations with appropriate audit trails, handoffs, fallback logic, approval controls, ownership and maintainability.
  
  
* Work with operations teams to ensure automation is embedded into daily routines rather than remaining as a standalone tool.
  

  

**4) Insights, KPIs & Benefit Realisation**

  

  
* Define outcome-led KPI frameworks for automation and process transformation, focused on hours saved, cycle time, quality, SLA, adoption, controls and customer impact.
  
  
* Use dashboards and reporting tools to monitor transformation outcomes, bottlenecks, adoption and benefit delivery.
  
  
* Perform practical analysis to identify trends, anomalies and improvement opportunities related to royalty statements, adjustments, disputes, metadata, reserves, payments or case volumes.
  
  
* Prepare concise executive-ready summaries that convert analysis into business decisions and action plans.
  

  

**5) Governance, Controls & Documentation**

  

  
* Create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, decision logs, control points, KPI definitions and adoption materials.
  
  
* Ensure automation and agent assets have clear ownership, change control, traceability, testing evidence and governance alignment.
  
  
* Strengthen audit readiness through reconciliation checkpoints, exception logs, approval matrices and documented process logic.
  

  

**Typical Outcomes / KPIs You May Own**

  

  
* Automation and agent benefit realisation: hours saved, cost avoidance, productivity uplift and reduced manual touchpoints.
  
  
* Cycle-time and SLA improvement across targeted royalty, rights, finance operations or query-management workflows.
  
  
* Reduction in rework, avoidable escalations, duplicate handling, leakage risk and control exceptions.
  
  
* Agent and automation adoption: active users, usage frequency, completion rate, deflection rate, satisfaction and feedback themes.
  
  
* Quality and reliability: successful workflow runs, exception rates, data accuracy, audit trail completeness and refresh reliability.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  

  
* 3-4 years experience in a Business Analyst, Transformation Analyst, Automation Analyst, Process Analyst, Product Operations or comparable role.
  
  
* Strong process discovery and problem-solving capability, with the ability to simplify complex operational work into clear, actionable requirements.
  
  
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, preferably Power Automate and Copilot Studio, or a demonstrable ability to build low-code automations and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
* Ability to define agent or automation use cases, map workflows, document requirements, test outputs, manage feedback and support adoption.
  
  
* Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance or Legal stakeholders.
  
  
* Good analytical capability and comfort working with operational data, KPIs and dashboards. Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Looker, BigQuery or similar tools is useful, but not the primary focus of the role.
  
  
* Excellent communication skills: concise documentation, clear visuals, executive-ready summaries and practical training materials.
  
  
* Outcome ownership and delivery pace: able to move from discovery to MVP to adoption with discipline and urgency.
  

  

**Preferred / Advantageous**

  

  
* Exposure to royalties, rights, licensing, publishing/media, revenue-share, finance operations or contract-driven processes.
  
  
* Understanding of the royalty lifecycle: contract terms, rate structures, deductions, reserves, statements, payments, recoupment, audit queries and dispute handling.
  
  
* Experience with ServiceNow, SharePoint, Teams, Excel-based operations, document repositories or workflow-heavy operational environments.
  
  
* Familiarity with process mapping tools such as Blueworks, Visio or Lucidchart; Lean, continuous improvement or process re-engineering methods.
  
  
* Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, access control, knowledge-source hygiene and governance considerations for enterprise agents.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Business, Operations, IT, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  
  
* Postgraduate qualification such as MBA, PG Diploma in Business Analytics, Operations, Finance or Transformation is a differentiator, not mandatory.
  
  
* Relevant certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, automation, business analysis, Lean/process improvement, data analytics or BI are advantageous.
  

  

**Behavioural**
**Competencies - Non-negotiable for Transformation**

  

  
* Agentic mindset: thinks beyond reporting and looks for ways to remove, automate or augment work.
  
  
* Adaptability, speed and agility:moves quickly from ambiguity to working MVPs and iterates based on feedback.
  
  
* Outcome ownership: focuses on measurable improvement, not activity completion.
  
  
* Structured problem-solving: separates symptoms from root cause and prioritises by business impact and control risk.
  
  
* Precision and control mindset: understands the financial, contractual and audit sensitivity of royalties operations.
  
  
* Collaboration and influence: earns trust across operations and technology, handles competing priorities and drives closure.
  

  

**Working Relationships**

  
  

Works closely with Rights & Royalties Operations, Finance Operations, Transformation leads, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance/Legal and operational leaders. Acts as a process transformation, agent enablement and automation partner to teams looking to improve efficiency, control and customer experience.

  
  

**What This Role Offers**

  

  
* High-visibility transformation scope with measurable business impact in a financially sensitive and globally relevant domain.
  
  
* Opportunity to build modern agentic automation capabilities across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Strong cross-functional exposure across Rights, Royalties, Finance, Product, Technology and Governance teams.
  
  
* A practical platform to convert process knowledge into scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions.

Javix Media is a full-service digital marketing agency specialising in performance-driven campaigns, content creation, social media management, influencer marketing and end-to-end brand building. We partner with growth-minded brands across B2B and B2C to craft memorable digital experiences and measurable ROI.

**Role Overview**

As our Account & Project Lead, you will be the glue between clients, strategy and execution. You’ll manage a team of executives and managers, own client onboarding, build project plans, track budgets & margins, and ensure flawless delivery across content, design, media and beyond.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll mentor your team, drive client engagement, spot growth opportunities, and help shape our agency’s future.

**Key Responsibilities**

A. Team Leadership & People Management

a) Lead, coach and inspire a multidisciplinary team (account managers, content writers, designers, media buyers).

b) Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews and training sessions to develop future leaders.

c) Monitor team bandwidth and productivity; ensure adherence to allocated hours per project.

**B. Client Onboarding & Engagemen**
t

a) Oversee new-client onboarding: develop and maintain an onboarding dossier (business goals, brand guidelines, approvals, stakeholder map).

b) Conduct discovery calls and briefs to crystallise project requirements.

c) Maintain daily client engagement SOPs: morning greetings, status updates, challenge alerts, scheduled calls, and timely MoMs with action items.

**C. Project Planning & Execution**

a) Prepare comprehensive project execution plans: deliverables, timelines, resource allocation, risk & mitigation matrix.

b) Champion the use of Asana (or equivalent PM tool) for task assignment, progress tracking and version control.

c) Leverage AI tools and AI Agents to streamline ideation, drafts, creative iterations, QA and approvals.

**D. Strategic Partnership & Growth**

a) Collaborate with agency principals on strategic brand positioning and digital roadmaps.

b) Guide clients on branding, messaging, positioning and go-to-market tactics across social, search, email, content, and emerging channels.

c) Participate in new-business pitches, presentations and RFP responses.

d) Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts; prepare proposals and secure approvals.

**E. Financial Stewardship & Reporting**

a) Manage billing cycles for assigned clients; perform Billing Cost Margin Analysis (BCMA) and maintain target Gross Margins per account.

b) Generate weekly/monthly status reports: budgets vs. spend, performance metrics, risk logs, resource utilisation.

**F. Miscellaneous & Continuous Improvement**

a) Coordinate ad hoc deliverables and special requests across internal teams.

b) Propose process improvements, tool integrations and service-offering expansions.

c) Stay abreast of industry trends, platform updates and best practices; share knowledge through internal workshops.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

a) Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, or related field.

b) Experience: 5–8 years in a digital agency (account management, project management, or similar leadership role).

c) Demonstrated Track Record:

a) Managing 3–5 simultaneous client accounts (minimum ₹50L annual spend combined, ).

b) Delivering complex, cross-channel campaigns on time and within budget.

**5. Tools & Technologies**

a) Project Management: Asana, Trello, or JIRA.

b) Collaboration: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace.

c) Analytics: Google Analytics, Facebook Business Manager, basic Excel/Pivot reporting.

d) AI Tools: ChatGPT, Midjourney/Firefly, Zapier or equivalent.

**6. Skills & Competencies**

* Leadership: Empathetic coach, decisive problem-solver, strong communicator.
* Client Focus: Proactive engagement, clear expectation-setting, polished stakeholder management.
* Strategic Thinking: Able to translate high-level goals into actionable digital tactics.
* Organisational Agility: Exceptional at multitasking, prioritising and adapting to shifting priorities.
* Financial Acumen: Comfortable with P&L basics, margin analysis and budget reconciliation.
* Attention to Detail: Rigorous about timelines, quality checks, brand consistency and process compliance.

**Company Description**
RS INFRA PROJECTS PVT LTD is an infrastructure-focused organization delivering engineering and construction solutions across a range of industrial and commercial projects. The company is committed to quality, safety, and timely project delivery, working closely with clients and partners to meet technical and regulatory requirements. Team members collaborate in a fast-paced environment that values practical problem-solving, clear communication, and professional integrity. The organization offers opportunities to work on complex projects, contribute to visible outcomes, and grow through hands-on experience and responsibility.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time Senior Engineer role based in Dadri, offered in a hybrid format that allows some work-from-home flexibility. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing engineering drawings, coordinating with site teams and contractors, monitoring project progress, and resolving technical issues that arise during construction. title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

TravelClues India Private Limited is a luxury travel advisory company dedicated to helping travelers discover the world in a meaningful and efficient way. The company focuses on maximizing clients’ time and investment during trips by carefully planning and optimizing travel experiences. TravelClues enhances the content and quality of travel programs through personalized, high-touch service and deep destination expertise. Team members collaborate to create distinctive journeys that reflect each traveler’s preferences and expectations.

This is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Ahmedabad. The position also involves mentoring team members, managing key client relationships, and supporting business growth through proactive planning and decision-making.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strategic planning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Candidates should possess customer-centric mindset and experience in client relationship management, preferably in travel, hospitality, or related industries.

* A bachelor’s degree in business, management, hospitality, tourism, or a related field is preferred.
* Comfort with basic digital tools, CRM or booking systems, and data-driven performance tracking is advantageous.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Own the customer journey from initial requirements to long-term platform success.

• Apply your EHR expertise across a growing range of private healthcare services.

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

• Stay close to the product, with direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership.

• See your recommendations become working solutions used by real healthcare teams.

• Help shape both customer delivery and the platform itself.

**📍 Location, working hours and joining**

• Based in India.

• Available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time, including a one-hour break.

• UK summer hours: 13:30–22:30 IST.

• UK winter hours: 14:30–23:30 IST.

• Candidates able to join within 45 days are welcome.

**Interested?**

Please ensure your CV clearly identifies the EHR platforms and modules you have worked with, your personal configuration responsibilities, and the client implementations or optimisation projects you have owned.

We would love to hear how you could bring that expertise to Script Assist.

title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery—from concept through detailed and construction design.
  
  
Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems.
* Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables

+ Equipment sizing & selection
+ Mechanical design calculations
+ Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
+ P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
+ Mechanical data sheets and specifications

* Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design.
* Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements.
* Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews.
* Manage and own key design management documents

+ Project Responsibility Matrix
+ Basis of Design
+ Overall Design Programme
+ Schedule of Deliverables
+ Design Risk Register
+ Design Change Register

* Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery.
* Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling.
* Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability.
* Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.

* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for

+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.
* Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.
* Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans.
* Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset.
* Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field is advantageous
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Mechanical Engineer (CEng) is advantageous

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems.
* Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning.
* Knowledge of sustainability principles and low‑carbon mechanical design approaches.
* Experience working with international codes, standards, and global delivery frameworks.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Assistant Manager - Logistics
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani**
**Total Gas**
**Limited (A**
**TG**
**L)**
**:**
Adani Total Gas Limited is a prominent entity in India's energy sector, specializing in the distribution of natural gas. It operates as a joint venture between the Adani Group and TotalEnergies.
  
  
ATGL is actively involved in the development of City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks, supplying Piped Natural Gas (PNG) to domestic, commercial, and industrial users, as well as Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) to the transport sector. The company has established CGD networks in various regions, including Ahmedabad and Vadodara in Gujarat, Faridabad in Haryana, and Khurja in Uttar Pradesh. Additionally, through a consortium with Indian Oil Corporation Ltd, ATGL is expanding its services to areas such as Allahabad, Chandigarh, Ernakulam, Panipat, Daman, Dharwad, and Udham Singh Nagar.
  
  
In line with its commitment to sustainable energy solutions, ATGL has ventured into renewable energy initiatives. The company has established Adani TotalEnergies Biomass Limited (ATBL), a wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to the development of biogas activities in India.
  
  
Through its comprehensive approach to energy distribution and sustainable practices, Adani Total Gas Limited continues to play a vital role in enhancing energy accessibility and contributing to India's infrastructure development.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This role is responsible for the execution and monitoring of logistics operations by implementing SOPs, coordinating logistics activities, and managing data analysis for decision-support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Team Member - COE Logistics - O3**
**SOP Implementation And Initiative Execution**

* Assist in the deployment of logistics SOPs and new initiatives within the operations to improve service delivery standards.
* Monitor adherence to logistics policies
* Identify opportunities for process enhancements.

**Logistics Operations**

* Track and report on the progress of logistics operations, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and initiative timelines.
* Manage Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PR) for customer vehicles, streamlining coordination with suppliers and internal teams.
* Prepare and maintain MIS reports adhering to the format required by management, capturing logistics-related data such as vehicle utilization, routes, and gas quantities.
* Analyze various trends taking into consideration location data, vehicle numbers, routes, amount of gas carried, charges per kg of gas delivered, etc. and report any deviations to the Lead - COE logistics.
* Provide actionable data and insights to the Lead - COE Logistics.
* Generate accurate bills and invoices for dealers and customers, facilitating timely submissions for payment processing.
* Ensure all financial transactions related to logistics services reflect the correct amount of charges and are validated against service delivery data.

**Operational Efficiency Tracking**

* Consistently monitor vehicle operations to ensure they are running optimally and meeting transportation needs effectively.
* Identify any irregularities in vehicle performance or utilization and communicate findings to the logistics team for corrective action.

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
**Internal Stakeholders**

* Technocommercial Team
* GA Team
* HSE Team

**External Stakeholders**

* Transporters

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
B.E./ B.Tech./ Bachelor's Degree (Logistics or related field), Additional Degrees and Certifications (Logistics Management, Supply Chain Management, Data Analysis) preferred
  
  
**Work Experience**
Minimum 3+ years of experience in logistics and supply chain management.
  
  
**Industry Preferred**
Background in gas, energy or utility sector with exposure of Logistics and Supply Chain Management is preferred.

description:

Your impact

In our water business, that means supporting UK water companies in delivering resilient and efficient clean water networks through advanced modelling, analytics, and digital solutions.

description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge.
