With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead development of cross-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies.
* Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management.
* Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making.
* Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications.
* Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures.
* Establish standard methodologies, governance processes, and best practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Mentor junior Industrial Engineers and provide technical leadership on analytical projects.
* Partner with site leadership, operations teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and IT to drive strategic improvement initiatives.
* Present recommendations, scenario analyses, and business cases to management and senior leadership.
* Support development of long-range capacity plans and fab expansion scenarios.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and statistical analysis tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, or related field.
* Semiconductor wafer fabrication experience.
* Experience with Factory Physics, cycle time engineering, capacity planning, production scheduling, or manufacturing optimization.
* Experience with simulation, optimization modeling, machine learning, or operations research techniques.

**Work Experience**

* 3–5 years of Industrial Engineering experience in semiconductor manufacturing or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience building capacity models, productivity analyses, factory scheduling models, or optimization tools.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is preferred.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

description:

* Create custom business logic and automated actions.

* Manage data import/export and migration activities.
* Configure appropriate access controls and security policies.
* Follow backup, data retention, and information-security practices.

* Document configurations, workflows, custom functions, integrations, and processes.
* Maintain technical documentation for Zoho applications.
* Evaluate new Zoho features and recommend improvements.
* Continuously optimize Zoho systems to improve operational efficiency.

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Zoho administration, Deluge scripting, workflow automation, API integrations, dashboards, and business process optimization.

* Strong knowledge of Zoho CRM Administration.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho One.

* Experience with Zoho Workflow Rules, Blueprints, Functions, Approvals, and Schedules.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, Webhooks, and API integrations.
* Experience in creating custom modules, fields, layouts, reports, and dashboards.

* Troubleshooting and debugging skills.

* Understanding of ISP/Telecom business processes.
* Knowledge of FTTH/FTTx, broadband, leased line, installation, activation, service requests, complaints, and customer lifecycle is an advantage.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced SAP Manager - FI Accounts Receivable (AR) to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of global receivables processes within SAP S/4HANA environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Accounts Receivable processes, with hands-on experience in banking integrations, collections, dispute management, and receivables transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead SAP FI-AR solution design, implementation, and support across global business units.
* Manage and optimize AR processes including customer invoicing, cash application, collections, dispute resolution, dunning, and account reconciliation.
* Drive and support:

+ Bank Communication Management (BCM) Integration
+ Interest Calculation Configuration and Processing
+ AR Correspondence Management
+ Customer Account Statements
+ Lockbox Processing and Cash Application
+ HighRadius Integration for Collections and Dispute Management

* Collaborate with finance, treasury, banking, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and compliant solutions.
* Lead transformation initiatives, process automation, and continuous improvement programs.
* Manage project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
* 10+ years of SAP Finance experience with strong expertise in SAP FI-AR.
* Proven experience with SAP BCM, Lockbox, Interest Calculation, Account Statements, and Correspondence Framework.
* Experience integrating SAP with HighRadius Collections and Dispute Management solutions.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, OTC processes, and finance transformation programs.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**Company:** Western Group of Companies

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 8–12 years preferred  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and analytical **Finance Controller & Manager – Projects & Operations** to oversee the company's complete finance and accounting functions while providing strategic financial insights to management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for cash flow management, Profit & Loss (P&L) analysis, budgeting, financial forecasting, project cost control and management MIS reporting. The candidate must possess strong expertise in advanced Microsoft Excel, financial modelling and project-based financial management, preferably in Oil & Gas, EPC, shipbuilding, marine engineering or infrastructure industries.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete finance and accounting functions, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliation, journal entries and monthly financial closing.
* Prepare, review and analyse monthly and project-wise Profit & Loss statements, balance sheets and cash flow statements.
* Monitor daily cash flow, working capital, fund requirements, receivables, payables and payment schedules.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and financial projections to support business planning and management decisions.
* Prepare and submit monthly, weekly and project-wise MIS reports, financial dashboards and performance summaries to senior management.
* Monitor project budgets against actual expenses, identify cost overruns and analyse project profitability.
* Prepare budgetary plans, financial forecasts, variance analysis and cost-control reports.
* Track project revenue, expenses, commitments, outstanding payments and collections in coordination with project, commercial and procurement teams.
* Analyse financial data using advanced Microsoft Excel to identify trends, financial risks, inefficiencies and opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Ensure timely GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable statutory compliance in coordination with the relevant teams and consultants.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records.
* Establish effective financial controls, accounting procedures and reporting systems across projects and operations.
* Provide management with actionable financial insights, profitability assessments and recommendations for improving financial performance.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* CA / CMA / MBA Finance or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in finance and accounts, preferably in a project-oriented organisation.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements, taxation, budgeting and financial reporting.
* Experience in cash flow management, P&L analysis, working capital management and project cost control.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, complex formulas, dashboards and financial modelling.
* Experience in preparing management MIS reports and presenting financial performance to senior management.
* Working knowledge of accounting software or ERP systems.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:

* Oil & Gas and EPC projects
* Shipbuilding, ship repair and marine engineering
* Pipeline and infrastructure projects
* Civil construction and other project-based industries

Key Skills

* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* Cash Flow Forecasting and Management
* Profit & Loss Analysis
* Complete Accounts Management
* Project Cost Control and Profitability Analysis
* Budgeting and Financial Forecasting
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and Financial Modelling
* Management Information Systems (MIS)
* Working Capital Management
* Statutory Compliance and Audit Coordination
* Analytical Thinking and Management Reporting

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, commercially aware and capable of independently managing the finance and accounts function while providing accurate, timely and meaningful financial reports to management. The candidate must have strong analytical skills, advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights.

**Candidates with strong experience in project-wise financial monitoring, cash flow planning and management reporting in Oil & Gas, EPC or shipbuilding organisations are strongly encouraged to apply.**

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Software Test Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software applications. The candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining test cases, identifying defects, and collaborating with development teams to deliver high-quality products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze business and functional requirements to prepare test scenarios and test cases.
* Execute manual and automated test cases to validate application functionality.
* Identify, document, and track defects through their lifecycle.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Review requirements and provide feedback from a quality assurance perspective.
* Create and maintain test documentation, test plans, and test reports.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Ensure applications meet quality standards before deployment.
* Support production issue analysis and verification when required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience in Manual Testing and defect tracking tools.
* Knowledge of Test Case Design Techniques.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Understanding of API Testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Basic SQL knowledge for database validation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Skills (For Automation Testing)**

* Experience with Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, or Cypress.
* Knowledge of Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
* Understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in Software Testing (Automation).
* ISTQB Certification is a plus.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Immediate joiners preferred.

**If you’re passionate about software quality, enjoy solving problems, and take pride in delivering reliable products, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and help build high-quality software that makes an impact.**

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Scrum Master is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for guiding and coaching teams in the use of Scrum / Agile practices.  
  
The primary responsibility of this role is to boost the effectiveness of teams by managing key projects, championing cross team alignment and delivering success and operationalizing underlying processes to make development teams hum effectively.  
  
The Scrum Masters resolves impediments, monitors and has control over the scrum processes and meetings.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Fosters a self-organizing and empowered environment that enables teams to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget.
* Facilitates and leads Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensures that teams adhere to the Scrum framework, follows agile best practices, and utilizes appropriate tools and metrics to track progress, identifies bottlenecks, and drives continuous improvement.
* Fosters effective communication and collaboration between cross-functional teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
* Acts as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of the project goals, priorities, and timelines.
* Proactively addresses any conflicts or challenges that may hinder team performance and delivery.
* Collaboratively identifies and synchronizes project interdependencies across multiple teams. Facilitates effective resource allocation across the programs.
* Drives the continuous improvement of agile processes, methodologies, and tools across the organization. Identifies and implements process enhancements to optimize efficiency, productivity, and quality of deliverables.
* Encourages innovation to foster a culture of continuous leading and growth.
* Ensures the program benefits remain viable throughout the program, communicating status and date changes and actively manage dependencies.
* Builds strong relationships with key stakeholders and manages these expectations regarding project scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* Collaborates closely with product owners to prioritize backlog items and ensures alignment with business goals.
* Provides regular project status updates and communicates any risks or impediments that may impact project success.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Ability to recognize the importance of working through others within the team through engaging and empowering others to use as much of their own capabilities as possible, thereby fostering trust and high energy to succeed.
* Has drive and energy to get the job done.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Assertive with the ability to come up with solutions to critical situations.
* Ability to make timely decisions and take calculated risks.
* Seasoned knowledge of other Agile approaches such as XP, Kanban, Scrum, extreme Programming (XP).
* Seasoned knowledge of the technologies used by the team.
* Ability to coordinate large teams with cross-functional dependencies.
* Proactive and organized with the ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment providing consistent, high-quality output.
* Ability to facilitate discussions to allow the team to consider alternative solutions or approaches and bring disagreements out into the open to help to manage them collaboratively.
* Ability to stimulate and relish change, adapt quickly and see change as an opportunity.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Project Management or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master or SAFe Advanced Scrum Master preferred.
* Other related certifications and/or training (for example - SAFe DeVos, Implementing SAFe etc.).

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned Scrum Master experience in an ICT environment, managing software projects and working with software development teams.
* Seasoned experience in Scrum Management.
* Seasoned experience of Agile concepts and principles.
* Seasoned experience as a coach and mentor in agile practices (Scrum, Kanban etc.).
* Seasoned experience with contemporary software development methodologies.
* Seasoned experience with widely successful Agile techniques such as User Stories, ATDD, TDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, Agile Games.

**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
Scrum Business Systems
  
  
Analyst Specialist
  
  
**DCF Level 35 | Individual Contributor**

Business Analysis / Agile Delivery

Any DGS office location
  
  
**WORKING MODEL**
Global, cross-functional teams
  
  
**TRAVEL**
As required
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
**The Scrum Business Systems Analyst Specialist**
is a hands-on individual contributor who combines strong business and systems analysis capability with practical Scrum delivery responsibilities. The role independently drives initiatives from discovery through implementation, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements while enabling an effective Agile delivery rhythm across business, product, engineering, data, and quality assurance teams.
  
  
The role serves as the functional point of contact for assigned projects and is expected to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, stakeholder alignment, requirements traceability, testing, implementation readiness, and post-release follow-up with limited day-to-day supervision.
  
  
ROLE OUTCOME
  
  

* Well-defined requirements
* Predictable sprint delivery
* Clear stakeholder decisions
* Business-ready solutions

Key Responsibilities - Business & Systems Analysis
  
  

* Independently lead discovery and requirement workshops with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, product owners, developers, architects, data teams, and quality assurance teams.
* Understand business problems, objectives, processes, data needs, and user outcomes; translate them into well-structured functional and non-functional requirements.
* Create and maintain business requirement documents, functional specifications, process flows, data flows, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability.
* Break down complex requirements into clear, prioritized, sprint-ready user stories that are understandable to both business and technical teams.
* Perform impact, dependency, feasibility, gap, and data analysis for new capabilities, enhancements, defects, and change requests.
* Lead requirement walkthroughs and clarify functional questions throughout design, development, testing, and implementation.
* Use SQL and other analysis techniques, where required, to validate data, investigate issues, support requirements, and confirm expected outcomes.
* Own functional quality for assigned initiatives, ensuring that delivered solutions remain aligned to approved business needs and acceptance criteria.
* Plan and support system testing, business validation, and user acceptance testing, including test scenarios, test data, defect triage, evidence, sign-off, and deployment of readiness.
* Maintain solution documentation and support-controlled transition into production, user communication, training, change management, and post-release validation.

Key Responsibilities - Scrum & Agile Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the Product Owner and delivery team to maintain a healthy, prioritized, and sufficiently refined product backlog.
* Facilitate or support Scrum events as needed, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Prepare stories for refinement by confirming business value, scope, dependencies, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and readiness before commitment.
* Help the team establish a realistic sprint goal and maintain shared understanding of committed outcomes.
* Track story progress, decisions, blockers, dependencies, risks, and actions; proactively coordinate resolution and escalate matters that may affect delivery.
* Protect requirement clarity during the sprint by managing questions and controlled changes without introducing avoidable disruption or scope ambiguity.
* Coordinate business participation in sprint reviews and demonstrations, capture feedback, and convert agreed feedback into prioritized backlog items.
* Use delivery measures and team feedback to identify opportunities to improve requirement quality, flow, predictability, and ways of working.
* Promote Scrum principles of transparency, inspection, adaptation, accountability, and continuous improvement while remaining practical and outcome focused.
* Where a dedicated Scrum Master is not assigned, provide day-to-day Scrum coordination for the project while continuing to own BSA responsibilities. This role supports team effectiveness and does not replace people management responsibilities.

Independent Project Ownership
  
  

* Take end-to-end functional ownership of small to medium initiatives, or a clearly defined workstream within a larger programme, with limited supervision.
* Build and maintain a delivery view covering scope, milestones, backlog readiness, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, stakeholder actions, and implementation readiness.
* Coordinate across globally distributed and matrixed teams, ensuring that the right stakeholders are engaged at the right stage.
* Identify ambiguity early, present options and recommendations, drive timely decisions, and document agreed outcomes.
* Balance business value, user needs, data availability, technical feasibility, quality, and delivery timelines when recommending an approach.
* Provide concise, fact-based status updates to project leadership and stakeholders, including progress, risks, decisions required, and proposed next steps.
* Contribute reusable templates, standards, frameworks, and lessons learned to strengthen Business Analysis and Agile delivery practices.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, technology implementation, or a closely related role.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing requirements and functional delivery across the full lifecycle, from discovery through production implementation.
* Strong hands-on experience with Agile and Scrum delivery, including backlog refinement, user story development, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and impediment or dependency tracking.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, architects, data teams, and quality assurance teams in a cross-functional environment.
* Experience creating functional documentation, process and data flows, requirements traceability, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans.
* Working knowledge of data concepts, system integrations, relational data structures, and data validation; practical SQL capability is strongly preferred.
* Experience with common work management and documentation tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira and Confluence or equivalent platforms.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managing multiple priorities in a complex, matrixed environment.

Core Skills & Behaviors
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, attention to detail, and ability to connect business requirements with system behavior.
* Ability to simplify complex concepts, ask effective questions, challenge constructively, and communicate recommendations clearly.
* Confident workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently, organize work, follow through on commitments, and maintain momentum across teams.
* Ability to manage changing priorities calmly, make progress despite ambiguity, and escalate with context and options rather than only highlighting problems.
* Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with a focus on business value, delivery quality, shared accountability, and positive stakeholder outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Professional Scrum Master, Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Product Owner, PMI-PBA, IIBA-CBAP/CCBA, or comparable certification.
* Experience with enterprise platforms, data management, master data management, integrations, reporting, or business intelligence solutions.
* Experience supporting organizational change, end-user training, production adoption, and continuous improvement.

Role Boundaries
  
  
**This role is accountable for**
**This role is not primarily accountable for**
Requirement quality, functional integrity, backlog readiness, Scrum coordination, stakeholder decisions, testing readiness, and end-to-end functional follow-through.
  
  
Direct people's management, performance management, formal line management, or acting as the technical architect or engineering lead.
  
  
Driving assigned initiatives independently and ensuring clear visibility of scope, risks, dependencies, actions, and outcomes.
  
  
Owning commercial management or programme governance unless specifically assigned as part of the initiative.

If you enjoy working with ambiguity, building platforms from the ground up, and shipping real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.
* Data-driven, outcome-focused decisions. Validates ideas with data, plans for schema evaluation, and aligns features with real user impact.

Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.
  
  
Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well-connected office locations in both Andheri East and Navi Mumbai.

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing
  **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with
  **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a
  **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**
  , ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Competitive compensation:**
  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:**
  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**
  up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:**
  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:**
  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:**
  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to spearhead the modernisation of a large-scale enterprise application from legacy ASP.NET to a modern .NET 10 Web API and React stack. You will own the technical direction of a cross-functional delivery pod, mentor a team of developers, and drive hands-on engineering across both frontend and backend.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role — you will write production code, lead architecture decisions, and be accountable for the technical quality of everything your pod delivers. You will work in a structured Agile environment, collaborating closely with the Solution Architect, QA leads, and client stakeholders across a multi-year, multi-phase modernisation programme.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end technical delivery of your pod — architecture, design, coding, code review, and quality gates
* Lead the migration from legacy ASP.NET (MVC / Web API / Web Forms) to .NET 10 REST APIs and React 18 frontend
* Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, and PR review process across the pod
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for all significant technical choices
* Conduct structured code reviews covering architecture, security, performance, and maintainability — not just syntax
* Identify and resolve technical debt proactively; maintain a tech debt register visible to stakeholders
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) with quality gates: SonarQube, unit coverage, OWASP dependency scan
* Collaborate with Solution Architect on cross-pod API contracts, shared services, and infrastructure decisions

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Design and build .NET 10 Web API microservices using Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design patterns
* Build React 18 SPAs: component architecture, Redux Toolkit / Zustand state management, routing, and performance optimisation
* Implement OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT authentication and role-based access control
* Design and optimise relational database schemas (SQL Server / PostgreSQL); write complex LINQ and EF Core queries
* Build and consume RESTful APIs with versioning, error handling, and OpenAPI documentation
* Write unit, integration, and contract tests as a core part of the Definition of Done

**Migration & Modernisation**

* Lead the technical approach for migrating legacy ASP.NET code to .NET 10 — analysis, characterisation testing, phased migration, parity validation
* Use GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate migration while maintaining review discipline
* Identify breaking changes, deprecated dependencies, and third-party package migration paths
* Establish repeatable migration patterns that the whole pod can follow consistently across modules
* Ensure all migrated code has adequate unit test coverage before merge — parity tests are non-negotiable

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead a pod of 4–6 engineers (mix of senior, mid, and junior developers)
* Run daily technical standups, remove technical blockers, and escalate risks to the Architect early
* Mentor mid and junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and 1:1 technical guidance
* Create a learning environment — internal tech talks, documentation, actionable review feedback
* Make resourcing recommendations and flag capacity risks to the Delivery Manager

**Agile Delivery (Added Advantage)**

* Participate in Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Backlog Grooming
* Collaborate with the Product Owner / BA to refine user stories, provide technical input on acceptance criteria, and raise technical stories
* Provide accurate SP estimates; track sprint progress and flag scope risk early
* Support the Scrum Master in removing impediments with a technical root cause
* Champion the Definition of Done — ensure every story that ships meets quality, test, and documentation standards

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**About ZENNER Aquamet**

At ZENNER Aquamet, we develop modern software solutions that power connected IoT ecosystems and enable secure,

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

support customers across utilities, smart infrastructure, and industrial domains. We foster a collaborative environment

where engineers can learn, contribute, and grow through real-world product development.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically versatile, and hands-on Technical Lead to drive the design,

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

The selected professional will take end-to-end technical ownership of projects, resolve complex engineering challenges,

guide development teams, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Take complete technical ownership of software projects, covering requirement analysis, technical planning,

solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Independently architect, design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications, mobile

applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.

• Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistent user experience, performance,

and accessibility.

• Develop robust frontend and backend applications, reusable components, scalable services, and secure integration

mechanisms.

• Architect, deploy, configure, secure, and manage production environments on both AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and maintain databases, data processing pipelines, distributed systems, caching mechanisms, and highvolume data handling solutions.

• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure automation, and application

release processes.

• Ensure system availability, performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and disaster recovery across

production environments.

• Design and implement secure, scalable IoT applications, including device connectivity, telemetry processing, realtime monitoring, and third-party platform integrations.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

• Evaluate technology choices, define solution architectures, prepare technical documentation, and recommend

appropriate implementation approaches.

• Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, coordinate development activities, and collaborate with

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

• Extensive hands-on proficiency in programming languages and modern application development technologies,

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

• Strong practical experience with modern frameworks and technologies such as Angular, React, Next.js, Django,

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

• Strong analytical ability, architectural decision-making, technical documentation, problem-solving, and leadership

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

• B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech/M.E., MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology,

Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including hands-on development, solution architecture,

cloud infrastructure, and technical leadership.

• Proven experience leading complex software projects and independently managing technical responsibilities

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

• Demonstrated expertise in designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads on both

AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Prior professional experience working on IoT-based products, platforms, or enterprise IoT integration solutions is

mandatory.

• Proven ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain complete enterprise software solutions.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Skills

• AWS and Microsoft Azure certifications in solution architecture, cloud engineering, DevOps, or related

specializations.

• Experience developing IoT solutions for smart metering, utilities, smart infrastructure, industrial systems, or device

management.

• Familiarity with LoRaWAN Network Servers (LNS), IoT gateways, communication protocols, and integration with

external IoT platforms.

• Experience working with multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, large-scale distributed systems, and

enterprise security architectures.

• Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI-powered applications, and intelligent automation.

• Experience mentoring engineering teams, managing multiple technical initiatives, and providing technical guidance

across the software delivery lifecycle

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

  

**Qualification**
**Education**
 Required 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required

Preferred

* Master’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred

  

**Experience**
 Required

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

Preferred

* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

Required

* Experience with:
  + Salesforce / CRM
  + Advanced SQL
  + Advanced Alteryx
  + Python / ML

+ AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI

* Data Analysis

+ Data Research
+ Data Integrity
+ Data Visualization
+ Automation
+ Project Management
+ Team Leadership

* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry
* Consistent alignment with Bain’s Operating Principles
* Skilled with advanced Excel and PowerPoint

  

Preferred

Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. * Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Capability Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Data Product Capability Manager is a senior, hybrid role that combines the strategic focus of a data product owner with the cross-functional coordination responsibilities of a capability manager. This individual will own the definition, prioritization, and delivery of enterprise data capabilities - establishing the structure for how structured data is identified, governed, and consumed across the organization. Reporting into the Product Management organization, the role serves as the central connective tissue between business stakeholders, data domain owners, IT delivery, and data governance functions, ensuring that data products are developed in alignment with enterprise strategy, quality standards, and business value objectives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Strategy Management & Roadmap Ownership: Define and maintain the enterprise data capability roadmap in alignment with overall business strategy. Identify data investment priorities, manage the capability backlog, and communicate progress and value delivery to senior stakeholders
* Vendor & Internal Data Needs Assessment: Evaluate and document structured data requirements across both vendor-sourced and internally generated datasets. Partner with procurement, legal, and data architecture teams to assess fit, feasibility, and compliance of data supply options
* Business & Domain Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with business and domain owners to identify and validate authoritative data sources (Systems of Truth / SOTs) and key attribute requirements. Facilitate workshops and working sessions to surface data needs, resolve conflicts, and build shared understanding of data definitions
* IT Partnership & Agile Delivery Planning: Collaborate with IT and engineering teams to translate data capability requirements into delivery plans using agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum). Participate in sprint planning, PI planning, and backlog grooming to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution
* Data Governance Support & Stewardship: Support and actively contribute to enterprise data governance frameworks, policies, and practices. Work with data stewards and governance councils to ensure data capabilities are developed and maintained in compliance with data standards, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations
* Data Quality Management: Define and enforce data quality standards, metrics, and SLAs for owned data products. Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to implement monitoring, remediation, and continuous improvement processes that ensure fitness-for-purpose data across the enterprise
* Data Product Definition & Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise data products - from ideation and requirements definition through development, launch, and sunset. Ensure data products are well-documented, discoverable, and aligned to measurable business outcomes
* Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation path for data capability delivery across business, IT, and governance functions. Manage stakeholder expectations, facilitate issue resolution, and deliver regular status updates and executive-level reporting
* Data Maturity & Capability Development: Assess the current state of enterprise data capabilities against industry benchmarks and organizational goals. Develop and execute maturity improvement plans that elevate the organization's ability to manage, consume, and derive value from data assets
* Metadata & Data Catalog Stewardship: Champion the adoption and maintenance of enterprise metadata standards and data catalog tools. Ensure critical data attributes, lineage, and ownership are documented and accessible to enable data discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in product management, data management, or a related discipline, with demonstrated accountability for delivering data or technology capabilities in a complex enterprise environment
* Hands-on experience working in agile delivery environments; proficiency with agile frameworks such as Scrum, and familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent
* Experience supporting or leading data governance initiatives, including data quality programs, data stewardship models, or regulatory compliance efforts (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
* Solid understanding of structured data concepts including data modeling, data dictionaries, systems of record/truth, master data management, and enterprise data architecture principles
* Proven ability to elicit, document, and prioritize data requirements from business and domain stakeholders, including the ability to reconcile conflicting priorities and drive alignment
* Proven exceptional cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across business, IT, and executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant certifications such as CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), SAFe Product Owner/Manager, or equivalent data or agile credentials
* Experience with vendor evaluation and management, including RFI/RFP processes for data and technology solutions
* Experience on US Healthcare Domain
* Experience in a capability management, product ownership, or enterprise program management role within a data & analytics, enterprise architecture, or digital transformation context
* Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools such as Alation, Collibra, Informatica, or Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of cloud data platform ecosystems (e.g., Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) and their implications for data product design and delivery

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, Leena AI has secured over $40M in financing from top-tier investors including Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This role owns leena.ai website end-to-end: shipping website changes, standing up A/B testing, and driving conversion optimization. It also owns the initial PLG surface: improving the sandbox experience and building a lightweight product wedge that gives prospects self-serve value before a sales conversation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Website Changes & Page Development
* Own the leena.ai codebase (Next.js / React deployed on Cloudflare); ship new pages, redesigns, and campaign landing pages within days, not sprints.
* Implement responsive, accessible, and performant front-end code aligned with the Design team's specs.
* Build reusable page templates and component libraries so Marketing can compose pages with minimal engineering lift.
* Manage deployment pipelines, staging environments, and site reliability (uptime, Core Web Vitals, page speed).
* A/B Testing Infrastructure
* Evaluate and implement an A/B testing infrastructure that can be integrated with the existing analytics stack.
* Build the plumbing: experiment assignment, event tracking, statistical significance reporting, and audience segmentation.
* Create a self-serve experimentation workflow so Marketing and Growth can launch, monitor, and conclude tests without engineering tickets.
* Document experimentation standards (sample size, run time, success metrics) for the team.
* Conversion-Rate Optimization
* Instrument the full visitor funnel — landing → page scroll → CTA click → demo form submit → confirmation with event-level tracking (GA4, Segment, or equivalent).
* Analyze conversion data by page, traffic source, geography, and device to identify drop-off points.
* Run iterative experiments on headlines, hero sections, social proof, form fields, and CTA placement to improve demo-request conversion rate.
* Partner with the Marketing teams to close the loop from website lead to qualified pipeline, feeding learnings back into page design.
* Sandbox & Product Wedge
* Own the Leena sandbox experience reduce setup friction, improve time-to-value.
* Build and iterate on a product wedge: a self-serve tool on leena.ai (e.g., HR ticket analyzer, automation ROI calculator) that uses Leena's domain model to deliver value a general-purpose LLM can't replicate.
* Instrument the wedge funnel; signups, activation, engagement, PQL conversion.
* Work with Product to define what "product-qualified" means and how wedge usage maps to enterprise buying intent.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of professional front-end or full-stack web development experience.
* Strong proficiency in React and Next.js (SSR, SSG, API routes, image optimization).
* Solid HTML/CSS fundamentals; responsive layouts, accessibility (WCAG 2.1), cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience with at least one A/B testing or feature-flagging tool (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, VWO, or custom).
* Familiarity with web analytics platforms (GA4, Segment, Mixpanel, or Amplitude) and event instrumentation.
* Comfortable with CI/CD workflows, Git, and deploying to modern hosting platforms (Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Vercel, or AWS).
* Light backend experience is a plus: our site runs on Cloudflare Workers, so experience writing edge logic, simple APIs, or redirects in JS/TS (Workers, Pages, KV/D1) helps
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and performance optimization (Lighthouse scores, lazy loading, bundle splitting).
* Strong communication skills; able to work directly with Marketing, Design, and GTM stakeholders without a PM intermediary.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company, especially in a growth or marketing-engineering role.
* Experience at a startup/ fast-paced growth teams
* Hands-on CRO experience; has personally run and analyzed multivariate tests that moved conversion metrics.
* Familiarity with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi) for marketing-managed content is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of SEO technical fundamentals (structured data, sitemap management, canonical tags, page speed).
* Exposure to tools like Hotjar, FullStory, or Microsoft Clarity for session recording and heatmap analysis.
* Design sensibility; can translate a Figma comp to pixel-accurate, polished UI without heavy design oversight.
* Basic data/SQL skills for pulling conversion funnel data from a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).
