title: Product Design Lead, Platform Tools
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business — from HR and payroll to IT and finance — so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we’re creating a unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity, confidence, and action.
  
  
As Product Design Lead for Tasks & Notifications, you’ll ensure our customers are working on the right thing at the right time. You’ll reimagine how users understand what matters, prioritize their work, and take action. You’ll also shape the platform tools that product teams will use to bring the right information and work to users at the right moment. You’ll also define the principles, templates, and tiering models that maintain quality across approximately 2,500+ templates and 1MM+ daily sends, giving users fewer, more relevant messages instead of more noise.
  
  
You’ll also lead design for Sandbox, a safe testing environment that gives IT administrators a copy of their production instance. You’ll help customers confidently build and validate settings, permissions, integrations, and workflows without affecting live data or employees.
  
  
Success in this role requires a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys partnering closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams, and can quickly develop deep expertise in new domains. Designers at Rippling are product builders. AI isn't just something we design, it’s fundamental to how we work from exploration and prototyping to shipping world-class customer experiences.
  
  
**About The Team**
Developer Platform builds the capabilities and experiences that help Rippling’s products work together as one coherent system. The team operates across product boundaries, solving foundational problems that affect how customers configure, understand, and interact with Rippling.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and drive the design vision for Inbox and Notifications, improving today’s experience while shaping how users discover, prioritize, and act on information across in-product, mobile, email, and other surfaces.
* Design systems that handle high volumes of tasks, alerts, approvals, and updates while accounting for prioritization, permissions, deadlines, and diverse user needs.
* Establish the principles, interaction patterns, quality standards, and governance that help teams create consistent notifications while moving quickly and addressing domain-specific needs.
* Lead end-to-end design for Sandbox, helping IT administrators safely configure, test, validate, and learn without introducing risk to their production environment.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows through research, data, customer conversations, and close partnership with customer-facing teams.
* Partner tightly with Product and Engineering to frame ambiguous problems, make high-velocity decisions, and ship with urgency while maintaining a high quality bar.
* Use AI throughout the design process from research synthesis and requirements development to prototyping and exploring intelligent product experiences.

**What You Will Need**

* 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience shipping complex, high-impact products from concept to launch and iterating based on what you learn.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking and the ability to turn messy, ambiguous problem spaces into simple, intuitive workflows.
* Experience designing complex SaaS, enterprise, platform, productivity, or workflow products across multiple personas, permissions, states, and dependencies.
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect functionality into coherent end-to-end journeys, anticipate second-order effects, and balance platform consistency with individual product needs.
* Excellent interaction and visual design craft, including the ability to produce polished work across edge cases and communicate clear, build-ready specifications.
* Relentless customer focus, backed by a habit of studying real behavior, identifying meaningful pain points, and using evidence to guide design decisions.
* Active use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your design workflow whether for research, requirements, copy, or exploration.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, from crisp async write-ups to persuasive presentations that drive alignment and decisions.

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Creative Hybrid (Creative AI Technologist) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.
  
  
You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.
  
  
You operate as the studio’s R&D engine. You proactively explore, test, and master emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover to raise the bar for everyone around you. You have a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.
  
  
You also work directly with clients and BCG case teams. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You lead workshops, shape narratives, and help organizations understand not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.
  
  
**Day To Day, You Will**

* Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
* Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
* Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
* Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualization, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
* Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
* Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
* Build capability across the studio. You run workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field
* 4+ years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment
* Fluency in Python, JavaScript, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution
* Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, ComfyUI, or similar, applied in a creative context
* Experience building agentic systems and pipelines: prompt taxonomies, evaluation rubrics, multi-step workflows, API orchestration. You understand RAG, tool use, and context windows at a working level
* Experience with automation frameworks, systems integration, and the judgment to know when to build versus when to connect
* An understanding of how brands work and how digital moments can create something people remember
* Confidence presenting to and working with clients, and the ability to lead a session, shape a narrative, and guide a review

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most cutting-edge design solutions.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You're Good AT**

* Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
* Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
* Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
* Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
* Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call
* Moving between creative and technical contexts without losing the thread of either. You think like a maker in both rooms
* Explaining what is technically possible in a way that gets non-technical people genuinely interested, not just nodding along
* Balancing experimentation with delivery, knowing when to push and when to ship

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.
  
  
As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.

**OpelOx Media and Marketing is a Mumbai-based 360° media & marketing agency**
helping brands tell bold stories through strategy, design, and performance. We’re obsessed with combining creativity and technology to deliver powerful campaigns across print, digital, outdoor, transit, and experiential. Our design team doesn’t just
**“make things look good” ; we build brand worlds.**

**www.opeloxmedia.com**

We’re looking for a
**Senior Website Developer & Designer**
who can own the full digital lifecycle; from initial UX wireframing and high-end UI design to clean front-end code and performance optimization for a portfolio of high-impact B2B and D2C brands.
**This isn’t a "drag-and-drop theme builder" role.**
You’ll craft bespoke digital experiences, lead complex web builds, and integrate cutting-edge AI-driven workflows into your design and coding stack.

You’ll set the technical and aesthetic direction, manage full-stack implementation across client platforms, and be the go-to person for seamless interaction design, flawless responsiveness, and bulletproof deployment.

  Establish and maintain high-performance, visually stunning website architectures that scale seamlessly across devices and align perfectly with client brand identities.
* **Conversion & Performance Velocity:**
  Deliver lightning-fast, high-converting landing pages, microsites, and enterprise websites optimized for Core Web Vitals, SEO, and user retention.
* **AI-Enhanced Pipeline:**
  Use advanced AI tools (beyond ChatGPT & Gemini) for code scaffolding, UX research synthesis, copywriting placeholders, component generation, and rapid prototyping to accelerate delivery without sacrificing craft.

  Seamlessly bridge the gap between creative storytelling and technical execution, integrating animations, APIs, and robust CMS frameworks.

  Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Framer) and design/ideation platforms (MidJourney, Looka, Relume, Awaaards, Framer) for rapid component and layout scaffolding.
* **CMS Integration & Management:**
  Set up, customize, and maintain robust content management systems (Webflow/Shopify or headless setups) empowering clients to manage content effortlessly.
* **Performance & Optimization:**
  Rigorously optimize site speed, mobile responsiveness, accessibility (WCAG standards), and on-page SEO metrics.
* **Quality & Deadlines:**
  Maintain an uncompromising standard of craft while thriving in a fast-paced agency environment with strict launch timelines.
* **Client Collaboration:**
  Present design prototypes and technical architectures to internal teams and clients, articulate technical choices clearly, and incorporate feedback gracefully.

**Must have experience :**

* A robust portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of sophisticated websites (from design concept to live production code).
* Expert-level command of UI/UX design tools (Figma, Framer, Wix) and modern front-end web development stack (HTML/CSS/JS, Tailwind, React/Next.js, or advanced Webflow/Wix/Framer architecture).
* Hands-on experience with AI development and design tools beyond ChatGPT/Gemini — e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or AI-driven prototyping plugins.
* **Exceptional eye for typography, grid systems, micro-interactions, whitespace, and luxury minimal or high-contrast editorial web aesthetics (Awwwards-level standards).**
* **Deep understanding of web performance metrics, conversion rate optimization (CRO), SEO, and cross-browser compatibility.**

**Benefits:**

* Competitive Pay aligned with your portfolio and leadership experience.
* Creative Freedom to experiment with new formats and technologies.
* AI-First Environment: We invest in paid AI tools for the team, so you’re not stuck on free trials.
* **Growth & Incentives: Clear pathways for pay raises and project-based bonuses.**
* Supportive Culture: A drama-free, collaborative team that values your craft and your time.

***How to Apply: Please submit your CV along with a portfolio analysis of your past work. We are excited to see how you can contribute to our team at Opelox Media!***

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Strategy Intern
description:
**About Vedantu and this role**

Vedantu is one of India's leading K-12 learning companies, with offerings across grades 3 to 12, and is at the pre-IPO stage.The CEO's Office sets direction for the whole company. To do that well, it needs a sharp, current view of the market from the outside in: what competitors are building, how they are performing, where funding is flowing, and which new categories are opening up.

This role exists to build that muscle. You will own Vedantu's competitive intelligence, from first-principles research to presenting what it means for Vedantu to the leadership team.

**What you'll do**

* **Map the competitive landscape.**
  Identify the key competitors in each of Vedantu's categories, from grade 3 to grade 12.
* **Build and own a living competitor tracker.**
  For every category, keep current each competitor's topline (revenue), bottomline (profit or burn), core strategy, and latest developments.
* **Do secondary research.**
  Pull numbers and insights from company filings, annual reports, research databases, investor material and the news, and cross-check sources before trusting a figure.
* **Do primary research.**
  Find and cold-reach industry experts, former employees, founders, educators and investors; set up and run interviews; and turn each one into crisp notes.
* **Stay on top of the news.**
  Track ed-tech and Indian startup developments: product launches, regulatory changes, fundraises, M&A, and emerging categories and opportunities.
* **Present to leadership every two weeks.**
  Turn what you've found into a short readout on what changed and what it means for Vedantu.

**What you'll get**

* **A front-row seat in the CEO's Office**
  of a pre-IPO company. See how strategic decisions are actually made.
* **Leadership exposure from week one.**
  Present your work to the leadership team every two weeks.
* **Direct mentorship.**
  Work one-on-one with the Chief of Staff to the CEO.
* **Real ownership.**
  The tracker you build becomes an input to company strategy, not a side project.
* **A competitive stipend**
  of ₹30,000–40,000 per month, with the option to extend the internship based on performance.

**Who we're looking for**

We care more about what you've done than where you study. You're a final-year or pre-final-year undergraduate from any discipline.

**You must have:**

* **Proof of market research.**
  At least one internship, project or piece of work where you researched a market or company, such as a consulting or VC internship, a startup strategy project, an equity research report, or a published sector teardown.
* **Experience running interviews.**
  You have spoken to customers, users or experts and turned those conversations into insight.
* **Confidence with cold outreach.**
  You can get a stranger on a call through LinkedIn, email or your network.
* **Fluency with AI research tools.**
  You use them to research faster, and you know where to double-check what they say.
* **Comfort with numbers.**
  You can read a P&L, find a company's revenue and profit or burn from public filings, and spot when figures don't add up.
* **Sharp synthesis.**
  You can turn 20 data points into the 3 that matter and say clearly why.
* **Ownership and discretion.**
  You keep things current without being chased, and you handle confidential information responsibly.

**Good to have:**

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
* Interest in education or ed-tech
* Writing you've published (a blog, newsletter, or LinkedIn posts)

The Workplace Experience Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.

* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.

* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Follow DTMS to ensure compliant product portfolio within WREF
* Support the Workplace Experience Product owner in the deployment and support of Workplace Experience technologies
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience delivering and supporting workplace experience technologies such as AppSpace
* Experience onboarding new sites to Workplace technologies and ensuring compliance with design standards.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Management, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story, Workplace Technology
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Research Intern
description:
**Company Description**

Most hotels in India don't fail on strategy. They fail on the fourth floor at 11pm — when the housekeeping attendant forgets the amenity list, when the F&B intern skips the temperature log, when the night desk closes out a checkout without the deposit note.

Focus Realm is the operating standards platform for Indian hospitality. SOPs, training, and compliance — running on the phones your team already carries, in the languages they actually speak.

**Why we exist**

Standards protect the guest, the brand, the star rating, the FSSAI license. And yet in most Indian hotels they live as PDFs on WhatsApp, day-one classroom sessions that fade inside a week, and a ring-binder audit file nobody wants to open. When 40–60% of the front line rotates in a year, whatever standards you had in January are unrecognisable by August.

We're not here to sell one more LMS. We're building the operating layer that keeps standards alive between audits — for the housekeeper on shift, the GM three properties away, and the corporate trainer trying to keep two hundred rooms in line.

**What Focus Realm does**

One system, three portals — each shaped to the person using it.

→ Employee — mobile-first, multilingual SOPs and training. The right procedure for the task in front of you, and a completion tap that goes on record.

→ Manager — property-level visibility. Where's the drift, who needs a refresher, what will the auditor find on Tuesday.

→ Author — corporate authoring. Write standards once, publish them across the group, version everything, and see who's actually running them.

**Role Description**

Focus Realm | Remote | Unpaid | 3 Months

**About the Role**

Focus Realm is looking for research-oriented individuals to investigate real-world industry pain points, market gaps, and business challenges. Interns will conduct in-depth research and develop research papers and articles for publication as part of Focus Realm's proprietary research portfolio.

**Research Domains**

Marketing, Business Strategy, Finance, Management, Human Resources, Hospitality, Education, and other relevant industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Research industry challenges, market trends, and existing solutions.

- Analyze competitors, business practices, and market opportunities.

- Write descriptive research papers and informative, evidence-backed articles.

- Maintain credible references, research documentation, and factual accuracy.

- Present progress during alternate-day meetings and incorporate feedback.

**Work Structure**

- Duration: 3 months, extendable to 6 months.

- Commitment: 1-2 hours daily, 5 days a week.

- Mode: Remote.

- Meetings: Alternate working days.

- Compensation: Unpaid internship.

**Expected Deliverables**

Over three months, interns are expected to work towards:

- 1–2 descriptive research papers.

- 2–4 articles published through Focus Realm's official platforms.

Publication is subject to quality review and approval.

**Eligibility**

Students, graduates, and aspiring researchers with strong analytical thinking, writing skills, attention to detail, and an interest in industry research are welcome. Prior experience is beneficial but not mandatory.

**What You Gain**

- Internship completion certificate.

- Letter of Recommendation (LOR) for deserving candidates.

- Research credit based on individual contributions.

- Practical industry research and market analysis experience.

- Published work to strengthen your portfolio.

Research produced during the internship will contribute to Focus Realm's proprietary research portfolio, with appropriate attribution based on contribution and publication policies.

**Apply:**
Submit your resume and a brief statement about your research interests and preferred domain.

**About The Role**
At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business — from HR and payroll to IT and finance — so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we’re creating a unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity, confidence, and action.
  
  
As Product Design Lead for Tasks & Notifications, you’ll ensure our customers are working on the right thing at the right time. You’ll reimagine how users understand what matters, prioritize their work, and take action. You’ll also shape the platform tools that product teams will use to bring the right information and work to users at the right moment. You’ll also lead design for Sandbox, a safe testing environment that gives IT administrators a copy of their production instance. You’ll help customers confidently build and validate settings, permissions, integrations, and workflows without affecting live data or employees.

* Establish the principles, interaction patterns, quality standards, and governance that help teams create consistent notifications while moving quickly and addressing domain-specific needs.
* Lead end-to-end design for Sandbox, helping IT administrators safely configure, test, validate, and learn without introducing risk to their production environment.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows through research, data, customer conversations, and close partnership with customer-facing teams.
* Partner tightly with Product and Engineering to frame ambiguous problems, make high-velocity decisions, and ship with urgency while maintaining a high quality bar.
* Use AI throughout the design process from research synthesis and requirements development to prototyping and exploring intelligent product experiences.

**What You Will Need**

* 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience shipping complex, high-impact products from concept to launch and iterating based on what you learn.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking and the ability to turn messy, ambiguous problem spaces into simple, intuitive workflows.
* Experience designing complex SaaS, enterprise, platform, productivity, or workflow products across multiple personas, permissions, states, and dependencies.
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect functionality into coherent end-to-end journeys, anticipate second-order effects, and balance platform consistency with individual product needs.
* Excellent interaction and visual design craft, including the ability to produce polished work across edge cases and communicate clear, build-ready specifications.
* Relentless customer focus, backed by a habit of studying real behavior, identifying meaningful pain points, and using evidence to guide design decisions.
* Active use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your design workflow whether for research, requirements, copy, or exploration.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, from crisp async write-ups to persuasive presentations that drive alignment and decisions.

title: Research Associate & Study Coordinator
description:
**Company Description**

Masthishkam Foundation is an not-for-profit, independent, non-partisan organisation connecting brain science with health, education, technology, policy and public life. Rooted in India and connected globally, the Foundation brings together science, medicine and the humanities to understand how people think, learn, make decisions and live. Its work includes research, policy briefs, educational resources and practical programmes that strengthen human capability, wellbeing and dignity, with particular attention to the needs and realities of the Global South.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, with a
**consolidated salary of ₹70,000 per month**
.

The Research Associate will coordinate a study examining whether a structured approach inspired by clinical diagnostic reasoning can improve judgement in intelligence analysis. Working directly with Dr Pravin Thomas and research collaborators, the successful candidate will help take a detailed study plan through preparation, pilot testing, data collection and publication.

Responsibilities include developing and editing research cases from published investigation reports; coordinating case writers and independent fact-checkers; preparing ethics submissions and participant materials; and organising participating institutions, recruitment and experimental sessions. The role also involves coordinating the study platform, maintaining datasets and documentation, protecting study blinding and confidentiality, and supporting analysis and manuscript preparation.

Alongside the study, the Research Associate will contribute to Masthishkam Foundation’s wider activities, including research syntheses, policy briefs, proposals, partner communications and programme coordination.

**Qualifications**

* A postgraduate degree in cognitive science, psychology, behavioural science, neuroscience, public health or a related discipline.
* Practical experience conducting human-participant research, preferably behavioural experiments or studies of judgement and decision-making.
* Understanding of experimental design, participant recruitment, research ethics, informed consent and data management.
* Strong analytical skills and familiarity with statistical software such as R, Python or SPSS.
* Excellent written English, with the ability to interpret complex reports, verify sources and develop clear, accurate research materials.
* Ability to implement a study protocol carefully, maintain blinding and confidentiality, and document procedures and deviations.
* Strong organisational skills, including coordinating collaborators, managing timelines and following tasks through to completion.
* Experience with online experimental or survey platforms, ethics applications and academic publications would be an advantage.
* Interest in cognitive security, reasoning under uncertainty and translating research into practical resources.

**Application**

Please send your CV, one research or writing sample, your earliest joining date, and a short description of a study you helped conduct—specifying your own responsibilities—to the Masthishkam Foundation LinkedIn Page by direct message or to connect@indiabrainforum.org.

title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:

They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.

* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

**Job details**

* Full Time
* Location: Mumbai

**Education**

* Preferred:

* Strategic mindset
* Strong focus on delighting customers

* Ability to liaise with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and establish credibility and strong relationship with senior stakeholders

With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. title: Senior Specialist, Product Development
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Product Development
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Prepaid Management Services global digital presence with over 55+ websites and 10+ mobile application. We are looking for senior specialist to be responsible for maintaining the current portfolio of customer facing channels - Mobile apps, My Account, Commercial platforms. The role holder will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of product features, enhancements and work collaboratively with the relevant regional product, account management, marketing, engineering, Bizops teams, Compliance and Legal to oversee the successful delivery of the changes as well as the launch of new digital platforms and capabilities.
  
  
**The Role**

* Managing the growth of Mastercard’s Prepaid Management Services (MPMS) websites: Including product capabilities, Web, CMS and mobile app updates and constant innovation to drive business success online.
* Attending scrum ceremonies and working closely with internal web and mobile development teams, to improve the user experience and always put the customer first.
* Delivering digital platforms for MPMS and clients, including the launch of new marketing, servicing sites and mobile application.
* Implement digital best practice, improve existing customer experience and drive financial growth with a focus on platform consolidation.
* Use data driven insights to reduce customer friction across our portfolio of websites and mobile apps.
* Provide regular analytical reporting and recommendations based on data.
* Partnering with and supporting regional team (Marketing, Product and Sales in particular) to advise on best practice digital execution and instigate change for the better.

**About You**

* The role requires someone with a strong all-round approach to digital; ranging from content management, launching of new features/functionality in production and a strong desire to innovate and learn from the ecommerce industry.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Product Executive
description:
* **Company Description**
  NFX Digital is a data-driven digital marketing company transforming the consumer and marketing research landscape in India. Through its flagship platform Adytude.com, NFX Digital blends traditional research instruments with innovative, digital-first methodologies to deliver fast, cost-effective, and statistically robust insights

**About the Role**

* **Experience:**

  1–2 years
* **Work Mode:**

  Full-time, Work from Office

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.

title: Science Communication and Writing Intern
description:
**Company Description**
BioTecNika Info Labs Pvt Ltd is India’s leading biotech career and Bio-IT platform, dedicated to helping biotechnology and life science students upskill and build successful careers. The company offers specialized training in bioinformatics, AI, machine learning, computational biology, cheminformatics, and coding for biologists, along with research-focused project work. BioTecNika is widely recognized for its CSIR NET Life Sciences coaching and comprehensive support for competitive exams such as GATE, BET, ICMR, and CUET. In addition to exam preparation, the platform connects learners with internships, jobs, and research roles in biotechnology, microbiology, bioinformatics, and life sciences. BioTecNika.org serves as a trusted partner for learners aiming to advance their academic and professional journey in biosciences.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Science Communication and Writing Intern role based in Bengaluru. The intern will support the creation of clear, engaging science content for students and professionals in biotechnology, life sciences, and related fields. Daily responsibilities include researching current topics in biosciences, drafting and editing educational articles, blogs, and learning resources, and assisting in the preparation of exam-focused content. The role may also involve collaborating with subject matter experts to translate complex scientific concepts into accessible language, contributing to social media and newsletter content, and maintaining consistency in tone and style across platforms. The intern will work closely with the content and education teams to ensure accuracy, relevance, and impact of all published material.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess a strong foundation in Science, particularly in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Microbiology, or related disciplines.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills and the ability to interpret scientific literature, data, and research findings.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication tailored to diverse learner audiences.
* Candidates should possess a background or interest in Education, with the ability to structure content for learning and exam preparation.
* Candidates should possess Research skills for sourcing credible information, staying updated with scientific developments, and supporting evidence-based content.
* Beneficial qualifications include enrollment in or completion of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant scientific field, familiarity with competitive exams (e.g., CSIR NET, GATE), attention to detail, basic editing skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment.

title: Field Application Engineer (FAE) – India
description:

This role is responsible for providing technical expertise and application support for industrial computing and edge AI solutions, working closely with the sales and engineering teams to deliver optimal solutions to customers. The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge in embedded and/or industrial systems, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to support customers throughout the design-in and deployment process.

**Major Job Responsibilities and Duties:**

1. Pre-sales Technical Support & Solution Design

I. Work closely with the India sales team to provide technical consultation and solution recommendations for customers.

II. Analyze customer requirements and propose suitable solutions based on ADLINK’s industrial computing, edge AI, or embedded platforms.

III. Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept (POC) activities.

IV. Assist in preparing technical documentation, proposals, and responses for RFQs/RFPs.

title: Research Intern
description:
**Company Description**

Most hotels in India don't fail on strategy. They fail on the fourth floor at 11pm — when the housekeeping attendant forgets the amenity list, when the F&B intern skips the temperature log, when the night desk closes out a checkout without the deposit note.

Focus Realm is the operating standards platform for Indian hospitality. SOPs, training, and compliance — running on the phones your team already carries, in the languages they actually speak.

**Why we exist**

Standards protect the guest, the brand, the star rating, the FSSAI license. And yet in most Indian hotels they live as PDFs on WhatsApp, day-one classroom sessions that fade inside a week, and a ring-binder audit file nobody wants to open. When 40–60% of the front line rotates in a year, whatever standards you had in January are unrecognisable by August.

We're not here to sell one more LMS. We're building the operating layer that keeps standards alive between audits — for the housekeeper on shift, the GM three properties away, and the corporate trainer trying to keep two hundred rooms in line.

**What Focus Realm does**

One system, three portals — each shaped to the person using it.

→ Employee — mobile-first, multilingual SOPs and training. The right procedure for the task in front of you, and a completion tap that goes on record.

→ Manager — property-level visibility. Where's the drift, who needs a refresher, what will the auditor find on Tuesday.

→ Author — corporate authoring. Write standards once, publish them across the group, version everything, and see who's actually running them.

**Role Description**

Focus Realm | Remote | Unpaid | 3 Months

**About the Role**

Focus Realm is looking for research-oriented individuals to investigate real-world industry pain points, market gaps, and business challenges. Interns will conduct in-depth research and develop research papers and articles for publication as part of Focus Realm's proprietary research portfolio.

**Research Domains**

Marketing, Business Strategy, Finance, Management, Human Resources, Hospitality, Education, and other relevant industries.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Research industry challenges, market trends, and existing solutions.

- Analyze competitors, business practices, and market opportunities.

- Write descriptive research papers and informative, evidence-backed articles.

- Maintain credible references, research documentation, and factual accuracy.

- Present progress during alternate-day meetings and incorporate feedback.

**Work Structure**

- Duration: 3 months, extendable to 6 months.

- Commitment: 1-2 hours daily, 5 days a week.

- Mode: Remote.

- Meetings: Alternate working days.

- Compensation: Unpaid internship.

**Expected Deliverables**

Over three months, interns are expected to work towards:

- 1–2 descriptive research papers.

- 2–4 articles published through Focus Realm's official platforms.

Publication is subject to quality review and approval.

**Eligibility**

Students, graduates, and aspiring researchers with strong analytical thinking, writing skills, attention to detail, and an interest in industry research are welcome. Prior experience is beneficial but not mandatory.

**What You Gain**

- Internship completion certificate.

- Letter of Recommendation (LOR) for deserving candidates.

- Research credit based on individual contributions.

- Practical industry research and market analysis experience.

- Published work to strengthen your portfolio.

Research produced during the internship will contribute to Focus Realm's proprietary research portfolio, with appropriate attribution based on contribution and publication policies.

**Apply:**
Submit your resume and a brief statement about your research interests and preferred domain.

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - WREF
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Senior/ Principal Product Analyst - WREF supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the WREF Product Owner, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The WREF Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the WREF Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the WREF Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Follow DTMS to ensure a compliant product portfolio for WREF products
* Support the WREF Product Owner in making product changes aligned to the Smart Buildings strategy
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience delivering and supporting workplace technologies, particularly IOT, smart buildings, real estate process automation
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Buildings Management, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Digital Solutions, Internet of Things (IoT) Platforms, Process Automation, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story, Workplace Technology
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

title: System Integration Test Engineer (4-10 Years of experience in Automotive system integration and testing ECU)
description:
We are seeking a System Integration engineer to contribute to the system integration and testing activities for the next generation vehicle controller and software platform. This new architecture will integrate new and advanced software functions for cloud connectivity and edge processing, thus enabling highly automated driving and advanced connectivity features. The individual should be an experienced engineer in system integration and testing, with strong skills in system-level issue root-causing and having a strong technical background in systems engineering and vehicle architecture development.

The primary focus will be to integrate the system of ECUs on a system bench and ensure that the software running on all ECUs function without issues or vulnerabilities. The process starts with flashing the software of the involved ECUs, and then running a suite of tests that verifies the communication (Ethernet, CAN, and LIN) among multiple ECUs, assess the stability of the software under stress, and run tests that involve verifying diagnostics functions and cybersecurity features. The responsibilities may include setting up and maintenance of system benches to ensure a workable test environment that is also remotely accessible. These activities involve a cycle of testing, analyzing results, and implementing remediation to improve overall security posture.

The job also entails reviewing relevant requirements, developing test cases using Python and CAPL scripting (among others), automating the execution of the test cases on CI pipelines, and analyzing the results. The role demands close alignment and interaction with SW design and architecture teams, in addition to cybersecurity experts.

We are looking for a highly motivated integration engineer who will work side by side with development engineers from the early design phase until system validation. This starts at day one by not only integrating early implementations and requirement models, but challenging design and logical architecture in the earliest phase and with a focus to always strive for a great end-to-end system experience.

We are seeking someone with good expertise at the following levels of the electrical system architecture and its various vehicle network functions and features: design verification, architecture verification, code/script development, system integration, and product validation.

**Position Requirements:**

*Basic Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering
* Minimum 4 years of experience in systems engineering/vehicle network development and industrialization, minimally on a sub-system domain level
* Solid technical knowledge of E/E architecture and vehicle networks, their functions and features, solid understanding of LIN (ISO 17987-1) and CAN (ISO 11898-1) networks
* Basic knowledge of Ethernet network (OA TC8) and SOME/IP protocol
* Good understanding of automotive testing standards for distributed systems (e.g., ISTQB Certified Tester)
* Knowledge of agile test methods, tools and automation (proven working knowledge with one or more of the following tools: Doors Next Generation, IBM RTC, Jira
* Strong experience in test automation using Python, CAPL
* Experience with continuous integration, testing & deployment (Github, Artifactory, Conan, Teamcity)

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience testing in multiple development contexts (Linux, AUTOSAR, Android, QNX)
* Experience with model driven test in early development stages (functional mockups, PoC’s)
* Knowledge of Cybersecurity mechanisms such as MACSec (IEEE 802.1AE)
* Experience in project execution roles for electrical architecture industrialization on sub-system and/or vehicle level
* Experience in Agentic AI and AI adaptation in test cycle.
* Experience in Ethernet Some IP Protocol and DOIP

At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.

If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a
**Payment Integrity Project Senior Analyst**
, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of initiatives across
**Health Cloud, Data Science, and Data Visualization**
within the Payment Integrity team.
  
  
Working closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, data scientists, and reporting teams, you will help translate business needs into well-defined requirements, maintain and prioritize team backlogs, coordinate delivery activities, and support the adoption of Agile ways of working.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in project coordination, business analysis, or process improvement who is interested in growing their Agile delivery, product management, and technology skills.
  
  
You will act as a bridge between business and technical teams, ensuring that requirements are clearly understood, documented, refined, tested, and delivered in alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives.
  
  
In addition, the role will support governance activities, stakeholder communications, training, documentation, testing coordination, and continuous improvement initiatives across multiple workstreams.
