* Partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog of Features, User Stories, and enhancements.
* Facilitate backlog grooming, story refinement sessions, sprint planning activities, and other Agile ceremonies where required.
* Elicit, document, validate, and manage business requirements, ensuring clear acceptance criteria and traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Coordinate with business and technical teams to identify dependencies, risks, assumptions, and implementation considerations.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, test case creation, execution coordination, and defect management.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, training materials, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.
* Deliver training and change management support for new functionality, enhancements, and process improvements.
* Assist in monitoring project progress, preparing status updates, and supporting governance activities for leadership and stakeholder review.
* Facilitate meetings, workshops, and stakeholder discussions while documenting decisions, actions, and outcomes.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize information from multiple sources to support data-driven decision making.
* Support operational readiness activities to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, team workflows, reporting capabilities, and delivery practices.
* Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement across Payment Integrity initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and functional areas.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Required

+ 2+ years of experience in Project Management, Business Analysis, Product Delivery, or a related role.
+ Strong experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
+ Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder meetings, and requirements discussions.
+ Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Experience creating process flows, business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and operational documentation.
+ Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
+ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

* Preferred

+ Experience working within Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or other Agile delivery frameworks.
+ Experience maintaining product backlogs and supporting Product Owners.
+ Experience using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Salesforce, or Health Cloud.
+ Exposure to Data Science, Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or Data Visualization projects.
+ Knowledge of dashboard development and reporting concepts (Power BI, Tableau, QlikSense, or similar tools).
+ Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing and release activities.
+ Experience within healthcare, health insurance, fraud, audit, payment integrity, or claims environments.
+ Interest in developing a career within Agile product delivery, business analysis, or product management.

title: Senior Consultant - Endur Functional
description:
**Senior Consultant – Endur Functional**

 

**Location:
India**

**Role:**
**Permanent/ Full Time**

**Why capSpire?**

 

capSpire is a fast-growing consulting and solutions company with a global footprint with eight offices in the world’s leading markets. We pride ourselves in being truly entrepreneurial, innovative, and collaborative, with a strong problem-solving ethos. We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.
* Support existing solutions for bug fixes, enhancements and operations.
* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

title: Senior Government Proposal Analyst – US Federal & SLED
description:
**About iVoyant:**

iVoyant Systems Private Limited is an IT services and technology company delivering innovative solutions to clients. We support our US business in pursuing technology opportunities across Federal, State, Local and Educational (SLED) agencies. We are seeking an experienced Senior Proposal Analyst to manage government solicitations and develop compliant, competitive proposals in coordination with US-based business, technical and management teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Opportunity Identification and Qualification

* Identify and evaluate RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, IFBs, task orders and other solicitations across US Federal and SLED markets; monitor procurement portals and agency websites.
* Assess eligibility, scope, evaluation criteria, mandatory requirements and deadlines; prepare opportunity summaries and bid/no-bid recommendations.
* Maintain an opportunity pipeline and procurement calendar, tracking amendments, milestones and submission dates.

**Proposal Development, Compliance and Quality:**

* Lead proposal writing, editing and coordination, including executive summaries, technical narratives, management approaches, staffing plans, implementation methodologies and past-performance responses.
* Develop win themes and differentiators aligned with agency requirements; translate technical concepts into clear, customer-focused responses.
* Create compliance matrices and track solicitation amendments, forms, certifications, attachments, page limits, formatting and submission instructions.
* Coordinate inputs from sales, SMEs, technical/product teams, finance and management; conduct compliance, technical and editorial reviews and obtain approvals.

**Pricing, Submission and Agency Coordination:**

* Coordinate pricing schedules, rate cards, cost assumptions and commercial inputs; check consistency between proposed scope, resources and pricing.
* Own end-to-end submissions, including schedules, document finalization, portal uploads, validation and submission confirmations.
* Coordinate clarification responses, agency requests for information, oral presentations and solution demonstrations.
* Track proposal status and award decisions; follow up with agencies and coordinate debriefings. Analyze feedback and document lessons learned.

**Business Development and Contract Administration:**

* Monitor award announcements, incumbents, competitor activity, procurement trends and recompete opportunities; maintain capability statements, past-performance references and supporting bid documents.
* Maintain a contract register covering values, dates, deliverables, milestones, options and renewals; track reporting, insurance, certification, notice and other compliance deadlines.
* Coordinate amendments, modifications, extensions, renewals and contracts closeout with sales, delivery, finance and legal teams.

**Team Coordination and Knowledge Management:**

* Guide proposal analysts as required; coordinate task assignments, SME inputs, progress tracking and quality reviews.
* Maintain a central library of templates, standard responses, past proposals, case studies and supporting evidence; improve proposal processes and document standards.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration or related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience preparing and managing US government proposals, preferably in IT services, software, technology solutions or consulting.
* Experience with US Federal and State, Local and Educational (SLED) procurement processes and the ability to interpret solicitations and develop compliant responses.
* Practical experience with opportunity qualification, compliance matrices, proposal coordination, quality reviews, electronic submissions and pricing/commercial coordination.
* Familiarity with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and other solicitation-specific requirements, where applicable.
* Experience with government procurement portals, vendor registrations, contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing agreements or task-order solicitations.
* Experience supporting government demonstrations, oral presentations, agency debriefings and post-award contract administration.
* Experienced in leading or mentoring proposal analysts; familiarity with proposal-management platforms, CRM systems or opportunity-tracking tools.
* Strong written English, editing, analytical, organizational and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF editing and document collaboration tools.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines, work independently and coordinate effectively with US-based teams across time zones.

**Performance Measures:**

Performance will be assessed through timely submissions, proposal compliance and quality, effectiveness of opportunity qualification, stakeholder coordination, accuracy of opportunity and contract records, completion of agency follow-ups, and contribution to continuous improvement and proposal win performance.

title: Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.

* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, geometry and mesh files, simulation inputs, material properties, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving finite-element analysis (FEA), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), thermodynamics, heat transfer, dynamics, robotics, flight simulation, propulsion, and orbital mechanics.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across units, equilibrium, conservation laws, boundary conditions, mesh convergence, solver tolerances, reference frames, and numerical stability.
* Validate computational environments, simulation tools, solvers, and dependencies to ensure reproducible results.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as stresses, deflections, natural frequencies, aerodynamic coefficients, thermal performance, orbital parameters, and safety margins.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Fortran, Julia, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: FEA, CFD, dynamics, flight simulation, thermal modeling, astrodynamics, guidance, navigation and control (GNC), or propulsion modeling.
* Strong understanding of engineering simulation, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate engineering assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and computational tools such as OpenFOAM, SU2, CalculiX, Code\_Aster, FEniCS, Elmer, Gmsh, FreeCAD, CadQuery, MuJoCo, ROS, XFOIL, AVL, OpenVSP, JSBSim, OpenMDAO, pyCycle, poliastro, Orekit, GMAT, or SPICE.
* Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or NASTRAN, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with state estimation, trajectory optimization, topology optimization, aeroelastic analysis, or multidisciplinary design optimization.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry or agency experience in automotive, energy, manufacturing, robotics, aircraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or UAVs.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Workplace Experience Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Follow DTMS to ensure compliant product portfolio within WREF
* Support the Workplace Experience Product owner in the deployment and support of Workplace Experience technologies
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience delivering and supporting workplace experience technologies such as AppSpace
* Experience onboarding new sites to Workplace technologies and ensuring compliance with design standards.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Management, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story, Workplace Technology
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Testing & Configuration Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
Hitachi Energy is looking for a Communication Systems Engineer to strengthen its capabilities in substation automation and protection communication networks. This role offers the opportunity to work on mission‑critical communication systems that enable reliable protection, monitoring, and control of power networks. The position involves close interaction with product management, engineering, testing, sales, and customers, and requires continuous engagement with evolving product features and communication technologies. The role is well suited for candidates who are technically curious, hands‑on, and motivated to contribute across design, deployment, and operational support within the Grid Automation ecosystem.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to engineering support activities by proposing technical solutions, optimizing feature usage, and supporting the adoption of new communication technologies in substation environments.
* Support sales and tender engineering through technical validations, product selection, standards compliance checks, and development of technically sound solution concepts.
* Work with the testing organization to define project‑specific test strategies, prepare FAT documentation, and support validation of new functionalities and technologies.
* Provide commissioning and integration support at customer sites, ensuring compatibility with existing communication networks and adherence to customer requirements.
* Participate in type testing and certification activities relevant to the Indian market, including regulatory and customer‑specific test requirements.
* Handle after‑sales technical support and root cause analysis, identifying fault patterns and driving corrective and preventive actions to improve product performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by translating field experience and fault trends into functional enhancements and cost‑optimization proposals.
* Deliver technical trainings to internal teams and external stakeholders as required for new product introductions or technology upgrades.
* Prepare and present technical material for customers, seminars, pre‑tender discussions, and customer engagement forums.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of basic electronics and communication engineering fundamentals.
* Exposure to or working knowledge of products such as ETL600, NSD570, FOX61x.
* Familiarity with communication technologies including SDH, PDH, Ethernet, and MPLS‑TP.
* Working knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, IEC 101, IEC 61850, and TCP/IP.
* Good understanding of how communication systems support protection schemes and automation functions within substations.
* Experience or exposure to engineering support, testing, commissioning, or technical after‑sales support in power or industrial communication systems.
* Ability to continuously learn and stay aligned with new technologies, standards, and product updates.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills for working across cross‑functional and customer‑facing teams.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.

title: Application Engineer
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Application Engineering

**Reports To:**
Application Engineering Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contribution

**Location:**
Pan India

****Job Responsibilities****

To be responsible for managing technical relational with Customers (OE/EU) or Distributors.

Contribute to opportunity generation and create customized value-added solutions.

To contribute substantially in the development and implementation of customized solutions and other unique offerings

To develop analytical methods, interpret and verify results from application engineering software’s to create value for customers

To perform Application Reviews on complex machines and equipment

To create application engineering proposals and customized solutions according to customer requirements and present to customer concisely with the application concept, design, and technical specifications.

Monitor competitor activities in respect of products and technical development and define SKF actions plan to counter those.

Work on customer key pain areas and develop solutions that can improve performance and result in business for SKF.

To evaluate technical requirements and common trend in the market and provide feedback to SKF Product/ Application Competence Centers to steer new product/service design and development.

To demonstrate, develop and transfer advanced engineering knowledge and expertise, on a high level, according to requirements in own field of work.

To identify and develop customer needs, providing high level of creativity (develop Application Specific/ Services Offering based on product performance capabilities).

To represent SKF and market products and services at customers and institutions through visits, presentations, seminars, and fairs.

To develop and perform Root Cause Analysis of bearing related problems, also in new types of applications.

To develop and execute internal and external trainings, act as a trainer and develop training material

Ensure that the technical details of customer’s requirements, needs, and pain area are identified, compiled, recorded, and analyzed.

Obtain customer’s product approvals in line with application proposals, product drawings, sample submitted and completed sample tests.

Monitor customer approval tests conducted on prototypes/initial samples at customer’s premises/installations.

Manage the portfolio of customer/technology related product development program for optimal profit

Maintain close relationship with customer’s engineering management. Represent the voice of customer during Design FMEA & Process FMEA.

**Skill Set**

Mechanical Engineering Domain Knowledge- relevant work experience in Design/Application Engineering/Maintenance

Experience of handling or working with OE/ End users.

Result driven and passion to win

Think and act decisively, and with clarity.

Collaboration and Managing Internal and External Stakeholders.

Team management

Solution selling

Basic understanding of logistics at a distributor point

**KPIs**

No of New Solutions (New Market Offer / Engineered to Order/Application specific Offer ) introduced in the Segment

No of Industry visibility activities done – conduct technical forums/ seminars with customer.

No of internal trainings for the SKF customer

Documented solutions for the customer.

Failure’s modes of application and probable solutions

****Education & Experience****

B.E / B. Tech (Mandatory)

Experience of 5-8 years in Application engineering / design engineering / Maintenance

customer facing experience mandatory

Industry – Bearings

**Interested, please share your updated profile – Margaret.Hirekerur@skf.com**

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Own the customer journey from initial requirements to long-term platform success.

• Apply your EHR expertise across a growing range of private healthcare services.

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

• Stay close to the product, with direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership.

• See your recommendations become working solutions used by real healthcare teams.

• Help shape both customer delivery and the platform itself.

**📍 Location, working hours and joining**

• Based in India.

• Available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time, including a one-hour break.

• UK summer hours: 13:30–22:30 IST.

• UK winter hours: 14:30–23:30 IST.

• Candidates able to join within 45 days are welcome.

**Interested?**

Please ensure your CV clearly identifies the EHR platforms and modules you have worked with, your personal configuration responsibilities, and the client implementations or optimisation projects you have owned.

We would love to hear how you could bring that expertise to Script Assist.

title: Lead Applied Value Engineer - CPGR /CMT -NAM
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
The position of
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
for the
**High Tech**
industry you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Team and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Identify & Frame Value**

* Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
* Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
* Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

**Realize Value**

* Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
* Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
* Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

**Scale Value**

* Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
* Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
* Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

**The qualifications you need:**
**Live for Customer Value:**
Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.
  
  
**Data, Analytics, Applications & IT:**
Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.
  
  
**Process Improvement & Value Realization:**
Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value
  
  
**Project Management:**
Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
  
  
**Executive Stakeholder Management:**
Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.
  
  
**Business Domain Expertise:**
Understanding of theHigh Tech domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)
  
  
**Industry Expertise:**
Expertise in the High Tech industry and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities
  
  
**Degree:**
In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program
  
  
**What Celonis Can Offer You:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
* Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: Senior Compliance Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Compliance Engineer**
**About Lumilens**
At Lumilens, we are building the critical photonics infrastructure powering tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. We develop chip-to-chip optical interconnects and scalable photonic engines, unlocking a new era of faster, cooler, and more efficient computing. Join our rapidly growing team and help shape the infrastructure of the future.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Compliance Engineer with 8 to 10 years of relevant experience to ensure our optical transceiver products meet all necessary compliance and certification requirements. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and executing end-to-end certification activities for products, including compliance with EMC, safety, RoHS, WEEE, GR468, and relevant international standards. This is a dynamic role requiring collaboration with both local and international labs, adaptability to work in shifts, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Take ownership for all compliance needs of optical transceiver products, including certification to EMC, safety, RoHS, WEEE, GR468, and other global standards.

* Build and manage a comprehensive certification ecosystem, working with local and international labs to ensure end-to-end compliance.
* Coordinate lab scheduling and demonstrate flexibility to work in shifts, based on lab availability.
* Prepare and manage documentation required to support product certifications, ensuring full compliance with product release milestones.
* Work independently on assigned compliance projects while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and external labs.
* Track regulatory changes and proactively update compliance processes and product certifications as needed.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8 to 10 years of experience in handling product compliance for optical transceivers or related electronic hardware, including EMC, safety, RoHS, WEEE, and GR468 standards.
* Strong knowledge of EMC and safety standards for IT devices/equipment.
* Proven ability to create and manage relationships with both local and global test labs to support certification efforts.
* Comfortable with working shifts, as required by lab scheduling.
* Capable of working independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Comprehensive benefits including health insurance

* Access to advanced technology and a collaborative, innovative environment

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

### **About the Role**

Monks is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Writer / Editor to join a regional creative team producing rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Working in close partnership with client stakeholders and a distributed global team, this role will refine complex technical material into clear, engaging content for consumer-facing audiences who are already comfortable with technology. All editorial and creative deliverables will be produced in English for global audiences.

This role is primarily focused on editing and adapting approved source content rather than writing technical narratives from scratch. The ideal candidate can improve clarity, structure and tone without diluting technical meaning, introducing inaccuracies or oversimplifying the subject matter.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.

### **In This Role, You Will**

* Edit and refine technical editorial and marketing content for clarity, accuracy, flow and audience relevance.
* Preserve essential technical meaning while making complex information accessible and engaging.
* Adapt approved source copy across web, social, video, presentation and other digital formats.
* Create copy variants based on platform requirements, audience needs, character limits and established messaging.
* Develop and refine headlines, subheads, summaries, captions, calls to action and on-screen copy.
* Apply approved copy within design layouts, working closely with designers to balance meaning, hierarchy and available space.
* Partner with subject matter experts to clarify technical details and resolve gaps or inconsistencies.
* Work with producers to track copy status, approvals, source material and open questions.
* Consolidate editorial feedback and recommend resolutions when comments are subjective, conflicting or unclear.
* Maintain established terminology, naming conventions, voice and editorial standards.
* Conduct thorough copy QA across spelling, grammar, punctuation, factual consistency, links, versioning and platform specifications.
* Document approved language, recurring feedback and editorial decisions for future use.
* Support clear, documented handoffs when work continues across regions or shifts.
* Use approved AI and editorial tools to support research, comparison, versioning and efficiency while maintaining human editorial judgment.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

### **Experience You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical editing, technical writing, technology journalism, digital publishing or editorial marketing.
* Demonstrated ability to edit complex technology content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Experience writing for technically fluent consumer, professional or business audiences.
* Strong understanding of digital editorial structure, information hierarchy and platform-specific copy requirements.
* Experience adapting a single source narrative into multiple formats and copy variants.
* Exceptional command of written English, including grammar, syntax, tone and editorial style, is required. All copy will be developed and edited in English.
* Strong proofreading, fact-checking and self-QA skills.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage rapid turnarounds and make sound editorial decisions amid ambiguity.
* Confidence collaborating with technical experts, designers, motion artists, producers and senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with collaborative design tools such as Figma is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across regions, time zones and shift-based teams.
* Ability to work an assigned nontraditional shift and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.

### **Working Model**

This is a hybrid, shift-based role supporting a global production model. Working hours will vary by assigned shift and may include early mornings, evenings, overnight coverage or other nontraditional schedules. Participation in a planned weekend and holiday rotation will also be required. Schedules will be established in advance, with some flexibility needed around urgent priorities and cross-regional handoffs.

description:
**Company:**

Zynith Labs

**Experience:**

2 - 4 Years

**Location:**

Chennai (Ekattuthangal)

**Employment Type:**

Full-time | On-site

**About Zynith Lab**

Zynith Labs is a design partner working at the intersection of creativity, strategy and technology. We partner with businesses to shape digital experiences, build brands and create solutions that make a difference.

**The Role**

Good copy does more than fill a page. It gives a brand its voice, makes complex ideas easy to understand and gives people a reason to pay attention.

That's what we're looking for at Zynith Labs.

We're looking for a Copywriter who knows how to find the right words, whether it's a website that needs to make a strong first impression, an ad that needs to earn a click, or a brand that needs a voice of its own.

You'll work across brands, industries and digital touchpoints, turning briefs into ideas and ideas into words that connect with the right audience. We value someone who can think beyond writing, understand why a message matters and know how to make every word count.

**What You'll be Working on**

* Writing website content, landing pages and service pages that communicate value without sounding like everyone else.
* Crafting ad copies, campaign headlines and creative messaging that capture attention and drive action.
* Developing brand narratives, positioning statements, taglines and communication frameworks.
* Writing LinkedIn posts, social media captions and content that gives brands a distinct personality.
* Creating email campaigns, newsletters and marketing communication that people actually want to read.
* Working closely with designers and marketing teams to bring creative concepts to life through words.
* Researching brands, industries, audiences and competitors before putting pen to paper.
* Reworking, refining and challenging copy until it says exactly what it needs to say.
* Applying SEO principles naturally, without compromising the quality of the writing.

**What Makes you a Good Fit**

* 2 - 4 years of experience in copywriting, preferably in a creative agency, digital agency or B2B environment.
* You have a strong command of English and know the difference between writing correctly and writing well.
* You can switch between brand storytelling, advertising copy and conversion-focused writing without losing your voice.
* You understand how brands communicate and what makes an audience pay attention.
* You know how to turn a complicated product or service into a message people can understand and relate to.
* You are comfortable working with creative teams, taking feedback and improving your work.
* You research before you write and pay attention to the details others might overlook.
* You have a portfolio that demonstrates your writing ability across different formats and industries.

**Why Zynith Labs ?**

* Work with brands across different industries and creative disciplines.
* Be part of a team where ideas are encouraged and good work is recognised.
* Collaborate closely with the founder, leadership and creative teams.
* Take ownership of your work and see your ideas move from brief to execution.
* Grow with an organisation that believes in growing its people along the way.

**We aren't looking for someone who simply knows how to write. We're looking for someone who knows what to say, how to say it and when to leave a word out.**

If that's you, we'd like to see your work.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

* Create and maintain reusable assets including:

* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  

  

**Technology Ecosystem**

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  
  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  
  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  

  

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

  
  

Deep understanding of:

  

  
* Agentic AI and autonomous systems
  
  
* Intelligent process automation
  
  
* Enterprise integration patterns
  
  
* Human-in-the-loop workflow design
  
  
* AI governance and Responsible AI principles
  
  
* Enterprise architecture frameworks
  
  
* Business process analysis and optimization
  
  
* Risk management, compliance, and security requirements
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

  

  
* Strategic thinking and problem solving
  
  
* Exceptional stakeholder management
  
  
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
  
  
* Executive presence and influence
  
  
* Decision-making under ambiguity
  
  
* Collaboration across global and cross-functional teams
  
  
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by:

**Pearson is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where innovation thrives and every employee can contribute to shaping the future of learning through AI and technology.**

description:

*Location: (On-site) Hyderabad, India*

Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.

* Hands-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.

If your experience falls slightly outside this range but your work makes the case, apply anyway.
