Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Specialist or higher level experience in NIO and technical systems analysis.
* An excellent communicator who can organize complex technical information and work effectively across engineering, product, operations, and dependent application teams.
* A highly technical analyst who can use AI to understand systems at a high level, while recognizing that this is not an engineering role and does not require producing production-ready code.
* Hands-on experience using version control such as Git to pull code and analyze systems directly.
* Experience writing clear, actionable technical requirements, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and analysis artifacts.
* Ability to identify, review, and correct ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting technical requirements.
* Some hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot Agent Mode, Cursor, or similar agentic AI technologies.
* Interest in using Glean, GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio, and GitHub Copilot CLI to research, generate, validate, and organize technical requirements.
* Ability to learn application operations, including password and certificate updates, while partnering with engineers for execution and review.
* Ability to analyze data mappings and dependencies across Java Spring Boot Microservices, Guidewire PolicyCenter, Informatica, IBM ACE, and IBM ODM.

**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
  
  
As a Technology Analyst you will partner with the business to understand business needs and outcomes as well as provide all types of analysis skills related to understanding and meeting business outcomes.  You will translate business outcomes into solution requirements using techniques such as facilitation and visual management.  A Technology Analyst should have broad technology and analysis experience including facilitation with large stakeholder groups, managing the complete requirements lifecycle, conducting structured analysis using both quantitative and qualitative techniques, analyzing data and application suites, and problem-solving using a collaborative style.  Technology Analysts are engaged in work efforts at all scales ranging from minor defect fixes and enhancements to development of new applications.  You will also work on all types of solution approaches (e.g., custom development, package implementation) and domains (e.g., all application types, data warehouses, Web, and Cloud).
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partners with the business and other technology professionals to understand business needs and outcomes.
* Translates business outcomes into solution requirements.
* Applies secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Executes requirements and ensures business alignment using facilitation and visual management techniques.
* Documents and clarifies work products requirements.
* Provides basic to mid-level analysis skills related to understanding and meeting business outcomes.
* Works with others to verify, trace and manage functional and non-functional requirements.
* Possess the technical skill to understand the applications used to support the business in a specific Business Solution Area(s) (BSA).
* Conducts quality improvements by providing analysis of relevant data.
* Additional responsibilities may include collaboration across teams and adherence to company standards.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or a related field is preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Three years of relevant work experience including software delivery or educational experience within a technology domain. Experience with delivering Technology and/or business solutions across industries, platforms, and/or lines of business (LOB) within the insurance and/or financial services industries. Demonstrated capability in managing the requirements lifecycle, including facilitation, elicitation, and documenting requirements.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Business Requirements
* Data Analysis
* Development Testing
* Problem Solving
* Requirements Gathering
* Systems Thinking
* Technical Acumen

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Effective communication and collaboration skills
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Time management and prioritization
* Ability to influence, negotiate and set priorities needed. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.

**Additional Information**
**Reporting Structure:**
Reports to Technology Leader – India
  
  
**Working Hours**
Aligned to India business hours with flexibility for global collaboration.
  
  
**Location Flexibility:**
[Hybrid/Remote/In-office] with periodic in-office collaboration.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Nationwide is committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, disability, religion, or other protected categories.

title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Learn More About Our Benefits Here.**
Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
**About SmartWinnr**

 

SmartWinnr is an enterprise-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.

**Job Role:**

Pre-Sales Solutions Architect

**Job Location:**

Hyderabad (On-site)

**About the role**

SmartWinnr is looking for a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between customer business requirements and our product capabilities. This role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, along with strong expertise in sales documentation and proposal development.

You will work closely with the sales team to demonstrate SmartWinnr's platform to prospective customers, including senior leadership, understand their requirements, and prepare compelling proposals, commercial documents, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

The role also involves coordinating the review of customer agreements, setting up demo accounts, and creating customized presentations and other sales materials based on business discussions. We are looking for someone who can communicate confidently with enterprise customers, manage documentation accurately, and support the sales team throughout the sales cycle.

**What you will own**

* **Product demonstrations and presentations.**

  Deliver engaging product demos to prospective customers, including senior leadership. Understand customer requirements and tailor demonstrations to relevant business use cases and expected outcomes.

* **Demo account setup.**

  Set up, configure, and maintain demo accounts and environments before customer meetings. Ensure the product is ready for demonstrations and aligned with the prospect's requirements

* **Proposal documentation.**

  Prepare professional proposals, solution documents, presentations, commercial proposals, and other sales-related documentation based on customer discussions and business requirements.

* **RFP/RFQ responses.**

  Review Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and customer questionnaires. Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information and ensure complete, high-quality submissions within deadlines.

* **MSA/NDA vetting and coordination.**

  Review customer Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) for completeness, identify non-standard clauses or deviations, and coordinate with the Legal team and relevant stakeholders for review and approval.

* **Commercial documentation.**

  Prepare quotations, pricing summaries, commercial proposals, and supporting documents in coordination with the sales and finance teams. Ensure accuracy and alignment with approved commercial terms.

* **Sales decks and supporting materials.**

  Create and customize presentation decks, solution overviews, and other sales collateral based on business discussions, prospect requirements, and sales opportunities.

﻿

* **Cross-functional collaboration.**

  Work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to gather information, validate product capabilities, address customer queries, and support deal progression.

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, sales support, or a similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to enterprise customers and senior leadership.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain product features, use cases, and business value clearly.
* Experience preparing proposals, presentations, commercial documents, and other customer-facing sales materials.
* Ability to understand business discussions and translate customer requirements into structured documentation and compelling presentations.
* Strong attention to detail when preparing and reviewing documents.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other tools used for sales documentation.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate documentation within tight deadlines.
* A proactive, organized, and ownership-driven approach to work.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, or enterprise SaaS sales.
* Experience conducting software product demonstrations for enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with RFP/RFQ processes, commercial proposals, and enterprise procurement requirements.
* Exposure to MSA/NDA review and contract coordination.
* Experience with CRM platforms, proposal management tools, and document collaboration systems.
* Understanding of SaaS business models and enterprise sales cycles.

**What this role is not**

This is not purely a product demonstration or presentation role. It requires equal attention to sales documentation, commercial proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, and coordination of customer agreements.

The person will be expected to contribute hands-on to preparing documents, setting up demo accounts, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting the sales team in moving opportunities forward.

**Things worth knowing before you apply**

You will work closely with the sales team and engage with prospective enterprise customers. Strong communication, presentation skills, documentation accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple sales-related activities are essential to succeeding in this role.

The position is based in Hyderabad and requires working on-site.

title: Presales And Application Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Edifice Medical Technologies is a solutions provider specializing in equipment and technology for hospital infrastructure, operating rooms, and surgical environments. The company offers integrated operating rooms, nurse call communication systems, pneumatic tube systems, modular OTs, tracking solutions, and hospital furniture from leading global and regional brands. Its portfolio also includes advanced surgical devices such as OT lights, OT tables, pendant systems, and bipolar coagulators for neurosurgery, sourced from manufacturers across Europe and Asia. Edifice Medical Technologies further supports sterile processing departments with high-performance pulsed IR sterilizers. Candidates joining the organization can expect to work with cutting-edge medical technologies that improve clinical workflows and patient care.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time on-site role for a Presales and Application Engineer based in Mumbai. The role involves engaging with prospective and existing hospital clients to understand their clinical and infrastructure requirements, preparing technical proposals, and delivering product demonstrations for operating room, surgical, and sterilization solutions. The Presales and Application Engineer collaborates with the sales team to design solution configurations, support tenders, and provide technical clarifications during the sales cycle. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating for Demonstration of Equipment, presales planning and designing, installation requirements with engineering teams, conducting functional testing of equipment, training users on product operation, and offering application support to ensure optimal performance. The role also includes documenting customer feedback, assisting with product evaluations, and contributing to continuous improvement of solutions and presales materials.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Technical Support skills, including troubleshooting, customer interaction, and after-sales application support.
* Candidates should possess Electrical / Mechanical Engineering skills for understanding and supporting electrical systems and interfaces in hospital equipment.
* Candidate should have working on Autocad drawing.
* Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to clinical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work on-site in hospital environments, manage multiple projects, and collaborate effectively with sales and engineering teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Biomedical, Mechanical, or related field) or an equivalent technical qualification.
* Experience in medical devices, hospital infrastructure, or healthcare technology is an advantage.

title: Digital Learning Associate - Gyanodaya - Navi Mumbai - 1-3 yrs
description:

**Payroll type-**
Third Party Payroll- Work from office- 5 days a week

**Position**
- Digital Learning Associate – Gyanodaya

**Basic Profile of the Position**

Support the Gyanodaya team in designing, developing, coordinating and executing digital learning initiatives and learning solutions for ABG businesses and employees.

The role will involve working closely with Program Directors, Learning Partners, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to ensure effective delivery of digital learning programs and a high-quality learner experience.

1. Digital Learning Coordination

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, Learning Partners and external vendors for digital learning programs.
* Support end-to-end execution of digital learning initiatives, including planning, content readiness, learner communication, launch and post-program activities.

* Support development/review of e-learning modules, digital learning assets, videos, presentations, assessments, quizzes and other learning resources.

* Monitor learner participation, completion and engagement and highlight gaps to the relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate resolution of learner/platform-related issues with internal teams and technology/service partners.
* Continuously look for ways to improve the digital learner experience.

4. Learning Analytics & Reporting

* Prepare regular MIS and dashboards related to digital learning programs.
* Analyse learner data and feedback to identify trends and areas for improvement.

  .

title: Senior Content Writer - Product Marketing
description:
**About Imarticus Learning**

Imarticus Learning is a professional education company dedicated to bridging skill gaps through industry-relevant education, specialised training, career assistance and mentorship. Its programmes help learners build careers across finance, data science, analytics, technology, marketing and management.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Content Writer who combines excellent writing with creative thinking, research depth and a strong understanding of marketing.

You will translate product strengths, customer insights and business objectives into compelling ideas, messaging and content across the customer journey. Your work will cover performance advertising, campaigns, websites, landing pages, brochures, nurture journeys, SEO and other relevant marketing touchpoints.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role working closely with the Product Marketing Manager. You will take ownership from research and ideation to writing, creative briefing, collaboration and timely delivery. We value someone who brings energy and curiosity, confidently recommends ideas, solves problems and moves work forward proactively.

The scope will evolve with business needs, offering opportunities to contribute to brand development, product launches, customer research and broader product marketing initiatives. Flexibility across products, audiences, formats and priorities is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Research and understand**

  : Study products, customers, competitors and market trends to identify audience needs, objections, differentiators and credible proof points.
* **Develop positioning and messaging**

  : Turn product features and insights into clear value propositions, benefit-led narratives and compelling reasons to act.
* **Ideate campaigns**

  : Propose original concepts, hooks, creative angles and storytelling approaches aligned with campaign objectives.
* **Copywriting across the funnel**

  : Develop TOF, MOF and BOF content that builds awareness, supports consideration, nurtures interest and drives conversion.
* **Create performance advertising content**

  : Write static ad copy, video and motion graphics scripts, including headlines, voiceovers, on-screen text, visual cues and CTAs.
* **Own marketing content**

  : Develop website and landing page copy, brochures, presentations, sales collateral, articles and other content required for campaigns and launches.
* **Build nurture journeys**

  : Plan and write WhatsApp and email drip campaigns for lead nurturing, remarketing, events, launches and conversion.
* **Deliver SEO content**

  : Conduct keyword and search-intent research, develop content briefs, and write or refresh articles and website content using sound on-page SEO practices.
* **Brief and collaborate**

  : Create actionable briefs and work with designers, video editors and content creators to bring copy, visuals and storytelling together.
* **Drive timely execution**

  : Coordinate inputs, feedback and revisions; review creative outputs and take responsibility for the quality and timely completion of assigned deliverables.
* **Learn and improve**

  : Use campaign performance, customer feedback and testing insights to refine messaging and recommend new approaches.
* **Contribute beyond individual assets**

  : Support brand voice, messaging frameworks, product launches and wider marketing initiatives, adapting to new channels, formats and business priorities.

**Requirements**

* 5–6+ years of relevant experience in content writing, copywriting or integrated marketing communication; agency experience strongly preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating research, campaign thinking, persuasive writing and ownership from concept to execution.
* Excellent command of English, with the ability to write sharp advertising copy and clear, well-researched long-form content.
* Strong understanding of advertising, branding, product positioning, customer behaviour and full-funnel marketing.
* Experience adapting messaging across B2C, D2C and B2B contexts and different stages of the buying journey.
* Familiarity with performance creative formats across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Hands-on expertise in SEO research and writing, including keywords, search intent, content structure and on-page optimisation.
* Strong research and fact-checking skills, with the ability to understand unfamiliar products and simplify complex information.
* Confidence in presenting ideas, explaining recommendations, asking questions and giving constructive creative feedback.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple briefs, respond to feedback and adapt to changing priorities.
* A proactive working style: identify gaps, suggest solutions, take initiative and follow through with minimal supervision.
* Working knowledge of current AI, research, SEO and content tools, supported by strong editorial judgement and a willingness to learn.
* Interest in developing broader capabilities in brand and product marketing.
* Experience in edtech and with international clients, audiences or markets is a plus.

**Must Share:**

* Updated resume.
* A portfolio showing a range of relevant content and creative work.
* Two campaign examples outlining the objective, audience insight, your idea, your contribution to execution and results where available.

Northern Trust is looking for an Associate to join its Technology Development Center in Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

Job Description: Technical SAP Signavio Architect/Techno-Functional ConsultantPosition OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled SAP Signavio Tecno-Functional Consultant with extensive hands-on technical capabilities to lead end-to-end business process transformation, optimization, and process mining initiatives. Unlike traditional functional roles, this position demands a deep understanding of data architectures, systems integration, and hands-on technical development.The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business operations and technical data engineering, actively building data pipelines, profiling source data, setting up complex system integrations via SAP BTP, and writing advanced queries to power operational dashboards and process intelligence metrics.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities
* 1. Module-Specific Functional Management
* SAP Signavio Process Manager: Establish and enforce workspace modeling conventions, govern the central corporate Dictionary for reusable business terms/objects, and model end-to-end process hierarchies using BPMN 2.0 and DMN (Decision Model and Notation). Conduct process simulations and perform structured "As-Is" vs. "To-Be" diagram comparisons to evaluate impact.
* SAP Signavio Process Insights: Configure rapid connections to core SAP ERP/S/4HANA instances to gain immediate, automated visibility into business processes. Analyze standard out-of-the-box performance indicators (such as automation rates, backlogs, and throughput), interpret industry benchmarking data, and execute standard correction or innovation recommendations.
* SAP Signavio Process Intelligence: Lead advanced process mining discovery initiatives across multi-system environments. Execute detailed conformance checks to analyze actual execution against standard target models, and identify process execution leakage including compliance violations, unwanted loops, and manual workarounds.
* 2. Process Mining & Data Profiling (Technical Hands-on)
* Perform exhaustive data profiling and structural data analysis across SAP and non-SAP source environments to validate data quality and completeness before process ingestion.
* Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for SAP Signavio Process Intelligence, mapping transactional data to event logs (Case ID, Activity, Timestamp).
* Identify data anomalies, concurrency issues, and gaps in transactional logs, implementing robust transformations to resolve them.
* 3. Integration & SAP BTP Engineering
* Configure, establish, and optimize secure data connections between SAP Signavio and various backend applications (including third-party ERPs, CRMs, legacy databases, and cloud services).
* Leverage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for enterprise integration, data orchestration, data federation, and custom extension developments.
* Implement API-based integrations and utilize JDBC/ODBC connectors, secure file transfers, and cloud ingestion agents to capture real-time or batch transactional records.
* 4. Query Development & Analytics
* Write, debug, and optimize complex queries using SIGNAL (Signavio Process Mining Query Language) and standard SQL to extract process insights and calculate critical KPIs.
* Develop advanced process dashboards, custom metrics, and automated alerts within SAP Signavio Process Intelligence to expose process bottlenecks, variations, and compliance violations.
* Build predictive metrics and custom logic to track process behavior and trigger operational actions based on data patterns.
* 5. Process Modeling & Functional Analysis
* Lead collaborative process discovery workshops with business stakeholders to model "As-Is" and "To-Be" business processes using BPMN 2.0 standards within SAP Signavio Process Manager.
* Translate analytical findings from process mining into actionable business optimization strategies, collaborating with functional process owners.
* Align custom developments with standard SAP Best Practices and Signavio Value Accelerators to accelerate digital transformation milestones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA migrations).



**Qualifications**

* Required Technical & Functional QualificationsExperience: Minimum of 5 to 10 years of professional experience in Business Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining, with at least 5 years of direct, hands-on technical implementation experience using the SAP Signavio Suite.

**Required Skills**

* Functional Competencies:
* Extensive knowledge of Process Manager, including business architecture design, simulation setups, and DMN decision tables.
* Deep proficiency in Process Insights, including setting up automated data extractions, analyzing standard process flows, tracking master data categories, and navigating the Variant Explorer.
* Masterful command of Process Intelligence functional configurations, identifying root causes, managing metrics, and aligning data-driven findings with stakeholders.
* Signavio Toolset Mastery: Proven expertise across SAP Signavio Process Intelligence (specifically the ETL layer), Process Manager, and Collaboration Hub.
* Database & Query Skills: Exceptional proficiency in writing complex queries in standard SQL and SIGNAL. Deep understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), data warehousing concepts, and schema design.
* SAP BTP & Middleware: Practical, hands-on experience using SAP BTP for data integration, orchestration, or application deployment. Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration) is highly advantageous.
* Third-Party Integrations: Demonstrated track record connecting Signavio to non-SAP systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, or custom legacy databases) via REST/SOAP APIs and standard database connectors.
* Data Engineering: Experience in ETL/ELT development, data profiling tools, data cleansing methodology, and transforming raw transactional tables into event logs.



**Preferred Skills**

* Preferred Professional QualificationsPreferred - Official certification in SAP SignavioPrior functional experience in core enterprise process cycles such as Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Record-to-Report (R2R).Experience assisting organizations through large-scale migrations from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA using process mining insights.
* Core Soft SkillsStrong analytical and problem-solving mindset capable of drilling down into low-level data anomalies while maintaining a high-level operational perspective.Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical data structures into clear business insights for executive stakeholders.Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments with cross-functional global teams.

title: DFM / Project Engineer
description:
**DFM / Project Engineer – C2W Group (Pune, India)**

C2W is a one-stop solution provider for supply chain management, manufacturing, quality control, and product development requirements in China and SE Asia.

We are currently seeking an experienced DFM / Project Engineer to join our Pune team. This is a full-time (40 hours/week), onsite position for candidates with a proven background in DFM, SolidWorks, and manufacturing.

**Before applying, read this posting in full.**
This role requires attending an
**in-person interview and a hands-on DFM test at our Pune office (approx 60-75 mins),**
there is no remote or take-home option. If you are not willing and able to do this, please do not apply. You will only waste your time and ours.

Please note:

* This is an in-person role based in Pune, India.
* No relocation assistance is provided. You must already be based in Pune. Applications from other cities will not be considered.
* No remote, no hybrid, no students. We don’t have work-from-home policies.
* Only experienced professionals will be considered.
* This is an urgent hire. We are prioritizing candidates who can join immediately or within 30 days or less.
* Candidates with a notice period of more than 30 days will not be considered. If you cannot start within 30 days, do not apply; no exceptions will be made. Do not waste our time.
* Our selection process is fully in person: a face-to-face interview and a hands-on DFM test completed on-site at our Pune office. There is no remote or take-home test — you must be able and willing to attend in person.
* Do not send connection requests or direct messages on LinkedIn. We will reach out to candidates who are a fit; unsolicited messages will be ignored.
* A work portfolio is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Include examples of DFM analyses, SolidWorks models, technical drawings, or relevant engineering work you have completed

**Position Summary**

You will be responsible for managing the transition of products from design to mass production, ensuring designs are optimized for manufacturability across a wide variety of processes including injection molding, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, and assembly.

You will work closely with our industrial design and engineering teams across India, China, and Southeast Asia, and occasionally support communication with international clients and vendors.

**Selection Process**

* Shortlisted candidates will be invited to our Pune office for a face-to-face interview.
* As part of the process, you will complete a practical DFM test on-site at our office, reviewing drawings, recommending manufacturability improvements, and presenting your findings. The test is done in person; there is no take-home or remote option.
* Please be prepared to attend in person and demonstrate your skills live. Candidates unwilling or unable to come on-site will not be progressed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform detailed DFM analysis and recommend improvements for manufacturability, cost-efficiency, and scalability.
* Create and revise 3D CAD models and 2D drawings using SolidWorks, with appropriate use of GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Generate production-ready technical documentation (BOMs, engineering drawings, assembly specs, etc.).
* Coordinate with internal teams and external suppliers for prototyping, tooling, and production execution.
* Evaluate supplier feedback on design feasibility, tooling challenges, and cost breakdowns.
* Support factory interactions including calls, visits, and documentation updates as needed.
* Maintain clear revision history and version control across all technical documentation.
* Monitor project timelines and proactively flag risks, misalignments, or bottlenecks.
* Assist quality control and production teams with testing plans and failure analysis.
* Remain open and available for international travel across our offices, this is not guaranteed but may be requested.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on, post-graduation proven experience in product engineering, manufacturing, or DFM-focused roles.
* Expert-level proficiency in SolidWorks (modeling, drafting, assemblies, GD&T).
* Proven knowledge of DFM principles for various processes: injection molding, CNC, die casting, sheet metal, and assembly.
* Experience preparing detailed production documentation and working with manufacturers or suppliers.
* Strong mechanical fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, fluent English required both written and spoken.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with secondary CAD/visualization tools (e.g., Fusion 360, KeyShot, AutoCAD).
* Experience working with international clients or cross-functional remote teams.
* Knowledge of product compliance and testing standards (ROHS, CE, etc.).
* Exposure to ERP/project tracking tools.

**Important Application Notice**

We value genuine, thoughtful applications. Submissions generated by AI tools will be detected and rejected. We are looking for real humans with real experience, not generic buzzword filled CVs.

You’d be surprised how often this happens, please don’t waste your time or ours.

title: Sr. Analyst - GTM Process Improvement
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**About The Role**
Qualys is seeking a highly motivated
**GTM Process Improvement Senior Analyst**
to help scale and optimize our go-to-market (GTM) operations. This role will partner across Sales, Marketing, IT BizApps and others to identify tool & process inefficiencies, improve data quality, streamline workflows, and enable more effective revenue generation. The ideal candidate combines analytical problem-solving, systems thinking, and hands-on experience with modern GTM technologies to drive operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze GTM processes to identify root causes of workflow inefficiencies, data quality issues, and operational bottlenecks.

title: EHS and Quality Systems Executive
description:
**About the Organisation**
: Karo Sambhav is a leading sustainability and circular economy organization focused on enabling responsible waste management and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance across India. The company works with producers, recyclers, government bodies, and consumers to build transparent, technology-driven systems for the collection, recycling, and recovery of electronic waste, plastic waste, batteries, and other regulated materials. With a strong focus on environmental impact, compliance, and scalable sustainability solutions, Karo Sambhav helps organizations meet regulatory obligations while driving long-term circular economy initiatives.

**About the Role**
: The Quality Systems & EHS Executive will lead the Quality Management System (QMS) and certification programs for a high‑volume recycling/ITAD facility in North India. This role ensures compliance with
**ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3, e‑Stewards, EPR requirements,**
and customer‑specific quality protocols, while driving continuous improvement across operations.

The position requires strong experience in quality systems, audits, documentation, and regulatory compliance, with the ability to work in fast‑paced recycling environments involving e‑waste, metals, plastics, and IT asset disposition.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Quality Systems & Certification Leadership**

* Build, implement, and maintain a robust QMS aligned with ISO 9001 and recycling‑sector standards.
* Lead certification and surveillance audits for
  **ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3,**
  e‑Stewards, and brand‑mandated audits.
* Own document control: SOPs, WI, formats, change management, training records, and version control.
* Conduct internal audits, supplier audits, and process audits; maintain audit calendars and closure reports.
* Drive CAPA, RCA, FMEA, and PDCA across all departments.
* Ensure material traceability, chain‑of‑custody, downstream vendor compliance, and data integrity for recycling and ITAD workflows.
* Prepare and maintain customer‑facing quality documentation, including compliance reports, certificates, and audit evidence.
* Lead customer audits, brand audits, and OEM compliance reviews.

**2. Regulatory & Compliance Management**

* Ensure compliance with E‑Waste Management Rules, Hazardous Waste Rules, EPR obligations, and SPCB/CPCB requirements.
* Maintain risk registers, compliance matrices, and legal registers relevant to North India regulatory expectations.
* Coordinate with SPCB/CPCB, auditors, and brand compliance teams for inspections and submissions.
* Ensure proper documentation for manifest tracking, waste storage, disposal, and vendor approvals.

**3. Operational Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Implement in‑process quality checks, sampling plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards for dismantling, segregation, shredding, and ITAD workflows.
* Collaborate with operations to ensure process standardization, error‑proofing, and adherence to SOPs.
* Use data analytics to track NCR trends, defect rates, process deviations, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead training programs for QMS, audit readiness, documentation discipline, and compliance culture.
* Support digitalization of quality workflows (checklists, dashboards, NCR systems).

**4. EHS Support**

* Support implementation of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 within the integrated management system.
* Assist in risk assessments, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, and contractor safety.
* Ensure alignment between quality, environmental, and safety documentation.
* Support waste handling, storage, and disposal compliance as per SPCB norms.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **Mandatory:**
  Hands‑on experience with
  **ISO 9001**
  and at least one of:
  **ISO 14001, ISO 45001, R2v3, e‑Stewards, IATF 16949**
  .
* 5–7 years of experience in quality systems, audits, and compliance in recycling, e‑waste, ITAD, electronics, automotive, or manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of Indian regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with audit management, documentation systems, and QMS software preferred.
* Quality Systems- ISO 9001, internal audits, CAPA, RCA, FMEA, PDCA.
* Soft Skills - Documentation discipline, stakeholder management, training, cross‑functional collaboration.
* Compliance - EPR, e‑waste rules, hazardous waste rules, SPCB/CPCB norms.
* Technical - SOP writing, sampling plans, inspection methods, traceability.
* Certifications - R2v3, e‑Stewards, ISO 14001/45001, OEM/brand audits.

title: Senior Consultant - Endur Functional
description:
**Senior Consultant – Endur Functional**

 

**Location:
India**

**Permanent/ Full Time**

**Why capSpire?**

 

capSpire is a fast-growing consulting and solutions company with a global footprint with eight offices in the world’s leading markets. We pride ourselves in being truly entrepreneurial, innovative, and collaborative, with a strong problem-solving ethos. We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.

* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

Growth Valley Community (GVC) is an entrepreneurial education platform empowering ambitious teens through hands-on AI projects, international mentorship, and leadership skill-building. Our mentors include alumni from Harvard, MIT, Columbia, and IIT who guide students in real-world startup challenges. We’re on a mission to shape a new generation of global innovators.

**Role Overview**

**The internship.**

You work directly with the founder and the Founder's Office as an apprentice operator. Not a coffee-and-decks internship. You will run real pieces of live systems, own small mandates end to end, and sit in rooms interns rarely enter: pipeline reviews, launch planning, hiring conversations. The trade is simple: we give you real responsibility from week one, and you deliver like it matters, because it does.

**What you will actually do. Live work, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment operations.**
  Keep our sales pipeline clean and moving: every family tracked, every follow-up on time, nothing living in anyone's head. Support the referral programme into our 200+ existing families.
* **Admissions system.**
  Help run our admission journey day to day: application queues, status updates, WhatsApp and email flows on our Airtable backbone, SLA tracking.
* **AI Founder Programme launch.**
  Support Cohort 1 end to end: Founders Session event operations, application funnel, squad logistics.
* **Reporting.**
  Maintain the numbers the founder runs the company on: weekly dashboards, ship-logs, progress tracking across teams.
* **Partnerships research.**
  Build target lists of schools and institutions, prepare outreach, track every relationship in company systems.

**How we measure you, and what earns conversion.**

Your internship is pass or fail on outcomes, not attendance. In your first 30 days you will own one system completely. By day 90 you will have shipped work that would not exist without you. Conversion to a full-time Founder's Office role is decided on exactly that evidence, reviewed between month 3 and month 6. We will write your targets down with you in week one, so there is never ambiguity about where you stand.

**Who fits.**

* Final-year students on a full-time break, recent graduates, or gap-year builders. Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent) or proof of initiative strong enough that pedigree is irrelevant.
* Proactive by default. You take a task from half a sentence and come back with it done.
* Organised and detail-obsessed. Multiple priorities do not rattle you.
* Comfortable with research, data, tools and fast learning. Interest in entrepreneurship, EdTech or AI is a plus.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. No version of this company survives cut corners.
* Legally eligible to work in India.

**Benefits & Details**

•
**Duration:**
2–6 months (flexible based on mutual agreement)

•
**Stipend/Compensation:**
Depending on hours and qualifications (details to be discussed during the interview)

•
**Experience:**
Mentorship from GVC’s founders and leadership, exposure to real startup challenges, and potential for involvement in future roles or full-time opportunities

•
**Work Environment:**
A supportive team focused on innovation and global educational impact and exponential personal growth.

**How to Apply**

If you’re excited by the idea of guiding a fast-growing startup from the inside, please submit your application (resume plus a brief note on why you’re drawn to GVC) to sam
**@growthvalleycommunity.com**
. Use the subject line “Founders’ Office Intern – [Your Name].”

We look forward to hearing from you and possibly welcoming you into Growth Valley Community—together, let’s redefine entrepreneurial learning for teens worldwide.

**Growth Valley Community (GVC)**
is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all applicants. We do not discriminate based on age, gender, gender identity, religion, ethnicity, race, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation. If you require accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product
description:
Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product

Ananant Systems | Noida | Full-time | Regular travel within India | Reports to the CEO

Ananant is hiring a Founders' Office Associate to own government programmes, partnerships, product input, contracts and marketing, working directly with the CEO and CTO.

ABOUT ANANANT

Ananant Systems is an Indian deep-tech semiconductor company. We design chips for small-cell 4G/5G and camera applications, with teams in Bengaluru, Noida and San Diego. We are backed by venture capital and by national semiconductor programmes, and we are growing several-fold over the next 18 months.

THE ROLE

Outside engineering, Ananant depends on three things: the government programmes it wins, the customers and partners who adopt its chips, and its standing in the market. This role owns all three.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO. You represent Ananant to government, partners and customers, and bring what you learn from them back into the company.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Government programmes. Identify, apply for and deliver government semiconductor and R&D programmes: applications, milestones, reporting and compliance, and the working relationship with the ministries and agencies involved.

• Partnerships and lead customers. Build and manage the pipeline of strategic partners and lead customers, and track every commitment made to them.

• Product and market. Bring customer requirements, market information and competitive analysis into product decisions, and build the business case for new opportunities.

• Contracts. Manage customer, partner, vendor and government agreements through review, approval and signature, working with our law firm. Maintain the contract register, renewals and obligations.

• Marketing. Own positioning, collateral, the website and our presence at industry events.

WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

Expected outcomes in the first year:

• Government programmes won, with every report and milestone under them delivered on time.

• Partnerships signed and lead customers evaluating our chips.

• Customer and market input feeding product decisions on a regular basis.

• A complete and current contract register, with no missed renewals or obligations.

• Consistent positioning and collateral in use with customers, partners and government.

WHY THIS ROLE

• Scope. Government, customers, product, contracts and marketing in one role, each being set up for the first time.

• Direct access. You work with the CEO and CTO directly, on decisions that matter to the company.

• Sector exposure. You will build relationships and expertise across Indian semiconductor policy, customers and partners.

• A path to leadership. The role is expected to grow into leading a function as the company scales.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1 to 5 years of experience. Comfortable both in meetings with senior government officials and partners, and in building financial models. Clear writer, strong with numbers, and able to run work end to end with limited supervision.

You bring:

• Strong Excel modelling and a solid grasp of business financials: P&L, cash flow, budgets and unit economics.

• Working knowledge of compliance and audits.

• Clear, persuasive writing and presentation for formal audiences.

• Daily, hands-on use of AI tools.

• Ability to represent the company with senior officials, partners and customers.

It helps if you have:

• An MBA, ideally with a consulting background.

• Founder or early-stage startup experience.

• An engineering degree, or experience in semiconductors, telecom or deep tech.

• Experience with Indian government programmes, public-sector stakeholders, or commercial contracts.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short note on something you built or ran end to end, and what you would do differently. The process is a conversation with the CEO, a short work sample on a problem from the role, and a review with the founders. It takes about two weeks.

title: Specialist, Financial Operations
description:
**Transformation Analyst - Agentic Process Transformation**

  
  

*Rights & Royalties Transformation | IC20 | 3-4*
*years experience*

  
  

**Role Focus**

  
  

**Primary Platforms**

  
  

**Success Measure**

  
  

**Domain Advantage**

  
  

Agent creation, workflow automation and process transformation

  
  

Copilot Studio, Power Automate, M365 ecosystem; BI/data tools as enabling skills

  
  

Efficiency gains, cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption and controls

  
  

Rights, royalties, licensing, finance operations and publishing

  
  

**Role Summary**

  
  

We are seeking a high-impact Business Transformation Analyst to help modernise the Rights & Royalties operating model through AI-enabled agents, workflow automation, process simplification and measurable efficiency gains. This role is designed for someone who can understand operational pain points quickly, convert them into practical automation opportunities, and deliver adoption-ready solutions that improve speed, quality, control and stakeholder experience.

  
  

The ideal candidate combines structured business analysis with a maker mindset: able to map processes, define requirements, build low-code/agentic solutions, partner with technology teams, and track outcomes through clear KPIs. Hands-on data capability remains important, but the emphasis is on using data, AI and automation to transform recurring operational work, not on deep engineering or specialist BI development.

  
  

Royalties, rights, licensing, finance operations, publishing/media or revenue-share experience will be a strong advantage, particularly where it supports understanding of contracts, statements, payments, deductions, reserves, exceptions, approvals and audit sensitivity.

  
  

**Key Objectives - What Success Looks Like**

  

  
* Create practical AI agents and guided automations that reduce manual effort, improve response quality and accelerate decision-making across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Simplify and standardise recurring workflows such as exception triage, approvals, reconciliations, case routing, notifications, quality checks and reporting packs.
  
  
* Deliver measurable efficiency gains through cycle-time reduction, lower rework, improved SLA performance, better adoption and stronger process controls.
  
  
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and adoption plans.
  
  
* Enable operational leaders with concise, self-serve visibility into risks, bottlenecks, productivity, quality and customer impact.
  

  

**Core Responsibilities**

  
  

**1) Process Transformation & Business Analysis**

  

  
* Conduct rapid discovery of current-state processes, pain points, root causes, handoffs, control gaps and duplication across Rights, Royalties and related Finance Operations.
  
  
* Design future-state workflows using a transformation lens: Simplify -> Standardise -> Automate -> Augment with AI -> Scale.
  
  
* Convert business needs into crisp requirements, user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
* Prioritise opportunities based on effort, impact, control risk, adoption readiness and efficiency potential.
  
  
* Support UAT, adoption, change communication, training aids and post-launch benefit tracking.
  

  

**2) Agent Creation & AI-enabled Solutions**

  

  
* Help design, configure and improve business-facing agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  
  
* Translate operational use cases into agent capabilities such as document review support, answer retrieval, exception explanation, guided decisioning, case summarisation and next-best-action recommendations.
  
  
* Define agent knowledge sources, prompts/instructions, guardrails, escalation paths, testing scenarios, success metrics and adoption feedback loops.
  
  
* Partner with technology, governance and business stakeholders to ensure agents are controlled, explainable, secure, measurable and fit for production use.
  
  
* Identify where agents should be combined with workflows, for example where AI reasoning is needed within a structured approval, triage or notification process.
  

  

**3) Workflow Automation & Operational Enablement**

  

  
* Build or support low-code automations using Power Automate, Copilot Studio workflows and connected Microsoft 365 services.
  
  
* Automate high-volume, rule-led and repeatable activities including validations, approvals, reminders, case routing, exception logging, report refreshes and stakeholder notifications.
  
  
* Design automations with appropriate audit trails, handoffs, fallback logic, approval controls, ownership and maintainability.
  
  
* Work with operations teams to ensure automation is embedded into daily routines rather than remaining as a standalone tool.
  

  

**4) Insights, KPIs & Benefit Realisation**

  

  
* Define outcome-led KPI frameworks for automation and process transformation, focused on hours saved, cycle time, quality, SLA, adoption, controls and customer impact.
  
  
* Use dashboards and reporting tools to monitor transformation outcomes, bottlenecks, adoption and benefit delivery.
  
  
* Perform practical analysis to identify trends, anomalies and improvement opportunities related to royalty statements, adjustments, disputes, metadata, reserves, payments or case volumes.
  
  
* Prepare concise executive-ready summaries that convert analysis into business decisions and action plans.
  

  

**5) Governance, Controls & Documentation**

  

  
* Create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, decision logs, control points, KPI definitions and adoption materials.
  
  
* Ensure automation and agent assets have clear ownership, change control, traceability, testing evidence and governance alignment.
  
  
* Strengthen audit readiness through reconciliation checkpoints, exception logs, approval matrices and documented process logic.
  

  

**Typical Outcomes / KPIs You May Own**

  

  
* Automation and agent benefit realisation: hours saved, cost avoidance, productivity uplift and reduced manual touchpoints.
  
  
* Cycle-time and SLA improvement across targeted royalty, rights, finance operations or query-management workflows.
  
  
* Reduction in rework, avoidable escalations, duplicate handling, leakage risk and control exceptions.
  
  
* Agent and automation adoption: active users, usage frequency, completion rate, deflection rate, satisfaction and feedback themes.
  
  
* Quality and reliability: successful workflow runs, exception rates, data accuracy, audit trail completeness and refresh reliability.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  

  
* 3-4 years experience in a Business Analyst, Transformation Analyst, Automation Analyst, Process Analyst, Product Operations or comparable role.
  
  
* Strong process discovery and problem-solving capability, with the ability to simplify complex operational work into clear, actionable requirements.
  
  
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, preferably Power Automate and Copilot Studio, or a demonstrable ability to build low-code automations and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
* Ability to define agent or automation use cases, map workflows, document requirements, test outputs, manage feedback and support adoption.
  
  
* Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance or Legal stakeholders.
  
  
* Good analytical capability and comfort working with operational data, KPIs and dashboards. Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Looker, BigQuery or similar tools is useful, but not the primary focus of the role.
  
  
* Excellent communication skills: concise documentation, clear visuals, executive-ready summaries and practical training materials.
  
  
* Outcome ownership and delivery pace: able to move from discovery to MVP to adoption with discipline and urgency.
  

  

**Preferred / Advantageous**

  

  
* Exposure to royalties, rights, licensing, publishing/media, revenue-share, finance operations or contract-driven processes.
  
  
* Understanding of the royalty lifecycle: contract terms, rate structures, deductions, reserves, statements, payments, recoupment, audit queries and dispute handling.
  
  
* Experience with ServiceNow, SharePoint, Teams, Excel-based operations, document repositories or workflow-heavy operational environments.
  
  
* Familiarity with process mapping tools such as Blueworks, Visio or Lucidchart; Lean, continuous improvement or process re-engineering methods.
  
  
* Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, access control, knowledge-source hygiene and governance considerations for enterprise agents.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Business, Operations, IT, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  
  
* Postgraduate qualification such as MBA, PG Diploma in Business Analytics, Operations, Finance or Transformation is a differentiator, not mandatory.
  
  
* Relevant certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, automation, business analysis, Lean/process improvement, data analytics or BI are advantageous.
  

  

**Behavioural**
**Competencies - Non-negotiable for Transformation**

  

  
* Agentic mindset: thinks beyond reporting and looks for ways to remove, automate or augment work.
  
  
* Adaptability, speed and agility:moves quickly from ambiguity to working MVPs and iterates based on feedback.
  
  
* Outcome ownership: focuses on measurable improvement, not activity completion.
  
  
* Structured problem-solving: separates symptoms from root cause and prioritises by business impact and control risk.
  
  
* Precision and control mindset: understands the financial, contractual and audit sensitivity of royalties operations.
  
  
* Collaboration and influence: earns trust across operations and technology, handles competing priorities and drives closure.
  

  

**Working Relationships**

  
  

Works closely with Rights & Royalties Operations, Finance Operations, Transformation leads, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance/Legal and operational leaders. Acts as a process transformation, agent enablement and automation partner to teams looking to improve efficiency, control and customer experience.

  
  

**What This Role Offers**

  

  
* High-visibility transformation scope with measurable business impact in a financially sensitive and globally relevant domain.
  
  
* Opportunity to build modern agentic automation capabilities across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Strong cross-functional exposure across Rights, Royalties, Finance, Product, Technology and Governance teams.
  
  
* A practical platform to convert process knowledge into scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. description:
