About Network18

Network18 is one of India's leading media and news organizations, with a strong presence across television, digital, and social media platforms. We are looking for dynamic, ambitious, and result-oriented sales professionals to join the advertising sales team of News18 Kerala.

Job Summary

The Media Sales Manager / Senior Media Sales Executive will be responsible for generating advertising revenue, acquiring new clients, managing key accounts, and developing integrated advertising solutions across television, digital, and social media platforms.

The ideal candidate will have proven sales experience, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to build strong client relationships while achieving revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate advertising revenue through television, digital media, social media, branded content, and integrated advertising campaigns.
* Identify, approach, and acquire new clients, including corporate brands, local businesses, advertising agencies, and media buyers.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients and agencies to generate repeat business.
* Understand client marketing objectives and develop customized advertising proposals and media plans.
* Present and pitch advertising solutions to prospective clients and decision-makers.
* Negotiate pricing, campaign placements, and commercial terms in accordance with company guidelines.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to overall revenue growth.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely campaign delivery and meet advertiser expectations.
* Work with event execution teams to develop sponsorship opportunities and deliver successful advertising partnerships.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates, revenue reports, and MIS as required.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collection from clients.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Graduate in any discipline; a degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* 5–10 years of sales experience, preferably in media advertising, television, print, radio, digital media, or advertising agencies.
* Strong track record in business development, client acquisition, and revenue generation.
* Good understanding of advertising sales, media planning, branded content, and sponsorship opportunities.
* Excellent English communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong negotiation, networking, and relationship management abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple accounts, and meet sales targets.
* Proficiency in MS Office and sales reporting tools.

Candidate Profile

* Candidates with relevant media sales or advertising sales experience are preferred.
* Experience handling corporate clients, advertising agencies, and local advertisers is an advantage.
* Existing industry contacts and knowledge of the local business market will be beneficial.
* Must be proactive, target-driven, commercially aware, and customer-focused.
* Candidates should be willing to work in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, or Thrissur, Kerala.

Compensation

Why Join News18 Kerala?

* Opportunity to work with a leading Indian media organization.
* Exposure to television, digital, social media, branded content, and event-based advertising.
* Opportunities to develop long-term relationships with leading brands and advertising agencies.
* A performance-oriented environment with opportunities to contribute to business growth.

How to Apply

description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a proactive Field Application Engineer (FAE) to support our business expansion in India. This role is responsible for providing technical expertise and application support for industrial computing and edge AI solutions, working closely with the sales and engineering teams to deliver optimal solutions to customers. The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge in embedded and/or industrial systems, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to support customers throughout the design-in and deployment process.

I. Work closely with the India sales team to provide technical consultation and solution recommendations for customers.

III. Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept (POC) activities.

description:
**Company Description**
NAAYA STUDIO is a Bangalore-founded lighting atelier that creates bespoke ceramic lighting objects for luxury residences, premium hospitality properties, and architecturally significant spaces worldwide. Each piece is conceived, designed, and produced entirely within the studio, from initial material exploration to final installation. The studio works exclusively on commissioned projects, collaborating closely with architects, interior designers, and developers who prioritize refined, custom solutions. Ceramic is the core medium, selected for its ability to hold form, interact with light, and age with distinctive character, resulting in lighting that feels warm and intentional. The Sales Marketing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru. The Sales Marketing Manager will represent the studio at industry events and meetings, ensuring that the brand’s values and aesthetic are consistently communicated.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Design Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, collaborate with cross-functional studio teams, and manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead
description:
**We're Hiring | Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead**

Build CXO Relationships. Shape Enterprise AI Adoption. Drive Business Growth.

**Location:**
Hyderabad |
**Experience:**
0–5 Years |
**Employment:**
Full-time

**Preferred Qualifications:**
Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA + B.Tech

THIS IS NOT A CONVENTIONAL ENTERPRISE SALES ROLE.

Enterprise AI is at an inflection point.

Businesses are moving beyond AI experimentation and looking for technologies that can fundamentally change how they operate, make decisions and execute business processes.

At FinteractAI, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI.

Our flagship platform, FORGE, is an Autonomous Business Operations Engine that works across existing ERP and business systems to intelligently understand, validate and execute complex business processes within enterprise-defined controls.

With live deployments across industries and demonstrated outcomes including up to 90% reduction in manual processing, we're now accelerating enterprise adoption.

We're looking for an exceptional individual who can help lead this journey.

Someone who can think like a strategist, engage like a business leader and execute like an entrepreneur.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As our Enterprise AI Strategy & Growth Lead, you'll work closely with the founding leadership, product and engineering teams to help enterprises understand and realise the business potential of AI.

You will independently develop enterprise relationships, engage with CEOs, CFOs, COOs and other senior leaders, identify high-impact business opportunities and convert them into successful customer engagements.

This is a frontline, revenue-owning role — combining strategic business understanding with the energy, initiative and persistence required to win enterprise customers.

You'll have the opportunity to build deep expertise in Enterprise AI, influence product direction and develop a strong professional network across industries.

We're looking for someone with the potential to become a recognised Enterprise AI leader and take on significantly larger business responsibilities as we grow.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

Enterprise Strategy & Business Development

- Identify and develop enterprise opportunities across industries.

- Build relationships with CEOs, CFOs, COOs and senior business decision-makers.

- Understand enterprise operating models, business challenges and technology priorities.

- Identify where AI can create measurable improvements in operational efficiency, execution speed, operating capacity and governance.

- Develop compelling business cases that connect AI capabilities with commercial outcomes.

Enterprise Growth & Revenue Ownership

- Independently own the enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and CXO engagement to commercial negotiations and closure.

- Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities.

- Drive customer acquisition, new revenue and account development.

- Take personal ownership of commercial outcomes, execution discipline and growth targets.

Enterprise AI Thought Leadership

- Stay current with developments in Enterprise AI, agentic AI, autonomous operations and enterprise technology adoption.

- Understand how AI is reshaping business processes, organisational roles, operating models and technology roadmaps.

- Build credibility as a knowledgeable and trusted enterprise AI professional.

- Represent FinteractAI in relevant industry discussions, business forums and customer engagements.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

- Work closely with our product and engineering teams to translate enterprise challenges into practical AI solutions.

- Bring customer insights and market feedback into product development discussions.

- Collaborate on solution positioning, demonstrations and customer adoption strategies.

- Help build repeatable enterprise use cases and scalable go-to-market approaches.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We value intellectual ability, curiosity, ambition and ownership more than conventional job titles or years of experience.

Educational Background

We particularly encourage applications from:

- Chartered Accountants (CA) — including exceptional newly qualified professionals.

- MBA + B.Tech graduates with strong analytical, business and technology aptitude.

- Exceptional candidates from other academic backgrounds who demonstrate outstanding potential.

Experience: 0–5 years.

Experience in enterprise sales, consulting, business development, corporate finance, technology or related areas is valuable, but not mandatory for outstanding candidates.

**THE QUALITIES THAT MATTER MOST**

1. Exceptional Intelligence & Analytical Ability

You think independently, learn quickly, connect complex ideas and can understand business problems beyond their surface symptoms.

2. Strong Technology Aptitude & AI Curiosity

You actively follow AI developments and understand their implications for enterprises.

You don't need to be a developer or AI researcher. But you should be able to discuss how AI can reshape business processes, human roles, enterprise systems and operating models.

3. High Energy & Commercial Drive

You enjoy building relationships, opening doors, pursuing ambitious opportunities and converting conversations into business outcomes.

You are persistent, resourceful and comfortable with demanding growth targets.

4. Leadership Potential

You demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, confidence, resilience and the ambition to take on larger responsibilities.

You don't wait for detailed instructions to make progress.

5. Executive Communication & Presence

You can communicate complex ideas simply, ask intelligent questions, engage confidently with senior executives and build lasting professional relationships.

6. Collaborative & Entrepreneurial Mindset

You enjoy working with engineers, product builders and business leaders.

title: Medical Business Associate -  Hyderabad
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
You will connect with healthcare professionals across Hyderabad to build trusted relationships and share clear, science-based information that supports better patient care. By designing and delivering a territory plan focused on local needs and customer insights, you will help make a meaningful difference. Working closely with colleagues from different teams, you will address challenges and improve patient access. We seek curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to grow, learn, and create impact. This role offers valuable learning opportunities, career growth, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners in your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan based on customer insights and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously build your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to improve your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This is an on-site role based in Hyderabad, requiring regular travel within the assigned territory. You will join a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and perspectives. We value inclusion and work to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution.
* At least 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Telugu; knowledge of other local languages is a plus.
* Basic digital skills including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Right to work in India.

**Preferred Qualification**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and explaining scientific concepts to healthcare professionals.
* Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills.
* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.
* Fluency in local languages spoken in and around Hyderabad.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

Ready to apply?
  
  
If this role matches your skills and ambitions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Job Location - Hyderabad**
**Skills**
Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
**The Role :**

At Recykal, strategy is not a support function. It is a growth engine. As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

**CORE MANDATE:**

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

**C. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

**D. PERFORMANCE & INSIGHTS**

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership
* Develop competitive intelligence frameworks to track market dynamics and benchmark Recykal's position

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

title: Assistant Manager-NEW VENTURES, TECH & INNOV-Tech Strategy-Hyderabad/Bengaluru
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are looking for a professional with 6+ years of experience in Technology strategy and/or business consulting to be part of the NVTI team in India. The NVTI team helps in setting the long-term direction for Deloitte, its businesses, and enabling areas by applying an integrated, strategic approach to complex, high-impact issues and opportunities. The team uses advanced techniques to identify and analyze emerging business and technological trends that are affecting our firm and our clients. We seek to educate our clients and equip our firm to understand and act on the implications of the trends we identify. The candidate should be self-motivated, technology savvy, and able to work well with a diverse set of professionals across India and the US.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Assistant Manager, Standardized Strategic Support Services on the NVTI team, you will be responsible for supporting high-impact, high-visibility initiatives aligned to Deloitte leadership priorities and helping drive coordination across workstreams.
  
  

* Lead and manage projects from planning through execution and delivery with minimal supervision.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across India and the US to drive alignment and project outcomes.
* Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify insights, trends, and implications for leadership decision-making.
* Develop executive-ready deliverables, including presentations, briefs, and reports with clear structure and recommendations.
* Mentor team members and contribute ideas, problem solving, and best practices to strengthen team delivery.

**The team**
The NVTI group shapes Deloitte’s long-term direction by bringing together strategy, technology insight, and data-driven analysis. We scan the market for emerging business and technology trends, quantify their impact, and translate our findings into actionable guidance for Deloitte’s businesses, enabling areas, and clients. By applying an integrated, cross-functional approach to high-impact issues, we help leadership anticipate disruption, prioritize investments, and build competitive advantage.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in technology strategy, business consulting, or a similar role
* 5+ years of experience in consulting, technology strategy, or a comparable function
* Experience developing executive presentations, reports, and business recommendations
* Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data to produce business insights
* Experience working with stakeholders or clients in virtual or cross-border team environments
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* MBA from a reputed school

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience in client consulting in the technology space
* Experience delivering technology-driven engagements
* Knowledge of one or more major technology domains such as Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, or Cyber
* Experience with primary and secondary research in strategy or consulting environments
* Experience using data visualization techniques to present analysis in graphical or tabular formats
* Experience working with US clients or US-based stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Lead System Architect
description:
**Meet Our Team**
Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.
  
  
**Picture Yourself At Pega**
Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.
  
  
At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
  
  
We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do At Pega**

* Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.
* Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

**Who You Are**

* Pega CLSA Certified resource must.
* You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
* Experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders
* Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  
  
You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You've Accomplished**

* You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.
* You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.
* You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.
* You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.
* You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologies

**Pega Offers You**

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

title: Advisor, Client Solutions - CUS Q1 FY27
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Client & User Support is an industry-leading and award-winning client service team starting in Hyderabad, focusing on people with a specialized knowledge of a select group of sophisticated software and product offerings. Initially, advisors will be tasked with supporting a wide-variety of clients using the FactSet workstation, which will give the advantage of gaining knowledge and experience working with the different products clients use to obtain and analyze financial information. The team is composed of self-motivated individuals who thrive in a highly collaborative environment and enjoy the challenge of independence, responsibility, and problem solving.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Answer client questions globally through expert telephone, email, instant message, and proprietary communication channels
* Support FactSet applications
* Create custom FactSet models and screens
* Solve complex financial queries
* A proficient understanding of the FactSet Workstation, the content clients consume through FactSet, and Microsoft Excel
* Follow procedures for maintaining the highest level of quality support for all FactSet clients
* Share ideas and promote suggestions for improvement of workflows
* Cooperate and liaise with other FactSet groups, including Client Solutions, Sales, and Product Development
* Meet targets and goals set by exhibiting motivation and high performance
* Attend internal meetings and training sessions and complete projects as requested
* Keep up to date with the market we are operating in, including our products and competitors
* Progress is reviewed informally on a monthly basis, followed by formal 6 month and yearly reviews as per FactSet procedure
* All FactSet policies can be found on-line at MyRewards@FactSet
* It is the employee’s responsibility to keep updated with any changes made to them

**What We're Looking For**

* MBA Finance (Freshers and Experienced) / B.Com or M.Com or BBA Finance (only if Experienced)
* English spoken fluently
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as experience in advanced web searching
* Highly organized
* Genuine interest or experience in financial markets
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Hardworking and proactive
* Ability to work independently using creative thinking without extensive direction
* Strong work ethic and highly self-motivated
* Positive team player attitude
* Willingness to work in U.S. shifts
* Job Location: Hyderabad

**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Company Overview**
Learn more about our benefits here.
  
  
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (TMT- AI Data Centers, Semiconductors, and Tech Hardware Research)**
Deloitte’s Center for TMT is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the TMT industry. The Center's goals are to:

Learn more about the TMT Center and have a peek into our work here .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus).
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings

**Requisite Experience And Skills**
**Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector skills**

* Business research/thought-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. Knowledge of AI [1] driven chip demand, AI chips and accelerators that support data centers, role of AI in chip design and manufacturing, chip hardware and integrated systems’ time-to-market, and fab efficiency.

·       Present decorative and architectural lighting, custom installations, materials, finishes, customization, durability and relevant specifications.

·       Read architectural drawings, concepts and mood boards, and align product selection with design intent, proportions, performance and budget.

4. Team Leadership & Commercial Control

·       Lead, coach and hold the business development/sales team accountable while directly managing high-value accounts.

·       Maintain forecasts, account plans, conversion metrics, project margins and collection discipline.

·       Coordinate with design, sourcing, technical, finance and project teams to deliver credible proposals and commitments.

Candidate ProfileEssential

title: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

As a Relationship Manager in Private Banking Group, you would act as a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers comprising of High Net worth Individuals, Family Offices and Institutions. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs that comprises of various asset classes and investment propositions. The core philosophy to hold is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like investment solutions covering equities, commodities, Mutual Funds, Insurance product amongst others. As a Relationship Manager, the focus is on ensuring the needs of the customers are covered through the customer-360 degree approach without any particular allegiance to product or domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service:**
Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Business Development:**
Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking:**
Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality:**
Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions:**
As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values:**
Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise:**
Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing:**
Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication:**
Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. After extensive in-house research, the group’s handpicked product offerings help our customers achieve their goals. With the team of experts, group reviews various assets classes along with market and economic conditions to produce incisive insights. These house views, along with rigorous due diligence, help our team of Relationship Managers to suggest a range of products across asset classes. As the financial goals are unique, group creates a tailor-made investment strategy according to the needs of the customers. This is done based on a thorough understanding of financial needs and keeping customers’ investment attitude in mind. The group also offers advisory on Trust Services and Succession Planning. Family Office proposition aims to strengthen the governance structure in family owned businesses.

Thus, emphasis is on a holistic approach towards financial and business goals. The strategic collaboration with global product providers enables us to construct unique solutions. It allows us to complement our core competencies with world class, third party capabilities to deliver solutions to customer's specific needs.

title: RFX Specialist
description:
Job Title
  
  
RFX Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
**RfX Specialist | Pune | Full-time**
Vanderlande is seeking a proactive Global RfX Specialist to enhance our procurement excellence through robust RfX processes. As part of the global Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will play a pivotal role in supporting our category managers and demand managers worldwide. Your expertise will streamline RfX operations, strengthen supplier communication, and drive process improvements.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables our projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the smart, cost effective, and sustainable procurement of goods and services. We ensure a resilient and competitive supplier ecosystem, supporting our transition towards best-in-class procurement practices and a more efficient, effective, and future proof organization.
  
  
Furthermore, procurement plays an important role in Vanderlande’s transformation from an Engineer to Order (ETO) to a Configure to Order (CTO) business model—enhancing customer value through increased standardization, scalability, and competitiveness.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Global RfX Specialist, you will support all RfX related activities, ensuring the timely and smooth execution of proposals and quotations. You will coordinate submission timelines, assist in evaluating supplier responses, and collaborate closely with cross functional business functions. You will follow established RfX processes while contributing to the continuous improvement of procurement practices across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you bring**

* Support category managers and demand managers worldwide in executing RfX processes (including spot buys and light tenders), including drafting RfX documents and assisting with initial proposal and quotation analysis.
* Coordinate and communicate submission timelines with suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal stakeholders.
* Consolidate supplier responses into clear, structured formats to support evaluations and decision making.
* Execute all RfX activities in compliance with procurement policies, legal regulations, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Identify opportunities for improving RfX processes and support the implementation of best practices across the Procurement CoE.

**What do we ask from you?**
To be successful in this role, you should have
  
  

* 4-7 years of proven progressive experience in procurement processes and sourcing strategies, ideally with hands on involvement in RfX activities such as drafting documents, evaluating proposals, and supporting supplier selection.
* Experience in project-based procurement environments (e.g., engineering, automation, intralogistics, material handling, or system integration), with the ability to work effectively when requirements evolve or clarity is limited.
* Strong ability to analyze supplier responses, identify key performance indicators, and support strategic procurement decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple RfX tasks simultaneously while maintaining accurate documentation.
* Demonstrated capability to identify and support process improvements, ideally within RfX or procurement operations.
* Stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively with cross functional global teams such as engineering, project management, category management, finance, and planning.
* Comfort working in ambiguous, low SOP environments, bringing structure, clarity, and proactive follow up when information is incomplete.
* Exposure to global, multicultural environments, with the ability to work across regions, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to interact effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders worldwide.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

About Us

We are a business advisory firm providing specialized advisory and consulting services to Indian businesses, multinational corporations, foreign investors, entrepreneurs and companies seeking to establish or expand their operations in India.

Our service portfolio includes:

* Corporate and business advisory
* Financial and compliance services for Direct and Indirect Taxes
* Internal Audits and Revenue audit SoP setup
* Legal advisory relating to financial and commercial matters
* Foreign company incorporation and India market-entry services
* FEMA, FDI and RBI-related regulatory advisory
* Business establishment, structuring and regulatory compliance
* Financial and corporate consulting
* Other associated professional advisory services

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Business Development Manager who can independently develop business opportunities, acquire clients and contribute directly to the firm's revenue growth.

The Role — What We Expect

**This is a complete business development and client acquisition role, not merely a lead-generation position.**

The selected candidate will be responsible for the entire business development cycle, from identifying potential clients to converting qualified opportunities into confirmed business engagements.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Independently identify and approach prospective domestic and international clients.
* Generate qualified leads through LinkedIn, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, professional associations and strategic partnerships.
* Identify foreign companies and investors interested in establishing or expanding operations in India.
* Build a consistent pipeline of Indian businesses requiring corporate, financial, legal and regulatory advisory services.

**2. Client Acquisition & Business Conversion**

* Initiate contact with prospective clients and understand their business requirements.
* Arrange and independently conduct introductory client meetings.
* Present the firm's capabilities and service offerings.
* Coordinate with senior consultants for technical discussions.
* Prepare commercial proposals, negotiate engagement terms within approved parameters and close business.
* Convert prospective clients into paying clients.

**3. International Business Development**

* Identify opportunities from overseas markets, including the UAE, UK, USA, Singapore and Europe.
* Develop relationships with foreign consulting firms, accounting firms, legal professionals and corporate service providers.
* Generate business for India market-entry, foreign company incorporation, regulatory compliance and corporate structuring services.
* Establish sustainable international referral and business relationships.

**4. Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop relationships with corporate consultants, financial advisers, law firms, professional networks, chambers of commerce and other relevant institutions.
* Identify opportunities for strategic alliances and business collaborations.
* Generate repeat business and long-term client relationships.

**5. Revenue Ownership & Reporting**

* Take ownership of agreed monthly and quarterly business development targets.
* Maintain an active CRM pipeline of leads, opportunities, proposals and conversions.
* Track revenue generated and fees collected.
* Provide regular business development reports and forecasts to management.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Management, Law or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 5–8 years of experience in B2B business development or client acquisition.
* Demonstrated experience in independently generating leads and closing business.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Experience dealing with business owners, CXOs, promoters, investors and corporate decision-makers.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn prospecting, CRM systems and B2B sales processes.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Highly Preferred Experience

Candidates from any of the following backgrounds will be preferred:

* Corporate advisory and management consulting firms
* Legal and financial consulting organizations
* CA / CS / professional services firms
* International business setup and company incorporation consultancies
* FEMA, FDI and regulatory advisory businesses
* Cross-border consulting and corporate services firms

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate should be capable of:

* Independently building and managing a qualified business pipeline.
* Generating approximately 20–30 qualified leads per month after the initial ramp-up period.
* Conducting 10–15 prospective client meetings monthly.
* Converting qualified opportunities into revenue-generating engagements.
* Working toward mutually agreed monthly and annual revenue targets.

Targets will be finalized based on the firm's service mix, average engagement value and sales cycle.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive fixed salary based on experience.
* Performance-linked incentives based on eligible business generated and revenue collected.
* Opportunity to work with Indian and international corporate clients.
* Direct interaction with senior management.
* Opportunity for long-term professional and career growth.
* Scope to build and lead the business development function as the organization expands.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have an established record of bringing business to professional services firms.
* Can independently generate opportunities rather than depend entirely on company-provided leads.
* Are comfortable approaching senior corporate decision-makers.
* Understand consultative selling and long-term relationship development.
* Can take accountability for business conversion and revenue generation.

**Candidates with only telecalling, digital marketing or lead-list generation experience, without demonstrated B2B business conversion experience, may not be suitable for this position.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with:

1. Current and expected CTC.
2. Notice period.
3. Relevant business development experience.
4. Industries and services for which they have generated business.
5. A brief summary of their business acquisition achievements over the last 12 months.

title: Medical Business Associate -  Delhi
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
You will connect with healthcare professionals across Delhi, sharing clear, science-based information that supports better patient care. You will design and deliver a territory plan focused on local needs and customer insight. Working closely with colleagues, you will help address challenges and improve patient access. We are looking for curious, honest, and practical thinkers eager to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact. This role offers strong learning opportunities, career growth, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and healthcare partners in your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan based on customer insight and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously expand your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to improve your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This is an on-site role based in Delhi that requires regular travel within your assigned territory. You will join a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and perspectives. We value inclusion and strive to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management roles.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of local languages spoken in Delhi is a plus.
* Basic digital skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Right to work in India.

**Preferred Qualification**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and explaining scientific concepts to healthcare professionals.
* Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills.
* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.
* Fluency in local languages spoken in and around Delhi.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

Ready to apply?
  
  
If this role fits your skills and career goals, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Job Location - Delhi**
**Skills**
Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. While the role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

A Relationship Manager is a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs. The core philosophy to hold is being Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best-in-class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like saving solutions, loan products, overdraft solutions, Insta loans, investment solutions, care products, trade solutions, business loans, or wealth management solutions while upholding our fundamental value of being Fair to the Bank and Fair to the Customer.

**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from across industries!**

We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome, irrespective of your present core responsibilities or the industry associated. Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. Professionals from across industries are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Customer Service:**
  Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.
* **Business Development:**
  Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers

title: Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product
description:
Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product

Ananant Systems | Noida | Full-time | Regular travel within India | Reports to the CEO

Ananant is hiring a Founders' Office Associate to own government programmes, partnerships, product input, contracts and marketing, working directly with the CEO and CTO.

ABOUT ANANANT

Ananant Systems is an Indian deep-tech semiconductor company. We design chips for small-cell 4G/5G and camera applications, with teams in Bengaluru, Noida and San Diego. We are backed by venture capital and by national semiconductor programmes, and we are growing several-fold over the next 18 months.

THE ROLE

Outside engineering, Ananant depends on three things: the government programmes it wins, the customers and partners who adopt its chips, and its standing in the market. This role owns all three.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO. You represent Ananant to government, partners and customers, and bring what you learn from them back into the company.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Government programmes. Identify, apply for and deliver government semiconductor and R&D programmes: applications, milestones, reporting and compliance, and the working relationship with the ministries and agencies involved.

• Partnerships and lead customers. Build and manage the pipeline of strategic partners and lead customers, and track every commitment made to them.

• Product and market. Bring customer requirements, market information and competitive analysis into product decisions, and build the business case for new opportunities.

• Contracts. Manage customer, partner, vendor and government agreements through review, approval and signature, working with our law firm. Maintain the contract register, renewals and obligations.

• Marketing. Own positioning, collateral, the website and our presence at industry events.

WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

Expected outcomes in the first year:

• Government programmes won, with every report and milestone under them delivered on time.

• Partnerships signed and lead customers evaluating our chips.

• Customer and market input feeding product decisions on a regular basis.

• A complete and current contract register, with no missed renewals or obligations.

• Consistent positioning and collateral in use with customers, partners and government.

WHY THIS ROLE

• Scope. Government, customers, product, contracts and marketing in one role, each being set up for the first time.

• Direct access. You work with the CEO and CTO directly, on decisions that matter to the company.

• Sector exposure. You will build relationships and expertise across Indian semiconductor policy, customers and partners.

• A path to leadership. The role is expected to grow into leading a function as the company scales.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1 to 5 years of experience. Comfortable both in meetings with senior government officials and partners, and in building financial models. Clear writer, strong with numbers, and able to run work end to end with limited supervision.

You bring:

• Strong Excel modelling and a solid grasp of business financials: P&L, cash flow, budgets and unit economics.

• Working knowledge of compliance and audits.

• Clear, persuasive writing and presentation for formal audiences.

• Daily, hands-on use of AI tools.

• Ability to represent the company with senior officials, partners and customers.

It helps if you have:

• An MBA, ideally with a consulting background.

• Founder or early-stage startup experience.

• An engineering degree, or experience in semiconductors, telecom or deep tech.

• Experience with Indian government programmes, public-sector stakeholders, or commercial contracts.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short note on something you built or ran end to end, and what you would do differently. The process is a conversation with the CEO, a short work sample on a problem from the role, and a review with the founders. It takes about two weeks.
