title: Techno Commercial Senior Manager - Wind
description:
Al Jomaih Energy & Water (AEW) headquartered in Saudi Arabia, is a fast-growing investor, lead developer, and operator of utility and infrastructure projects in various geographical markets such as KSA, GCC, Asia & North Africa, with investments in 6 GW of Conventional and Solar power plants, and around 700,000 m3/day of water.
  
  
AEW was established in 2007, as a subsidiary of Al Jomaih Holding Company, a leading Saudi conglomerate with a legacy spanning over 80 years, focused on enabling sustainable, social, and economic progress in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and beyond.
  
  
At AEW, our mission is to tackle new technologies, solve complex problems, and leverage our expertise to unlock opportunities in the Power, Renewables & Water Sectors, while driving impact for our stakeholders across the value chain.
  
  
**Overview**
Al Jomaih Energy and Water recognizes the importance of sustainable energy sources in addressing the growing global demand for clean and renewable energy. In line with this vision, the company aims to expand its wind project portfolio and contribute to a greener future. Technical manager role will support Al Jomaih's vision in securing, executing Wind projects in global market.
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon, India
  
  
**Reporting Structure**
Head of Technical Support
  
  
**Your Job Functions (Duties & Responsibilities)**
You will:
  
  

* Responsible for the technical stream and coordinate all technical activities of bid development catering to business development, project finance and legal
* Responsible for development of wind resource assessment, micro siting, constraint map based on topography and environmental and social constraints, layout and configuration, energy yield assessments based on constrain map and layout/configuration, Wake modelling and effects, Uncertainty assessments, BoP optimization
* Technical/Technology analysis and selection of WTG
* Qualification of WTG based on test certifications and compliances to ISO/IEC/IEEE standards for Wind Farm design and operation
* Responsible for the HoT, scope and services of long-term wind turbine service agreements. Engage in all the technical and techno-commercial aspects of EPC, , BOP and O&M contract tender and negotiation processes in combination with undertaking due diligence activities on potential new development acquisitions
* Lead and provide technical input to bidding team and responsible for all the project technical assumptions
* Interface with Turbine OEMs and BOS Contractors to negotiate the most competitive and compliant technical solutions for the Bids
* Analysis and interpretation of site measurement data and production data, including SCADA, Met Mast, SODAR & LiDAR
* Modelling of wind flow using linear and non-linear wind flow models
* Due diligence analysis for wind resource, energy yield and project layout/site suitability analysis
* Performance review of operational sites
* Review and negotiate the technical Performance guarantees with OEMs and Contractors
* Development of Availability modelling, Aux power modelling
* Development of O&M budget

This is a client facing role that would suit a highly numerate individual with a diverse set of skills and the initiative to rise to a challenge.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Relevant electrical or mechanical engineering bachelor's or master's degree
* WAsP /Wind Pro modelling & Wake Modelling experience desirable,
* Knowledge of routine and periodic maintenance of WTG and BoP systems is desirable
* Wind farm O&M experience is desirable
* 10+ years of relevant experience in the Wind Energy industry in similar role
* Experience in Middle East and North Africa wind projects is desirable
* An analytic mindset with the ability to identify and summarize complex topics in a structured and concise way
* Familiar with the interface between commercial and technical aspects of a project. Comfortable in communicating within a techno-commercial environment
* Strong attention to detail and organization, ability to prioritize and meet demanding deadline

title: Medical Business Associate -  Gurgaon
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
In this role based in Gurgaon, you will connect with healthcare professionals to build trust through clear, science-based information. You will design and implement a territory plan that reflects the needs of local patients and healthcare providers. Working closely with colleagues across teams, you will help address challenges and improve patient access to care. We are looking for curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to learn, grow, and make a positive difference. This role offers strong learning opportunities, visible career progression, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners in your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan based on customer insight and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report your activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and enhance patient access.
* Continuously grow your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to improve your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This is an on-site role based in Gurgaon, requiring regular travel within the assigned territory. You will be part of a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of local languages in Gurgaon is a plus.
* Basic digital skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Right to work in India.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and sharing scientific information with healthcare professionals.

* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your priorities.
* Fluency in local languages spoken in and around Gurgaon.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

Ready to apply?
  
  
If this role matches your skills and ambitions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Job Location - Gurgaon**

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Senior Consultant - Endur Functional
description:
**Senior Consultant – Endur Functional**

 

**Location:
India**

**Role:**
**Permanent/ Full Time**

**Why capSpire?**

 

capSpire is a fast-growing consulting and solutions company with a global footprint with eight offices in the world’s leading markets. We pride ourselves in being truly entrepreneurial, innovative, and collaborative, with a strong problem-solving ethos. We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.
* Support existing solutions for bug fixes, enhancements and operations.
* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.

Preferred:

title: senior Admission counsellor
description:
Job Description

**About Masters’ Union**

Founded in 2020, Masters’ Union is a new-age, industry-led university focused on business, technology, engineering, and entrepreneurship. Built around learning by doing, the institution combines academics with real-world projects, startup building, and global exposure, with the ambition of becoming one of the world’s top business schools and multidisciplinary universities over the next two decades.

Today, Masters’ Union has nearly 3,500 students across undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive programs, with almost half being experienced professionals. Spread across nearly 5 lakh square feet in Gurgaon and Manesar, the institution houses the PwC Center for Generative AI, a Bloomberg Lab, Gurgaon’s premier maker space, AI and robotics infrastructure, advanced bioengineering workshops, and startup incubation spaces, while also expanding into areas such as bioengineering and genetic engineering.

The institution is chaired by Manoj Kohli, former CEO of Bharti Airtel and former Country Head of SoftBank India. Its leadership ecosystem includes Vivek Gambhir, Pankaj Bansal, Sanjiv Bikhchandani, Amitabh Kant, and 30+ other founders, CEOs, investors, and policymakers who contribute to teaching and institution building.

Masters’ Union’s flagship postgraduate program has recorded the highest average salary among MBA-equivalent programs in India, with graduates placed at firms such as Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, Google, and Microsoft. The institution has also built one of the country’s strongest student startup ecosystems, with 10+ students pitching on Shark Tank India and 20+ students raising external funding for their ventures, alongside several successful creators and internet entrepreneurs.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Admission Counsellor professional to join our team, who will be responsible for engaging with working professionals for our specialised program in capital markets. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in inside sales and will be instrumental in helping working professionals enhance their careers by enrolling in our high-impact, capital markets-focused program.

**Specifically, this role will involve**

* Engaging with working professionals to identify their career needs and how the program can enhance their skills in capital markets.
* Conducting online and offline product demonstrations, providing detailed insights into the program’s features, benefits, and career opportunities.
* Scheduling and conducting consultations and follow-up sessions with prospective students, addressing their concerns and queries.
* Developing an in-depth understanding of the customer profile and align the program’s offerings to their career aspirations.
* Handling objections, provide solutions, and negotiate program fees to close sales and generate revenue.

description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Own the customer journey from initial requirements to long-term platform success.

• Apply your EHR expertise across a growing range of private healthcare services.

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

• Stay close to the product, with direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership.

• See your recommendations become working solutions used by real healthcare teams.

• Help shape both customer delivery and the platform itself.

**📍 Location, working hours and joining**

• Based in India.

• Available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time, including a one-hour break.

• UK summer hours: 13:30–22:30 IST.

• UK winter hours: 14:30–23:30 IST.

• Candidates able to join within 45 days are welcome.

**Interested?**

Please ensure your CV clearly identifies the EHR platforms and modules you have worked with, your personal configuration responsibilities, and the client implementations or optimisation projects you have owned.

We would love to hear how you could bring that expertise to Script Assist.

title: Assistant Manager - Techno Commercial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. The Buyer or TCD Executive coordinates procurement activities across multiple sitesorclusters within the natural resources sector. Prepare change ordersoramendments in orders and facilitate contract closures.

Projects team
  
  
Marketing department

Suppliers

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions.

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance & Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Demonstrates strong AI acumen, with the ability to effectively leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a dynamic, strategic, and execution-oriented 
**Brand Marketing, PR & Influencer Relations Manager**
 to lead marketing initiatives for an upcoming consumer brand being developed by the team behind London Waffle Co.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building brand awareness, developing strategic partnerships, managing public relations, driving influencer collaborations, and planning and executing high-impact brand launches and events.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, strong industry connections, creative campaign development, and hands-on execution. The candidate will work closely with the founders and take ownership of key brand-building initiatives from concept to execution.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Brand Marketing & Strategy**

* Develop and execute comprehensive brand marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Build brand positioning, awareness, and visibility across relevant consumer segments.
* Conceptualise innovative marketing campaigns, brand activations, and promotional initiatives.
* Identify strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities to accelerate brand growth.
* Track campaign performance, marketing expenditure, and return on investment.

**2. Public Relations & Media Management**

* Develop and maintain relationships with media houses, journalists, publications, PR agencies, and relevant industry stakeholders.
* Drive press coverage, media features, brand announcements, and publicity initiatives.
* Develop PR strategies to generate brand awareness and establish a strong market presence.
* Coordinate press releases, media interactions, interviews, and brand communications.

**3. Influencer Marketing & Celebrity Collaborations**

* Develop and execute influencer marketing strategies across relevant social media platforms.
* Identify, negotiate, onboard, and manage influencers, content creators, and celebrity collaborations.
* Build and maintain a strong network of influencers and talent agencies.
* Coordinate campaign briefs, content deliverables, timelines, and performance tracking.
* Negotiate collaboration fees and maximise campaign reach within approved budgets.

**4. Brand Launches & Event Management**

* Plan and execute end-to-end brand launch events, influencer previews, media events, and promotional activations.
* Manage event conceptualisation, budgeting, venue coordination, vendors, production, and execution.
* Coordinate influencer attendance, celebrity appearances, media participation, and event coverage.
* Develop launch campaigns designed to generate pre-launch anticipation, launch-day visibility, and sustained post-launch engagement.
* Ensure all events and activations are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.

**5. Campaign Execution & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal teams, creative agencies, designers, production teams, and external vendors.
* Manage campaign calendars, marketing deliverables, budgets, and execution timelines.
* Oversee the development of marketing collaterals, promotional content, and campaign assets.
* Monitor campaign outcomes and recommend improvements based on performance and market feedback.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in brand marketing, public relations, influencer marketing, or event management.
* Demonstrated experience in executing brand launches, influencer campaigns, and PR initiatives.
* Strong professional network across influencers, media, celebrities, and event partners.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Strong project management, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in social media platforms, influencer campaign management, and marketing analytics.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in F&B, QSR, hospitality, lifestyle, fashion, or consumer-facing brands.
* Prior experience launching a new brand or scaling an emerging brand.
* Experience working with PR agencies, influencer management agencies, or event production companies.
* A demonstrable portfolio of successful campaigns, brand launches, and influencer collaborations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Brand awareness and reach generated through marketing initiatives.
* Number and quality of influencer and strategic brand collaborations.
* Media coverage and PR visibility secured.
* Successful execution of launch events and marketing activations.
* Marketing budget utilisation and campaign return on investment.

**Assistant Manager – Customer Growth& CRM Lifecycle**

**Assistant Manager – Customer Growth & CRM Lifecycle**
with

, to drive repeat customer growth, retention, and CRM-led revenue across Tata CLiQ Fashion and Luxury.

The role will work closely with Business, Category, Product, Technology, Analytics, and Loyalty teams to improve repeat purchases, customer lifetime value, and channel effectiveness.

**What You’ll Do**

**Customer Growth & Retention:**

* Drive repeat customer growth, retention, purchase frequency and CRM-led revenue.

* Build lifecycle journeys covering onboarding, second purchase, repeat purchase, cross-sell, loyalty and win-back.
* Translate business revenue targets into customer, cohort and CRM plans.

**CRM Lifecycle & Campaign Management:**

* Plan and execute personalized campaigns across Push Notifications, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Email, In-App Messages, App Inbox and Native Displays.
* Own the CRM campaign calendar aligned to business priorities and customer lifecycle stages.
* Ensure campaigns are targeted, personalized, tested and delivered with high quality and accuracy.
* Continuously optimize communication frequency, channel mix and customer experience.

**CRM Channel Health & Platform Ownership:**

* Own channel health metrics including reachability, deliverability, CTR, conversion, engagement, unsubscribe rates and customer fatigue.
* Monitor channel-wise revenue contribution, ROI and ROAS and identify optimization opportunities.
* Manage CRM platform capabilities, data quality, campaign automation and journey orchestration.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to implement new triggers, personalization capabilities and platform enhancements.

**Analytics & Experimentation:**

* Analyze customer behaviour, campaign performance and lifecycle movement to identify growth opportunities.
* Measure key KPIs including repeat customers, retention rate, reactivation, purchase frequency, orders per customer, CRM GMV, CTR, conversion and ROAS.
* Conduct A/B tests and experiments to continuously improve customer engagement and business performance.
* Develop and leverage machine learning models and predictive analytics for churn prediction, customer reactivation, purchase propensity, customer lifetime value (CLV) and next-best-action recommendations.
* Build dashboards and present actionable insights to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with Business, Category, Product, Technology, Customer Service, Analytics and Creative teams to deliver customer growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop relevant customer offers, improve customer experience and resolve campaign or platform issues.
* Benchmark industry best practices and recommend new CRM capabilities, automation and customer engagement initiatives.

**Skills We Are Looking For**

**Technical Skills:**

1. **SQL & Data Analysis:**
   Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, and customer-level data analysis.
2. **Python:**
   Working knowledge of Python, particularly Pandas and NumPy, for data manipulation, analysis, and workflow automation.
3. **Statistical Analysis & Experimentation:**
   Understanding of descriptive statistics, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and campaign uplift and incrementality analysis.
4. **Data Visualization & Reporting:**
   Proficiency in Excel, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau for dashboard development and performance reporting.
5. **Automation & Analytics:**
   Ability to automate recurring reports, data extracts, campaign performance tracking, and analytical workflows using SQL and Python.
6. **Data Science & Machine Learning:**
   Understanding of predictive modelling techniques for customer segmentation, churn prediction, customer lifetime value (CLV), purchase propensity, and customer reactivation.

**Desired Skills:**

1. Passion for customer growth, retention, and lifecycle marketing in E-commerce/M-commerce.
2. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
3. Understanding of customer cohorts, RFM segmentation, loyalty programs, repeat purchase behaviour, and customer lifetime value.
4. Familiarity with regression analysis, data science, and machine learning models for customer targeting and campaign optimization.
5. Knowledge of CRM campaign measurement, customer journey analysis, and cross-channel performance optimization.
6. Awareness of AI-driven personalization, recommendation systems, and next-best-action frameworks.
7. Ability to translate customer insights into actionable CRM strategies and measurable business outcomes.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Repeat Customer Growth
* Retention & Reactivation Rate
* CRM-led GMV & Revenue
* Purchase Frequency & Orders per Customer
* Channel Health (Reachability, Deliverability, CTR, Conversion)
* Channel ROAS & Campaign ROI
* Automation & Lifecycle Journey Contribution

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
### Job Description: Digital Media Strategist

Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai

Work Mode: Full-time | Work from Office

Experience: Freshers or maximum 2–3 years of experience

Joining: ImmediateQualification:  BMS /BBA or MBA in Marketing

Compensation: Up to 4.20 LPA

### About BLL

Business Leadership League (BLL) is a business leadership and growth platform connecting entrepreneurs, manufacturers, MSMEs, professionals and business leaders.

Since 2019, BLL has been building a community that helps businesses access the right people, opportunities and visibility through curated business events, leadership conversations, business storytelling, corporate partnerships and international business initiatives.

Our vision is to build BLL into a powerful platform for India's business community, bringing the stories, capabilities and ambitions of Indian businesses to a wider national and global audience.

We are looking for a Digital Media Strategist who can think like a marketer, tell stories like a creator and execute like a business owner.

### The Role

This is not a routine social media management position. You will be responsible for shaping BLL's digital identity, developing compelling content properties, growing our digital community and using digital media to support business growth.

You will work closely with the founder, leadership team, community and sales teams to transform BLL's network, events, member stories and business initiatives into a consistent stream of meaningful digital content.

### Key Responsibilities

1. Build BLL's Digital Brand

* Develop and implement a comprehensive digital media strategy aligned with BLL's vision and business objectives.
* Strengthen BLL's positioning as a platform for business leadership, entrepreneur visibility and growth.
* Create platform-specific strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook.
* Build a consistent digital presence that attracts entrepreneurs, manufacturing SMEs, business leaders, corporate partners and institutions.
* Identify emerging content formats, trends and opportunities relevant to India's business community.

2. Create Powerful Business Stories

* Identify compelling stories of entrepreneurs, founders, manufacturers and business leaders within the BLL ecosystem.
* Convert interviews, factory visits, founder journeys and event interactions into engaging digital content.
* Develop scripts and content concepts for reels, short videos, carousels, interviews and long-form videos.
* Create content that highlights the people, products, innovations and capabilities behind Indian businesses.
* Coordinate with designers, videographers and internal teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.

3. Develop BLL's Signature Content Series

Build recognisable content properties that give entrepreneurs a reason to follow, engage with and participate in BLL.

Key series include:

* Makers of India: Showcasing Indian factories, manufacturing capabilities, products and entrepreneurs to a wider audience.
* Indian Business Inspiration Stories: Sharing the journeys, challenges and achievements of Indian entrepreneurs.
* Baton Series: Exploring leadership, business succession, family businesses and lessons across generations.
* Global Trust Circle Stories: Highlighting the journeys, expertise and perspectives of members.
* Leadership & Business Insights: Turning business conversations, books, industry developments and leadership lessons into useful content.
* BLL Event Stories: Capturing insights, key moments and opportunities from roundtables, procurement meets, delegations and leadership events.

You will be expected to develop new series that are relevant to manufacturing SMEs, founders and business decision-makers.

4. Drive Digital Growth and Community Engagement

* Develop monthly content calendars and weekly execution plans.
* Increase relevant audience reach, engagement, shares, saves and meaningful conversations.
* Build relationships with entrepreneurs, industry leaders, associations and relevant digital communities.
* Encourage BLL members to participate in and amplify digital campaigns.
* Explore collaborations and cross-promotion opportunities with business leaders, institutions and industry bodies.
* Build a digital community that values BLL's content and actively participates in its initiatives.

5. Convert Digital Visibility into Business Opportunities

* Develop campaigns that support BLL memberships, events, corporate partnerships and international business delegations.
* Work with the sales and community teams to create content that generates qualified enquiries.
* Develop event promotion campaigns from announcement to registration and post-event engagement.
* Use founder stories, member achievements and event outcomes to demonstrate BLL's value.
* Track the journey from content engagement to enquiries, registrations and membership conversions.
* Identify opportunities to monetise BLL's content properties through sponsorships, brand partnerships and business showcases.

6. Measure, Analyse and Improve

* Track performance across platforms and content formats.
* Prepare monthly reports covering reach, engagement, audience growth, enquiries and conversions.
* Identify which topics, formats and campaigns are delivering results.
* Recommend improvements based on data, audience feedback and business priorities.
* Experiment with new formats and campaigns while maintaining BLL's brand identity.

### Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Freshers/maximum 2-3 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media strategy or content-led brand building.
* Understands the difference between gaining followers and building a relevant business audience.
* Has excellent storytelling, copywriting and content planning skills.
* Understands LinkedIn as a platform for business credibility and Instagram and YouTube as channels for storytelling and discovery.
* Can independently develop a campaign idea, write a brief, coordinate execution and measure results.
* Is comfortable working directly with the founder and taking ownership of important initiatives.
* Is curious about entrepreneurship, manufacturing, family businesses, leadership and the Indian business ecosystem.
* Is organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

Preferred: Experience with B2B brands, startups, business communities, media platforms, manufacturing brands or founder-led businesses.

### Tools & Technical Skills

Working knowledge of the following will be useful:

* Canva and basic creative production tools.
* Video editing and short-form content workflows.
* Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools.
* Google Analytics and social media analytics.
* SEO, digital advertising and lead-generation campaigns.
* AI tools for research, ideation, scripting and content repurposing.

The candidate need not personally perform every design or video-editing task but must be capable of directing the work, maintaining quality and ensuring timely execution.

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

* Consistent execution of the approved content calendar.
* Quality and relevance of content produced.
* Growth in BLL's relevant digital audience and engagement.
* Development and consistency of BLL's signature content series.
* Visibility generated for BLL members and participating businesses.
* Qualified enquiries and registrations generated through campaigns.
* Contribution to membership, event and partnership marketing.
* Quality of performance analysis and improvement recommendations.

Share your updated CV and portfolio at:

📧 Email: shazma@bll.org.in📱 WhatsApp: +91 85911 25238

Ready to Shape the Voice of India's Growth Leaders? Apply Now!

title: Brand & Marketing Associate
description:
Marketing Executive (Brand & Content) | The Financialist | Mumbai

About us

The Financialist is India's Digital Family Office, strategically backed by Zerodha. Our CAs, CFAs and investment bankers give unbiased advice, with no commissions and no brokerage. 700+ families trust us, and we advise on Rs 2,500+ Cr.

We are launching a new home loan brand. It sits on the buyer's side of the biggest purchase of their life.

The role

You will be part of the brand's entire zero-to-one story. You will be in the room for every brand strategy discussion, and you will own the execution that turns those decisions into work that goes live.

What you will own

• Brand strategy: Sit in every strategy discussion on brand positioning, messaging, brand voice and go-to-market. Bring consumer insights and competitor analysis to the table, and keep every piece of work on-brand.

• Content and content calendar: Own the content calendar end to end across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and the website. Plan, brief, publish and track. Build long-form, organic content (guides, explainers, blogs) that earns trust.

• Influencer campaigns: Run creator and influencer campaigns from start to finish. Shortlist creators, write briefs, manage approvals and timelines, and track reach, engagement and enquiries.

• Website and SEO: Do the keyword research, write SEO content for the website and blogs, handle on-page optimisation, and track what ranks and converts.

• Consumer understanding and experiments: Understand the home buyer: what they search, ask and worry about. Find the topics that matter to them, and test new formats, topics and channels to grow our reach and trust.

• AI-first execution: Use AI every day for research, drafts, design, repurposing and reporting. Build simple workflows, and always check the output before it ships.

Who you are

Must have

• A marketing background: a degree or specialisation in marketing (BMS, BBA, MBA or PGDM), plus 0 to 2 years of marketing execution. Internships count.

• Strong fundamentals of branding and marketing: positioning, STP, the 4Ps, brand voice and consumer behaviour. You know how to apply them, not just define them.

• You have shipped real work: a campaign, a content calendar, a social page, an influencer collaboration or a launch, and you can show it along with the numbers.

• You write well: clear, simple and persuasive English. Hindi is a plus.

• You use AI every day for real work, and you check its output before you trust it.

• You own your work: organised, on time, and you follow up without reminders.

• Comfortable working from our Mumbai office (Andheri East), 5 days a week.

Good to have

• Experience in a D2C, fintech, BFSI or real estate brand, or at a marketing or digital agency.

• Canva or Figma, and basic video editing.

• Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite or SEO tools.

• Curiosity about personal finance or real estate. We will teach you the rest.

• You are into fitness, health or sports. "How's your health journey going?" is a fixed item in our catch-ups, and you will fit right in.

What you get

• Build a brand from zero to one, with a real voice in strategy, not just execution.

• Work at a Zerodha-backed company, alongside CAs, CFAs and finance professionals.

• Ownership early. Good ideas ship, whoever they come from.

• An AI-native team that will push you to work smarter, not longer.

• Direct mentoring from the people building the brand.

The details

• Location: Mumbai, in office (Boston House, Andheri East)

• Working days: 5 days a week

• Type: Full-time

• Experience: 0 to 2 years in marketing

• Start: Immediate joining

**A Day in the Life**

* Orchestrate new product launches and core catalogue activations across digital, social, retail, e-commerce, and traditional channels.

**We Are Looking For**
You bring collaborative agility, commercial acumen, and an entrepreneurial approach to health-led beauty innovation. You bring:
  
  

* Brand Development: Proven track record in operational marketing, product launches, and integrated campaign delivery within beauty, FMCG, or healthcare.
* Consumer & Market Insight: Ability to analyse consumer data and identify market drivers to shape effective go-to-market strategies.
* Digital & Influencer Activation: Practical experience managing owned social channels, e-commerce campaigns, and advocacy networks.
* Collaborative Leadership: Strong stakeholder management across internal multidisciplinary teams (medical, sales, supply chain) and external agencies.
* Activation Excellence: Analytical rigour to control budgets, monitor campaign ROI, and support accurate business planning.

**What’s In It For You**

* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)

* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference.

**Who We Are**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.

L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. description:
**Company Overview**

**Emami Limited & Mr. Nithin Kamath – Zerodha Rainmatter.**

**Know more about us:**
http://www.trunativ.co

**Role:**

Social Media Manager

**Department:**

Creatives

**Location:**

Andheri West (100% Work from Office)

**Reports to:**

Creative Head

**About the Role**

Most "Social Media Manager" JDs describe someone who manages a page. This one's different: we're hiring someone who ideates, builds, scripts, shoots, hosts, analysis and grows it.

You'll own everything from the monthly content calendar to the camera-facing series that becomes appointment viewing, ideating, writing, shooting, presenting, and analyzing the results yourself, in-house.

**If you've grown a real page or channel from scratch, this is for you.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Content Strategy, Pillars & Calendar Ownership**

* Define and maintain content pillars (education/insight driven, aspirational/new gen, product/proof, culture/BTS, community/UGC, trends); every post maps to one.
* Own the monthly calendar across Instagram (expanding to YouTube/LinkedIn), balanced across pillars, formats, and funnel stages.
* Build recurring IPs and segments within each pillar so the calendar compounds instead of resetting monthly.
* Own copy end-to-end: captions, campaign copy, scripts, and social ad films. You ideate and execute it all, not just the on-camera pieces.
* Experiment with new formats and hooks; double down on winners, retire what doesn't work.
* Keep a constant eye on emerging trends, formats, sounds, and content styles across Instagram and YouTube, and bring the right ones into the calendar before they peak.
* Coordinate in-house shoots with the team and track platform/category trends to adapt into our voice.

**Be the Face: On-Camera & Production**

* Be the primary on-camera presence for educational and brand content: confident, camera-ready, quick on your feet.
* Build repeatable, recognizable IPs that audiences come back for, not isolated videos.
* Turn nutrition and product education into content people actually want to watch, without dumbing it down.
* Shoot in-house and on location with the team, hands-on from pre-production through edit direction.

**Data, Analytics & Competitive Intelligence**

* Track engagement, follower growth, retention, and format performance monthly at the pillar and IP level.
* Publish a monthly report: what's winning, what to retire, what to test next.
* Run a monthly competitor analysis and benchmarking against comparable D2C/wellness/nutrition brands (follower growth, engagement rate, content pillars, formats) and feed findings straight into the calendar.

**Ownership, Budget & Stakeholder Management**

* Set social media KPIs/OKRs tied to business goals and report progress to leadership monthly.
* Own the content production budget (shoots, freelance support, tools) and brief/manage in house editors, designers & copywriters as and when needed.
* Be the single point of accountability for brand voice and tone consistency across every post.
* Handle audience sentiment and reputation professionally, including negative comments or a PR moment, proactively addressing direct messages, comments, queries etc.

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 3–5 years building and growing a real Instagram/YouTube page or channel, with numbers to show for it.
* Proven end-to-end ownership: you've ideated concepts, executed them end to end and seen them perform.
* Genuinely enjoys being on camera, not just tolerates it.
* Comfortable owning the function solo, end-to-end, with minimal oversight. This is a lead role, not a support seat.

**Skills**

* A strong strategist and copywriter first: owns everything from captions and campaign copy to scripts and social ad films, ideating and executing it all.
* Can build a content pillar framework and structure a calendar around it.
* Proactively running competitor and category research and turning it into calendar decisions, repeatedly.
* Fluent reading analytics dashboards and translating numbers into monthly priorities.
* Working knowledge of shooting and editing: understands pacing, framing, what makes a cut work.
* Genuine eye on trends, the latest platform features, and content styles, and quick to pick up new tools (editing, scheduling, analytics, AI) rather than sticking to one workflow.
* Confident presenting strategy and results to founders/leadership, and briefing or directing support (editors, freelancers, junior creators).

**Personality**

* Out-of-the-box thinker with a natural knack for storytelling.
* Quirky, funny, and has an interesting personality that comes through on screen: basically main-character energy, not corporate-spokesperson energy.
* Extremely online: If your screen time is high and you know what's trending across the category, formats, news, insights, sounds, & tools before it peaks, you’d be a great fit.

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in D2C, health/nutrition, FMCG, or wellness brands.
* Basic design skills (Canva/CapCut/Premiere/Figma) for storyboarding or rough cuts.
* Comfort with AI tools for scripting, ideation, or production support.

**Immediate joiners or candidates serving their notice period are preferred.**

title: Lead Analyst, Database Marketing
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Marketing Database Management professional to own and evolve the organization's marketing data foundation. The role will be responsible for ensuring that Marketing has access to a trusted, accurate, complete, compliant and business-ready database that can support demand generation, account-based marketing, personalization, campaign execution, lead management, analytics and AI-driven marketing.
  
  
The ideal candidate would own the quality, governance, growth, enrichment and usability of the marketing database, while partnering closely with MarTech, Campaigns, Sales/SDR, Analytics, IT and Enterprise Systems. The person will be expected to establish a scalable data management framework, identify and eliminate data quality issues, improve the marketable database, automate repetitive data processes and help build the data foundation required for advanced analytics and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Marketing Database Strategy
* Own the Marketing database strategy, health and roadmap
* Define and maintain standards for account, contact, lead and prospect data
* Drive database growth, coverage and marketable database development
* Establish database health and quality scorecards
* Data Quality & Enrichment
* Own data cleansing, deduplication, normalization and validation
* Develop data enrichment and augmentation strategies
* Improve accuracy, completeness, freshness and usability of Marketing data
* Establish processes to prevent bad data from entering the database
* Data Governance & Compliance
* Define data ownership, governance, taxonomy and data standards
* Manage consent, suppression and data retention requirements
* Partner with Enterprise Systems, Security and Legal on data governance and compliance
* Segmentation & Data Activation
* Develop audience segmentation frameworks for campaigns, ABM, personalization and nurture
* Partner with Campaign, Email and Lead Management teams to ensure audiences are accurate and activation-ready
* Improve target-account and persona coverage
* MarTech & Data Integration
* Partner with the MarTech team to ensure reliable data flows across CRM, Marketing Automation, enrichment, web, SDR and analytics platforms
* Identify data integration gaps, synchronization issues and data leakage
* Support requirements for the future Marketing Data Lake / data foundation
* Automation & AI
* Identify opportunities to automate data cleansing, enrichment, validation, segmentation and quality monitoring
* Explore AI-enabled approaches for entity matching, classification, enrichment and anomaly detection
* Continuously reduce manual database management effort

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Database Management, Marketing Operations, CRM Data, Revenue Operations or a related field
* Strong experience managing complex B2B databases
* Excellent understanding of CRM and Marketing Automation data models
* Experience with platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, ZoomInfo or equivalent data/enrichment platforms
* Knowledge of data governance, segmentation, enrichment, deduplication and consent management
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data warehouses/lakes and BI tools is desirable
