title: Brand & Content Strategy Intern
description:
**Punekar Group**
is expanding into the cosmetics and beauty sector through 
**Aléxander & Victoria (AnV)**
, an emerging consumer venture focused on building an affordable premium beauty brand for the next generation of Indian consumers.

We are looking for a 
**business-minded creative who combines content creation skills with an understanding of branding, marketing and business management.**
 This role is designed for someone who can turn business ideas and consumer insights into engaging digital content while contributing to the strategic development and growth of an emerging consumer brand.

We are particularly interested in candidates from business management, marketing and related disciplines who actively follow digital trends, enjoy creating content and want to understand how brands are built, marketed and scaled.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of 
**content creation, brand strategy, digital marketing and business development**
, contributing directly to the development of a new consumer venture.

**Role Overview**

As a 
**Brand & Content Strategy Intern**
, you will work closely with the team at Punekar Group to develop the digital presence, brand identity and marketing initiatives of Aléxander & Victoria.

The role combines creative execution with strategic thinking and business analysis. You will be involved in creating digital content, researching consumer preferences, developing marketing campaigns, analysing competitors and supporting initiatives that contribute to the brand’s growth.

Beyond content creation, this role offers practical exposure to consumer behaviour, brand positioning, go-to-market planning and the commercial decisions involved in building a consumer business.

We are looking for someone who can 
**think strategically, create compelling content and approach business challenges with an entrepreneurial mindset.**

Roles & Responsibilities

* **Content Production:**
   Conceptualise, script, shoot and edit engaging reels, short-form videos, carousels, stories and other digital content for Aléxander & Victoria (AnV).
* **Creative Storytelling:**
   Develop compelling hooks, narratives, captions and creative concepts that communicate product benefits, beauty trends and lifestyle ideas in formats that resonate with Gen Z audiences.
* **Social Media Execution:**
   Plan and publish content, experiment with emerging formats and AI-powered creative tools, and improve content based on reach, watch time, engagement and audience response.
* **Brand Positioning & Identity:**
   Help develop and maintain the brand’s visual identity, tone of voice and communication style across social media and other digital touchpoints.
* **Market & Competitor Research:**
   Analyse beauty and skincare brands, consumer preferences, industry trends and competitor campaigns to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.
* **Campaigns & Influencer Marketing:**
   Support the development of brand campaigns, product launch communication and influencer collaborations to strengthen brand awareness and audience engagement.
* **Digital Marketing & Paid Campaigns:**
   Assist in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across relevant platforms, including Instagram and Meta Ads, to increase brand awareness, reach target audiences and support customer acquisition.
* **SEO & E-commerce Marketing:**
   Support search engine optimisation (SEO), keyword research, website content optimisation and digital growth initiatives to improve online visibility, attract relevant traffic and support future e-commerce sales.
* **Consumer & Market Insights:**
   Research target audiences, purchasing behaviour, customer preferences and emerging market opportunities to support business and marketing decisions.
* **Growth & Performance Analysis:**
   Evaluate content and campaign performance using relevant metrics, identify growth opportunities and recommend improvements based on data and consumer feedback.
* **Business Strategy & Execution:**
   Contribute to go-to-market planning, marketing initiatives and growth projects, understanding how content and branding support customer acquisition, brand development and broader business objectives.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for individuals who combine 
**creative ability, business acumen, communication skills and a strong bias towards execution.**

* **Academic Background:**
   Candidates pursuing or holding a degree in Business Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Management Studies, Communications or a related discipline are preferred. MBA and postgraduate management students with demonstrated creative abilities are particularly encouraged to apply.
* **Content Creation Experience:**
   Demonstrated interest or experience in creating reels, short-form videos, social media posts, personal-brand content or other digital formats.
* **Business & Marketing Understanding:**
   An interest in branding, consumer behaviour, marketing strategy, entrepreneurship and the commercial factors that influence brand growth.
* **Communication & Storytelling:**
   Strong communication skills and the ability to explain ideas clearly, develop engaging narratives and write compelling scripts or captions.
* **Creative Thinking:**
   An eye for trends, storytelling, visual presentation and the ability to identify why certain content captures attention.
* **Digital Fluency:**
   Familiarity with Instagram, short-form video formats, social media trends and the broader creator economy.
* **Initiative & Ownership:**
   A proactive approach to work, willingness to experiment and the ability to take ideas from concept to execution.
* **Analytical Mindset:**
   An ability to interpret content performance, research competitors and use consumer insights to improve marketing decisions.
* **Interest in Beauty & Lifestyle:**
   An interest in skincare, cosmetics, wellness, consumer brands and Gen Z culture is an advantage.

**Tools & Platforms:**
 Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Instagram, Meta Business Suite, Google Trends, Google Analytics and AI-powered content creation tools will be beneficial. Experience with video editing, on-camera presentation, paid advertising, SEO or e-commerce platforms is an advantage.

**Who Should Apply?**

This is a 
**Founder’s Office role**
 designed for individuals who want to understand how businesses are built, brands are developed and strategic decisions are translated into execution.

The role is suited to business management students, MBA candidates and aspiring entrepreneurs who combine creative thinking with commercial awareness. You should be interested not only in creating content, but also in understanding the business rationale behind marketing decisions, consumer acquisition, brand positioning and growth strategy.

We are looking for individuals who take initiative, think independently, communicate effectively and are comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment where ideas are encouraged and execution matters.

**If you aspire to build a career in management, marketing, entrepreneurship or business strategy, this role offers an opportunity to develop both creative capabilities and a broader understanding of how a business operates and grows.**

**What You Will Gain**

* Practical exposure to building a consumer brand from the ground up.
* Hands-on experience in social media and digital marketing.
* Exposure to brand positioning, consumer research and marketing strategy.
* Experience in influencer marketing, campaign execution and audience growth.
* Practical understanding of paid campaigns, SEO and e-commerce marketing.
* An understanding of go-to-market planning, business development and consumer acquisition.
* Experience using AI tools and performance analytics in modern marketing workflows.
* The opportunity to work closely with the team at Punekar Group and contribute to real business initiatives.

**Compensation**

**Monthly Stipend: ₹6,000–₹10,000 per month**

**Application Process**

Interested candidates may apply through either of the following channels:

* **LinkedIn:**
   Submit your application through the LinkedIn job posting.
* **Email:**
   Send your CV along with proof of work to office@punekargroup.com.

Applicants are encouraged to include relevant work samples, such as reels, social media pages managed, videos created, personal-brand content, design samples, marketing projects or other examples demonstrating their creative and analytical abilities.

title: Team Lead
description:
**Company:**

Intent Amplify

**Location:**

Magarpatta Cybercity, Hadapsar, Pune

**Work Model:**

Work From Office (WFO) – Mandatory

**Shift:**

US Business Hours / Night Shift (India)

**Experience:**

4–8 years in B2B telemarketing, lead qualification or appointment generation, including 1–2

years of team leadership

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**About Intent Amplify**

At Intent Amplify, we believe successful B2B marketing is not about generating more names. It's about

identifying the right buyers, creating meaningful engagement and delivering qualified demand that Sales

teams can act on.

We are a B2B Revenue Activation company helping technology organizations connect market intelligence,

audience engagement, demand generation and buyer qualification into a measurable commercial

journey.

Our capabilities include:

**GTM Intelligence & Strategy:**

Market research, ICP development, target-account intelligence and

buying-group identification.

**Media & Marketing Activation:**

Thought leadership, executive interviews, content distribution

and audience engagement.

**Demand Generation:**

ICP-aligned campaigns, content syndication, MQLs and demand activation.

•
**Webinar & Event Audience Activation:**

Targeted registration campaigns and event audience

development.

**Pipeline Activation:**

Progressive lead qualification, including SAL, Intent, ANT, BANT and SQL

programs, enabling stronger Sales follow-up.

•
**Appointment Generation:**

Prospect engagement, discovery, objection handling and qualified

meeting coordination where required by the program.

Through
**CyberTech Intelligence**

, we also bring specialized cybersecurity market knowledge, security

buyer intelligence and engagement with relevant cybersecurity audiences.

Learn more:

https://intentamplify.com/

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a hands-on, performance-driven Team Lead – Operations who can build, coach and lead

a team responsible for engaging B2B decision-makers, qualifying buyer interest and generating high

quality sales conversations.

This is not a role focused only on managing dial counts or preparing daily reports.

We want someone who understands the difference between a contact and a qualified buyer, can turn

campaign requirements into effective calling strategies, and knows how to develop agents into confident

B2B sales professionals.

You'll work closely with our Campaign Operations, Quality, Revenue Execution and GTM teams to ensure

that campaign delivery meets agreed client expectations.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Team Leadership & Performance**

•Lead and manage a team of Telemarketing Executives and Appointment Generation Specialists.

• Set clear daily, weekly and monthly performance expectations.

• Monitor calling productivity, meaningful conversations, qualification outcomes and appointment

performance.

• Conduct daily huddles, coaching sessions, performance reviews and call audits.

• Identify performance gaps and implement measurable improvement plans.

• Support onboarding, training and skill development for new team members.

• Build a culture of accountability, consistency and continuous improvement.

**2. B2B Telemarketing & Lead Qualification**

• Manage outbound calling campaigns targeting US and other approved international B2B markets.

• Ensure agents understand campaign ICP, target accounts, buyer personas and qualification

requirements.

• Guide teams across MQL, SAL, Intent, ANT, BANT and SQL qualification programs.

• Train agents to identify business challenges, buyer interest, decision-making authority and

timelines.

• Ensure qualification evidence is captured accurately rather than assumed.

• Maintain lead quality, data accuracy and compliance with agreed client criteria.

• Monitor lead rejection reasons and implement corrective actions.

**3. Appointment Generation & Sales Conversations**

• Lead appointment generation campaigns involving senior B2B decision-makers.

• Coach agents on prospect research, cold-call openings, discovery questions, value articulation and

objection handling.

• Improve conversion from conversations to qualified meetings.

• Ensure appointments meet agreed campaign criteria before client handoff.

• Support meeting confirmations, follow-ups and rescheduling.

• Review meeting outcomes and use feedback to improve qualification and calling effectiveness.

**4. Campaign Execution & Client Delivery**

• Translate campaign briefs into practical execution plans for the calling team.

• Understand campaign goals, qualification frameworks, delivery timelines and acceptance criteria.

• Collaborate with Campaign Operations, Quality and Revenue Execution teams.

• Monitor campaign pacing, conversion trends, lead quality and delivery risks.

• Escalate operational issues proactively and recommend corrective action.

• Ensure CRM updates, disposition codes, call notes and qualification records are accurate and

complete.

• Support reporting and campaign reviews with actionable insights.

**5. Coaching, Quality & Continuous Improvement**

• Conduct regular call listening and structured feedback sessions.

• Develop scripts, discovery frameworks and objection-handling playbooks.

• Improve agent confidence when engaging Directors, VPs, CXOs and other senior decision-makers.

• Identify effective messaging, call approaches and qualification questions.

• Share campaign-level insights to improve targeting, messaging and performance.

• Lead by example through live calling, demonstrations and difficult prospect conversations when

required.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Requirements**

• Graduate degree from a recognized university.

• 4–8 years of relevant experience in B2B telemarketing, international lead generation, lead

qualification or appointment generation.

• At least 1–2 years of experience leading a calling or appointment generation team.

• Demonstrated experience working on US-market B2B campaigns.

• Strong understanding of MQL, SAL, BANT and SQL qualification methodologies.

• Practical experience conducting cold calls, discovery conversations and objection handling.

• Experience managing campaign delivery targets, agent performance and quality standards.

• Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

• Proficiency with CRM systems, calling platforms, Excel and performance reporting.

• Ability and willingness to work from our Pune office during US business hours.

**Preferred Experience**

• B2B technology, SaaS, cloud, IT services or cybersecurity campaigns.

• Appointment generation targeting enterprise or mid-market decision-makers.

• Managing multiple client campaigns with different qualification requirements.

• Coaching underperforming agents and improving team conversion rates.

• Working with US-based clients or stakeholders.

• Familiarity with account-based marketing and target-account lists.

**How You'll Make a Difference**

Your impact will go beyond the number of calls your team makes.

You'll help us:

-
**Turn activity into quality:**

Improve the proportion of conversations that produce relevant, validated buyer

intelligence.

-
**Build stronger talent:**

Develop agents who can confidently engage business decision-makers rather than

simply read scripts.

-
**Improve client outcomes:**

Ensure the leads and appointments delivered align with agreed qualification

standards.

-
**Create execution consistency:**

Build repeatable calling, coaching, quality and reporting practices.

-
**Strengthen Sales readiness:**

Help clients receive better-qualified buyers with clearer context for follow-up.

-
**Build a performance-driven team:**

Create an environment where productivity, quality, ownership and

professional development reinforce one another

.
**What Success Looks Like**

Your performance will be evaluated across both productivity and delivery quality, including:

• Daily calling and outreach productivity against defined team targets.

• Meaningful conversation and connection rates.

• Lead qualification and acceptance rates.

• Qualified appointments scheduled and held, where contracted.

• Campaign delivery against agreed timelines and requirements.

• CRM accuracy, documentation and compliance.

• Team coaching effectiveness and individual performance improvement.

• Client feedback, campaign quality and operational consistency.

**We value measurable outcomes not activity numbers alone.**

**Why Join Intent Amplify?**

**1. Lead a team that contributes to real commercial outcomes.**

You'll help shape how B2B technology

companies identify, engage and qualify prospective buyers.

**2. Work beyond traditional telemarketing.**

Gain exposure to demand generation, account-based

marketing, buyer intelligence, qualification frameworks and pipeline activation.

**3. Develop leadership capabilities.**

Own team coaching, execution quality, performance improvement

and campaign delivery.

**4. Gain exposure to international B2B markets.**

Work on programs involving US-market technology

companies, enterprise audiences and senior decision-makers.

**5. Influence how campaigns are executed.**

Your insights from live prospect conversations can directly

inform messaging, qualification and operational improvements.

**6. Grow with a revenue-focused organization.**

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to evolving

sales processes, team capabilities and scalable delivery practices.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**

- Someone who enjoys developing people but is equally comfortable getting involved in execution.

- Someone who can explain why a campaign isn't performing and knows how to improve it.

- Someone who understands that a successful calling team needs strong conversations, accurate

qualification, consistent coaching and disciplined execution.

- Most importantly, someone who takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply supervising

activities.

**If you believe great teams create great conversations and great conversations create stronger**

**commercial opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.**

**Apply:**

Share your updated resume with our recruitment team, mentioning Team Lead – Operations in

the subject line.

**Location:**

Magarpatta Cybercity, Hadapsar, Pune

**Work Mode:**

Full-Time | Work From Office | US Shift

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role

Éprise is a consumer brand, and social media is one of our most important channels for building awareness, community, and sales. We're looking for a Social Media Manager to own the brand's voice and content across every public-facing channel. You'll decide what goes live, why it goes live, and how it grows our audience, with a strong focus on growing our Instagram following.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Content Ownership Across Channels**

* Own all content published on Instagram, LinkedIn, the website, and paid ads.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice, look, and message across every platform.
* Approve everything before it goes live, including captions, creatives, copy, and landing page content.
* Build and manage a monthly content calendar with clear themes, formats, and posting schedules.

**2. Strategy**

* Create and execute a social media strategy tied to business goals (awareness, engagement, leads, sales).
* Define content pillars for each platform. For example, Instagram for product, lifestyle, and community; LinkedIn for brand story, founder voice, and hiring.
* Research competitors, trends, and audience behaviour to keep the strategy sharp.
* Plan campaigns around product launches, festivals, and seasonal moments.

**3. Instagram Growth**

* Own the plan to grow Instagram followers, with monthly follower and engagement targets.
* Drive reach through Reels, carousels, Stories, collaborations, and trending formats.
* Run influencer, creator, and UGC collaborations. Source, brief, and manage creators.
* Build community through comments, DMs, and customer shout-outs.
* Optimise bio, highlights, hashtags, posting times, and profile to improve discovery and conversion.

**4. Paid Ads and Website Content**

* Work with the performance or ads team (or agency) on ad creatives, copy, and messaging for Meta and other paid channels.
* Review ad performance and recommend creative changes based on results.
* Ensure website copy, banners, and product content match the brand and campaign messaging.

**5. Execution and Team Coordination**

* Brief and manage designers, video editors, photographers, copywriters, and freelancers.
* Oversee shoots for product, lifestyle, and Reels content.
* Handle publishing, scheduling, and community management, or supervise those who do.

**6. Analytics and Reporting**

* Track KPIs such as follower growth, reach, engagement rate, video views, link clicks, and conversions.
* Share a weekly snapshot and a monthly performance report with the Founder, covering what worked, what didn't, and what's next.
* Run experiments (formats, hooks, posting times) and double down on what performs.

**7. Brand Safety and Reputation**

* Monitor comments, mentions, and reviews, and respond promptly and on-brand.
* Escalate sensitive issues and handle negative feedback professionally.

Key Performance Indicators

* Monthly Instagram follower growth against target
* Engagement rate and reach per post
* Content calendar adherence (on-time, on-brand publishing)
* Ad creative performance (CTR, cost per result)
* Traffic and sales attributed to social channels
* Quality and consistency of the brand voice

Requirements

**Must have**

* 1-3years of experience managing social media for a brand, preferably D2C, FMCG, or consumer products
* A proven record of growing an Instagram account organically
* Strong writing and copywriting skills in English (Hindi is a plus)
* Hands-on experience with Reels, short-form video, and trend-driven content
* Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, scheduling tools, and analytics
* Understanding of paid social and ad creative fundamentals
* Basic skills in Canva, CapCut, or similar tools

**Good to have**

* Experience with influencer marketing and UGC campaigns
* Basic knowledge of SEO and website content
* Experience with LinkedIn brand or founder-led content
* Photography or video shooting skills

What We're Looking For

* A creative thinker who also loves numbers
* Someone who takes ownership and doesn't need to be chased
* Quick to spot trends, but disciplined about brand consistency
* Comfortable working directly with the founder and moving fast in a growing company

What We Offer

* Ownership of the brand's entire social presence
* Direct access to the founder and real decision-making power
* Room to grow into a Head of Marketing or Brand role as the company scales

**To apply:**
Send your CV along with links to the social accounts you've managed or grown, plus one example of content you're proud of, to mahima@eprise.life

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
**Job description:**

Company: Chasing Illusions Studio Pvt. Ltd.

Location: On-site, Kashmere Gate, Delhi

Experience: 2–3 Years

Job Type: Full-time, On-site

Search is changing.

Ranking on Google is no longer enough.

Today, brands also need to appear in AI Overviews, featured answers, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot and other AI-powered discovery platforms.

Chasing Illusions Studio is looking for an AI SEO Specialist who understands both sides of modern organic visibility:

Traditional SEO + Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) + Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

This is not a role for someone who only knows keyword research, backlinks and meta tags.

We need someone who understands how search engines crawl, rank and evaluate content — and also how AI systems discover, interpret, cite, summarize and recommend brands.

What You’ll Own

**1. Traditional SEO**

You should have strong hands-on knowledge of:

●     Keyword research and search intent mapping

●     Competitor and SERP analysis

●     On-page + Technical SEO audits

●     Content optimization + Internal linking strategy

●     URL structure and website architecture

●     Meta details (title, description, headings, etc.)

●     Image SEO

●     Schema markup + Core Web Vitals

●     XML sitemaps and robots.txt

●     Canonicalization

●     Indexing and crawlability

●     Page speed optimization

●     Duplicate content management

●     Redirects and 404 issues

●     Backlink analysis and link-building

●     Local and location-based SEO

●     Google Search Console and Google Analytics

●     Organic traffic, ranking and conversion analysis

You should be comfortable diagnosing why a page is not ranking, not indexing, losing traffic or underperforming against competitors.

**2. AEO — Answer Engine Optimization**

We need someone who understands how to optimize content for direct answers, not just blue-link rankings.

You should know how to:

●     Structure content around real user questions

●     Identify conversational and long-tail queries

●     Optimize for featured snippets

●     Build FAQ-driven content strategically

●     Improve answer clarity and information hierarchy

●     Create concise answer-first sections

●     Optimize content for voice and conversational search

●     Use relevant structured data/schema

●     Improve topical authority through question clusters

●     Analyze People Also Ask and related-question opportunities

●     Match content format with informational, commercial and transactional intent

The objective is simple:

When users ask a question related to our services, our content should have a strong chance of becoming the answer.

**3. GEO — Generative Engine Optimization**

This is a critical part of the role.

You should understand how brands can improve their visibility across generative AI platforms and AI-powered search experiences.

You will work on:

●     Optimizing content for AI Overviews

●     Increasing brand/entity visibility in generative search

●     Building strong topical and entity associations

●     Creating content that AI systems can easily understand and summarize

●     Improving factual clarity and semantic relationships

●     Strengthening E-E-A-T signals

●     Developing citation-worthy content

●     Creating original statistics, insights, examples and expert-led content

●     Building topic clusters and knowledge depth

●     Strengthening brand mentions across authoritative third-party sources

●     Monitoring how Chasing Illusions Studio appears in AI-generated answers

●     Tracking competitor visibility across AI search platforms

●     Identifying prompts where our competitors appear but we do not

●     Improving content so it can be referenced or recommended by AI systems

You should understand that GEO is not keyword stuffing for ChatGPT.

It requires strong content structure, authority, entities, citations, context, relevance and brand signals.

**4. Content Strategy for Search + AI Discovery**

You must have knowledge of content writing + optimization for at least 2 years.

Your responsibility will be to identify:

What are people searching?

What are they asking AI?

What problems are they trying to solve?

What type of content would make our brand the most useful answer?

**5. SEO + AI Visibility Analysis**

We expect you to think beyond rankings.

You should regularly analyze:

●     Google organic rankings + Search impressions

●     CTR + Organic traffic

●     Conversion opportunities

●     Competitor content + Content gaps

●     SERP features + Search intent satisfaction

●     ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity brand mentions + AI Overview appearances

●     Citation opportunities + Entity visibility

●     Topic authority + Backlink quality

Your reports should answer:

What improved?

What declined?

Why did it happen?

What should we do next?

Not just screenshots and exported spreadsheets.

Tools You Should Be Comfortable With

Experience with most of the following is expected:

●     Google Search Console + Google Analytics 4

●     Google Keyword Planner + Ahrefs / Semrush / similar SEO tools + Google Trends

●     Screaming Frog

●     PageSpeed Insights

●     Google Tag Manager

●     Schema testing tools

●     ChatGPT + Perplexity + Gemini + similar AI websites

●     AI-search monitoring or visibility tools

**Who We Are Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if:

●     You have
**2–3 years of hands-on SEO experience**

●     You have independently handled SEO projects

●     You understand technical SEO, not just content optimization

●     You understand the difference between
**SEO, AEO and GEO**

●     You actively follow changes in Google Search and AI search

●     You understand search intent deeply

●     You can identify ranking and traffic problems independently

●     You understand that modern SEO is increasingly about
**visibility, authority and answers — not just rankings**

**What We Do NOT Need**

We are not looking for someone whose SEO experience is limited to:

●     Adding keywords into content

●     Submitting backlinks to directories

●     Posting generic guest blogs

●     Checking rankings every morning

●     Generating AI articles without strategy

●     Following outdated SEO checklists

We need someone capable of thinking strategically about how a brand gets discovered across both search engines and AI engines.

**Why This Role Matters?**

Search behavior is moving from:

“Search → Click → Read”

toward:

“Ask → Compare → Get an AI-generated recommendation.”

We want someone who understands this transition and can help build our organic visibility for both environments.

If you understand Traditional SEO + AEO + GEO and want to work hands-on with a growing animation and video production company, we’d like to hear from you.

**Experience:**

●     SEO: 3 years (Required)

●     Creative writing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

As Multichannel Marketing Manager you will be responsible for establishing an integrated digital support network for the development of e-commerce channel partnering across Haleon. You will also develop and execute an integrated business plan while managing relationships with strategic partners and pilot initiatives. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career.
  
  
These responsibilities include some of the following:

:

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

title: Customer Relationship Management Team Lead
description:
**About ibaby**

ibaby is a premium baby retail brand offering parents in India a curated range of essentials across feeding, travel gear, bath & body, toys, and more. With stores in Gurgaon and Punjabi Bagh, along with our growing e-commerce platform at ibabyxpress.com, we are on a mission to become India's most trusted destination for premium baby essentials.

**About the Role**

As a CRM Manager at ibaby, you will own the customer lifecycle end-to-end—building and executing retention strategies, driving repeat purchases through smart segmentation, and ensuring every customer touchpoint (phone, WhatsApp, email, social) strengthens the relationship with our brand. You will work closely with Shopify and Google Sheets/CRM data to identify high-value segments, design targeted campaigns, and turn one-time buyers into loyal customers. This role suits someone who thinks in funnels and cohorts, but is just as comfortable getting on a call to close a sale or resolve an issue personally.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the CRM strategy—design and execute lifecycle campaigns (welcome series, win-back, upsell, loyalty, seasonal offers) across email, WhatsApp, and calls.
* Build and maintain customer segmentation frameworks using Shopify and Google Sheets data to identify high-value, at-risk, and repeat-purchase opportunities.
* Drive proactive outreach—calls and messages—to convert segments into repeat purchases and upsells.
* Set up and monitor CRM performance metrics: conversion rates, response rates, repeat purchase rate, CLV, and campaign ROI, reporting insights regularly.
* Oversee customer query resolution across phone, WhatsApp, email, and social media, ensuring a consistent, professional, and prompt brand voice.
* Manage order-related communication (updates, delays, exchanges, returns) with a resolution-first approach, feeding recurring issues back into process improvements.
* Partner with store and marketing teams to align outreach calendars, promotions, and messaging.
* Gather and structure customer feedback into actionable insights for product, marketing, and operations teams.
* Continuously refine customer data hygiene and organization across Shopify and Google Sheets to support accurate segmentation and reporting.

**Requirements**

* 2-5+ years of experience in CRM, customer retention, tele-sales, or a similar customer lifecycle role.
* Excellent spoken and written English with clear, warm, and professional communication.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Google Sheets for data analysis, segmentation, and campaign tracking.
* Comfortable making outbound sales calls and following up to drive conversions.
* Familiarity with Shopify or another e-commerce platform is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills; able to translate data into action.
* Empathetic, patient, and solution-oriented, especially when working with new parents.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in retail, e-commerce, or a baby/parenting brand.
* Exposure to WhatsApp Business API, bulk messaging tools, or CRM platforms.
* Working knowledge of email marketing platforms (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.) and basic segmentation/automation logic

description:
# Seeking Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner | ₹10 Lakhs+ Investment | Healthcare, Education & Technology
  
  
I am looking for an entrepreneurial \*\*Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner\*\* who can bring investment, sales and marketing expertise to help build and scale a healthcare-focused digital business with ambitions in India and globally.
  
  
## About Our Existing Digital Assets
  
  
We have developed multiple healthcare-focused websites and media assets that are receiving website traffic. We are now preparing to monetise these platforms and establish sustainable revenue streams.
  
  
\*\*Our current platforms include:\*\*
  
  
\*\*1. DentalClinicAlly.com — Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Helping Indian dentists with dental clinic setup consulting, business Planning, dental clinic growth strategies & Dentist Brand development.
  
  
\*\*2. DentistUpgrade.com — Dental Education & Government Job information - Career Platform\*\*
  
  
Our vision is to develop DentistUpgrade.com into a \*\*global training platform for dentists\*\*, offering:
  
  
\* Hands-on clinical training programmes.
  
\* Online courses for dentists.
  
\* Continuing professional learning opportunities.
  
\* Educational resources to help dentists enhance their clinical knowledge and professional skills.
  
\* Government Dental job listings and career-related opportunities.
  
  
\*\*3. Medihel365.com — Healthcare Digital Platform, Health care services provide Directory\*\*
  
  
An additional digital asset with potential to serve broader healthcare audiences as our business develops.
  
  
\*\*4. Chikitsa Katha & Medical Help 365days\*\*
  
  
Our medical-related YouTube channels, providing opportunities to develop healthcare education content and explore future monetisation.
  
  
## Our Long-Term Business Vision
  
  
We plan to build a broader healthcare services, education and technology business through four major areas:
  
  
\*\*1. Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Help dentists establish, manage and grow their clinics through practical business consultancy and customised growth planning.
  
  
\*\*2. Global Dental Training & Education\*\*
  
  
Build DentistUpgrade.com into a global platform offering hands-on training, online courses and professional learning opportunities for dentists.
  
  
\*\*3. Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency\*\*
  
  
Provide specialised digital marketing, lead generation and patient acquisition services to dentists, clinics and other healthcare service providers.
  
  
\*\*4. Patient & Clinic Management Software\*\*
  
  
Explore the development of software to support clinic operations, patient management, appointment workflows and practice administration.
  
  
Our initial focus will be on dentists, with plans to expand into other healthcare services as we validate demand and build our capabilities.
  
  
## Who Are We Looking For?
  
  
I am seeking a strategic partner who can contribute both capital and practical business-building expertise.
  
  
\*\*Key requirements:\*\*
  
  
\* Minimum proposed investment of \*\*₹10 lakhs\*\*.
  
\* Strong experience in sales, marketing, business development or entrepreneurship.
  
\* Ability to develop customer acquisition strategies and generate paying customers.
  
\* Experience in healthcare, dental education, digital marketing, EdTech, SaaS or HealthTech will be an advantage.
  
\* Ability to develop strategic partnerships with dentists, training providers, clinics and healthcare organisations.
  
\* A long-term vision for building a scalable healthcare business in India and internationally.
  
  
## Role & Responsibilities
  
  
The selected partner will work with me to:
  
  
\* Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies.
  
\* Acquire our first paying customers and establish repeatable revenue channels.
  
\* Build partnerships for dental training, education and healthcare services.
  
\* Develop revenue models for our existing websites and digital assets.
  
\* Explore opportunities in healthcare digital marketing and clinic management software.
  
\* Help establish and scale our dental education platform for a global audience.
  
  
## What We Bring
  
  
I bring \*\*12+ years of dental experience and experience owning two dental clinics\*\*, along with existing websites, digital platforms and healthcare-related media assets.
  
  
We have a foundation to build upon, and our current priority is to convert existing website traffic into paying customers, validate our business models and develop our future services progressively.
  
  
\*\*Please note:\*\* We are currently at an early stage of monetisation and are not yet generating revenue from these ventures. Our future initiatives will depend on market validation, investment and execution.
  
  
## Interested in Building This Business Together?
  
  
If you have the investment capacity, relevant experience and entrepreneurial mindset, I would welcome a discussion.
  
  
Please message me on LinkedIn with:
  
  
1. Your professional background and entrepreneurial experience.
  
2. Your sales, marketing, education or technology expertise.
  
3. Your proposed role and contribution.
  
4. Your investment capacity and expectations.
  
  
This is a \*\*co-founder and strategic investment partnership opportunity, not a salaried job\*\*. Equity participation, investment terms, responsibilities and governance will be discussed transparently and documented through appropriate legal agreements. Investment does not guarantee returns.
  
  
Let's explore the opportunity to build a healthcare, dental education and technology business with global ambitions.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.
  
  
You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.
  
  
**The Role**
As the Growth Manager, you will sit at the intersection of our elite GTM Engineering team and our high-accountability sales culture. You will be responsible for taking our sophisticated AI suite of products to market. You will have the freedom to experiment but the responsibility to measure, iterate, and scale what works.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and manage the Coram growth engine across conventional channels (Email, Webinars, Physical Events) and digital experiments
* Work side-by-side with our engineering team to automate lead gen workflows and build custom GTM tools that give us a 10x edge over legacy incumbents
* Develop structured GTM playbooks for our core industries (Warehousing, Education, and Manufacturing) translating technical AI capabilities into clear value for operational buyers
* Own full funnel execution by focusing on data from first touchpoint to closed-won, ensuring every marketing dollar is an investment in a repeatable system

**Skills And Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of experience in B2B growth/demand generation, including ownership of pipeline targets, ideally in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment
* An advanced degree from a reputable organization in a relevant field
* Experience in writing high-converting copy for a physical security director with the ability to explain the logic of a multi-step automation workflow to engineers or other technical stakeholders
* Ability to strategically assess various marketing channels on a strategic level (You don't just see a webinar; you see a data-collection opportunity, a content-recycling loop, and a lead-scoring variable)
* Experience using LLMs and automation tools to 5x your own productivity, and an enthusiasm to build similar AI agents for our marketing stack
* Enthusiasm for collaborating with engineers and other technical stakeholders
* Proven experience operating in in high agency, 0 → 1 environments
* Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels.
* Ability to work in an onsite environment

**What We Offer**

* Flexible paid time off and paid holidays
* Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses
* Regular team offsites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.
  
  
Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

title: Growth Marketing Leader - APAC
description:
Ascendion is a fast-growth, AI-native software engineering company redefining how software, platforms, and intelligent agents are built and delivered at scale. We are hiring a
**Growth Marketing Leader for India**
to drive above-market growth through disciplined field marketing, account-based programs, and tight pursuit support that directly enables our sales and markets teams.
  
  
This role is for a builder hungry to make a mark and capable of operating at speed inside a global services business that is scaling fast.
  
  
This role has two distinct responsibilities.
  
  

* Growth marketing for Ascendion across India and APAC growth markets. This is field marketing, pipeline generation, pursuit support, and brand activation, with your feet on the ground. 80% of your time goes here (India and APAC growth markets; e.g., Singapore).
* Global portfolio marketing for our Global Capability Center offering. This means building the category narrative and go-to-market motion for an offering that's sold and delivered worldwide, not just out of India. 20% of your time will be here. That balance will shift as the business scales, creating meaningful opportunity for expanded scope.

****What You'll Own And Drive****
*Field Marketing and Pipeline Generation (Primary Accountability)*
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Own the field marketing engine for India: ABM programs, in-person and virtual events, executive engagement, and pursuit-aligned marketing that directly supports active deals.
* Partner daily with the Markets (Sales) team — not as a service function, but as a force multiplier. You are in the room, on the pursuit, at the client.
* Build and run account-based programs targeting named accounts and key verticals with precision. Volume without targeting is noise.
* Orchestrate integrated GTM motions: campaigns, sales enablement materials, roundtables, and executive-level engagement that shorten cycles and strengthen positions.
* Bring a sales-adjacent mindset to everything. You understand how deals are won. You build marketing that helps win them.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Growth in influenced pipeline from India and APAC Growth Market regions via events, executive connects, campaigns, and account-based marketing.
* Increase in net-new logo additions from India and APAC Growth Market regions influenced by marketing.
* Growth in pipeline sourced specifically through marketing-led events.

*Pursuit Support*
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Embed directly into active pursuits alongside sales leadership. Translate Ascendion's capabilities into compelling, buyer-relevant narratives under real time pressure.
* Support RFP responses, pursuit decks, and executive briefing materials where marketing has a tangible role in the outcome.
* Ensure every pursuit has the right story, the right evidence, and the right differentiation — not boilerplate.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Increase in the number and TCV of active pursuits directly supported by marketing (proposals, solutioning, asset development, presentations).
* Higher conversion of marketing-supported pursuits into bookings, measured in both count and TCV.

*Brand Activation in Market (India)*
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Activate and localize the Ascendion brand across India: analysts, media, digital, social, and executive visibility.
* Work in close coordination with the global brand and content team — your role is to adapt and amplify global positioning for India audiences, not to operate independently of it.
* Build market presence that earns credibility with buyers and feeds the pipeline.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Brand visibility and credibility in India and key APAC markets reflected in media coverage, analyst recognition, and share of voice versus competitors.
* Growth in digital and social engagement in-market (e.g., site traffic, LinkedIn engagement, executive visibility, campaigns) leading to pipeline.
* Meaningful contribution to Ascendion's APAC growth target through market presence that builds buyer credibility.

**Portfolio Marketing: Global GCC-AI Offering (~20% of role)**
Ascendion is already delivering global capability center (GCC) services globally. We're deploying AI platforms to improve how GCC work is done. For clients, this means faster innovation, process transparency, productivity, and capital unlock. We anticipate this will be a powerful growth engine for the firm. GCC pipeline is a shared metric that will be co-owned with a dedicated sales leader
  
  
***Essential Responsibilities:***

* Build and execute the go-to-market and portfolio marketing strategy for our GCC services, positioning our AI-enabled delivery model against traditional GCC and outsourcing competitors.
* Develop messaging and positioning that translates our AI-driven delivery advantage into buyer-relevant value for CXO and procurement audiences across target geographies.
* Partner with sales and delivery leadership to build enablement assets (case studies, ROI models, competitive battlecards, video assets, thought leadership, etc.) to support this fast-growing offering.
* Design and run demand generation campaigns (digital, events, ABM) targeting enterprise buyers evaluating GCC strategies globally.

***Anticipated Impact:***

* Marketing-influenced GCC pipeline globally.
* Stronger message resonance in sales win/loss feedback.
* Sales team adoption of enablement materials.
* Greater analyst and brand recognition in target segments.

****Who This Role Is For****
This role is designed for someone with experience and on the rise. You likely have:
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, with increasing scope and impact over time.
* A genuine services background. You have worked inside a global technology services firm — consulting, IT services, managed services, or professional services — and you understand how those businesses sell, how clients buy, and what "pursuit" actually means.
* Hands-on field marketing experience: running events, executing ABM programs, building enablement materials, and supporting sales in live deals. Not managing agencies at arm's length.
* A sales-adjacent orientation. You may have started in sales, or worked so closely with sales teams that you think like one. You are not intimidated by revenue targets. You are energized by them.
* Experience working across global teams and adapting global strategy for regional markets without losing clarity or consistency.
* Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where impact matters more than process.

You are a field and growth marketer with the credibility to walk into a client conversation or a pursuit review and add immediate value.
  
  
****What We're Specifically Looking For****

* Proven track record driving pipeline and pursuit outcomes in India markets (with numbers to back it).
* Demonstrated experience in a global technology services environment.
* Evidence of hands-on execution: events run, ABM programs built, sales enablement delivered, pursuits supported. Supervision and delegation are fantastic, but we are looking for people who roll up their sleeves and personally get things done.
* High engagement as a working style. You actively seek contact with the Markets team. You are in the meetings, on the calls, at the events. You complement and enable sales. You are highly proactive.
* A history of shifting how a company is perceived in a market through consistent, disciplined storytelling.
* Ability to work fluidly within a global marketing structure: aligning to global brand standards and content direction while executing with regional relevance.
* Comfortable engaging external analysts, clients, and partners as well as internal stakeholders including senior global and regional leadership.
* Fluency in AI-powered marketing tools and workflows. High motivation to do more by leveraging all that AI can offer (without losing the human-touch impact).

And also…
**We need evidence of personal storytelling capability.**
We will review recent work product (where permitted) from 2-3 prior employers or engagements.

title: Senior Manager – Technical Sales & Business Development
description:
**Senior Manager – Technical Sales & Business Development**

**Product:**
PSA Nitrogen Generators – TriEquion™

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Territory:**
Pan-India

**Experience:**
8+ years

**Engagement:**
Full-time

**About the Opportunity**

We are looking for a commercially driven and technically proficient professional to lead sales and market development for industrial PSA Nitrogen Generator systems across India.

The role is suited to an experienced Technical Sales professional who understands engineered industrial products and can translate technical specifications into practical customer solutions and business outcomes.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, understanding application requirements, presenting technical solutions, preparing commercial proposals and converting opportunities into orders.

In addition to individual sales ownership, the role will involve supervising and mentoring a junior team member, strengthening sales processes and contributing to the expansion of the business across relevant industrial segments.

**About the Product**

The role focuses on PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption) Nitrogen Generator systems, including the TriEquion™ product range.

These systems generate nitrogen on-site for industrial applications where customers require a dependable nitrogen supply with specific purity, flow and pressure requirements.

The candidate should be capable of explaining the technology, understanding the customer's process requirements and demonstrating the commercial and operational value of on-site nitrogen generation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Sales & Business Development**

* Drive end-to-end sales of PSA Nitrogen Generator systems across India.
* Identify, qualify and develop new business opportunities across relevant industrial segments.
* Understand customer requirements relating to nitrogen purity, flow capacity, pressure, consumption and application.
* Translate technical requirements into appropriate product configurations and commercially viable solutions, working with engineering teams wherever required.
* Conduct customer meetings, technical presentations, product demonstrations and solution discussions.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and requirement assessment through proposal submission, negotiation and order closure.
* Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to support business growth and revenue targets.

**2. Market Development & Industry Engagement**

* Develop a strong understanding of the Indian market for industrial nitrogen generation systems.
* Identify target customers, high-potential industries, geographic opportunities and new application areas.
* Build relationships with plant heads, engineering teams, operations leaders, procurement stakeholders, consultants, OEMs and system integrators.
* Explore opportunities across industries such as food processing and packaging, pharmaceuticals, electronics, metal processing and laser cutting, chemicals, petrochemicals and other nitrogen-intensive manufacturing applications.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market trends, customer expectations and pricing dynamics.
* Participate in industry exhibitions, technical seminars, customer events and other relevant marketing initiatives.
* Develop territory-level sales and market-development plans to improve market penetration.

**3. Technical Solutioning & Commercial Proposals**

* Develop a sound understanding of PSA technology, nitrogen generation, compressed-air requirements, system capacity, gas purity and operating economics.
* Explain product functionality, technical advantages, operational benefits and application suitability to prospective customers.
* Work closely with engineering and technical teams to validate customer specifications and recommend suitable solutions.
* Prepare and present technical and commercial proposals, quotations, cost estimates and supporting documentation.
* Develop customer-specific business cases covering operating costs, potential savings, total cost of ownership and return on investment.
* Support technical clarifications, commercial negotiations and solution validation throughout the sales process.
* Ensure that proposed solutions are aligned with customer requirements, product capabilities and commercial objectives.

**4. Customer Relationship Management**

* Establish and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Understand customer operating challenges and position solutions based on business value rather than price alone.
* Maintain regular engagement with key accounts and track opportunities for additional systems, upgrades and repeat business.
* Coordinate with engineering, project execution and service teams during order handover and project delivery.
* Support customer satisfaction and long-term account development.
* Resolve commercial and pre-sales queries in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

**5. Sales Strategy, Planning & Reporting**

* Develop and execute annual, quarterly and monthly sales plans.
* Track sales pipeline, order bookings, revenue, conversion rates and forecast performance.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, customer information and opportunity-stage updates.
* Prepare periodic sales reports and business forecasts for leadership review.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of sales initiatives and identify opportunities to improve sales productivity.
* Contribute market intelligence and customer feedback to product, pricing and business strategy discussions.

**6. Team Management & Mentoring**

* Manage and guide a junior sales resource with approximately 3–5 years of experience.
* Allocate and review leads, customer follow-ups and sales activities.
* Provide technical guidance, product knowledge and coaching on consultative selling.
* Conduct periodic pipeline reviews and monitor individual and team sales performance.
* Support joint customer visits, proposal development and opportunity conversion.
* Establish disciplined processes for CRM updates, sales reporting and customer follow-up.
* Contribute to building a productive, accountable and customer-focused sales team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in technical sales, industrial equipment sales, capital equipment sales or industrial business development.
* Demonstrated experience selling technically complex products or engineered industrial solutions.
* Proven ability to understand technical requirements and convert them into customer solutions and commercial opportunities.
* Experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, solution discussions, proposals, negotiations and order closure.
* Strong customer engagement and relationship-management capabilities.
* Experience in sales planning, opportunity management, forecasting and reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or supervise junior sales professionals.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India.
* Strong verbal and written communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

**Preferred Technical & Industry Experience**

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:

* PSA Nitrogen Generators or industrial gas-generation systems.
* Industrial gases and gas-handling solutions.
* Compressed-air systems and associated equipment.
* Process equipment, industrial machinery or capital equipment.
* Industrial automation and process technologies.
* Engineering solutions sold to manufacturing and industrial customers.

Familiarity with PSA technology, Carbon Molecular Sieve (CMS), nitrogen purity specifications, flow rates, operating pressure, compressed-air consumption and relevant industrial applications will be an advantage.

Direct experience selling PSA Nitrogen Generator systems would be particularly valuable.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Technical product understanding and consultative selling.
* Industrial market development and lead generation.
* Customer requirement analysis and solution positioning.
* Technical proposal and commercial quotation preparation.
* Negotiation and order closure.
* Pipeline management, sales forecasting and CRM discipline.
* Customer relationship and key-account development.
* Commercial awareness, including costing, margins and return on investment.
* Team supervision, mentoring and performance management.
* Planning, prioritization, communication and cross-functional collaboration.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance in this role will be evaluated against agreed business targets, including:

**Sales & Commercial Performance**

* Sales revenue and order bookings against target.
* Gross margin and commercial profitability.
* Qualified pipeline value and pipeline coverage.
* Proposal-to-order conversion rate.
* Sales forecast accuracy.

**Market Development**

* New customer acquisition.
* Qualified opportunities generated across target industrial segments.
* Growth in strategic accounts and geographic coverage.
* Development of effective customer, consultant, OEM and channel relationships.

**Sales Execution**

* Timeliness and quality of proposals.
* Opportunity progression and sales-cycle effectiveness.
* Accuracy of CRM data and reporting.
* Customer feedback and successful handover of orders to delivery teams.

**Team Effectiveness**

* Productivity and performance of the junior sales resource.
* Quality of pipeline reviews, coaching and follow-up discipline.
* Achievement of agreed team objectives.

Targets and weightages will be defined in line with business priorities and the annual sales plan.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a technically strong, commercially minded professional who can engage confidently with both engineering teams and business decision-makers.

They should be comfortable discussing technical specifications, identifying customer applications, demonstrating measurable business value and leading negotiations through to order closure.

They must also have the maturity to manage a junior resource, establish sales discipline and independently drive market development across India.

**We are looking for a professional who can understand the technology, communicate its value and turn that understanding into sustainable business growth.**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Assistant Manager, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (TMT- AI Data Centers, Semiconductors, and Tech Hardware Research)**
Deloitte’s Center for TMT is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (R&I) group, focusing primarily on the TMT industry. The Center's goals are to:
  
  

* Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the TMT industry
* Provide practical and actionable insights - whether they are strategic, technical, operational.
* Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the health and evolution of the TMT industry.
* Make extensive use of leading practices from TMT professionals across diverse disciplines, including content strategy, digital distribution, advertising and monetization, consumer analytics, rights management, finance, risk management, regulation, and human capital, to identify innovative steps they have taken to address critical challenges.

Learn more about the TMT Center and have a peek into our work here .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the Technology sector with particular focus primarily on semiconductor and enterprise hardware sub-sectors (including AI data center infrastructure), as well as consumer tech (secondary focus).
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in Technology sector, with a focus on AI tech infrastructure (e.g., data centers, memory, GPUs, networking, edge, etc.), hybrid computing architectures, advanced packaging of hardware and chips, AI in chip design and manufacturing, strategic supply chain chokepoints, and adoption of AI/agent powered consumer devices and edge applications. These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist Assistant Manager, focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse Tech sector (with a focus on semiconductor and enterprise hardware) topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Develop and maintain subsector-level expertise across tech (and specifically hardware, semiconductor and consumer tech) landscape, including emerging technologies, business models, and financial drivers. This includes proactively researching companies, trends, themes, underlying technologies, and potential disruptions through direct study of industry reports, company disclosures and other credible sources.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan. Execute structured research plans by translating business objectives into clear research questions, identifying areas of investigation, and conducting thorough secondary research using relevant and trustworthy industry, company, and news sources.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals – through a combination of expertise and direct study, complemented by AI tools.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and use the relevant data analysis methods and work with the relevant data science and analytics professionals to analyze voluminous and complex datasets.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Being largely autonomous (with minimal supervision) and managing the projects to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines, demonstrating a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Ability to apply sound research judgment by grounding outputs in direct study and critical thinking, while using generative AI tools to enhance efficiency (and not as a substitute for independent synthesis.)
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings

**Requisite Experience And Skills**
**Experience**

* 6-9 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects, preferably in Technology industry related topics and areas as noted earlier in this document.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector skills**

* Business research/thought-leadership development in Technology sector is preferred. Knowledge of AI [1] driven chip demand, AI chips and accelerators that support data centers, role of AI in chip design and manufacturing, chip hardware and integrated systems’ time-to-market, and fab efficiency.
* Familiarity with architectural innovation, heterogeneous compute. (CPU/GPU/NPU/memory/interconnects), chiplet-based designs, co-packaged optics, advanced chip packaging and their role in performance and cost curves.
* Awareness about strategic chokepoints and importance of supply chain resilience for hardware and semiconductor components; Geopolitical and operational risks in this space.
* Consumer and end-user needs and attitudes towards AI and agent-powered devices and applications for work, education, and personal reasons – including AI at the edge.

**Technical skills**

* Proficiency in using one or more of the research tools/databases, including S&P Global, Factiva, Thomson Research, Refinitiv Workspace, and Gartner.
* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.
* Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.
* Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.
* Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.
* Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector.
* Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools in a responsible and transparent way to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
* Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.
* Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage

The Deloitte Research and Insights teams’ mission is to conduct research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The team plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thoughtware from end to end, published on Deloitte Insights and Deloitte.com.
