title: Asia Markets News Curator
description:
**Engagement:** Full-time, remote (independent contractor)  
**Compensation:** INR 35,000/month base + performance bonus  
**Hours:** Approx. 06:00–16:00 IST, Monday to Friday  
**Reports to:** Senior Editor (direct, daily)

**About the role**

We are a Singapore-headquartered investment research firm producing macro and equity research. Together with a US partner, we are launching an Asian markets newsflow service: live, curated, real-time coverage of Asia-Pacific equities, economic and macro events, distributed to retail and professional clients.

The person we hire will be the live engine of this product. During Asia trading hours, you will scan the tape, filter the noise, and publish short, sharp, time-stamped updates that traders and portfolio managers can act on within seconds. The output is fast, factual, well-formatted newsflow with just enough context to be useful at the screen, sourced from the tools and platforms we provide.

**What you will do, every day**

*Live curation (the core of the job)*

* Monitor primary news sources across India, Japan, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia) and Greater China (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen), covering listed companies and key economic and macro releases, depending on your assigned market focus.
* Publish short updates per shift in the agreed format: timestamp, ticker or instrument, one-sentence headline, and a few lines of context where it adds value.
* Prioritise what moves markets: earnings surprises, regulatory actions, central bank decisions, large block trades and sector-moving headlines. Leave out the noise.
* Cross-check newswires, exchange filings (HKEX, SGX, NSE/BSE, TSE), regulator releases (MAS, BoJ, RBI, PBoC, etc.) and reputable local-language sources, depending on the assigned region.

*Scheduled deliverables*

* **Asia Pre-Open (06:30 IST):** overnight US handover, key Asia events on the day, scheduled data and earnings.
* **Asia Midday Wrap (12:30 IST):** morning movers, sector rotation, intraday news of consequence.
* **Asia Close (15:45 IST):** index closes, top movers with attributed reasons, what to watch.

*Standards and quality control*

* The Senior Editor sets templates, examples and editorial standards. You follow them precisely, every day, without drift.
* All output is in clean, professional English, free of AI-generated phrasing, filler, marketing language and personal opinion.
* Source every non-obvious claim. Never copy text verbatim from a wire or filing; paraphrase tightly.

**Must-have requirements**

* **Markets fluency.** You already understand what a P/E, a yield curve, a credit spread, an earnings surprise and a central bank decision are, and why a trader cares. We will not teach this from scratch.
* **Asia-Pacific market knowledge.** Working familiarity with at least one of: Indian equities (Nifty, Sensex), Greater China (HSI, CSI 300, A-shares vs H-shares), Japanese equities (Nikkei, TOPIX), ASEAN equities, regional economics.
* **Professional written English.** Crisp, accurate, neutral, fast. Closer to Reuters or Bloomberg style than to retail blogging. We will test this.
* **Speed and discipline.** Comfortable publishing short updates per shift with zero careless errors. Tickers and numbers must be right every time. The work is routine by design and rewards genuine interest in markets, high standards and personal reliability.
* **Reliable infrastructure.** Stable broadband, a dedicated quiet workspace, a modern laptop, and the ability to start your shift on time every trading day.
* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree minimum, ideally in finance, economics, accounting, business or a quantitative discipline. CFA candidates or charterholders preferred but not required.
* **Tools.** Comfortable with Excel, Slack, Google Workspace and standard news-aggregation interfaces. Experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet or similar is a strong plus.

**Strong pluses**

* Prior experience as a sell-side or buy-side analyst, newswire reporter or trading desk assistant.
* Reading proficiency in Hindi, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bahasa Indonesia or Japanese for monitoring local-language sources.
* Practical experience using AI tools in a research or news workflow.
* Familiarity with institutional trading or market data platforms.

**What this role is not**

* Not investment advice. We never tell readers what to buy or sell. We report facts and frame context.
* Not long-form research. Your focus is newsflow and the live tape.
* Not sales. You will not pitch clients or speak with subscribers.

**Selection process**

* **Step 1: Application.** CV plus a short note (max 200 words) on which Asian markets you follow most closely and why.
* **Step 2: Written test (paid, ~2 hours).** We send you a one-hour window of raw Asia trading-hours newsflow and you produce 30 curated updates in our format. This is the single most important filter.
* **Step 3: Live trial day (paid).** A half shift producing real output, reviewed in real time by the Senior Editor.
* **Step 4: Offer and 90-day probation.** Performance reviews on days 30, 60 and 90.

**Compensation and growth**

* INR 35,000/month base, paid monthly.
* Performance bonus tied to update volume, accuracy and editor revisions.
* Annual review with a clear progression path: Curator, Senior Curator, Editor.
* All training, templates, source lists and tooling provided.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with:

* CV (PDF, max 2 pages).
* Short note (max 200 words), as described in Step 1.
* One example of your own written work in English on a financial topic, such as a blog post, internship report, university paper, sample wire-style update, or anything comparable.

*We respond to every applicant within 7 days. Suitable candidates proceed directly to the written test.*

Pay: ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: APAC Portfolio (Sr.) Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an independent, commercially minded professional to join our Portfolio team and own the identification, evaluation, and advancement of novel pharmaceutical opportunities for our APAC markets, taking each opportunity from first signal to a clear recommendation and driving the agreed next steps.

The role will focus on innovative and differentiated assets, including NCEs, 505(b)(2) products, and other value-added pharmaceutical opportunities, assessing their strategic fit, value, and timing across our key APAC markets to decide where our time and resources are best invested.

The individual will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Business Development, Finance, and other internal teams, integrating their input into a single Portfolio view of each opportunity and a clear recommendation the business can act on.

**Scope and Decision Rights**

The Head of Portfolio APAC sets strategy, priorities, and major portfolio decisions. Within that framework, this role independently drives its own analyses, opportunities, and projects, makes recommendations, and executes the agreed actions. It is expected to move work forward without step-by-step approval and to judge when to involve others:

* **Decides directly:**
  how to scope and structure an evaluation, which data and internal experts to draw on, when a first answer is sufficient, and which opportunities to screen out against agreed criteria.
* **Aligns with the Head of Portfolio APAC:**
  recommendations to advance, pause, or stop an opportunity, changes to priorities, and positions to take with potential partners.
* **Escalates:**
  matters with material financial, legal, IP, or reputational impact, and cross-functional disagreements that cannot be resolved at working level.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own an up-to-date view of the APAC opportunity pipeline across near-, mid-, and long-term horizons, flag gaps and imbalances, and recommend areas for expansion, investment, or rationalization.
* Proactively scan global markets, pipelines, and competitor activity to identify novel product opportunities relevant to APAC, and bring forward those worth pursuing with a clear rationale.
* Lead the evaluation of shortlisted opportunities end-to-end, integrating medical, clinical, IP, regulatory, development, commercial, competitive, and market-access perspectives with timing and economics, and scaling the depth of analysis to what the decision actually requires.
* Build a working understanding of treatment guidelines, clinical practice, patient pathways, unmet needs, and physician preferences in each market, and use it to judge whether an opportunity is genuinely differentiated against current and future standards of care.
* Assess competitive landscape, product differentiation, market potential, pricing, reimbursement, and positioning, distinguishing real, reachable opportunities from theoretical ones.
* Drive product evaluations to a conclusion with Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Medical, and Business Development teams, involving the right people at the right time and reconciling conflicting inputs.
* Build patient-based forecasts, sales potential, and scenario analyses, making key assumptions explicit and identifying which of them drive the decision.
* Identify relevant companies and assets for partnering and licensing opportunities, and recommend, together with Business Development, which to prioritize and how to approach them.
* Plan and follow through on partnering conferences: prioritize target companies, products, and meetings beforehand, and turn outcomes into agreed next steps afterwards.
* Own follow-through on assigned opportunities, keeping evaluation status, partner interactions, and follow-up actions current, and making sure agreed actions are delivered.
* Present assigned areas in periodic portfolio reviews with management in decision-ready form, highlighting key risks, gaps, growth opportunities, the recommended course of action, and the decisions required.

**Ways of Working**

We are looking for someone who, given an objective and the context, works out how to get there: think, decide, act, and follow through. In practice, this means:

* **Own the outcome, not just the task.**
  Start from what needs to be achieved, structure the problem, find and analyze the information needed, reach a conclusion, and follow through until the agreed actions are delivered.
* **Useful answers, fast.**
  Produce a solid first answer quickly, be explicit about what is fact and what is assumption, identify what is missing, and go deeper only where it would change the decision.
* **Always a recommendation.**
  Analysis ends with a position, not a list of findings: “Based on this, I recommend X because Y, and the next step is Z.”
* **Proactive.**
  Spot risks and opportunities before being asked (in an asset, market, patent situation, launch opportunity, competitive development, or portfolio assumption), raise them early, and propose how to address them.
* **Independent, not isolated.**
  Move work forward without needing approval for each step, and know when to bring in Portfolio, BD, Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Medical, Finance, or other functions.
* **Constructive challenge.**
  Question assumptions, analyses, and proposed approaches when there is good reason to, explain why, and bring a better alternative.
* **Clear and concise.**
  Communicate across functions and geographies in a structured, commercially relevant way: what is happening, why it matters, what you think, and what we should do.

**Preferred Profile**

* Degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field; MBA or equivalent business training is an advantage.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in New Product Planning, Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Commercial Strategy, Medical Affairs, or pharmaceutical consulting, including a track record of taking evaluations or projects through to a decision or outcome.
* Strong ability to interpret clinical data and translate it into commercial implications and portfolio recommendations.
* Strong analytical and forecasting skills, combined with the judgment to separate what matters from what does not and to know when an answer is good enough to act on.
* Intellectual curiosity about pharmaceutical innovation and emerging assets, with the commercial sense to tell an interesting asset from a real opportunity for the company.
* Working understanding of how IP, regulatory pathways (including 505(b)(2)), development, and market access shape the value and timing of an asset; deep expertise in every area is not required.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and willing to take a position, defend it with evidence, and revise it when the evidence changes.
* Clear, concise communicator, effective with colleagues and partners across functions, cultures, and geographies.

While applying, please mention the APAC countries you have handled and one novel asset you have evaluated.

description:
**The Position**

  

Purpose of the role is to develop and implement Boehringer Ingelheim India's Human Pharma Market Access Strategies & framework. It involves promoting the range of innovative products in both Public/Reimbursed and Out of Pocket market by developing and driving better market access initiatives for the payers/patients. Developing pricing strategies for the Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio which includes new product launch pricing, existing product pricing/pricing schemes as well as maintaining pricing from the external stakeholder/Government/NPPA perspective. Identifying, developing and design suitable market access initiatives on the lines of partnership models across therapies, pricing schemes, Health Economics & Outcomes etc. which can enable maximization of opportunities and drive business growth in the public/out of pocket market in close collaboration with the Government Affairs/Healthcare Affairs/Marketing/Medical Team. Monitor, interpret and shape developments and gaps in healthcare policies and healthcare delivery for our current and future HP product portfolio.

  

**Tasks & Responsibilities**

  

  
* Developing new pricing / price change proposal/business case for the complete portfolio of Boehringer Ingelheim India in alignment with local business requirements and working closely with the Global team for getting approvals of the same. Also, taking the lead for all submissions related to global market access such as price approval process, BIP track, Global launch tracker etc.
  
* Ensuring timely and continuous submissions to notify products price to Government pricing authority (NPPA). Streamlining any gaps in data with the government and ensuring all issues are resolved with the concerned authorities
  
* Developing the Market Access Strategies, tactical and execution plan for Boehringer Ingelheim’s portfolio products. Involves identifying suitable therapy opportunities within Government health policy/NCD policy and developing strategies towards increasing advocacy for Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio through either increase in government funding or increase in government priority. Meeting & presenting to senior level external stakeholders. Also, taking the lead for all submissions related to global team such as access related advocacy plan.
  
* Ideating and executing various strategic initiatives across the value chain of Market access such as Pricing Schemes, Payer value tools such as HEOR models, information, diagnosis, affordability, adherence etc. Also aligning with internal stakeholders such as Government Affairs, Sales & Marketing, Medical teams to ensure timely and effective implementation of all tactical plans.
  
* Taking the lead to devising the market access roadmaps & strategy for existing Boehringer Ingelheim brands and new launches. Providing inputs to the Business Teams for implementation.
  
* Manages prioritized health systems engagement on prevention, diagnosis, screening, quality of life and access to care initiatives, health & wellness programs, and patient support related efforts.
  
  

  
  

**Requirements**

  

  
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience required; Preferred an MBA from a reputed institution.
  
* At least 8-10 years of relevant experience in Health policy/Market Access.
  
* Deep understanding of Indian healthcare and regulatory environment with proven expertise in access related initiatives. Strong sales/marketing acumen.
  
* Strong business acumen with the capability and vision to plan and implement strategic company level initiatives.
  
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral, as well as negotiation and presentation skills.
  
* Strong understanding of Indian Healthcare environment and relevant policies.

title: Product Manager - Sustainability & Climate AI Solutions
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
We are seeking an
**AI Product Manager**
to own the building and commercialization of new AI solutions across our Sustainability and Climate (S&C) product suite. Responsibilities will include owning and expanding our new MCP / MSCI AI Insights solution and leading the build and commercialization of new AI agents for the S&C business.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of data, data distribution (API, Snowflake, etc), emerging AI applications, and the needs and workflows of investors and other regulated financial services clients. You will work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Data Operations, Legal and Client Coverage colleagues to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities that unlock value at scale. You will interact with clients to understand their evolving needs in relation to AI, and with potential third party partners to establish new business growth opportunities.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Product & solution vision (cross-functional leadership): Own the product vision for AI interfaces and agent solutions — including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights and agentic workflow tools — identifying client needs and use cases, sizing opportunities, creating prototypes with relevant cross-functional stakeholders and validating ideas with clients, translating prototypes into requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering, and leading launch and commercialization with cross-functional colleagues.
* Ownership of the S&C MCP and AI Insights interface: Own the ongoing running and enhancement of our new S&C MCP, and accompanying AI Insights platform experience on MSCI ONE.
* Partnership with Product, data, and research experts: Work closely with product, data, and research experts to define target use cases, understand client workflows (today and in future AI-first world) and ground truth for AI products, and map the datasets, dashboards, and sources those features draw from.
* Documentation and enablement: Own and build documentation for internal training, client enablement, and ongoing feature updates, keeping it aligned with the underlying data model as datasets, factors, and dashboards evolve.
* Sustainability and climate data expertise: Maintain a working understanding of MSCI's S&C datasets and the data structures and taxonomy unique to each, using that expertise to validate AI-generated outputs against methodology before they reach clients.
* Distribution and delivery mechanisms: Understand how S&C data reaches its clients via API, Datafeeds, Snowflake, and platforms such as MSCI ONE, and partner with engineering on the data architecture questions that affect how MCP tools and AI Insights query and present that data, and ensure S&C data is AI-ready for consumption by client AI assistants and third-party AI connectors. Partner closely with the Product owner for S&C Data Distribution to ensure all S&C datasets are transformed to be “AI-ready” and high-performing within our AI tools.
* Senior stakeholder communication: Present product vision, roadmap, and business cases — including pricing and packaging options — to senior stakeholders for alignment and investment, and support client AI-governance and due-diligence questionnaires with Legal and Compliance.
* Client-facing validation: Lead client presentations, demos, and working sessions with senior client stakeholders to validate direction and build advocacy ahead of launch, representing the voice of the client in prioritization trade-offs.
* Roadmap ownership and success metrics: Own the end-to-end roadmap for AI interfaces and agent solutions, including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights, and agentic tools. Report adoption, quality, and business-impact metrics to leadership on a regular cadence.

**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* 7+ years in product management or other related role, including ownership of AI/ML-enabled or data-distribution products — financial data, ESG/sustainability, or index/analytics experience preferred.
* Solid understanding of sustainability and climate data domains (ESG ratings & scores, sustainability data, carbon emissions and climate risk metrics, etc) and comfort with complex, evolving data taxonomies.
* Working knowledge of AI/LLM concepts: retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector embeddings, similarity scoring, hallucination mitigation, agentic AI architectures, and MCP or comparable tool-calling protocols.
* Familiarity with data distribution mechanisms — APIs, data feeds, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), and client-facing UI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements for engineering and user documentation for clients.
* Strong executive presence — comfortable presenting to senior internal stakeholders and high-profile client stakeholders.
* Track record of excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Research, Programme Management, Legal, Client Coverage and Marketing.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm and curiosity for learning about and using cutting-edge AI tools and technologies

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

description:
**BLUEBERRY AGRO**

**QA & PACKING SHIFT MANAGER**

*Job Location: Kanchad, Maharashtra*

Position Summary

The QA & Packing Shift Manager is responsible for overseeing packing operations and quality assurance activities during the assigned day, afternoon or night shift. The role ensures product quality and safety, manages packing materials and finished-goods inventory, and coordinates with other departments to support efficient and timely dispatch.

Key Responsibilities

· **Packing & Dispatch Operations:** Lead and supervise the packing team to ensure tasks are completed efficiently, maximise output, and ensure lots are loaded, blended and passed on time so packing is not delayed.

· **Workflow Coordination:** Ensure smooth product flow from production to packing, effective handovers between production and packing teams, accurate and durable labelling for identification and traceability, and timely movement of materials through blending, packing, vehicle loading and dispatch.

· **Inventory & Material Management:** Monitor packing material and finished-goods stock against consumption and dispatch plans. Coordinate with SCM to avoid shortages and ensure correct storage locations, containers, quality and area demarcation.

· **Shipping Documentation:** Generate and verify shipping labels and dispatch documentation in coordination with Head Office, SCM and other stakeholders.

· **Logistics Coordination:** Coordinate with Head Office and transport companies to ensure timely deliveries, vehicle planning, loading and dispatch. Maintain safe storage and sufficient space for forklifts and pedestrian movement.

· **Continuous Improvement:** Implement improvements to increase efficiency and reduce errors in packing, finished-goods storage, vehicle loading and dispatch.

· **Quality Control:** Ensure raw material inspection, batch numbering and testing are completed before warehouse unloading approval. Conduct quality checks, process audits and sample analysis to maintain company and customer standards, including incoming raw materials and packing materials.

· **Compliance:** Ensure activities comply with company policies, safety regulations and applicable standards, including Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Distribution Practices (GDP).

· **New Product Introduction (NPI):** Coordinate new product and improvement projects with stakeholders, oversee trials and sample segregation, and manage testing and evaluation until the required outcome is achieved.

· **Deviation Management:** Identify deviations from standard operating procedures and ensure corrective actions are taken.

· **Documentation & Customer Complaints:** Maintain Certificates of Analysis, retained samples and audit records. Capture customer complaints and coordinate timely corrective and preventive action (CAPA).

· **Shift & Team Management:** Track daily productivity, report performance, address shortages, breakdowns and defects, maintain safety and hygiene, train employees, assess competencies and communicate issues and objectives clearly.

· **Planning & Collaboration:** Develop packaging strategies focused on efficiency, cost savings and sustainability. Work with production, marketing and product development teams on improvement projects, timelines and budgets, and escalate issues through appropriate channels.

Qualifications & Skills

· **Leadership:** Strong leadership, problem-solving and attention to detail.

· **Operational Capability:** Ability to manage packing, quality assurance, inventory and dispatch activities during an assigned shift.

· **Quality & Compliance:** Knowledge of quality checks, process audits, traceability, documentation and safety practices.

* Identify potential knowledge partners, financial institutions, fintech companies and industry bodies.

**6. Project Coordination & Documentation**

title: Head of Product Business Unit
description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: Head of Partnerships
description:
Head of Partnerships

Fintech Cloud Pvt. Ltd. | Delhi NCR | Full-time

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Experience: 10 to 14 years in partnerships, alliances or business development, with at least 5 in lending or financial services

Team: Builds and leads a team of four to six

ABOUT FINTECH CLOUD

Fintech Cloud is a lending technology and operations platform. We run the origination, underwriting and servicing infrastructure for RBI-registered NBFC partners, and operate the consumer lending brands they lend through. The business is growing quickly, in both partner count and lending volume.

It reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and owns the partner-sourced side of customer acquisition end to end.

THE ROLE

We have mapped a partner universe of more than three hundred companies across thirty-two categories, from DSA and agent networks to marketplaces, payroll platforms, employers and lender-to-lender referral. None of it is contracted. This role turns that map into a working pipeline.

It is a build role. You will get a free hand to build the partnerships team, commercial template, onboarding process and partner reporting. All of it has to be created while the first partners are already going live.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• The partner pipeline end to end: qualification, commercial negotiation, contracting, and the capacity statement that tells the business what is genuinely committed rather than hoped for.

• Wave sequencing across the portfolio, so effort goes where time to first lead is shortest rather than where the headline target is largest.

• Commercial models by channel, whether cost per lead, cost per disbursal, revenue share or hybrid, with cost per disbursal adjusted for first-payment default as the decision metric.

• The pilot protocol: every partner tested at five to ten thousand leads, with kill criteria agreed before any spend.

• Joint governance with Legal and Compliance, since consent provenance and the lawfulness of data sharing decide whether a partner can be used at all.

• Decision-maker relationships across lenders, networks, platforms and large employers.

• Hiring and running the partnerships team.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Built a partner or channel function from nothing rather than inheriting one that already worked.

• Lending, NBFC, insurance or financial services background, with real fluency in funnel economics through to disbursal rather than to lead.

• Negotiated commercial terms at volume with DSA networks, affiliate networks, marketplaces or enterprise platforms.

• Willingness to move away from partners that do not work, and specific examples of having done it.

• The discipline to hold a forecast honestly, including stating an uncommitted shortfall early rather than at the end of the quarter.

• Working knowledge of the DPDP Act, RBI digital lending rules, and what a lending service provider may and may not do.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience inside an LSP or co-lending structure.

• Exposure to bureau, account aggregator or alternate data partnerships.

SUCCESS AT SIX MONTHS

• First-wave partners live and contracted, with volume measured against a signed commitment rather than a projection.

• A capacity statement that finance and the credit team both trust.

• The pilot protocol running, with at least one partner discontinued on evidence.

• The team hired and each category owned by a named person.

title: Business Development Manager - Electronics
description:
About BRITONE

BRITONE is an Indian electronics brand with a presence in the audio products category, including speakers, woofers, subwoofers and tweeters.

We are focused on expanding our national distribution network, strengthening our product portfolio and building a scalable, profitable electronics business.

We are looking for a commercially minded, entrepreneurial professional who can contribute across business development, product planning and sourcing. This is an opportunity to work closely with the Director and participate in important decisions that shape the company's growth.

Role Overview

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for expanding BRITONE's dealer and distributor network across India while working closely with the Director on product selection, new product development, supplier identification, sourcing strategy, pricing and market positioning.

The ideal candidate will combine strong offline channel-sales experience with commercial understanding of consumer electronics products and the ability to identify market opportunities, evaluate suppliers and build a competitive product portfolio.

This is a hands-on role in a growing business, requiring ownership, initiative, market understanding and the ability to work across functions.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development and National Distribution

* Develop and execute a pan-India dealer and distributor expansion strategy.
* Identify, evaluate and appoint distributors, wholesalers and dealers in priority markets.
* Build relationships with channel partners and develop a pipeline of new business opportunities.
* Develop territory-wise sales plans and achieve agreed revenue and gross-profit targets.
* Increase product penetration, repeat orders and sales productivity across the distribution network.
* Analyse competitor activity, channel margins, market pricing and customer requirements.
* Monitor primary sales, secondary sales, stock movement and channel-partner performance.
* Develop strategies to improve BRITONE's market presence and competitiveness.

2. Product Strategy and Portfolio Development

* Work closely with the Director to identify new product categories and expansion opportunities.
* Research market demand, emerging trends, competitor products, price points and customer preferences.
* Gather structured feedback from dealers, distributors, retailers and end customers.
* Identify product gaps and opportunities within BRITONE's existing and potential categories.
* Evaluate product concepts based on market potential, expected selling price, landed cost, gross margin and competitive differentiation.
* Recommend new products, product variants, features and specifications that meet market requirements.
* Help prioritise product launches based on commercial viability, sourcing feasibility and channel demand.
* Monitor product performance after launch and recommend improvements or discontinuation where appropriate.

3. Sourcing and Supplier Development

* Identify and evaluate domestic and international manufacturers, OEMs and contract suppliers.
* Research potential suppliers in India and overseas, including China where appropriate.
* Compare suppliers on product quality, pricing, minimum order quantities, production capacity, lead times and reliability.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations, samples, product specifications and commercial terms.
* Work with the Director to negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, exclusivity and other supplier arrangements.
* Coordinate product sampling, evaluation and testing before commercial orders.
* Develop a reliable supplier base while managing cost, quality, delivery and supply risks.
* Explore opportunities to improve sourcing costs and product competitiveness without compromising quality.

4. Product Economics and Commercial Analysis

* Prepare product-level costing and profitability analyses.
* Evaluate purchase costs, freight, duties where applicable, packaging, compliance costs and other relevant expenses.
* Recommend selling prices and channel margins based on market conditions and profitability requirements.
* Assess the financial viability of new products before launch.
* Monitor product-wise sales, margins, inventory movement and returns.
* Work with management to improve working-capital efficiency and avoid slow-moving inventory.
* Ensure product and sourcing decisions support sustainable profitability rather than revenue growth alone.

5. Market Research and Competitive Intelligence

* Conduct structured research into the Indian electronics and audio markets.
* Identify competitors, comparable products, retail prices, dealer economics and distribution practices.
* Visit relevant trade markets, dealers, distributors, retailers and industry events.
* Maintain an organised database of prospective channel partners, suppliers and product opportunities.
* Translate market feedback into actionable recommendations for product development, sourcing and sales strategy.
* Prepare concise business cases for new products, categories and territories.

6. Channel Partner and Supplier Relationships

* Build long-term relationships with distributors, dealers, wholesalers, manufacturers and suppliers.
* Understand channel-partner needs and identify opportunities to improve BRITONE's product proposition.
* Support partners with product information, commercial proposals and approved sales initiatives.
* Maintain professional supplier relationships and ensure clear commercial communication.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve product availability, quality and delivery issues.

7. Business Planning and Reporting

* Prepare annual and quarterly business development plans.
* Maintain a sales pipeline and provide realistic revenue forecasts.
* Present product proposals and sourcing recommendations with supporting data.
* Report on distributor appointments, sales, collections, product performance, sourcing opportunities and market developments.
* Track agreed business objectives and recommend corrective action where required.
* Work closely with the Director on strategic priorities and execution.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, Engineering or a related field.
* Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in consumer electronics, audio products, electrical goods, home appliances or related physical-product categories.
* Proven experience in offline channel sales and dealer/distributor development.
* Exposure to product management, category development, OEM sourcing, procurement or supplier management.
* Strong commercial understanding of pricing, gross margins, costing and product profitability.
* Experience evaluating market opportunities and translating them into business decisions.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Good working knowledge of Excel and presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel across India and, where required, undertake supplier visits overseas.

title: Brand Partnerships Manager - FMCG
description:
**Brand Partnership Manager - FMCG**

**About Wishlink**

Wishlink is on a mission to revolutionize the creator economy and redefine how people shop. We're all about providing every user with a highly personalized shopping experience guided by creators, so they can find exactly what they want, in a very short time, while improving their online shopping experience severalfold. We are shaping a new era at the intersection of two of the most prominent aspects of the internet-
**e-commerce and social media**
.

**Team and Investors**

Wishlink was founded by 3 friends from college, Chandan, Shaurya, and Divyansh, with a shared passion to solve real-world problems at scale and consume content for hours (XD). We started Wishlink in January 2022 when we discovered products on social media that we wanted to buy but could not (in some cases, actually did)! We are based out of Gurugram. We have recently raised a
**series B round of $17.5M backed by leading global investors including Vertex Ventures SE Asia & India, Fundamentum, and Elevation Capital.**

**Why Join Us?**

**Exciting Problem**

The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews - which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.

**Immense Scale**

In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over
**900k users daily**
to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.

**Stellar Team**

Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!

**Growth Opportunity**

We have grown remarkably in the last 3 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 300cr. We are working with over 50,000 content creators and 300+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.

Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.

**What would you be doing?**

* **Own the monetization P&L**
  — set and deliver the growth and revenue target across your category, and be accountable for the number end to end.
* **Build the category annual plans**
  — bottom-up targets by category and brand, the assumptions behind them, and the quarterly milestones that make the annual number credible. Own the re-forecast when reality moves.
* **Build the category strategy and brand playbook**
  — decide which categories and brands to prioritize, how to price and package solutions, what the pitch is, and what the reachout motion looks like at scale. Turn what works into something repeatable, not a series of one-off wins.
* **Hunt and farm brand budgets**
  — build the pipeline from the ground up, run the outreach, negotiate deals, and grow spend from existing brands season over season. You'll be as comfortable opening a cold brand as expanding a live one.
* **Set and drive targets across teams**
  — translate the category plan into clear targets for the respective category KAMs, align them on the why, and run the review cadence that keeps everyone honest against the number.
* **Run the category on data**
  — build the metrics and dashboards that matter, use them to spot opportunities and diagnose problems, and translate analysis into decisions (not just charts).
* **Partner cross-functionally**
  — work with sales, product, creator, and marketing teams to execute your plan when you don't directly control every lever.
* **Shape how we monetize**
  — as an early owner, define the playbook for categories that others will build on.

**What are we looking for?**

* **5–7 years in category management**
  at an FMCG / CPG or beauty & personal care (BPC) brand, or on the e-commerce / quick-commerce / marketplace side.
* **A track record of owning a commercial or revenue number**
  — ideally monetization, ad revenue, or retail media (not only supply, assortment, or vendor management).
* Experience
  **planning a target bottom-up**
  and then landing it across teams you don't directly manage.
* **Strong, hands-on data and analytics ability**
  — comfortable in Excel/Sheets and BI tools, and able to manipulate data yourself rather than relying entirely on an analyst.
* **Proven experience building business partnerships and alliances**
  — sourcing, negotiating, and growing brand relationships.
* **Strategic and hands-on in equal measure**
  — you can set the plan and also do the work in a lean, fast-moving environment.
* **Strong commercial judgment and communication**
  — able to influence stakeholders and make sound trade-off calls.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with retail media or ad-monetization products on a platform/marketplace.
* Exposure to the creator, influencer, or affiliate-commerce ecosystem.
* Have built a monetization or GTM motion from scratch before.

**Why join us?**

* Full ownership of a category's monetization — not a slice of it.
* A rare role that genuinely blends strategy, hands-on data, and partnerships.
* High-growth stage with room to shape how the category is built.

**Perks and Benefits**

* We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.
* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning & Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget

title: Performance Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Are you looking for an opportunity to manage the digital transformation for Ecommerce and Digital Marketing across all brands and therapeutic areas? If so, this is the job for you. As Multichannel Marketing Manager you will be responsible for establishing an integrated digital support network for the development of e-commerce channel partnering across Haleon. You will also develop and execute an integrated business plan while managing relationships with strategic partners and pilot initiatives. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career.
  
  
These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Strategy Development: Develop and implement comprehensive on-platform performance marketing strategies aligned with business objectives on Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Bigbasket, Swiggy and other e-comemerce platforms.
* Campaign Management: Manage and optimize performance marketing campaigns to maximize ROI, CPC, CTR, and other key performance metrics.
* Performance Analysis: Conduct thorough analysis of campaign performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to improve campaign effectiveness and efficiency. Continuously test and optimize campaigns based on data insights.
* Budget Management: Utilize data-driven approaches to make informed decisions and optimize marketing budgets for maximum impact.
* Agency Management: Manage agency to implement performance marketing strategies.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Brand and Design teams
* Third Party Stakeholder: Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising platforms teams to identify opportunities for growth.
* Stay Updated: Stay informed with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in performance marketing, and implement innovative strategies to stay ahead of the competition.
* Reporting: Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and marketing metrics to track progress towards goals and objectives and communicate insights to stakeholders.
* Lead the digital capability for the brand teams as well as key stakeholders in other functional areas
* Create and pilot e-commerce initiatives
* Continue to feed the customer insight to the commercial team’s brand strategy
* Lead the 12-month digital operational plan to deliver the activities that build towards the longer-term strategy

**Why you?**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* MBA Tier 1 colleges.
* 6+ years in a large multi-national working environment.
* 4+ year’s Marketing experience.
* Experience in multi-channel/digital marketing.
* On platform experience on blinkit, amazon, flipkart etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**
:
  
  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* MBA (Marketing, Brand Management, Communications, or a Technology related field in Pharmaceuticals) consult manager on Technology related field experience
* Digital course work
* Expert in digital marketing channels in sales and marketing
* Ability to influence, challenge and gain credibility with senior commercial leaders
* Digital/social/interactive marketing experience with a clear commercial focus, including digital analytics and metrics
* Excellent communication skills, strong presentation and facilitation skills to explain/sell creative concepts
* Proven track record of driving sales performance
* Agency management experience
* Proficient in customer understanding and campaign development
* Capable of working across boundaries and functional areas
* Familiarity with copy approval process
* Experience in the Pharma sector
* Project management experience

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-17
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

title: Product Manager Hardware
description:
About the role

You will own a physical product line end to end, from the first customer insight to units shipping off the line and the experience after purchase. You sit at the centre of industrial design, mechanical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, and go-to-market teams, and you decide what gets built, why, and when.

**Experience:**
 4–8 years

What you'll do

**Strategy and discovery**

* Talk to customers, retailers, and service teams to find the problems worth solving; turn them into a clear product vision and multi-year roadmap.
* Size markets, study competitors, and build business cases covering target price, bill of materials (BOM) cost, margin, and volume.

**Definition**

* Write product requirement documents (PRDs) that set features, performance specs, certifications, and cost targets.
* Make the trade-offs between cost, quality, features, and schedule, and document why.

**Development and launch**

* Drive the product through the build gates (EVT, DVT, PVT) to mass production with engineering and contract manufacturers.
* Work with sourcing on component selection, supplier risk, and lead times; keep BOM cost on target.
* Define test plans and quality gates with QA, and own the decision to ship.
* Plan launches with marketing, sales, and service: positioning, pricing, packaging, channel readiness, and spares.

**After launch**

* Track returns, field failures, reviews, and service tickets; turn them into fixes, firmware updates, and next-generation requirements.
* If the product is connected, own the companion app and firmware roadmap alongside the hardware.

What we're looking for

* 4+ years in product management, with at least 2 years on physical products.
* Shipped at least one hardware product from concept to mass production.
* Working knowledge of the hardware lifecycle: build gates, DFM, BOM costing, tooling, and certification (BIS, CE, FCC, or similar).
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers, including in-factory visits.
* Comfortable with numbers: unit economics, pricing, forecasting, and P&L impact.
* Clear writer and communicator who can align engineers, executives, and partners.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, industrial design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

* Background as a hardware, mechanical, or electrical engineer before moving into product.
* Experience with connected (IoT) devices, embedded firmware, and companion mobile apps.
* Consumer electronics or home appliance experience, including retail and e-commerce channels.
* Exposure to manufacturing in India, China, or Southeast Asia.
* Familiarity with sustainability requirements: repairability, materials, and e-waste rules.

How success is measured

**First 90 days**

* Learn the current products, customers, and supplier base; visit the factory floor.
* Audit the roadmap and BOM costs, and bring a prioritised set of improvements.
* Own at least one in-flight program through its next build gate.

**Ongoing**

* Launches hit their planned date, cost, and quality targets.
* Product margin and BOM cost stay on plan.
* Return rate and field failure rate fall generation over generation.
* Customer ratings and NPS rise for the products you own.

Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This job develops and executes strategic recruiting plans to attract top talent. They partner with hiring managers to understand specific hiring needs and create job descriptions. Senior Recruiters source and screen candidates, conduct interviews, and assist in the selection and offer process. They also manage relationships with candidates and hiring managers, develop recruiting metrics, and may supervise junior recruiters. With extensive experience in recruiting, they utilize advanced sourcing tools and techniques to ensure the company hires the best talent
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Partner with hiring managers and business unit leader to understand hiring requirements, products and services while providing consultative expertise in recruitment.
* Lead & develop recruiting strategies and manage the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, delivering an efficient and effective recruiting partnership.
* Oversees candidates in the talent pipeline through every life cycle stage and develop an outstanding candidate experience and recognition of downstream impact on other disciplines
* Advises and influences leaders of assigned business units on Talent Acquisition strategy and how to identify and invest in talent pipeline
* Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
* Collaborates regularly with peers and/or internal partners

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**What You Need To Know About The Role-**
This role is for Technical Recruiter to join the India Talent Acquisition team. Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll play a key role in shaping and rolling out TA initiatives and projects including recruitment campaigns & marketing, diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging hiring, and our Global TA transformation.
  
  
**Meet our team**
-
  
  
The TA team is based out of Bangalore in India.
  
  
The hiring TA team is responsible for achieving headcount needs for the Engineering & Products organization.
**Job Description:**
**Your way to impact-**
You will own end-to-end hiring activities across some of our most critical business areas across the India region, partnering closely with Coordination, Onboarding, and Sourcing. Additionally, you'll engage closely with leaders on the site, the broader HR community, and the Global GTA team.
  
  
**Your day to day-**

* Achieves staffing objectives by recruiting and evaluating job candidates; advising managers
* Educating and guiding hiring managers on Talent Acquisition related policies, processes, and interview skills.
* Developing innovative recruitment strategies and managing the end-to-end hiring activities, delivering an efficient and effective service to all involved in the hiring process.
* Monitor and ensure 100% compliance with hiring process activities and resolve any discrepancies that may arise prior to the completion of the hiring process
* Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to develop innovative and effective sourcing strategies, providing market intelligence to the business as required.
* Use various sourcing platforms and techniques LinkedIn, Boolean strings, X-ray search, and other select sourcing tools to further build a robust pipeline of top-tier candidates
* Assist in identifying, organizing, attending, and participating in sourcing channels, such as community outreach events, job fairs, Meetups, conferences, educational institutions, non-profit organizations, and social networking activities, on behalf of PayPal, in order to promote PayPal’s employer-brand
* Conduct thorough pre-screen activities in line with PayPal and job requirements, and presents a shortlist and recommendations of the most suitable candidates for consideration for assigned requisitions.
* Support the administration and coordination of the end-to-end hiring activities of assigned requisitions, ensuring an efficient and effective service is delivered to all involved in the hiring process.
* Prepare, present, and negotiate job offers in accordance with PayPal compensation and benefits guidelines.
* Manage and actively participate in Talent Acquisition related projects of varying complexity, importance, and priority.
* Represent the Talent Acquisition team positively in relationships and communication with the Human Resource Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, business leaders, and other Global Talent Acquisition team members.

**What Do You Need To Bring-**

* 5 + years experience with full life cycle talent acquisition in a fast-paced corporate environment.
* Comfortable to multitask, project management, and presentation skills coupled with technical / business acumen
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment of change, challenge, and multiple deadlines and priorities
* Experience handling sensitive/confidential information
* Networking, and relationship-building skills
* High level of comfort with direct sourcing

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued.
