title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**HR Intern**

**PropSarathi**

**Location:**
Sathnur, near REVA University, North Bengaluru

**Type:**
Full-time, in-office internship

**Stipend:**
₹10,000 per month, payable on achievement of monthly targets

**Reporting to:**
Founder & Business Head

**About PropSarathi**

**PropSarathi is a real estate advisory and channel partner firm focused on North Bengaluru, with a growing presence in Dubai and across India. We work with leading developers and help buyers and investors make confident property decisions. We are building a team that moves fast, takes ownership, and grows with the company.**

**Why This Role Matters**

**HR at PropSarathi is not a back-office function. You will build the team that sells, supports, and grows the company. From the first candidate you source to the last onboarding document you close, you will shape how people join, perform, and stay with us. You will get direct access to the Founder, real decisions and visible results.**

**What You Will Do**

*Talent Acquisition*

* Source candidates for every open position across sales, marketing, content, operations and admin, using LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, campus outreach and community channels
* Write and publish job posts for each role and keep them updated
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates against role requirements
* Schedule, coordinate, and follow up on interviews, and collect structured feedback
* Maintain a live hiring tracker covering source, stage, status, timelines, and drop-off reasons
* Build and maintain a talent pool of pre-screened candidates for future openings
* Coordinate reference checks and final-stage paperwork

*Offers & Documentation*

* Prepare offer, appointment, and internship letters from approved templates
* Track acceptances, joining dates, and document collection
* Coordinate background and document verification
* Maintain confidential employee files, including ID, address, education and experience records

*Onboarding*

* Plan and run the joining process: welcome, system access, tools, introductions and first-week schedule
* Prepare an onboarding checklist for each role and track completion
* Brief new joiners on company policies, culture and expectations
* Follow up at 7, 30, and 60 days to check settling-in and early concerns

*Attendance, Leave & Payroll Coordination*

* Maintain attendance and leave records
* Collect timesheets and inputs needed for monthly payroll, and coordinate with accounts
* Track stipend and salary eligibility against approved targets
* Process leave requests and maintain leave balances

*Performance Management*

* Set up monthly and quarterly review cycles with managers
* Maintain performance records, goals, and review outcomes
* Flag underperformance early and coordinate improvement plans with managers
* Track incentive and target sheets for HR-related roles, in coordination with the Founder

*Employee Engagement & Culture*

* Be the first point of contact for employee questions and day-to-day concerns
* Plan team meetings, training sessions, celebrations, and internal events
* Run monthly engagement check-ins and act on feedback
* Build and maintain a learning calendar with training topics for each function

*Policies & Compliance*

* Maintain the employee handbook, HR policies and code of conduct
* Ensure every employee has signed the relevant agreements, including confidentiality and non-disclosure
* Track statutory and compliance deadlines relevant to employees, in coordination with accounts and legal
* Manage exits: resignation processing, notice periods, handover checklists, full and final settlement coordination, and exit feedback

*Reporting & Analytics*

* Prepare a monthly HR report covering headcount, hiring funnel, time-to-hire, attrition, attendance, and open roles
* Maintain dashboards and trackers in Google Sheets
* Share insights and recommendations with the Founder

*Employer Brand*

* Support content for LinkedIn and recruitment posts, in line with PropSarathi's brand guidelines
* Showcase team achievements and culture moments on social channels

**What We Are Looking For**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field
* Strong written and spoken English, with Hindi and Kannada as a plus
* Confident using Google Sheets or MS Excel, including basic formulas and filters
* Comfortable with LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email and online job portals
* Organised, proactive and able to manage several hiring processes at once
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information
* Genuine interest in people, recruitment and building teams
* Interest in real estate or sales-led organisations is a strong plus
* Able to commute to our Sathnur office

**Targets & Stipend**

**The ₹15,000 monthly stipend is payable on achievement of targets agreed with the Founder at the start of each month:**

* 40 qualified candidates sourced across all open roles
* 15 interviews scheduled and coordinated
* 100% of onboarding checklists completed on time
* 100% of attendance and leave records updated by the 5th of each month
* Monthly HR report submitted by the 3rd working day of the following month

**What You Will Gain**

* End-to-end HR experience across recruitment, onboarding, performance, compliance and exits
* Direct mentorship from the Founder and a front-row seat to how a growing real estate firm is built
* A strong portfolio of HR work to take into your next role
* A pathway to a full-time HR role at PropSarathi based on performance

**How to Apply**

**Send your CV and a short note on why you want to build people operations at PropSarathi to pareekshith@propsarathi.com or call/whatsapp on +91 8884401147. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview at our Sathnur office.**

title: Product Support Analyst, Associate
description:
### **Description**

The Product Support Analyst Associate will provide dispatch and customer support services to Infor customers in the United States who use Infor Restaurants POS products.

The role involves receiving customer support requests, understanding and documenting customer issues accurately, creating support tickets, assigning the appropriate priority, and routing cases to the correct support team.

The ideal candidate should have excellent written and verbal English communication skills, strong customer-service skills, good organization, and the ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Basic knowledge of POS systems and PC technology will be beneficial.

The Infor Restaurants support team operates 24/7, so candidates must be flexible to work across shifts, including India overnight hours, based on business requirements.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Answer customer support calls and understand the customer's issue clearly.
* Create support tickets with complete and accurate descriptions of customer issues.
* Provide professional, courteous, and polite customer service in accordance with established procedures.
* Assign the appropriate priority level to tickets based on the nature of the issue.
* Route support tickets to the appropriate team for further investigation and resolution.
* Monitor and manage email, voicemail, and other support channels for new customer requests and create tickets as required.
* Learn and effectively use the team's ticketing and phone systems.
* Handle multiple customer requests and tasks effectively in a fast-paced support environment.
* Support administrative activities such as reporting, document distribution, and other assigned projects.
* Work collaboratively with team members to provide a positive customer-support experience.
* Remain flexible to work different shifts based on the requirements of the 24/7 support operation.

  

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 0–2 years of experience in dispatch, customer support, technical support, or a similar environment.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based customers.
* Ability to understand a customer's issue and translate the information into a clear and accurate support ticket.
* Strong interpersonal, customer-service, and customer-handling skills.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Basic understanding of fast-food and/or restaurant POS operations and systems.
* Proficiency in basic Microsoft applications, particularly Word and Excel.
* Willingness and flexibility to work across shifts, including India overnight hours, according to business requirements.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Previous experience working with Point of Sale (POS), restaurant, or fast-food environments and terminology.
* Basic technical knowledge of PC systems.
* Previous experience using CRM or ticket-management systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, or ServiceNow.
* Experience using cloud-based PBX/telephone systems such as AWS Connect, Mitel, or RingCentral.

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Shift allowance will be paid if employee works within required parameters based on business needs.
* Spot bonus awards are possible depending on individual performance and contributions. (Star Awards)

### **About Infor**

**About Infor**

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. title: Senior HR Recruiter
description:
**Role overview**
-----------------

The Senior HR Recruiter owns full-cycle hiring across engineering, security, design and marketing roles in four countries. You will run searches from intake to joining, raise the bar on candidate quality, and help build a hiring process that scales.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will work directly with hiring managers and leadership, and mentor junior recruiters as the team grows.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Full-cycle recruitment**

* Run end-to-end hiring for technical and non-technical roles: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer and onboarding handoff.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, scorecards and interview plans.
* Manage open requisitions at a time across India, Indonesia, Singapore and the UAE.

**Sourcing and talent pipelines**

* Source passive candidates via LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, security communities and referrals.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring roles such as DevSecOps engineers, security instructors and fullstack developers.
* Write compelling job descriptions and outreach messages that reflect our brand.

**Assessment and selection**

* Conduct structured screening interviews against defined competencies.
* Use standardized scorecards and screening question sets to keep evaluation fair and consistent.
* Give hiring managers clear, evidence-based candidate summaries and recommendations.

**Offers and closing**

* Benchmark compensation by market and prepare offer letters and salary structures.
* Negotiate offers and manage candidates through acceptance and joining.
* Ensure offers comply with local employment norms in each country.

**Process, data and reporting**

* Keep the ATS accurate and up to date.
* Track and report hiring metrics: time-to-hire, source quality, offer acceptance and pipeline health.
* Improve hiring processes, templates and SOPs as the company scales.

**Employer brand and candidate experience**

* Deliver a timely, respectful candidate experience at every stage.
* Mentor junior recruiters and coordinators.

**Employee data and support**

* Maintain accurate, confidential employee records, including personal details, contracts, joining documents and exits, in the HRMS or employee database.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries on HR policies, documentation, leave and onboarding.
* Coordinate with payroll, finance and managers to keep employee information current across India, Indonesia, Singapore and the UAE.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field; an MBA in HR is a plus.
* 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including at least 2 years hiring for tech, SaaS or cybersecurity roles.
* Proven record of closing hard-to-fill technical roles such as security engineers, DevOps or developers.
* Strong sourcing skills: LinkedIn Recruiter and passive candidate outreach.
* Working knowledge of at least one ATS and comfort with spreadsheets and hiring data.
* Experience preparing offer letters and negotiating compensation.
* Excellent written and spoken English; clear, confident communication with candidates and leaders.
* Able to manage many requisitions at once while keeping quality and pace high.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Has hired for security roles such as penetration testers, AppSec engineers or security trainers, and understands certifications like OSCP, CISSP and CEH.
* Has built a recruitment function or hiring process from scratch at a startup or scale-up.
* Has run cross-border hiring, including contractor and employer-of-record setups.
* Has used recruitment analytics or dashboards to improve hiring decisions.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary, benchmarked to market and experience.
* Ownership of hiring across four countries and a direct line to leadership.
* Remote or hybrid work with flexible hours.
* A fast-growing global team where your work is visible from day one.

**How to apply**
----------------

Send your resume and a short note on a hard-to-fill role you closed and how you did it. Shortlisted candidates move through a screening call, a hiring manager interview, a practical sourcing exercise and a final round with leadership.

*PDSO is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background.*

title: TA Manager, APAC
description:
**Who we are:**

Headquartered in Singapore, SATS Ltd. is one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. SATS Gateway Services provides airfreight and ground handling services including passenger services, ramp and baggage handling, aviation security services, aircraft cleaning and aviation laundry. SATS Food Solutions serves airlines, institutions, and operates central kitchens with large-scale food production and distribution capabilities for a wide range of cuisines. SATS is present in the Asia-Pacific, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, powering an interconnected world of trade, travel and taste. Following the acquisition of Worldwide Flight Services (WFS) in 2023, the combined SATS and WFS network operates over 215 stations in 27 countries. These cover trade routes responsible for more than 50% of global air cargo volume. SATS has been listed on the Singapore Exchange since May 2000. For more information, please visit www.sats.com.sg

**Role Purpose**

Join SATS' Human Capital team in India and help shape the workforce behind a global aviation, food solutions and logistics organization. In this role, you will partner with leaders across APAC and global functions to identify, engage and hire specialist and leadership talent. You will have the opportunity to work on cross-border searches, develop talent intelligence, build critical pipelines and contribute to SATS' expanding global capability footprint in India. Emphasis will be on building pipelines for leadership roles across functions/businesses
**and other emerging global capability roles.**

The Regional TA Manager will support the identification and hiring of high-quality talent for
**SATS Ltd. across APAC and selected global functions**
, being based in India.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Global & APAC Talent Acquisition**

* Manage
  **end-to-end recruitment**
  for assigned APAC and global positions, from intake discussion through offer and onboarding coordination.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand:
* Role requirements
* Critical competencies
* Technical/functional skills
* Market availability
* Location strategy
* Candidate profile
* Recruit across multiple markets, cultures and time zones.
* Manage multiple specialist and leadership searches simultaneously while maintaining hiring quality and candidate experience.
* Build talent pipelines for anticipated business and capability requirements.

**2. Strategic Sourcing & Talent Mapping**

* Proactively identify passive talent using
  **LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, referrals, talent communities, industry associations and targeted market mapping**
  .
* Conduct talent intelligence and competitor mapping for critical and hard-to-fill positions.
* Build talent pools for recurring and future global requirements.
* Map relevant external talent across:
* Aviation and air cargo
* Logistics and supply chain
* Food solutions
* Technology and digital
* Commercial
* Finance and corporate functions
* Human Capital
* Reduce dependence on recruitment agencies through strong direct-sourcing capability.

**3. Hiring Manager & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Act as a
  **Talent Acquisition advisor**
  , rather than simply a recruitment coordinator.
* Work effectively with senior stakeholders based in Singapore, India and other APAC/global locations.
* Conduct structured role-intake meetings and translate business requirements into practical sourcing strategies.
* Provide stakeholders with fact-based views on:
* Talent availability
* Candidate expectations
* Hiring challenges
* Notice periods
* Compensation competitiveness
* Location considerations
* Maintain regular recruitment dashboards and pipeline reviews with hiring managers.

This is particularly relevant to the current India hiring environment. Internal recruitment discussions note that manager-and-above candidates in India can have approximately three-month notice periods, making proactive pipeline management important.

**4. Candidate Assessment & Selection**

* Conduct initial candidate screening and structured competency-based interviews.
* Assess candidates against technical requirements, leadership competencies, experience and organizational fit.
* Prepare concise candidate assessments for hiring managers.
* Coordinate panel interviews and selection processes across different countries/time zones.
* Support reference and pre-employment processes in partnership with relevant HC teams.
* Maintain strong engagement with shortlisted candidates throughout potentially long notice periods.

**5. Offer Management & Candidate Conversion**

* Partner with HC and hiring leaders on offer development and candidate closure.
* Understand candidate motivations, competing opportunities and potential joining risks.
* Support compensation discussions with appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Maintain engagement from offer acceptance through joining.
* Track offer declines, dropouts and counter-offer risks and identify improvement opportunities.

**6. Global Capability**

* Support recruitment of global positions that are based in India but serve regional or global stakeholders.
* Build targeted talent pools from established GCCs, technology companies, consulting organizations and multinational businesses.
* Help position India as a credible source of high-quality global talent.
* Support the development of India as a long-term talent and capability hub for SATS.

**7. Recruitment Analytics & Governance**

Maintain and periodically report key recruitment metrics, including:

* Time to shortlist
* Time to offer
* Time to fill
* Offer-to-accept ratio
* Offer-to-join ratio
* Source effectiveness
* Direct sourcing percentage
* Recruitment cost
* Pipeline conversion
* Candidate dropout/decline reasons
* Hiring manager and candidate feedback

Use recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

**8. Employer Branding & Talent Engagement**

* Represent SATS consistently and professionally in the external talent market.
* Communicate the company's global scale, business platforms and career opportunities to prospective candidates.
* Partner on LinkedIn, recruitment campaigns, talent events and targeted employer-brand initiatives.
* Build relationships with relevant professional communities and specialist talent networks.
* Deliver a high-quality candidate experience regardless of hiring outcome.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in
  **Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Management or related discipline.**
* Postgraduate HR qualification/MBA preferred

**Experience**

* **8-12 years**
  of Talent Acquisition/recruitment experience.
* Demonstrable experience recruiting across
  **APAC and/or international markets**
  .
* Experience in a multinational, GCC, global shared-services, aviation, logistics, technology, consulting or similarly complex environment strongly preferred.
* Experience directly sourcing specialist and managerial talent rather than relying predominantly on recruitment agencies.
* Exposure to senior/leadership hiring preferred.

**Technical / Functional Competencies**

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* End-to-end recruitment expertise
* Advanced sourcing capability
* LinkedIn Recruiter / Boolean search proficiency
* Talent mapping and market intelligence
* Competency-based interviewing
* Stakeholder and hiring-manager management
* Offer negotiation and candidate closure
* Recruitment analytics
* ATS/recruitment technology proficiency
* Employer branding awareness

**Critical Success Attributes**

The individual should be:

* **Commercially minded:**
  understands that recruitment is ultimately about enabling business outcomes.
* **Consultative:**
  comfortable challenging or advising hiring managers using market evidence.
* **Globally oriented:**
  able to work effectively across cultures and geographies.
* **Strong networker:**
  capable of creating talent pipelines before vacancies arise.
* **Hands-on:**
  personally comfortable sourcing and engaging candidates.
* **Data driven:**
  uses recruitment analytics to influence decisions.
* **Highly responsive:**
  able to manage priorities across different time zones.
* **Candidate focused:**
  maintains a professional and engaging experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* **Adaptable:**
  comfortable operating in a growing global capability environment where requirements may evolve rapidly.

**About ICG Medical:**

ICG Medical is a leading global healthcare recruiter with a focus on nurses (all specialties), midwives, and home care/healthcare workers.

Our company vision is to improve patient care. The DNA makeup of our business stems from our core values: Open, Family, and Passion.

An Allied Healthcare Recruiter typically focuses on recruiting professionals in various allied health specialties. Allied health refers to a broad group of healthcare professions that are distinct from medicine and nursing but play crucial roles in patient care, diagnostics, therapy, and support services. Some of the specialties an Allied Healthcare Recruiter may work on include.

* Medical Laboratory Science: Recruiting medical laboratory technologists and technicians.
* Dietetics and Nutrition: Recruiting dietitians and nutritionists.
* Pharmacy: Recruiting pharmacists and pharmacy technicians.
* Emergency Medical Services: Recruiting paramedics and emergency medical technicians (EMTs).
* Medical Assisting: Recruiting medical assistants.
* Health Information Management: Recruiting health information technicians and managers.
* Surgical Technology: Recruiting surgical technologists.

**Tributum Power Private Limited**

*An Accel1 Inc. Joint Venture | AtmosPOLE™ Manufacturing & Assembly*

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)

**Department:**
Human Resources & Administration

**Experience:**
Minimum 15 Years

**Qualification:**
MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management or Industrial Relations

**Reporting To:**
JV CEO / Senior Management

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Industry:**
Climate Engineering | Intelligent Infrastructure | Advanced Manufacturing

**ABOUT TRIBUTUM POWER**

**Tributum Power Private Limited is a joint venture of Accel1 Inc.**
, established to manufacture, assemble, deploy and scale AtmosPOLE™, Accel1's flagship intelligent environmental infrastructure platform.

AtmosPOLE™ integrates environmental monitoring, air treatment, smart lighting, IoT connectivity, digital communication, public safety and AI-powered environmental intelligence into multifunctional urban infrastructure.

Tributum Power is establishing advanced manufacturing and assembly capabilities to support large-scale deployment of intelligent climate infrastructure.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on
**Senior HR Manager with 15+ years of experience**
to establish and lead the Human Resources and Administration function for our manufacturing operations in Noida.

The selected candidate will build HR operations from the ground up, recruit approximately
**48 manufacturing and operational professionals**
, establish HR policies, implement digital systems, manage statutory compliance and develop a high-performance organizational culture.

The role requires strong expertise in manufacturing recruitment, industrial relations, workforce planning, payroll, performance management and employee development.

**We seek an HR leader who can build an organization, not simply manage an existing department.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. HR Strategy & Organization Building**

* Establish the HR and Administration function, organizational structure, policies and procedures.
* Develop scalable HR systems aligned with manufacturing growth.
* Define employee grades, compensation structures and reporting hierarchies.
* Advise senior management on workforce strategy and organizational development.
* Build a culture of accountability, safety, productivity and operational excellence.

**2. Workforce Planning & Recruitment**

* Lead recruitment and onboarding for approximately 48 manufacturing and operational positions.
* Recruit engineers, production managers, mechanical/electrical technicians, electronics and IoT specialists, QA/QC personnel, supervisors and administrative staff.
* Develop manpower plans, recruitment budgets and hiring schedules.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, technical assessments and offers.
* Build partnerships with ITIs, polytechnics, engineering colleges and recruitment agencies.
* Develop talent pipelines across Noida, Greater Noida and Delhi NCR.
* Monitor recruitment timelines, costs, offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Plan future staffing requirements for manufacturing expansion.

**3. HR Policies & Employee Administration**

* Develop employee handbooks, HR policies, appointment letters and employment agreements.
* Establish attendance, leave, shift, overtime, holiday and disciplinary policies.
* Implement onboarding, probation, confirmation, appraisal and exit processes.
* Maintain employee records, statutory documentation and administrative controls.
* Ensure consistent HR policy implementation across departments.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Industrial Relations**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and Uttar Pradesh labor laws and employment regulations.
* Manage applicable EPF, ESI, gratuity, minimum wages, overtime and statutory benefits.
* Maintain factory-related employment records, statutory registers and compliance documentation.
* Oversee applicable contract labor, apprenticeship and outsourced workforce requirements.
* Establish grievance, disciplinary, employee welfare and workplace harassment prevention procedures.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, labor consultants, auditors and government authorities.
* Resolve employee disputes and maintain compliance calendars.

**5. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Develop salary structures, compensation policies and employee benefits.
* Coordinate payroll, attendance reconciliation, overtime, statutory deductions and settlements.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely processing with Finance.
* Develop increments, incentives and employee recognition programs.
* Prepare manpower budgets and compensation reports.

**6. Performance Management & Development**

* Establish performance appraisal systems and role-specific KRAs/KPIs.
* Implement probation reviews, evaluations and performance improvement plans.
* Develop performance-linked incentives and recognition programs.
* Support promotions, career progression and leadership development.
* Partner with department heads to improve productivity and accountability.

**7. Training & Technical Skills**

* Establish induction, orientation and employee development programs.
* Coordinate training in mechanical assembly, electrical systems, electronics, IoT and quality control.
* Develop competency matrices with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and EHS teams.
* Coordinate safety awareness and workplace training.
* Maintain training records and develop institutional skill-development partnerships.

**8. Employee Relations & Retention**

* Build a professional, inclusive and performance-oriented workplace.
* Establish grievance-resolution and employee communication processes.
* Develop engagement, welfare, recognition and retention programs.
* Conduct employee feedback sessions and exit interviews.
* Monitor attrition, absenteeism and workplace satisfaction.

**9. Manufacturing HR & Shop-Floor Operations**

* Work closely with Production Managers, Supervisors and Engineering leadership.
* Establish shift-wise manpower planning and workforce allocation.
* Monitor attendance, overtime and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate technical staffing based on production requirements.
* Support production ramp-up, workforce readiness and operational expansion.
* Reinforce workplace discipline, safety and quality expectations.

**10. HRMS, Digital Systems & Analytics**

* Implement HRMS and biometric attendance systems.
* Digitize recruitment, onboarding, employee records, payroll and performance management.
* Develop dashboards for headcount, recruitment, attrition, payroll, training and compliance.
* Ensure employee data confidentiality and reporting accuracy.
* Present HR analytics and management reports.

**11. Administration, Budgeting & Leadership**

* Oversee assigned factory and office administration and employee facilities.
* Coordinate workplace welfare and safety induction with EHS personnel.
* Prepare HR budgets, manpower forecasts and training plans.
* Report recruitment progress, compliance and workforce costs.
* Build and mentor the HR team as operations expand.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations or related discipline.
* **Minimum 15 years of HR experience**
  , preferably in manufacturing or industrial operations.
* Proven experience establishing or scaling HR functions.
* Strong technical recruitment and industrial workforce planning capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial relations, payroll and compliance.
* Experience implementing HR policies, HRMS an

**FIRST 90 DAYS – EXPECTED DELIVERABLES**

**Days 1–30: Establish**

* Finalize manpower plans and recruitment priorities.
* Establish essential HR policies, documentation and onboarding processes.
* Begin hiring critical manufacturing and technical personnel.
* Assess statutory compliance, payroll and HRMS requirements.

**Days 31–60: Mobilize**

* Accelerate recruitment against agreed staffing milestones.
* Implement employee records, attendance and payroll coordination.
* Establish induction, safety awareness and training programs.
* Introduce HR dashboards, compliance tracking and departmental KPIs.

**Days 61–90: Operationalize**

* Progress toward completion of the initial recruitment plan.
* Stabilize HR administration, payroll and employee relations.
* Implement employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Conduct an initial compliance assessment.
* Present a scalable HR roadmap for future expansion.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Success will be measured through recruitment completion, time to hire, workforce readiness, employee retention, statutory compliance, payroll accuracy, training completion, KRA/KPI implementation, HRMS adoption, employee engagement and manpower budget adherence.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are requested to send their updated résumé to
**careers@accel1.com**
with the subject line:

**Application – Senior HR Manager – Tributum Power**

Please include your current designation, total HR and manufacturing experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and current location.

**Apply Now:**
**careers@accel1.com**

title: Trainer Acquisition Specialist
description:
**We are hiring Trainer Acquisition Specialist!**

**Mid-Senior | 3 to 5 Years of Experience**

You'll be part of
**Uptut's Trainer Acquisition & Operations team**
, working at the intersection of talent, learning, partnerships, and project delivery.

**What you'll do at Uptut**

At Uptut, we bring people and organisations together through practical, hands-on learning, and you'll help make that happen by finding the right experts and turning training requirements into successful projects.

**Trainer Acquisition & Partnerships**

* Hunt for great trainers and subject matter experts through LinkedIn, Naukri, and other platforms.
* Screen profiles, conduct calls and interviews, verify expertise, and find the right fit for client requirements.
* Build a go-to pool of reliable trainers who can deliver across multiple learning and technology domains.
* Build relationships with trainers, staffing partners, training vendors, and certification partners.
* Turn incoming training leads into confirmed projects through smart sourcing, follow-ups, and negotiations.

**Operations & Project Management**

* Own training projects end to end, from understanding client needs and identifying trainers to coordinating content, labs, delivery, and project closure.
* Work with clients to understand training objectives, required tools, lab environments, schedules, and learning materials.
* Manage trainer contracts, invoices, proposals, vouchers, and partner documentation.
* Create training proposals and presentations using Google Workspace, Canva, and Other tools.
* Keep our trainer portal, company documents, shared drives, and WhatsApp groups organised and up to date.
* Track project progress using tools like Slack, ClickUp, Jira, Trello, or Asana, and use data to spot gaps and improve processes.
* Support internal operations, including Zoho People leave management, meal benefits, and team coordination.

**How you'll work?**

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

About Us
  
Sage helps small and mid-sized businesses make work and money flow. Our finance, HR, and payroll technology simplifies essential work and helps customers make decisions with confidence. We build with empathy, earn trust by delivering on our promises, and look for simpler ways to solve real problems. Across teams, we value curiosity, ownership, and ideas that improve the experience for customers and colleagues.
  
Our team builds Sage Expense Management, which helps finance teams manage spend from card transactions and receipt collection through policy checks, reimbursements, reconciliation, and accounting integrations. The platform also powers white-label and embedded experiences that banks, card issuers, and other partners offer to their customers.
  
What We’re Looking For
  
- You have 8+ years building software and 5+ years managing engineers across multiple engineering teams, including experience developing engineering managers or senior technical leaders.
  
- Technical depth in backend systems: strong experience with Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed systems, plus enough familiarity with Angular to guide frontend decisions and review work across the product.
  
- Hands-on engineering judgment: ability to work in the codebase, review design docs and pull requests, debug production issues, and improve performance and resilience.
  
- Visible leadership in AI-assisted engineering: use AI tools productively yourself, help engineers evaluate their output, and build team-level harnesses and workflows that improve quality and speed.
  
- Delivery ownership: break complex initiatives into milestones, make sound trade-offs, and maintain high standards for tests, automation, monitoring, and documentation.
  
- People leadership: coach engineers and managers, give clear feedback, support career growth, and participate in hiring.
  
- Cross-functional collaboration: communicate clearly with Product, Design, Support, go-to-market teams, external stakeholders, and other Sage Engineering groups.
  
What to Expect
  
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You’ll remain technically involved while giving engineers ownership, growing the team, and taking responsibility for delivery and long-term product health.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You’ll Make
  
- Lead engineering teams building a product used by businesses across 39 countries.
  
- Stay hands-on across the stack: guide backend architecture and Angular frontend design, review critical changes, and help solve difficult production issues, write code where it matters.
  
- Build and operate services handling 7 million+ requests per day, with peaks above 1,000 requests per second. Own delivery and reliability from design through deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
  
- Partner with Product, Design, and go-to-market teams to turn customer needs into priorities and deliver useful features at scale.
  
- Build trusted relationships with customer and partner engineering teams and other external stakeholders. Work with wider Sage Engineering teams, including Cloud-Ops and Security, to align plans, commitments, and technical standards.

title: Associate Director, Service Ops Lead - Talent and L&D
description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

  

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Associate Director, Service Operations Lead – Talent & L&D is responsible for ensuring the stable, compliant, and reliable operation of select systems and platforms within the HR Digital & Tech domain. The role oversees day-to-day platform operations and ensures that processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely. It maintains the operational performance of multiple platforms (e.g. SuccessFactors), ensuring they meet agreed service levels and adhere to security and compliance expectations. The role also provides leadership across operational service teams and partner-delivered support services, ensuring effective service delivery, proactive issue management, continuous improvement, and strong coordination across business, technology, security, infrastructure, product, and vendor teams.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide operational leadership across Talent & Data platforms, ensuring system stability, availability, and adherence to service levels, acting as the primary internal escalation point for product and domain teams on service performance and major incidents.
* Govern incident, problem, change, configuration, and release processes for domain platforms, ensuring operational compliance with ITSM policies and control frameworks, and defining measurable outcomes for problem management (e.g., RCA closure time, recurrence prevention, defect trend reduction).
* Define and maintain service readiness and runbook quality standards (e.g. ServiceNow Knowledge), ensuring escalation paths, support tasks, data handling, continuity steps, and deployment impacts are captured and validated before go-live.
* Create and oversee service plans for new and enhanced products, coordinating with Product Owners, third-party partners, and platform/service teams to define SLAs, performance expectations, and support handover criteria.
* Monitor platform performance, proactively identifying risks, trends, and recurring issues, and implement improvement actions to strengthen stability and user experience.
* Coordinate with Platform Owners, engineering squads, solution architects, and service teams to ensure changes, integrations, upgrades, and releases are deployed safely and meet operational readiness standards.
* Lead operational readiness assessments, ensuring documentation, support models, monitoring coverage, and non-functional controls are in place prior to deployment.
* Own operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for the platforms, ensuring performance, risks, and issues are communicated to senior stakeholders.
* Oversee root cause analysis for major incidents, ensuring sustainable fixes, clear remediation actions, and preventative measures are identified and delivered.
* Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, configuration inventories, and architectural operational views.
* Manage relationships with third-party vendors and managed service providers to ensure high-quality operational support and fulfilment of contractual obligations.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate operational support teams and partner resources across areas such as service desk, platform support, infrastructure, cloud services, and application operations, ensuring clear accountability, timely delivery, and effective escalation management.
* Collaborate with security, risk, compliance, infrastructure, product, and engineering teams to ensure access controls, data handling, cyber security requirements, operational controls, and compliance standards are embedded into day-to-day service operations.
* Where required, support extended operational coverage, escalation, or on-call arrangements for critical incidents, major releases, or high-priority business events.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

  

* **15–19 years of experience** in platform operations, system administration, IT service management, or technical delivery within complex enterprise environments, ideally supporting **SuccessFactors, Degreed, or similar HR/L&D platforms** .
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong knowledge of **platform operations, ITSM, cloud technologies, system integrations, monitoring, security, compliance, resilience, and business continuity** .
* Proven experience managing **incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management** , including root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience with **ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps** , monitoring platforms, knowledge management tools, or similar enterprise technologies.
* Experience leading operational support across multiple platforms and coordinating with **engineering, architecture, product, service desk, infrastructure, cloud, and third-party teams** .
* Strong service-management experience across **SLAs, KPIs, operational dashboards, incident trends, service performance, and operational risk indicators** .
* Experience managing **vendors, managed service providers, and SaaS partners** , including escalations, service quality, and continuous improvement.
* Experience developing operational documentation such as **runbooks, support procedures, and operational readiness assessments** .
* Experience working in **Agile/DevOps and fast-paced environments** , ensuring continuous delivery while maintaining platform reliability and user experience.
* Relevant certifications such as **ITIL, AWS/cloud, Agile/Scrum, DevOps Foundations, or equivalent** are desirable.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, especially in complex operational scenarios.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clarity during incidents and complex change cycles.
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, and operational risk controls.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and promote operational discipline.
* Effective organisational skills, able to balance multiple priorities and manage time-sensitive escalations.
* Strong leadership and coaching capability, with the ability to develop others, build collaboration, and create a high-performing service culture.
* Strong vendor, stakeholder, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across internal and external teams.
* Ability to work flexibly across time zones and support critical service events, releases, or escalations where required.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
Comfortable with ambiguity and change  

**Skills**

Degreed (Platform), Human Resources (HR) Technology, Incident Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), Major Incident Management, Operational Governance, Phenom (Platform), SAP SuccessFactors, Service Operations, Vendor Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

title: Team Lead - Fullstack
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Team Lead** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**

Responsible for guiding a software development team to deliver high‑value, performant, and secure software solutions. This role ensures that day‑to‑day development activities align with the R&D Department goals and processes.
  
  
The Team Lead provides direction, coaching, and technical oversight for developers through the design, implementation, and automated/integration testing of software. They work closely with the Project Lead (who owns project planning, status reporting, estimation, and delivery) to ensure work is executed effectively. The Team Lead focuses on people leadership, roadmap execution, and team performance, but may support the architecture and development if needed.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
  
As a **Team Lead** at Arctic Wolf, you will:

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers.
* Provide day-to-day technical guidance and remove obstacles impacting delivery.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and career development discussions.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation.
* Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, tools, and team effectiveness.
* Build strong partnerships with Product Management, Architecture, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to software development standards, security policies, and engineering best practices.  

  

Technical Leadership & Software Delivery

* Guide the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software solutions.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Provide technical oversight on architecture, implementation, code quality, and troubleshooting activities.
* Promote secure coding practices, automated testing, and engineering excellence.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
Support software development activities as needed through hands-on technical contributions.  

People Management & Operations

* Support team planning, capacity management, and resource allocation.
* Approve vacation requests, expenses, and training budgets.
* Partner with Engineering Leadership and HR on performance management and compensation planning.
* Participate in hiring activities, including candidate screening, interviewing, and selection.
* Support onboarding and development of new team members.

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in software development or a related technical role.
* Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to engineering teams.
* Strong background in designing, developing, and delivering software applications.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Experience driving engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of secure coding standards, software security principles, and quality engineering practices.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members in a collaborative environment.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.  

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**About Arctic Wolf**

title: HR Generalist
description:
Job Title: HR Generalist (Media & Entertainment)
  
  
• Location: India – Mumbai
  
• Department: Human Resources
  
• Employment Type: Full-Time
  
• Reporting To: Head of HR / Manager – Human Resources
  
• Experience Level: 3–5 Years
  
  
Job Brief
  
  
We are looking for a highly structured, process-oriented HR Generalist to join our fast-paced media company [Insert Company Name]. Unlike a standard creative-facing role, this position is focused heavily on HR operations, heavy statutory compliances, process documentation, and Compensation & Benefits (C&B). You will be responsible for building standardized HR workflows from scratch, maintaining strict legal compliance across a diverse media workforce (including permanent employees and creative freelancers), and seamlessly coordinating payroll inputs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  
1. Compliance Management (Heavy Focus)
  
  
• Ensure 100% adherence to all Central and State-level Indian labor laws (e.g., Factories Act/Shops & Establishment Act, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Bonus Act).
  
• Oversee and audit all statutory filings including Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Gratuity, and Professional Tax (PT).
  
• Act as a core member or coordinator for the Internal Committee (IC) under the POSH Act, ensuring continuous employee training and legal documentation.
  
• Manage legal compliance, work orders, and risk mitigation for dynamic project-based media staff, contractors, and production crews.
  
  
2. HR Process Documentation & SOPs
  
  
• Design, write, and implement comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the entire employee lifecycle.
  
• Build and update the official Company Employee Handbook to align with evolving media business structures and remote/hybrid work policies.
  
• Create and formalize process maps for onboarding, offboarding, performance appraisals, asset tracking, and disciplinary actions.
  
  
3. Payroll Coordination & Administration
  
  
• Consolidate monthly attendance, leave trackers, overtime, and variable production-based payouts to deliver error-free payroll inputs.
  
• Liaison with external payroll vendors or internal finance teams to ensure accurate, timely processing of salaries.
  
• Manage the full Full & Final (F&F) settlement process for exiting employees, minimizing compliance lag or disputes.
  
  
4. Compensation & Benefits (C&B)
  
  
• Structure tax-efficient salary components (e.g., HRA, LTA, Special Allowance) for diverse pay scales in line with Indian Income Tax guidelines.
  
• Manage the administration of corporate group health insurance, wellness plans, and life insurance policies.
  
• Conduct benchmark studies within the Indian media industry to ensure competitive remuneration and incentive programs.
  
  
5. Shared Recruitment & Employee Lifecycle
  
  
• Handle partial recruitment support, stepping in to screen candidates or manage interviews during peak production/hiring seasons.
  
• Execute day-to-day HR operations, including maintaining employee digital records within the HRMS and managing formal internal communications.
  
  
Qualifications & Requirements
  
  
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or related fields (MBA/Postgraduate in HR or Finance/Labor Laws is highly preferred).
  
• Experience: 3 to 5 years of core HR generalist or HR operations experience. Prior exposure to a media house, production agency, or client-servicing environment is a major advantage.
  
• Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables for payroll/data tracking) and hands-on experience with modern HRMS platforms (e.g., Keka, Darwinbox, GreytHR).
  
• Core Competencies:
  
• Strong expertise in Indian statutory compliance and labor laws.
  
• Exceptional technical writing capability for drafting strict corporate policy documentation.
  
• High mathematical and analytical precision for managing compensation components.
  
To finalize this draft, tell me:
  
• Do you use a specific HRMS software (like GreytHR, Keka, etc.) that I should mention?
  
• Is this role for a single office location or managing compliances across multiple states in India?

* Reduce dependence on recruitment agencies through strong direct-sourcing capability.

**3. Hiring Manager & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Act as a
  **Talent Acquisition advisor**
  , rather than simply a recruitment coordinator.
* Work effectively with senior stakeholders based in Singapore, India and other APAC/global locations.
* Conduct structured role-intake meetings and translate business requirements into practical sourcing strategies.
* Provide stakeholders with fact-based views on:
* Talent availability
* Candidate expectations
* Hiring challenges
* Notice periods
* Compensation competitiveness
* Location considerations
* Maintain regular recruitment dashboards and pipeline reviews with hiring managers.

This is particularly relevant to the current India hiring environment. Internal recruitment discussions note that manager-and-above candidates in India can have approximately three-month notice periods, making proactive pipeline management important.

**4. Candidate Assessment & Selection**

* Conduct initial candidate screening and structured competency-based interviews.
* Assess candidates against technical requirements, leadership competencies, experience and organizational fit.
* Prepare concise candidate assessments for hiring managers.
* Coordinate panel interviews and selection processes across different countries/time zones.
* Support reference and pre-employment processes in partnership with relevant HC teams.
* Maintain strong engagement with shortlisted candidates throughout potentially long notice periods.

**5. Offer Management & Candidate Conversion**

* Partner with HC and hiring leaders on offer development and candidate closure.
* Understand candidate motivations, competing opportunities and potential joining risks.
* Support compensation discussions with appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Maintain engagement from offer acceptance through joining.
* Track offer declines, dropouts and counter-offer risks and identify improvement opportunities.

**6. Global Capability**

* Support recruitment of global positions that are based in India but serve regional or global stakeholders.
* Build targeted talent pools from established GCCs, technology companies, consulting organizations and multinational businesses.
* Help position India as a credible source of high-quality global talent.
* Support the development of India as a long-term talent and capability hub for SATS.

**7. Recruitment Analytics & Governance**

Maintain and periodically report key recruitment metrics, including:

* Time to shortlist
* Time to offer
* Time to fill
* Offer-to-accept ratio
* Offer-to-join ratio
* Source effectiveness
* Direct sourcing percentage
* Recruitment cost
* Pipeline conversion
* Candidate dropout/decline reasons
* Hiring manager and candidate feedback

Use recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

**8. Employer Branding & Talent Engagement**

* Represent SATS consistently and professionally in the external talent market.
* Communicate the company's global scale, business platforms and career opportunities to prospective candidates.
* Partner on LinkedIn, recruitment campaigns, talent events and targeted employer-brand initiatives.
* Build relationships with relevant professional communities and specialist talent networks.
* Deliver a high-quality candidate experience regardless of hiring outcome.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in
  **Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Management or related discipline.**
* Postgraduate HR qualification/MBA preferred

**Experience**

* **8-12 years**
  of Talent Acquisition/recruitment experience.
* Demonstrable experience recruiting across
  **APAC and/or international markets**
  .
* Experience in a multinational, GCC, global shared-services, aviation, logistics, technology, consulting or similarly complex environment strongly preferred.
* Experience directly sourcing specialist and managerial talent rather than relying predominantly on recruitment agencies.
* Exposure to senior/leadership hiring preferred.

**Technical / Functional Competencies**

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* End-to-end recruitment expertise
* Advanced sourcing capability
* LinkedIn Recruiter / Boolean search proficiency
* Talent mapping and market intelligence
* Competency-based interviewing
* Stakeholder and hiring-manager management
* Offer negotiation and candidate closure
* Recruitment analytics
* ATS/recruitment technology proficiency
* Employer branding awareness

**Critical Success Attributes**

The individual should be:

* **Commercially minded:**
  understands that recruitment is ultimately about enabling business outcomes.
* **Consultative:**
  comfortable challenging or advising hiring managers using market evidence.
* **Globally oriented:**
  able to work effectively across cultures and geographies.
* **Strong networker:**
  capable of creating talent pipelines before vacancies arise.
* **Hands-on:**
  personally comfortable sourcing and engaging candidates.
* **Data driven:**
  uses recruitment analytics to influence decisions.
* **Highly responsive:**
  able to manage priorities across different time zones.
* **Candidate focused:**
  maintains a professional and engaging experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* **Adaptable:**
  comfortable operating in a growing global capability environment where requirements may evolve rapidly.

title: Implementation Manager
description:

A global organisation is building a capability centre in India. It needs an Implementation Manager to turn business knowledge into practical playbooks and lead controlled process migrations from the regions to India. The work starts with Finance and expands to HR, IT, Operations, Sales and Recruitment once the pilot succeeds. The role reports to the General Manager of the centre and offers exposure to the business globally.

* Turn the approved centre strategy into a migration roadmap with clear milestones.
* Document current processes, controls and risks with regional experts.
* Develop reusable playbooks covering scope, roles, process steps, controls and service levels.
* Plan knowledge transfer, testing and cutover, and confirm readiness before go-live.
* Monitor service performance after go-live and capture lessons for the next wave.
* Hand over methods, documents and open actions to permanent owners when the assignment ends.

**About you**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in the staffing or workforce solutions industry.
* Good understanding of how staffing businesses serve clients, contractors and candidates.
* Experience across several functions, regions or transformation initiatives.
* Experience turning operational knowledge into clear processes, controls or implementation plans.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects without formal authority.
* Willingness to work closely with the centre in India and travel to regions as needed.

title: HR Manager

**Role Summary**

The **HR Business Partner (HRBP)** will act as a strategic partner to business leaders and store teams, aligning HR practices with business objectives. The role involves managing the entire employee lifecycle, driving performance culture, supporting retail operations, and ensuring a positive employee experience across stores and corporate teams.

The HRBP will work closely with leadership, store managers, and employees to strengthen people practices, engagement, performance management, and compliance.

· Align HR strategies with **business goals and store performance objectives**.

· Support leadership in **workforce planning and organizational development**.

**4. Performance Management**

· Conduct **quarterly and annual performance discussions** with managers.

**5. Employee Engagement & Culture**

· Address employee concerns and maintain **a positive work environment**.

· Organize **training programs, team activities, and culture-building initiatives**.

**6. HR Compliance & Policy Implementation**

· Ensure compliance with **labour laws, HR policies, and company guidelines**.

· Maintain employee records and HR documentation.

· Support audits and HR reporting requirements.

**7. Training & Development**

· Identify skill gaps and coordinate **training programs for retail staff**.

· Support **sales training, leadership development, and capability building**.

**8. HR Analytics & Reporting**

· Track and analyze HR metrics such as:

o Attrition

o Hiring timelines

o Employee performance

o Store staffing levels

· Strong **HR Business Partnering skills**

· Understanding of **retail HR operations**

· Excellent **communication and stakeholder management**

· Knowledge of **labour laws and compliance**

· Experience in **performance management and employee engagement**

· Problem-solving and conflict resolution skills

· Ability to manage **multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment**

· **3–6 years of HR experience**, preferably in **Retail / Jewellery / Luxury / Fashion / D2C industry**.

· Experience handling **multi-store retail workforce** is preferred.

· Bachelor’s degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field**

· **MBA in HR or equivalent qualification preferred**

title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
**About MaxIQ**

**MaxIQ**
is a revenue intelligence platform that helps enterprise sales and customer success teams forecast accurately, inspect pipeline, and act on customer signals. We integrate with Salesforce, Snowflake and Gong, and our AI agents work on top of MaxIQ’s Context Graph. We’re a fast-growing team in Pune building for global enterprise customers.

**The Role**

We’re hiring our first senior people leader. You’ll build HR at MaxIQ from the ground up and also own finance and compliance operations for our India entity. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set the strategy and do the work, partnering directly with the founders and leadership.

**What You’ll Own**

* HR policies, employee handbook and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, POSH)
* Recruitment end to end, managing our in-house recruiter, plus exits and F&F settlements
* Employer branding content on culture, hiring and life at MaxIQ, in partnership with marketing
* Onboarding, employee engagement, team events, gifting and recognition
* Performance management, appraisals and career frameworks
* Compensation bands, increments, bonus planning, ESOP administration and monthly payroll
* Banking relationship, FIRC coordination, GST/TDS/ROC filings and statutory audit, working with our accountant and external CA
* Org structure, headcount planning and a monthly people dashboard for leadership
* SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance program management and people-side controls
* Employee wellbeing, retention, culture and L&D
* Advising founders on people and scaling decisions, and building a lean HR team as we grow

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years in HR, with at least 3–4 years leading HR in a startup or product/SaaS company
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, payroll and statutory compliance
* Hands-on exposure to finance operations such as GST, TDS, banking and audits
* Experience setting up HR policies, processes and HRMS from scratch
* Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits is a strong plus
* A builder’s mindset: comfortable owning many areas without a large team
* Excellent communication and judgment, with the trust of both leadership and employees

**Why Join**

* Build the people function from day one at a high-growth AI company
* Direct partnership with founders and real ownership across HR, finance and compliance
* A sharp, collaborative team working on hard enterprise AI problems

description:

The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.

This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.

The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.

**Principal** **Responsibilities/Requirements:**

  

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.
* Skill / ExperienceMinimum:· Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.· Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.· Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.· Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.· Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.· Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.· Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.· Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.· Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.· Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred. **Preferred**:· 3-5 years of relevant experience· Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

JOB DESCRIPTION – HR MANAGER

**Company:**
All India Institute of Occult Science
