About the Role

All India Institute of Occult Science is looking for a result-oriented and technically strong HR Manager who can independently manage HR operations, payroll processing, statutory compliance, and employee-related matters. The ideal candidate must possess practical, execution-level knowledge of EPFO/PF compliance, ECR filing, PF challans, TDS, statutory returns, compliance audits, and EPFO notices.

We are looking for a professional who can take complete ownership of HR functions, resolve complex compliance issues, maintain accuracy in payroll, and ensure timely statutory submissions without excessive dependence on external consultants.

Key Responsibilities1. HR Operations & Employee Management

* Manage end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management, employee records, and exit formalities.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, HR policies, and workplace issues.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure proper documentation.
* Coordinate with management on manpower planning, employee performance, and HR requirements.

2. Payroll Management

* Independently manage monthly payroll processing, including attendance validation, LOP calculations, salary revisions, arrears, deductions, and full-and-final settlements.
* Verify payroll inputs and ensure accurate salary calculations and timely salary disbursement.
* Reconcile payroll data with attendance records, employee master data, bank statements, and statutory deductions.
* Investigate and resolve salary discrepancies, incorrect deductions, and employee payroll complaints.
* Maintain payroll registers, salary statements, and supporting documentation.

3. EPFO / PF Compliance – Critical Requirement

* Independently manage monthly EPFO compliance, including PF calculations, ECR preparation, validation, and filing.
* Generate, verify, and reconcile PF challans and ensure timely payment of statutory dues.
* Handle UAN-related issues, employee PF complaints, missing contributions, and ECR errors.
* Reconcile payroll PF deductions with ECR records, challans, and applicable EPFO records.
* Investigate and resolve PF contribution mismatches and rejected ECR submissions.
* Handle EPFO notices, inspections, audits, queries, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with EPFO authorities and prepare appropriate responses and supporting records.
* Maintain accurate PF registers, employee contribution records, challans, returns, and compliance documentation.

4. TDS, Taxation & Other Statutory Compliance

* Manage or coordinate employee salary TDS calculations, declarations, investment proofs, tax projections, and year-end reconciliation.
* Review TDS deductions following salary revisions and changes in employee tax declarations.
* Coordinate timely TDS deposits, applicable returns, and related documentation.
* Ensure applicable ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other statutory obligations are met.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and track filing dates, payments, returns, and acknowledgements.
* Identify compliance gaps, take corrective action, and minimise the risk of penalties or notices.

5. Compliance Audits & Management Reporting

* Prepare payroll and statutory records for internal audits, external audits, and government inspections.
* Maintain organised records of ECR filings, challans, payroll registers, TDS documents, and statutory returns.
* Prepare HR MIS reports covering payroll, employee strength, attendance, compliance status, and pending issues.
* Provide regular compliance updates to management and highlight risks with corrective action plans.
* Ensure that all applicable statutory obligations are completed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll management, and statutory compliance.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience in EPFO/PF, ECR filing, PF challans, reconciliation, and employee PF matters.
* Practical exposure to EPFO notices, audits, inspections, and compliance-related queries.
* Strong working knowledge of salary TDS, payroll taxation, and applicable statutory filings.
* Experience in handling payroll discrepancies, statutory mismatches, and deadline-driven compliance issues.
* Good command of MS Excel, payroll systems, HR MIS, and compliance documentation.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain strict confidentiality.

Mandatory Selection Criteria

**This position requires practical execution, not merely theoretical knowledge.**

**Candidates must be able to explain the actual steps they have personally performed for:**

* Monthly payroll processing and reconciliation.
* ECR preparation, validation, filing, and error resolution.
* PF challan generation, payment, and reconciliation.
* Resolving UAN issues and missing PF contributions.
* Handling EPFO notices, audits, and inspections.
* Salary TDS calculations and applicable statutory filings.

Candidates whose experience is limited to coordinating with consultants, forwarding documents, or having theoretical knowledge of payroll and PF compliance will not be suitable for this role.

Key Performance Expectations

* Accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Timely completion of applicable statutory filings and payments.
* Effective resolution of payroll and PF discrepancies.
* Proper maintenance of statutory records and audit documentation.
* Proactive identification and resolution of compliance risks.
* Independent ownership of HR operations and statutory compliance.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A technically sound HR professional who can independently manage HR operations, payroll, EPFO/PF compliance, TDS coordination, statutory documentation, and audit-related responsibilities while providing reliable support to management.

* **Apply Now:**
  Candidates with strong hands-on payroll and statutory compliance experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
We're hiring a
**Founder’s Office Intern**
at Neuroid

**Location:**
Ghitorni, New Delhi

**Setup:**
In-office (4 days WFO)

**Type:**
90-day paid internship | Converts to full-time on performance

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

This is a generalist seat next to the founder. One week you’re screening media buyer applications, the next you’re reconciling invoices in Zoho, the next you’re cutting a reel script down to 40 seconds. If you want a job title that fits on a business card, this isn’t it. If you want to see how a 20-person agency actually runs - money, people, content, clients - from the inside, in 90 days, it is.

**What you’ll do**

* Hiring and people: post roles, screen applications, schedule interviews, prepare offer letters and onboarding checklists, keep HR records current, run the first-week experience for every new joiner
* Finance and billing: raise invoices in Zoho Books, track what’s paid and what’s overdue, prepare the weekly receivables sheet, log expenses, chase documents from vendors and clients
* Agreements: fill client and employment agreements from our templates, track what’s signed, what’s pending and what renews when
* Content: sit in on the founder’s content planning, research topics, draft and tighten scripts and posts, keep the idea bank and posted log current, give an honest opinion on what’s good
* AI: find and test tools that make any of the above faster, and build the small automations yourself - sheets, Zapier, prompts, whatever works
* Whatever the founder’s office needs that week

**Who this is for**

* A final-year student or recent graduate, or someone 0 to 1 year in, who has already run something - a college fest, a society, a small business, a freelance practice - and can show the mess they cleaned up
* You’re comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets and don’t need to be asked twice to follow up
* You read, you write clearly, and you have taste - you know why one caption works and another dies, and you can say it without being asked
* You’ve used AI tools for real work, not just to write assignments, and you’re curious about what else they can do
* You’re organised to the point of being slightly annoying about it
* Available full-time, in-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), starting November

**What you get**

* A seat in the founder’s office of a 30+ client agency, with real exposure to hiring, finance, legal, content and clients in one stint
* A written review at day 45 and a full-time offer at day 90 if you’ve earned it
* Direct mentorship from the founder and the Head of Ops
* More context on how an agency makes and loses money than most people get in two years

**How to apply**

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject “Founder’s Office Intern”. Three lines on one thing you organised or fixed and what changed because of it, plus one piece of content you’ve made that you’re proud of. No cover letters.

AtmosPOLE™ integrates environmental monitoring, air treatment, smart lighting, IoT connectivity, digital communication, public safety and AI-powered environmental intelligence into multifunctional urban infrastructure.

**Senior HR Manager with 15+ years of experience**
to establish and lead the Human Resources and Administration function for our manufacturing operations in Noida.

The selected candidate will build HR operations from the ground up, recruit approximately
**48 manufacturing and operational professionals**
, establish HR policies, implement digital systems, manage statutory compliance and develop a high-performance organizational culture.

The role requires strong expertise in manufacturing recruitment, industrial relations, workforce planning, payroll, performance management and employee development.

**We seek an HR leader who can build an organization, not simply manage an existing department.**

**1. HR Strategy & Organization Building**

* Establish the HR and Administration function, organizational structure, policies and procedures.
* Develop scalable HR systems aligned with manufacturing growth.
* Define employee grades, compensation structures and reporting hierarchies.
* Advise senior management on workforce strategy and organizational development.

* Implement onboarding, probation, confirmation, appraisal and exit processes.
* Maintain employee records, statutory documentation and administrative controls.

* Manage applicable EPF, ESI, gratuity, minimum wages, overtime and statutory benefits.
* Maintain factory-related employment records, statutory registers and compliance documentation.
* Oversee applicable contract labor, apprenticeship and outsourced workforce requirements.
* Establish grievance, disciplinary, employee welfare and workplace harassment prevention procedures.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, labor consultants, auditors and government authorities.
* Resolve employee disputes and maintain compliance calendars.

**5. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Develop salary structures, compensation policies and employee benefits.
* Coordinate payroll, attendance reconciliation, overtime, statutory deductions and settlements.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely processing with Finance.
* Develop increments, incentives and employee recognition programs.
* Prepare manpower budgets and compensation reports.

**6. Performance Management & Development**

* Establish performance appraisal systems and role-specific KRAs/KPIs.
* Implement probation reviews, evaluations and performance improvement plans.
* Develop performance-linked incentives and recognition programs.
* Support promotions, career progression and leadership development.
* Partner with department heads to improve productivity and accountability.

**7. Training & Technical Skills**

* Establish induction, orientation and employee development programs.
* Coordinate training in mechanical assembly, electrical systems, electronics, IoT and quality control.
* Develop competency matrices with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and EHS teams.
* Coordinate safety awareness and workplace training.
* Maintain training records and develop institutional skill-development partnerships.

**8. Employee Relations & Retention**

* Build a professional, inclusive and performance-oriented workplace.
* Establish grievance-resolution and employee communication processes.
* Develop engagement, welfare, recognition and retention programs.
* Conduct employee feedback sessions and exit interviews.
* Monitor attrition, absenteeism and workplace satisfaction.

**9. Manufacturing HR & Shop-Floor Operations**

* Monitor attendance, overtime and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate technical staffing based on production requirements.
* Support production ramp-up, workforce readiness and operational expansion.
* Reinforce workplace discipline, safety and quality expectations.

**10. HRMS, Digital Systems & Analytics**

* Implement HRMS and biometric attendance systems.
* Digitize recruitment, onboarding, employee records, payroll and performance management.
* Develop dashboards for headcount, recruitment, attrition, payroll, training and compliance.
* Ensure employee data confidentiality and reporting accuracy.
* Present HR analytics and management reports.

**11. Administration, Budgeting & Leadership**

* Prepare HR budgets, manpower forecasts and training plans.
* Report recruitment progress, compliance and workforce costs.

* **Minimum 15 years of HR experience**

* Proven experience establishing or scaling HR functions.
* Strong technical recruitment and industrial workforce planning capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial relations, payroll and compliance.
* Experience implementing HR policies, HRMS an

title: Senior Atlassian Admin
description:
**Job Description - Senior Atlassian Admin**

**About Rightsline:**

At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the world’s most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology.

Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control.

At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide.

Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference.

**What You Will Own:**

**Instance Configuration & Governance**

* Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes.
* Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires — establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step.
* Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery
* Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects.
* Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use.
* Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes.

**Workflow, Automation & App Administration**

* Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration — and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration.
* Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state.
* Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus.
* Administer our Marketplace apps — including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent.

**Confluence & Process Documentation**

* Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy.
* Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives.
* Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes.

**Reporting, Data & Integrations**

* Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence.
* Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost.
* Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely.
* Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus.
* Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors.

**Access, Compliance & Support**

* Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when.
* Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management.
* Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks

**What You Bring:**

* 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration.
* Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management).
* ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps.
* Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics.
* Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires.
* Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection.
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira.
* Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change.
* Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping.
* Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates.
* Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations.
* Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction.
* Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on.
* Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative.
* Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones.

**Work Environment & Expectations:**

* Noida/NCR based
* Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts. Regular overlap with US-based engineering leadership, targeting 4 hours daily.
* Compliance with security and remote working policies

**Compensation & Growth:**

Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities.

**Life at Rightsline India:**

At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success.  
We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes:

* Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security

You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand.

At Quick Clean, we are building more than a laundry services company. We are transforming how the hospitality and healthcare industries manage their laundry operations through technology, operational excellence, and sustainable solutions.

With 140+ On-Premise Laundry (OPL) sites across India, a workforce of 1,000+ employees, and ambitious expansion plans, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth.

We are looking for a Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) who can build the organisation, develop future leaders, strengthen our performance culture, and create the people infrastructure required to support our next phase of growth.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role working directly with the Founder & CEO. The mandate goes beyond traditional HR: we expect our CHRO to influence business performance through better leadership, workforce productivity, talent quality, and organisational effectiveness.

If you are passionate about building high-performance organisations and thrive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment, this opportunity is for you.

What Will You Own?

1. Organisation Strategy & Design

\* Partner with the Founder & CEO and leadership team to translate business objectives into a comprehensive people strategy.

\* Design scalable organisation structures, workforce plans, and reporting frameworks aligned with business growth.

\* Establish clear accountability, role ownership, and performance expectations across functions and locations.

\* Identify organisational capability gaps and build solutions to support rapid expansion.

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

\* Build a robust recruitment engine to support leadership, sales, operations, engineering, and corporate hiring.

\* Develop manpower plans aligned with new-site launches, business expansion, and operational requirements.

\* Strengthen recruitment quality, hiring turnaround time, and onboarding effectiveness.

\* Build leadership pipelines, campus recruitment programmes, and management trainee initiatives.

\* Establish talent acquisition metrics covering hiring efficiency, quality of hire, and early-tenure retention.

3. Workforce Productivity & Operational HR

\* Partner with Operations and regional leadership to improve manpower availability, deployment, and productivity across our pan-India sites.

\* Develop workforce planning models covering staffing requirements, absenteeism, attrition, shifts, and overtime.

\* Establish productivity benchmarks and workforce management dashboards.

\* Strengthen HR engagement with frontline employees and operational teams through regular site visits.

\* Drive initiatives that improve workforce efficiency without compromising service quality, employee welfare, or safety.

4. Performance Management & Accountability

\* Build a high-performance culture through clear KRAs, measurable KPIs, quarterly reviews, and structured performance appraisals.

\* Align individual and functional performance with company objectives and business outcomes.

\* Establish transparent performance calibration, promotion, rewards, and performance improvement processes.

\* Work with business leaders to address sustained underperformance and strengthen managerial accountability.

\* Design performance-linked incentive and recognition frameworks that reward ownership, execution, and results.

5. Leadership Development & Succession Planning

\* Develop leadership capabilities across regional teams, functional heads, and operational site managers.

\* Build structured career progression, succession planning, and internal talent development programmes.

\* Identify high-potential employees and prepare them for larger responsibilities.

\* Coach managers to become stronger people leaders who can build capable, accountable teams.

\* Reduce dependence on external hiring by developing a strong internal leadership pipeline.

6. Employee Engagement, Retention & Culture

\* Strengthen Quick Clean’s culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, integrity, and customer focus.

\* Identify attrition drivers and develop targeted retention strategies for critical talent and frontline employees.

\* Build effective employee feedback, recognition, communication, and grievance-resolution mechanisms.

\* Improve managerial effectiveness, employee experience, and consistency of people practices across locations.

\* Develop initiatives that make Quick Clean an employer of choice for high-performing professionals.

7. HR Systems, Analytics & Governance

\* Build a data-driven HR function supported by effective HRMS utilisation, automation, and people analytics.

\* Establish dashboards covering attrition, recruitment, attendance, manpower costs, productivity, and performance.

\* Standardise HR processes across corporate offices, regional teams, and operational sites.

\* Position HR as a strategic business partner rather than a purely administrative function.

What Are We Looking For?

Experience & Qualifications

\* 10–15 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3–5 years in a senior HR leadership or strategic HR business partnering role.

\* Demonstrated experience managing HR for a multi-location organisation with a geographically dispersed workforce.

\* Strong experience in talent acquisition, workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, and organisation development.

\* Experience working with frontline employees, site-based teams, and regional leadership.

\* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and multi-state HR compliance.

\* Experience building HR systems, dashboards, and measurable people processes.

\* A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline. An MBA/PGDM in HR from a reputed institution would be preferred.

Preferred Background

Experience in one or more of the following sectors would be advantageous:

\* Hospitality and healthcare

\* Manufacturing and industrial services

\* Facilities management

\* Logistics and supply chain

\* Retail or other multi-location, service-intensive businesses

Experience in a founder-led, high-growth, entrepreneurial, or private-equity-backed organisation will be a strong advantage.

The Leadership Qualities We Value

We are looking for someone who:

\* Thinks like a business leader: Understands the relationship between people, productivity, revenue, and profitability.

\* Executes relentlessly: Converts ideas into measurable outcomes rather than stopping at policies and presentations.

\* Builds leaders: Develops managers who can take ownership and deliver results.

\* Makes tough decisions: Addresses performance issues with courage, fairness, and sound judgement.

\* Uses data to drive decisions: Relies on evidence, analytics, and measurable outcomes.

\* Stays close to the ground: Is comfortable engaging directly with frontline employees and visiting operational sites.

\* Thrives in a growth environment: Can bring structure and discipline without slowing down entrepreneurial execution.

What Does Success Look Like?

\* Improve workforce planning and manpower productivity across operational sites.

\* Strengthen leadership capability and succession coverage for critical positions.

\* Improve retention of high-performing and critical employees.

\* Build a dependable recruitment engine for business expansion.

\* Introduce reliable people analytics and HR dashboards for leadership decision-making.

Specific targets will be agreed upon after an initial assessment of the organisation and its current performance baselines.

Why Join Quick Clean?

This is an opportunity to work directly with the Founder & CEO and play a defining role in building a high-growth Indian company.

You will have the opportunity to shape the organisation’s culture, develop its future leaders, influence business decisions, and build the people systems required for national and international expansion.

We value ownership, integrity, speed of execution, continuous improvement, and the courage to challenge the status quo.

We are not looking for someone to simply manage HR. We are looking for a leader who can help build the organisation that will take Quick Clean to its next level of growth.

Interested?

If you are ready to build, lead, and make a measurable difference, we would love to hear from you.

title: HR Manager
description:
**HR Manager**

**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Industry:** Steel Manufacturing | PEB | Prefabricated Construction

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on HR Manager to set up ,establish, develop and lead the Human Resources function across the corporate office, factory and project sites.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building the HR function from scratch, developing HR strategies aligned with business objectives, establishing policies and systems, and building a capable HR team to support organisational growth.

The role requires an independent HR leader who can work closely with the senior management, introduce structured HR processes, and manage both strategic HR planning and day-to-day people matters. Practical experience in manufacturing or plant operations, including hands-on management of blue-collar workers, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Strategy & Organisational Development**

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
* Establish the HR function from scratch, including policies, processes, systems and responsibilities.
* Work closely with the CEO to identify organisational requirements and workforce priorities.
* Develop manpower plans, organisational structures and HR budgets.
* Implement scalable HR practices to support business expansion.

**2. HR Team Building & Function Setup**

* · Build and develop the HR team from the ground up.
* · Identify HR staffing requirements, define roles and responsibilities, and recruit team members.
* · Establish workflows, reporting structures and accountability within the HR function.
* · Guide and develop the HR team to ensure effective delivery of HR services.
* · Create standard operating procedures for consistent HR practices across the corporate office, factory and project sites.

**3. HR Policies, Systems & Performance Management**

* · Formulate and implement HR policies, procedures, employee handbooks and SOPs.
* · Design and implement performance management systems, including KRAs, KPIs and performance appraisals.
* · Establish structured processes for employee engagement, training, development and retention.
* · Identify skill gaps and implement employee development initiatives.
* · Monitor HR metrics and continuously improve people-management processes.

**4. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* · Develop recruitment strategies to meet current and future manpower requirements.
* · Lead recruitment for management, corporate, factory and project-site positions.
* · Coordinate with departmental heads to forecast workforce requirements.
* · Establish structured recruitment, onboarding and induction processes.
* · Ensure timely fulfilment of manpower requirements across the organisation.

**5. Manufacturing, Plant & Blue-Collar Workforce Management**

* · Manage HR requirements across manufacturing operations, factory premises and project sites.
* · Handle blue-collar workforce matters, including manpower deployment, attendance, discipline, grievances and contract labour coordination.
* · Work closely with plant and site management to address workforce challenges.
* · Manage employee relations, industrial relations and disciplinary matters.
* · Implement workforce practices that support productivity and operational continuity.

**6. Statutory Compliance & Industrial Relations**

* · Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* · Oversee factory-related HR documentation, statutory records, audits and inspections.
* · Handle labour grievances, disciplinary proceedings, disputes and union-related matters, wherever applicable.
* · Coordinate with contractors, consultants and relevant authorities as required.

**7. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination**

* · Oversee onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management and separation processes.
* · Coordinate payroll inputs and documentation with the Accounts team; payroll processing is handled by Accounts.
* · Establish effective HR reporting, documentation and employee-data management systems.
* · Ensure smooth HR operations across the organisation.

**8. Management Reporting & Advisory**

* · Advise the CEO and senior management on organisational design, workforce planning, employee relations and HR strategy.
* · Prepare regular reports on manpower, recruitment, attrition, performance and compliance.
* · Identify HR process gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* · Drive continuous improvement and support long-term organisational growth.

**Candidate Requirements**

* · Experience in strategic HR leadership and independent management of the overall HR function.
* · Demonstrated ability to establish or build an HR function from scratch, including policies, processes, systems and team structures.
* · Experience in building, hiring or developing an HR team.
* · Mandatory experience in a manufacturing, industrial or plant environment.
* · Hands-on experience managing blue-collar workers and contract labour.
* · Strong understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance and industrial relations.
* · Experience in manpower planning, performance management, organisational development and employee engagement.
* · Ability to work independently and partner with the CEO and senior management.
* · Strong leadership, communication, decision-making and problem-solving skills.

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked in a manufacturing Company or in a plant setup?
* Have you directly handled blue-collar workers and contract labour?
* Have you developed HR policies, performance management systems, KRAs/KPIs and appraisal processes?
* Have you built an HR department from scratch, including policies, processes, systems and SOPs?
* Have you developed and implemented HR strategies aligned with business goals?
* Whom do you currently report?

title: TA and People Partner
description:
**Role purpose:**

Prevalent AI is a fast-scaling, AI-first security organization with teams operating across multiple geographies. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition and People Partner to drive recruitment delivery and people partnering while contributing to the wider effectiveness of our People function.

This role carries primary responsibility for managing end-to-end Talent Acquisition independently, partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to understand resource requirements, develop effective sourcing strategies and deliver high-quality hiring outcomes across technical and business functions. The role requires someone who can take ownership of multiple recruitment priorities, provide strong candidate experience, and adapt to recruitment approaches to meet changing business needs. The talent acquisition will be for the wider organization, which predominately will be technical roles but also provide an opportunity to drive successful execution on global Sales and Client Solutions positions.

The role also demands contribution to the broader People activities, including onboarding, people partnering, employee engagement, and internal communications for the talent spread across the globe. This provides an opportunity to contribute beyond recruitment and develop a broader understanding of the People function.

We are looking for a proactive, commercially aware and collaborative professional with high level of independent thinking and ownership who combines strong recruitment execution with sound stakeholder management, attention to detail and an interest in supporting the wider global employee experience.

**Key accountabilities:**

1. **Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Delivery**

* Own and deliver the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for roles across the globe, covering technical, product, AI, cybersecurity, business, Sales and other functions as required.

* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, clarify essential skills and experience, agree with recruitment priorities, and establish realistic hiring timelines.

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies using direct headhunting, job portals, professional networks, referrals, direct sourcing and other relevant channels to build qualified candidate pipelines.

* Work closely with agency headhunters, recruitment partners and EOR (Employer on Record) providers based on the needs to fill specific roles in specific geographies.

* Be a passionate advocate for the business and our growth opportunities with candidates who may not currently be looking for a role.

* Conduct initial candidate assessments, evaluate role suitability, communicate opportunities effectively and present relevant candidates to hiring managers.

* Coordinate and drive interview processes, maintain momentum across hiring stages and ensure timely feedback, clear communication and a positive candidate experience.

* Manage candidate engagement and experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle, including offer discussions, compensation alignment, negotiations, offer approvals, documentation and pre-joining follow-up.

* Monitor recruitment progress, identify bottlenecks and take corrective action when pipelines are weak; requirements change or hiring timelines are at risk.

* Maintain accurate recruitment records and pipeline updates in BambooHR and other relevant recruitment tools, providing visibility into progress, risks, and outstanding actions.

* Track and report recruitment metrics, including pipeline status, time-to-fill, conversion rates and hiring outcomes, using insights to improve recruitment effectiveness.

* Support employer branding and represent Prevalent AI professionally in candidate interactions, communicating the company's culture, values, opportunities, and employee proposition.

* Manage relationships with recruitment vendors and external sourcing partners where required and support the effective use of recruitment platforms and tools.

* Contribute to workforce and resource planning discussions by providing recruitment pipeline insights, market feedback and hiring feasibility assessments.

  

2. **People Operations and Onboarding Support**

* Work closely with the newly onboard team members to ensure that they embrace their new roles and close any learning gaps without delays.

* Co-ordinate with other team members within and outside HR to ensure onboarding completion on time.

* Actively engage the new team members during their initial days in Prevalent AI – irrespective of the locations they join to ensure that the messaging and onboarding followed are uniform across the organization and a memorable experience for the new joiner.

* Maintain accurate employee records in BambooHR, including new starter information, role changes, contract updates, and offboarding records.

* Support the administration of core People processes, including reviews, contract renewals, leave management and policy acknowledgements.

* Assist with resource management administration by maintaining team allocation trackers and highlighting changes or potential conflicts for review.

* Work as a single point of contact for all employee related queries for the team members onboarded in other global locations, ensuring the same first-class experience regardless of where on the globe the new team member joins.

* Work collaboratively with the People and Administration teams to ensure employee-related processes are completed accurately and efficiently.

  

3. **Events and Cultural Initiatives**

* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives; , annual all-hands meetings, Rewards & Recognition events, and team activities

* Work with colleagues across the People team to deliver well-organized, inclusive and engaging employee experiences.

* Contribute ideas and practical support to initiatives that strengthen collaboration, reinforce company values, and improve employee engagement.

  

4. **Managing Employee Performance and Professional Growth**

* Create a supportive environment for team members to learn, perform, grow, and get rewarded.

* Maintain regular employee connects with team members across the globe

* Actively engage with team members and understand early warning signals on attrition

* Supporting our bi-annual performance process with timely documentation and admin support.
* Preparing reports, follow-ups, and statistics on performance review and goal-setting processes.

  

5. **Internal Communications and Collaboration**

* Draft, coordinate and publish People-related communications based on briefs and guidance from the People Director or relevant team members.

* Ensure communications are clear, accurate, professional and consistent with Prevalent AI's Authentic, Focused and Inquisitive values.

* Coordinate communication inputs for recruitment, onboarding, L&D, employee engagement and cultural initiatives, ensuring timely distribution.

* Collaborate proactively across the People team, share updates, follow through on commitments and provide operational support where priorities require it.

  

**Skills and Experience:**

To be successful in this role, you will be a proactive and accountable professional who can independently manage recruitment delivery while contributing to the wider priorities of the People function.

  

* Strong end-to-end Talent Acquisition experience: Demonstrated ability to independently manage recruitment from requirement intake and sourcing through assessment, interview coordination, offer management and joining.

* Technical recruitment capability: Experience headhunting and recruiting for technical roles, ideally within IT, software, SaaS, product, AI or cybersecurity environments, with the ability to understand technical requirements and identify relevant talent.

* Stakeholder partnership: Strong ability to work with hiring managers and business leaders, clarify requirements, manage expectations, provide market insights, and maintain alignment throughout the recruitment process.

* Sourcing and problem-solving: Ability to develop targeted sourcing strategies, build relevant candidate pipelines and adapt approaches when hiring requirements are challenging or progress is slower than expected.

* Recruitment ownership and delivery: Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple requisitions, competing deadlines and changing priorities while maintaining quality and candidate engagement.

* Data and process orientation: Attention to detail in maintaining recruitment records, tracking progress, monitoring hiring metrics, and using data to identify delays and improvement opportunities.

* Communication and relationship management: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage professionally with candidates, hiring managers, vendors and internal stakeholders.

* Candidate experience and employer representation: A professional, candidate-focused approach, with the ability to communicate company values, culture and opportunities effectively.

* Collaboration within the people function: Willingness to contribute to, People administration, Learning & Development coordination, Rewards and events as part of a broader People team.

* Interest in broader People Operations: Extensive prior experience across all HR operational areas is not essential; however, a genuine interest in learning and contributing to these activities is important.

* Systems and digital tools: Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel and Word. Experience with BambooHR or similar HRIS/ATS is advantageous, alongside an openness to using AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and work quality.

* Personal effectiveness: A proactive, dependable, and collaborative working style, with sound judgement, discretion when handling confidential information and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  

**Education:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. A qualification in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field is preferred.

title: Account Manager - US SMB
description:
**About ZOCA**
ZOCA is building products that help businesses simplify their operations, improve customer engagement, and drive growth. As we continue to scale our US SMB business, we are looking for an experienced Senior Account Manager to own the customer relationship and commercial health of a portfolio of US SMB customers.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role responsible for driving retention, expansion, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention across an existing customer base.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Account Manager who can take complete ownership of a portfolio of US SMB customers and drive both customer outcomes and revenue growth.
  
  
You will be responsible for protecting the existing revenue base while identifying and executing opportunities to expand customer relationships through upsells, cross-sells, additional locations, product adoption, and other expansion opportunities.
  
  
The ideal candidate has deep experience in subscription SaaS account management, with a strong track record in farming, retention, expansion, and managing a high-velocity SMB customer portfolio.
  
  
This is a commercially-oriented account management role. You should be comfortable having conversations about value, renewals, pricing, product adoption, expansion, and retention — while ensuring customers have a strong overall experience with ZOCA.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
You will have direct ownership of the commercial and relationship health of your assigned customer portfolio, including:
  
  

* GRR – Gross Revenue Retention
* NRR – Net Revenue Retention
* Customer retention and churn
* Expansion revenue
* Upsell and cross-sell
* Customer satisfaction
* CSAT
* NPS
* Product adoption and engagement
* Renewal performance
* Customer relationship health

**What You'll DoCustomer Portfolio Management**

* Own a portfolio of US SMB customers and act as the primary strategic point of contact.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with business owners, operators, and key decision-makers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, goals, challenges, and use of ZOCA.
* Proactively manage customer health and identify risks before they become churn events.
* Segment and prioritize your portfolio based on revenue, growth potential, engagement, and risk.
* Establish a consistent cadence of customer engagement appropriate to the account's size, value, and health.

**Retention & Renewals**

* Own customer retention and renewal outcomes across your portfolio.
* Proactively identify customers showing signs of churn risk and develop structured save plans.
* Lead renewal conversations and address commercial, product, adoption, and relationship-related objections.
* Understand the underlying reason behind customer churn risk rather than simply reacting to cancellation requests.
* Execute effective retention strategies including value reinforcement, product adoption, stakeholder engagement, and commercial negotiation.
* Recover at-risk customers and execute churn win-backs where appropriate.
* Maintain strong visibility into upcoming renewals and potential churn.

**Expansion & Revenue Growth**

* Identify and execute opportunities to grow existing customer revenue.
* Drive upsell, cross-sell, additional locations, higher plans, and other expansion opportunities.
* Identify expansion opportunities through customer usage, business growth, product adoption, and unmet customer needs.
* Conduct commercial conversations and negotiate expansion opportunities.
* Partner with customers to identify additional ways ZOCA can create value for their business.
* Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across the portfolio.
* Consistently achieve expansion and revenue targets.

**Customer Experience**

* Take ownership of overall customer satisfaction and relationship health.
* Drive improvements in CSAT and NPS across the portfolio.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and work cross-functionally to resolve them.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.
* Partner closely with Product, Support, Sales, and Operations teams to resolve customer issues and improve the customer experience.
* Turn customer feedback into actionable insights for the broader organization.

**Data, Forecasting & Execution**

* Maintain accurate customer health, renewal, expansion, and forecast data in the CRM.
* Track GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, CSAT, NPS, and other key portfolio metrics.
* Build accurate forecasts for renewals and expansion revenue.
* Develop action plans for customers at risk and track progress against those plans.
* Identify trends across the portfolio and proactively recommend strategies to improve retention and growth.
* Use data to prioritize where to spend time across a high-volume SMB customer base.

**What We're Looking ForMust Have**

* 3-5 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Client Management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS / subscription-based businesses.
* Proven experience managing and growing an existing customer portfolio.
* Strong hands-on experience in farming, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* Experience managing customers in the US market while working from India.
* Strong experience working with the SMB segment.
* Proven track record of owning retention and expansion targets.
* Strong understanding of GRR, NRR, churn, renewals, expansion revenue, and customer health.
* Experience managing a high-velocity customer portfolio with a large number of accounts.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, particularly with US-based customers.
* Ability to build relationships with business owners and senior decision-makers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with customer data, metrics, forecasts, and CRM systems.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently manage a portfolio.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience in a SaaS business with monthly or annual recurring revenue.
* Experience managing SMB customers at scale.
* Experience owning a book of business against GRR/NRR targets.
* Proven history of driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell.
* Experience with churn saves, win-backs, downgrade prevention, and renewal negotiations.
* Experience owning or influencing CSAT and NPS.
* Experience working in a high-growth startup or high-velocity SaaS environment.
* Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or similar CRM/customer success platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means growing and protecting the revenue in your portfolio while creating strong customer relationships.
  
  
**Your Key Metrics Will Include**

* GRR
* NRR
* Renewal rate
* Churn rate
* Expansion ARR / MRR
* Upsell and cross-sell revenue
* Churn saves and win-backs
* Customer health
* CSAT
* NPS
* Product adoption and engagement
* Forecast accuracy

You should be able to look at your portfolio and clearly answer:
  
  
Which customers are at risk? Why are they at risk? What am I doing about it?
  
  
Which customers have expansion potential? Why? What is the opportunity?
  
  
Which customers are healthy? How can I make them even more valuable and successful?
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate**
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**
Think commercially: You don't view Account Management as simply servicing customers. You understand how to protect revenue and create opportunities to grow it.
  
  
Are proactive: You identify churn risk and expansion opportunities before they become obvious.
  
  
Know how to farm: You can take an existing customer relationship and systematically grow its value over time.
  
  
Are comfortable with difficult conversations: You can confidently discuss renewals, pricing, cancellations, downgrades, and commercial objections.
  
  
Are customer-obsessed: You genuinely care about customer outcomes and understand that strong retention starts with delivering value.
  
  
Are data-driven: You know your portfolio numbers and use data to prioritize your time and actions.
  
  
Operate well at scale: You can effectively manage a high-volume SMB portfolio without every account requiring a completely bespoke approach.
  
  
Take ownership: You own the outcome — whether that means saving a customer, expanding an account, improving NPS, or fixing a customer experience issue.
  
  
**Why Join ZOCA?**

* Own a significant portfolio of US SMB customers and directly influence ZOCA's recurring revenue.
* Play a critical role in building ZOCA's retention and expansion engine.
* Work in a high-velocity SaaS environment with significant opportunities to drive NRR.
* Have direct visibility into the commercial impact of your work.
* Partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, and Operations teams.
* Opportunity to grow into senior Account Management, Customer Success, or leadership roles as ZOCA scales.

**If you're an experienced SaaS Account Manager who knows how to protect revenue, grow existing accounts, and build long-term customer relationships in the US SMB market, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:

**Job Overview**

The role requires a hands-on professional who can streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, manage client relationships, and independently generate new business opportunities.

Working closely with the founder and internal teams, the selected candidate will establish accountability, improve client satisfaction, optimize processes, and contribute to the agency's revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations & Process Management**

* Lead weekly internal team meetings to review progress, resolve challenges, and align priorities.
* Monitor client performance reports to identify significant changes in revenue, paid traffic, organic traffic, and other key performance indicators.
* Conduct sprint planning and review meetings to ensure timely task execution and adherence to workflows in ClickUp.
* Coordinate with the founder to review operational performance, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Participate in client meetings to assess service quality, review deliverables, and ensure client expectations are met.
* Act as the primary escalation point for client issues and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Work with account managers to ensure deliverables meet agreed Scope of Work (SoW) requirements.
* Oversee client invoicing, invoice dispatch, payment follow-ups, and related coordination.
* Identify workflow improvement opportunities and implement automation using Zapier, Slack, ClickUp, or equivalent platforms.
* Prepare and circulate a weekly internal newsletter covering team updates, achievements, progress, and important announcements.

**2. Team Management & Performance Enablement**

* Ensure new employees complete onboarding, role-specific training, and assessments before independently handling deliverables.
* Develop structured assessments and evaluation frameworks to measure employee knowledge, skills, and role readiness.
* Coordinate with HR and team leads to ensure timely completion of employee performance reviews.
* Establish clear performance goals, accountability measures, and productivity benchmarks across teams.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and team performance.
* Support team leads in improving coordination, resource utilization, and delivery quality.

**3. Sales, Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Collaborate with the lead generation team to strengthen the sales pipeline and improve prospect conversion.
* Work with the founder on sales calls, prospect meetings, presentations, proposals, and business development initiatives.
* Independently identify and approach potential clients through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Build and maintain a personal sales pipeline to generate new business opportunities and contribute directly to revenue growth.
* Establish and manage structured CRM processes for lead tracking, follow-ups, pipeline management, and conversion reporting.
* Develop lead-nurturing strategies through email marketing and consistent follow-ups to re-engage prospects.
* Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new service offerings, and alternative revenue streams.
* Explore industry awards, recognitions, and other initiatives to strengthen the agency's brand positioning and credibility.

**4. Freelancer & Resource Management**

* Identify and engage skilled freelancers through professional networks, industry communities, Fiverr, Upwork, and other relevant platforms.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of specialized external resources to support project requirements.
* Prepare job descriptions, project briefs, and scope requirements for freelance assignments.
* Coordinate resource allocation based on project timelines, client requirements, and business priorities.
* Evaluate freelancers based on expertise, reliability, work quality, and ability to meet deadlines.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience.
* **Prior experience in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency is essential.**
* MBA preferred; candidates with relevant experience and strong business acumen may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, account management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, lead conversion, and revenue generation.
* Experience managing CRM systems, sales pipelines, client relationships, and prospect follow-ups.
* Hands-on familiarity with project management and automation tools such as ClickUp, Slack, and Zapier, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to interpret client performance reports, identify potential risks, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Process-driven mindset with the ability to establish scalable systems and improve operational efficiency.
* Willingness to take ownership of both operational responsibilities and independent business development.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Consistent execution of internal workflows, sprint plans, and operational processes.
* Timely delivery of client commitments and effective resolution of escalations.
* Improved client satisfaction, service quality, and adherence to agreed SoWs.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Timely completion of employee onboarding, training, assessments, and performance reviews.
* Effective resource allocation, team productivity, and operational accountability.
* Implementation of structured CRM processes, consistent follow-ups, and improved pipeline visibility.
* Generation of qualified business opportunities, improved lead conversion, and contribution to revenue growth.
* Development of strategic partnerships and initiatives that enhance the agency's market presence.

title: Manager - Lending Partnerships
description:
**About WeRize**

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class-

delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small

cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60

Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth)

with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next

12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained

local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-

stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

* Distributor trust: Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
* Customer trust: End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
* Manufacturer trust: Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

**Key highlights: What do we do**

1. Large, underpenetrated market opportunity: India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. Differentiated, asset-light social distribution: WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. Proprietary AI driven tech stack: Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

**Role Description:**

This is a critical role in the company. The incumbent in the role will be responsible for leading and

enhancing the lending partnerships with the Banks, NBFCs, Fintech and other ecosystem players for business growth across multiple asset classes/ products. This role spans partner acquisition

outreach, business program management, and hands-on operational execution to drive conversion

across our lending partner ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Partner Sourcing & Business Development**

* Identify and reach out to prospective NBFCs, fintech lenders, and digital lending partners through LinkedIn, cold outreach, and network connections.
* Initiate email threads, schedule introductory pitches, and highlight WeRize’s monthly lead volume to onboard new supply partners.

**2. Program Management & Integrations**

* Act as a primary liaison between the product teams of WeRize and the potential partners to ensure smooth integration and go-live.
* Coordinate API integrations, track implementation, troubleshoot workflow bottlenecks, and push integrations through to go-live.

**3. Operations & Conversion Optimization**

* Manage daily lead delivery pipelines and monitor end-to-end conversion funnels with lending partners.
* Work closely with operational teams at WeRize and the lending partners to resolve day to day operational issues for friction-less workflows and operations.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:**
  1–4 years of experience in digital lending, fintech operations, partner management, or business development.
* **Outreach Capability:**
  Confident communicator skilled in cold outreach via LinkedIn and email to open doors with senior stakeholders.
* **Tech-Literate:**
  Basic understanding of digital lending workflows and product integration lifecycles.
* **Analytical & Hands-on:**
  Data-oriented approach to monitoring conversion metrics combined with strong execution ownership.

title: Sr. Manager - Implementation (CCAAS)
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
As a Sprinklr Implementation Manager, you will lead a team of high-performing implementation consultants to ensure successful, value-oriented deployments of the Sprinklr platform. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end implementation process, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that clients derive maximum value from Sprinklr's solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and mentor a team of implementation consultants, fostering professional growth and ensuring high performance.
* Oversee multiple concurrent implementation projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the implementation phase, building strong relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Define and maintain regional implementation strategies in collaboration with other regional leaders.
* Develop and implement best practices, methodologies, and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the implementation process.
* Work closely with sales, product, and customer success teams to ensure seamless transitions and alignments.
* Identify potential risks in the implementation process and develop mitigation strategies.
* Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to implementation projects and team performance.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation.
* 5+ years of experience in Voice, Chat, Email kind of Contact Center applications such as Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, RingCentral, or similar platforms.
* Proven track record in leading complex implementation projects, preferably in CCaaS, UCaaS, or CPaaS environments.
* Understanding of voice technologies, protocols (TCP/IP, VOIP, SIP, RTP, WebRTC), and contact center infrastructure (ACD, IVR, CTI, Dialer, SBC) is a plus
* Experience with Groovy, JavaScript, and/or scripting for integrations is a plus
* Technical background with a deep understanding of software development life cycles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; highly competent and confident presenter.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and client-facing communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Business proficiency in English is mandatory.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering/design or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in project management or software implementation are advantageous.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Manager, Account Management, S3P Apparel
description:
**Description**
We are looking for a results-oriented candidates to join our Account Management team. In this role, you will lead a team of Account Managers focused on driving third-party (3P) seller input improvements to accelerate business growth, while serving as a key liaison with partner teams to align on priorities and execution. You will combine strong people leadership with a data-driven, operational mindset to deliver measurable outcomes for sellers and the business.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Team Leadership & Performance Management
  
  
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Managers, setting clear goals and driving structured performance conversations to build a high-performance culture
  
  
Build team capability to independently identify seller input gaps and execute improvement initiatives at scale
  
  
3P Seller Input Improvement & Growth
  
  
Own the strategy for identifying and closing seller input gaps — spanning catalog quality, pricing competitiveness, selection, and fulfillment — to drive measurable growth outcomes
  
  
Define and track key input metrics through weekly review mechanisms, scalable playbooks, and structured operating rhythms (standups, funnel reviews, escalation frameworks) to ensure consistent execution
  
  
Cross-functional Liaison & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Serve as the primary liaison between Account Management and partner teams (Category, Operations, Product, Finance), aligning on priorities, resolving blockers, and representing team progress in leadership reviews
  
  
Operational Excellence
  
  
Establish data-driven mechanisms to track seller health, input metrics, and team productivity; leverage insights to prioritize interventions and contribute to org-wide initiatives through best practice sharing and program scalin
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of sales experience
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience managing teams
* Experience using Salesforce or other CRM tool

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
* 5+ years of B2B industry service delivery experience
