title: Lead Applied Value Engineer - CPGR /CMT -NAM
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
The position of
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a
**Lead Applied Value Engineer**
for the
**High Tech**
industry you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Team and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Identify & Frame Value**

* Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
* Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers
* Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

**Realize Value**

* Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
* Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
* Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

**Scale Value**

* Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
* Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
* Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

**The qualifications you need:**
**Live for Customer Value:**
Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.
  
  
**Data, Analytics, Applications & IT:**
Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.
  
  
**Process Improvement & Value Realization:**
Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value
  
  
**Project Management:**
Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
  
  
**Executive Stakeholder Management:**
Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.
  
  
**Business Domain Expertise:**
Understanding of theHigh Tech domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)
  
  
**Industry Expertise:**
Expertise in the High Tech industry and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities
  
  
**Degree:**
In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program
  
  
**What Celonis Can Offer You:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
* Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Area Manager
description:

title: Delivery Lead - Social & Search Ops
description:
* **Title**
  : Delivery Lead — Social & Search Ops
* **Location**
  : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings**
  : 2-11 pm

**About Joveo**

As the global leader in AI-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.

The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.

**About the Role**

* The Delivery Lead is the most senior role in the Social & Search Operations team. You own the business — revenue, client outcomes, team performance, and the operating model that ties it all together.
* The team is structured in pods. Each pod is an Account Manager and one or more Associates. The AM owns the client relationship within their pod; the Associate owns campaign execution. You sit above all pods — accountable for what every pod delivers, for the commercial health of the client portfolio, and for the team's growth as professionals.
* This role exists because the team is scaling a significant mandate: taking over client-facing campaign operations from a CS function, building toward full end-to-end ownership of enterprise recruitment advertising accounts. You will be the person who makes that transition work — credible with clients, trusted by your team, and commercially sharp with leadership.
* If you have spent your career executing campaigns for someone else's clients, this is not the right step. If you have owned outcomes — revenue targets, client retention, team results — and are ready to do that in a high-growth environment, this is the role.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the revenue number for the Social & Search Operations practice — renewals, upsells, and new business contributions
* Oversee all client pods — review account health across the portfolio, identify risk accounts, and intervene when needed
* Step in as the senior escalation point for client issues that exceed AM-level resolution
* Present portfolio-level performance and strategy to senior client stakeholders (C-suite, VP-level) on key accounts
* Lead quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts alongside or on behalf of AMs
* Partner with Sales on enterprise pitches and proposals — you bring the performance marketing credibility
* Hire, onboard, and develop AMs and Associates — including defining role clarity, setting performance expectations, and running structured feedback
* Define and enforce operating standards across pods: SLA compliance, reporting quality, campaign health benchmarks
* Work with leadership to define which accounts receive full client-facing ownership vs. CS-supported delivery
* Report monthly to senior leadership on capacity utilisation, revenue performance, and team health

**What You Will Own**

* The revenue performance of the Social & Search Operations practice
* Client retention across all pod accounts — renewal rate, satisfaction, escalation resolution
* Team structure and headcount decisions — you define when a new pod is needed and what profile to hire
* Cross-pod quality and consistency — every client gets the same standard regardless of which pod they sit in
* The operating model — you update and enforce the RoE, SLAs, and pod protocols as the team evolves

**What You Bring**

* 7–12 years in performance marketing, with the last 3+ years in a leadership role that included direct revenue or P&L accountability
* Proven track record of owning client relationships at a senior level — you have presented to and retained enterprise clients, not just supported someone who did
* Direct team management experience — you have hired, developed, and if necessary, exited people

Backed by Binny Bansal and built by founders with successful exits to Flipkart and Polygon Labs, we’re bringing together technology, creativity, and commerce.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to own client relationships, drive successful delivery, and grow accounts.

You’ll work with D2C brands and enterprise clients, managing their journey from onboarding to adoption, renewals, and expansion. Working closely with our creative, product, and engineering teams, you’ll translate client goals into clear execution plans and ensure ShopOS delivers measurable value.

This role is well suited to professionals in account management, client servicing, or client partnerships at creative, digital, content, and performance marketing agencies. We also welcome candidates with customer success experience in e-commerce SaaS and MarTech.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Client relationships:**
  Manage a portfolio of accounts, building a strong understanding of each client’s business, goals, and stakeholders.

  Define success goals, guide clients through onboarding, and help them integrate ShopOS into their workflows.
* **Briefs and execution:**
  Translate client requirements into actionable briefs, coordinating deliverables, timelines, feedback, and approvals across teams.
* **Delivery quality:**
  Ensure outputs meet agreed expectations, flag risks early, and take ownership of issues through resolution.
* **Account reviews:**
  Lead regular progress discussions and quarterly business reviews, presenting results, recommendations, and next steps.
* **Retention and renewals:**
  Monitor account health, address concerns proactively, and manage renewal conversations.
* **Account growth:**
  Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned with client needs and partner with GTM teams to convert them.
* **Customer advocacy:**
  Share client feedback with internal teams to improve our products, workflows, and delivery experience.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–7 years of experience in customer success, account management, client servicing, or client partnerships.
* Experience in a creative, digital, content, or performance marketing agency, e-commerce business, SaaS company, or MarTech platform.
* Proven ability to independently manage multiple client accounts, stakeholders, and delivery timelines.
* Demonstrated outcomes in client retention, account growth, product adoption, or campaign performance.
* Ability to turn open-ended client requirements into clear briefs, priorities, and execution plans.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including confidence handling difficult conversations and managing expectations.
* Understanding of e-commerce and marketing metrics such as ROAS, CAC, AOV, conversion rates, and repeat purchases.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, performance reports, and account data to recommend actions.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate across teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience managing D2C, retail, fashion, beauty, or lifestyle brands.
* Exposure to creative production, content strategy, performance marketing, or retention marketing.
* Familiarity with AI products, marketing automation, or e-commerce platforms.
* Experience working with CRM, customer success, and project management tools.
* Experience presenting to founders, marketing leaders, or senior enterprise stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clients onboard smoothly and experience value early.
* Deliverables consistently meet agreed timelines and quality expectations.
* Clients adopt relevant ShopOS capabilities and deepen their engagement.
* Account risks are identified and addressed proactively.
* Strong client outcomes translate into renewals and account growth.

**Why Join ShopOS**

* Work on AI products transforming how e-commerce brands operate.
* Own meaningful client relationships and influence how we build customer success.
* Collaborate closely with founders and experienced e-commerce and AI leaders.
* Join a culture that values ownership, clear communication, craft, and empathy.
* Competitive salary and health and wellness benefits.

This role is based in our Bangalore office in HSR Layout.

**Build early, own more, go further.**

title: Lead, Solutions Engineering

When we do our job well, merchants are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on PhonePe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex payment systems.

 **Qualifications**

* You have Strong quantitative, analytical, and Problem Solving skills
* Experience in API driven products is a big plus.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal and listening skills
* Comfortable working in a fast paced environment

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

title: Sr Advanced Project Engr
description:
Be part of the Program Management Office (PMO) that is integral to our Honeywell Connected Enterprise (HCE) portfolio with responsibility over Engineering Operations across all our global sites determining Management Operating Systems (MOS) and implementing best practices for elements such as: Strategic Planning (STRAP), Annual Operating Plans (AOP), life cycle management, metrics, scrum, and agile techniques that supports the development and integration of highly complex software functions within HCE. You will partner with world class engineering and leaders to implement product strategies, develop program schedules and milestones, and define technology. You will also generate innovative solutions in work situations; trying different and novel ways to deal with problems and opportunities.

The Senior Advanced Project Engineer will assist in creating and executing on Connected Enterprise engineering management operating system, manage projects as required, and contribute to strategy deployment of Connected Enterprise business. This position will provide support for a variety of products, processes, and system development programs across customer platforms. You will be responsible for programs including technical, financial, and organizational elements.

You will work in close coordination with the PMO, technical managers, software engineers as well as support functions. You will be responsible for close interaction and support of strategic business initiatives including proposal development, strategic planning and customer support and product development. You will achieve breakthrough improvements in program performance through development and deployment of cost effective and proactive processes.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering

* 5-6 years of software program management experience; managing complex projects or multiple projects combined into a program with demonstrated success.

* 5-6 years technical product development.

* 4 years of experience managing the development of one or more enterprise class software development projects.

* 4 years of experience in leading programs utilizing the Agile product development process.

WE VALUE

* Minimum 5-6 years of relevant engineering and program management experience with a track record of delivering successful results on significant, well tracked software, mechanical, electronics and/or services programs.

* Experience in all aspects of the engineering development life cycle, and program management including key Agile tools and techniques such as scrum, Kanban, sprints, epics, and story point estimating.

* Advanced Degree (MBA, Engr).

* Scaled Agile Framework – SAFe Certification.

* PMP, Agile Certification (scrum master PSM, CSM) or equivalent certification preferred.

* Tools: Jira, Confluence, Other Portfolio/ Program Management Tools (Jira Align, MSFT Project, etc.)

* Prior experience with SaaS based cloud products.

  

Essential Responsibilities:

* Generate and implement MOS, programs and other requirements using SAFe and CCMI techniques;

* Understand and support both the Support strategic planning (STRAP) and annual operation plan (AOP) and are comfortable assisting in formally establishing these processes

* Understands the SW development life cycle, both waterfall and agile.

* Oversee various portfolios and/or programs focusing on PI iterations and sprints stages.

* Employ PM tools and development processes, including statement-of-work (SOW), work-breakdown- structure (WBS), basis-of-estimate (BOE) management, scope / requirements management, scheduling, and cost management

* In an agile fashion - Execute on scope, schedule, cost, delivery, and quality while demonstrating program management skills in the following areas:

o Portfolio Backlog management; PI Requirements Management and Fulfillment; Planning / Estimation, including resource, material, capital, and other needs

o Scheduling, including resource-loading and critical path analysis for any assigned projects

o Financials (ex. RDE, spend, forecast, variance); Risk Management (Identification & Mitigation);

o Reporting / Reviews, and Communications;

* Collaboration … capability to work across and influence multiple groups;

* Facilitate forecasting and capacity analysis related to delivery requirements

* Establish and maintain the channels of communication necessary to assure timely management awareness of program progress and issues, including external communications

* Consistently present programmatic details, requirements, actions, and status to (senior) leadership, technical, and functional audiences

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Software Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Create and maintain dependable automated checks that protect X3 customer behaviour and give X3 squads fast feedback on every change, release and migration asset.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code.
  
- Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing.
  
- Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control.
  
- Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows.
  
- Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the team’s secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices.
  
Preferred skills
  
- TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle.
  
- Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports.
  
- Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence.
  
- Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change.
  
- Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact.
  
- The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.
  
AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)
  
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)
  
About Us
  
Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building a finance, accounting, payroll and expense management\*\* solution\*\*\*\*s\*\* that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.
  
Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.
  
We’re investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.
  
The Impact You’ll Make
  
- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
  
- Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
  
- Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
  
- Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.
  
- Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals.
  
- Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
  
- Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.
  
- Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.
  
What We’re Looking For
  
We’re looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
Technical Skills
  
- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
  
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
  
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
  
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
  
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
Leadership & Ownership
  
- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
  
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
Mindset & Collaboration
  
- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
  
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
Nice to Have
  
- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
  
- Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
  
- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
  
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
  
- Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.
  
What to Expect
  
- We value humility and collaboration — we’re looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
  
- We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Develop automated UI, API, GraphQL, integration and regression tests from clear risks and acceptance criteria.
  
- Maintain test data, environments, diagnostics and documentation so failures can be reproduced and fixed efficiently.
  
- Contribute tests to CI/CD quality gates and help identify flaky, missing or redundant coverage.
  
- Learn X3 processes, metadata and customisation patterns so automation reflects real customer outcomes.
  
- Participate in defect analysis, release verification, upgrade checks and rollback rehearsals.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Test implementation for assigned stories, defect evidence, coverage recommendations and escalation of quality or environment risks.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

- Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability.

title: Senior Software Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead automation and quality engineering for a X3 squad, turning customer and migration risks into fast, reliable evidence that supports confident releases.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Strong automation programming in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages.
  
- Experience with UI, API, GraphQL, integration, data and end-to-end test design.
  
- Strong SQL/data validation, REST/SOAP integration and batch or migration workflow testing.
  
- CI/CD, containers, test data, observability and defect analysis in a cloud-native environment.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to explain quality risk and evidence in clear English across time zones.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Automate contract and event-integration checks, secure pipeline controls, release/upgrade/rollback evidence, and migration reconciliation. Make failures observable and useful to developers; apply container or orchestration test environments when relevant to the suite.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle or Web/Syracuse testing.
  
- Working X3 domain knowledge and understanding of metadata, customisation and upgrade risk.
  
- Contract testing, performance testing, accessibility, security or chaos/resilience testing.
  
- Migration comparison tooling, synthetic monitoring or golden customer datasets.
  
- Cloud environments and partner certification.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 6+ years in quality engineering or software automation, with ownership of automation for a substantial product area. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- The squad has a trusted regression signal for the highest-risk customer and migration paths.
  
- Quality gates run consistently in delivery pipelines and failures are diagnosed promptly.
  
- Migration and upgrade evidence supports predictable go/no-go, hypercare exit and rollback decisions.
  
- Manual regression effort and escaped defects reduce without reducing meaningful coverage.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Software Engineers, Senior/Principal Automation Engineers, Product, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and migration/partner teams across India, Europe and North America.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Challenges weak evidence respectfully, follows risk to impact and helps the whole squad own quality.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Design and implement maintainable automated tests across UI, API, GraphQL, data, integration, performance and operational journeys.
  
- Own risk-based regression for an X3 domain or platform capability, including legacy-modern equivalence and customisation behaviour.
  
- Integrate tests into CI/CD quality gates and make failures diagnosable, actionable and visible to the squad.
  
- Support migration waves, upgrades and rollback rehearsals with repeatable evidence and clear exit criteria.
  
- Coach Software Automation Engineers and partner with developers early in design and implementation.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Test design and automation approach for owned scope, risk-based coverage, evidence quality and release recommendations within agreed programme guardrails.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Brand partnership Manager
description:

Team members collaborate in a dynamic, innovation-focused environment to deliver impactful solutions for clients.

The Brand Partnership Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. Develop and implement an overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes, and structure.

Good oral and written communication skills.

Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships.

title: Insurance Delivery -Senior-Manager -Hyderabad, Chennai, TVM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting - Senior Manager, Insurance Delivery (Guidewire and Insurance Platforms)**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an accomplished Senior Delivery Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead complex Insurance technology engagements for global clients. The role requires broad functional and technical understanding of Guidewire InsuranceSuite, surrounding digital and integration platforms, and a strong command of service management and ITIL principles. The successful candidate will own client outcomes, delivery performance, financial health, service quality, people leadership and continuous improvement across a large engagement or a portfolio of engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex or multiple Insurance engagements across implementation, transformation, application maintenance and support, enhancements, integration, testing, release and production operations.
* Provide executive governance across scope, schedule, quality, SLAs, risks, dependencies and benefits, with clear accountability for committed client outcomes.
* Lead geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams across onshore, nearshore and offshore locations, including service managers, architects, functional consultants, engineering, testing, DevOps and service management teams.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders, product owners and third-party partners, and act as the senior escalation point for delivery and service matters.
* Establish and run governance forums, steering committees, service reviews and executive reporting with fact-based insights, decisions and actions.
* Drive predictable delivery through integrated planning, demand and capacity management, dependency management, release readiness, quality gates and disciplined change control.
* Own performance against contractual service levels and experience measures; lead recovery plans where performance is at risk and ensure transparent reporting of trends and corrective actions.
* Oversee major incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis, change and release management, service transition, knowledge management and operational resilience.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes, client controls, security requirements, regulatory obligations, audit expectations and delivery standards.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, shift-left, observability, engineering excellence and AI-enabled operations to improve reliability, responsiveness and cost efficiency.
* Support solutioning, estimation, proposal development, transition planning and mobilization for new opportunities and scope expansion.
* Develop leadership capability and succession across the account; coach managers and senior team members, manage performance, improve retention and build a strong delivery culture.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Guidewire and platform leadership**

* Broad knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, including configuration, integration, data, digital channels, rating, batch processing, rules, workflows and reporting.
* Understanding of Guidewire Cloud delivery and operations, cloud migration considerations, platform upgrades, environment strategy, deployment pipelines and production support models.
* Ability to oversee Guidewire integrations with policy, claims, billing, document, payment, finance, customer relationship management, data, analytics, identity and other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of modern architecture and engineering practices involving APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, middleware, cloud services, secure DevOps, automated delivery pipelines, test automation and observability.
* Working knowledge of adjacent Insurance platforms and technologies such as digital portals, data and analytics platforms, document and content management, rating solutions, enterprise integration and cloud infrastructure.

**Service management and operational excellence**

* Practical application of ITIL principles across incident, major incident, problem, change, release, request, configuration, knowledge, availability, capacity and service-level management.
* Experience establishing operating models, service governance, escalation paths, responsibility structures, support coverage, on-call models and service improvement plans.
* Ability to use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns, service risks, demand drivers and improvement opportunities, and convert insights into measurable actions.

**Leadership and delivery attributes**

* Strong Insurance domain understanding, preferably Property and Casualty, across policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims and related business processes.
* Proven success delivering large-scale or multi-account technology engagements for global clients, with accountability for distributed teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate confidently across executive governance, commercial management, delivery detail and technical risk while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Strong leadership presence, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
* Commercial acumen covering estimation, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, productivity, contract interpretation and change control.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, scaled delivery and traditional delivery methods, with the judgment to apply fit-for-purpose governance.
* Working familiarity with service and engineering tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, monitoring platforms, knowledge repositories and automated delivery toolchains.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of overall experience in technology delivery, including substantial leadership experience in Insurance engagements.
* Proven experience as a Senior Delivery Manager, Program Manager, Account Delivery Lead or equivalent, managing a large engagement or multiple concurrent teams across global clients.
* Demonstrable delivery knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, plus associated digital, integration, data and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading implementation and/or managed services engagements with responsibility for service performance, client governance, financials, people and risk.
* Strong understanding of ITIL and service management principles, including practical experience across incident, problem, change, release and service-level management.
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Guidewire certification in one or more InsuranceSuite modules; broader cross-module or cloud credentials are advantageous.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Program or project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an Agile certification.
* Experience with Guidewire Cloud, cloud transformation, complex platform modernization or large-scale service transition.
* Exposure to solution shaping, presales, contract negotiations, account growth and capability development.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**

description:

.
**Minimum qualifications:**

**About the job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well-being, Google provides support for any non-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Transition Manager
description:
**Company profile :**

Indevia Accounting Pvt Ltd, a subsidiary of Indevia Accounting Inc., is a rapidly growing accounting firm based in Andheri, Mumbai. The company is an “accounting firm of the future,” using Robotics, Analytics, and Lean Six Sigma principles to improve quality, streamline processes and increase productivity. The focus is on providing timely, accurate, and meaningful accounting to franchisees and franchisors, with a specialty in the U.S. Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) industry. The company is the preferred accounting vendor for four national QSR chains in North America and serves over 35 other brands. IAPL maintains Quality Management Systems (QMS) certified to ISO 9001, and Information Security Management Standard (ISMS) to ISO 27001.

This position calls for a project management-driven role that is key in transitioning and onboarding new clients using our CRM solutions. We are seeking an Individual who would leverage his/her unique expertise to influence a move away from traditional accounting service delivery towards a more modern approach and efficient working practices, thereby acting as a critical change agent.As we continue to automate, we also have added value-added services, including dashboards, analytical tools, process improvement consulting, IT services, and more. Our ability to secure Preferred Vendor positions with QSR franchisors is a testimony to our success. We have led the industry in automation, process improvement, and innovation and plan to continue to do so.

The ideal candidate is inquisitive, hands-on, passionate, and highly consultative in nature. The transition manager (TM) will report to the VP – HR and Operations and closely collaborate with the CEO and Senior Stakeholders to drive projects across Indevia. The individual will lead, manage, and drive (US) Accounting client transitions into our environment.

**Scouting for Transition Manager**

Job Summary:

* Responsible for leading and driving new client and existing client transitions for the addition of new services (migrating, improving, and optimizing the business process into our environment)
* Ensuring the satisfaction of client expectations and that company processes and procedures are followed and maintained, which includes all aspects of personnel, relationships with the client, and detailed decisions to make the transition a success.
* Undertake the development, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of the Transition Plan to meet the strategic goals and interests of the Organization.
* Analyze the current transition process to identify areas for improvement.
* Identify opportunities for work redesign, workflow enhancement, shift utilization, Staff mix, and staff utilization in order to meet / exceed internal financial goals.
* Work with and support the sales team to ensure service agreements are consistent with our deliverables, educate the client on the requirements of a successful transition in due diligence discussions/meetings with clients, draft client solutions, etc.
* Map the work process from client to Indevia, service delivery, client communication, and delivery follow-up. Ensure complete documentation of the service process. Since we primarily serve one type of client, create a service process master document and edit for each client.
* Builds and maintains a departmental structure, operating standards, and practices that are responsive and adaptable to evolving business needs.
* Managing team functions and utilizations, viz. workforce planning, facilitating recruitment, selection, induction, performance appraisal, training, etc., in line with overall business goals.
* Lead the transition team in terms of delivery timelines, service quality, documentation, cost, and client (both internal and external) satisfaction.
* Work location : Mumbai

**Candidate profile:**

* Master's or a bachelor's degree in commerce with 8 - 10+ years of experience or in a related field. Experience in a BPO will be an added advantage
* **Preference: Demonstrated/Proven track record of managing US accounting for Quick Service Restaurant clients (QSR)**
* Managing process improvement and transition projects to completion (and to be able to demonstrate tangible business benefits realization) - (onsite or offshore) – accounting /finance/BPO is a plus.
* Demonstrated success as an accounting process transition manager – experience in P2P or O2C will be a plus.
* Passion for using the best tools available to transform accounting (Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics, Sage 100, Quick books, R365 - highly preferable)
* An entrepreneurial spirit who is excited by the prospect of rapid growth.
* Process-driven with a strong Project Management and Product Owner Mindset
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills with a strong orientation toward customer service and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

If this sounds like you, write to us at HRteam@indevia.com and leave your contact information. We will be delighted to offer the insights that you seek about Indevia.

For additional information, please visit www.indevia.com.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer with no discrimination as to gender, religion, caste, creed, disability, or national origin.

title: Delivery and Aggregator Manager
description:
**For Mumbai based candidates only**
(No relocation assistance)

**Role Summary**

The Delivery & Aggregator Operations Manager owns the restaurant's presence and performance across third-party delivery platforms. This person ensures listings are accurate and optimized, offers and promotions are live and correctly displayed, order aggregation and reconciliation runs smoothly, and delivery execution meets speed and quality standards — directly driving online sales growth and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Aggregator & Sales Management*

* Monitor and manage day-to-day operations across delivery aggregator platforms
* Track online sales performance, order volumes, and platform-wise revenue; report daily/weekly/monthly numbers to management
* Identify trends, peak hours, and underperforming SKUs/outlets and recommend corrective action
* Reconcile aggregator payouts, commissions, and settlements against actual sales

*Menu & Offer Accuracy*

* Ensure menu items, prices, images, and descriptions are correctly and consistently listed across all platforms
* Set up, schedule, and verify that discounts, combos, and promotional offers are live and displaying correctly on each app
* Coordinate with platform account managers to resolve listing errors, pricing mismatches, or offer discrepancies quickly
* Plan and execute platform-specific campaigns (ads, banners, sponsored listings) in line with the marketing calendar

*Delivery Management*

* Monitor order acceptance, preparation time (kitchen SLA), and rider pickup/handover to minimize delays
* Track delivery TAT, order accuracy, cancellations, and customer complaints; work with kitchen/packing staff to reduce errors
* Liaise with aggregator logistics support for rider shortages, delayed pickups, or delivery escalations
* Ensure packaging quality standards are maintained to reduce spillage/damage complaints

*Customer Experience & Ratings*

* Monitor ratings, reviews, and customer feedback on each platform; respond to or escalate issues as needed
* Work cross-functionally to resolve recurring complaints (missing items, wrong orders, cold food, etc.)
* Drive initiatives to improve platform ratings and repeat order rates

*Reporting & Coordination*

* Prepare regular MIS reports on sales, offers performance, delivery metrics, and platform issues
* Coordinate between kitchen, front-of-house, and platform support teams to keep operations aligned
* Stay updated on new platform features, commission structures, and competitor activity

**Key Skills & Requirements**

* 1–4 years' experience in QSR/restaurant operations, preferably with exposure to food delivery aggregator platforms
* Working knowledge of delivery aggregator partner/owner apps used for restaurant operations
* Strong attention to detail, especially for pricing/offer accuracy
* Comfortable with basic data/Excel reporting
* Good coordination and communication skills to liaise with platform teams and internal staff
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle real-time issue resolution
* Open to work from multiple outlets (Kurla, Oshiwara and Bandra) for smoother co-ordination

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Online sales growth (platform-wise)
* Order acceptance rate & average delivery TAT
* Order accuracy / complaint rate
* Platform ratings
* Offer uptime and accuracy (% of time correct offers are live)
* Commission/payout reconciliation accuracy

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Sales Manager – API Distribution & Relationship Management**

**Company:**
AIRIQ 365 LIMITED

**Department:**
Hotel Business

**Locations:**
**2 - Mumbai and Bangalore**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Reporting To:**
Head – Hotel Business

**Experience:**
6–8 years in relevant roles

**Travel:**
Regular travel for partner meetings and business development

**Role Overview**

The Sales Manager – API Distribution & Relationship Management will drive AIRIQ’s hotel business by acquiring, activating and managing B2B API distribution partners, including OTAs, travel platforms, travel management companies, bed banks and other travel intermediaries.

The role involves expanding the distribution of AIRIQ’s pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory, generating profitable sales and developing long-term partner relationships. The selected candidate will work closely with Technology, Distribution, Procurement, Revenue, Operations and Finance to ensure successful onboarding, consistent booking production and account growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partner Acquisition and Business Development**

* Identify and acquire partners for the distribution of AIRIQ’s hotel inventory through APIs.
* Build and maintain a sales pipeline across relevant domestic and international markets.
* Present AIRIQ’s hotel portfolio, destination coverage, inventory availability and commercial advantages.
* Understand prospective partners’ requirements and propose suitable commercial arrangements.
* Negotiate pricing structures, payment terms and business commitments within approved guidelines.
* Coordinate agreements, documentation and internal approvals.

**2. API Onboarding and Partner Activation**

* Manage the commercial onboarding process from agreement signing through integration, testing and go-live.
* Coordinate with partner and internal technical teams on API access, hotel mapping, inventory availability and booking requirements.
* Track onboarding milestones and resolve business dependencies to support timely activation.
* Ensure relevant hotels and destinations are enabled on partner platforms.
* Drive initial bookings and develop newly integrated partners into consistently productive accounts.

**3. Relationship and Account Management**

* Act as the primary commercial contact for assigned API distribution partners.
* Develop relationships with partner leadership, sourcing, sales, revenue, product and technical teams.
* Understand each partner’s customer segments, destination demand, booking patterns and growth opportunities.
* Prepare account plans covering sales targets, inventory promotion and business expansion.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and agree on actions to improve production.
* Coordinate the resolution of commercial, booking and service escalations.

**4. Sales Growth and Inventory Distribution**

* Achieve agreed targets for room nights, revenue, contribution and productive accounts.
* Promote AIRIQ’s pre-purchased and directly contracted hotel inventory across partner networks.
* Increase sales of priority hotels, destinations and travel periods.
* Work with Revenue on partner-specific pricing, mark-ups, offers and promotional campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase wallet share and reactivate low-producing accounts.
* Share partner demand and hotel sourcing requirements with Procurement.

**5. Distribution Performance and Market Intelligence**

* Monitor partner searches, bookings, conversion, cancellations and hotel-level production.
* Coordinate action on rate competitiveness, availability, mapping errors and booking issues affecting sales.
* Review search-to-book performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
* Track competitor offerings, partner feedback and emerging market demand.
* Recommend improvements to AIRIQ’s hotel portfolio and distribution proposition.

**6. Credit, Collections and Reporting**

* Coordinate partner credit limits, payment schedules and collections with Finance.
* Monitor outstanding balances and escalate overdue payments or credit concerns.
* Ensure commercial commitments remain within approved policies and authority limits.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, sales pipelines, account plans and business forecasts.
* Submit regular reports on partner acquisition, activation, production and account performance.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in travel, hospitality or business management is preferred.
* **6–8 years of experience**
  in B2B hotel sales, API distribution, bed-bank sales or travel account management.
* Established relationships with hotel API buyers, OTAs, travel platforms, travel management companies or other relevant distribution partners.
* Proven ability to acquire new accounts and grow existing partner business.
* Working understanding of hotel APIs, hotel mapping, room and rate plans, booking flows and distribution commercials.
* Experience coordinating API partner onboarding with technical teams.
* Understanding of hotel pricing, margins, credit exposure and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Candidates should be based in, or willing to relocate to,
  **Mumbai or Bengaluru**
  , depending on the position.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New API distribution partners acquired.
* Partners integrated, activated and generating bookings.
* Time from agreement signing to go-live and first booking.
* Room nights, revenue and contribution from assigned accounts.
* Sales of priority pre-purchased and directly contracted inventory.
* Growth, retention and wallet share of existing partners.
* Improvement in partner conversion and productive hotel coverage.
* Timely collections and adherence to approved credit terms.
* Accuracy of sales forecasts and account reporting.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Divya Shipping India Pvt Ltd is a shipping and logistics company operating in the dynamic maritime and trade environment of India. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, cost-effective solutions to clients across domestic and international markets. Working closely with partners and customers, the company aims to streamline cargo movement and optimize supply chains. Team members can expect a professional environment that values accountability, client service, and operational efficiency. The company offers opportunities for growth to individuals who are committed to performance and relationship-building in the logistics sector.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Manager role at Divya Shipping India Pvt Ltd is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. The Sales Manager will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing client accounts, and maintaining strong customer relationships in the shipping and logistics sector. Day-to-day tasks include prospecting and meeting potential clients, preparing and presenting sales proposals, negotiating rates and contract terms, and coordinating with operations and customer service teams to ensure smooth service delivery. The role also involves monitoring market trends, tracking competitors, creating sales forecasts, and reporting on pipeline and performance to leadership. The Sales Manager is expected to work closely with internal stakeholders, uphold high professional standards, and contribute to revenue growth and brand reputation.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong sales, account management, and business development skills, with experience in managing end-to-end sales cycles.
* Candidates should possess skills in client relationship management, negotiation, and customer service to build long-term partnerships and resolve issues effectively.
* Candidates should possess skills in market analysis, forecasting, and basic data interpretation to identify opportunities and support decision-making.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to engage with clients and collaborate with internal teams.
* Candidates should possess organizational, time management, and follow-up skills to handle multiple accounts, deadlines, and sales activities.
* Previous experience in shipping, logistics, freight forwarding, or related industries is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Logistics, or a related field is preferred; equivalent work experience will also be considered.
* Comfort working in an on-site, fast-paced environment in Mumbai, with proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.

title: Sales Manager
description:

description:
**Job Description**
**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**

* Drive Performance Through Value Based Propositions

* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Knowledge Base, Build Skill Sets & Develop Competencies

* Execute at Speed While Maintaining Error Free Operations
* Develop a Passion for Performance to Grow Talent Pool
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity

**Business Function**
Global Transaction Services (GTS) comprises of Cash & Trade, Securities Services and Fiduciary Services. In an increasingly borderless world marked by burgeoning Asset transactions expertise in trade finance services is an invaluable asset. With cash the lifeblood of every company, so too, is a good understanding of how to manage these cashflows. Trade Finance, together with Cash & Securities Management, is the mainstay of GTS, and is extended to Funds, MNCs and corporate clients for their local and cross-border financial transaction needs.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
You will be responsible for Custody, Derivative Clearing (Professional Clearing Member (“PCM”), Fund Accounting Products and Designated Depository Participant (“DDP”) role. The individual will have responsibility for regulatory compliances, P&L and product strategy. The individual will have to collaborate closely with external stakeholders across SEBI, RBI, IFSCA, Exchanges, Depositories, Clearing Corporations, Custodians. The individual will also have to collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across relationship, Group SFS, Compliance, Legal, FCSS, Technology, Operations, Sales and Client Management teams. The industry is embarking on a period of significant change, innovation and new business opportunities and DBS India is looking to play a leadership role. The role will report directly to the India Product Head of Securities and Fiduciary Services.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Activities related to client onboarding, due diligence and regulatory compliances.
* Lead the development and execution of the India custody product strategy including ongoing priorities and alignment with Indian regulatory changes and Group guidelines
* Collaborate on commercial topics with key stakeholder and business partners across functions including legal, risk and compliance.
* Explore new business opportunities that help to shorten the chain of custody, drive efficiency and reduce risk
* Developing and driving the vision and product strategy
* Partner with the business to drive revenue and profitable growth
* Own product across Custody, PCM, Fund Accounting in both India and IFSC-GIFT
* Partner with operations to manage operating costs, drive process improvements and improve cost to serve
* Provide market insights to drive development and competitive positioning of the product
* Identify areas of improvement in the core products
* Participate in Industry groups across the region to drive market leadership and change
* Partner with clients and industry participants to drive and deliver value added products

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**
