* Responsibility for ensuring that the compliance of all procedures with banking/statutory requirements and securities industry are updated as per market developments.
* Participating in projects affecting custody processes arising from new/revised business areas.
* Initiate continual enhancements to productivity and quality of service in line with developments within Processing & Services Group and the Bank
* Planning for operational changes to meet securities and custody market developments
* Ensure prompt responses to clients’ queries (24-hr turnaround / acknowledgement).
* Work with the client on account structure so that the account registration process with SEBI is smooth.
* Liaise with client on the account opening document requirements.
* Ensure that the transition of new business is smooth.

* Keep abreast of market developments and keep the clients updated on the same.

* Identify areas of improvement in the core products
* Explore new business opportunities that help to shorten the chain of custody, drive efficiency and reduce risk
* Participate in Industry groups across the region to drive market leadership and change
* Partner with clients and industry participants to drive and deliver value added products
* Collaborate on commercial topics with key stakeholder and business partners across functions including legal, risk and compliance.

**Required Experience**

* Mid/Senior level, experienced talent with deep subject matter expertise in Custody, Fund Accounting, DDP and PCM functions and the broader asset servicing product set
* Proven track record of working with large complex clients and establishing strong partnerships at all levels
* Strong working knowledge of technology, market infrastructures and industry partners that support the custody chain
* Excellent client skills and the ability to engage at all levels
* Strong understanding of operational processes across all aspects of Custody, DDP, PCM and Fund Accounting functions
* Ability to effectively communicate at all levels within an organization
* Demonstrates strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and mentor staff
* Proven ability to execute on product deliverables and strategic vision

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* An MBA or Chartered Accountant or equivalent degree is preferable, with at least 4-5 years with Custody/product knowledge & in Securities market regulations.
* Good understanding of the product management process

* Experience in FPI, FVCI and AIF business is an added advantage

**Core Competencies**

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, BOM144 DCEO
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Primary responsibilities and SME fields include, but are not limited to:  
  
Operations and Maintenance:  
  

* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
* Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
* Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**Area Business Manager, CAR-T Patient Referral & Awareness**

**Department**

Business Development / Patient Access

**Location**

Based in Metro/Non-Metro City, with extensive travel to Tier 1, 2 and 3 cities

**Reports to**

Regional Sales Manager

**Experience**

2-7 years

BBA (Sales/Marketing), B.Pharm, BSc.

**Role Summary**

The Area Business Manager builds and maintains a network of referring hospitals, oncologists and haematologists in an assigned territory. The goal is to help eligible patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (B-ALL) and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (B-NHL) reach CAR-T centres for evaluation and treatment. The role also drives awareness of CAR-T cell therapy among clinicians and the wider community in the territory.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Referral network development**

* Identify and map hospitals, oncology and haematology centres, and key treating physicians in the assigned territory.
* Build and sustain relationships with referring oncologists, haemato-oncologists, paediatric oncologists and hospital administrators.
* Visit referral hospitals regularly and maintain a structured call plan.
* Act as the single point of contact between referring centres and the CAR-T centre.

**2. Patient referral facilitation**

* Coordinate the referral pathway: sharing the centre's eligibility criteria, collecting clinical records, and scheduling consultations with the CAR-T treating team.
* Support patients and families with logistics: travel, appointment coordination, and information on the treatment journey, in coordination with the patient navigation team.
* Follow up with referring doctors on case status, in line with patient consent and privacy requirements.
* Track every referral from first contact through consultation, evaluation and treatment.

**3. Awareness and education**

* Organise and support CME programmes, doctor meets, tumour boards and webinars on CAR-T therapy, with the medical team and invited experts presenting the clinical content.
* Share approved educational material with clinicians, and support patient awareness and community outreach initiatives.
* Represent the centre at regional medical conferences and oncology forums.

**4. Territory management and reporting**

* Plan and manage territory travel efficiently.
* Maintain accurate records of visits, referrals and conversion status in the CRM.
* Submit weekly and monthly reports covering activities, pipeline, challenges and market insights.
* Gather feedback and competitive intelligence on referral patterns and barriers to access (cost, distance, awareness, financing).

**5. Cross-functional collaboration**

* Work closely with the clinical team, medical affairs, patient navigation, finance/financial counselling and marketing teams.

**Compliance and Ethics**

* All interactions must follow applicable regulations, including NMC guidelines, the UCPMP, and the organisation's code of conduct.
* No inducements, incentives or gifts to healthcare professionals in exchange for referrals.
* Only approved, scientifically accurate and balanced materials may be used. No unapproved efficacy claims or guarantees of outcomes.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure consent in all patient-related communication.
* Clinical decisions on eligibility and treatment rest solely with the treating physicians.

**Qualifications**

* Education: BBA / B.Pharm/BSc (MBA or M.Pharm is an added advantage).
* Experience: up to 7 years in pharma, healthcare, hospital marketing or patient services. Internships in oncology or hospital settings are a plus.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi, with working knowledge of regional languages as an advantage.
* Ability to build trust with senior physicians and handle rejection with persistence.
* Willingness to learn complex clinical concepts (haematological malignancies, cellular therapy).
* Empathy and sensitivity in dealing with patients and families facing serious illness.
* Self-driven, organised and comfortable with independent field work.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.
* Integrity and ethical judgement.

**Work Conditions**

* Intense travel across the territory, including overnight trips.
* Valid driving licence preferred.
* Occasional weekend work for conferences and camps.

**What We Offer**

* Structured onboarding and training in oncology, haematology and CAR-T therapy.
* Opportunity to work at the frontier of cellular therapy in India.
* Clear career path toward Senior District Manager, Regional Manager and Patient Access leadership roles.
* Competitive fixed pay plus travel allowance. Any variable pay should be tied to activity and quality metrics, not to referral volume alone.

title: Brand Partnerships Manager - FMCG
description:
**Brand Partnership Manager - FMCG**

**About Wishlink**

Wishlink is on a mission to revolutionize the creator economy and redefine how people shop. We're all about providing every user with a highly personalized shopping experience guided by creators, so they can find exactly what they want, in a very short time, while improving their online shopping experience severalfold. We are shaping a new era at the intersection of two of the most prominent aspects of the internet-
**e-commerce and social media**
.

**Team and Investors**

Wishlink was founded by 3 friends from college, Chandan, Shaurya, and Divyansh, with a shared passion to solve real-world problems at scale and consume content for hours (XD). We started Wishlink in January 2022 when we discovered products on social media that we wanted to buy but could not (in some cases, actually did)! We are based out of Gurugram. We have recently raised a
**series B round of $17.5M backed by leading global investors including Vertex Ventures SE Asia & India, Fundamentum, and Elevation Capital.**

**Why Join Us?**

**Exciting Problem**

The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews - which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.

**Immense Scale**

In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over
**900k users daily**
to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.

**Stellar Team**

Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!

**Growth Opportunity**

We have grown remarkably in the last 3 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 300cr. We are working with over 50,000 content creators and 300+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.

Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.

**What would you be doing?**

* **Own the monetization P&L**
  — set and deliver the growth and revenue target across your category, and be accountable for the number end to end.
* **Build the category annual plans**
  — bottom-up targets by category and brand, the assumptions behind them, and the quarterly milestones that make the annual number credible. Own the re-forecast when reality moves.
* **Build the category strategy and brand playbook**
  — decide which categories and brands to prioritize, how to price and package solutions, what the pitch is, and what the reachout motion looks like at scale. Turn what works into something repeatable, not a series of one-off wins.
* **Hunt and farm brand budgets**
  — build the pipeline from the ground up, run the outreach, negotiate deals, and grow spend from existing brands season over season. You'll be as comfortable opening a cold brand as expanding a live one.
* **Set and drive targets across teams**
  — translate the category plan into clear targets for the respective category KAMs, align them on the why, and run the review cadence that keeps everyone honest against the number.
* **Run the category on data**
  — build the metrics and dashboards that matter, use them to spot opportunities and diagnose problems, and translate analysis into decisions (not just charts).
* **Partner cross-functionally**
  — work with sales, product, creator, and marketing teams to execute your plan when you don't directly control every lever.
* **Shape how we monetize**
  — as an early owner, define the playbook for categories that others will build on.

**What are we looking for?**

* **5–7 years in category management**
  at an FMCG / CPG or beauty & personal care (BPC) brand, or on the e-commerce / quick-commerce / marketplace side.
* **A track record of owning a commercial or revenue number**
  — ideally monetization, ad revenue, or retail media (not only supply, assortment, or vendor management).
* Experience
  **planning a target bottom-up**
  and then landing it across teams you don't directly manage.
* **Strong, hands-on data and analytics ability**
  — comfortable in Excel/Sheets and BI tools, and able to manipulate data yourself rather than relying entirely on an analyst.
* **Proven experience building business partnerships and alliances**
  — sourcing, negotiating, and growing brand relationships.
* **Strategic and hands-on in equal measure**
  — you can set the plan and also do the work in a lean, fast-moving environment.
* **Strong commercial judgment and communication**
  — able to influence stakeholders and make sound trade-off calls.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with retail media or ad-monetization products on a platform/marketplace.
* Exposure to the creator, influencer, or affiliate-commerce ecosystem.
* Have built a monetization or GTM motion from scratch before.

**Why join us?**

* Full ownership of a category's monetization — not a slice of it.
* A rare role that genuinely blends strategy, hands-on data, and partnerships.
* High-growth stage with room to shape how the category is built.

**Perks and Benefits**

* We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.
* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning & Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget

**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**

**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.

As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

---------------

Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.

Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.

You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. * **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Vacancies:** 01
* **Experience:** 4 to 8 Years

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle:**

* Direct complete employee lifecycle processes including joining, onboarding, probationary confirmation, internal transfers, personnel files, and exit clearances.
* Manage daily attendance, shift rosters, leaves, separations, and end-to-end HRMS workflows.
* Collate, validate, and coordinate monthly plant payroll inputs with the central payroll team.

**2. Industrial Relations & Employee Relations:**

* Manage shop-floor discipline, employee relations (ER), and day-to-day Industrial Relations (IR) at the plant.
* Draft and issue show-cause notices, charge sheets, warning letters, and conduct domestic enquiries in alignment with legal standards.
* Maintain healthy relations with workforce representatives and manage contract labor agencies.

**3. Statutory Compliance & Factory Audits:**

* Ensure 100% adherence to applicable Indian labor laws and factory acts.
* Coordinate and monitor statutory compliance for PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), Bonus, Gratuity, CLRA (Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act), and the Factories Act.
* Maintain statutory registers, submit annual returns, and represent the company during labor inspections and social/statutory audits.

**4. Manpower Planning & Recruitment:**

* Forecast manpower demands and execute hiring drives based on production targets.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Logistics departments to ensure optimal operator and staff staffing.

**5. Training, Welfare & Engagement:**

* Organize technical, safety, behavioral, and statutory compliance training programs for plant employees.
* Drive employee welfare initiatives, overseeing canteen services, bus transportation, uniforms, personal protective equipment (PPE), and medical room provisions.
* Plan and execute employee engagement programs to promote motivation and retain talent.

**6. Performance Management & HR MIS:**

* Execute Performance Management System (PMS) cycles, appraisals, and employee KPI reviews at the plant level.
* Maintain comprehensive HR MIS dashboards, tracking attrition, absenteeism, OT costs, and hiring turnaround metrics for management reviews.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Solid practical knowledge of plant HR administration and blue-collar/white-collar workforce management.
* Hands-on experience in managing Industrial Relations (IR), grievance handling, and disciplinary actions.
* Deep understanding of the Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, PF, and ESIC regulations.
* Expertise in contract labor contractor management and shop-floor productivity tracking.
* Strong interpersonal, mediation, conflict resolution, and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in HRMS software, MS Excel, and HR MIS analytics.

**Apply Now**

Share your updated resume at **hr1@lubielectronics.com** or call/WhatsApp **+91 90810 83834**.

title: Influencer Relation Manager
description:
At Watevr, influencer marketing is about more than finding creators and getting content published. It’s about building relationships that make great collaborations happen.

We’re looking for an Influencer Relations Manager who understands creator culture, enjoys working with people, and knows how to turn conversations into meaningful collaborations. You’ll be the bridge between creators, brands, and our internal team, making sure every campaign runs smoothly and every relationship is built on trust.

What you’ll be doing

* Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers and content creators across platforms.
* Identify relevant creators for brand campaigns and manage outreach, negotiations, and follow-ups.
* Coordinate with creators on campaign briefs, timelines, deliverables, and content requirements.
* Be the go-to person for creators throughout a campaign, ensuring clear communication and a smooth working experience.
* Work closely with the internal team to keep campaigns organised and on track.
* Manage creator databases, track communications, and maintain accurate campaign records.
* Understand creator expectations while balancing brand requirements, budgets, and deadlines.

Who we’re looking for

* Someone who genuinely understands social media, influencer culture, and how creators work.
* A confident communicator who can build rapport, negotiate professionally, and follow through on commitments.
* Someone who is organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple conversations and deadlines.
* A people person who can balance empathy for creators with the expectations of brands.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Previous experience in influencer marketing, talent management, public relations, or a similar role is an advantage.

Work location and culture

This is a Kochi-based role. Being present in the office and working closely with the team is an important part of the job. We value spontaneous conversations, quick collaboration, and people who enjoy being involved in the day-to-day flow of an agency.

Hybrid flexibility may be possible, but you should be comfortable with regular office presence in Kochi.

title: Regional Business Manager
description:

This role requires strategic thinking, deep market knowledge, and the ability to translate national strategies into effective local execution.

description:
**Who is Shift?**  
  
At Shift, we’re business specialists dedicated to helping Australian SMEs take control of their cashflow, streamline trade terms and choose the right financial products.  
  
We believe Australian businesses are the driving force behind our economy and are core to our communities. That’s why our business expertise, focus on relationships, and market-leading technology is at the core of everything we do. We’ve helped solve the credit and payment pain points for more than 30,000 businesses, providing over $6 billion in aggregate funding.

Graduated in Computer Science degree or equivalent (Minimum Requirement)

* Proficiency in managing a range of mobile devices utilizing Microsoft Intune (Windows, MacOS, Android, iOS).

Office 365 Administration, Atlassian toolkit, PowerShell, Microsoft Intune MDM, Device Deployment (Apple ADE / MS Autopilot), Technical troubleshooting.

Exceptional listening and problem-solving skills. Resilience, self-starter, and passion for technology. Time management and organisational skills. Proactivity and Responsiveness

A strong team player capable of working autonomously. Keen attention to detail, adaptability, and user-focused approach. A willingness to try new technical domains and areas.

title: Service Desk Advisor
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
  
Being great in this job is less about your resume and more about your personality. We are looking for friendly, helpful, and empathetic people who have an interest in technology. As a Customer Service Representative, you’ll be the face and voice of Kyndryl, helping customers solve their problems every day.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Deliver assistance through multiple channels, including chat, email, and Microsoft Teams.
* Provide customer support by combining technical troubleshooting, problem-solving, and excellent customer service.
* Manage multiple customer inquiries and support requests in a fast-paced environment.
* Provide concierge-level service to ensure a positive and seamless customer experience.
* Collaborate with back-office teams to escalate and resolve complex customer issues.
* Work closely with senior team members and mentors to expand technical knowledge and professional skills.
* Develop expertise in Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel, and gain experience with various technology platforms.
Participate in continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and industry certifications, including Microsoft, Azure, and Google Cloud.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
  
This is a true “start here, go anywhere” opportunity. As you get a close-up look at a wide variety of Kyndryl job roles, you can choose your career path. Many have moved up to the 2nd or 3rd level escalation team. Others go on to further education/certifications and more senior or technical roles.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Skills and Experience**

* Knowledge of Windows and Mac operating systems
* Minimum experience needed is 2 years
* Support help desk knowledge
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Customer support knowledge
Active listener with flexibility to modify approach and adapt to customer needs  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience working with Windows and Mac operating systems
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving expertise
* Support help desk experience
* Customer support experience
Experience modifying approaches and adapting to customer needs  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role to deliver great customer service/experience by effectively acknowledging, tracking, and prioritizing all client cases as per the regulatory guidelines, and ensuring resolution as per the defined SLAs, by allocating the same to the relevant support team.

͏

**Do**

* **Ensure operational excellence through contract and regulatory compliance, effective case acknowledgment, tracking, prioritization, system updation, and reporting**
  + Acknowledge client cases as per the SLA s defined in the contract
  + Access client tool and log all incoming client cases accurately on the internal tool as per contract
  + Accurately document all pertinent case information such as case number, case type, etc. of daily cases received
  + Follow standard processes and procedures to track and prioritize all client cases
  + Accurately update the internal tool with daily cases and forward the same to respective agents and QAs
  + Access and maintain internal knowledge bases, resources and frequently asked questions to aid in effective case logging and prioritization
  + Maintain and timely update internal tool for agents to speed up response time
  + Identify red flags and escalate serious client issues to Team leader in cases of non-compliance and untimely resolution
  + Ensure all client information, disclosures and regulatory changes are given to agents and QA s on a regular basis
  + Monitor compliance with service agreements to avoid legal challenges
  + Share recorded case logs and status reports with clients and supervisors on a daily basis

͏

* **Deliver excellent customer service through effective understanding of client tool, accurate case logging and prioritization as per regulatory guidelines**
  + Serve as the primary point of contact for accessing cases pertaining to a specific client using designated client tool
  + Develop deep understanding and use of client tool to effectively perform day today duties
  + Access client tool and acknowledge to the client the receipt of the cases as per the SLA s defined in the contract
  + Accurately document all pertinent case information such as case number, case type, etc. on a daily basis for all cases received
  + Prioritize cases on the levels of urgency and complexity as per the regulatory guidelines defines by the client
  + Accurately extract case information and create an excel listing cases along with relevant information pertaining to the cases
  + Maintain logs and records of all client cases as per the standard procedures and guidelines
  + Collaborate with client and undergo trainings on any new regulatory guidelines for a particular client process and implement the same on all cases

͏

* **Ensure allocation and resolution of client cases as per the defined SLAs by accurately updating internal tools, training sessions on new regulations and regular reporting**
  + Ensure allocation of cases to agents and QAs by accurately recording all client cases on the designated internal tracking software
  + Maintain tracker of all cases received along with the allocation information for reporting purposes
  + Ensure all client cases are resolved as per the defined SLA s and regulatory guidelines defined by the client
  + Maintain and share the resolution status report with supervisor and client on a daily basis
  + Share the hourly productivity update report with supervisors and clients on a daily basis
  + Undertake client training on specific tool features and/or any other regulatory changes introduced by client/govt.
  + Conduct training sessions for agents and QA ensuring the regulatory changes have been effectively communicated to all agents and QAs
  + Ensure new regulatory guidelines are implemented all client processes to avoid penalties and non-compliance
  + Liaise between the client and internal teams on escalations of serious issues and unique queries
  + Follow up with agents and QAs to record feedback and ensure compliance to contract SLA s and regulations
  + Interact and engage with the client and internal stakeholders to communicate and update progress against a particular case

͏

* **Build capability to ensure operational excellence and maintain superior customer service levels for the existing client**
  + Undertake trainings to stay current with any new features, changes and updates on client tool
  + Enroll in product specific and any other trainings per client requirements/recommendations
  + Conduct training sessions for Agents and QAs on any new regulatory guideline that needs to be applied to any process urgently
  + Identifying and document most common problems and recommend appropriate changes to the team leader
  + Updates job knowledge by participating in self learning opportunities and maintaining personal networks

.

Experience: 5-8 Years
  
.

title: System Integrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a System Integrator with hands-on experience in network infrastructure implementation, integration, and troubleshooting. The candidate will be responsible for deploying and integrating network devices, switches, firewalls, load balancers, authentication systems, and monitoring solutions to ensure seamless connectivity, security, and high availability across enterprise environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement and integrate enterprise network infrastructure based on HLD and LLD documents.
* Install, configure, and integrate network switches and routers from Cisco, HPE, Aruba, and Juniper.
* Configure VLANs, Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, inter-VLAN routing, STP, VRRP, BGP, and link aggregation.
* Install and configure Fortinet FortiGate and SonicWALL firewalls, including security policies, firewall rules, and access controls.
* Configure and integrate F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancers, including virtual servers, pools, and health monitors.
* Integrate network devices with RADIUS/ISE authentication and SNMP-based monitoring platforms.
* Perform connectivity testing, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution during deployment.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal technical teams for implementation and system integration activities.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, application reachability, firewall, and routing issues.
* Monitor network performance and support incident management to maintain service availability.
* Prepare and maintain network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation plans, and SOPs.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, device replacements, and production deployment activities.

**Required Skills**

* 4–6 years of experience in System Integration, Network Engineering, or Infrastructure Implementation.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, LAN/WAN, routing, and switching.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco, HPE, Aruba, or Juniper networking equipment.
* Experience with Fortinet FortiGate or SonicWALL firewalls.
* Knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancing and high-availability concepts.
* Experience with BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP, and inter-VLAN routing.
* Familiarity with RADIUS/ISE, SNMP, SolarWinds, and Wireshark.
* Experience in network deployment, integration testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read network topology diagrams and HLD/LLD documentation.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge.
* Experience in enterprise network and security infrastructure integration.
* Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.

Skills: integration,routing,firewalls

You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.
  
  
Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. title: Principal Production Engineer — Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Principal Production Engineer — Operations**
**Job Description**
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Tech@Lilly**
*At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.*
**About The Technology Organization**
Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non-negotiable.
  
  
Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise.
  
  
**About The Team**
Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
  
  
The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world-class technology capabilities and platforms.
  
  
Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
  
  
The Production Reliability Engineering team is the engineering-first function that owns operations, incident command, runbook automation, and the safe evaluation of agent-assisted remediation across a multi-application production estate. The estate is deliberately diverse: it spans low-code platforms (Power Platform, Power Automate), SaaS ecosystems (Salesforce / SFDC, SharePoint), traditional enterprise stacks (Java/JVM, .NET, Node.js, Python), automation platforms (RPA — Automation Anywhere, UiPath-class tooling), data and analytics platforms (Power BI, Tableau, relational and NoSQL databases), and the integration layer that ties them together. The team works in close partnership with the engineering team that builds the agentic automation platform that increasingly reduces manual operational load.
  
  
Role summary
  
  
As a Principal Production Engineer in Operations, you are the final-escalation authority within your shift and the named on-call anchor for the team. You drive root-cause analyses to engineering-grade quality before handoff to the SRE engineering practice in the same pillar, and you are the last call before the engineering lead is engaged.
  
  
What sets this seat apart from a single-stack senior engineer is the breadth of technology you operate across. The estate covers low-code platforms, SaaS ecosystems, traditional enterprise stacks, RPA and automation tooling, integration middleware, and data and analytics platforms. You are expected to debug across all of them — not by memorising every product, but by reading logs, traces, code, and configuration in any reasonable stack and isolating where it broke. Candidates who thrive in this role pick up unfamiliar tech in weeks, not quarters.
  
  
This is a senior individual-contributor role with real shift weight and real authority. The team supports continuous operations across multiple shifts, and you will anchor on-call coverage for your assigned shift while partnering with the engineering lead on cross-shift incident command.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Shift anchor and on-call leadership
* Hold the on-call anchor role for your shift and lead the L1/L2/L3 operations engineers working alongside you; carry the page that the engineering lead does not.
* Direct triage and dispatch in real time: pull L1 and L2 to the work they can own, keep senior capacity on the hard problems, and step in only where the call genuinely needs you.
* Make incident-disposition decisions within your shift (escalate, resolve, or open a problem record) with disciplined judgment, and coach your team to make the same calls when you are not on the bridge.
* Run effective shift handoffs to maintain operational continuity across globally distributed teams, and raise the bar on handoff quality so the next shift inherits clarity, not noise.
* Multi-stack debugging and major incident response
* Be the final-escalation point before the engineering lead, and earn the right to be the last call by consistently isolating fault domains across the stack faster than anyone else on shift.
* Debug across very different technology families — low-code (Power Platform, Power Automate), SaaS (Salesforce/SFDC, SharePoint), enterprise stacks (Java/JVM, .NET, Node.js, Python), RPA (Automation Anywhere or equivalent), integration middleware, and data/analytics platforms (Power BI, Tableau, SQL and NoSQL stores) — using logs, traces, metrics, code reading, and first-principles reasoning. Deep domain knowledge of every product is not the bar; the bar is finding where it broke and stopping the bleed.
* Lead in-shift major incident execution and partner with the engineering lead on cross-shift incident command. Own the bridge, drive comms, and keep the response moving.
* Coordinate cross-team response across engineering, product, platform, security, and vendor teams when needed, and hold each owner to clear next steps and timestamps.
* Root-cause engineering and pattern feedback
* Drive root-cause analyses to engineering-grade quality before handoff to the SRE engineering practice in the same pillar, covering symptom, timeline, fault domain, root cause, contributing factors, and the engineering work that follows.
* Partner with the engineering lead on problem management for chronic incident patterns, and convert recurring incidents into runbooks, automation, or alert tuning that L1 and L2 can execute on their own next time.
* Identify cross-product, cross-stack failure patterns across application, integration, infrastructure, data, and identity layers, and feed them upstream to the right engineering team with enough evidence that the fix is unambiguous.
* Partner with the agentic automation engineering team on which production patterns become safe agent-assisted remediations — including the guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints that keep automation honest.
* Operational readiness, runbook engineering, and toil reduction
* Validate work packages from the agentic automation engineering team before they go live in production. Pressure-test runbooks, alerting, rollback paths, and observability coverage.
* Write and maintain runbooks, scripts, and ServiceNow workflows that let L1 and L2 resolve routine incidents without paging up. Measure your impact in the toil you remove from the shift, not just the incidents you personally close.
* Maintain ServiceNow lifecycle hygiene across the supported application estate.
* Provide senior operational oversight for releases and deployments within your shift, including go/no-go calls when readiness gaps surface late.
* Compliance, security, and regulated-environment readiness
* Ensure operational practices comply with Lilly standards and applicable regulatory requirements, including change control, access reviews, audit trail, and evidence capture during incidents.
* Promote secure handling of sensitive data during incidents, including the data that surfaces in logs, screenshots, and bridge transcripts.

How you will succeed
  
  
At the principal level in operations, success is defined by named-owner posture and sustained operational outcomes:
  
  

* You judge escalation timing well; too early erodes credibility, too late costs the business.
* You write root-cause analyses that leadership reads.
* You hold the operational bar consistently across your shift.
* You move comfortably across very different technology families, and L1/L2 engineers learn how to debug across stacks from working with you.
* Toil you remove from the shift shows up in fewer pages, faster handoffs, and L1/L2 closing incidents they would have escalated last quarter.

What you should bring
  
  
**Required**

* 10+ years of professional technology experience, with at least four years in production incident response and named on-call ownership.
* Demonstrated ability to debug across multiple technology stacks without deep application-domain knowledge. You read logs, traces, code, and configuration across at least four of the following families and have actually shipped fixes in three: low-code platforms (Power Platform, Power Automate, or equivalent); SaaS ecosystems (Salesforce/SFDC, SharePoint, ServiceNow customisations); traditional enterprise stacks (Java/JVM, .NET, Python, Node.js); Linux and Windows server; relational and NoSQL databases; REST and messaging integration layers; RPA platforms (Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or Blue Prism); data and analytics platforms (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* Working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred, Azure or GCP acceptable), including networking, IAM, compute, storage, and the operational footprint of managed services.
* Working fluency with at least one major observability platform (Splunk preferred, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Elastic, or equivalent). You build dashboards and queries during incidents, not just read them.
* Scripting (Python or Bash, ideally both) good enough to write quick remediations and one-off automations during an incident.
* Proven experience leading other operations engineers, including running shifts, mentoring L1 and L2, and lifting team capability over time.
* Strong ServiceNow operational fluency and deep ITIL practice across incident, problem, change, and CMDB hygiene.
* Visible willingness to learn unfamiliar stacks fast — the candidates who thrive in this role pick up new tech in weeks, not quarters.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.

**Preferred**

* Experience operating in highly regulated industries (pharma, financial services, healthcare, or similar) where audit, validation, and change control are non-negotiable.
* Breadth across additional stack layers such as container platforms (Kubernetes, OpenShift, ECS), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD pipelines, identity providers, API gateways, and integration middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or equivalent).
* Exposure to AIOps tooling and agent-assisted operational workflows, and a point of view on where automation pays off versus where it adds risk.
* SLI/SLO/error-budget practice; can define meaningful indicators for an unfamiliar service and defend the targets.
* Track record of root-cause analyses you can describe end to end, covering symptom, timeline, fault isolation, root cause, contributing factors, and the engineering work that followed.
* Formal certifications welcome but not required, such as ITIL, AWS, Azure, CKA, or SRE Foundation.

Leadership expectations
  
  

* Brings the named-owner posture this role demands.
* Drives accountability, clarity, and calm during high-pressure situations.
* Treats ServiceNow as the operational system of record, not as an annoyance.
* Raises the capability of the team through example, especially in how to debug across unfamiliar stacks.
* Treats picking up a new technology family as part of the job, not as a special project.

Additional information
  
  
Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable.
  
  
This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts (e.g., 6 AM to 2 PM and 2 PM to 11 PM) when required to align with global delivery partners.
  
  
*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.*

description:
Job Description – ITI Technician (Power Car)

**Position:** ITI Technician – Railway Power Car  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and hardworking **ITI Technician** to support the operation, inspection, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting of **Railway LHB Power Car systems**. The role involves working on diesel generator sets, alternators, switchboard/control panels, batteries, electrical distribution, and associated equipment used to supply power to passenger coaches. Indian Railways' LHB Power Cars use diesel-alternator sets and distribute electrical supply through power-car switchboards.

Key Responsibilities

* Carry out routine inspection and preventive maintenance of **Railway LHB Power Car equipment**.
* Check and maintain **DG sets, diesel engines, alternators, switchboards, feeders, batteries, battery chargers, transformers, pumps, and control circuits**.
* Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, and control-system faults and assist in breakdown rectification.
* Check and record parameters such as **voltage, current, frequency, load, engine temperature, and oil pressure** as required.
* Inspect electrical connections, cables, panels, fuses, breakers, and earthing arrangements.
* Assist in checking diesel levels, leakage, radiator/cooling systems, and engine-related components.
* Ensure proper power supply to coaches and safe functioning of Power Car equipment.
* Follow **Railway safety procedures, PPE requirements, isolation/earthing practices, and maintenance instructions**.
* Maintain maintenance checklists, logbooks, inspection records, and breakdown reports.
* Report defects, abnormalities, and equipment failures to the supervisor/engineer.
* Assist senior technicians and engineers during scheduled maintenance and repair activities.
* Maintain tools, equipment, and the Power Car work area in proper condition.
* Be willing to work in **rotational shifts, including night shifts**, as required for railway operations.

Qualification

* **ITI** in Electrician / Electrical / Diesel Mechanic / Mechanic Motor Vehicle / Electronics or relevant trade.
* NCVT/SCVT certification preferred.
* Basic knowledge of electrical systems, DG sets, alternators, motors, batteries, control panels, wiring, and troubleshooting.

Required Skills

* Basic electrical and mechanical troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of hand tools and testing instruments.
* Good problem-solving ability.
* Ability to work in a team.
* Safety-conscious and disciplined.
* Basic Hindi/Marathi communication; English knowledge will be an advantage.

Preferred Experience

* Freshers with relevant ITI qualification can apply.
* Experience in **Railway Power Car, LHB coaches, EOG/HOG systems, DG sets, railway electrical maintenance, or industrial maintenance** will be preferred.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Sr Associate, Cyber Sec Eng
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
For more than a century, Northern Trust has worked hard building our legacy of outstanding service, expertise and integrity. From a Chicago-based bank founded in 1889, we now have more than 20 international locations and 18,500 employees globally. We serve the world’s most-sophisticated clients – from sovereign wealth funds and the wealthiest individuals and families, to the most-successful hedge funds and corporate brands.
  
  
We burnished our reputation as a global leader delivering innovative investment management, asset and fund administration, fiduciary and banking solutions enabled by sophisticated, leading technology. And through it all, we continually laid a solid, forward-looking foundation on which future generations can continue growing and achieving greater.
  
  
Northern Trust is looking for an Associate to join its Technology Development Center in Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
