title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

description:

As a Windows System Administrator, you will be responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and reliable operation of computer systems, network servers, and virtualization. You will work closely with the IT team to ensure the smooth operation of all systems and networks, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and end-user problems.

 Perform regular system updates and upgrades.

 Manage Windows servers, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.  
 Configure and maintain virtualization on platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.  
 Implement and manage backup and recovery solutions.

 Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues.  
 Configure and maintain network switches, routers, and firewalls.  
 Implement and maintain VPN solutions for remote access.

**Security Compliance:**   
 Implement security measures to protect systems and data from unauthorized access.  
 Monitor systems for security breaches and respond to incidents promptly.  
 Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

**User Support:**   
 To provide technical support to end-users, resolving hardware and software issues.  
 Assist in the setup and configuration of new user accounts and devices.  
 To Train users on basic system usage and best practices.

**Documentation and Reporting:**   
 Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.  
 Generate reports on system performance, security incidents, and user support activities.

**Requirements:**   
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).  
 Proven experience as a Windows System Administrator or similar role.  
 Strong knowledge of Windows Server operating systems (2008/2012/2016/2019).  
 Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and other Windows server roles.  
 Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.  
 Knowledge of network protocols and services (TCP/IP, VPN, VLANs, etc.).

title: IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator** to manage and support IT infrastructure across our business environments.

This role will have responsibility for both **day-to-day IT operations and proactive IT infrastructure management**. The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling network, endpoint and user-support requirements while also taking ownership of Microsoft 365, endpoint management, security, access management and infrastructure improvements.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just resolve individual tickets but can **identify recurring problems, determine root causes, implement permanent solutions and continuously improve the IT environment.**

Key Responsibilities

**IT Infrastructure & Network**

* Manage and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and Internet connectivity.
* Configure and troubleshoot firewalls, VPNs and network security solutions.
* Work with vendors and service providers for hardware, network and infrastructure issues.
* Monitor infrastructure performance and proactively identify potential issues.
* Manage DNS, DHCP, Active Directory and other core infrastructure services.

**Microsoft 365 Administration**

* Administer Microsoft 365 users, licenses, groups, mailboxes and permissions.
* Manage Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and related services.
* Manage MFA, authentication and user access.
* Review Microsoft 365 configuration and recommend improvements.
* Monitor Microsoft 365 security alerts and service health.
* Maintain appropriate access controls and security standards.

**Endpoint & Device Management**

* Manage company laptops and other endpoints using **ManageEngine Endpoint Central** or similar platforms.
* Handle device onboarding, configuration, software deployment, patching and compliance.
* Monitor endpoint health and security.
* Ensure operating systems and applications are appropriately patched.
* Maintain accurate IT asset and device records.

**IT Security**

* Support endpoint security, antivirus/EDR and security policies.
* Manage and monitor MFA and privileged access.
* Identify security gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements and ISO-related IT activities.
* Maintain appropriate IT documentation and security procedures.

**IT Support & User Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 technical support for hardware, software, Microsoft 365, network and access issues.
* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT perspective.
* Create and manage user accounts and access.
* Troubleshoot Windows and application-related issues.
* Coordinate with external vendors and support teams where escalation is required.

**IT Improvement & Ownership**

* Identify recurring IT problems and perform root-cause analysis.
* Implement permanent solutions rather than repeatedly resolving the same issue.
* Review existing IT tools and recommend ways to improve their utilization.
* Maintain IT SOPs, documentation, asset registers and configuration records.
* Prepare periodic IT infrastructure and security reports.
* Maintain an improvement tracker with clear ownership, timelines and outcomes.

**Required Skills**

* 4–7 years of experience in IT infrastructure/system administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft 365 Administration**.
* Experience with **Endpoint Central / ManageEngine** or equivalent endpoint management tools.
* Strong knowledge of Windows administration and Active Directory.
* Good understanding of networking — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi and VPN.
* Hands-on experience with firewalls such as **FortiGate, Sophos, Check Point or equivalent**.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender or other endpoint security solutions.
* Experience managing laptops, software deployment and patch management.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience coordinating with IT vendors and service providers.
* Good documentation and communication skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with SharePoint and OneDrive administration.
* Experience with Azure / Entra ID.
* PowerShell scripting/automation.
* Experience with ISO 27001 or other IT compliance frameworks.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or IT ticketing systems.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure across multiple locations.
* Relevant certifications such as **Microsoft, CCNA, Fortinet, ITIL or CompTIA**.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Proactive rather than purely ticket-driven**
* Comfortable taking **end-to-end ownership** of IT systems.
* Able to work independently and prioritize competing requirements.
* Capable of identifying recurring issues and driving them to permanent resolution.
* Interested in **optimizing and improving IT infrastructure**, not just maintaining it.
* Comfortable working with both technical teams and business users.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Stability and reliability of IT infrastructure.
* Endpoint and patching compliance.
* Microsoft 365 security and access management.
* Timely resolution of IT issues.
* Reduction in recurring IT problems.
* Effective onboarding/offboarding.
* Accurate IT asset and documentation management.
* Implementation of measurable IT infrastructure improvements

title: Manager - Customer Experience (Hospitals)
description:
**Job Description – Manager – Customer Experience**
Position: Manager – Customer Experience
  
  
Department: Customer Experience / Hospital Operations
  
  
Level: Central / Corporate
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  
Reporting To: Head – Hospital Operations / Business Head
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and customer-centric Manager – Customer Experience to drive and standardize the patient and attendant experience across Even Hospitals.
  
  
The role will have central-level ownership of Customer Experience, Housekeeping, and Security, ensuring consistent service standards, operational discipline, safety, cleanliness, and hospitality across all hospital units.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be highly hands-on, data-driven, and strong in stakeholder management, with the ability to identify gaps, implement processes, and continuously improve the overall patient journey.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Experience
* Own the overall patient and attendant experience across Even Hospitals.
* Define and implement standardized Customer Experience (CX) processes, SOPs and service standards across all units.
* Map the end-to-end patient journey and identify opportunities to improve experience at every touchpoint.
* Monitor patient feedback, complaints, grievances, NPS/CSAT and other CX metrics.
* Establish a structured VOC (Voice of Customer) mechanism and ensure timely closure of feedback.
* Drive root-cause analysis for recurring complaints and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Clinical, Nursing, Front Office, Operations, Billing and other teams to resolve patient experience issues.
* Develop service-recovery mechanisms for escalated patient/attendant concerns.
* Conduct regular audits across hospitals to assess adherence to CX standards.
* Drive initiatives to improve patient satisfaction, service quality and overall hospital experience.
* Housekeeping Management
* Provide central oversight and governance for Housekeeping operations across all hospitals.
* Standardize housekeeping SOPs, cleaning protocols, checklists and service standards.
* Monitor cleanliness and hygiene standards across patient areas, OPD, wards, common areas and other hospital facilities.
* Define and monitor housekeeping manpower requirements, deployment and productivity.
* Conduct regular housekeeping audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Coordinate with vendors/agencies wherever housekeeping services are outsourced.
* Monitor housekeeping consumables, equipment and inventory.
* Work closely with Infection Control and Hospital Operations teams to maintain required hygiene standards.
* Track housekeeping-related complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Security Management
* Provide central oversight of Security operations across Even Hospitals.
* Establish and maintain security SOPs, access-control protocols and incident-management processes.
* Ensure appropriate security manpower deployment across hospitals and shifts.
* Monitor visitor, patient attendant and staff access protocols.
* Ensure effective management of security incidents, emergencies and escalations.
* Conduct periodic security audits and identify gaps in hospital safety and security.
* Coordinate with hospital leadership and external security agencies where applicable.
* Drive security training, discipline and service standards for security personnel.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and reporting of security incidents.
* Central Governance & Standardization
* Develop common CX, Housekeeping and Security standards across all Even Hospitals.
* Create dashboards and monthly MIS covering key operational and experience metrics.
* Conduct periodic reviews with Unit Operations Heads and relevant stakeholders.
* Identify best practices from individual hospitals and implement them across the network.
* Drive cross-functional projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and customer experience.
* Support new hospital/unit launches by establishing CX, housekeeping and security processes from day one.
* People & Vendor Management
* Lead and mentor CX/housekeeping/security teams either directly or through respective unit managers.
* Define manpower requirements and productivity benchmarks.
* Participate in recruitment and onboarding of key team members.
* Set performance standards and KPIs for teams and vendors.
* Manage outsourced service providers and ensure adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and drive improvements.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Patient NPS / CSAT
* Patient complaints and escalation rate
* Complaint resolution TAT
* Customer feedback closure %
* Housekeeping audit scores
* Hospital cleanliness and hygiene scores
* Security audit scores
* Security incidents and response TAT
* Housekeeping & Security manpower productivity
* Vendor SLA adherence
* Patient experience improvement initiatives
* Reduction in recurring complaints
* Compliance with hospital/NABH standards

Candidate Profile
  
  

* Experience: 10 - 15 years of experience in Customer Experience, Hospital Operations, Hospitality, Facility Management or a similar service-oriented environment.
* Experience in healthcare/hospital operations would be strongly preferred.
* Prior experience managing Housekeeping and Security will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of patient/customer experience and service quality.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work across multiple hospitals/locations.
* Strong execution orientation with the ability to work hands-on at the unit level.
* Experience in SOP creation, audits, MIS and process improvement.
* Should be comfortable managing internal teams as well as external vendors.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
Someone who can act as the central CX owner for Even Hospitals and ensure that a patient receives a consistent, safe, clean and high-quality experience irrespective of which Even Hospital they visit.
  
  
**Key Focus**
Customer Experience + Housekeeping + Security + Service Standards + Audits + Continuous Improvement.

title: Manager Financial Operations
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

**What is the role?**

The Manager, Financial Operations will lead the day-to-day execution of financial close operations, multi-partner reconciliation, data pipeline governance, and operational reporting within Roku's Revenue Infrastructure function. This role owns the hands-on delivery of reconciliation workflows, journal entry execution, exception management, data quality assurance, and operational analytics that underpin Commerce Platform financial integrity. Operating as the execution arm of the Financial Systems & Controls pillar, this leader ensures that month-end close, daily reconciliation, partner settlement validation, and financial data operations are completed accurately, on time, and with full auditability. The role manages a team of Financial Operations Analysts and partners closely with Revenue Accounting, Treasury, Platform Engineering, and Payment Operations to deliver reliable, scalable financial operations across the Commerce ecosystem. This role bridges the gap between strategic financial architecture and the analyst-level execution that delivers production outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong operational execution discipline with financial systems knowledge, SQL/Python proficiency, reconciliation expertise, and people management experience in high-volume commerce, payments, fintech, or subscription environments.

**How will I use AI at Roku?**

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

**What are the responsibilities of the role?**

* Oversee and review the team's end-to-end month-end and quarter-end financial close for Commerce Platform revenue, liabilities, and partner payables — own the close calendar, priorities, and on-time completion
* Direct and review the team's execution and validation of automated journal entries across revenue recognition, deferred revenue, chargebacks, and partner settlements; ensure posting failures are investigated and resolved
* Partner with Revenue Accounting and Treasury to resolve close blockers, inter-company settlements, and timing differences; represent the team in US / PST close reviews
* Ensure the team maintains close checklists, run books, and process documentation, and that SOX evidence packages are complete and audit-ready
* Oversee the team's daily and monthly multi-partner reconciliation workflows across authorization-to-settlement, settlement-to-payout, and bank reconciliation
* Review, triage, and prioritize reconciliation breaks, exceptions, and discrepancies; ensure the team resolves them within SLAs
* Monitor exception aging trackers and drive resolution, escalating to payment processors, banks, and internal teams as needed
* Guide root-cause investigation on recurring breaks; review the team's findings and approve process fixes for implementation
* Oversee partner onboarding into reconciliation workflows against readiness criteria and acceptance standards
* Direct the team's build and maintenance of operational dashboards (Looker / Tableau) tracking reconciliation status, exception rates, close timelines, and pipeline health; review them for accuracy
* Review and present weekly and monthly operational status reports to leadership — exception aging, SLA performance, pipeline uptime
* Direct ad-hoc analytical support for financial investigations, partner disputes, and settlement discrepancy research; review outputs before they reach stakeholders
* Ensure the team executes SOX control activities for owned financial workflows; review control steps, evidence, and test results
* Oversee preparation and delivery of audit evidence packages for internal and external audit requests within required timelines; act as the primary point of contact
* Review day-to-day processes for control gaps and operational risks; escalate for framework-level decisions
* Ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs) with clear RACI ownership are maintained for all operational workflows
* Set clear expectations and allocate daily workload across reconciliation, close, data operations, and reporting; follow up and track every deliverable to closure
* Review and quality-check the team's deliverables (reconciliations, journals, dashboards, reports) before release — hold the bar on accuracy, timeliness, and documentation
* Drive skill development in SQL, Python, financial analysis, and reconciliation methodologies; conduct regular one-on-ones and career development conversations
* Run daily connects / standups with the India team, plan and track work, remove blockers, and ensure operational continuity during US business hours
* Proactively identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone areas and direct the team to build automation (Python scripts, Airflow DAGs, SQL procedures) that reduces toil
* Champion AI adoption within the team — leverage AI tools to accelerate development, surface patterns in data, and improve productivity
* Define and track monthly KPIs and performance metrics for the team — throughput, error rates, SLA adherence, and automation coverage
* Foster an analytical, data-driven mindset — encourage hypothesis-driven investigation, evidence-based decisions, and connecting the dots across workflows
* Build a culture of documentation and knowledge sharing — ensure processes are organized, repeatable, and not dependent on any single individual

**What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a quantitative field
* 7+ years in Financial Operations, Revenue Operations, Reconciliation, or Commerce / Payments, including 3+ years directly managing analyst teams (ideally distributed / offshore teams supporting US-based stakeholders)
* Strong working proficiency in SQL (window functions, CTEs, complex joins across large datasets) — enough to review and guide the team's analytical work
* Familiarity with Python for data automation and scripting — enough to review and guide the automation the team builds
* Experience with data warehouse platforms (such as Snowflake), ETL/orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt), and BI tools (Looker, Tableau)
* Experience operating in high-volume commerce, payments, or subscription environments with multi-currency, multi-partner complexity
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution
* Detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy, timeliness, and documentation
* Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and implement solutions that reduce manual effort by measurable margins
* Experience using AI/ML tools or LLMs to enhance operational workflows, data analysis, or code generation
* Proven people-management track record — leading, mentoring, and developing analyst teams; allocating work, reviewing output, following up to closure, and getting results through others
* Strong decision-making skills with the ability to balance speed, accuracy, and risk in a fast-paced operational environment
* Demonstrated ability to work across time zones and partner effectively with US-based stakeholders
* Effective communication skills — ability to explain complex financial/data issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience in streaming, media, ecommerce, or digital subscription businesses is a plus
* Experience with payment settlement operations across multiple processors (such as Adyen, PayPal, Braintree) is a plus
* Familiarity with financial controls frameworks (SOX, SOC2) and audit processes is a plus
* Experience building automated reconciliation solutions or financial data pipelines from scratch is a plus
* Experience with Git/GitLab version control for SQL/Python code management is a plus
* Experience with Jupyter Notebooks for financial analysis and data exploration is a plus

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Supervisor, Benefits Operations - CX
description:

title: Team Lead - CRP Services
description:
**Why join Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. Join Rolls-Royce and you could have the opportunity to work in a world-class engineering environment, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

**Job Purpose:**

The Team Lead – CRP Services will lead the GBS team in India in supporting the Civil Aerospace Service Business team in Derby throughout the end-to-end Contract Review Pack process. The role is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, data management, variance and forecast impact analysis, reporting, automation, controls and stakeholder coordination to enable accurate financial forecasting for aftermarket service contracts.

**Role Overview:**

The role leads a small team of analysts responsible for operating controlled CRP processes across multiple systems, executive data sources, Excel, Power BI and purpose-built tools. It ensures the CRP window is delivered accurately, on time and in line with required controls, while driving continuous improvement, automation, resource planning, quality reviews and team development. The Team Lead acts as the primary operational link between the GBS India team and Derby-based Service Business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the GBS India CRP Services team to deliver an excellent level of service to the Derby-based Civil Aerospace Service Business team.
* Manage the identified elements of the end-to-end operational delivery of Contract Review Pack processes across multiple systems, tools and data sources within agreed timelines and controls.
* Oversee master data management, standardisation and integration across platforms and applications, ensuring data quality supports accurate financial forecasting.
* Own and drive automation and process improvement opportunities using advanced Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL, VBA and other relevant tools to improve accuracy, control and efficiency.
* Manage workflow, resource allocation, service levels and monthly quality reviews in collaboration with Derby-based stakeholders and leadership.
* Lead the setup, revision and documentation of CRP processes, including Standard Operating Procedures, controls and continuous improvement actions.
* Line manage, coach and develop analysts, including performance monitoring, capability building, individual development planning and collaborative problem solving.

**Key Experiences and Qualifications:**

5–8 years of relevant experience in data management, financial analytics, forecasting support, reporting, process improvement or business operations, including experience leading a team or coordinating delivery through others. Aerospace, supply chain, aftermarket services or financial planning experience is desirable. The recommended grade range for this role is GG9–GG10, reflecting a team lead position with operational accountability, stakeholder ownership, people-management responsibility and delivery of continuous improvement across the CRP process.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* Graduate or engineering degree with strong analytical, numerical and business problem-solving capability.
* Experience leading, coaching or coordinating analysts in a time-bound operational or forecasting process.
* Strong data analytics, variance analysis, interpretation and reporting capability.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including complex data handling, controls and reporting.
* Experience working with databases, structured data, master data management and reporting outputs.
* Strong stakeholder management, relationship management and communication skills, including working with UK-based stakeholders.
* Ability to maintain process discipline, accuracy, service levels and controls within defined CRP window timelines.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Power BI reporting, dashboard development and data visualisation capability.
* Python, SQL, PLSQL and VBA for automation and data processing.
* Extract, Transform, Load (ETL), data integration and reporting experience.
* Oracle Hyperion Planning or similar financial planning system experience.
* Standard Operating Procedure preparation, documentation and control framework experience.
* Lean, continuous improvement or process improvement experience.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your vision too.

Rolls-Royce creates fair and impartial teams and non-discriminatory workplaces where we can all be at our best.

description:
Redica Systems is a data and analytics SaaS platform that helps regulated industries improve their quality and stay on top of evolving regulations. We are shaping the future of predictive quality with our pioneering work in AI workflows and the development of an exclusive intelligence layer for quality and regulatory data. Our purpose-built processes transform one of the industry’s most complete data sets—aggregated from hundreds of health agencies and unique Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) sourcing—into meaningful answers and insights that reduce regulatory and compliance risk.

Founded in 2010, Redica Systems serves over 200 customers in the Pharma, BioPharma, MedTech, and Food and Cosmetics industries, including 19 of the top 20 Pharma companies and 9 of the 10 top MedTech companies. More information is available at
redica.com.

**The Role**

Redica Systems is looking for a Manager, Regulatory Intelligence to lead a team responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and structuring regulatory developments across 150+ countries.

In this role, you will oversee the quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of regulatory intelligence covering Pharmaceutical, Biologics, MedTech, and Animal Health sectors. You'll guide the team in interpreting regulatory developments, determining industry relevance and impact, and maintaining reliable information within Redica's regulatory intelligence platform.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who brings strong GxP knowledge, sound judgment, and a practical approach to managing people, improving processes, and making effective use of technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Solutions Coordinators, providing clear priorities, guidance, feedback, and performance management.
* Oversee global regulatory monitoring activities, ensuring relevant developments are identified, evaluated, and processed accurately and on time.
* Guide the team's assessment of regulatory developments, including industry scope, GxP applicability, operational impact, and classification decisions.
* Maintain standards for structured regulatory data, including metadata accuracy, effective dates, consultation deadlines, enforcement timelines, and document relationships.
* Establish and monitor team KPIs covering productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround times, addressing gaps and improving performance.
* Manage team workload, resource allocation, and priorities to maintain consistent regulatory coverage and meet operational objectives.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to improve monitoring capabilities, classification logic, quality controls, and workflows.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and other technologies to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of regulatory intelligence operations.

**About You**

* **Communicates Effectively**
  : Develops and delivers clear, concise communications across multiple platforms, ensuring accurate and timely sharing of regulatory intelligence insights, updates, and trends with teams and stakeholders.
* **Decision Quality**
  : Demonstrates the ability to make good and timely decisions in data operations. Understands the implications of various data choices.
* **Optimizes Work Processes**
  : Demonstrates the ability to enhance and streamline data processes. Seeks opportunities for data process improvement.
* **Business Insight**
  : Demonstrates an understanding of the business and uses this knowledge to inform data decisions
* **Tech Savvy**
  : Demonstrates a basic understanding of current technologies used in data operations. Can effectively use these technologies in daily work and is open to adopting new ones.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, GxP, or Regulatory Intelligence within Pharmaceutical, Biologics, Medical Device, or Animal Health industries.
* Previous experience leading, supervising, or managing teams, with demonstrated responsibility for work quality, performance, and delivery.
* Strong understanding of GxP principles and global regulatory frameworks, including the ability to interpret regulatory language and assess industry impact.
* Experience overseeing regulatory monitoring, intelligence gathering, data classification, or compliance-related operations.
* Demonstrated ability to establish quality standards, manage operational KPIs, and improve team workflows.
* Comfortable working with technology-enabled processes, data platforms, and AI or automation tools.
* A Master's degree in Regulatory Affairs, Pharmaceutics, Quality Assurance, or a related discipline is preferred.

**Additional information**

Top pharmaceutical companies, food manufacturers, medtech companies, and service firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets such as MSNBC, The Wall Street Journal, and The Boston Globe.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
**About BHIVE Group:**
BHIVE Group is a Bengaluru-headquartered real estate and workspace company, with a vision to help people live a better quality of life and a mission to become one of India’s most loved and admired real estate companies by 2033.

Its flagship business, BHIVE Workspace, launched in 2014 and is one of India’s leading flexible workspace providers. It offers managed offices, coworking, on-demand and virtual offices, meeting spaces, food and beverage and other workplace services to more than 1,000 clients, from startups to global enterprises.

1. 30+ centres across Bengaluru and Mumbai, with over 2 million sq ft of workspace and around 42,500 seats.
2. Expanding rapidly, with four large new campuses in Bengaluru, including Hebbal and Bellandur, and premium campus formats such as BHIVE Platinum Plus.

**About the Role:**
We are looking for a Head – Revenue Operations to own the efficiency of how BHIVE sells, contracts, serves and renews clients across every revenue line. This is a high-impact leadership role that shapes how a growing, IPO-bound company runs its revenue engine.

You will be accountable for sales and customer management efficiency across the organisation: how well we sell, how well we deliver what we sold, and how well we serve and retain clients. You will lead the revenue operations team and work as a peer to business and sales leaders, driving outcomes through data, process design, systems and cross-functional influence rather than direct reporting lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Cross-business revenue mandate:**

* Drive funnel, process and data efficiency across all revenue lines, including managed office, coworking, on-demand workspace, F&B, outbound sales, pre-sales and other monetization.
* Run the weekly revenue review and pipeline forecast with the leadership team.
* Partner with the leaders of each revenue line to put shared processes, systems and data in place, while the business strategy and teams stay with those leaders.
* Ensure customer success and account management delivery is efficient and measurable.
* Partner with Finance to improve collection efficiency upstream, through contracts, billing and early warnings.

**2. Revenue lifecycle: process, SLAs and metrics:**

Own the process, SLAs and metrics across the full client lifecycle, from first enquiry to renewal, and make sure they are followed.

* **Lead capture and source accuracy:**
  every lead captured in the CRM, with the correct source recorded and kept accurate.
* **Qualification and routing:**
  pre-sales qualification and routing to the right sales team, with tracked turnaround times.
* **Site visits:**
  every visitor registered and every visit linked to a deal in the CRM before it happens.
* **Proposals, pricing and approvals:**
  discount and pricing approval workflows followed, with exceptions visible.
* **Contracting:**
  consistent use of the contracting system, fast turnaround and protection of standard terms.
* **Handover and move-in:**
  a clean handover from sales to operations and projects, so we deliver what was sold.
* **Billing and collections:**
  correct billing from day one, timely collection of security deposits, and early flags on overdue accounts.
* **Account management and customer success:**
  set, measure and enforce standards for client meeting cadence, response times, ticket resolution and client communication.
* **Renewals, rebalancing and expansion:**
  visibility of renewals well ahead of expiry, clear ownership and a tracked process for each, and root-cause analysis of churn translated into action with the business teams.

**3. Revenue governance:**

* Own deal attribution rules across direct, broker, channel-partner and referral sources.
* Own broker onboarding and the validation of brokerage payouts before payment.
* Ensure accurate sales incentive calculations.
* Maintain clean, trusted revenue data and strong controls across the lifecycle.

**4. Systems, data and reporting:**

Own how our revenue systems are used and how they talk to each other, with the goal of one trusted source of truth for pipeline, bookings, occupancy and revenue. Judge what the tools should do, not just report from them.

**5. Leading the revenue operations team:**

* Lead, build and develop the revenue operations team.
* Set team priorities, ways of working and quality standards.
* Build the capability to scale revenue operations as the business grows.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experience:**
  you bring 10–15 years of experience, with senior leadership in revenue operations, sales operations or business operations.
* **Background:**
  you come from B2B businesses with recurring revenue and a long client lifecycle, such as flexible workspace, commercial real estate, hospitality or SaaS.
* **Systems depth:**
  you are hands-on with a CRM (HubSpot preferred), and comfortable with data warehouses, integrations and dashboards.
* **Track record:**
  you have built and fixed processes end to end, with measurable results to show, not just reports.
* **Influence:**
  you drive change in teams you do not manage, and hold people to standards without needing authority over them.
* **Seniority:**
  you work as a peer with senior business and sales leaders.
* **Education:**
  you have an MBA (preferred); an engineering or analytical background is a plus.

**Collaboration and communication:**
Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the centre.

**How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals:**
Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the revenue function with overall business goals.

title: Store Director
description:
**About Food Stories**

Foodstories is redefining the gourmet food landscape in India, catering to the nation's most discerning and affluent consumers with an unwavering passion for exceptional culinary experiences. With an ambitious vision to become the leader in India's gourmet food space, Foodstories is committed to shaping the narrative around food, while offering products and experiences that delight the senses and elevate everyday dining.

Currently, Foodstories operates flagship stores in Ambience Mall, Vasant Kunj (Delhi), Banjara Hills (Hyderabad), Hill Road (Mumbai), Lokhandwala, Andheri (Mumbai) and Prestige Sterling Square (Bengaluru) with customers also enjoying seamless access through FoodStories.Shop. These thoughtfully designed spaces offer a curated selection of premium, farm-sourced produce, artisanal bakery items, bespoke cheeses, single-origin chocolates, exotic spices, and more. The range is further complemented by a unique all-day dining café, where patrons can indulge in a culinary journey that includes a specialized estate-to-cup organic coffee program and a cutting-edge bio-hacking zone, designed to address the evolving wellness needs of today's health-conscious consumer. Nearly half of the offerings at Foodstories are freshly prepared on-site, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavor. The brand also provides an exclusive assortment of domestic and international pantry essentials, dry fruits, and other premium food products, all handpicked to cater to the most refined tastes.

Looking ahead, Foodstories plans to expand its footprint with multiple stores across Gurgaon , Bangalore supported by state-of-the-art commissaries, back-end kitchens, and dark stores. Founded by Ashni and Avni Biyani, Foodstories is the result of their shared passion for food and their commitment to offering unparalleled quality and innovation. Owned and operated by Foodstories Private Limited,

Foodstories is setting a new standard in gourmet food retail in India, combining luxury , sustainability, and culinary excellence in every product and experience.

**Visit us :**

https://www.foodstories.shop/

https://www.linkedin.com/company/foodstoriesshop/posts/?feedView=all&viewAsMember=true

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an exceptional
**Store Director to lead our new store in Bellandur, Bengaluru**
. This is an exciting opportunity to build and shape a premium, food-led retail experience from the ground up, bringing together business performance, operational excellence, inspiring people leadership, and outstanding guest experiences.

You will take ownership of the stores overall performance, culture, and day-to-day operations, ensuring every aspect of the experience reflects our brand’s standards. From building a high-performing team and driving sales to creating meaningful guest connections and delivering operational excellence, you will play a pivotal role in establishing the store as a destination for exceptional food, discovery, and community.

**What You’ll Lead:**

* **People & Culture:**
  Build, coach and inspire a high-performing, cross-trained team across Retail, Café, Operations and Digital Concierge.
* **Guest Experience & Community:**
  Create exceptional guest experiences through VIP engagement, tastings, masterclasses and local collaborations.
* **Business & P&L:**
  Drive sales, margins, average transaction value, units per transaction, conversion and labour productivity while controlling waste and shrinkage.
* **Operations & Excellence:**
  Ensure adherence to SOPs, inventory accuracy, audit readiness and disciplined stock and waste management.
* **Omnichannel & Digital:**
  Integrate store, website, WhatsApp and phone orders while growing memberships and repeat business through personalised outreach.
* **Visual Merchandising & Storytelling:**
  Bring the brand to life through merchandising, tasting counters and seasonal experiences.
* **Partnerships & Compliance:**
  Manage relationships with property partners and relevant authorities while ensuring hygiene and food safety compliance.

**Leadership & People:**

* **Onboarding & Development:**
  Establish clear 30/60/90-day goals, cross-training plans and succession pipelines.
* **Coaching & Performance:**
  Drive daily huddles, regular coaching, development conversations and talent reviews.
* **Standards & Training:**
  Uphold service standards, brand voice, grooming and escalation protocols, with full compliance training.
* **Workforce Planning:**
  Optimise rosters and team deployment to meet business demand without compromising guest experience.
* **Culture & Retention:**
  Build an accountable, approachable and high-performing team through recognition, feedback and development.
* **Quality & Audits:**
  Maintain high standards of safety, hygiene, training and operational compliance.

**You Might Be Born for This If…**

* You are a hands-on leader who understands both people and business performance.
* You are passionate about food, its origins, makers, craft and stories, and love sharing that curiosity.
* You remain calm and decisive under pressure and bring out the best in your team.
* You enjoy owning both the guest experience and the commercial performance of a business.

**What You've Done**

* 6 to 10 years of experience in premium or luxury retail or hospitality, preferably in food-led environments, with experience leading teams across multiple functions.
* Proven ownership of P&L, sales KPIs, inventory management, audits and loss prevention.
* Experience in guest relationship management, remote selling and omnichannel fulfilment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with property partners and local authorities.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene standards and FSSAI requirements.
* A compelling storyteller with a genuine passion for food and beverage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Store operations run seamlessly, with clear routines, actionable dashboards and consistent SOP adherence.
* Key guests are understood and engaged personally, driving repeat orders, loyalty and successful events.
* Inventory remains accurate, waste and shrinkage reduce, and audits consistently meet required standards.
* Teams are confident, cross-trained and engaged, with a visible pipeline of future leaders.
* Company governance standards are implemented consistently, ensuring accountability and compliance across all store functions.

title: AVP Operations
description:
Westbury Sportswear is looking for a
**senior operations leader**
to own and scale our end-to-end
**supply chain, warehousing and fulfilment operations**
across a growing e-commerce business.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role with
**direct exposure to the CEO and Board**
, combining hands-on operational leadership with long-term warehouse, technology and automation strategy.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Lead end-to-end warehouse, fulfilment, logistics and control tower operations across multiple business lines.
* Drive SLA, productivity, cost, inventory and service-level performance.
* Build and execute the warehouse automation and technology roadmap, including WMS and process automation.
* Lead new warehouse setup from site selection and layout to hiring, SOPs, WMS implementation and go-live.
* Evaluate and drive 3PL vs. owned warehouse strategies as the business scales.
* Own key 3PL, vendor, equipment and infrastructure partner relationships.
* Build data-driven business cases and present ROI/investment proposals to senior leadership and the Board.
* Build a strong operations team and develop second-line leadership.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 10–15 years of experience in Supply Chain, Warehousing, Logistics or Operations, with 3–4+ years in leadership.
* Strong hands-on warehouse operations experience.
* Mandatory e-commerce experience; exposure to Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar marketplaces preferred.
* Proven track record in warehouse automation, process improvement and technology implementation.
* Experience setting up and scaling warehouses end-to-end is highly preferred.
* Strong analytical, strategic and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to operate at both shop-floor and Board level.
* Full-time MBA from a Tier 1/2 institution preferred/required.

Why Join Us?
  
  
Join Westbury Sportswear at a stage where you can
**build the operating model, automation roadmap and warehouse infrastructure for scale**
, rather than simply manage an established operation.
  
  
**Apply if you are excited by building scalable, technology-led operations in a high-growth e-commerce environment.**
Skills: supply chain,infrastructure,leadership,automation,accountability,operations

title: Head of Fleet
description:
**Position : HEAD OF FLEET**

**Experinces**
: 10 + years

**Location**
: Bangalore (Frequent field travel required to Tamil Nadu)

MANDATE & CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Role at a glance

* **Director-level ownership**
  of a revenue-linked EV fleet function.
* Current scale: 1,500+ three-wheeler EVs, ~50 pit stops/technicians and two cluster managers across Tamil Nadu.

Mandatory requirements

* **Tamil-speaking; frequent**
  field travel and direct engagement with technicians and workshops.
* Hands-on fleet leadership, technical judgement and practical EV/battery understanding.
* P&L exposure; able to discuss revenue, costs and trade-offs with business finance.
* Ability to build operating systems and lead a lean, distributed team.
* Candidate evidence: fleet/team scale, systems built and measurable operational improvements.

Business impact the candidate must demonstrate

* Improve uptime, repair turnaround and maintenance cost per vehicle.
* Identify recurring failures and fix root causes; avoid repeated temporary repairs.
* Build vehicle histories, job cards, preventive maintenance and accident/insurance SOPs.
* Assess vehicle condition, battery upgrades and replacement timing to extend useful life.
* Build OEM/workshop partnerships and use product-led automation where useful.
* Candidate evidence: before/after results, durable technical fixes and systems that supported growth.

Revenue ownership the candidate must demonstrate

* Work backward from weekly, monthly and quarterly revenue plans to fleet readiness.
* Prioritise uptime and backup vehicles by location revenue and future potential.
* Set different service levels for different business cohorts; protect high-value sales.
* Agree repair-speed, redundancy and cost trade-offs with business finance.
* Candidate evidence: how fleet decisions protected sales, supported growth and balanced cost.

Additional mandate and open points

* 30 days: diagnose/take control. 60–90 days: resolve priority failures. Six months: stabilise the operating system.
* Later priorities: sourcing, OEM terms and ownership versus pay-per-use options.
* Target backgrounds (search guidance): EV/commercial fleets, last-mile operations or OEM service with fleet and commercial ownership.

title: Engineering Team Leader | Conrad Bengaluru
description:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* HVAC, Electrical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitter trade-qualified advantageous
* Must have sound general Engineering knowledge and trade background

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
**Job title: Head of Growth & Operations - Marketing Agency**

**Job Overview**

The ideal candidate must have prior experience in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency, along with a strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, project management, and business development. The role requires a hands-on professional who can streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, manage client relationships, and independently generate new business opportunities.

Working closely with the founder and internal teams, the selected candidate will establish accountability, improve client satisfaction, optimize processes, and contribute to the agency's revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations & Process Management**

* Lead weekly internal team meetings to review progress, resolve challenges, and align priorities.
* Monitor client performance reports to identify significant changes in revenue, paid traffic, organic traffic, and other key performance indicators.
* Conduct sprint planning and review meetings to ensure timely task execution and adherence to workflows in ClickUp.
* Coordinate with the founder to review operational performance, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Participate in client meetings to assess service quality, review deliverables, and ensure client expectations are met.
* Act as the primary escalation point for client issues and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Work with account managers to ensure deliverables meet agreed Scope of Work (SoW) requirements.
* Oversee client invoicing, invoice dispatch, payment follow-ups, and related coordination.
* Identify workflow improvement opportunities and implement automation using Zapier, Slack, ClickUp, or equivalent platforms.
* Prepare and circulate a weekly internal newsletter covering team updates, achievements, progress, and important announcements.

**2. Team Management & Performance Enablement**

* Ensure new employees complete onboarding, role-specific training, and assessments before independently handling deliverables.
* Develop structured assessments and evaluation frameworks to measure employee knowledge, skills, and role readiness.
* Coordinate with HR and team leads to ensure timely completion of employee performance reviews.
* Establish clear performance goals, accountability measures, and productivity benchmarks across teams.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and team performance.
* Support team leads in improving coordination, resource utilization, and delivery quality.

**3. Sales, Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Collaborate with the lead generation team to strengthen the sales pipeline and improve prospect conversion.
* Work with the founder on sales calls, prospect meetings, presentations, proposals, and business development initiatives.
* Independently identify and approach potential clients through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Build and maintain a personal sales pipeline to generate new business opportunities and contribute directly to revenue growth.
* Establish and manage structured CRM processes for lead tracking, follow-ups, pipeline management, and conversion reporting.
* Develop lead-nurturing strategies through email marketing and consistent follow-ups to re-engage prospects.
* Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new service offerings, and alternative revenue streams.
* Explore industry awards, recognitions, and other initiatives to strengthen the agency's brand positioning and credibility.

**4. Freelancer & Resource Management**

* Identify and engage skilled freelancers through professional networks, industry communities, Fiverr, Upwork, and other relevant platforms.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of specialized external resources to support project requirements.
* Prepare job descriptions, project briefs, and scope requirements for freelance assignments.
* Coordinate resource allocation based on project timelines, client requirements, and business priorities.
* Evaluate freelancers based on expertise, reliability, work quality, and ability to meet deadlines.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience.
* **Prior experience in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency is essential.**
* MBA preferred; candidates with relevant experience and strong business acumen may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, account management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, lead conversion, and revenue generation.
* Experience managing CRM systems, sales pipelines, client relationships, and prospect follow-ups.
* Hands-on familiarity with project management and automation tools such as ClickUp, Slack, and Zapier, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to interpret client performance reports, identify potential risks, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Process-driven mindset with the ability to establish scalable systems and improve operational efficiency.
* Willingness to take ownership of both operational responsibilities and independent business development.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Consistent execution of internal workflows, sprint plans, and operational processes.
* Timely delivery of client commitments and effective resolution of escalations.
* Improved client satisfaction, service quality, and adherence to agreed SoWs.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Timely completion of employee onboarding, training, assessments, and performance reviews.
* Effective resource allocation, team productivity, and operational accountability.
* Implementation of structured CRM processes, consistent follow-ups, and improved pipeline visibility.
* Generation of qualified business opportunities, improved lead conversion, and contribution to revenue growth.
* Development of strategic partnerships and initiatives that enhance the agency's market presence.

title: Assistant Restaurant Manager
description:

title: Head Chef
description:
Key Responsibilities:

1. Recruitment & Team Building

* Recruit, screen, and onboard chefs and kitchen staff across Tribal Brew Daily and North West outlets.
* Build a bench of trained, deployable kitchen talent to support new outlet launches without revenue disruption.
* Partner with HR/Operations to close kitchen manpower gaps within agreed timelines.
* Reduce attrition-linked revenue loss through structured onboarding and career pathing.

2. Food Sales & Revenue Growth

* Own the food (F&B) revenue contribution target as a defined share of total outlet sales — “fill the food part of Tribal Brew.”
* Drive upselling and cross-selling of food items alongside beverages at every outlet.
* Identify high-margin, high-velocity menu items and push their visibility and sales at store level.
* Track outlet-wise food sales performance and course-correct underperforming outlets.
* Align new launches and promotions with revenue and footfall opportunities identified through R&D.

3. Menu Planning & R&D

* Lead menu planning and seasonal menu refreshes for both Tribal Brew Daily and North West.
* Develop and test new products with a clear view on cost, margin, and revenue potential before rollout.
* Run pilot launches and food trials, and use customer/outlet feedback to refine offerings.
* Continuously improve recipes for taste, consistency, cost efficiency, and speed of execution.

4. Wastage Control & Cost Management

* Track wastage at every outlet — raw material, prep, and plate wastage — and drive it down against target.
* Investigate root causes of wastage (over-prep, poor storage, expiry) and implement corrective action.
* Report wastage cost impact monthly and tie improvement targets to outlet P&L.
* Drive food costing discipline to protect gross margin on every menu item.

5. Inventory, FIFO & Storage Management

* Implement and audit FIFO (First-In-First-Out) discipline across all outlet kitchens and stores.
* Set and monitor storage standards — temperature control, labeling, segregation, and hygiene.
* Own product shelf-life / longevity management: define shelf-life standards for each product and minimize spoilage-driven loss.
* Coordinate with Procurement to align ordering quantities with actual consumption and shelf-life data.

6. Training & Development

* Conduct structured onboarding and kitchen training for all new chefs and kitchen staff.
* Develop training modules, recipe manuals, and skill assessment programs for both brands.
* Run regular refresher training across all outlets, tied to KPI gaps (wastage, speed, quality).
* Mentor kitchen teams to improve efficiency, consistency, and productivity, linking training outcomes to sales and cost performance.

7. Systems & Automation (Store Level)

* Identify and roll out kitchen systems and automation to reduce manual dependency and human error at store level.
* Standardize prep and production workflows so outlets can scale without proportional cost increase.
* Work with Operations/Tech teams to pilot and implement automation tools (e.g., digital checklists, inventory/wastage tracking systems).

8. SOP Development — QSR & Restaurant

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) tailored separately for QSR (Tribal Brew Daily) and full-service/restaurant (North West) formats.
* Standardize recipes, prep methods, storage procedures, and service processes across formats.
* Ensure SOP compliance across all outlets and continuously refine SOPs for operational efficiency.

9. Quality Assurance & Food Presentation

* Ensure consistency in taste, portion size, plating, and product quality across all outlets and both brands.
* Conduct regular quality audits and implement corrective actions where standards slip.
* Establish and maintain plating and presentation standards that reflect each brand's identity.

10. FSSAI Hygiene & Food Safety

* Ensure full compliance with FSSAI regulations and company food safety standards across all outlets.
* Conduct regular hygiene and food safety audits; maintain documentation and inspection readiness.
* Train kitchen teams on food handling, sanitation, personal hygiene, and contamination prevention.

11. Outlet Visits & Operations

* Visit 2–3 outlets daily across the outlet network, covering MG Road, Indiranagar, Magrath Road, Agara, Mysore, and Bel Road, along with North West in Koramangala.
* Support kitchen setup, training, and go-live readiness for upcoming Tribal Brew Coffee (TBC) outlets.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Operations to close outlet kitchen equipment and resource requirements on time.
* Identify operational gaps on visits and implement corrective measures to protect revenue, quality, and cost.

title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

Scale Readiness

New city / category sourcing readiness checklist

Vendor Quality

% Vendors with Scorecard Score

Category Waste

Blended Dump & Excess Rate across fish & seafood

* 7–10 years in procurement/sourcing within seafood, meat, agri or other perishable categories, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
* Hands-on knowledge of Indian coastal sourcing — harbours, landing centres, aquaculture clusters, species seasonality and price cycles.
* Proven track record of building direct vendor and processor networks from scratch, including commercial negotiation and contracting.
* Experience managing distributed, on-ground teams across multiple locations and processing centres.
* Strong data orientation — comfortable working in Excel/Google Sheets and sourcing dashboards to drive fill rate, cost and waste decisions.
* High on-ground presence; willing to travel extensively across coastal belts (AP, TN, Kerala, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Odisha, West Bengal).

* Bias for action, ownership mindset, and the ability to operate with pace in a high-growth environment.
