title: Post Production Manager
description:
**👩 💻 The role**

As
**Post-Production Manager**
, you'll lead video editing at Headout, building the team, systems, and creative standards that make great travel content possible at scale.

We create long-form and short-form videos that help millions of people make better travel decisions. From explaining the London Underground to breaking down museum tickets or navigating an unfamiliar city, our videos turn complicated information into something simple, useful, and engaging.

You'll own creative quality, editorial standards, timelines, and the post-production pipeline while building workflows that help the team deliver excellent videos consistently. You'll partner with producers and writers to improve storytelling and formats, use YouTube performance data to make better creative decisions, and develop editors who can work independently.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll continue editing and independently own a smaller slate of videos alongside your management responsibilities, with lower individual output targets than the editors you manage.

**🤩 What makes this role special?**

* **Set the Editorial Standard:**
  You'll define what great looks like across storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and audience retention. Your goal is to make informational travel content genuinely engaging without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Build a Scalable Post-Production System:**
  You'll own the pipeline from asset handover and first cuts to feedback, quality checks, and final delivery. You'll build workflows, templates, and reusable visual systems that help the team produce better videos, faster.
* **Stay Hands-On with the Craft:**
  You'll continue editing videos yourself, experimenting with formats, and making creative decisions. You'll balance your own editing responsibilities with leading the team and maintaining quality across projects.
* **Build a Team of Independent Editors:**
  You'll lead editors working across long-form and short-form content, owning creative quality, timelines, feedback, and delivery. You'll mentor them, strengthen their editorial judgement, and build a culture of ownership and constructive feedback.
* **Shape Stories That People Want to Watch:**
  You'll work closely with producers and writers to improve formats, identify storytelling opportunities, and solve creative challenges. You'll turn information people are actively searching for into content they find useful and enjoyable.
* **Use Data to Make Better Creative Decisions:**
  You'll use YouTube metrics, including click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration, to understand what's working and improve future edits. Data will inform your creative judgement, not replace it.
* **Make Creative Work More Efficient:**
  You'll experiment with new tools, including AI, to eliminate repetitive tasks and give editors more time to focus on creative decisions. You'll build systems that reduce firefighting, improve consistency, and make every project easier to execute than the last.

**💝 What skills & experience do you need?**

* **4–6 years of experience**
  in video editing and post-production, with experience leading editors or managing multiple projects.
* **Strong editing skills:**
  A portfolio demonstrating excellent storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and editorial judgement. A portfolio is a must.
* **Team leadership:**
  Experience leading editors, managing feedback and timelines, maintaining creative quality, and developing team members.
* **Strong storytelling instincts:**
  Ability to make informational content engaging and easy to understand without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Workflow management:**
  Ability to manage multiple deadlines, streamline post-production processes, and build reusable templates and systems that improve speed and consistency.
* **Understanding of YouTube:**
  Familiarity with how editing decisions influence click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration.
* **Technical expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of editing software, motion graphics, asset management, and collaborative workflows.
* **Feedback and mentorship:**
  Ability to give clear, actionable feedback that strengthens editorial judgement and helps editors become more independent.
* **Hands-on ownership:**
  Willingness to continue editing videos while managing and developing a team.
* **A systems-first mindset:**
  Someone who simplifies workflows, balances quality with speed, uses data to inform creative decisions, and looks for ways to make every project more efficient than the last.

description:

* We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)

title: Manager - Special Projects & Sustainability
description:
**Position Title**
- Manager – Special Projects & Sustainability

**Department:**
Business Development

**Reporting to:**
Director – Business Development

**Location:**
Corporate Office, with travel to manufacturing sites as required

**1. Role Purpose**

Identify, evaluate and execute strategic projects that deliver measurable business value through technology adoption, green energy, brewing-process optimisation, waste-to-wealth initiatives and resource efficiency.

The role combines technology scouting, data analytics, financial modelling and end-to-end project execution. The incumbent will be responsible for converting opportunities into commercially viable investments and ensuring delivery against approved business cases, frozen engineering designs, budgets, specifications and timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Technology Scouting and Special Projects.**

* Maintain current knowledge of developments in renewable energy, industrial energy efficiency, waste recovery, circular economy and emerging technologies relevant to brewing and process manufacturing.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities in solar and other green energy solutions, heat recovery, energy optimisation, biogas, compressed biogas (CBG) and alternative fuels.
* Identify opportunities to convert brewing by-products and manufacturing waste—including spent grain, surplus yeast, effluent and other process residues, as applicable—into saleable products, energy or useful raw materials.
* Benchmark industry practices, assess technology providers and develop a prioritised pipeline of commercially attractive projects.

**B. Data Analytics and Business Case Development**

* Analyse plant operating data, energy consumption, production yields, waste streams, water usage and operating costs to identify improvement opportunities.
* Independently develop detailed, data-driven business cases and financial models covering capital expenditure, operating costs, revenue potential, savings, payback, NPV, IRR and sensitivity analysis.
* Compare alternative technologies and commercial models, validate assumptions and assess technical feasibility, investment risks and expected returns.
* Prepare evidence-based investment recommendations for management approval, supported by clear assumptions and quantified benefits.
* Use advanced Excel for financial modelling and data analysis. Proficiency in Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools is desirable; familiarity with SQL, Python and AI-enabled analytical tools is an advantage.

**C. Project Execution and Commissioning**

* Take approved projects from detailed planning and engineering through procurement, installation, commissioning, performance testing and operational handover.
* Establish and maintain the approved design, scope, specifications, budget, quality standards and schedule as the execution baseline.
* Coordinate with engineering consultants, technology providers, contractors, plant teams and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective implementation.
* Enforce strict adherence to the frozen design and approved specifications. Any proposed deviation must undergo documented technical and commercial evaluation and formal approval before implementation.
* Monitor project progress, expenditure, risks, quality and milestones; promptly escalate deviations and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure commissioning, performance validation, documentation, training and handover, followed by verification of actual financial and operational benefits against the approved business case.

**D. Sustainability and Resource Efficiency**

* Develop projects to reduce energy consumption, conventional energy costs.
* Evaluate waste-to-energy, waste-to-wealth, water recovery.
* Quantify environmental and financial benefits against defined baselines and identify opportunities to replicate successful projects across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure proposed initiatives meet applicable regulatory, environmental, quality and safety requirements.

**E. Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Engineering, Plant Operations, Finance, Procurement and other relevant functions to validate proposals and deliver approved projects.
* Build relationships with technology providers, equipment manufacturers, consultants and potential commercial partners.
* Present investment proposals, project updates, risks and benefits realisation to the Director – Business Development and senior management.

3. Qualifications and Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Energy, Environmental or another relevant engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in energy management, sustainability, project management or business management is desirable.

**Experience**

* Approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience in industrial project execution, engineering, energy management, process manufacturing or technology implementation.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering projects from feasibility through commissioning.
* Proven capability in financial modelling, investment evaluation and project cost and schedule control.
* Exposure to renewable energy, brewing or fermentation, bioenergy, CBG, waste management, resource recovery or industrial energy efficiency is desirable.

**Preferred industry background**

Brewing and distilleries, food and beverage, bioenergy and CBG, chemicals, cement, paper and pulp, renewable energy, industrial engineering or EPC project execution.

4. Critical Competencies

* Strong technical understanding of industrial processes, utilities, energy systems and resource efficiency.
* Advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to independently build comprehensive financial models and data-backed business cases.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and commercial decision-making skills.
* Hands-on project planning, execution, commissioning and performance validation experience.
* High discipline in engineering design freeze, scope control, change management, quality and cost control.
* Ability to challenge vendor assumptions and translate technical opportunities into measurable financial returns.

5. Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against agreed annual targets:

1. **Value creation:**
   Verified cost savings and incremental revenue delivered.
2. **Project execution:**
   Projects commissioned within approved budgets and timelines.
3. **Design compliance:**
   Adherence to frozen designs and formal change-control procedures.
4. **Investment performance:**
   Actual returns against approved business cases.
5. **Resource efficiency:**
   Measurable improvements in energy, and identified oppurtunties
6. **Waste-to-wealth:**
   Commercial value realised from by-products and waste streams.
7. **Benefits realisation:**
   Achievement of agreed technical, financial and environmental outcomes after commissioning.

title: Head of Operations - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
  
  
**Build. Scale. Operate.**
We’re looking for a hardcore operations leader who thrives in the real world — someone who has built and scaled large, distributed operations from the ground up and knows what it takes to turn an idea into an operation that actually works.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who only manages dashboards, processes, or strategy decks.
  
  
We’re looking for a builder and operator, someone who can start with a blank sheet of paper, build the team, design the processes, solve problems on the ground, and scale the operation without losing speed or quality.
  
  
You’ll be operating in an environment where things change quickly, the problems are often ambiguous, and there is rarely a playbook to follow.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and scale operations from the ground up — define the operating model, build processes, hire teams, establish metrics, and create the systems needed to scale.
* Own large, distributed, real-world operations across multiple locations, teams, and workflows.
* Build high-performing teams — hire exceptional operators, develop leaders, set a high bar for execution, and create a culture of ownership and accountability.
* Turn chaos into structure — identify operational bottlenecks, build repeatable processes, and continuously improve how the organization operates.
* Be relentlessly execution-oriented — when something breaks, you don’t wait for someone else to solve it. You get to the ground, understand the problem, and figure it out.
* Operate at speed — priorities will change, plans will move, and unexpected problems will come up. You’ll need to make decisions quickly and keep the team moving.
* Build for scale — design processes and teams that can handle 10x growth, not just solve today’s problem.
* Own outcomes, not just activities — set clear operational metrics and relentlessly drive performance, quality, productivity, and efficiency.

**What We’re Looking For**
**You’ve built before.**

* 12+ years of experince in Operations
* Significant experience building and running large, distributed, real-world operations.
* Experience in e-commerce, logistics, marketplaces, field operations, fast-scaling startups, hardware-adjacent businesses, or other operationally intensive environments.
* A track record of building teams and operating models from scratch, not just inheriting established ones.
* Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build teams that are highly accountable, ambitious, and deeply committed to the mission.
* Extremely high ownership — you naturally think, “I’ll figure it out.”
* Extreme agility and resilience.

+ Plans change → you adapt, rather than freeze.
+ Pressure increases → you become clearer and more decisive.
+ Something breaks → you go after the root cause.

* Strong operational judgment — you know when to build a process, when to break one, and when to simply get things done.
* Comfortable working with incomplete information and making decisions without waiting for perfect data.
* A strong bias toward action, with the ability to balance speed, quality, cost, and scale.

**The Kind of Leader We Want**
You’re the person who:
  
  

* Can walk into a messy operation and figure out what needs to happen next.
* Has built teams from a handful of people into large, high-performing organizations.
* Can spend the morning looking at operational metrics and the afternoon solving a problem on the ground.
* Doesn’t need a perfect org structure or playbook to get started.
* Sets an extremely high bar — but earns trust by giving the team the support, context, and ownership to meet it.
* Builds teams that want to run through walls for them.
* Is calm when things are chaotic and gets more focused when the pressure goes up.
* Gets excited by operational complexity rather than intimidated by it.
* Has experience with robotics, AI data collection, or hardware operations

**Bonus, Not Required**
Experience or exposure to:
  
  

* Supply chain or manufacturing operations
* Field workforce operations
* Marketplace operations
* Multi-city / multi-location scaling
* Building operations in an early-stage or rapidly scaling startup

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Center Director - Indiranagar Location
description:
**About us**

At Openhouse, we are building a network of premium play based learning centres across Bangalore. Our learning centres offer preschool, childcare and co-curricular activities for ages 1-10 years. We believe that modern parents are seeking professionally run schools that are child-centric, have quality infrastructure and follow global pedagogies.

Our learning centres are different from traditional K-12 schools or preschools. We are building learning hubs (micro-schools) at a neighbourhood level where parents can send children for play school, nursery, kindergarten and a range of co-curricular activities from dance to drama, chess to robotics!

**The problem**

We realise that in big urban metros, parents preferences are changing:

1. Families are more nuclear and there are a lot of childcare responsibilities especially in the early years which they need to figure out on their own.
2. Parents are dissatisfied with existing preschools due to an overemphasis on academics with subpar educators and infrastructure.

Looking at the above, Openhouse is trying to bridge the gap for modern thoughtful parents and be their support partner in the first 10 years of parenting. We have been on this mission since 2018 and already have 12 live learning centres across Bangalore and Kolkata where we help 4000+ families and mentor 200+ educators.

Click here to take a look at our modern centres.

Click here to view our Instagram Page

**Who are we?**

Founded by Stanford alumni and headquartered in Bangalore, Openhouse is an Ed Tech Startup. We emphasise on play based learning and believe that the future of education lies in designing games and activities that promote peer based learning. This philosophy reflects in each team member at Openhouse. Our team’s background spans institutions like Harvard, MIT, IIT, and ISB, and companies like Cult.fit and Truecaller. We’re backed by leading global education investors who believe in us.

**What is the role?**

As a Centre Director at Openhouse, you will play a pivotal role in managing one learning centre entrusted to you. It’s a role that allows you to build that centre in your neighborhood and create social and economical impact.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Working with our enthusiastic teachers by building an inclusive, growth oriented culture.
* Implementing our Curriculum in the centre for both preschool and afterschool programs
* Managing day to day functioning of the centre
* Owning the Professional Development of the entire team by bridging any knowledge or skill gaps.
* Maintaining open and effective communication with parents, sharing insights into their child's progress and milestones.

**Who is the ideal candidate?**

We are looking for someone who-

* Has at least 4-5 years of being a Preschool Teacher in a Premium Early Childhood Education school.
* Has good team management experience and has led teams before
* Has good communication and team building skills
* Is willing to be entrepreneurial and do whatever it takes to grow a learning centre in their community.
* Is outgoing and able to hold good quality conversations with parents, teachers and students alike
* Loves being around children and is passionate about quality education
* A course in Early Childhood Education or a B.Ed or NTT, MTT would also be great to have and is a bonus.

**Things you should know before applying**

* Location: Bangalore
* Timings: 8:30am to 5pm
* 5 day working week (However, 1 day of the weekend will be working, non negotiable)

title: Manager HR Operations
description:
Pretium is a specialized investment manager with ~$53B in assets under management (AUM) focused on real estate, mortgage finance, and corporate debt. Pretium manages more than 96,000 single-family rentals (SFRs) in the United States and has a global employee base of ~4,400.

Pretium Enterprise Operations India Private Limited (PES India), based in Bangalore, is integral to the growth, innovation, and transformation of Pretium’s global operating companies. With 700+ employees, PES India delivers with excellence, ownership, and a relentless focus on scalable growth.

**Job Description:**

*About the role:*

The Manager HR Operations India is a key delivery role within the HR function, responsible for executing and overseeing the day-to-day HR operations processes that keep the employee lifecycle running accurately and on time — from Day 1 to exit. This role ensures that the operational heartbeat of HR is consistent, compliant, and employee-centric.  
We are looking for a detail-obsessed, process-driven, and dependable HR Ops Team Lead who can own their workstreams end-to-end, support and guide junior team members, and serve as the first point of operational escalation within the team. This role works closely with the HR Ops Assistant Manager and Manager, the HRBP, Finance, and external vendors to deliver seamless HR operations for our 700+ employees.

*What you will do at PES India:*

*Employee Lifecycle Management*

* Execute and oversee end-to-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle — onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, role changes, and exits — ensuring accuracy and timeliness at every stage
* Coordinate weekly induction logistics and ensure every new joiner has a smooth Day 1 — system access, documentation, and orientation completed before they arrive
* Manage the offboarding process — exit documentation, clearance coordination, full and final settlement inputs, and real-time HRMS updates
* Prepare and issue all HR letters — offer, confirmation, transfer, promotion, and exit — with accuracy and turnaround speed
* Coordinate background verification (BGV) with vendors and ensure timely, accurate completion for all new joiners

*HR Documentation & Compliance*

* Maintain accurate, audit-ready employee records across both physical and digital systems
* Ensure compliance with company HR policies and applicable statutory requirements; flag gaps proactively to the Assistant Manager
* Support internal and external HR audits with well-organised documentation and trackers
* Assist in updating HR policy documents and process SOPs as directed by the HR leadership

*Payroll & Attendance Support*

* Compile and validate monthly payroll inputs — attendance, leaves, shift data, arrears, and variable pay — and share with the payroll processing team on time, every cycle
* Track leave balances, attendance records, and shift schedules; resolve discrepancies before they become payroll errors
* Coordinate with Finance and the payroll vendor to ensure smooth monthly cycles; flag exceptions and unresolved issues to the Assistant Manager

*Benefits Administration*

* Manage the end-to-end medical insurance process — enrolments, additions, deletions, claim coordination, and annual renewal support
* Administer other employee benefits including shift allowances, weekend allowances, and any other applicable benefits programmes
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee benefit queries; resolve with speed and clarity; escalate complex cases appropriately

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**
===============================

**Location:** Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | **Team:** Engineering | **Reporting to:** CTO | **Level**: Senior Individual Contributor

**OVERVIEW**
------------

APEXX is an **independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.** Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: **acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.** Our **routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.** We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by **MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital** and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including **Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an **Engineering Operations Lead** to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
------------------------

### **Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:** take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:** establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:** connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:** oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:** troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

### **Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:** establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:** develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:** coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:** track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:** strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:** translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:** identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

### **AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:** develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:** explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:** strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:** reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:** evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* Strong experience in **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role** within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving **Jira**, including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with **engineering performance metrics**, including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting** to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**, constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Experience working within a **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management** function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**, ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**
---------------

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges — improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
---------------------------

* **Competitive compensation:** that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:** annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:** up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:** for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:** for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:** enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:** opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**
-----------------------------

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to **200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.** We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

* Experience managing rapid-turn digital, web, editorial, design and motion deliverables.

title: Associate Director, Enterprise Systems Finance Business Operations
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Associate Director-Enterprise Systems Finance Business Operations is responsible for driving the financial management, operational performance and business rhythm to the Enterprise Systems function. The Associate Director translates complex financial data and operational metrics into actionable insights that support investment decisions, resource planning and continuous improvement across the Enterprise Systems portfolio. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure headcount, vendor spend and programme budgets are managed effectively, and that the Enterprise Systems function is equipped to meet its commitments within agreed financial guardrails.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage the Enterprise Systems financial planning cycle, ensuring budgets are accurately maintained, variances are understood and explained and financial commitments are met.
* Serve as the primary finance and operational business partner to Enterprise Systems leadership, providing proactive financial analysis, cost modelling, and investment appraisal to support prioritisation and decision-making.
* Maintain a consolidated view of Enterprise Systems spend across run, change, and invest categories — including internal headcount costs, external vendor and managed service contracts, software licences, and capital expenditure — ensuring accurate allocation and recharging where required.
* Lead the operational management of Enterprise Systems vendor and contract portfolio, including purchase order creation, invoice approval, accruals management, and contract renewal tracking in partnership with Procurement and Legal teams.
* Develop and maintain the Enterprise Systems management information pack, providing regular reporting on financial performance, headcount, productivity, and operational KPIs to senior leadership and relevant governance bodies.
* Support the Enterprise Systems leadership team in preparing business cases for investment, ensuring financial modelling, benefit quantification, and risk assessment are robust and aligned to GSK's investment approval standards.
* Partner with HR Business Partners to manage headcount planning, contractor and contingent worker governance, role change processes, and workforce cost tracking across the Enterprise Systems function.
* Drive continuous improvement in financial processes, reporting tools, and operational workflows within the Enterprise Systems function, identifying AI/automation and simplification opportunities that reduce administrative burden and improve data quality.
* Support the Director Enterprise Systems Business Operations in preparing materials for senior leadership meetings, business reviews, and governance forums, ensuring financial and operational content is accurate, well-structured, and presented at the right level of detail.
* Ensure compliance with GSK financial controls, procurement policies, and internal audit requirements across all Enterprise Systems financial and operational activities.
* Act as a subject matter expert on Enterprise Systems financial processes, tooling, and data, providing guidance to the broader team and supporting onboarding of new team members to financial ways of working.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* 15 to 19years of professional experience with bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, Information Systems or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in finance operations, finance systems, reporting or controls in a large organisation.
* Practical experience using ERP or enterprise finance systems (e.g., SAP, Ariba, Oracle, Workday) to support budgeting, reporting, procurement, financial controls, and month-end processes.
* Experience working in a finance business partnering, financial management, or IT financial operations role within a large, complex organisation.
* Proven experience managing technology or IT function budgets, including headcount cost management, vendor spend, and capital/operational expenditure tracking.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to produce high-quality financial analysis, forecasts, and management information that supports executive decision-making.
* Experience working as a trusted business partner to senior technology or functional leaders, translating financial complexity into clear, actionable guidance.
* Familiarity with procurement, vendor management, and contract governance processes, including purchase order management and invoice approval workflows.
* Exposure to workforce planning processes, including headcount tracking, contractor governance, and role change management.
* Experience supporting business case development, including financial modelling, benefit quantification, and investment appraisal.
* Experience working within structured financial governance, internal controls, and audit frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to understand and experiment with AI and automation to improve data quality and reporting output  

**Preferred Skills:**  
  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus.

  
  

* Professional finance qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent.
* Experience with business intelligence tools and data modelling (for example Power BI, Tableau, Qlik).
* Prior experience in program or project delivery across finance and technology.
* Exposure to control frameworks, compliance or risk management in a global environment.
* Experience working in an internal company matrix environment and with external vendors or service providers.
* Familiarity with automation, RPA or system integration concepts.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to present complex financial information clearly and confidently to non-finance stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
* Strong financial modelling and data analysis skills, able to build robust forecasts, cost models, and business cases that withstand senior scrutiny.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple financial cycles, reporting deadlines, and operational workstreams simultaneously without loss of accuracy.
* Proactive and commercially minded, able to identify financial risks and opportunities and bring them to the attention of senior leaders with recommended courses of action.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, compliance, and internal control frameworks, ensuring all financial activities meet GSK's policies and audit standards.
Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately  

Location and Working Model:
  
This role is based in India with UK working business hours. The role is hybrid, with a mix of on-site and remote work. Specific on-site days will be agreed with your manager.

  

**Skills**

Anaplan, ApptioOne, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Budget Planning, Data Analysis, Finance Business Partnering, Financial Governance, Financial Operations, Forecasting, IT Financial Management, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI)  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Sr. Manager Supplier Engineering
description:
**Company Description**
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
  
  
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
  
  
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
  
  
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
  
  
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of the Position:**
The successful candidate will lead a team of Supplier Engineers, to develop a portfolio of suppliers that deliver components, parts, and sub-assemblies at lowest landed cost for Intuitive’s robotic systems. By building technical expertise and business acumen in the Robotics space including its primary commodities of Motion control (electric motors, gearboxes, brakes, sensors, and other actuators), Electronics (PCBAs, PCBs, and electrical harness assemblies), Metals (CNC machining, Castings), and Plastics (injection molding, thermoforming, reaction injection molding), Supplier Engineering leads the technical evaluation during supplier selection, works with suppliers to develop manufacturing processes for components, and qualifies these processes to ensure suppliers can deliver the quality, capability, capacity, and cost necessary to meet Intuitive’s needs.
  
  
You will be responsible for the engineering relationship with many suppliers and the corresponding spend required to establish production, as well as for the discovery and development of new suppliers. You will strive to deliver the best-in-class performance score from your suppliers which is derived from several KPIs of Capacity, On-time Delivery, Cost reduction, Risk Mitigation, Product Quality and Service levels.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**
Lead a team of supplier engineers who are delivering value to the business through the following activities.
  
  

* Supply-chain Strategy: Develop and execute Global Supply-chain strategy and roadmap for long term, sustainable and resilient supply-chain to support Intuitive’s Product strategy and roadmap.
* Supplier Selection: Conduct market research to identify trends in the field of [plastics, Metal] manufacturing and accordingly select and evaluate suppliers to enable Agility and innovation during New Product Introduction, and to enable production scale globally for products that reach broad commercial launch. Establish a strong partnership with the commodity sourcing team to incorporate commercial viability in supplier selection process.
* Supplier Development and collaboration: Drive and adopt new technologies and automation in supply-chain to achieve high efficiency and production scale. Champion best practices like DFX, Lean, SPC, Six-sigma, Project management, into supply-chain. Establish clear communication channels with suppliers and manage both technical and business relationships
* Supplier Performance and Monitoring: Partner closely with suppliers to select optimal mfg process and process controls to achieve high quality and cost performance. Develop effective KPIs to monitor supplier performance (delivery, capacity, cost, quality). Execute projects towards continuous improvements of KPIs.
* Supplier Compliance: Partner with Supplier Quality org to drive audit finding resolution with suppliers through processes like CAPA and SCARs to maintain compliance with QMS requirements
* Supplier Risk management: Partner with Global supply-chain team to identify various risks within supply-chain and implement mitigation measures.
* Supplier Change management: For commercially launched products, execute Intuitive’s change management processes like major/moderate change (MCF), Supplier Change Request (SCR) and Change Order (CO) to support large scale projects towards capacity scaling, cost reduction, product quality improvement and supply-chain risk mitigation.
* Stakeholder Influence: Aligning/Negotiating on project ownership and hand-off points with various peer Supplier engineering groups (like New Product Introduction, Mfg Plant support, Tooling development). Influencing decisions with key partners in Global Ops (planning, sourcing, purchasing), Engineering (Design, Process, Quality) and Project Management Org.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Proven ability to lead teams to solve complex technical and process problems
* Proven ability to hire highly capable staff, and grow and mentor staff
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentations to executives
* Demonstrated Project Management skills and ability to influence and negotiate with stakeholders.
* Domain Knowledge expertise in the [Plastic, Metal] commodity. Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes and measurement techniques. Deep understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, schedule and capacity
* Outstanding analytical skills along with good judgment
* Proficiency in Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing techniques; certification preferred
* Knowledge of document management systems and ERP Systems, preferably Agile and SAP
* Knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485 preferred
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus
* Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis – domestic and international (25%)

**Required Education And Training**

* BS degree in engineering, advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years related experience in Manufacturing, Operations, Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, or related field with significant medical or medical device experience preferred
* 3+ years of experience leading supplier engineering, supplier quality or supplier development teams, or leadership of equivalent areas.

title: Director - Cloud Platform Operations, Reliability & Security
description:
**Location**
Chennai, India; relocation can be discussed

**Experience 15**
+ years in technology, including substantial executive leadership

**Reporting**
Senior technology leadership

**The mandate**

An established enterprise software organization is strengthening the way it builds, protects, and operates its cloud services. It is looking for an executive who can bring platform engineering, production resilience, and security outcomes under clear leadership, while working closely with product and engineering teams.

The successful leader will set direction and build a capable organization that delivers dependable services, reduces security exposure, and automates routine operational work. This is a leadership appointment with real technical accountability: the executive will challenge design decisions, examine service and security evidence, and personally engage in critical events when needed.

**What you will own**

An integrated operating model for cloud platforms, service operations, SRE, secure software delivery, and security engineering.

Organization design, leadership development, and measurable accountability across managers and specialist teams.

The executive view of service health, operational risk, security posture, major incidents, and investment priorities.

A close partnership with engineering leaders so reliability and security are built into architecture, development, release, and support.

**Areas of impact**

**Service resilience and operational leadership**

Define how critical services are measured and operated, including SLOs, error budgets, availability, performance, capacity, and release risk.

Lead high-severity incident response and 24x7 escalation. Set expectations for command, communications, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective work.

Use telemetry, service reviews, readiness practices, and resilience exercises to identify weak signals and prevent customer-impacting failures.

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement.

**Cloud platform and financial stewardship**

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle.

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled.

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results.

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend.

**Security engineering and threat response**

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments.

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services.

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure.

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through.

**Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations**

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning.

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable.

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses.

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions.

**Experience and leadership profile**

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering.

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams.

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant.

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning.

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness.

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response.

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control.

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews.

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Additional strengths**

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable.

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment.

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

title: Director, Core Infrastructure
description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Director, Core Infrastructure is a hands-on leader responsible for the reliability, resilience, performance, operational discipline, and continuous improvement of Nationwide’s core infrastructure capabilities in India. This role leads a broad, multidisciplinary portfolio spanning Mainframe, Network, Telephony, Compute, Storage, Database, Middleware, Containers, and FinOps, while partnering closely with Cloud, Security, Architecture, Application, and business teams.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong technical judgment with a positive, people-centered leadership style. They will be comfortable engaging at both strategic and technical levels, and passionate about developing, coaching, and recognizing people so the organization builds durable capability for the future.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day delivery and operational performance across the core infrastructure portfolio for Nationwide India
* Liaise and coordinate with Nationwide US leadership team and frontline staff
* Establish clear priorities, service expectations, ownership models, and escalation paths across participating teams.
* Maintain a strong focus on availability, resilience, capacity, performance, recoverability, security, and compliance.
* Provide hands-on leadership during complex incidents, problem investigations, major changes, and service-improvement initiatives.
* Drive standardization, automation, lifecycle management, modernization, and reduction of operational toil.
* Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to shape practical, scalable infrastructure road maps.
* Build disciplined practices for monitoring, observability, configuration management, patching, vulnerability remediation, disaster recovery, and technical debt reduction.
* Strengthen FinOps practices by improving cost transparency, forecasting, demand management, utilization, and accountability across infrastructure services.
* Coordinate dependencies across Mainframe, Network, Compute, Storage, Database, Middleware, and Containers to deliver integrated outcomes rather than isolated technology improvements.
* Develop trusted relationships with internal partners, vendors, and service providers.
* Translate business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, risks, and decisions for senior leadership.
* Ensure operational processes and technical solutions support Nationwide’s risk-management, governance, and audit expectations.

**People leadership expectations**

* Create a positive, inclusive, and accountable team environment.
* Coach individuals through regular feedback, career conversations, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities.
* Build a strong bench of technical and operational talent through delegation, stretch assignments, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Recognize contributions and reinforce behaviors that improve customer outcomes, teamwork, and reliability.
* Lead through change with transparency, empathy, consistency, and a bias toward constructive problem solving.
* Encourage healthy challenge, learning from incidents, and continuous improvement without blame.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Significant experience leading infrastructure engineering or operations teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience across multiple core infrastructure domains, with sufficient depth to guide technical decisions and challenge assumptions.
* Experience leading critical incidents, operational reviews, service improvements, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure reliability, security, resilience, capacity, performance, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals and first-line leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues to senior and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with distributed teams, external partners, and global operating models.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated, highly available, or financial-services environment.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, observability, platform engineering, and modern operational practices.
* Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, service providers, and technology road maps.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and hybrid technology environments.
* Experience establishing or improving FinOps, IT service management, or reliability engineering practices.

**Leadership profile**
We are seeking a leader who is technically credible, calm under pressure, optimistic, collaborative, and committed to making the people and the platform better every day. The right candidate brings energy to difficult problems, stays close enough to the work to understand reality, and creates an environment where people can do their best work.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technological solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
The Director of Technology Engineering leads a team of infrastructure engineers involved in the analysis, design, development and implementation of hardware/software. You’ll determine hardware/software systems requirements, authorize and oversee systems hardware/software design; plan projects; establish priorities and monitor progress. You’ll also evaluate project status and resource utilization and implement changes to improve the staff's effectiveness. The ability to ensuring project completion, on time and on budget, is essential. You’ll also need the ability to generate hardware/software systems engineering policies, standards, and procedures. You also may mentor associates who are not members of your core team.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Directs a staff that delivers on build and operational (build and run) components for the product(s) aligned to a technology area, such as but not limited to, consulting, managing and development of new products, upgrade/patching efforts, annual budgeting, efficiency efforts, etc. and the function responsible for driving a competitive unit cost through efficient product lifecycle.

* Oversee vendor management/relationships and sourcing, in collaboration with Technology Product Manager.
* Drives release cadence and business feature alignment leveraging automation to drive speed and actively drives continuous process improvement activities including Lean, process/product innovation, quality, cost reduction and other initiatives.
* Leads people through guidance and support on the execution of work; management of associates including but not limited to performance management, salary planning, training, development, workforce planning, hiring, and disciplinary actions; and attracts, hires, engages and develops the team through impactful recruitment, coaching and feedback.
* Participates in strategic initiatives/planning for core products including products that cross Technologies.
* Develops and manages project budgets and deployment.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, mathematics, or related field is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Ten years knowledge of project management concepts and techniques. Experience leading multiple teams and assets across various technology platforms. Three years of management experience is preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Business Strategies
* Computer Science
* Financial Management
* IT Infrastructure
* Technical Acumen
* Vendor Management
* Technology Strategies

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Expert communication skills
* Ability to influence, negotiate, and set priorities
* Mentoring and coaching abilities to guide associates

* Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus
