title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Lead — Bandilo

**Location:** Hyderabad, India (on-site) **Reports to:** Founder & Director, Ecom Cloud Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

About Bandilo

Bandilo is a zero-commission hyperlocal delivery marketplace connecting push-cart vendors and street sellers with customers across Hyderabad. Vendors keep 100% of every order; Bandilo earns through a flat monthly vendor subscription instead of commission.

The role

Right now, every function — tech, marketing, field vendor onboarding, delivery, and an external onboarding partnership — reports directly to the founder. This role exists to change that. You'll go through a structured 15-day handover across every function, then take over day-to-day running of the business so the founder can step back into a supervisory role.

What you'll own

* Full, independent ownership of the team and day-to-day running of Bandilo — this isn't a support role, the buck stops with you
* Day-to-day coordination across Tech, Marketing, AFO (field vendor operations), and Delivery
* The daily and weekly reporting cadence across all functions
* End-to-end resolution of vendor and customer complaints — full ownership through to resolution, not just escalation
* Operational issues and delivery failures — only looping in the founder when something crosses a defined threshold
* The relationship with Bandilo's external onboarding partner — an MOU-governed engagement covering vendor and delivery onboarding across two zones, including weekly payout reconciliation and audit compliance
* Vendor onboarding pace and delivery reliability, with authority to redirect field resources where the numbers are lagging

What we're looking for

* 3+ years in an operations, general management, or chief-of-staff role — ideally at a hyperlocal delivery, quick-commerce, or gig-economy startup
* Comfortable managing field and delivery staff you don't sit next to every day
* Process-first: able to take a founder's mental model of the business and turn it into something a team can run without him in the room
* Working knowledge of Telugu and/or Urdu is a strong plus, given the vendor base
* Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate

First 15 days

A structured, hands-on handover directly with the founder: shadowing every function, taking over the reporting cadence, and starting to own the escalation matrix. By the end of day 15, the founder should be able to step back and observe from a distance.

**Cleaning & CIP Management**

* Ensure proper execution of cleaning and CIP activities as per validated procedures.
* Review cleaning records and ensure compliance with cleaning schedules.

**People Management**

* Lead accident, near-miss, and unsafe condition investigations.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions arising from safety observations.
* Drive the objective of Zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI).
Ensure proper use of PPE and compliance with safety standards.  

  

**Continuous Improvement**

  

* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor production KPIs and implement actions to improve performance.

title: ML Operations Lead
description: # Job Title: ML Operations LeadExperience:** 18–25 Years overallRelevant Experience:** 8+ years in ML, MLOps, or Data Science Engineering, including team leadershipLocation:** Hinjewadi Phase 1, PuneWork Mode:** 5 Days Work from OfficeWorking Hours:** 9 AM – 6 PM IST(870)Notice Period:** Immediate Joiners to Serving Notice Period Candidates(only upto 30days)## Role OverviewWe are seeking an experienced ML Operations Lead to lead a team responsible for operating and maintaining traditional Machine Learning models in production. The role focuses on ensuring model accuracy, reliability, stability, auditability, and continuous performance through effective monitoring, drift detection, retraining, validation, deployment, and rollback practices.The successful candidate will manage a team of two ML Operations Engineers in India and collaborate with international stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, and business teams to ensure timely and reliable model operations.Note:** This is a classical MLOps role focused on traditional predictive ML models, not LLM/GenAI operations.## Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and develop the ML Operations team, establishing operational standards, priorities, and best practices. Manage the deployment, monitoring, retraining, validation, and maintenance of traditional ML models in production. Establish model validation gates, including backtesting and champion-challenger approaches, before promoting models to production. Define and manage rollback procedures to restore previous stable model versions when required. Monitor data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model performance degradation across the model portfolio. Define retraining triggers, thresholds, and processes to maintain model accuracy and reliability. Maintain model registries, version history, training data lineage, baseline metrics, and last-known-good model records. Track model performance using relevant metrics such as AUC, precision, recall, and other business-aligned KPIs. Monitor model bias and fairness, ensuring appropriate controls and human oversight for sensitive decision-making use cases. Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to manage data quality, data freshness, data contracts, and upstream data changes. Implement business-requested model changes within agreed timelines while maintaining operational and validation standards. Coordinate with international stakeholders on deployment schedules, production incidents, change management, and operational standards. Report model health, deployment success rates, retraining outcomes, and overall portfolio performance. Support predictive ML use cases such as customer churn prediction, fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting.## Must-Have Skills Strong experience in **MLOps and production ML operations**. Hands-on experience deploying and operating traditional Machine Learning models in production. Strong understanding of **customer churn prediction models** and related predictive analytics use cases. Expertise in model deployment, model monitoring, drift detection, and model retraining. Experience implementing ML CI/CD pipelines, model registries, and model lineage. Practical experience with data drift, feature drift, concept drift, and model decay management. Experience with model validation, backtesting, and champion-challenger methodologies. Knowledge of model performance metrics, including AUC, precision, recall, and precision-recall evaluation. Experience leading teams, mentoring engineers, and managing operational priorities. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including cross-border collaboration. Ability to translate business requirements into operational priorities and deliver model changes within agreed timelines. Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline.## Nice-to-Have Skills Experience in telecommunications (telco) or large-scale data environments. Exposure to fraud detection, revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting models. Experience with cloud-based Machine Learning platforms. Postgraduate qualification in Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline. Experience with model governance, auditability, responsible AI, bias monitoring, and model-risk management.## Leadership Expectations Ability to lead a lean ML Operations team and establish scalable operating practices. Strong operational judgment and ownership of production model health. Effective coordination with business, data, and platform stakeholders. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.## Candidate Requirements Minimum 2 years of stability in an organization. Immediate joiners and candidates currently serving notice are preferred. Candidates based in Pune are preferred. Willingness to work from the office five days a week in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune. Excellent communication skills are essential due to regular stakeholder and client interaction.## Interview Process 2 Technical Rounds 1 Client Round HR RoundSkills: feature drift,model deployment,drift detection,metrics,auc,machine learning models,model monitoring,model validation,mlops,production ml operations,backtesting,ml ci/cd pipelines,model registries,stakeholder-management,concept drift,data drift,customer churn prediction models

title: Campus Director – Academics, Operations & Student Success

**Hiring: Campus Director – Academics, Operations & Student Success**

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (On-site)

**Experience:**
Minimum 8 years | Preferred 10–15 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

Intellipaat is seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Campus Director to take complete ownership of academic delivery, faculty management, campus administration, student experience, financial discipline, and operational excellence at its Pune campus.

The successful candidate will act as the
**single point of accountability for campus performance**
, ensuring that every academic, operational, and student-experience commitment is implemented to the highest standards.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring strong execution capabilities, an ownership mindset, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Academic Delivery & Curriculum Execution**

* Ensure end-to-end execution of the approved curriculum and academic delivery plans established.
* Oversee academic, daily class schedules, faculty allocations, labs, assignments, assessments, and examinations.
* Ensure every class and practical session is delivered according to approved schedules and quality standards.
* Monitor student learning outcomes, curriculum completion, coding proficiency, projects, and academic performance.
* Identify learning gaps, establish corrective action plans, and ensure timely improvement.
* Drive coding labs, hackathons, innovation activities, industry projects, and other experiential learning initiatives.

**2. Faculty Leadership & Quality Management**

* Supervise all teaching faculty, academic coordinators, mentors, and supporting academic staff.
* Coordinate faculty recruitment, onboarding, training, performance reviews, and development.
* Conduct regular classroom observations and faculty-quality audits.
* Monitor faculty attendance, teaching effectiveness, student feedback, syllabus coverage, and assessment quality.
* Ensure appropriate replacement and contingency arrangements for faculty absence or performance issues.
* Build a culture of academic accountability and continuous improvement.

**3. Student Success & Campus Experience**

* Own the complete student experience from onboarding to graduation.
* Monitor attendance, academic performance, student engagement, behavioral discipline, and retention.
* Establish effective mentorship, academic counseling, and student-support systems.
* Conduct regular student-feedback sessions, address grievances, and drive improvements.
* Maintain proactive communication with parents regarding student progress and important concerns.
* Promote coding competitions, hackathons, technical clubs, entrepreneurship, and extracurricular initiatives.
* Ensure students experience a safe, disciplined, supportive, and high-quality learning environment.

**4. Campus Administration & Operations**

* Take ownership of day-to-day campus functioning, including classrooms, laboratories, IT infrastructure, facilities, security, housekeeping, and vendor management.
* Lead the campus administration team and coordinate with university departments.
* Ensure readiness of infrastructure, learning equipment, and student facilities.
* Oversee hostel and transportation coordination wherever applicable.
* Maintain operational discipline, safety standards, documentation, and effective grievance-resolution mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs and applicable university policies.

**5. Fee Management & Financial Accountability**

* Monitor student fee-payment schedules, collections, outstanding balances, and overdue payments.
* Coordinate with finance, admissions, students, and parents to ensure timely and professional fee follow-ups.
* Maintain accurate fee records, reconciliations, payment commitments, and collection forecasts.
* Identify and escalate chronic overdue cases, fee disputes, and financial irregularities.
* Supervise campus operating expenditure, budget adherence, vendor payments, and resource utilization.
* Ensure fee-related decisions and collection processes comply with university agreements and applicable policies.

**6. University Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary operational liaison between all stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships with university leadership, academic departments, examination teams, and administrative offices.
* Coordinate implementation of approved academic schedules, curriculum, academic policies, examination requirements, and student records.
* Ensure university-specific academic and administrative requirements are fulfilled on time.
* Escalate matters requiring institutional approvals without disrupting student learning.

**7. Campus Performance & Reporting**

* Maintain daily and weekly dashboards covering academic delivery, faculty performance, student attendance, student satisfaction, fee collections, and operational issues.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with faculty and administration teams.
* Identify performance deviations, create corrective action plans, and track closure.
* Provide transparent, data-driven reporting wherever required.
* Take accountability for agreed campus performance targets and continuous improvement.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 8 years of professional experience, preferably 10–15 years in higher education, engineering colleges, university administration, EdTech, or academic operations.
* At least 3 years managing academic or campus operations with direct responsibility for teams and measurable outcomes.
* Prior experience as Campus Head, Campus Director, Academic Operations Head, Dean – Operations, Senior Program Manager, or equivalent.
* Proven ability to manage faculty, academic delivery, student experience, administration, and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of engineering or technology education and outcome-oriented learning models.
* Experience implementing centralized curriculum and academic policies at a campus level.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, fee follow-ups, operational reporting, and escalations.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, communication, and analytical capabilities.
* Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, student information systems, and LMS/ERP platforms.
* Bachelor's degree required; B.Tech, MBA, or a relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

**What We Are Looking For**

We need a leader who is proactive, highly disciplined, data-driven, and comfortable taking complete ownership.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable reviewing classroom teaching quality, handling a difficult parent conversation, resolving faculty shortages, coordinating with university leadership, reviewing fee outstanding reports, and driving improvements in student performance.

**Success in this position will be measured by academic outcomes, curriculum execution, faculty effectiveness, student satisfaction, operational excellence, financial discipline, and overall campus performance.**

title: Manager - Cloud Container Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise.
  
  
This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi-tenant AKS operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform Operations & Service Ownership
  
  

* Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls.
* Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-life planning.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements.

Kubernetes Platform Management
  
  

* Oversee centralized multi-tenant AKS environments supporting mission-critical and non-mission-critical workloads.
* Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations.
* Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements.
* Implement automation-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code.
* Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity readiness for critical Kubernetes workloads.
* Reduce operational overhead through standardization and automated remediation.

Executive Reporting & Operational Metrics
  
  

* Develop executive dashboards and leadership reporting focused on:

+ Platform Availability & Uptime
+ Cluster Health Metrics
+ MTTR & Incident Trends
+ SLA/SLO Compliance
+ Kubernetes Resource Utilization
+ Capacity Planning & Forecasting
+ Node Pool Utilization
+ Security & Compliance Posture
+ Platform Adoption Metrics
+ Cost Optimization & FinOps Insights
+ Support Backlog & Service Request Metrics

* Present operational reviews, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership

**Security & Governance**

* Maintain enterprise Kubernetes governance standards.
* Oversee RBAC, Azure AD integration, Managed Identities, and secrets management.
* Ensure enforcement of Azure Policy, security guardrails, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to ensure secure platform operations.
* Lead audit and regulatory compliance activities related to container platforms

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary operational contact for application teams consuming AKS services.
* Build relationships with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and strategic partners to optimize platform capabilities.
* Drive customer experience and service improvement initiatives across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Kubernetes platform operations team.
* Establish operational goals and performance expectations.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical capability growth.
* Promote a culture of automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, container engineering or platform engineering with 15+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments.
* 5+ years of people management experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, specifically:

+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
+ Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD.
+ DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Hub and Spoke Architecture,
+ RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault etc..

* Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews.
* Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Kubernetes Services.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration, and cloud-native technologies.
* Expertise in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) administration and operations.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong knowledge of container technologies including Docker and container registries.
* Experience with GitOps practices using ArgoCD and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Bicep).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Private Link, Azure Firewall, ingress, and service networking.
* Experience implementing Kubernetes security controls, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Secrets Management.
* Expertise in observability, monitoring, logging, and performance management using enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
* Vendor and Managed Service Provider Governance.

Key Success Metrics
  
  

* Enterprise CAKS platform consistently achieves availability, performance, and security objectives.
* Increased adoption of centralized AKS services across business units.
* High levels of automation, self-service, and operational maturity.
* Reduced operational overhead and improved platform reliability.
* Leadership receives timely, actionable operational insights and recommendations.
* High-performing teams delivering secure, scalable, and resilient Kubernetes platform services.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

title: Regional Head of Services (APAC)
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Head of Services, APAC owns the commercial performance and operational build-out of Addepar's services organization across the region. This leader is directly accountable for services revenue, SOW pricing, and margin — not just partnering with sales, but personally owning the number. A central part of this mandate is building and scaling the APAC services function itself: hiring, process design, partner delivery frameworks, and an operating model that doesn't yet fully exist in the region today.
  
  
This leader will translate the global services strategy into local execution, ensuring Addepar's standards for implementation, partner solutions, and client support are met. Implementation depth matters — the candidate needs enough technical and data fluency to hold their own in engineering conversations and to understand where recurring feed enhancements and service escalations originate — but it is one input to the role, not the primary qualification.
  
  
As a key leader in a matrixed organization, this role reports directly to the VP, Global Services & Delivery, while maintaining a strategic partnership with regional business leadership. The successful candidate will navigate a collaborative structure where cross-functional alignment is essential, as some regional team members may maintain dual reporting lines to global and regional functional leads.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the commercial performance of the APAC services business, including revenue, margin, SOW pricing, and utilization. This is a direct P&L responsibility, not a support function to Sales.
* Build and scale the APAC services organization, including hiring, process design, partner delivery framework, and operating model — this function is being built from the ground up in the region, not inherited as a mature machine.
* Serve as the primary leader for the APAC services organization, ensuring alignment with the global GTM strategy defined by the VP, Head of Services.
* Oversee service delivery, including implementation, partner solutions, and technical client support for the APAC client base.
* Resolve recurring client escalations and BAU requirements, implementing local operational models that improve client outcomes and reduce time-to-value.
* Build and mentor a regional team, capable of handling complex, data-intensive implementations and ongoing support requirements.
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, and Global Services, ensuring local client needs (feed enhancements, platform adoption) are integrated into the global roadmap.
* Establish and track KPIs for the APAC region spanning commercial performance, service predictability, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

**Who You Are**

* You have directly owned a services P&L. You can speak to a specific revenue target, SOW pricing model, or margin number you were personally accountable for — not one you supported from the sales or delivery side.
* You have built or significantly transformed a services function. You've stood up a services org from early stage, or substantially restructured one — not solely operated a mature, pre-existing machine.
* You've been a Head of Professional Services for a region, ideally APAC, with both services sales and services delivery leadership experience.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in professional services within a high-growth, data-intensive SaaS or fintech environment.
* Proven track record managing distributed teams across distinct APAC sub-regions, with the regional leadership to navigate matrixed, dual-reporting structures.
* Enough implementation and technical fluency to hold your own in conversations about complex, data-intensive onboarding, feed architecture, and platform adoption — without needing to be the team's deepest technical expert.
* Willing and able to personally triage, not exclusively delegate — when a technical or client problem is stuck, you can get into the details enough to unblock it.
* Strong analytical skills with a focus on metrics-driven performance and operational excellence.

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing

* a talent screen,

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.

  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**

* **Comprehensive health insurance:**
  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:**
  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:**
  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

title: Associate Director
description:
**Company:**
AIRIQ 365 LIMITED

**Department:**
Hotel Business – Procurement & Supply

**Open Positions:**
**3 – Delhi NCR – North | Bengaluru – South | Mumbai – West**

**Reporting To:**
Head – Hotel Business

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Travel:**
Regular travel within the assigned region

**Role Overview**

The Regional Lead – Hotel Contracting will develop and manage AIRIQ’s hotel supply network within the assigned region. The role involves identifying suitable hotel partners, negotiating competitive commercial terms and securing inventory through pre-purchase arrangements and direct contracts, with distribution enabled through channel managers.

The position requires strong hotel relationships, commercial judgement and ownership of inventory availability, utilisation and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regional Supply Development**

* Build and execute the hotel contracting plan for the assigned region, covering key business cities, leisure destinations and emerging markets.
* Identify hotels based on agent demand, booking trends, destination potential, seasonality and market competition.
* Develop relationships with hotel owners, promoters, general managers, sales heads and revenue teams.
* Maintain a pipeline of hotel partnerships and expand coverage across independent hotels and hotel chains.

**2. Contracting and Commercial Negotiation**

* Negotiate pre-purchase arrangements, direct contracted rates, room blocks, rolling deposits and other approved inventory models.
* Finalise room categories, meal plans, occupancy terms, extra-person charges, taxes, blackout dates and peak-period supplements.
* Negotiate payment schedules, credit terms, release periods, cancellation policies, refunds and treatment of unutilised deposits.
* Secure competitive rates, priority inventory and favourable commercial terms.
* Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate internal approvals before confirming commitments.
* Ensure negotiated terms are accurately documented and contracts are executed through authorised signatories.

**3. Pre-Purchase and Inventory Management**

* Recommend hotel-wise inventory commitments based on demand forecasts, achievable selling rates and expected returns.
* Prepare acquisition plans for peak, shoulder and low-demand periods.
* Monitor room-night utilisation, unsold inventory, deposit balances and release deadlines.
* Coordinate corrective action through promotions, inventory adjustments and renegotiation of terms.
* Track hotel obligations and escalate inventory denial, rate discrepancies or breaches of agreed terms.

**4. Market Intelligence and Demand Mapping**

* Benchmark hotel rates and commercial terms against competing suppliers and distribution channels.
* Track festivals, weddings, conferences, exhibitions, sporting events and other demand drivers.
* Map major venues and nearby hotels to identify advance contracting opportunities.
* Share regional market intelligence with Revenue, Research, Sales and Leadership.

**5. Onboarding and Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with Distribution and Technology teams for hotel onboarding through channel managers, APIs or the extranet.
* Ensure accurate property information, room descriptions, photographs, rate plans and booking policies are obtained.
* Work with Sales and Revenue teams on pricing, offers and inventory promotion.
* Support Operations in resolving hotel-related booking, availability and service escalations.
* Coordinate with Finance on advances, deposits, payments, reconciliations and recoveries.

**6. Reporting and Team Coordination**

* Maintain updated contracting pipelines, agreement trackers and regional performance reports.
* Review hotel productivity, commercial performance and upcoming inventory requirements.
* Guide regional procurement executives and coordinate with consultants, where applicable.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in hospitality, tourism or business management is preferred.
* Typically
  **10–12 years of relevant experience**
  in hotel contracting, hotel procurement or hotel supply development.
* Strong relationships with hotels and decision-makers in the assigned region.
* Experience with a B2B travel company, OTA, bed bank, tour operator or hotel distribution business.
* Proven ability to negotiate hotel rates, inventory commitments and payment terms.
* Working understanding of pre-purchase risk, margins, inventory utilisation and hotel distribution.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and commercial reporting.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Productive hotels contracted and activated.
* Coverage of priority destinations and high-demand hotels.
* Competitiveness of contracted rates and commercial terms.
* Availability and utilisation of contracted inventory.
* Room nights, revenue and contribution generated from the regional portfolio.
* Utilisation and recovery of advances and deposits.
* Contracting pipeline conversion and onboarding turnaround time.
* Accuracy of contracts, trackers and commercial records.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
company: All India Institute of Occult Science
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR MANAGER

**Company:**
All India Institute of Occult Science

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Salary:**
₹4 LPA – ₹7.2 LPA

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

About the Role

All India Institute of Occult Science is looking for a result-oriented and technically strong HR Manager who can independently manage HR operations, payroll processing, statutory compliance, and employee-related matters. The ideal candidate must possess practical, execution-level knowledge of EPFO/PF compliance, ECR filing, PF challans, TDS, statutory returns, compliance audits, and EPFO notices.

We are looking for a professional who can take complete ownership of HR functions, resolve complex compliance issues, maintain accuracy in payroll, and ensure timely statutory submissions without excessive dependence on external consultants.

Key Responsibilities1. HR Operations & Employee Management

* Manage end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management, employee records, and exit formalities.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, HR policies, and workplace issues.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure proper documentation.
* Coordinate with management on manpower planning, employee performance, and HR requirements.

2. Payroll Management

* Independently manage monthly payroll processing, including attendance validation, LOP calculations, salary revisions, arrears, deductions, and full-and-final settlements.
* Verify payroll inputs and ensure accurate salary calculations and timely salary disbursement.
* Reconcile payroll data with attendance records, employee master data, bank statements, and statutory deductions.
* Investigate and resolve salary discrepancies, incorrect deductions, and employee payroll complaints.
* Maintain payroll registers, salary statements, and supporting documentation.

3. EPFO / PF Compliance – Critical Requirement

* Independently manage monthly EPFO compliance, including PF calculations, ECR preparation, validation, and filing.
* Generate, verify, and reconcile PF challans and ensure timely payment of statutory dues.
* Handle UAN-related issues, employee PF complaints, missing contributions, and ECR errors.
* Reconcile payroll PF deductions with ECR records, challans, and applicable EPFO records.
* Investigate and resolve PF contribution mismatches and rejected ECR submissions.
* Handle EPFO notices, inspections, audits, queries, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with EPFO authorities and prepare appropriate responses and supporting records.
* Maintain accurate PF registers, employee contribution records, challans, returns, and compliance documentation.

4. TDS, Taxation & Other Statutory Compliance

* Manage or coordinate employee salary TDS calculations, declarations, investment proofs, tax projections, and year-end reconciliation.
* Review TDS deductions following salary revisions and changes in employee tax declarations.
* Coordinate timely TDS deposits, applicable returns, and related documentation.
* Ensure applicable ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other statutory obligations are met.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and track filing dates, payments, returns, and acknowledgements.
* Identify compliance gaps, take corrective action, and minimise the risk of penalties or notices.

5. Compliance Audits & Management Reporting

* Prepare payroll and statutory records for internal audits, external audits, and government inspections.
* Maintain organised records of ECR filings, challans, payroll registers, TDS documents, and statutory returns.
* Prepare HR MIS reports covering payroll, employee strength, attendance, compliance status, and pending issues.
* Provide regular compliance updates to management and highlight risks with corrective action plans.
* Ensure that all applicable statutory obligations are completed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll management, and statutory compliance.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience in EPFO/PF, ECR filing, PF challans, reconciliation, and employee PF matters.
* Practical exposure to EPFO notices, audits, inspections, and compliance-related queries.
* Strong working knowledge of salary TDS, payroll taxation, and applicable statutory filings.
* Experience in handling payroll discrepancies, statutory mismatches, and deadline-driven compliance issues.
* Good command of MS Excel, payroll systems, HR MIS, and compliance documentation.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain strict confidentiality.

Mandatory Selection Criteria

**This position requires practical execution, not merely theoretical knowledge.**

**Candidates must be able to explain the actual steps they have personally performed for:**

* Monthly payroll processing and reconciliation.
* ECR preparation, validation, filing, and error resolution.
* PF challan generation, payment, and reconciliation.
* Resolving UAN issues and missing PF contributions.
* Handling EPFO notices, audits, and inspections.
* Salary TDS calculations and applicable statutory filings.

Candidates whose experience is limited to coordinating with consultants, forwarding documents, or having theoretical knowledge of payroll and PF compliance will not be suitable for this role.

Key Performance Expectations

* Accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Timely completion of applicable statutory filings and payments.
* Effective resolution of payroll and PF discrepancies.
* Proper maintenance of statutory records and audit documentation.
* Proactive identification and resolution of compliance risks.
* Independent ownership of HR operations and statutory compliance.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A technically sound HR professional who can independently manage HR operations, payroll, EPFO/PF compliance, TDS coordination, statutory documentation, and audit-related responsibilities while providing reliable support to management.

* **Apply Now:**
  Candidates with strong hands-on payroll and statutory compliance experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Full-time · Some travel

Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. Built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Sitender Sehrawat is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. The work is active across Europe, the US, and the Gulf, and it is scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does. The bridge between Sitender and the world— the person who holds the whole picture, ensures nothing is dropped, and protects the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

You will run the day-to-day across event logistics, the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: capable of managing a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and sensing what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats
* Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up
* Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination
* Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and maintaining a consistent voice and aesthetic
* Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators spanning multiple time zones
* Keep the office of the founder moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and ensuring projects don't stall
* Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

*Essential*

* 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles
* Exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details
* Strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency
* Comfortable owning social media and marketing execution
* Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed
* Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

*Preferred*

* Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure
* Background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation with many moving parts
* A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities
* Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

* You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped
* Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters
* Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things
* A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

* Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location
* A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide
* Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer
* Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role
* Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

We don't pay much attention to where you went to school — or whether you did. A degree is welcome but not necessary. What matters is capability, character, and care. We're looking for the kind of person whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

**Compensation & Onboarding**

This role begins with an 8-week probation period. During these first eight weeks, you'll be paid a mutually agreed figure while we both find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion — based on performance and delivery — you'll step into the role permanently, with a full CTC
upwards
of 6 LPA, commensurate with experience and growing as the work expands across cities.

**To Apply**

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

www.antaha.org

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
The
Radisson Blu Hotel, Faridabad
is a 5-star upscale business hotel located on Mathura Road (Sector 20B), directly across from the Bata Chowk metro station. Opened in 2016, it features 124 modern rooms, extensive event spaces, multiple dining venues, and wellness amenities tailored for business and leisure travelers.

**Job Description**

Job Description – Restaurant Manager

**Department:**
Food & Beverage
  
  
**Location:**
Radisson Blu Faridabad

**Job Purpose:**

Responsible for managing the day-to-day restaurant operations of a five-star hotel, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, consistent service standards, operational efficiency, and achievement of revenue and profitability targets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily restaurant operations, ensuring seamless service delivery in line with five-star hotel standards and brand SOPs.
* Ensure exceptional guest satisfaction through personalized service, effective complaint handling, and prompt service recovery.
* Lead, motivate, and develop the restaurant team through regular briefings, training, and performance monitoring.
* Drive revenue through suggestive selling, upselling, menu knowledge, and effective guest engagement.
* Monitor food and beverage costs, inventory, breakage, wastage, and operating expenses.
* Ensure compliance with hygiene, food safety, grooming, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the kitchen, stewarding, and other departments to ensure smooth operations and consistent food and service quality.
* Monitor guest feedback, operational reports, and performance indicators to drive continuous improvement.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management or a related discipline.
* 4–6 years of experience in Food & Beverage operations, preferably in a reputed five-star hotel, with prior supervisory or restaurant management experience.

**Key Competencies:**
Leadership, guest relationship management, communication, service excellence, commercial awareness, team development, and operational problem-solving.

**Qualifications**

Diploma or degree in Hotel Management or a related discipline.

**Additional Information**

We are seeking a dynamic, guest-focused, and results-oriented Restaurant Manager to lead Food & Beverage operations in a premium five-star hotel environment. The ideal candidate should possess strong operational expertise, exceptional leadership capabilities, and a passion for delivering memorable dining experiences while maintaining the highest standards of service excellence.

The candidate must have proven experience in managing restaurant operations, leading and developing service teams, handling guest feedback, driving revenue through upselling, and maintaining effective cost and inventory controls. A strong understanding of restaurant service standards, food and beverage knowledge, hygiene and safety regulations, and brand SOPs is essential.

The successful candidate should be hands-on, commercially aware, proactive, and capable of maintaining operational excellence during high-volume business periods. Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to teamwork are critical for success in this role.

**Candidates with relevant experience in reputed five-star hotels, a strong guest-centric approach, and a passion for hospitality excellence are encouraged to apply.**

title: Senior Manager - Strategy and Process Governance
description:
**About the Role**

The role is responsible for supporting the Head of Group Sourcing - Clothing in facilitating through leading the implementation of long-term strategic roadmaps across the regional sourcing hubs. They will establish and maintain standardized operational frameworks to ensure consistency and efficiency and managing cross-functional projects designed to modernize our sourcing workflows and digital integration across Asia sourcing offices.

Meanwhile, this is a role will also play an important part in designing and executing sourcing strategies to meet long-term commercial objectives and scale the Own Brand business. A key priority is leading our operating model transformation—optimizing processes, aligning systems, and standardizing 'ways of working'. This role is the key to unlock OB growth potentials across the group.

**What You'll Do**

The scope of the role will include, but not limited to the following main areas:

* **Strategy & Delivery:**
  Lead the end to end design, planning and execution of Sourcing Strategy (including strategic partnership, SRM, Risk Management, Diversification) to deliver category growth, Own Brand ambitions and optimize COGS benefits
* **Operating Model Transformation:**
  Lead the end-to-end mapping of global sourcing operations to identify and drive process optimizations including but not limited to develop and implement standardised procedures, best practices, and guidelines. You will ensure organizational alignment, integrate systems and tools, and manage the end-to-end change process to deliver a highly efficient and effective global sourcing function
* **Strategic Insights**
  : Consolidate and analyze internal and external data to identify emerging trends, commercial risks, and white-space opportunities. Translate these insights into executive-level narratives and actionable recommendations that influence long-term strategy
* **Project Management:**
  Lead the execution of high-priority strategic projects (team level or Group level) from inception to completion. Establish project governance, track milestones, and manage cross-functional dependencies to ensure initiatives are delivered on time
* **AOP Planning:**
  Orchestrate the annual planning cycle for Asia Sourcing team, translating multi year strategies into actionable targets - defining budget requirements, resource allocation and KPIs that ensure the Group’s commercial and operation goals are met
* **Thought Leadership:**
  Act as a subject matter expert on strategic framework designs, global sourcing trends, emerging technologies, and geopolitical shifts. You will proactively identify industry best practices and innovative sourcing models to challenge the status quo, ensuring the Group remains competitive and resilient in a changing global market.
* **Collaboration Facilitation:**
  Build communication and internal collaboration within the Sourcing and Asia teams and between the Australian business commercial teams. Identify opportunities and ensure teams are working towards common goals.
* **Stakeholder Engagement and Management:**
  Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the Group commercial and enablement teams and within sourcing teams to understand their needs and align sourcing strategies and strategic initiatives accordingly

**What You'll Bring**

***Personal Characteristics***

* Influence, adaptability, judgment, collaboration, managerial skills, interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Horizontal Leadership capabilities and the ability to work well in a pressured situation
* Ability to influence, establish and maintain strong relationships with senior management.

***Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities***

* 10+ years of relevant retail / industry experience necessary.
* Proven experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management. Project management experience is an added advantage.
* Strong business acumen analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good understanding of retail operations, industry trends, supply chain and AI Integration.
* Track record of managing and delivering change as well as results
* Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of relevant sourcing tools and buying processes & systems.

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work
* Premium insurance coverage for you and your dependents

**Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group**

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team’s diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential.

We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process.

title: Transformation Leader-Master Black Belt
description:
The Transformation Leader (Insurance) is responsible for driving end-to-end operational transformation across Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier & broker operations. The role focuses on improving efficiency, scalability, service quality, and profitability through process redesign, digitization, operating model changes, and data-driven decision making.

The role would be responsible for the effective delivery of the Transformation Roadmaps and projects for the clients with a distinctive focus on deploying digital technologies like Robotics, Machine Learning, Intelligent automations, Generative AI, etc. by working with cross-functional global teams to favourably impact to the business outcomes of the customer.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Operational Transformation**

• Lead large-scale transformation initiatives across core broker operations, including:

• Policy placement & renewals

• Endorsements & mid-term adjustments

• New business onboarding

• Claims coordination & servicing

• Carrier interactions and compliance

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and cost drivers; redesign processes using Lean / Six Sigma principles.

• Standardize workflows across lines of business, geographies, and acquired broker entities.

**2. Digital & Automation Enablement**

• Drive adoption of digital tools, workflow platforms, and automation (RPA, OCR, straight-through processing).

• Partner with IT, vendors, and Insurtech to modernize broker management systems (BMS), CRM, and document management.

• Enable data integration between carriers, brokers, and internal systems.

**3. Operating Model & Organization Design**

• Define target operating models aligned to growth, M&A, and client segmentation strategies.

• Optimize role clarity, spans of control, and sourcing models (onshore/offshore/shared services).

• Support post-merger integration for acquired brokerages.

**4. Performance & Analytics**

• Establish operational KPIs and dashboards (e.g., turnaround time, hit ratios, cost per policy, error rates).

• Embed performance management routines and continuous improvement culture.

• Use data to drive prioritization of transformation initiatives.

**5. Change & Stakeholder Management**

• Lead change management across frontline teams, leaders, and partners.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

• Communicate vision, progress, and impact clearly and consistently.

**Skillset**

* 12–18+ years of experience in insurance, with deep exposure to P&C broker or carrier operations
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformation or operational excellence programs
* Strong understanding of broker workflows, carrier interactions, and regulatory requirements
* Experience working with senior executives and cross-functional teams
* Experience in setting up process measurement systems with advance visualization tools to implement real time monitoring frameworks and platforms

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Marketplace Manager to own and grow our presence across India's leading online marketplaces — primarily Amazon and Flipkart, and others such as Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, and JioMart as relevant to our categories. You'll be responsible for the full commercial and operational health of these channels: driving sales, protecting margins, keeping listings and inventory in top shape, and turning major sale events into our biggest revenue days of the year.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who knows Seller Central and Seller Hub inside out and can move comfortably between the spreadsheet and the strategy.

Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end management of the brand's storefronts on Amazon, Flipkart, and other marketplaces, including revenue targets and channel P&L.
* Create and optimize product listings — titles, images, bullet points, descriptions, and A+ / enhanced brand content — to maximize search ranking and conversion.
* Manage pricing strategy and win/defend the Buy Box while protecting margins against competitor activity.
* Plan and execute marketplace advertising (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) against clear ACOS / ROAS targets.
* Forecast demand and coordinate inventory and fulfillment across FBA, Flipkart Assured / FBF, and self-ship models to avoid stock-outs and overstock.
* Lead planning and execution for major sale events — Great Indian Festival, Big Billion Days, Prime Day, and brand-day activations.
* Monitor and protect account health: seller ratings, return rates, policy compliance, and listing suppressions.
* Build and manage relationships with platform category / account managers to unlock visibility, deals, and co-marketing opportunities.
* Track, analyze, and report channel performance — sales, traffic, conversion, ad efficiency — and translate the data into actions.
* Stay ahead of marketplace policy changes, new features, and category trends.

Requirements

* 3–6 years managing brands or accounts on Amazon and/or Flipkart (in-house, or at a seller / aggregator / agency).
* Hands-on expertise with Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Strong command of marketplace advertising and the metrics that govern it (ACOS, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate).
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets.
* Solid understanding of marketplace SEO, listing optimization, and Buy Box mechanics.
* Commercial acumen — able to balance growth, margin, and inventory.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to Have

* Experience with tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar.
* Exposure to additional platforms (Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, Ajio, and quick-commerce such as Blinkit / Instamart).
* Experience managing external agencies or a small team.
* Category experience relevant to [our products].

What Success Looks Like

* **First 3 months:**
   listings audited and cleaned up, clear targets set per channel, and a firm handle on account health.
* **First 6–12 months:**
   measurable growth in marketplace revenue and improved ad efficiency, with well-executed festive sale events.
