title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About the Opportunity**

**Role:**
Revenue Management

**Level:**
Assistant/ Deputy Manager

**Reporting To:**
Associate Director - Revenue Management

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**About the Function**

Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.

The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.

This is further complemented by a world-class post-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self-help features or our hand-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.

At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.

**About the role:**

As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting, quick-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high-quality work under pressure.

**What will you be doing**

**P&L and Revenue Management**

* Own and manage the business P&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.

**Growth Strategy Development**

* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short- and long-term growth strategies, influencing key cross-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.

**Customer Engagement & Marketing Collaboration**

* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.

**Collaboration with Product & Operations Stakeholders**

* Partner with product teams to develop first-class, customer-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.

**Qualification & Experience**

* MBA from a reputed institute with 2–5 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business—preferably in the e-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high-growth, data-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.

**Key Success Factors for the Role:**

* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team-oriented, and brings a positive, can-do attitude.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, with hands-on experience in data-driven decision-making.
* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

title: Associate Director – Hotel API Commercials
description:
**Associate Director – Hotel API Commercials**

**Inward Hotel Supply & Outward API Distribution Management**

**Company:**
AIRIQ B2B Online private Limited

**Department:**
Hotel Business

**Reporting To:**
Head – Hotel Business

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
8–10 years in management of hotel API commercials

**Role Overview**

The Associate Director – Hotel API Commercials will lead the commercial strategy and management of AIRIQ’s
**inward hotel API supply and outward hotel API distribution**
.

On the inward side, the role will manage commercial partnerships with hotel aggregators, bed banks, OTAs offering B2B hotel supply, hotel chains and other accommodation suppliers connected through APIs. On the outward side, the role will oversee commercial arrangements for distributing AIRIQ’s hotel inventory to OTAs, bed banks, travel platforms, travel management companies and other hotel API buyers.

The position will be responsible for securing competitive hotel supply, developing profitable distribution partnerships, improving margins and managing commercial and financial exposure.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Inward Hotel API Supply Commercials**

* Identify and evaluate hotel API suppliers based on destination coverage, hotel portfolio, rate competitiveness, inventory availability and commercial viability.
* Negotiate hotel supply agreements covering net rates, discounts, commissions, production-linked incentives and overrides.
* Finalise supplier deposits, credit limits, payment schedules, settlement currencies and refund timelines.
* Evaluate rate conditions covering room categories, occupancy, meal plans, taxes, mandatory supplements, cancellation policies and nationality or residency restrictions.
* Secure competitive domestic and international hotel inventory across relevant destinations and customer segments.
* Compare overlapping supply on equivalent room types, meal plans, cancellation conditions and total payable prices.
* Review supplier production and renegotiate commercial terms based on business delivered and future potential.

**2. Outward Hotel API Distribution Commercials**

* Develop commercial structures for distributing AIRIQ’s hotel inventory to B2B API buyers.
* Establish pricing arrangements for pre-purchased hotels, directly contracted hotels and inventory sourced through hotel APIs.
* Negotiate buyer mark-ups, commissions, incentives, deposits, credit terms, settlement cycles and production commitments.
* Develop partner-specific commercial arrangements based on destination demand, sales potential and expected contribution.
* Define permitted markets, sales channels and onward redistribution rights in line with supplier agreements.
* Support API Sales and Relationship Management teams in acquiring, activating and growing productive accounts.
* Review buyer profitability and renegotiate commercially unsustainable arrangements.

**3. Hotel API Pricing and Profitability**

* Own agreed revenue, room-night, margin and contribution targets for the hotel API portfolio.
* Evaluate profitability after supplier costs, buyer incentives, connectivity and mapping charges, payment costs and foreign exchange costs.
* Establish guidelines for mark-ups, minimum margins, promotional pricing and commercial exceptions.
* Coordinate hotel-level, destination-level and partner-level pricing with Revenue.
* Identify margin leakage arising from incorrect rate configuration, currency conversion, tax treatment or cancellation charges.
* Ensure outward booking, cancellation and refund commitments appropriately reflect inward supplier obligations.
* Prepare commercial business cases for new hotel API partnerships and integrations.

**4. Agreements and Commercial Governance**

* Lead commercial negotiations and coordinate agreement reviews with Finance, Legal and Leadership.
* Ensure agreements clearly define booking confirmation, rate revalidation, amendments, cancellations, no-shows, refunds and settlement obligations.
* Negotiate responsibility for failed or duplicate bookings, incorrect rates, overbooking, denied check-in and guest relocation.
* Define escalation procedures and financial responsibility for hotel service failures.
* Ensure hotel rates are distributed in accordance with agreed market, channel and rate-display restrictions.
* Maintain records of agreements, renewals, deposits, incentives and contractual commitments.
* Ensure commitments remain within approved commercial policies and authority limits.

**5. Supplier and Buyer Performance Management**

* Conduct regular commercial reviews with inward hotel suppliers and outward API buyers.
* Monitor searches, availability, conversion, room nights, cancellations, booking failures and net contribution.
* Review search-to-book ratios and API usage charges with Technology and Sales to assess commercial viability.
* Identify the most competitive suppliers for priority hotels and destinations.
* Review non-producing integrations and coordinate corrective action.
* Resolve commercial disputes affecting bookings, settlements or partner relationships.

**6. Deposits, Credit and Settlements**

* Coordinate supplier deposits, buyer credit limits and payment arrangements with Finance.
* Monitor utilisation of supplier advances and financial exposure across partners.
* Track booking-level reconciliation, cancellation refunds, credit notes, debit notes and disputed charges.
* Support timely recovery of buyer receivables, supplier refunds and commercial claims.
* Review foreign currency settlement terms and associated exposure.
* Recommend corrective action where production, payment behaviour or service performance does not justify the financial commitment.

**7. Cross-functional Leadership**

* Work with Hotel Procurement to distribute pre-purchased and directly contracted inventory through suitable API channels.
* Coordinate with Technology and Distribution on integration priorities, hotel mapping and commercial configuration.
* Work with Operations on booking fulfilment issues involving commercial liability.
* Guide API Sales and Relationship Management teams on pricing, negotiations and account profitability.
* Present hotel API performance, forecasts, partnership opportunities and commercial risks to Leadership.

**Candidate Profile**

**Position Summary**

Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

title: Manager Operations - Traditional Fund Accounting
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Manager Operations - Traditional Fund Accounting.**

**In this role, you will:**

* The traditional Accounting & Valuations team has daily, monthly and weekly Net Asset Value valuations with stringent timelines. The team is responsible for performing capital activity bookings, accruals, amortization, yields leading to final generation and validation of Net Asset Value through diagnostic checks, Financial Mainframe Report and post Net Asset Value activities. The team also performs other Monthly & Reporting activities which includes Fee Reviews. Ex‑Dividend Distribution, Trustee Packs and Queries, Regulatory & Client Reporting. The Accounting & Valuations team is responsible functionally across multiple jurisdictions (where applicable) serviced out of Markets and Securities Services Kolkata.
* The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators and / or Subject Matter Expert to achieve target Key Performance Indicator. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering excellent client service within the standard Net Asset Value model of promoting continuous improvement of Net Asset Value processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies.
* Responsible for identifying and reducing manual processes for enhanced operational control. Undertake relevant measures to extend support and implementation of technology upgradation. Lead and oversee User Acceptance Testing for the business (as and when required) initiatives.
* Lead Projects for both business partners and Markets and Securities Services Kolkata (based on business objectives, targets and requirements). To acquire a comprehensive and broad understanding of the Traditional Net Asset Value processes and to keep abreast of the latest developments in the assigned markets on the rules and regulations by the regulators, stock exchange and etc. that may have implication to the daily Net Asset Value processes.
* This role includes the responsibility to ensure that business data requirements are completed accurately and efficiently, additionally make sure that supporting statistics/reports/returns are presented to business/management within agreed timescales. Drive the plan for standardization of processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim of enhancing cost effectiveness and efficiency.

* To ensure control measures/checkpoints are established to scrutinize exceptions/errors to prevent any operational losses and reviews on these measures are constantly performed. Procedural changes/new initiatives are reviewed, fully communicated to and implemented.
* Review Contingency requirements on a periodic basis and invoke relevant business recovery measures as necessary. Carry out effective Operational Risk Assessment by monitoring and implementing risk mitigating plans. Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
* Ensure Gross Asset Value / Net Asset Value operating procedure is followed with management of risks (if any). Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures. Ensure governance on all daily/weekly tracker updated by team. Update all management MI by the stipulated deadlines. Additional review of Job-Aid Matrix, Standard Operating Procedure, process notes, checklists and other internal process related documents periodically.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or qualifications in the accounting/finance industry. Strong working knowledge on Microsoft Office.
* Overall 5+ Years of experience and 3-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent knowledge of Capital Markets and Financial instruments. Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge in Net Asset Value Calculation process with clear understanding of the End-to-End Fund Accounting Model.
* Ability to monitor and meet operational goals. Should have an eye for detail and a strong analytical mind. Ability to update, manage and analyze Management Information related activities. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements and recognize areas for development.
* Complete understanding of Trade Life Cycle. Understanding of Gross Asset Value - Net Asset Value Activities. Previous experience in performing & reviewing funds in Accounting & Valuations. Knowledge in investment accounting, investment valuations, fund industry. Working knowledge on IMS, Multifonds, ICON, Bloomberg, etc. Knowledge in the use of Bloomberg and/or Reuters.

* Ability to speak and understand English fluently, writes business letters and reports, good conversational / telephone skills. Ability to learn quickly, transfers knowledge appropriately, understand and interpret numeric data. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements.
* Initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads. Evidence of very good prioritizing, planning and organizing skills. Ability to effectively communicate and implement group policies and procedures
* Ability to comprehend and minimize operational risks including wide understanding of audit controls and compliance requirements. Ability to maintain control, direction and motivation of staff in an ever-changing environment. Proven experience in change and problem-solving management.
* Strong Accounting Concepts with a clear understanding of financial statements. Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

title: Reconciliation Manager - Global Trading Firm | GIFT City India
description:
Our client is a global trading firm looking to hire a Reconciliation Manager to lead and build out their reconciliation function in GIFT City.

This is a newly established function within the firm's growing back office, covering daily reconciliation of trades, positions and cash across global markets and asset classes. The role would suit a hands-on operations leader who wants ownership of an end to end process, works comfortably in a flat and fast moving environment, and is interested in shaping how a reconciliation team is run rather than maintaining business as usual.

**Responsibilities for the Reconciliation Manager:**

* Own the daily reconciliation of trades, positions and cash against prime brokers, custodians, clearing members, clearing corporations and fund administrators.
* Lead, mentor and develop a team of reconciliation associates, allocating workload across coverage windows and acting as the escalation point for complex breaks.
* Oversee investigation and timely resolution of breaks, working with internal teams and external counterparties globally to identify root causes.
* Onboard new reconciliations and counterparties as the firm's activity and control environment expands.
* Identify patterns in recurring breaks and feed improvements back into upstream processes.
* Own management reporting on match rates, break aging, root cause trends and team performance metrics.
* Document and formalise procedures to support consistency, scalability and knowledge continuity.
* Partner with technology to evaluate, design and implement automation and process improvements.
* Work closely with the global team, including senior stakeholders based overseas, across APAC and EMEA coverage.

**Requirements for the Reconciliation Manager:**

* At least 15 years of experience in reconciliation, settlements or a related operations function, with direct people management experience.
* Strong working knowledge of trade, position and cash reconciliation and the full trade lifecycle, with exposure to global market conventions.
* Familiarity across multiple asset classes including equities, equity swaps, FX, futures, options and fixed income products.
* Hands on experience reconciling against prime brokers, custodians, clearing members and corporations, and fund administrators.
* Proven ability to build and develop an operations team and deliver against tight deadlines across time zones.
* Comfort working with large and complex data sets and drawing practical conclusions from them.
* Interest in technology and automation, and a willingness to drive improvements personally rather than only through others.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to assess processes, challenge the status quo and think beyond standard operating procedures.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage stakeholders globally.
* A controls oriented mindset with strong documentation and organisational skills.
* Based in or willing to relocate to GIFT City, India.

**Senior Manager (HoD)**
**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala, India
  
  
**Department:**
Research & Development
  
  
**Industry:**
Robotics, Underwater Systems & Deep-Tech Engineering
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Role Type:**
Senior Leadership
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Sr Manager of R&D**
to lead the end-to-end technology and product development function for a deep-tech engineering organization specializing in underwater robotics and integrated hardware-software systems.
  
  
The role will be responsible for translating business and customer requirements into reliable, scalable, and production-ready products. The ideal candidate will bring strong systems-engineering expertise, product development experience, and proven leadership capabilities to build a high-performing R&D organization.
  
  
The position requires a combination of technical judgment, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and cross-functional leadership to drive product innovation and business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* R&D Strategy & Technology Roadmap
* Define and execute a 2–3-year R&D and technology roadmap aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
* Identify emerging technologies, innovation opportunities, and platform development priorities.
* Establish technology-readiness milestones and product development priorities.
* Product Development & Engineering Delivery
* Lead the complete product development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through prototyping, integration, validation, field trials, and production handover.
* Ensure engineering programs meet agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and performance objectives.
* Drive structured program governance, milestone tracking, risk management, and corrective actions.
* Systems Engineering & Technical Excellence
* Oversee multidisciplinary engineering across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded systems, software, controls, sensors, communications, and system integration.
* Establish strong engineering practices covering requirements management, design reviews, configuration control, and verification and validation.
* Drive structured problem-solving, reliability engineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Testing, Validation & Product Reliability
* Establish validation strategies covering laboratory testing, environmental testing, integration, endurance, and field trials.
* Ensure products meet defined reliability, performance, safety, and acceptance criteria before release.
* Monitor field failures and recurring defects and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Production Readiness & Industrialization
* Ensure smooth transition of products from R&D to manufacturing and operations.
* Establish complete handover processes covering engineering drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), specifications, firmware, software versions, test procedures, and acceptance criteria.
* Improve design-for-manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and production readiness.
* Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with business leadership, Sales, Operations, Production, and project teams to evaluate technical feasibility and customer requirements.
* Support technical discussions, solution estimation, field trials, and customer escalations.
* Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, risks are identified early, and dependencies are resolved effectively.
* Team Leadership & Organization Development
* Lead and develop multidisciplinary R&D teams and engineering leaders.
* Establish clear responsibilities, accountability, performance expectations, and succession plans.
* Identify capability gaps and develop hiring and team-strengthening strategies.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, transparency, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Budget, Partnerships & Risk Management
* Own R&D budgeting, resource planning, laboratory infrastructure, prototyping, tools, and external development requirements.
* Evaluate technology vendors, development partners, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Protect intellectual property, technical documentation, source code, and confidential engineering knowledge.
* Manage technical, supply-chain, component obsolescence, compliance, and program risks.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Performance Will Be Measured Against The Following Areas**

* Program Delivery: Milestone adherence, schedule variance, and delivery against committed plans.
* Product Quality & Reliability: Validation pass rates, field failures, defect recurrence, and endurance performance.
* Engineering Excellence: Design-review compliance, documentation quality, requirements traceability, and engineering-change closure.
* Production Readiness: Handover completeness, production rework, and manufacturing-related engineering issues.
* Innovation & Technology Roadmap: Roadmap achievement, technology maturity, platform reuse, and meaningful IP development.
* Customer Responsiveness: Technical issue resolution, trial readiness, and estimation accuracy.
* People Leadership: Retention of key talent, leadership development, succession planning, and team effectiveness.
* Cost & Resource Management: Budget adherence, resource utilization, prototyping costs, and development efficiency.
* Risk Management: Early identification, mitigation, and closure of critical technical and program risks.

**Candidate Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in engineering, technology management, or business is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, R&D, or complex product development.
* At least 5 years in a senior R&D or engineering leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams and complex technology programs.
* Proven experience taking integrated hardware-software products from concept and prototyping through validation, industrialization, and field deployment.
* Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, marine technology, defence, aerospace, industrial electronics, embedded systems, or similar deep-tech environments is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to high-reliability, mission-critical, government, or defence customer requirements is an advantage.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of systems engineering and multidisciplinary product architecture.
* Expertise in new product development (NPD), stage-gate processes, requirements management, and verification and validation.
* Experience in engineering program management, estimation, resource planning, and risk mitigation.
* Familiarity with design reviews, configuration management, engineering change control, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, FMEA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving techniques.
* Understanding of design for manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and production handover.
* Experience in technology evaluation, vendor management, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Awareness of IP protection, product compliance, cybersecurity considerations, and component lifecycle management.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into feasible technical solutions and credible delivery commitments.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking: Develops long-term technology and product strategies aligned with business priorities.
* Execution Excellence: Converts complex objectives into clear milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Technical Judgment: Makes sound engineering decisions across multiple disciplines and evaluates trade-offs effectively.
* People Leadership: Develops future leaders, sets clear standards, and builds a culture of accountability.
* Stakeholder Management: Resolves cross-functional conflicts and aligns engineering, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Communication: Explains complex technical matters clearly to leadership, customers, and engineering teams.
* Decision-Making: Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and adapts when new information becomes available.
* Innovation & Learning: Encourages experimentation while maintaining engineering rigor and product quality.
* Integrity & Transparency: Communicates risks and delays early and maintains credibility around commitments.
* Composure Under Pressure: Provides direction during customer escalations, failed trials, and competing delivery priorities.

**First 180-Day Expectations**

* Assess the existing R&D organization, active programs, technical debt, capability gaps, and delivery risks.
* Establish a consolidated R&D portfolio with clear priorities, ownership, milestones, and escalation mechanisms.
* Strengthen product development processes, design reviews, documentation, configuration control, validation, and production handover.
* Develop an agreed technology roadmap and capacity plan in alignment with senior leadership, Sales, and Operations.
* Review the organization structure, leadership responsibilities, succession priorities, and critical hiring requirements.
* Identify recurring field and production issues and implement measurable corrective actions.
* Establish a predictable weekly and monthly R&D governance and reporting cadence.
* Improve engineering ownership, cross-functional collaboration, delivery predictability, and closure discipline.

**Definition of Success**
Success in this role means building a technically strong and operationally dependable R&D organization with a clear technology roadmap, reliable product releases, disciplined engineering processes, effective production handovers, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
The Head of R&D will be expected to develop engineering leaders, institutionalize technical knowledge, improve product reliability, and position R&D as a scalable driver of innovation and business growth.
  
  
**Role Expectations**
This is a strategic and execution-oriented engineering leadership position. It is not limited to research, individual technical contribution, or project coordination.
  
  
The successful candidate must be comfortable owning business outcomes, making cross-functional decisions, balancing immediate delivery requirements with long-term product maturity, and building an R&D function that can scale with the organization.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Job Summary

Caspian Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive and technically competent **Facility Manager** to oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of our commercial mall property at Willingdon Island, Kochi.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, boots-on-the-ground leader with strong technical knowledge of **MEP systems, particularly STP (Sewage Treatment Plant), mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems**. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the property remains safe, functional, well-maintained, and professionally managed while delivering high standards of facility operations, statutory compliance, and customer service.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Facility Operations & Maintenance**

* Oversee daily operations, maintenance, and upkeep of the mall property and common areas.
* Ensure the smooth functioning of all building infrastructure, utilities, and essential services.
* Conduct regular site inspections to identify maintenance issues, safety risks, and areas requiring improvement.
* Implement preventive and corrective maintenance schedules to minimize equipment breakdowns and operational disruptions.

**2. MEP & Technical Systems Management**

* Monitor and maintain STP operations, including treatment processes, water quality, equipment performance, and statutory compliance.
* Oversee electrical systems, DG sets, transformers, panels, lighting, and power distribution.
* Supervise mechanical systems, pumps, motors, ventilation, HVAC, and other building equipment.
* Ensure proper functioning of plumbing, drainage, water supply, and water management systems.
* Coordinate with technical teams and external vendors for troubleshooting, repairs, and major maintenance activities.
* Maintain equipment logs, service records, maintenance schedules, and technical documentation.

**3. Vendor & Service Team Management**

* Supervise housekeeping, security, technical maintenance, landscaping, and other outsourced service teams.
* Monitor vendor performance, manpower deployment, service quality, and adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Coordinate with contractors and service providers for routine maintenance, repairs, and facility improvement works.
* Ensure effective coordination between internal teams, tenants, vendors, and management.

**4. Safety, Statutory Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety, fire safety, environmental, building, and other statutory requirements.
* Monitor fire-fighting systems, fire alarms, emergency exits, and other life-safety equipment.
* Conduct routine safety inspections and coordinate emergency response drills.
* Ensure proper maintenance of statutory records, inspection reports, licences, and compliance documentation.
* Identify potential operational risks and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures.

**5. Budgeting & Administrative Control**

* Prepare and monitor facility maintenance budgets, utility expenses, and vendor costs.
* Track electricity, water, diesel, and other utility consumption and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Maintain records of maintenance expenses, purchase requirements, service contracts, and asset inventories.
* Submit regular operational reports, breakdown reports, and maintenance updates to management.

**6. Housekeeping & Property Presentation**

* Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation across common areas and service zones.
* Ensure proper waste management and adherence to environmental and hygiene standards.
* Monitor the overall condition of the property and ensure timely resolution of maintenance complaints.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering, or Facilities Management.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in facility management, preferably in malls, commercial buildings, hotels, or large-scale properties.
* Strong practical knowledge of **STP operations, MEP systems, electrical infrastructure, plumbing, pumps, motors, and building maintenance**.
* Experience in managing housekeeping, security, technical maintenance, and outsourced service providers.
* Knowledge of preventive maintenance, safety procedures, statutory compliance, and emergency management.
* Strong vendor coordination, team management, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, maintenance documentation, and reporting.
* Ability to work independently, conduct regular site inspections, and handle operational issues proactively.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* A hands-on professional who can actively supervise site operations rather than rely solely on administrative reporting.
* Experience in managing commercial properties with multiple service teams and critical utility systems.
* Strong focus on safety, asset upkeep, service quality, and cost control.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate effectively with management, vendors, tenants, and on-site personnel.
* Candidates with immediate or short-notice availability will be preferred.

title: Corporate Finance Analyst
description:
Job Summary

Corporate Financial Analyst responsible for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, MIS reporting, variance analysis, and profitability assessment. The role involves financial modelling, working capital analysis, cash flow projections, management reporting, and supporting strategic business decisions through data-driven insights. Strong Excel, analytical, and stakeholder management skills are essential.

Key Responsibilities

· Business Planning & Forecasting: Support Annual Business Planning (ABP), budgeting, periodic forecasting, and financial projections to facilitate business planning and performance monitoring.

· MIS & Financial Performance Reporting: Prepare monthly MIS reports, profit centre-wise and cost centre-wise analyses, and conduct variance and trend analysis to evaluate financial performance against budgets, forecasts, and prior periods.

· Working Capital & Profitability Analysis: Prepare monthly projected cash flow statements and P&L statements to assess working capital requirements, liquidity, cash flow adequacy, and business profitability.

· Financial Modelling & Capital Raising: Develop financial models, business projections, and scenario analyses to support fundraising, debt and equity capital raising, and other strategic financial initiatives.

· Management Reporting & Presentations: Prepare management presentations, business review decks, dashboards, and board-level reports, highlighting key financial insights, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.

· Process Improvement & Ad Hoc Analysis: Manage internal and external reporting tools, drive reporting standardisation and automation, coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, and provide analytical support for ad hoc management requests and strategic initiatives

Candidate Profile

· Dynamic and commercially oriented individual with a strong interest in financial analysis, business performance, and strategic decision-making.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to translate financial data into meaningful business insights.

· High attention to detail and accuracy, combined with the ability to understand the broader business context.

· Proactive, structured, and execution-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within deadlines.

· Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment with regular interaction across business and functional teams.

· Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Experience: 4-7 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial planning, management reporting, corporate finance, or business finance roles.

· Experience in monthly MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial modelling, and projected financial statement preparation.

· Exposure to fundraising, debt or equity capital raising, working capital analysis, financial projections, and management presentations.

Experience in multi-business, manufacturing, or professional services environments is preferred.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Global Data Analytics Expert to own the forecasting, financial modelling and data intelligence behind our product. This person will work closely with the Co-founder and Product and Engineering teams to build growth forecasts, brand-level P&Ls, profitability models and valuation frameworks for e-commerce brands on our platform.

This is not a traditional reporting or BI role. The focus is on understanding how e-commerce businesses grow, modelling their financial and marketing performance, and translating that expertise into repeatable product logic and AI-powered intelligence.

The person will be accountable for the quality, accuracy and commercial reliability of the numbers our product generates, ensuring that every forecast is backed by documented assumptions, validated data and clearly defined confidence levels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Growth Forecasting and Financial Modelling**

* Build and own 12-month growth forecasts and brand-level P&Ls covering revenue, COGS, contribution margins, operating costs and profitability.
* Develop unit economics, breakeven, working capital, pre-funding prediction and valuation models.
* Maintain forecasts as actual performance data comes in, analyse variances and continuously improve model accuracy.
* Translate financial and growth data into actionable recommendations for founders and business leaders.

**2. Brand Intelligence and Benchmarking**

* Build and maintain a benchmark library across e-commerce categories, markets, growth stages and marketing channels.
* Evaluate CAC, AOV, LTV, payback period, contribution margin, retention and channel-level performance.
* Analyse paid, organic and offline channels, distinguishing blended returns from incremental impact.
* Develop reliable forecasting approaches for brands with incomplete, self-reported or limited historical data.

**3. Data Quality and Model Validation**

* Define data schemas, metric definitions, assumptions and validation rules for structured commercial inputs.
* Establish checks that identify inaccurate, inconsistent or implausible numbers before they reach customers.
* Measure forecast accuracy against actual outcomes, investigate errors and recalibrate models.
* Define confidence levels, limitations and human sign-off requirements for commercially sensitive outputs.

**4. Productisation and AI Integration**

* Translate forecasting and financial models into product logic in collaboration with Product and Engineering.
* Define how models, benchmarks and assumptions are encoded into the platform so outputs are repeatable, traceable and explainable.
* Specify AI agent workflows, prompt templates, knowledge sources, evaluation criteria and human-in-the-loop review processes.
* Establish clear boundaries for what AI agents can calculate, recommend or assert, and what requires human verification.
* Design how forecast and performance insights are presented to different user groups across the product ecosystem.

**5. Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement**

* Work closely with the Co-founder, Product, Engineering and delivery teams to ensure the models reflect real commercial requirements.
* Present and defend modelling assumptions, financial outputs and uncertainty to founders and business stakeholders.
* Document modelling standards, metric definitions and delivery requirements.
* Build quantitative literacy across the business so teams can interpret and use forecasts correctly.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 6–8 years of experience in growth, commercial, marketing or product analytics, ideally within DTC/e-commerce, marketplaces or products serving these businesses.
* Experience working across multiple brands, with a strong understanding of differences in category economics, growth stages and marketing performance.
* Proven ownership of forecasting, unit economics, financial modelling or media mix models used to make real commercial decisions.
* Strong understanding of brand-level P&Ls, revenue forecasting, CAC, AOV, COGS, contribution margin, LTV, payback, breakeven and working capital.
* Strong statistical grounding, including the ability to quantify uncertainty, validate assumptions and work with incomplete datasets.
* Hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building and validating analytical models.
* Experience collaborating with Product and Engineering to operationalise models, calculations or metric definitions in production.
* Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into clear commercial recommendations and defend assumptions with senior stakeholders.
* Strong documentation skills and the ability to establish standards that other teams can consistently follow.

title: Lead - Business Analyst (Marketing Analytics)
description:
**Job Description**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly analytical and business-oriented Lead Marketing Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. This role will partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to drive data-informed decisions across the marketing funnel.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in B2B SaaS marketing analytics, demand generation, pipeline measurement, and business planning. You will be responsible for translating complex marketing and sales data into actionable insights that influence investment decisions, improve funnel efficiency, and accelerate revenue growth.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can operate at the intersection of data, strategy, and execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Marketing Performance & Business Analytics**

* Own marketing performance reporting across the full funnel, from lead generation to pipeline, bookings, and revenue.
* Develop and maintain executive dashboards, weekly business reviews, and monthly performance reports for marketing leadership.
* Analyze performance across regions, segments, customer personas, business units, and marketing channels.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate them into clear business recommendations.
* Partner with leadership to define and track key marketing KPIs and business outcomes.

**2. Demand Generation & Funnel Analytics**

* **A**
  nalyze the performance of inbound, outbound, field marketing, partner marketing, paid media, organic, and lifecycle marketing programs.
* Monitor funnel conversion metrics including Lead → MQL/MQC → SAL/SAO → Opportunity → Closed Won.
* Identify bottlenecks in the marketing and sales funnel and recommend actions to improve conversion and velocity.
* Evaluate lead quality, pipeline contribution, customer acquisition costs, and marketing-sourced bookings.
* Build attribution and cohort analyses to understand the effectiveness of marketing investments.

**3. Marketing Planning & Forecasting**

* Support annual operating plan (AOP), quarterly planning, and bottoms-up marketing budget planning.
* Build pipeline and bookings forecasts based on historical performance, funnel conversion, ASP/ARPA, and marketing investment.
* Partner with Finance and Marketing leadership to evaluate budget allocation and investment scenarios.
* Develop ROI and efficiency models to assess the impact of incremental marketing investments.
* Track actuals versus plan and provide recommendations to close performance gaps
  **.**

* Work with data engineering, business systems, and operations teams to ensure accuracy and consistency across marketing and sales data.
* Own metric definitions, reporting logic, and documentation for key marketing KPIs.
* Reconcile data across platforms such as Salesforce, marketing automation systems, and BI dashboards.
* Identify data quality issues and drive resolution with relevant stakeholders.
* Improve reporting automation, scalability, and efficiency through SQL, BI tools, and analytics solutions.

**5. Strategic Business Partnership**

* Act as a trusted analytics partner to Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, and Sales leadership.
* Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.
* Support strategic initiatives such as GTM segmentation, ICP analysis, ABM, product-led growth, and marketing channel optimization.
* Develop analytical frameworks to support business decisions and measure the impact of new initiatives.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and revenue contribution
  **.**

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, revenue operations, or a related analytical function.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or a high-growth technology company.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing funnels, demand generation, pipeline generation, and revenue metrics.
* Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets and experience building complex analytical models.
* Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Salesforce CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Marketo
* Familiarity with marketing attribution, lead scoring, account-based marketing, and customer lifecycle analytics.
* Experience with Python or other analytical programming languages.
* Exposure to financial planning, marketing budget management, and ROI analysis.
* Experience supporting global GTM teams across regions and customer segments.
* **Strong understanding of data governance, metric dictionaries, and reporting standardization.**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Marketing leadership has a clear and trusted view of funnel performance, pipeline, and bookings.
* Marketing investments are supported by robust data, forecasting, and ROI analysis.
* Reporting is accurate, automated, and scalable.
* Funnel inefficiencies and growth opportunities are identified proactively.
* Analytics becomes a strategic partner in marketing and business planning.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
  
  
The team prepares and reports P&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, TRS, ETFs and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P&L to Front Office & Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P&L or other issues on an ad-hoc basis
* Front-to-Back analysis & reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month-end controls ensuring management vs financial P&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development & continuous improvement of existing processes & workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk

**Education\***
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Excel Power Query or Alteryx would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly

**Experience Range\***
2-5 years of experience in Global Markets
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Prior BFC experience for >2 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated and self-starter. Reactive and/or passive individuals need not apply

**Desired Skills**

* Alteryx / Python / Tableau knowledge would be an added advantage
* Must be proactive and be a highly-motivated self-starter
* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions
* Analytical skills
* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

1:30 PM to 10:30 PM

title: Manager - Strategy

As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
The Controllership R2R Ops Manager for BMS will be a highly collaborative Finance team member. This exceptional individual will support execution of R2R accounting activities in BMS’s Hyderabad CoE, and demonstrate the following attributes
  
  

* Exceptional expertise in record-to-report accounting processes
* Deep understanding of the business landscape, market trends, and industry dynamics
* Open communication and cooperation to ensure R2R activities are executed seamlessly

Successful candidates will possess excellent leadership skills, inspiring and motivating team members to deliver exceptional results.
  
  
A minimum of 6-8 years of experience is required for qualified and 8+ Years of experience for non CA/CMA.
  
  
The position will be based in the BMS’s Hyderabad Location (Expected 50% in-person).
