title: Analyst, Data Acquisition (R-20068)
description:
**Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet**

  

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at 
dnb.com/careers
.

The Data Acquisition (Trade) function is to drive the growth of program participation and credit data from new and established providers. As an Analyst, you will play a vital role in supporting our data-driven decision-making processes. Your primary responsibilities will include collecting, cleaning, and analyzing data from various sources. You will perform data analysis to evaluate data for quality and eligibility, create basic visualizations to present findings, and prepare reports to communicate insights to team members and stakeholders. Additionally, you will collaborate with different departments to understand their data needs and assist in maintaining and optimizing datasets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
* Present program information to new and/or existing clients or providers and developing accounts remotely via telephone or other electronic means
  
* Collect, evaluate, and set up datasets from multiple channels and sources
  
* Review and validate data to ensure it meets high standards of quality, accuracy, and reliability
  
* Engage in various administrative tasks, documentation, implementation, monitoring, and reporting
  
* Support continuous improvements in data collection and delivery processes
  
* Contribute to the creation of tools for monitoring and reporting
  
* Proactively analyze and troubleshoot data-related issues, assess their criticality, escalate for timely resolution, and participate in problem-solving
  
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support retention
  
* Provide analysis and drive modern solutions and efficiencies in our processes.
  

**Key Skills:**

  
* Master’s degree in business administration, MBA, Mathematics, CA & ACCA, MSC in Finance
  
* Experience in related fields preferred. Familiarity and comfort working in a production-based environment
  
* Experience in data visualization, analysis, statistics and/or data manipulation is a plus
  
* Strong technical aptitude with proficiency in Microsoft Office suite
  
* Passionate and curious about data, with the ability to query and analyze datasets to drive fact-based decisions
  
* Results-oriented and capable of working independently while managing multiple priorities
  
* Ability to operate with a sense of urgency and meet critical deadlines
  
* Strong organization, decision-making, and analytical skills
  
* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
  
* Show an ownership mindset in everything you do; be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action, 
    
  be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success
  
* Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, 
    
  experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses 
    
  and programs
  
* Where applicable, fluency in English and languages relevant to the working market.

  

All Dun & Bradstreet job postings can be found at https://jobs.lever.co/dnb. Official communication from Dun & Bradstreet will come from an email address ending in @dnb.com.

description:

SAP Treasury & Risk Management (TRM) Consultant

**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Treasury & Risk Management (TRM) Consultant with strong expertise in treasury operations, financial instruments, cash and liquidity management, and financial risk management. The candidate will be responsible for configuring, implementing, and supporting SAP TRM solutions aligned with business and financial requirements.

* Implement, configure, and support SAP Treasury & Risk Management solutions.
* Gather requirements from treasury, finance, and risk management teams.
* Configure and support treasury transactions involving money market instruments, foreign exchange, securities, and derivatives, as applicable.
* Work on transaction management, valuation, settlement, and accounting processes.
* Configure integration between SAP TRM and SAP FI/General Ledger.
* Support financial risk analysis, exposure management, and treasury reporting.
* Work on cash flow processing, position management, and financial instrument lifecycle activities.
* Troubleshoot configuration, transaction processing, valuation, and accounting issues.
* Conduct functional testing, UAT, deployment, and production support.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, and process documentation.

**Required Skills**

* 8+ years of relevant SAP experience with strong hands-on SAP TRM expertise.
* Strong understanding of treasury operations and financial instruments.
* Experience with transaction management, valuation, settlement, and accounting.
* Knowledge of SAP FI integration and financial accounting processes.
* Understanding of foreign exchange, interest rate risk, liquidity, and treasury controls.
* Experience in requirements gathering, configuration, testing, and issue resolution.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in SAP S/4HANA Treasury.
* Knowledge of SAP Cash Management and liquidity forecasting.
* Experience in treasury transformation and end-to-end implementation projects.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

Our Company

Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Accountant
description:
Location: Hyderabad, on-site

Experience: 2–3 years

Employment Type: Full-time

About Lighthaus

Lighthaus is an AI-powered accounting services firm helping modern businesses, especially D2C and digital-first companies, manage their finances better.

We combine AI with human expertise to deliver accurate, timely and always-up-to-date accounting — from bookkeeping and reconciliations to GST, TDS and financial reporting.

We’re looking for an Accountant who can work hands-on across multiple client companies and help us build a new kind of accounting experience.

The Role

As an Accountant at Lighthaus, you will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting activities for multiple companies.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll work closely with client data, accounting systems and our internal team to ensure books are accurate, reconciled and up to date.

What You’ll Do

* Handle day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting for multiple companies
* Pass and verify journal entries and maintain accurate books of accounts
* Perform bank, payment gateway, marketplace and other account reconciliations
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable
* Work on Tally and Zoho Books for accounting and bookkeeping
* Review invoices, expenses, settlements and transaction data
* Assist with GST, TDS and other accounting/compliance-related activities
* Identify discrepancies and resolve accounting mismatches
* Coordinate with clients and internal team members to collect missing information
* Maintain proper documentation and accounting records
* Work with D2C/e-commerce transaction data such as marketplace settlements, returns, fees and inventory-related transactions
* Support month-end closing and preparation of financial reports
* Work across multiple businesses and accounting environments

What We’re Looking For

* 2–3 years of relevant accounting experience
* Strong practical knowledge of Tally
* Experience with Zoho Books / Zoho
* Good understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, journal entries and financial statements
* Experience handling accounts for multiple companies/clients is preferred
* Experience working with D2C, e-commerce or consumer brands is a strong advantage
* Comfortable working with large volumes of transaction data
* Good attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership
* Good communication skills — both written and verbal
* Comfortable interacting directly with clients when required
* Willingness to travel to client locations when required
* Comfortable learning new technology, software and AI-enabled accounting workflows

Why Join Lighthaus?

You won’t be joining a traditional accounting firm.

At Lighthaus, you’ll work at the intersection of accounting, technology and AI, while getting exposure to multiple fast-growing businesses and modern finance operations.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

* Work with growing D2C and digital-first companies
* Learn how AI is changing the accounting function

**MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS**

• Chartered Accountant (CA), preferably cleared in the 1st or 2nd attempt, with 4–6 years of post-qualification experience.

• Strong hands-on experience in MIS reporting, financial analysis, dashboards and company performance monitoring.

• Exposure to statutory audit and/or internal audit, with an understanding of financial controls, governance and risk management.

• Big 4 experience preferred, particularly candidates combining strong MIS expertise with statutory audit exposure. Prior PE/VC or portfolio company experience is an added advantage.

**ABOUT THE CLIENT**

A leading India-focused private equity investment platform with a strong track record of partnering with high-growth businesses across diverse sectors. The firm focuses on long-term value creation through strategic investments and active portfolio management.

**JOB ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**MIS & Portfolio Performance Monitoring:**

• Review monthly and quarterly MIS reporting packs across portfolio companies, monitor the firm's MIS tool and prepare dashboards for internal reviews.

• Standardise reporting frameworks, dashboards and reporting cadence across portfolio companies, leveraging technology and automation.

• Analyse financial and operational performance, including revenue, margins, working capital and sector-specific metrics, to identify trends, performance gaps and emerging risks.

• Evaluate P&L, Balance Sheet and cash flows to provide actionable insights on business performance and financial health.

**Governance, Audit & Risk Management:**

• Conduct special assignments and support fraud or whistleblower investigations, where required.

• Advise portfolio company management on governance, reporting quality and best practices, facilitating knowledge-sharing across the portfolio.

**Due Diligence:**

• Support the Deals Team in financial and operational due diligence for new investment opportunities and add-on acquisitions, identifying key findings and red flags for internal review.

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

• Chartered Accountant with 4–6 years of relevant post-qualification experience.

• Strong MIS and financial reporting experience is essential; statutory audit and/or internal audit exposure is highly desirable.

• Prior exposure to private equity, investments or portfolio company monitoring is an added advantage.

**Role Description**
The Chartered Accountant at SMARTANK will be responsible for managing end-to-end financial accounting, including preparation and finalization of financial statements, general ledger oversight, and accurate bookkeeping in compliance with applicable standards and regulations. The role involves budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial analysis to support business strategy and performance improvement for both SMARTANK and its clients. The Chartered Accountant will handle direct and indirect tax planning and compliance, audits, statutory filings, and coordination with external auditors and regulatory bodies. * Candidates should possess strong core accounting and financial reporting skills, including experience with preparation of financial statements, general ledger management, and adherence to accounting standards (Ind AS/IFRS).

title: APAC Portfolio (Sr.) Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an independent, commercially minded professional to join our Portfolio team and own the identification, evaluation, and advancement of novel pharmaceutical opportunities for our APAC markets, taking each opportunity from first signal to a clear recommendation and driving the agreed next steps.

The role will focus on innovative and differentiated assets, including NCEs, 505(b)(2) products, and other value-added pharmaceutical opportunities, assessing their strategic fit, value, and timing across our key APAC markets to decide where our time and resources are best invested.

The individual will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Business Development, Finance, and other internal teams, integrating their input into a single Portfolio view of each opportunity and a clear recommendation the business can act on.

**Scope and Decision Rights**

The Head of Portfolio APAC sets strategy, priorities, and major portfolio decisions. Within that framework, this role independently drives its own analyses, opportunities, and projects, makes recommendations, and executes the agreed actions. It is expected to move work forward without step-by-step approval and to judge when to involve others:

* **Decides directly:**
  how to scope and structure an evaluation, which data and internal experts to draw on, when a first answer is sufficient, and which opportunities to screen out against agreed criteria.
* **Aligns with the Head of Portfolio APAC:**
  recommendations to advance, pause, or stop an opportunity, changes to priorities, and positions to take with potential partners.
* **Escalates:**
  matters with material financial, legal, IP, or reputational impact, and cross-functional disagreements that cannot be resolved at working level.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own an up-to-date view of the APAC opportunity pipeline across near-, mid-, and long-term horizons, flag gaps and imbalances, and recommend areas for expansion, investment, or rationalization.
* Proactively scan global markets, pipelines, and competitor activity to identify novel product opportunities relevant to APAC, and bring forward those worth pursuing with a clear rationale.
* Lead the evaluation of shortlisted opportunities end-to-end, integrating medical, clinical, IP, regulatory, development, commercial, competitive, and market-access perspectives with timing and economics, and scaling the depth of analysis to what the decision actually requires.
* Build a working understanding of treatment guidelines, clinical practice, patient pathways, unmet needs, and physician preferences in each market, and use it to judge whether an opportunity is genuinely differentiated against current and future standards of care.
* Assess competitive landscape, product differentiation, market potential, pricing, reimbursement, and positioning, distinguishing real, reachable opportunities from theoretical ones.
* Drive product evaluations to a conclusion with Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Medical, and Business Development teams, involving the right people at the right time and reconciling conflicting inputs.
* Build patient-based forecasts, sales potential, and scenario analyses, making key assumptions explicit and identifying which of them drive the decision.
* Identify relevant companies and assets for partnering and licensing opportunities, and recommend, together with Business Development, which to prioritize and how to approach them.
* Plan and follow through on partnering conferences: prioritize target companies, products, and meetings beforehand, and turn outcomes into agreed next steps afterwards.
* Own follow-through on assigned opportunities, keeping evaluation status, partner interactions, and follow-up actions current, and making sure agreed actions are delivered.
* Present assigned areas in periodic portfolio reviews with management in decision-ready form, highlighting key risks, gaps, growth opportunities, the recommended course of action, and the decisions required.

**Ways of Working**

We are looking for someone who, given an objective and the context, works out how to get there: think, decide, act, and follow through. In practice, this means:

* **Own the outcome, not just the task.**
  Start from what needs to be achieved, structure the problem, find and analyze the information needed, reach a conclusion, and follow through until the agreed actions are delivered.
* **Useful answers, fast.**
  Produce a solid first answer quickly, be explicit about what is fact and what is assumption, identify what is missing, and go deeper only where it would change the decision.
* **Always a recommendation.**
  Analysis ends with a position, not a list of findings: “Based on this, I recommend X because Y, and the next step is Z.”
* **Proactive.**
  Spot risks and opportunities before being asked (in an asset, market, patent situation, launch opportunity, competitive development, or portfolio assumption), raise them early, and propose how to address them.
* **Independent, not isolated.**
  Move work forward without needing approval for each step, and know when to bring in Portfolio, BD, Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Medical, Finance, or other functions.
* **Constructive challenge.**
  Question assumptions, analyses, and proposed approaches when there is good reason to, explain why, and bring a better alternative.
* **Clear and concise.**
  Communicate across functions and geographies in a structured, commercially relevant way: what is happening, why it matters, what you think, and what we should do.

**Preferred Profile**

* Degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field; MBA or equivalent business training is an advantage.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in New Product Planning, Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Commercial Strategy, Medical Affairs, or pharmaceutical consulting, including a track record of taking evaluations or projects through to a decision or outcome.
* Strong ability to interpret clinical data and translate it into commercial implications and portfolio recommendations.
* Strong analytical and forecasting skills, combined with the judgment to separate what matters from what does not and to know when an answer is good enough to act on.
* Intellectual curiosity about pharmaceutical innovation and emerging assets, with the commercial sense to tell an interesting asset from a real opportunity for the company.
* Working understanding of how IP, regulatory pathways (including 505(b)(2)), development, and market access shape the value and timing of an asset; deep expertise in every area is not required.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and willing to take a position, defend it with evidence, and revise it when the evidence changes.
* Clear, concise communicator, effective with colleagues and partners across functions, cultures, and geographies.

While applying, please mention the APAC countries you have handled and one novel asset you have evaluated.

The role has a strong focus on tax reporting and compliance for listed companies. The incumbent will be expected to manage current and deferred tax computations, effective tax rate analysis, advance-tax workings, tax reporting packages and financial-statement tax disclosures in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards and International Financial Reporting Standards.

**You’ll Make a Difference By**

* Prepare tax disclosures for financial statements, including current tax, deferred tax, tax rate reconciliations, deferred tax asset and liability schedules, and related note disclosures.

* Evaluate tax risks associated with business transactions and advise stakeholders on appropriate tax positions.

* Liaise with external consultants, counsels, and tax authorities in relation to assessments, appeals, refund claims, rectification applications, and demand management.
* Monitor outstanding tax demands, refund status, and litigation trackers and drive timely resolution.

* Support tax compliance requirements relating to permanent establishments, and foreign tax positions.
* Partner with finance, treasury, legal, procurement, and business functions on tax considerations relating to contracts, business initiatives, restructuring exercises, financing arrangements, M&A transactions, and strategic projects.
* Drive automation and digitalization initiatives within the tax function to enhance efficiency, standardization, and reporting accuracy.
* Develop and implement robust internal controls around tax reporting, tax accounting, and compliance processes.
* Promote continuous process improvement and best practices across the tax function.
* Continuously monitor developments in domestic and international tax laws, accounting standards, and judicial precedents.
* Conduct training sessions and awareness trainings for finance and business stakeholders on key direct tax and tax reporting developments

**Your Success Is Grounded In**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant. Equivalent international qualifications, such as Certified Public Accountant, may also be considered.
* Additional qualifications such as LL.B., MBA in Finance, Diploma in International Taxation or other relevant tax certifications would be an advantage.
* Relevant post-qualification experience in corporate direct taxation, tax accounting, tax reporting, litigation and international taxation with 4+yrs of experience.
* Mandatory hands-on experience in managing tax provisions and related tax compliance and reporting requirements for a listed company.
* Prior experience with a listed company, multinational corporate group, Big Four consulting firm is desirable.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong technical knowledge of corporate tax and tax accounting.
* Demonstrated ownership of quarterly and annual tax reporting cycles.
* High degree of accuracy, attention to detail and financial discipline
* Ability to operate effectively within demanding quarterly-close timelines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* Strong documentation, review and control orientation.
* Ability to communicate complex tax matters in a concise and business-friendly manner.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across functions, entities and geographies.
* Digital mindset and willingness to drive automation and process transformation.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in
**Mumbai**
. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

title: Senior Wholesale Credit Risk Researcher, SVP (Hybrid)
description:
Citi is seeking a Senior Wholesale Credit Risk Researcher to lead high-impact credit risk analysis and research across the wholesale banking portfolio, informing decisions that directly influence how the firm identifies, measures, and manages credit exposure. This is a senior individual contributor role where your research shapes risk frameworks, informs senior leadership, and contributes to the governance structures that underpin Citi's wholesale lending activities. If you bring deep expertise in wholesale credit risk and a track record of translating complex analysis into clear, actionable insight, this role offers the scope and visibility to make a genuine difference.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-depth credit risk research across the wholesale banking portfolio, producing assessments that enable senior leadership to make well-informed risk decisions.
* Develop and enhance risk measurement methodologies to ensure Citi's approach to wholesale credit risk remains rigorous, current, and aligned with evolving market conditions.
* Analyze credit portfolios to identify emerging risk concentrations, trends, and vulnerabilities, translating findings into clear recommendations for risk mitigation.
* Monitor credit risk trends across wholesale counterparties and sectors, ensuring the firm maintains an accurate and up-to-date view of its credit exposures.
* Produce high-quality risk assessment reports and research outputs that communicate complex findings in a clear, structured format for senior stakeholders.
* Engage directly with senior business and risk leaders to present research conclusions, discuss implications, and inform strategic risk decisions.
* Contribute to the development and ongoing refinement of credit risk governance frameworks, ensuring research outputs are embedded into risk oversight processes.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Deep expertise in wholesale credit risk research, analysis, or a closely related discipline gained within a financial services environment.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and enhance credit risk measurement methodologies, with a solid grounding in quantitative and qualitative analytical techniques.
* Strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret complex credit data, identify material risk themes, and draw well-reasoned conclusions.
* Clear and confident communicator, able to present nuanced credit risk findings in writing and in person to senior and executive-level audiences.
* Familiarity with wholesale credit risk governance frameworks and the regulatory environment governing credit risk management in banking.
* Ability to manage multiple research workstreams simultaneously, delivering high-quality outputs within defined timelines without compromising rigour

**What We Offer**
At Citi, senior researchers in wholesale credit risk work at the heart of one of the world's most significant financial institutions, with direct access to complex, high-stakes subject matter and the leadership teams who act on it. This is an environment that rewards analytical rigour, rewards ownership, and offers genuine scope to shape how credit risk is understood and managed at scale.
  
  

* A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing structure alongside meaningful flexibility.
* Direct exposure to senior risk and business leadership, with your research informing decisions at the highest levels of the firm.
* The opportunity to influence credit risk governance frameworks that have real consequences for Citi's wholesale portfolio and strategic direction.
* Access to Citi's global network of risk professionals, supporting ongoing learning and long-term career development in wholesale credit.
* A performance-driven environment that recognizes intellectual contribution, accountability, and delivery of high-quality analytical work.
* Comprehensive wellbeing support and a genuine commitment to work-life balance at all levels of the organization.

title: Vice President – Private Credit Fund Accounting, PFS
description:
**About This Role**
HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.
  
  
HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM the “Transaction”. Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).
  
  
The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Fund Accounting team’s primary responsibility is the books and records of the HPS funds. This responsibility includes oversight, review and reconciliation of the books and records with internal teams including Middle Office, Cash Management, and Asset Management / Valuation as well as with external, third-party fund administrators. This responsibility includes NAV calculation and review, management and performance fees, expense review and management and capital calls and distributions. In addition to the core books and records, Fund Accounting works closely with Legal on fund setup and operation, with Product Specialist and Investor Relations on ongoing and ad hoc analysis and with Management Company Accounting on AUM, performance and fee reporting and revenue recognition.
  
  
**Position Description**
PFS is currently hiring for a Vice President level candidate to join the BlackRock Fund Accounting team based in Mumbai, India. The Fund Accounting Vice President performs an integral role within the Fund Accounting team, managing a group of Fund Accounting Analysts and Associates with collective responsibility for review and reconciliation of the funds’ books and records. The Fund Accounting Vice President reports to an Executive Director. The Fund Accounting Vice President will be involved in the closing of the books including NAV review and reconciliation, fee calculations and partners’ capital statement review among other responsibilities. Additionally, the Fund Accounting Vice President will be involved in fund setup and operation and ad hoc internal and investor requests.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
  
  

* Monthly and quarterly closing of the funds’ books with fund administrators
* Management fee and incentive fee waterfall calculation and review
* Review of partners’ capital statements
* Review of capital call and distribution calculations and notices
* Review of fund expenses for accuracy and review of accruals and payments
* Review of monthly investor return and NAV estimates
* Preparation and review of quarterly and annual GAAP financial statements
* Review and support monthly and quarterly corporate reporting requirements
* Oversee and review quarterly and annual compliance-related requests, eg, Form ADV, Form PF requests, etc.
* Ad hoc reporting and projects
* Interact regularly with internal clients, stakeholders, external administrators and auditors.
* Management and oversight of day to day Fund Accounting function and Analyst and Associate team members.

**Candidate Profile**

* 8-15 years of relevant experience in an Accounting role
* Financial Services experience required, Asset Management or Alternative Investment industry preferred, Private Credit experience highly preferred
* Accounting degree preferred
* CPA preferred

**Location**

* Mumbai, India

**Employment Type**

* Full-time, Exempt

**Hybrid Work Schedule**

* 4/1 split (M-Th from office, F work from home)

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

* Prepare audit schedules and support quarterly reviews and annual audits.
* Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, SOX, internal controls, and company accounting policies.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant
description:
Senior Revenue Accountant Finance

AppZen is an AI-first automation platform for finance teams, covering the full spend-to-pay lifecycle — from invoice processing and expense auditing to accounts payable and corporate card review. Our AI platform integrates with customers' existing systems to reduce manual effort, errors, fraud, and compliance risk, giving finance and accounting teams the tools to operate more strategically and scale without adding headcount.

Role Summary

As a member of the Finance team, the Senior Revenue Accountant will own operational revenue accounting and compliance at AppZen.This role reviews, analyzes, and approves customer contracts and revenue arrangements under ASC 606, drives the month-end revenue close, and partners closely with AR & Collections, Deal Desk, GTM, and FP&A to ensure revenue, deferred revenue, and receivable balances are accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, motivated, and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This is initially an individual contributor role, with the expectation that it will grow into a managerial position as the Revenue Accounting function scales.

Responsibilities

• Manage daily revenue accounting operations — review, analyze, and approve customer contracts using the ASC 606 framework and company policy for revenue recognition.

• Review and approve revenue arrangements for allocations, concessions, and similar items to ensure accurate revenue recognition in compliance with ASC 606.

• Perform the month-end revenue close process, including revenue-related account reconciliations and journal entries for revenue, deferred revenue, and unbilled receivables.

• Perform quarterly CECL aging analysis to ensure consistent application of ASC 326, and partner with the AR & Collections Lead to develop and report key AR metrics for management reporting.

• Work closely with the AR team to resolve complex AR and collections issues.

• Perform regular month-end close flux analysis, identifying and explaining significant variances in revenue and accounts receivable balances to support financial integrity and management decision-making.

• Perform and maintain the annual SSP (standalone selling price) analysis, including management of the item master and fair value records.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with GTM, Deal Desk, and AR teams to resolve issues.

• Support revenue accounting system initiatives, including implementation, testing, and optimization.

• Prepare audit schedules and assist with coordination of the year-end audit with external auditors. • Maintain the highest documentation standards.

• Partner with FP&A to provide inputs for revenue forecasts as needed.

• Prepare detailed revenue packages for management and the audit committee/Board as requested.

• Participate in special projects as they arise.

What You Need

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Strong understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.

• 7+ years of experience in revenue accounting, and full-cycle accounts receivable, ideally for SaaS companies.

• Knowledge of US GAAP revenue accounting, specifically revenue from customer contracts (ASC 606), is required.

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage effectively through ambiguity and complexity.

• Consistently meets deadlines, prioritizes appropriately, and remains flexible.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace applications.

• Highly motivated, energetic self-starter and strategic thinker.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build relationships within and outside the Finance team.

• Experience with NetSuite ERP, NetSuite ARM, and Salesforce is required.

Things That Make a Difference

● Familiarity with US sales tax regulations and requirements.

● Proven expertise managing full-cycle accounts receivable processes.

● Knowledge of Order Processing.

● Hands-on experience navigating customer procurement portals, including Coupa and Ariba.

Corporate Finance / Strategy / Investments
  
Role Overview

The role will involve working closely with senior leadership on investment opportunities, strategic transactions, financial analysis and investor-related deliverables.

* Conduct industry, sector and company-level research to identify investment opportunities and assess business fundamentals.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, growth drivers, risks and investment viability.

* Prepare investment teasers, opportunity assessments and preliminary investment evaluation reports.

* Assist in preparing transaction documentation, management presentations and other deal-related materials.
* Track action items, timelines and deliverables to ensure the smooth execution of transaction workstreams.

**4. Investor Relations (IR) and Management Support**

* Conduct market, peer and competitor benchmarking to support investor communication and strategic decision-making.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency and timely collation of financial and business information used in investor-related deliverables.
* Provide analytical and execution support to senior leadership on ad hoc strategic, financial and business initiatives.

**5. Research, Analytics and AI-Enabled Productivity**

* Use AI-powered tools to accelerate research, information synthesis, financial analysis, document review and presentation development.

Educational Qualifications

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. **Job Title: Manager/ Senior Manager – Market Share & Intelligence**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a high-ownership, analytical professional to drive business strategy, market-share growth, competitive intelligence, and strategic initiatives for Angel One’s Assisted Business. The role will focus on tracking market performance, benchmarking competitive positioning, identifying growth opportunities across trading segments, and translating data-driven insights into actionable business interventions.

The individual will work closely with Business, Product, Sales, Technology, Marketing, and Operations teams to drive strategic initiatives, improve business performance, strengthen competitive positioning, and deliver measurable growth outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Market Share & Business Performance Analysis:**
  Track and analyse market share, exchange-level turnover, trading volumes, active clients, segment mix, and other relevant business indicators across equity delivery, intraday, futures & options (F&O), and commodity segments.
* **Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking:**
  Monitor competitor strategies, brokerage and pricing structures, product propositions, trading experience, customer engagement initiatives, and distribution models to assess Angel One’s competitive positioning.
* **Growth Opportunity Identification:**
  Identify market-share gaps, emerging trends, underpenetrated customer and partner segments, and opportunities to improve client activity, turnover, product adoption, and business growth.
* **Business Insights & Strategic Recommendations:**
  Analyse performance trends, anomalies, and underlying drivers of market-share gains or losses. Translate findings into actionable recommendations and business cases for improving segment-level performance.
* **Strategic Initiative Execution:**
  Drive cross-functional growth initiatives from problem identification and opportunity assessment through implementation, tracking, and evaluation of measurable outcomes.
* **Performance Monitoring & Reviews:**
  Establish structured performance-review frameworks, dashboards, and scorecards to monitor business metrics, evaluate the effectiveness of interventions, and recommend course corrections.
* **Competitor and Market Deep Dives:**
  Conduct focused analyses of competitor initiatives, market movements, pricing changes, and product developments, assessing their potential impact on Angel One’s business.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Partner with Product, Sales, Technology, Marketing, and Business Operations teams to translate insights into business actions and ensure effective execution.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Prepare business reviews, leadership presentations, periodic performance updates, and strategic recommendations to support business planning and decision-making

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3–7 years of experience in market share, market research, business strategy, growth analytics, competitive intelligence, business analytics, management consulting, broking research, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of equity markets, derivatives, commodities, the Indian stockbroking ecosystem, and broking business models.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse market and business performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong commercial acumen, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to connect market movements with business outcomes.
* Advanced Excel skills and strong PowerPoint proficiency. Experience with SQL and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau will be an advantage.
* Experience working with large datasets, building dashboards and performance scorecards, and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from analysis to execution.

title: Program Leader - Finance
description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration.
  
  
With over 30,000 employees globally and a robust presence in India, comprising over 17,000 employees across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai, we foster an inclusive culture where every team member feels valued and empowered. Our mission is to transform the healthcare industry by driving efficiency for healthcare systems, hospitals, and physicians.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Lead the India SSC FP&A delivery model for the Physician IDP portfolio, with end-to-end accountability across close, reporting, planning and decision support. The role will operate as a senior finance partner to US-based finance leadership and business stakeholders, translating operational and client drivers into clear financial outcomes while building a scalable, well-controlled FP&A capability in India.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the month-end close rhythm for the Physician IDP portfolio, including pre-close readiness, in-close financial tracking, issue escalation, accrual and adjustment coordination, and final performance review.
* Lead post-close reporting, client-level P&L reviews, variance analysis and executive commentary across revenue, headcount, cost and margin.
* Drive forecasting cycles, annual budgeting and long-range planning, ensuring assumptions are integrated, challenged, documented and aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with US finance and business leaders during contract and solution-development stages to create financial drafts and business cases, including expected headcount based on volumes, productivity assumptions, onshore/offshore mix and client-level margin.
* Provide finance leadership on commercial trade-offs, scenario modeling, pricing economics, capacity choices and margin improvement opportunities.
* Establish governance for physician-client data masters, including client hierarchy, contract attributes, volume drivers, staffing assumptions, cost allocations and ownership of changes.
* Lead ad hoc analysis and decision support on growth, profitability, productivity, workforce, cost actions and client performance.
* Own service delivery governance with clear calendars, review checkpoints, quality standards, issue logs and stakeholder communication.
* Identify and deliver standardization, automation and dashboard opportunities that improve control, cycle time, transparency and analytical capacity.
* Build, coach and manage the India FP&A team; define responsibilities, develop capabilities, provide feedback and create succession depth.
* Act as the senior India point of contact for US leadership, maintaining a predictable operating cadence and proactively escalating risks and decisions.

Core Deliverables
  
  

* Close tracker and issue/risk view
* Monthly client-level performance pack and executive commentary
* Forecast, annual budget and LRP models
* Commercial solution drafts and scenario models
* Headcount, volume, location-mix and margin bridge
* Governed physician-client data master
* Ad hoc decision-support analyses
* Process documentation, controls and improvement roadmap

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Chartered Accountant, CMA or equivalent finance qualification.
* Typically 12+ years of relevant experience, with substantial experience in FP&A and finance business partnering.
* Demonstrated leadership of month-end performance management, forecasting, budgeting and long-range planning in a complex, multi-client or multi-business environment.
* Strong financial modeling, client-level P&L, workforce planning and scenario-analysis capability.
* Experience working with senior US-based stakeholders and within a Global Capability Center or Shared Services model.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capability; working knowledge of planning, ERP and BI/reporting tools.
* US healthcare, physician services or revenue-cycle exposure is preferred.

Leadership and Behavioral Capabilities
  
  

* Enterprise ownership and sound judgment
* Executive communication and influence
* Commercial and client profitability mindset
* Structured problem solving and analytical depth
* Team leadership and capability building
* Control orientation, data discipline and attention to detail
* Ability to lead across time zones and through ambiguity

Success Measures
  
  

* Timely and accurate completion of close, reporting and planning cycles.
* Quality and usability of financial insights provided to US leadership and business stakeholders.
* Forecast reliability, data integrity and strength of client-level profitability visibility.
* Effectiveness of business partnering, issue resolution and decision support.
* Progress in standardization, automation, controls and team capability.

title: Assistant Manager - Franchise Revenue
description:

* Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

title: Senior Leader - M&A, Corporate Development & Investor Relations
description: Designation: Senior Leader – M&A, Corporate Development & Investor RelationsExperience: 10+ yearsFunction: Corporate Strategy, M&A & Investor RelationsRole Overview We are seeking an experienced, commercially astute and hands-on professional to lead and support the organisation’s Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), corporate development and Investor Relations (IR) initiatives. The role will work closely with senior leadership on identifying and evaluating strategic opportunities, structuring transactions, conducting investment analysis, coordinating due diligence and managing relationships with promoters, investors, analysts and other key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of corporate M&A, financial analysis, accounting and transaction execution, complemented by the relationship-building skills required to engage with diverse stakeholders. Familiarity with the business services industry would be an advantage. We are looking for someone who combines the energy and agility to drive transactions with the maturity, credibility and commercial judgement to engage confidently with senior business leaders and investors. The candidate must be willing to travel extensively, where required, and be comfortable operating in a dynamic, multi-stakeholder environment. Key Responsibilities 1. M&A Strategy, Deal Origination & Execution Identify, evaluate and pursue strategic acquisition, merger, investment and business expansion opportunities aligned with the organisation’s growth objectives. Engage with promoters, business owners, investment bankers, advisors and potential partners to explore and develop transaction opportunities. Undertake preliminary screening and detailed evaluation of target companies, assessing strategic fit, business fundamentals, financial performance, growth potential and key risks. Structure transactions and support negotiations on deal terms, valuation, commercial arrangements and transaction frameworks. Drive transaction workstreams from initial opportunity assessment through due diligence, internal approvals and deal closure. Build and maintain a pipeline of potential acquisition targets and strategic investment opportunities. 2. Investment Analysis & Investment Committee (IC) Presentations Prepare initial opportunity assessments and detailed investment analyses for consideration by senior management and the Investment Committee. Develop and review financial models, valuation analyses, business projections, scenario assessments and investment return calculations. Prepare comprehensive IC notes, transaction memoranda, management presentations and investment recommendations. Evaluate the financial and strategic rationale for proposed transactions, including synergies, risks, integration considerations and value-creation opportunities. Present findings and recommendations clearly, objectively and confidently to senior leadership, incorporating feedback into investment decisions. 3. Financial Analysis, Accounting & Due Diligence Demonstrate a strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, P&L analysis, balance sheets and cash flow statements. Assess the financial health, earnings quality, working capital, cash flows, liabilities and underlying business performance of target companies. Actively support and coordinate financial, commercial, tax, legal and operational due diligence with internal teams and external advisors. Identify financial, operational and commercial risks, accounting discrepancies and potential deal-breakers during the diligence process. Challenge assumptions, validate information and translate due diligence findings into actionable inputs for valuation, negotiations and deal structuring. Ensure robust tracking of diligence findings, transaction milestones, dependencies and closure requirements. 4. Investor Relations & Stakeholder Management Support the development and execution of the organisation’s Investor Relations strategy and investor communication initiatives. Build and nurture relationships with investors, analysts, promoters, business owners, financial institutions and other relevant stakeholders. Develop investor presentations, business performance updates, financial narratives and other stakeholder-facing materials in collaboration with senior management. Communicate the organisation’s strategy, business performance, growth plans and investment rationale with clarity and credibility. Support investor meetings, analyst interactions, business discussions and other strategic engagements. Ensure consistency, accuracy and quality of information shared with relevant stakeholders, in coordination with the appropriate internal teams. 5. Business Research & Strategic Advisory Track industry developments, market trends, valuation benchmarks, transaction activity and competitor movements. Develop an understanding of the business services sector, including its operating models, revenue drivers, profitability metrics, customer dynamics and consolidation opportunities. Identify emerging sectors, adjacent business opportunities and potential platforms for inorganic growth. Provide data-backed insights and strategic recommendations to support management decisions on acquisitions, investments and business expansion. 6. Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with senior leadership and multiple internal functions to drive strategic initiatives and transaction execution. Coordinate with finance, legal, operations, business teams and external advisors to ensure timely delivery of transaction requirements. Manage multiple priorities and complex workstreams while maintaining high standards of analysis, confidentiality and execution. Demonstrate ownership, sound judgement, cultural adaptability and the ability to work effectively across different organisational styles and stakeholder groups. Travel as required to meet promoters, investors, target companies, advisors and other business stakeholders. Desired Candidate Profile 10+ years of relevant experience in corporate M&A, corporate development, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity or a closely related function. Demonstrated experience in evaluating and executing M&A transactions, including financial analysis, valuation, deal structuring and due diligence. Strong understanding of accounting, financial statements, P&L analysis, cash flows and business economics. Proven ability to prepare investment assessments and detailed IC notes, and to present recommendations to senior decision-makers. Experience in Investor Relations, investor engagement, analyst interactions or senior stakeholder communication is essential. Exposure to the business services industry, particularly asset-light or people-intensive service businesses, would be advantageous. Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the confidence to engage with promoters, investors, analysts and senior executives. Willingness to travel frequently and participate in face-to-face business and transaction discussions. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and detailed analytical work. High levels of integrity, discretion, cultural sensitivity and professional maturity. Educational Qualifications CA, MBA (Finance), CFA or an equivalent qualification in Finance, Business or a related discipline. Strong transaction experience and demonstrable financial and commercial acumen will be key selection criteria. Key Success Factors Ability to independently drive M&A opportunities from evaluation to execution. Quality and rigour of investment analysis and IC recommendations. Effectiveness in structuring deals and managing due diligence. Strength of relationships with promoters, investors and other external stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with senior leadership and multiple internal functions. Sound judgement, cultural compatibility and a high degree of ownership.

Maintain and update accounts payable and accounts receivable records.

Assist in monthly closing activities and financial reporting.

Identify discrepancies and support their timely resolution.

Maintain proper documentation for internal reviews and audits.

**4. Operations Coordination**

Coordinate with Procurement, Order Processing, Logistics, and other internal teams regarding invoices and financial documentation.

Verify supplier bills and operational expenses before processing.

Maintain accurate records of purchase-related and operational transactions.

Support the finance team in improving accounting workflows and documentation processes.

Ensure timely communication and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

Maintain organized financial records, invoices, vouchers, and supporting documents.

Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Good communication and coordination skills.

High attention to detail, accuracy, and time management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment.

Able to manage multiple accounting tasks and meet deadlines.

Capable of coordinating with multiple internal teams and external vendors.

Proactive in identifying discrepancies and resolving financial issues.

Committed to maintaining confidentiality and accuracy in financial records.

Opportunity to work with a global B2B e-commerce and industrial supplies business.

Collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth.

title: Relationship Manager - Wholesale Banking Group
description:
**Essential Services: Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service.**
The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

ICICI Bank provides comprehensive banking solutions to corporate customers. As a Relationship Manager of Wholesale Banking, you will be responsible for credit appraisal, financial analysis, client servicing, writing of credit notes, end-to-end executive of banking transactions, documentation, and covenant management. In this role, you work under the guidance of a Senior Relationship Manager/ Regional Head. While serving customers, you will be responsible for 360-degree banking and looking for banking opportunities across the customer ecosystem. This will involve offering banking products and services across the customer segments of the Bank. In your responsibility, you also hold the principle of being “Fair to Customer, Fair to Bank. You will be responsible for generating new business leads as well as deepening relationships with existing customers.

**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from across industries!**

We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome, irrespective of your present core responsibilities or the industry associated. Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. Professionals from across industries are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **360° Credit Assessment:**
  Understand in detail the client’s business and financials and prepare a quality appraisal note in collaboration with the Risk Management team.
* **Business Development:**
  Market scoping, segmenting and targeting to acquire new clients as per the risk appetite of the bank and drive ecosystem revenue o The RM for the purpose of business origination, will engage with banks, brokers, corporates, law firms, trade associations, chamber of commerce as well as attend events, participate in seminars, and trade fairs.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work in synergy with different internal teams of the Bank in order to deliver the right solutions to the customer. Collaborative working is key in this role.
* **Portfolio Management:**
  Manage a high-quality portfolio of corporate clients. Work towards generating new business leads as well as deepening relationships with existing customers.
* **Customer Service:**
  Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offer suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

* **Educational Qualification:**
  MBA/chartered accountants/ Graduates. Graduates with 3-6 years of work experience or MBA/CAs with 1-5 years of work experience in the area of relationship management across industries
* **Communication skills:**
  Ability to tailor conversations (both verbal & written) arounds the need of customer with utmost focus on service delivery.
* **Financial Understanding:**
  Understanding of the intricacies of financial analysis, the balance sheet, profit & loss accounts and cash flow statements. Knowledge of basic banking products.

**About the Business group**

The Wholesale Banking Group of ICICI Bank manages a wide range of clients, which includes large private sector business houses and companies, financial institutions and banks, public sector undertakings, and Central and State government entities. The group also has a strong franchise among Multi-National Corporations (MNCs), real estate companies, IT & ITES, and new-age services companies, along with a strong franchise in the financial sponsor's space with a special focus on private equity funds and their investee companies. Additionally, it also caters to the requirements of the capital market and custody participants through unique digital solutions, improving their operational efficiency.

title: CA Articles
description:
**Company Description**
AKG & Associates is a chartered accountancy firm based in New Delhi, offering professional services in accounting, audit, taxation, and advisory. The firm supports a diverse portfolio of clients, including individuals, small businesses, and corporate entities, across various industries. AKG & Associates emphasizes practical learning, professional ethics, and technical excellence, providing article trainees with exposure to real client engagements. The firm encourages continuous professional development and offers a structured environment for candidates pursuing the Chartered Accountancy qualification.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site CA Articles role based in New Delhi. The role involves assisting with statutory and tax audits, including vouching, verification of records, and preparation of working papers under the supervision of seniors. The candidate will support accounting and bookkeeping activities, preparation of financial statements, and reconciliation of ledgers and bank accounts. Day-to-day tasks include working on direct and indirect tax compliance, drafting and filing returns, supporting regulatory and compliance documentation, and maintaining organized files and records. The role also includes coordinating with clients for data collection, attending internal training sessions, and contributing to reports and documentation for various assignments.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Currently pursuing CA With both intermediate groups cleared.
* Knowledge of financial statements, ledger posting, reconciliations, and standard accounting processes.
* Familiarity with taxation concepts (direct and indirect taxes), return filing, and basic regulatory compliance.
* Comfort with MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and willingness to learn accounting and audit software.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured processes and documentation standards.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with team members and clients.
* Demonstrated integrity, reliability, and ability to work under supervision while meeting deadlines.
* Preference for candidates who have completed the required CA intermediate examinations and are available for the full articleship tenure.

As an Accounts Manager - Transaction Banking Group, you will have the opportunity to manage the global trade finance, cash management (including payments and receivables), and banking needs of corporate clients. In addition, the role encompasses servicing client requirements across the financial spectrum. Hence, it is imperative that you analyze the available data to understand the client persona and subsequently offer the right solutions as part of the 360-degree banking framework. Leveraging technological platforms is at the core of providing clients a best-in-class experience. The role involves enhancing the relationship value with existing customers and onboarding new customers through lead generation from customers, vendors, dealers, and curated databases.

Managing Transaction Banking relationships of corporate clients with the aim to increase relationship value with impeccable focus on quality of service.

Scoping the market for opportunities and understanding the competition, industry, and economy.

**Building relationships:**
Sourcing of new corporate relationships linked to existing relationships by offering the right solutions through the customer 360-degree approach.

**Collaboration:**
Ability to collaborate with multiple internal groups to provide efficient and innovative financial products to the mapped clients.

**Customer service:**
Facilitate day-to-day corporate needs and understand the intricacies of the products and services to ensure a seamless banking experience for the clients.

MBA, Chartered Accountants, Engineers & Graduates with relevant work experience in Trade Finance or Lending.

Ability to understand market dynamics, both at micro and macro levels.

Good oral and written communication skills.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with the distribution team for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Interpersonal Skills:**
Build & maintain strong professional relationships with the customers.

**Domain Knowledge:**
Knowledge on finance, forex, and trade.

The Transaction Banking Group at ICICI Bank services corporate clients across the country for their Cash Management and Trade Finance requirements. Clients are serviced by the on-ground team of Account Managers and Customer Service Managers ably supported by the Product Design team.

DMI Finance is looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused
**AVP**
–
**Product**
to be part of our Consumption Loan (CL) product team. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end product ownership, including strategy formulation, partner integrations, risk alignment, regulatory compliance, and performance optimization.

* Deep expertise in Consumer Durable Loans, with strong understanding of end-to-end customer journeys including merchant onboarding, consumption loan product construct, subvention/CIB schemes working, credit underwriting, loan origination, disbursement, EMI servicing, collections, and loan closure processes.

* Hands-on experience working with ecosystem partners including online merchants, OEMs, retailer networks, payment gateways, lending service providers (LSPs), bureaus, and digital KYC providers, with a clear understanding of point-of-sale consumer durable financing, embedded lending journeys, and regulatory compliance requirements.

* Strong familiarity with operational, credit, fraud, and portfolio management nuances across the Indian consumer lending ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for the Consumer Durable Loans portfolio.
* Design and optimize customer acquisition journeys across online, offline, and merchant-assisted channels.
* Lead integrations and operational alignment with merchant partners, OEMs, online E-commerce platforms, payment gateways, credit bureaus, eKYC providers, Account Aggregators, and lending technology platforms.

* Mandatory hands-on experience in Consumer Durable Loans, Point-of-Sale (POS) Financing, Online checkout financing.
* Strong understanding of digital onboarding, bureau integrations, eKYC, underwriting systems, and loan management systems (LMS).

title: Marketplace Manager
description:

You'll be responsible for the full commercial and operational health of these channels: driving sales, protecting margins, keeping listings and inventory in top shape, and turning major sale events into our biggest revenue days of the year.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who knows Seller Central and Seller Hub inside out and can move comfortably between the spreadsheet and the strategy.

* Manage pricing strategy and win/defend the Buy Box while protecting margins against competitor activity.
* Plan and execute marketplace advertising (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) against clear ACOS / ROAS targets.

* Build and manage relationships with platform category / account managers to unlock visibility, deals, and co-marketing opportunities.

Requirements

* 3–6 years managing brands or accounts on Amazon and/or Flipkart (in-house, or at a seller / aggregator / agency).
* Hands-on expertise with Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Strong command of marketplace advertising and the metrics that govern it (ACOS, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate).
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets.
* Solid understanding of marketplace SEO, listing optimization, and Buy Box mechanics.
* Commercial acumen — able to balance growth, margin, and inventory.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to Have

* Experience with tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar.
* Exposure to additional platforms (Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, Ajio, and quick-commerce such as Blinkit / Instamart).
* Experience managing external agencies or a small team.

What Success Looks Like

* **First 3 months:**

* **First 6–12 months:**
   measurable growth in marketplace revenue and improved ad efficiency, with well-executed festive sale events.

Finance Operations Executive

Company: SuperProfile (a product by Cosmofeed)

SuperProfile, a product by Cosmofeed, is a creator-commerce platform that enables content creators to build, grow and monetise their businesses through integrated solutions for audience engagement, lead generation, online courses, coaching and digital products. As the organisation continues to expand, we are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Finance Operations Executive to support financial tracking, transaction reconciliation, reporting and documentation processes.
