The Finance Operations Executive will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial transaction records, reconciling bank statements with internal records, investigating discrepancies and ensuring the completeness and traceability of financial data. The role requires strong numerical and analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and a thorough understanding of financial transactions and reconciliation procedures. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a high degree of accuracy, accountability and independence, while actively contributing to improvements in financial processes and operational efficiency.

3. Key Responsibilities

3.1 Financial Tracking and Transaction Management

● Maintain a centralised and regularly updated record of all incoming and outgoing financial transactions.

● Record, categorise and validate payments, receipts, refunds, transfers and other financial movements.

● Ensure the accuracy, completeness and proper documentation of all transaction entries.

● Maintain transaction-level details, including dates, amounts, payment references, categories and settlement status.

3.2 Bank and Transaction Reconciliation

● Conduct regular reconciliation of bank statements against internal financial records and transaction trackers.

● Identify gaps in existing documentation and reconciliation procedures and recommend corrective measures.

3.5 Process Improvement and Automation

● Review existing financial tracking systems and reporting workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement.

● Develop and optimise Excel-based trackers, formulas and reconciliation reports to improve accuracy and reduce manual effort.

● Establish consistent procedures for transaction categorisation, discrepancy tracking and financial reporting.

● Take ownership of recurring finance operations and ensure deliverables are completed accurately within stipulated timelines.

3.6 Cross-functional Coordination

● Coordinate with internal stakeholders to verify transactions, obtain supporting information and resolve discrepancies.

● Communicate financial exceptions clearly and escalate unresolved or material issues to the appropriate personnel.

● Collaborate with the finance team to maintain data integrity and ensure the smooth execution of day-to-day financial operations.

● Identify missing, duplicate, incorrect and unmatched transactions through systematic verification. ● Investigate discrepancies, timing differences and unexplained variances, determining their underlying causes.

● Coordinate with relevant stakeholders, banks and payment partners, where required, to resolve outstanding discrepancies.

● Ensure that recorded balances are supported by corresponding bank and transaction records.

4. Required Qualifications and Skills Educational Qualifications

● Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related discipline.

● CA Intermediate candidates are encouraged to apply. A full Chartered Accountancy qualification is not mandatory. Professional Experience

● 2–3 years of relevant experience in finance operations, accounting support, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation or transaction management.

Technical Competencies

● Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including:

○ XLOOKUP and VLOOKUP

○ SUMIFS and COUNTIFS

○ IF and IFERROR functions

○ Pivot Tables ○ Data filtering, sorting and conditional formatting

● Strong understanding of financial transactions, bank statements, debit and credit entries, and account balances.

● Demonstrated ability to analyse large datasets, reconcile information across multiple sources and identify inconsistencies.

● Familiarity with financial documentation, reconciliation schedules and audit trail maintenance.

● Knowledge of accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books or equivalent financial systems will be an advantage. Core Competencies

● High degree of numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

● Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.

● Demonstrated ownership, accountability and the ability to work independently.

● Proactive approach to identifying, investigating and resolving discrepancies.

● Effective organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities within defined timelines.

● Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective stakeholder coordination.

5. Key Performance Expectations Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

● Maintain complete, accurate and up-to-date financial transaction records.

● Ensure timely and consistent reconciliation of bank statements and internal records.

● Identify, investigate, document and resolve discrepancies within agreed timelines.

● Maintain comprehensive supporting documentation and reliable audit trails.

● Deliver accurate financial reports within established reporting schedules.

● Improve the efficiency and reliability of financial tracking and reconciliation processes.

6. What We Offer

An opportunity to contribute to the financial and operational efficiency of a growing creator-commerce business. The role offers scope to take ownership of core finance operations, strengthen reconciliation processes and contribute to the development of scalable financial systems as the organisation expands.

7. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented finance professional with advanced Excel capabilities, strong analytical judgement and a disciplined approach to financial record-keeping. They should be capable of independently managing transaction tracking and reconciliation, investigating discrepancies to their root causes, and ensuring that financial records remain accurate, complete and verifiable.

Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.

title: Reconciliation Manager - Global Trading Firm | GIFT City India
description:
Our client is a global trading firm looking to hire a Reconciliation Manager to lead and build out their reconciliation function in GIFT City.

This is a newly established function within the firm's growing back office, covering daily reconciliation of trades, positions and cash across global markets and asset classes. The role would suit a hands-on operations leader who wants ownership of an end to end process, works comfortably in a flat and fast moving environment, and is interested in shaping how a reconciliation team is run rather than maintaining business as usual.

* Own the daily reconciliation of trades, positions and cash against prime brokers, custodians, clearing members, clearing corporations and fund administrators.

* Oversee investigation and timely resolution of breaks, working with internal teams and external counterparties globally to identify root causes.

* Identify patterns in recurring breaks and feed improvements back into upstream processes.
* Own management reporting on match rates, break aging, root cause trends and team performance metrics.

* Partner with technology to evaluate, design and implement automation and process improvements.
* Work closely with the global team, including senior stakeholders based overseas, across APAC and EMEA coverage.

**Requirements for the Reconciliation Manager:**

* At least 15 years of experience in reconciliation, settlements or a related operations function, with direct people management experience.
* Strong working knowledge of trade, position and cash reconciliation and the full trade lifecycle, with exposure to global market conventions.
* Familiarity across multiple asset classes including equities, equity swaps, FX, futures, options and fixed income products.
* Hands on experience reconciling against prime brokers, custodians, clearing members and corporations, and fund administrators.
* Proven ability to build and develop an operations team and deliver against tight deadlines across time zones.
* Comfort working with large and complex data sets and drawing practical conclusions from them.
* Interest in technology and automation, and a willingness to drive improvements personally rather than only through others.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to assess processes, challenge the status quo and think beyond standard operating procedures.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage stakeholders globally.
* A controls oriented mindset with strong documentation and organisational skills.
* Based in or willing to relocate to GIFT City, India.

title: Senior Process Associate - Accounts Payable
description:
**Position Summary**
The Accounts Payable Senior Process Associate is responsible for managing and executing the daily accounts payable operations, ensuring timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, payments, and reconciliations. This role also involves supporting process improvements, maintaining data accuracy, and assisting in month-end closing activities. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, solid understanding of AP procedures, and the ability to work effectively within a team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Invoice Verification, Processing, Reporting on a Regular Basis.
* Resolve Invoice Discrepancies by coordinating with purchase team and suppliers.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in accounts payable or general accounting.
* Knowledge of general accounting procedures.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
* Knowledge of any accounting software will be an added advantage.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload in order to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* Be able to demonstrate attention to details and good-record-keeping.

Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. * Relevant internship or up to 2 years of experience in accounting or finance, preferably in a tech-driven or SME environment, is beneficial.

**Company Description**
Chengalpattu District Court serves the Chengalpattu region as part of the broader judicial system in Tamil Nadu, India. The court handles a wide range of civil, criminal, and administrative matters, providing accessible legal services to individuals, businesses, and public entities. Advocates working with the court engage in diverse cases, gaining exposure to trial practice, procedural law, and substantive legal issues. The environment emphasizes integrity, adherence to legal ethics, and commitment to fair representation for all parties. It offers legal professionals opportunities to develop litigation expertise and contribute to the delivery of justice in the community.
  
**Role Description**
The Advocate will represent clients in matters before Chengalpattu District Court, handling case preparation, filing, and appearances in court on a full-time basis. Day-to-day responsibilities include drafting petitions, affidavits, written statements, and legal opinions, as well as reviewing case documents, evidence, and precedents. The role involves advising clients on legal rights and obligations, negotiating settlements where appropriate, and coordinating with court staff and other legal professionals to ensure timely progression of cases. The Advocate will conduct legal research, prepare arguments, and present oral submissions in hearings and trials. This is an on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular presence in court and related offices.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of civil and criminal laws, procedural codes, and local court rules applicable to district court practice.
* Proficiency in drafting legal documents such as pleadings, petitions, affidavits, written arguments, and contracts.
* Capability in legal research using statutes, case law, commentaries, and online legal databases, with clear analysis and application to cases.
* Effective advocacy and negotiation skills, including confident oral presentation, examination of witnesses, and client counseling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Tamil is highly beneficial for client and court interactions.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle multiple cases, deadlines, and court schedules responsibly.
* Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and impartiality, with a client-centered and service-oriented approach.
* LL.B. (Bachelor of Laws) from a recognized institution and valid enrollment with the Bar Council of Tamil Nadu or relevant Bar Council.
* Prior experience practicing in district courts or trial courts is preferred; motivated early-career advocates with internship or chamber experience are also encouraged to apply.

title: Country Risk Officer
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
In this role as an India Chief Risk Officer in Wise’s second line Risk Management Team, you will be a key contributor in, and risk partner for the delivery of the risk management framework in India. This role is an exciting opportunity for you if you have significant risk management experience and are looking to do impactful work. The role will be under the APAC Risk team and reports to the Regional Head of Risk for South East Asia and South Asia.
  
  
**Here’s What Will You Be Doing**

* Act as the primary risk partner for the business in India, developing and executing a global risk management strategy tailored to India.
* Implement the Wise enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite, and other applicable risk policies at the local level to support India in managing risks effectively and meeting local regulatory requirements.
* Manage local regulatory relationships and engagement, representing the management during regulatory reviews around risk;
* Drive/review risk and controls self-assessments and documentation by first-line functions/risk owners, providing risk advisory and second-line review and challenge where relevant;
* Collaborate with product teams to integrate risk insights into product changes, new product launches, and address emerging risks in the region.
* Investigate incidents to determine root cause and impact, specifically regarding incidents, and supporting remediation efforts;
* Report risk updates directly to the local Board of Directors and the Regional Head of Risk;
* Create risk awareness through training and regular communications to first-line teams and supporting them in regulatory or internal audits; and
* Involvement in regional or global projects to ensure local compliance and integration with global risk toolsets.

**Qualifications**

* Significant experience (8+ years) in the financial services or payments industry, with deep expertise in the local regulatory landscape in India.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing comprehensive risk management frameworks, with a strong command of governance, risk reporting, and risk policy oversight.
* Proven track record of engaging with executive leadership, board members, and external regulators; exceptional ability to influence and lead across cross-functional, global teams.
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk, operational risk, regulatory risk and/or technology risk management.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and project managing risk management initiatives with strong business engagement.
* Strategic mindset and ability to operate independently, bridging local operational needs with global risk standards in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)
description:
**Job Title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)**

**Location: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Travel: As per the project need**

**Position Overview:**

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana Skill Education component as part of a dedicated Project Management Unit (PMU). The Assistant/ Deputy Manager will lead school based skill education reforms across the state, working directly with senior bureaucrats (including IAS officers) on Skill Education strengthening, managing co-ordination between National & State level Institutions in Education & Skilling domain, policy implementation & Tech & Data based governance improvement. Based in Hyderabad, the role combines strategic exposure, scale based execution and high-impact work in India’s skilling & education ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Govt & Stakeholder Engagement

* State & Central Ministry: Facilitate co-ordination between State School Education dept (Samagra Shiksha) & other Central institutions: Ministry of Education, NCVET, PSSCIVE, SSCs etc under established State & Centre channel for Samagra Shiksha based Skill Education delivery in schools
* Inter-State Depts: Facilitate coordination between Dept of School Education (Samagra Shiksha), SCERT, State Board, Dept of Skill Development & other relevant departments for School based Skill Education delivery support

2.School based Skill Education Delivery Facilitation at State Level

* Skill Education Delivery as per Scheme & Policy: Facilitate Skill Education delivery in Govt Schools at Scale in alignment with CSSVSE scheme, NEP-NCF mandate & State Vision for Skill Education for thousands of schools (Grade 6-12)
* Facilitate design & delivery of System setup in Schools: e.g-Skill lab setup in Schools, Skill Education Books delivery, Internships for School Students, AI integration in Skill Education curriculum etc
* Facilitate sufficient govt budget allocation to Skill Education in coordination with State School Education dept & Ministry of Education

3. Teacher Onboarding, Capacity Building

* Vocational Teacher Onboarding Facilitation: Support onboarding and management of vocational training partners (VTPs) & Vocational Teachers/ Trainers (VTs).
* Training: Coordinate Vocational/ Skill Education teacher training, Training of Trainers (ToT) and master trainer development.
* Support development of training resources and capacity-building systems.

4.Tech & Data Based Governance Improvement- Monitoring

* Facilitate effective monitoring through State based Monitoring platform; Monthly District & VTP review meeting; keeping IAS/State officers updated on progress through data & reports
* Prepare progress reports and analytical presentations for program reviews
* Facilitate large data collection from govt schools, analytics & outcome reporting to IAS & other senior officials for timely decision making around Skill Education

5. Drive Student Outcome

* Facilitate Students Internships (Grade 11-12), Career Counselling, Job Fairs, Higher Education pathways by planning & designing intervention at the State level
* Facilitate delivery of the same in schools as per State budget & program allocation

6. Team Management-PMU

* Manage PMU Team at State level
* Guide & Mentor all PMU team members of the State

7. PMU Operations & Government Coordination

* Support day-to-day functioning of the Skill/Vocational Education PMU at Samagra Shiksha, School Education Dept
* Coordinate with senior officers, including IAS and State Services officers, for meetings, reviews, and follow-ups
* Prepare briefing notes, presentations, concept notes, and action trackers for senior bureaucrat/IAS leadership
* Track meeting outcomes, decisions, and implementation timelines

8. Reporting & Documentation

* Prepare periodic progress reports, and presentations
* Maintain records of PMU activities, meetings, and outputs
* Ensure professional communication between Lend A Hand India and Government counterparts

9. Support to all LAHI’s Projects in Telangana: Need based support to other LAHI’s projects in Andhra Pradesh (SCERT, State Board, Skill Development Dept)

**About Lend A Hand India :**
Lend A Hand India (LAHI) is a leading national Think Tank/Non Profit Organisation with over 20 years of experience in strengthening India’s skill and vocational education ecosystem. LAHI works closely with 20+ State and UT governments through long-term partnerships, providing technical advisory and Project Management Unit (PMU) support to drive systemic reforms. In Telangana, LAHI partners with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha to support large-scale improvements in school based Skill Education (6-12) delivery. Currently, In 20+ States 22,000+ schools and 25 lakh + students are supported by LAHI through 300+ team members working Pan-India.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
* 250+ Team Members

**What Truly Sets a Career at Lend A Hand India Apart –**

* **Work as a Systems Architect, not just an Implementer:**
  You help build and refine the system itself, influencing policy and creating lasting change.
* **Experience the thrill of scale with depth:**
  See your ideas and efforts replicated across thousands of schools, impacting millions of students in a measurable way.
* **Master Complex Collaboration:**
  Gain unparalleled experience navigating and synergizing the worlds of government, corporate CSR, and community.
* **Career with a Tangible Legacy:**
  Your work directly creates skilled professionals, confident entrepreneurs, and a stronger national economy.
* **Investment in you:**
  We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive support & robust benefits and a culture that actively champions your professional development and holistic well-being.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Overall experience of 5-10+ years in Education & Govt PMU Management
* Prior experience of Education/Skill Development
* Prior experience of working with State level Senior bureaucrats/ IAS (preferred)
* Experience of relevant fellowship desirable (Education/Skilling: Gandhi, TFI, MGNF etc)
* Prior experience working with State or Central Government departments preferred

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Public Policy, Education, Management, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Relevant fellowships (e.g., MGNF, Gandhi Fellowship, TFI, etc.) will be an added advantage

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Language: Excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & Telugu
* Team management: Experience of Managing team, Ability to lead State PMU and manage/guide team members who are part of PMU
* Technical Skills: Experience of developing strategy & documentation for IAS/State level Govt officials use: State level presentations for Senior Bureaucrats; Policy/Guideline Drafts; Notesheets; Concept Notes, SOPs; tender work-technical support etc
* Ability to manage Govt projects at State level (notesheets, tender work-technical support, desk research work, orientation to senior officials about project details)
* Strong Expertise in Technical project writing work & data analytics-Report writing (Word, PPT) & large datasets analysis using excel
* Proficient in drafting official letters, note sheets, proposals, concept notes, SOPs, making presentations etc. (preferred)
* Proficient in large data analytics (excel & google sheet based) & presenting the findings via great visual presentation & report to senior officials
* Good understanding of India’s School Education system
* Ability to work in a government system with professionalism, discretion, and persistence
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills especially with Senior Bureaucrats/ Senior partners/management
* Proficient in communicating ideas, strategy to State level Senior Govt. officers
* High proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Personal Attributes:**

* Comfortable working in government environments
* Detail-oriented, proactive, and solution-focused
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Strong sense of responsibility and teamwork

title: Manager - Corporate Investigations
description:

Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Manager - Corporate Investigations**
, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be a key member of the Ethics & Compliance team, collaborating with investigators, legal teams, corporate security, internal audit, finance, human resources, and business stakeholders. You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and improve investigative processes while upholding our commitment to integrity, quality, and continuous learning.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead and manage escalated, sensitive, and high-risk investigations in partnership with Ethics investigators and key stakeholders.
* Plan, organize, and conduct investigations related to alleged violations of Corporate Security policies, the Code of Ethics, and other company policies and standards.
* Conduct investigations involving fraud, bribery, conflict of interest, embezzlement, employee misconduct, litigation support, health and safety matters, cyber incidents, theft, and proprietary information misuse.
* Analyze investigative findings to identify trends, root causes, systemic weaknesses, and opportunities for risk mitigation while providing actionable recommendations to management and legal teams.
* Collaborate across functions and contribute to projects, training initiatives, and process improvements that strengthen the Ethics & Compliance program and investigative capabilities.

As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact alongside our vibrant people and culture while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* 12-15 years of significant and direct experience in investigative roles involving analysis of potential violations, issues, root causes, and contributing factors.
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting internal investigations, evidence gathering, interviewing witnesses, and managing sensitive corporate matters.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including preparation of executive-level investigative reports and presentations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience identifying trends, patterns, and business risks from investigative findings.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders including Corporate Security, Internal Audit, Finance, Human Resources, and Legal teams.
* Strong understanding of ethics, compliance, corporate governance, and investigative best practices.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality, professional integrity, and sound judgment in all investigations.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

* Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification.
* Professional Certified Investigator (PCI) certification.
* REID or PEACE investigation model certification.
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) certification.
* CHFI certification.
* Certifications in networking, cybersecurity, or cloud technologies.
* Experience with case management systems and investigative technologies.
* Experience delivering investigative training and consultation services.

title: Company Secretary (CS) – Listed Company Compliance
description:
Department: Legal & Secretarial

Experience: 3-5 Years

Location: Hyderabad

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and qualified Company Secretary (CS) with hands-on experience in listed company compliance, corporate governance, and regulatory filings. The candidate should have strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI regulations, and stock exchange compliance requirements.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience working with a listed company or a listed company group and be capable of independently managing secretarial compliances, Board and Committee meetings, corporate governance reporting, and coordination with regulatory authorities, auditors, and stock exchanges.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Listed Company Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI LODR).
* Handle periodic and event-based disclosures to NSE/BSE, as applicable.
* Manage quarterly, half-yearly, and annual compliance filings with stock exchanges.
* Ensure timely disclosure of material events and information under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR.
* Monitor compliance with SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015.
* Maintain the Structured Digital Database (SDD), insider trading records, and related compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with stock exchanges, SEBI, Registrar of Companies (ROC), and other regulatory authorities.
* Track regulatory updates and ensure timely implementation of changes in applicable laws and regulations.

**B. Board and Committee Management**

* Organise Board Meetings, Annual General Meetings (AGMs), Extraordinary General Meetings (EGMs), and committee meetings.
* Prepare agendas, notices, explanatory statements, minutes, and resolutions.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements relating to the Board of Directors and its committees.
* Maintain statutory registers, minute books, and other secretarial records.
* Coordinate with Directors, Independent Directors, Key Managerial Personnel (KMPs), and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with applicable provisions relating to the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and other committees.

**C. Corporate Governance and Reporting**

* Prepare the Corporate Governance Report, Annual Secretarial Compliance Report, and other applicable disclosures.
* Coordinate the preparation of the Annual Report, Board's Report, and related statutory disclosures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements relating to Independent Directors, Director appointments, resignations, and disclosures of interest.
* Monitor compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards issued by ICSI, and applicable SEBI regulations.
* Support the Board and senior management in implementing sound corporate governance practices.
* Coordinate with Practising Company Secretaries (PCS), statutory auditors, and internal auditors for compliance reviews and certifications.

**D. ROC and MCA Compliance**

* Prepare and file statutory forms and returns with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), including applicable forms relating to:
* Annual returns and financial statements.
* Appointment, resignation, and changes in Directors and KMPs.
* Board and shareholder resolutions.
* Creation, modification, and satisfaction of charges.
* Other event-based statutory filings.
* Maintain statutory registers and records under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Ensure compliance with applicable provisions relating to deposits, loans, investments, related-party transactions, and other corporate actions.

**E. Insider Trading and Shareholder Management**

* Administer the Code of Conduct for prevention of insider trading.
* Manage trading window closures, pre-clearance of trades, and disclosures by designated persons.
* Maintain the list of designated persons and their immediate relatives, as applicable.
* Coordinate with the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) and depositories.
* Monitor shareholding patterns, investor grievances, and shareholder-related disclosures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements relating to dematerialisation, share transfers, and corporate actions.

**F. Legal and Regulatory Advisory**

* Advise management on corporate law, listing obligations, governance, and regulatory matters.
* Identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely closure of statutory obligations.
* Support due diligence, corporate restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, and other corporate transactions, wherever applicable.
* Assist in responding to regulatory queries, notices, and stock exchange observations.

**3. Eligibility Criteria**

* Qualified Company Secretary and member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
* Graduate in Commerce, Law, or a related discipline.
* 3-5 years of relevant experience, preferably with a listed company.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in SEBI LODR, Companies Act, 2013, and stock exchange compliances.
* Experience in handling Board and Committee meetings, annual reports, and corporate governance reporting.
* Good drafting, communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MCA portal filings, NSE/BSE compliance portals, and compliance management systems.

**4. Preferred Experience**

* Experience with a company listed on NSE and/or BSE.
* Exposure to quarterly and annual compliance reporting and event-based disclosures.
* Experience in Annual Secretarial Compliance Reports and Secretarial Audit coordination.
* Familiarity with SEBI PIT Regulations, SDD maintenance, and related-party transaction compliances.
* Experience coordinating with statutory auditors, Practising Company Secretaries, legal counsel, and stock exchange officials.
* Exposure to corporate restructuring, fundraising, preferential issues, rights issues, or other capital market transactions.

**5. Key Competencies**

**Competency**

**Expected capability**

Regulatory knowledge

Strong understanding of Companies Act and SEBI regulations

Listed company experience

Independent handling of stock exchange compliances

Corporate governance

Effective Board and Committee management

Drafting skills

Notices, minutes, resolutions, disclosures, and reports

Compliance management

Proactive tracking and timely filing

Communication

Effective coordination with Directors and senior management

Attention to detail

Accuracy in statutory records and regulatory disclosures

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of all applicable ROC, MCA, and stock exchange filings.
* Zero avoidable penalties or compliance defaults.
* Timely disclosure of material events and information.
* Accurate preparation of Board and Committee documentation.
* Timely submission of corporate governance reports and annual disclosures.
* Effective maintenance of the compliance calendar, statutory registers, and SDD.
* Timely resolution of shareholder grievances and regulatory observations.

**About the Opportunity**

The Indian Dental Association (IDA) is inviting applications from qualified dental professionals for the position of
**Compliance Officer – Dental Clinical Governance**
.

The selected candidates will support the compliance and clinical governance requirements of the
**Smile Clinic Group**
, with particular reference to dental practices operating within the United Kingdom. The role will involve reviewing clinical and administrative documentation, conducting compliance audits, assessing potential risks, and supporting practices in meeting applicable UK dental regulations and quality standards.

This position is suitable for dentists who wish to build a specialised career in dental compliance, clinical governance, quality assurance, patient safety, regulatory documentation, and healthcare risk management.

**Role Summary**

The Compliance Officer will work closely with the Compliance Team to ensure that dental practices maintain high standards of clinical care, patient safety, professional conduct, documentation, and regulatory compliance.

The officer will review patient records, policies, incidents, complaints, audit findings, and compliance documentation against applicable requirements, including:

* Care Quality Commission regulations and fundamental standards
* General Dental Council standards and professional guidance
* National Health Service dental requirements
* UK dental legislation and regulatory frameworks
* Information governance and confidentiality requirements
* Clinical governance and patient-safety principles
* Internal policies, standard operating procedures, and quality protocols

The role requires a strong understanding of dental clinical procedures, excellent analytical ability, precise documentation, and the confidence to identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective and preventive actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Clinical Record Auditing**

* Conduct structured audits of dental patient records to assess their completeness, accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
* Review clinical notes, medical histories, consent documentation, radiographic records, treatment plans, prescriptions, referrals, follow-up records, and patient communications.
* Confirm that clinical records demonstrate appropriate diagnosis, treatment justification, informed consent, clinical decision-making, and continuity of care.
* Identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially non-compliant documentation.

**2. Regulatory Compliance Monitoring**

* Monitor practice compliance with relevant CQC regulations, GDC Standards, NHS dental requirements, UK dental legislation, and clinical governance frameworks.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory updates, professional guidance, inspection requirements, and emerging compliance risks.
* Assist in translating regulatory requirements into practical checklists, policies, workflows, and monitoring tools.
* Support practices in preparing for internal audits, external inspections, regulatory reviews, and quality assessments.
* Escalate serious or recurring compliance concerns to the Head of Compliance.

**3. Clinical Governance and Patient Safety**

* Support the implementation and monitoring of clinical governance systems across dental practices.
* Review matters relating to patient safety, safeguarding, infection prevention and control, consent, record keeping, prescribing, radiography, medical emergencies, and professional conduct.
* Assist in identifying clinical and operational risks that may affect patient care or regulatory compliance.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and the development of corrective and preventive action plans.
* Monitor whether agreed corrective actions have been implemented within the required timelines.

**4. Incident and Complaint Review**

* Review clinical incidents, patient complaints, adverse events, near misses, and significant-event records.
* Assess whether incidents and complaints have been documented, investigated, responded to, and closed appropriately.
* Support the preparation of factual, professional, and compliant responses to clinical governance matters.
* Identify trends, recurring concerns, and areas requiring training or process improvement.
* Maintain confidentiality and objectivity while handling sensitive clinical and patient-related information.

**5. Policy and SOP Management**

* Assist in drafting, reviewing, updating, and standardising policies, protocols, checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures.
* Ensure that compliance documentation reflects current regulatory requirements and organisational policies.
* Maintain proper document control, including version numbers, review dates, approvals, and revision histories.
* Support the development of practical guidance documents for dentists, dental nurses, practice managers, and administrative teams.
* Recommend policy revisions where audits, incidents, complaints, or regulatory changes indicate a need for improvement.

**6. Compliance Reporting and KPI Monitoring**

* Prepare clear and accurate compliance reports for management review.
* Maintain audit trackers, corrective-action registers, risk logs, incident records, and compliance dashboards.
* Monitor key performance indicators relating to documentation quality, audit outcomes, complaint resolution, training completion, policy compliance, and corrective-action closure.
* Analyse compliance data to identify patterns, trends, and priority areas.
* Present findings in a structured manner, supported by evidence and practical recommendations.

**7. Practice Support and Guidance**

* Respond to compliance-related queries from practice managers and clinical teams.
* Provide evidence-based guidance on documentation, consent, patient communication, clinical governance, and regulatory expectations.
* Support practices in developing and implementing improvement plans.
* Assist in conducting compliance-awareness sessions and staff training.
* Encourage a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, accountability, and patient-centred care.

**8. Coordination and Stakeholder Communication**

title: Credit Risk Management Governance Lead
description:

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.
  
  
As Credit Risk Management Governance Lead - Vice President, you will help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. You will strengthen the Private Bank credit risk governance framework by maintaining and enhancing policies, procedures, controls, committee governance, and issues management, as well as coordinate internal, external, and regulatory examinations, and provide constructive, independent challenge to stakeholders across locations and seniority levels. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class.
  
  
The Wealth Management Risk Management Governance team manages Risk policies, due diligence reviews, adherence to regulatory requirements, and internal controls for Global WM Credit Risk. The team collaborates closely with the Global Credit Risk approval and analysis team, Audit, Compliance, Controls, Legal and Business partners to ensure efficient and effective process are in place.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Drive Risk governance initiatives and change management.
* Support external regulatory examinations, internal audits, and independent reviews of the Credit Risk function and associated remediation.
* Partner with Wholesale Credit Risk and other Lines of Business in the firm to understand and benchmark Wealth Management processes.
* Evaluate Credit Risk controls and provide clear, well-supported observations and recommendations to stakeholders. Ensure timely remediation and sustainable control improvements for issues.
* Maintain a high standard of documentation, professionalism, and confidentiality while working with sensitive client and firm information.
* Contribute to special projects/initiatives that enhance the Credit Risk Governance program, reporting, and risk coverage.
* Identify material credit risks and assess their impact on Risk.
* Clearly define and document roles between business execution (1LOD), risk oversight (2LOD), and audit (3LOD).
* Perform risk assessment to address and appropriately escalate and remediate issues.
* Provide transparency into emerging risks and governance matters.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in Auditing, Accounting, Internal Control, and/or Credit Analysis, with a focus on Credit Risk with Bachelor in Accounting or Finance is required.
* Strong knowledge of financial principles and procedures; demonstrated background in the Financial Services industry.
* Working understanding of credit risks and related controls.
* Ability to follow complex methods and procedures across diverse tasks and product types.
* Experience with Credit Risk infrastructure tools and applications (e.g., iCRD, Loan IQ, Connect, LLM, etc.).
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications
* Highest level of professionalism; proven ability to manage highly confidential information appropriately.
* Strong time management, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively; shares information and supports colleagues.
* Flexibility and ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* Self-motivated and detail oriented with a willingness to take ownership of new projects/initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's in finance or business administration or similar preferred

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. title: Legal Consultant
description:
Job Description

Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.

  
  

**About Seclore:**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit **www.seclore.com**.

  
  

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

  
  

We are seeking a customer-focused Technical Consultant to provide end-to-end technical consulting, solution design, deployment, upgrades, migrations, troubleshooting, performance analysis, training, and documentation for Seclore solutions. The role requires hands-on expertise across Windows/Linux infrastructure, web and application servers, databases, networking, security, Docker, and cloud technologies — plus the ability to translate complex customer requirements into practical solutions and use AI tools responsibly to boost technical productivity.

  
  

**A sneak peek into the role:**

We’re looking for a lawyer whose primary focus and expertise is in **commercial technology contracts.** You’ll work on **drafting, redlining, and finalizing contracts** with clear guidance from senior counsel, with the expectation that you’ll operate independently over time.

  
  

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

* Core contracting: Draft and review technology/commercial agreements (NDAs, SaaS subscriptions, MSAs/SOWs, software licenses, partner/reseller, and vendor/procurement contracts); assist in negotiations and escalate nonstandard terms.

* Contract negotiation support: Prepare contract markups, issues lists, and concise negotiation summaries; join and, where appropriate, lead external customer/vendor contract calls with clear positions; capture decisions, action items, and next steps.

* Contract management tools: Manage contracts in a contract management system from request to signature: log requests, route approvals, track versions, capture key terms, track obligations, and maintain reports.

* Research & writing: Targeted research on legal and contract questions and crisp guidance notes for business teams.

* Business partnering: Provide practical, timely support to Sales, Procurement, Product, and Finance; coordinate with external counsel as needed.

* Other: Pitch in on special projects and general legal tasks as required.

  
  

**We can see the next Entrepreneur At Seclore if you have:**

* Education & experience: LL.B. (or equivalent). 2–4 years focused on commercial/technology contracts inhouse or at a techsavvy firm.

* Drafting & redlining: Strong grasp of endtoend drafting and review; translate business positions into precise contract language.

* Contract management systems: Handson with at least one contract management tool; comfortable managing workflows, metadata, and dashboards.

* AI & technology skills: Comfortable using AI tools for legal work (e.g., drafting summaries, clause suggestions) and verifying outputs; proficient with Track Changes, spreadsheets, and common productivity tools.

* Tech/IP basics: Comfortable with SaaS terms, IP ownership/licensing, confidentiality, warranties, indemnities, and liability caps. U.S. contract exposure is a plus, not a must.

* Communication & collaboration: Clear writing, stakeholder management, and timely escalation; experience handling external negotiation calls with customers and vendors.

* Work style: Extremely organized, curious, and reliable; delivers on timelines with appropriate guidance.

* Global support & hours: Supports Seclore’s global operations; willingness to work occasional US and Middle East hours when needed.

  
  

**Why do we call Seclorites Entrepreneurs not Employees?**

* We value and support those who take the initiative and calculate risks.
* We have an attitude of a problem solver and an aptitude that is tech agnostic. You get to work with the smartest minds in the business.
* We are thriving not living. At Seclore, it is not just about work but about creating outstanding employee experiences. Our supportive and open culture enables our team to thrive.
  

  

**Let’s build the future of data security at Seclore together.**

title: Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product
description:
Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product

Ananant Systems | Noida | Full-time | Regular travel within India | Reports to the CEO

Ananant is hiring a Founders' Office Associate to own government programmes, partnerships, product input, contracts and marketing, working directly with the CEO and CTO.

ABOUT ANANANT

Ananant Systems is an Indian deep-tech semiconductor company. We design chips for small-cell 4G/5G and camera applications, with teams in Bengaluru, Noida and San Diego. We are backed by venture capital and by national semiconductor programmes, and we are growing several-fold over the next 18 months.

THE ROLE

Outside engineering, Ananant depends on three things: the government programmes it wins, the customers and partners who adopt its chips, and its standing in the market. This role owns all three.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO. You represent Ananant to government, partners and customers, and bring what you learn from them back into the company.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Government programmes. Identify, apply for and deliver government semiconductor and R&D programmes: applications, milestones, reporting and compliance, and the working relationship with the ministries and agencies involved.

• Partnerships and lead customers. Build and manage the pipeline of strategic partners and lead customers, and track every commitment made to them.

• Product and market. Bring customer requirements, market information and competitive analysis into product decisions, and build the business case for new opportunities.

• Contracts. Manage customer, partner, vendor and government agreements through review, approval and signature, working with our law firm. Maintain the contract register, renewals and obligations.

• Marketing. Own positioning, collateral, the website and our presence at industry events.

WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

Expected outcomes in the first year:

• Government programmes won, with every report and milestone under them delivered on time.

• Partnerships signed and lead customers evaluating our chips.

• Customer and market input feeding product decisions on a regular basis.

• A complete and current contract register, with no missed renewals or obligations.

• Consistent positioning and collateral in use with customers, partners and government.

WHY THIS ROLE

• Scope. Government, customers, product, contracts and marketing in one role, each being set up for the first time.

• Direct access. You work with the CEO and CTO directly, on decisions that matter to the company.

• Sector exposure. You will build relationships and expertise across Indian semiconductor policy, customers and partners.

• A path to leadership. The role is expected to grow into leading a function as the company scales.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1 to 5 years of experience. Comfortable both in meetings with senior government officials and partners, and in building financial models. Clear writer, strong with numbers, and able to run work end to end with limited supervision.

You bring:

• Strong Excel modelling and a solid grasp of business financials: P&L, cash flow, budgets and unit economics.

• Working knowledge of compliance and audits.

• Clear, persuasive writing and presentation for formal audiences.

• Daily, hands-on use of AI tools.

• Ability to represent the company with senior officials, partners and customers.

It helps if you have:

• An MBA, ideally with a consulting background.

• Founder or early-stage startup experience.

• An engineering degree, or experience in semiconductors, telecom or deep tech.

• Experience with Indian government programmes, public-sector stakeholders, or commercial contracts.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short note on something you built or ran end to end, and what you would do differently. The process is a conversation with the CEO, a short work sample on a problem from the role, and a review with the founders. It takes about two weeks.

title: Company Secretary (CS)
description:
**About Quattro Group**

Quattro Group of Companies is a diversified business group with interests in commercial real estate, office leasing, managed workspaces, turnkey fit-outs, facility management, information technology and retail.

With multiple business entities and an expanding portfolio, the Group is looking for a competent and experienced Company Secretary to strengthen corporate governance, ensure regulatory compliance and support management in corporate and legal matters.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Corporate Secretarial & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable rules and regulations.
* Manage statutory filings, annual returns, financial statement filings and event-based compliances with the Registrar of Companies (ROC).
* Maintain statutory registers, records, minutes books and corporate documentation.
* Monitor compliance requirements across all Group companies, subsidiaries and associated entities.
* Coordinate with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), ROC and other statutory authorities.

**2. Board Meetings & Corporate Governance**

* Organize Board Meetings, Annual General Meetings (AGMs) and Extraordinary General Meetings (EGMs).
* Prepare notices, agendas, resolutions, minutes and related documentation.
* Advise Directors and management on corporate governance requirements and statutory responsibilities.
* Maintain records of Board approvals, shareholder resolutions and delegated authorities.

**3. Legal & Commercial Documentation**

* Coordinate with internal and external legal counsel on corporate and commercial matters.
* Review and assist in preparing agreements, contracts, MOUs, NDAs, shareholder agreements and other legal documentation.
* Support documentation for real estate transactions, leasing arrangements, business partnerships and commercial contracts.
* Assist management in identifying contractual and regulatory risks.

**4. Group Structure & Corporate Transactions**

* Manage documentation relating to incorporation of new companies, changes in shareholding, appointment or resignation of Directors and capital restructuring.
* Support corporate restructuring, mergers, acquisitions and joint ventures, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with auditors, bankers, consultants and regulatory authorities for corporate transactions.
* Maintain updated records of Group entities, ownership structures and authorized signatories.

**5. Compliance Monitoring & Risk Management**

* Develop and maintain a centralized compliance calendar for all Group entities.
* Track statutory deadlines, renewals, filings and approvals.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, Legal and Operations teams to ensure timely compliance.
* Identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide periodic compliance status reports to Group management.

**6. Regulatory & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Liaise with statutory auditors, secretarial auditors, tax consultants, legal advisors and government authorities.
* Assist with due diligence exercises, corporate records and regulatory submissions.
* Support management on FEMA, RBI and other regulatory matters wherever applicable, in coordination with specialist advisors.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Qualified Company Secretary and member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
* 5–10 years of relevant post-qualification experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, MCA/ROC procedures and corporate governance.
* Experience managing statutory compliances for multiple companies.
* Working knowledge of corporate contracts, commercial documentation and regulatory requirements.
* Proficiency in MCA V3 portal, MS Office and compliance management systems.
* Experience in real estate, infrastructure, diversified business groups or multi-entity corporate structures will be an advantage.

Key Competencies

* Strong attention to detail and regulatory discipline.
* Excellent drafting, documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple Group entities.
* High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional ethics.
* Strong coordination skills with senior management, auditors, consultants and legal advisors.
* Proactive approach to identifying compliance risks and meeting statutory deadlines.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work directly with Group leadership.
* Exposure to multiple businesses and corporate structures.
* A responsible role combining governance, legal coordination and strategic corporate support.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with qualifications and experience.

**Compensation:** As per industry standards and candidate experience

**Application:** Share your updated CV at hr@quattrospaces.com, mentioning "Application – Company Secretary" in the subject line.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Payments Business Systems Analyst
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Business Analyst with around 5 years of experience to join our IT services team. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to analyze data, generate insights, and support data-driven decision-making for global clients. The role requires strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with SQL and BI tools, and the ability to translate business requirements into meaningful reports. Your future duties and responsibilities Required to understand new business requirements, conduct business analysis. Prepare data mapping, technical requirements and perform testing of applications. Analyze payment transactional data and provide recommendations to ensure no business/technical data leakage across the systems in the bank. Develop in depth knowledge of applications and their interdependences; understand the architecture, payment flows, and optimal configurations of business solutions. Analyze and manipulate large data sets. Continually seek out process improvement opportunities and have full awareness of process controls. Demonstrate leadership and partnership skills by interacting with other business and technology teams within organization to solve problems and deliver solutions. Understand, document and interpret complex user requirements. The Business Systems Analyst will take a leadership role in working with and liaising with business partners, other Technology teams and external vendors to define the business and technical requirements at the program level. Review, analyze and evaluate detailed business and functional requirements, documentation, process flows and data models to contribute to the development of project plans including project charter, project deliverables, timeline estimates, scope and control. Develop use cases, define and document user procedures and workflows, and how each class of user interacts with east system function. Identify and problem solve for issues that prevent an optimal experience for advocates and customers; ensure Business Recovery Plans are in place. Integrate technical solutions with the business environment, recognizing systems design and data interdependencies and reusability. Establish appropriate security levels for processes, information exchange and system implementation. Define, review and influence standards and quality measures/metrics. Assist in the development of conversion and implementation strategies. Conduct pre and post implementation reviews, ensuring all technical solutions have met business requirements. Supports system implementation and production readiness by liaising with change management, IT architecture and desktop standards, and the business. Review test plans, test cases and assist testing. Provide user documentation, user training, and post implementation support. Collaborate with business leaders, IT professionals, and vendors ensuring that management is kept informed of project status and that problems and issues are escalated appropriately and clearly communicated. Required qualifications to be successful in this role Strong experience of payment applications wires processing (SWIFT and FED) with knowledge of ISO20022 standards. Strong data analytical skills including SQL. Knowledge of reporting tools (eg. Jaspersoft, Tableau) beneficial. Self starter with solid interpersonal skills projecting a uniquely positive customer service oriented attitude. Ability to work alone and with other members of a team. Must be a team player with exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Create and maintain thorough, up to date, functional and technical systems documentation for projects, design, customization and maintenance actions taken. Ability to negotiate winning solutions for customers and projects. Ability to effectively manage multiple efforts simultaneously and adjust to changes in direction as needed to meet business objective; Make recommendations for system enhancements and changes. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Strong presentation and communications skills. Knowledge of project methodologies (SDLC, Agile). Skills Jira Agile Banking Business Analysis SWIFT

The outcome is a clear, governed set of commercial policies - credit, claims, pricing and trade terms - and customer agreements that are standard, compliant and correctly executed in the systems; fewer and cleaner customer claims; lower invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage; and The scope spans Commercial Standards, Claims and Contracts end to end - formulation and governance of credit, claims, pricing and trade-terms policies, policy exceptions and delegation of authority, the customer agreement and contract lifecycle (drafting, approval, activation, amendment and renewal), pricing, rebate, discount and promotion setup, accruals, claims intake, validation and settlement, proof of performance, and the controls that link agreed terms to what is invoiced and paid. The role designs across this scope as one process rather than as separate contract, promotion and claims solutions. It works with market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service and Collections teams, GBO, D&T, the SAP and Control Tower (Claims and Deduction platform) teams and third-party vendors. Role capabilities Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies-the credit policy (credit limits, payment terms, risk categorisation, blocks and releases), the claims policy (eligibility, evidence, time limits, approval and write-off thresholds), and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount and rebate guardrails, price-change control) and the standards and controls that make them work in practice. As a business analyst, interrogate contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data, document current and target process, and write requirements to standard. As a subject matter expert, bring the functional depth to act as design authority for the fragment and to challenge solutions that would not work in the markets. As a sprint or project owner, take a scope fragment through design, test and deployment on a two to four week value drop cadence. As a process and technology expert, translate commercial policy, contract terms and controls into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction capability, and the contract and trade promotion management toolset. Key design disciplines The defining discipline of this role is designing claims out at source, not processing them faster. A quicker claim approval is a smaller prize than a contract term clear enough never to be disputed; a faster settlement is a smaller prize than a promotion set up correctly in the system so the customer never needs to claim. The postholder is expected to use the data to find where in the commercial process claims are created - an ambiguous contract clause, a non-standard trade term, a late or incorrect pricing or promotion setup, an accrual gap, a weak approval control - and design the fix upstream into commercial policy, standards, contract templates, deal approval and master data, as well as into the claims and settlement design. Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role. A claim usually starts life as a commercial negotiation; a contract term becomes a pricing condition, an accrual, an invoice and, if anything is misaligned, a deduction in Collections. The postholder is expected to know what happens on either side of their own process - from deal negotiation through to cash and the P&L - and to design accordingly. This is a transformation design and delivery role, not an operational one. The postholder does not negotiate customer deals, draft or approve individual contracts, validate or settle individual claims, or manage customer relationships; that stays with market Commercial, Legal, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done - including the commercial policies, standards, contract templates, reason codes, analytics and controls that let run teams find and remove causes in BAU. The role formulates and recommends policy; final approval sits with the relevant policy owners and governance forums. Working style and governance The role works independently within an agreed frame set by the workstream lead, gathers its own data, forms its own view and brings recommendations rather than questions. Where a Senior Specialist is assigned on the same fragment, it works under their design direction. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS. Baseline and design / Analysis Analyse commercial terms, contracts and claims performance and baseline the problem - 25%. Document current-state credit, claims and pricing policies, commercial standards, contract lifecycle and claims processes across markets and identify variation from the global standard. Build the process, trade-terms and claim-type taxonomy and interrogate the data directly at portfolio level - customer agreements and terms, pricing and promotion conditions, accruals versus actuals, claims volume, value, ageing and rejection rates, invalid deductions, write-offs and trade-spend leakage - to baseline the problem per market and size the opportunity. Perform gap analysis between current process, commercial policy, contract terms, platform capability, controls and the target operating model, separating structural design issues from operational backlog. Support business-rule validation, master-data requirements and policy analysis. Aim for validated current-state documentation and a defensible baseline that will stand up to audit. Formulate commercial policies and standards, and design claims out at source - 25%. Support future-state design aligned to the global standard, always designing for the cause rather than the symptom. Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies the design depends on - credit policy (credit limits and risk categorisation, payment terms, credit blocks and release authority), claims policy (claim eligibility, evidence and proof-of-performance requirements, submission time limits, validation, approval and write-off thresholds) and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount, rebate and promotion guardrails, price-change control and margin protection) - with a clear policy-exception and delegation-of-authority framework, and take them through the governance forums for approval. Translate policy into the standards that operationalise it: standard trade-terms structures, contract and agreement templates

 No training or fine tuning of AI/ML models.
 No ownership of AI architectures or MLOps pipelines.
 Focus is on integration, adoption, and productivity uplift, not AI research or engineering.

title: SAP CPI Consultant
description:
SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) Consultant 

 
 
 We are seeking an experienced SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) Consultant to design, develop, and support enterprise integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP systems. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SAP Integration Suite (CPI), integration design, API development, message mappings, scripting, and cloud integration technologies. The role requires close collaboration with functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing integration solutions. 
 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Independently design, develop, configure, and deploy SAP CPI integration flows based on functional and technical requirements. Develop complex integration scenarios using SAP CPI adapters, message mappings, value mappings, XSLT mappings, and Groovy/JavaScript scripting. Build and maintain integrations between SAP and non-SAP applications using SOAP, REST, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Salesforce, and other standard connectors. Execute unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and troubleshoot integration issues to ensure stable and high-performing interfaces. Collaborate with SAP Functional Consultants, technical teams, external vendors, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver integration solutions. Monitor SAP CPI integration runtimes, message processing, and proactively resolve interface failures, exceptions, and performance bottlenecks. Enhance and optimize existing integration interfaces to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including Technical Design Documents (TDD), interface specifications, deployment guides, test cases, and operational manuals. Support deployments across Cloud and Hybrid/On-Premise environments and coordinate with infrastructure teams for connectivity, security certificates, and environment setup. Ensure compliance with SAP integration best practices, governance standards, security policies, and organizational development guidelines. 
 

 Required Skills 
 Strong experience with SAP Cloud Platform Integration (SAP CPI) / SAP Integration Suite. Hands-on experience with SOAP, REST APIs, OData, IDoc, RFC, XML, JSON, and XSLT. Experience in developing Groovy Scripts and JavaScript within SAP CPI. title: B&V | Hiring Assoc Engineer-Mechanical HVAC CFD | Data Center
description:
Role Overview The Black & Veatch Data Center Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Solutions Team is highly skilled and experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in data center CFD modeling and analysis, including airflow management, thermal performance evaluation, and liquid-cooling simulations. The ideal candidate will possess advanced CFD capabilities and a strong understanding of data center cooling systems and mission-critical facility design. Key responsibilities include the following: Lead and manage complex CFD projects within the Data Center CFD Solutions Team, ensuring high-quality technical execution and client-focused deliverables. Provide technical and oversight for domestic and offshore (OUS) CFD project teams, and maintain consistency in modeling methodologies and reporting standards. Perform advanced CFD analyses of data center environments, including airflow, thermal, and liquid-cooling simulations for both steady-state and failure operating conditions. Develop and execute flow network models of liquid-cooling distribution systems, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), pumps, piping networks, manifolds, and rack-level cooling technologies to assess hydraulic performance, flow balance, pressure drops, and system redundancy. Conduct detailed airflow management assessments to evaluate cooling performance, rack inlet temperatures, containment effectiveness, and compliance with project design criteria. Perform transient CFD simulations to evaluate data center response to power and cooling system failure events, supporting resiliency and operational risk assessments. Conduct exterior CFD analyses to evaluate wind effects, recirculation, and heat entrainment associated with air-cooled chillers, dry coolers, cooling towers, generators, and other mechanical infrastructure. Perform air contaminant dispersion modeling for generator exhaust and other emission sources to assess environmental impacts, air quality risks, and compliance with applicable project requirements. Develop CFD-driven design recommendations to optimize cooling performance, improve energy efficiency, increase capacity utilization, and enhance operational resiliency in mission-critical data centers. Support business development activities through proposal preparation, technical presentations, and preferably carry out client engagement related to data center thermal management and CFD solutions. Develop and maintain documentation for CFD simulations and procedures. Develop CFD project proposals and labor estimates. description:

 Key Responsibilities Support HVAC and plumbing design activities for greenfield and brownfield data center projects from concept development and basis of design through detailed engineering, construction support, commissioning, and closeout.
