Coordinate HVAC and plumbing requirements with architectural, structural, electrical, fire protection, controls, civil, process piping, security, telecommunications, BIM, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams. Support the mechanical team in design-related decisions and coordinate with clients, internal project teams, and global engineering offices to help resolve design issues, project milestones, deliverable priorities, and open technical items. Support design reviews for technical quality, code compliance, energy performance, constructability, maintainability, commissioning readiness, interdisciplinary coordination, and alignment with client standards. Support vendor and contractor coordination, including technical bid reviews, equipment evaluations, RFIs, shop-drawing and submittal reviews, field changes, site observations, functional testing, commissioning, and startup support. Perform site assessments of existing data center HVAC and plumbing infrastructure, identify capacity, reliability, or maintainability constraints, and develop practical recommendations for improvement or expansion.

Minimum 4 years of relevant HVAC and plumbing design experience, preferably including data centers, mission-critical facilities, semiconductor facilities, advanced manufacturing, power, or other high-availability infrastructure. Strong knowledge of data center cooling architectures, ventilation, pressurization, filtration, humidity control, hydronic systems, heat rejection, controls, equipment-room ventilation, and electrical-room cooling. Strong understanding of plumbing systems, including domestic water, sanitary waste and vent, storm drainage, condensate and equipment drainage, emergency fixtures, plumbing fixtures, and water-heating systems. Working knowledge of applicable international and local standards, including ASHRAE standards and guidelines, NFPA, SMACNA, IMC, IPC, and relevant energy and building codes. Experience preparing and reviewing design criteria, calculations, drawings, specifications, schedules, datasheets, technical evaluations, sequences of operation, and design reports. Strong fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, psychrometrics, ductwork, piping, controls, and mechanical equipment selection. Hands-on experience with HVAC load-calculation and analysis software such as HAP, ELITE, TRACE, IES VE, or equivalent tools. Strong written and verbal communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and technical coordination skills in a fast-paced global delivery environment. 
 Preferred Qualifications Professional Engineer registration, Chartered Engineer status, or an equivalent professional certification. Experience with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, modular, or edge data center projects. description:

description:
Job Description Manager - Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery 
 Kraft Heinz Global Business Services | Continuous Improvement Six Sigma Green Belt | Process Discovery Lead | GBS Towers: ATR, AP, Commercial Ops, SCM & More Job Title Manager - Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery Department Global Business Services (GBS) - Continuous Improvement CoE Reports To Senior Manager - Continuous Improvement Location GBS GCC Ahemdabad Six Sigma Requirement Certified Green Belt (GB) - Required; Black Belt aspirant preferred Travel Up to 20% POSITION OVERVIEW The Manager of Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery is a hands-on practitioner and team lead who drives process discovery and improvement initiatives across assigned GBS FnA towers. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role owns the end-to-end execution of Six Sigma projects, facilitates process discovery workshops, produces high-quality process documentation, and coaches Analysts. The Manager bridges strategic direction with operational delivery, ensuring GBS towers continuously evolve toward leaner, more efficient models. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Process Discovery & Improvement Execution - Lead full-cycle DMAIC projects for assigned GBS towers (ATR, S2P, RTR, Commercial Ops, SCM), from charter definition through Control phase. - Facilitate SIPOC, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Swimlane, and Process Flow mapping workshops with tower SMEs and operations teams. - Document current-state (as-is) processes and develop future-state (to-be) blueprints with gap analysis and improvement recommendations. - Apply Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, FMEA, Root Cause Analysis) to identify and eliminate waste across transactional processes. - Build and maintain the GBS process library (SOP-level documentation) in collaboration with tower leads. Data Analysis & Performance Measurement - Collect and analyze process performance data using statistical methods (control charts, Pareto analysis, Fishbone, hypothesis testing). - Build and maintain KPI dashboards to track process health, improvement adoption, and project benefits realization. - Partner with GBS Data & Analytics teams to leverage process mining tools and ERP data for baseline measurement. Team Leadership & Analyst Development - Supervise and develop 2-4 CI Analysts; assign workstreams, review deliverables, and provide structured coaching. - Guide Analysts through process mapping assignments and quality-check documentation for accuracy and completeness. - Support Analyst Yellow Belt and Green Belt certification journeys through project guidance and knowledge transfer. Stakeholder Collaboration - Engage tower process owners, operations leads, and functional SMEs to gather inputs, validate findings, and drive buy-in for improvements. - Prepare and present project updates, workshop findings, and improvement proposals to Senior Manager and tower leadership. - Coordinate with IT/automation teams to align process redesigns with digitalization and RPA pipeline. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelors degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or Supply Chain. - Certified Six Sigma Green Belt (ASQ, IASSC, or equivalent) - mandatory. - 5-8 years of relevant experience in process improvement, operations, or business analysis. - Minimum 2-3 years in a GBS, Shared Services, SSC, or BPO environment. - Hands-on experience facilitating VSM, SIPOC, and Process Mapping sessions. - Proficiency in process documentation tools (Visio, Lucidchart, ARIS, Signavio, or Bizagi). - Strong data analysis skills; working knowledge of Minitab, Excel (advanced), or similar tools. - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Six Sigma Black Belt certification or active pursuit. - Exposure to process mining tools (Celonis, UiPath Process Mining). - Experience with ERP platforms (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) in an ATR or AP context. - Lean certification or Kaizen facilitation experience. - Experience in FMCG, CPG, or Kraft Heinz GBS environment. COMPETENCIES & BEHAVIORS - Strong facilitation skills - ability to lead structured workshops with diverse, cross-functional participants. - Analytical mindset with a practical, results-oriented approach to problem solving. - Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate process complexity into simple documentation. - Collaborative team player who builds trust with operations teams and fosters a CI culture. - Detail-oriented with high standards for documentation quality and process rigor. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS KPI Target DMAIC projects completed per year 4 closed projects / year Process maps delivered (as-is + to-be) 10 per tower per year On-time project milestone delivery 90% Savings / efficiency contribution per project > $100K average Analyst performance rating (direct reports) Meets expectations, 100% Stakeholder Satisfaction (Tower level surveys) 4.5 / 5 Location(s) Ahmedabad - Venus Stratum GCC

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
Software Engineer (Full Stack) Maersk is hiring Software Engineers who can work across the stack to join the Visibility Platform team. The platform answers the questions "where is my shipment" and "when will I get it" with a high level of accuracy and timeliness. It is powered by tons of data from multiple sources, and this role provides an opportunity to innovate on how the right subset of that data is processed, served and presented to users in the right context. 
 About the role In this role, you will work on a greenfield project that aims to provide increased quality of visibility into the movements of containerised shipments and associated attributes like delays, extra charges incurred, emissions, etc. You will lead and own the features you pick up from first prototype to production, working across the tech stack. You will move comfortably between the front-end and the back-end, using modern coding agents to move fast and teammates for review and guidance. 
 Here are some of the things the role involves: - Independently lead and own the design, delivery and long-term health of the features and services you build. - Contribute freely to both the web front-end and the back-end services, using coding agents to explore unfamiliar code, produce working changes, and learn conventions as you go. Take responsibility for what you ship, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft. - Work closely with the UX and product team to iterate and provide feedback on mocks and designs and how well they solve user problems. - Build quick prototypes for exploring concepts. Be happy to throw some away and evolve others into solutions that are maintainable for a long time. - Work backwards from the mocks and help design API structures that can power the views in an efficient and performant manner. Where existing APIs can be limiting, help explore alternate options in design that dont degrade the originally intended user experience. - While building views, care deeply about semantic HTML, accessibility and rendering performance, often with each going hand-in-hand with the other. - While building services, build event driven applications and microservice-based APIs with a lot of focus on scalability, reliability and secure practices from the ground up. - Work with Maersks design system conventions and ensure consistency in design language across multiple micro-applications. Know when the conventions can be limiting and be comfortable stepping out of them. - Ensure hygiene practices like test coverage, performance profiling, security checks etc. are put in place and gated with automated checks. - Ensure applications emit the standard signals needed for effective monitoring and alerting. - Actively participate in code reviews and encourage using them as a tool for team members to learn from each other. Review agent-assisted changes with the same rigour as any other. - Contribute to a culture of continuous delivery where the path from code commit to going live is as automated as it can be. - Work in an inclusive manner with team members across geographies, time zones and cultures. About you Here are some things we expect from you for the role. Minimum qualifications - Be highly proficient with either the back-end or the front-end, as described below. This is the minimum bar, and you should be able to independently lead and own delivery of major components, pages or services there with very little hand-holding. - Back-end: Java or Kotlin and a framework like Spring Boot, with experience building event driven applications and microservice-based APIs that handle a huge amount of data. - Front-end: Vue, React, Svelte or Angular, TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design. We mainly use Vue, so be open to it. - Be able to contribute across the other side with the help of coding agents: enough familiarity to read the code, judge what an agent produces, write and run tests, and know when to ask a teammate for a second pair of eyes. - Be adept at using modern LLM-based coding agents (like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to increase quality and speed of work, including giving them good context, verifying their output, and recognising when they are going wrong. - Be highly proficient with a test framework like JUnit or Jest, and be a natural at always maintaining high test coverage for any code written. - Be familiar with analysing the algorithmic complexity of code, common design patterns and when to use them. - Be familiar with at least one relational and one NoSQL database, and with observability concepts: logging, metrics, traces and alerts. - Be familiar with cloud computing concepts and able to put them into practice, with experience in at least one of Azure, Google Cloud or AWS. - Be familiar with a build system like Webpack, and with Node. js and the npm ecosystem. Be aware of common reusable open-source libraries, and mindful of not causing bloated dependencies. - Be open to deep dives into new areas of the tech stack and learn new skills on the go. - Be a stickler for developer productivity, and always be on the lookout to get things done more efficiently. - Be effective at written and spoken communication. Also exhibit the same in writing code that can be well understood by other developers. Preferred qualifications - Be highly proficient on both sides: the back-end and the front-end described above, rather than one with agent-assisted contribution to the other. - Be familiar with browser-based testing frameworks like Cypress to automate end-to-end user workflow tests, and with Core Web Vitals and how to build pages that render blazing fast, with measurements set up to be monitored continuously. - Have an eye for extracting patterns for reusability that help ensure consistency across multiple applications. - Previous experience working with visual elements like maps and charts that help display a massive amount of data in aggregated form. - Prior experience working with Kafka, or with containerised 12-factor apps and tools like Docker and Kubernetes. - Knowledge about the logistics and supply chain domain. . .

description:

Data Engineer Our Technology team is the backbone of our company, constantly creating, testing, learning, and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you re in the right place. Job Summary As a Data Engineer on our Data & AI/ML team, you will own the cloud-scale data backbone that powers our entire company. Data isn't just a part of our business; it is the fuel for our advanced machine learning models. You will build and optimize systems that process billions of events daily. With the most advanced big data and AI technologies at your fingertips, you will unlock the insights needed to understand, meet, and anticipate the needs of our customers. title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
Job Summary AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members. The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Position expectations Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search and bring interesting developments back to the team Qualifications 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it Nice to Have Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries Familiarity with Jira and related tools Success measures In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

About Chegg
Chegg is a student-first learning and skilling company focused on helping learners build confidence, develop practical skills, and achieve better outcomes. Our teams use technology, data, and thoughtful product experiences to make learning and skill development more accessible, useful, and effective for learners around the world.
About the Role
As a CloudOps Engineer II, you will help build, operate, and improve secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to automate infrastructure, support deployments, strengthen observability, troubleshoot production issues, and reduce operational toil.
 Shift requirement: This role requires participation in a rotating shift schedule within a four-person group, covering both day and night shifts. Candidates must be willing and able to work both shifts as scheduled.
What Youll Do
 Design, provision, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other automation practices. Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines that enable safe, frequent software delivery. Administer and troubleshoot systems across development, staging, and production environments. Create Python or Bash automation to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency. Implement and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting to support system health and rapid incident detection. Respond to production incidents, contribute to root-cause analysis, and drive follow-up remediation. Review cloud resources for security, reliability, performance, scalability, and cost optimization. Partner with engineering and security teams on deployments, capacity planning, and infrastructure design. Maintain clear runbooks, operational procedures, and infrastructure documentation. Required Qualifications
 2+ years of hands-on experience in CloudOps, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role. Strong practical experience working with the AWS Cloud. Practical systems troubleshooting skills, with a working understanding of networking concepts in cloud environments. Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform. Proficiency in automation or scripting; Python is preferred, and Bash experience is valuable. Working knowledge of CI/CD and monitoring or observability platforms; experience with GitLab CI/CD is preferred. Strong understanding of DevOps principles and cloud operations practices. Ability to work calmly through production issues, collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and continuously learn and adopt new technologies. Hands-on experience with Docker. Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Amazon ECS, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS. Exposure to cloud security, secrets management, vulnerability management, or compliance practices. Familiarity with AWS cost optimization or FinOps principles. Relevant AWS certification or experience in a consumer-facing technology company. Comfort using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve day-to-day productivity. Join Us

Implement reliable data synchronization using transactional outbox, change data capture (CDC), or controlled incremental processing patterns as appropriate. Ensure Oracle database transactions and synchronization events are consistently captured. Implement retry mechanisms, duplicate-safe processing, checkpoint management, and failure recovery. Maintain data consistency between Oracle PaaS and PostgreSQL. Develop reconciliation processes to identify missing, failed, or inconsistent records. Support replay and reprocessing of failed synchronization transactions. Monitor synchronization delays, processing status, and data completeness. 4. Flat File Generation and Enable SFTP Integration Develop Java-based batch services to extract and process data from PostgreSQL. Implement business rules for data filtering, transformation, aggregation, and mapping. Generate CSV, delimited, or other Enable-approved flat-file formats. Implement file naming conventions, header/trailer records, record counts, and control totals where required. Validate file structure, completeness, accuracy, and duplicate prevention. Implement secure SFTP file transmission to the Enable platform. Develop file transfer logging, delivery status tracking, retry, and recovery mechanisms. Implement file archiving, retention, and audit controls. Support reconciliation between source records, generated files, and vendor acknowledgments where available. Develop Java batch jobs that can be triggered and managed through UC4/Automic. 6. GCP Deployment and Application Support Develop containerized Java services for deployment on Google Cloud Platform. Work with cloud infrastructure teams to configure application environments, connectivity, and security. Support integration with GCP services such as Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, and Cloud Logging. Implement secure connectivity between AWS Kafka, Oracle PaaS, PostgreSQL, and Enable SFTP. Support CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and production deployments. Troubleshoot performance, connectivity, and integration failures. 7. Testing and Quality Assurance Test Kafka message processing, database persistence, asynchronous synchronization, and file generation. Validate duplicate handling, retry processing, failure recovery, and data reconciliation. Support QA, SIT, E2E, and UAT testing. Document technical designs, interface mappings, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks. Experience consuming Kafka topics hosted in AWS from applications deployed in GCP. Knowledge of Oracle PaaS environments and connectivity. Experience with UC4/Automic scheduling and enterprise batch orchestration. Experience implementing financial data interfaces and reconciliation controls. Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud observability. Experience with SFTP. Understanding of SOX controls, audit trails, data retention, and financial data security. Key Competencies Strong understanding of distributed systems and enterprise integration architecture. Ability to design reliable, fault-tolerant, and recoverable data processing solutions.  JOB REQUIREMENT (SKILLS): 
 • Accountable and resilient • Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service. • Ability to work under pressure. • Flexibility to work as part of the team • Able to work accurately with an eye for details 
 JOB PURPOSE: 
 Ensure that all procedural requirements and formalities in connection with the Admission of patients are quickly and satisfactory completed to enable them to get admitted within the shortest possible time after their arrival in the hospital. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES: 
 • Close and continuous monitoring of outstanding cases. • Timely referral of cases for obtaining concessions. • Furnish statistical data relating to admission/ Data analysis of outstanding recoveries/necessary statistical inputs etc. for information of Management and Finance Department for preparation of revenue budget and forecasts. • Objective evaluation of Individual staff performance and counseling them periodically. • Monitors monthly employee schedule ( Officer, Supervisors ,clerks, receptionist and attendant ) • Motivating staff to carry out routine activities and develop special skills for better patient/relative service delivery as well educating them about the time management, professional etiquette, adaptability of computer usage etc. • Developing job profiles and reviews if the position is being replaced. • Study to enhance the processes, reduce waiting time and increase capacity utilization. • Prepare monthly duty roster of staff. • To keep a track of optimal utilization of beds. • To take care of needs and comforts of the patient, while awaiting admission. • Ensure that the patients are provided with all the information along with the leaflets and booklets pertaining to the hospital, the services provided by the hospital and the rules and regulations of the hospital. • Ensure that billing/ refund action is completed well in time, so that the patient/the relatives need not have to wait long by settlement of Accounts and final discharge should be made to appear as a smooth , swift and pleasant experience to the patient/ relatives. • Checking of invoices is raised on credit parties to ensure that they are supported by relevant back up papers before dispatching them to the costing department. Since the normal permissible credit period is one month from the date of receipt of invoices by the credit party, it is essential that invoices are dispatched within two days after the discharge of the patients. • Ensure that after tallying the credit cards and Cheque collection, their statement are sent to accounts. • Render assistance whenever manpower shortage is experienced in any area due to staff absenteeism etc. so that the operative functions go on smoothly. • Provision of indenting of stationary items from General stores on periodical basis. • Assign extra or special duties to staff whenever is required. • To maintain liaison with the sister-in-charge and unit clerk of the patient floors to know the general nature and extent of treatment given , in order to ensure that the expenses already incurred on the treatment of the patients are always well within the advance amounts collected from them. • Sending the complete TPA/corporate files on time to finance department. • Coordinating with corporate for resolving the queries regarding the admission or the procedure. • Ensuring all the reports are properly send to report dispatch and the department is functioning smoothly. • Ensure the smooth admission, OPD procedures for the High profile patients. • To be part of the Quality Improvement initiative and protocols of the organization.

Communication: communicate findings, model limitations, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences. Production hand-off: partner with AI/ML Engineers and Data Engineers to productionize validated models, defining the handoff contract features, retraining cadence, monitoring requirements. Mentorship: mentor junior data scientists/analysts on statistical rigor, experiment design, and modeling best practices. Strong foundation in statistics hypothesis testing, experiment design, causal inference and classical/modern ML techniques. Strong communication skills able to explain statistical/modeling concepts and their limitations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. description:
CloudOps Engineer II
 Location: Jasola, Delhi
 
About Chegg
Chegg is a student-first learning and skilling company focused on helping learners build confidence, develop practical skills, and achieve better outcomes. Our teams use technology, data, and thoughtful product experiences to make learning and skill development more accessible, useful, and effective for learners around the world.
About the Role
As a CloudOps Engineer II, you will help build, operate, and improve secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to automate infrastructure, support deployments, strengthen observability, troubleshoot production issues, and reduce operational toil.
 Shift requirement: This role requires participation in a rotating shift schedule within a four-person group, covering both day and night shifts. Candidates must be willing and able to work both shifts as scheduled.
What Youll Do
 Design, provision, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other automation practices. Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines that enable safe, frequent software delivery. Administer and troubleshoot systems across development, staging, and production environments. Create Python or Bash automation to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency. Implement and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting to support system health and rapid incident detection. Respond to production incidents, contribute to root-cause analysis, and drive follow-up remediation. Review cloud resources for security, reliability, performance, scalability, and cost optimization. Partner with engineering and security teams on deployments, capacity planning, and infrastructure design. Maintain clear runbooks, operational procedures, and infrastructure documentation. Required Qualifications
 2+ years of hands-on experience in CloudOps, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role. Strong practical experience working with the AWS Cloud. Practical systems troubleshooting skills, with a working understanding of networking concepts in cloud environments. Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform. Proficiency in automation or scripting; Python is preferred, and Bash experience is valuable. Working knowledge of CI/CD and monitoring or observability platforms; experience with GitLab CI/CD is preferred. Strong understanding of DevOps principles and cloud operations practices. Ability to work calmly through production issues, collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and continuously learn and adopt new technologies. Hands-on experience with Docker. Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Amazon ECS, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS. Exposure to cloud security, secrets management, vulnerability management, or compliance practices. Familiarity with AWS cost optimization or FinOps principles. Relevant AWS certification or experience in a consumer-facing technology company. Comfort using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve day-to-day productivity. Join Us
If you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to build reliable cloud platforms while continuously learning and adopting new technologies, we would like to hear from you. Join Chegg and help shape technology that supports learning and skilling for learners around the world.

title: Manager - Continuous Improvement
description:
Job Description Manager - Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery 
 Kraft Heinz Global Business Services | Continuous Improvement Six Sigma Green Belt | Process Discovery Lead | GBS Towers: ATR, AP, Commercial Ops, SCM & More Job Title Manager - Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery Department Global Business Services (GBS) - Continuous Improvement CoE Reports To Senior Manager - Continuous Improvement Location GBS GCC Ahemdabad Six Sigma Requirement Certified Green Belt (GB) - Required; Black Belt aspirant preferred Travel Up to 20% POSITION OVERVIEW The Manager of Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery is a hands-on practitioner and team lead who drives process discovery and improvement initiatives across assigned GBS FnA towers. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role owns the end-to-end execution of Six Sigma projects, facilitates process discovery workshops, produces high-quality process documentation, and coaches Analysts. title: National Collection Manager
description:
About MobiKwik 
MobiKwik is India's leading digital banking platform, offering a wide range of financial products for both consumers and merchants - including payments, digital credit, and investments. As a technology-first company, it leverages big data analytics and deep data science (including machine learning) to continuously delight users and merchants on its platform. The Company's mission is to build world-class financial products for Bharat! 
Founded in 2009 by Bipin Preet Singh and Upasana Taku, MobiKwik has 140 million+ registered users across a 3.7 million strong merchant network. With 40 million credit pre-approved users, MobiKwik is focused on providing India's underserved population their first access to credit -democratising financial services for a billion Indians. 
 Role Overview 
 Position: Senior Collections Manager (NCM) Location: Gurgaon Department: Collections & Recovery 
As Senior Collections Manager at MobiKwik, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimising the collections process for our Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) and digital lending portfolio. You will drive timely recovery of outstanding balances while upholding customer dignity and ensuring strict compliance with RBI's Fair Practices Code and relevant regulatory guidelines. The role demands a strategic mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and an unwavering commitment to ethical collections conduct. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Collections Strategy & Portfolio Management 
 Develop and implement comprehensive collections strategies aligned with company goals and RBI regulatory requirements. Analyse portfolio performance, bucket-wise delinquency trends, and market conditions to identify opportunities for improving collections efficiency. Collaborate with senior management to set achievable recovery targets and build data-driven action plans. Define segmentation-based strategies for different borrower profiles - MSMEs, merchants, digital-first customers across DPD buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+). 2. Team Leadership & Performance Management 
 Lead, mentor, and coach a team of collection executives and field agents to optimise individual and team performance. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide structured feedback, and identify training needs - including mandatory Fair Practices training. Foster a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, and continuous improvement within the collections department. Ensure all team members are trained on RBI's Code of Conduct for recovery agents before deployment. 3. Operations Management 
 Oversee day-to-day collections operations including outbound dialling, digital collection nudges, field visits, payment processing, and account reconciliation. Implement robust processes and controls to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and recovery agent guidelines. Leverage technology, diallers, and data analytics to streamline workflows, improve RPC rates, and enhance collections outcomes. Manage vendor/agency relationships for outsourced collections, ensuring contractual compliance and RBI-prescribed conduct standards. 4. Customer Engagement & Grievance Management 
 Proactively engage with borrowers to understand their financial situations, communicate empathetically, and negotiate feasible repayment arrangements. Handle escalated customer inquiries and complaints with professionalism, ensuring resolution within timelines prescribed under RBI's Integrated Ombudsman Scheme. Maintain and periodically review a documented Customer Grievance Redressal mechanism aligned with RBI Fair Practices Code. Ensure all borrower communication is conducted only during permissible hours (8 AM to 7 PM) as per RBI guidelines, without any form of harassment or intimidation. 5. Reporting, Analytics & Risk Controls 
 Track and report KPIs including collection efficiency ratio, RPC rate, roll rates, resolution rate, and recovery rate across DPD buckets. Prepare regular MIS reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting performance trends and areas for optimisation. Conduct root cause analysis of delinquent accounts and implement corrective actions to minimise future losses. Ensure maintenance of call recordings and field visit logs for regulatory audit readiness. 
 Code of Conduct RBI Compliance Expectations 
As a Senior Collections Manager at a regulated NBFC/Fintech, adherence to the RBI's prescribed Code of Conduct for recovery agents is a non-negotiable condition of employment. The incumbent is expected to:
 Ensure that all recovery agents (internal and outsourced) are duly trained and certified before being deployed for collections, in accordance with RBI's Recovery Agent Guidelines. Maintain a list of authorised recovery agents and share it with the company's Compliance and Nodal Officer; ensure the list is updated with every change. Ensure agents carry and present a duly authorised identity card at all times during field visits. Prohibit any recovery practice that amounts to harassment, intimidation, threats, or use of abusive language whether in person, via call, SMS, email, or any digital channel. Ensure all borrower communication occurs only within RBI-prescribed hours (8 AM - 7 PM) unless the borrower explicitly consents otherwise; no exceptions. Prohibit contact with any person other than the borrower or their authorised representative for recovery purposes, except for tracing purposes and strictly within legal bounds. Ensure borrowers are provided with a clear notice before any recovery action, specifying the amount due, the consequences of non-payment, and the name and contact details of the recovery agent. Maintain detailed records of all collection interactions calls, visits, messages for a minimum period as specified by RBI, to facilitate audit and grievance resolution. Ensure that all collection-related communications (notices, settlement letters, receipts) are factually accurate, clearly worded, and free from misleading statements. Prohibit engagement of any recovery agent who has been found guilty of any offence involving moral turpitude or has been blacklisted by any regulated financial entity. Uphold borrower privacy no disclosure of personal financial information to unauthorised third parties, family members, or employers without explicit borrower consent. Report any violations of the Code of Conduct by agents or staff immediately to the Compliance Officer and ensure appropriate disciplinary action. Cooperate fully with RBI inspections, audits, or inquiries related to collections practices, and ensure timely submission of required data and documents. Support the implementation and periodic review of the company's Board-approved Fair Practices Code, ensuring collections policies remain aligned with evolving RBI circulars. 
 Note: Non-compliance with RBI's Code of Conduct for Recovery Agents may attract regulatory penalties for the organisation and will be treated as a serious disciplinary matter for the incumbent. 
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 10 - 15 years of experience in collections management, preferably within fintech, NBFC, or banking (digital lending, MCA, or SME credit preferred). Proven track record of leading large collections teams (50+ headcount) and consistently achieving recovery targets in a high-volume environment. Graduate/Postgraduate in Business, Finance, or related field; MBA preferred. Familiarity with RBI's regulatory framework: Fair Practices Code, FLDG guidelines, Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, and Recovery Agent Certification requirements. Skills & Competencies 
 Deep understanding of collections regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices in the Indian lending ecosystem. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills. Ability to analyse complex delinquency data, derive actionable insights, and make data-driven decisions. Experience with collections technology platforms - diallers, CRMs, LMS integration, and digital nudge tools. High integrity with a demonstrated commitment to ethical collections practices and regulatory compliance. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders - legal, risk, operations, and technology teams - with clarity and purpose. Why MobiKwik? 
 Be part of India's digital lending story at scale - 40 million pre-approved credit customers. Work in a fast-paced, data-first environment with strong cross-functional collaboration. Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives. A leadership role with direct impact on portfolio quality and business outcomes. Exposure to the full spectrum of fintech collectionsn- digital nudges, field operations, legal, and policy.

Chegg is a student-first learning and skilling company focused on helping learners build confidence, develop practical skills, and achieve better outcomes. About the Role
As a CloudOps Engineer II, you will help build, operate, and improve secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to automate infrastructure, support deployments, strengthen observability, troubleshoot production issues, and reduce operational toil.

Administer and troubleshoot systems across development, staging, and production environments. Create Python or Bash automation to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency. Implement and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting to support system health and rapid incident detection. Proficiency in automation or scripting; Python is preferred, and Bash experience is valuable. Working knowledge of CI/CD and monitoring or observability platforms; experience with GitLab CI/CD is preferred. Strong understanding of DevOps principles and cloud operations practices. Ability to work calmly through production issues, collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and continuously learn and adopt new technologies. Hands-on experience with Docker. Familiarity with AWS cost optimization or FinOps principles. Relevant AWS certification or experience in a consumer-facing technology company. title: Electronic FPGA Engineer
description:
Your tasks Design & implement FPGA logic in VHDL for Xilinx Artix-7 devices using Vivado, adhering to coding standards and design reviews. Develop finite state machines to control and sequence hardware interfaces and protocols reliably. Create low-level driver logic for I C, SPI (and other simple serial interfaces), including initialisation, transaction handling, and error conditions. Write and maintain test benches (self-checking where practical), conduct functional and timing simulations, and document verification results. Perform hardware bring-up and validation, including lab testing, measurements, and iterative debug; collaborate on board-level constraints and interface timing. Manage constraints (XDC), clocking, resets, and CDC analysis; achieve timing closure and generate production-ready bitstreams. Contribute to requirements capture, architecture design, module specifications, and DFT/DFM considerations for FPGA-based systems. Maintain configuration management (SVN), branching/release processes, and traceability to requirements. Produce and maintain technical documentation: design descriptions, registers/interfaces, test procedures, and change logs. Participate in design and code reviews, support system integration, and assist production/field teams with issue triage. Support continuous improvement of FPGA design flows, test coverage, and automation (e.g., Tcl/Python scripts). Your profile Degree or equivalent experience in Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline. Strong hands-on experience with VHDL for FPGA design and verification. Proven experience targeting Xilinx Artix-7 families; confident using Vivado (project setup, constraints, synthesis, place & route, timing closure, bitstream generation). Ability to design deterministic finite state machines (FSMs) for control/driver logic. Experience implementing and validating low-level embedded interfaces: I C, SPI, UART (desirable), including bus arbitration, timing, and protocol edge cases. Competence in writing self-checking test benches and performing simulation (e.g., using Vivado simulator). Experience testing on hardware: bringing up boards, using logic analysers/oscilloscopes, debugging timing/constraint issues, and validating firmware in-system. Understanding of timing constraints (XDC), clock domain crossing (CDC), metastability, resets, and synchronous design best practices. Familiarity with version control (e.g., SVN). Optional but beneficial: knowledge of PCB-level considerations, signal integrity, and simple scripting (Tcl/Python) to automate flows. Typically 3+ years in FPGA development within a product or R&D environment (or demonstrable equivalent). Track record of delivering FPGA features/modules from requirements through to validated hardware. Experience collaborating with electronics engineers and embedded software engineers for system integration. Clear communicator with strong documentation habits (design specs, interface descriptions, test plans, release notes). Methodical problem-solver with attention to detail; able to work independently and in cross-functional teams. Ownership mindset with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and testability.  We have an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture within the business.

title: Data Sc
description:
Key Responsibilities Problem framing: partner with product and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined, testable data science problems. Analysis: conduct exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, and statistical analysis to generate and validate insights that inform product/business decisions. Model development: design, build, train, and validate machine learning models classification, regression, clustering, time series, or NLP depending on team focus to solve defined business problems. Experimentation: design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, causal inference methods) to measure the real-world impact of product and model changes. Validation rigor: rigorously validate model performance using appropriate metrics, back-testing, and out-of-sample validation before recommending production deployment. Communication: communicate findings, model limitations, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences. Production hand-off: partner with AI/ML Engineers and Data Engineers to productionize validated models, defining the handoff contract features, retraining cadence, monitoring requirements. Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. Complete management responsibilities to include performance management, hiring and coaching of staff, and resource planning. Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization s policies, procedures, and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems. Ensure all staff is provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible. Ensure all staff is provided with frequent feedback and coaching in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently. Manage and encourage new ideas from staff to foster improvements through innovations. Empower the staff to be accountable and responsible for their own actions and decisions. All other duties as assigned. Requirements Experience with technologies mainly focused on Java and Springboot background in addition to Gen AI exposure. Background in the healthcare space or related field is an added advantage with atleast 4+ years of team lead or engineering management experience with Proven track record of effectively developing direct reports through continual feedback and goal-setting and growing them through the ranks of an engineering organization. Advanced understanding of modern software development practices and methodologies, and the ability to roll up your sleeves and contribute when necessary Experience directly working on or managing teams working on production systems and high-volume applications, successfully navigating the relationship between Engineering, Product, and Design teams with collaboration, mentoring, learning from other engineers, and treating colleagues with empathy and respect. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with all stakeholders, internal drive to problem-solve, both creatively and pragmatically to scope, prioritize, and deliver on project commitments and learn new technologies quickly. Strong skills in setting, communicating, implementing, and achieving business objectives and goals through the direct management of others. Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity. Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine: Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains Polished technical communications Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time. The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs. This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB. Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Cool things you'll do 
 MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem What you need 
 You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes: Communicator: Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations) Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability Collaborator: Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts Problem Solver: Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos Technical Expert: Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP Builder: Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDBs technical relationship with marquee customers Product evangelism: The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems 

 Bonus Points 
 Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL) Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures Microservices/Serverless architectures CI/CD tools and approaches Containerization, orchestration and management tools Enterprise Identity platforms Experience using or managing MongoDB Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering 

 Success Measures 
 In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects
